attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the environmental permit or authorization obtained for seismic acquisition activities on this line. Required for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Environmental Permitting Standards

attributes.name: fold_coverage
attributes.description: Number of times a subsurface point is sampled by different source-receiver pairs. Higher fold improves signal-to-noise ratio and data quality.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: hse_incident_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Count
attributes.description: Number of HSE incidents recorded during acquisition of this seismic line. Used for safety performance tracking and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) - Incident Reporting Standards

attributes.name: interpretation_status
attributes.description: Current status of geological and geophysical interpretation for this seismic line: not started, in progress, preliminary, final, approved, or archived.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - G&G Interpretation Standards

attributes.name: line_length_km
attributes.description: Total length of the seismic line measured in kilometers. Represents the physical extent of the acquisition line on the surface or subsurface.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: line_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or identifier for the seismic line as assigned during acquisition planning. Used for operational reference and G&G interpretation workflows.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Data Management Standards

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Unique line number or code assigned within the survey. May follow contractor or operator naming conventions (e.g., L-1001, IL-2500).
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Data Management Standards

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classification of the seismic line by acquisition geometry: 2D (single line), 3D inline, 3D crossline, 4D (time-lapse), VSP (Vertical Seismic Profile), or walkaway VSP.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this seismic line record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO 8601) - Date and Time Format

attributes.name: play_type
attributes.description: Geological play type targeted by this seismic line (e.g., structural trap, stratigraphic trap, combination trap). Supports prospect classification and resource assessment.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: processing_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when seismic data processing was completed and final processed data was delivered.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Processing Standards

attributes.name: processing_contractor
attributes.description: Name of the contractor or service company responsible for processing the seismic data for this line.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Processing Standards

attributes.name: processing_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Processing Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for processing the seismic data for this line, measured in USD. Includes contractor fees and computational resources. Used for CAPEX tracking and AFE management.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Accounting Standards

attributes.name: processing_sequence
attributes.description: Description of the seismic data processing workflow applied to this line. May include steps such as deconvolution, stacking, migration, filtering, and noise attenuation.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Processing Standards

attributes.name: receiver_spacing_m
attributes.description: Distance between successive receiver stations (geophones or hydrophones) along the line, measured in meters. Determines spatial resolution of the acquired data.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: record_length_ms
attributes.description: Total recording time for each seismic trace in milliseconds. Defines the temporal extent of data captured per shot point.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special considerations related to this seismic line. May include acquisition challenges, data quality issues, or interpretation insights.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Data Management Standards

attributes.name: sample_interval_ms
attributes.description: Time interval between successive samples in the seismic trace, measured in milliseconds. Determines the temporal resolution of the acquired data.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: shot_point_end
attributes.description: Ending shot point number for the seismic line. Defines the end of the acquisition sequence along the line.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: shot_point_start
attributes.description: Starting shot point number for the seismic line. Defines the beginning of the acquisition sequence along the line.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: source_interval_m
attributes.description: Spacing between successive seismic source points along the line, measured in meters. Affects spatial sampling and data quality.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Type of energy source used for seismic acquisition: dynamite, vibroseis, airgun, watergun, sparker, or weight drop. Determines the signal characteristics and environmental considerations.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: start_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the starting point of the seismic line in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial positioning and mapping.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO 6709) - Geographic Coordinates

attributes.name: start_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the starting point of the seismic line in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial positioning and mapping.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO 6709) - Geographic Coordinates

products.name: well_log
products.description: Master record for all subsurface data acquired from exploration and appraisal wells. Covers wireline logs (GR, resistivity, neutron-density, sonic, image), LWD/MWD logs, rock core samples (conventional and sidewall, with routine and SCAL analysis including porosity, permeability, fluid saturation, lithology), reservoir fluid samples (PVT — API gravity, GOR, saturation pressure, viscosity), and geochemical samples (TOC, vitrinite reflectance, hydrogen/oxygen index, thermal maturity). Captures data type, run/sample number, depth interval (MD/TVD), acquisition tool/method, quality flag, analytical results, sample condition, storage location, and data format (LAS/DLIS). Serves as the consolidated G&G data inventory for subsurface interpretation and formation evaluation. Integrates with Landmark DecisionSpace log analysis and Petrel property modeling workflows.

attributes.name: well_log_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the well log record. Primary key for subsurface data acquisition records from exploration and appraisal wells.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - subsurface data management standards

attributes.name: exploration_well_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exploration or appraisal well from which this log or sample was acquired. Links to the well master record.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - well identification standards

attributes.name: formation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.formation. Business justification: Well logs are acquired from specific stratigraphic formations. Currently well_log has formation_name (STRING); this should be replaced with a FK to the formation master table to ensure consistent form

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.reservoir. Business justification: Well logs from appraisal/delineation wells characterize reservoir properties (porosity, permeability, saturation). Essential for reservoir modeling, volumetric calculations, and petrophysical analysis

attributes.name: service_company_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Wireline service companies (Schlumberger, Halliburton, Baker Hughes) are major vendors - critical for vendor performance tracking, invoice validation, and contract compliance. Role prefix reflects wir

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the log was run or the sample was collected downhole. Critical for correlating with drilling timeline and formation conditions.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data acquisition timestamp standards

attributes.name: acquisition_tool
attributes.description: Name or model of the logging tool, coring equipment, or sampling device used. Examples: Schlumberger Platform Express, Halliburton Rotary Sidewall Coring Tool, Baker Hughes Reservoir Description Tool.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - logging tool taxonomy

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of reservoir fluid sample. Measure of petroleum density relative to water. Higher values indicate lighter, more valuable crude oil.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - crude oil classification standards

attributes.name: api_well_number
attributes.description: Standardized API well number assigned by regulatory authority. Unique identifier for the well in North American jurisdictions.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) Bulletin D12A - well numbering system

attributes.name: bottom_depth_md
attributes.description: Ending depth of the log interval or sample location along the wellbore path, measured from surface. Defines the lower boundary of the logged or sampled interval.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - depth measurement standards

attributes.name: bottom_depth_tvd
attributes.description: Ending depth of the log interval or sample location measured vertically from surface. Used for subsurface mapping and reservoir depth determination.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - depth measurement standards

attributes.name: bubble_point_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bubble Point Pressure Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Pressure at which gas begins to come out of solution from the oil. Key parameter for reservoir simulation and production optimization.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PVT property standards

attributes.name: cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost of acquiring the log or sample, including service company charges, rig time, and laboratory analysis. Used for AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) tracking and well economics.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - well cost accounting standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this well log record was first created in the data management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - date and time format standard

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Confidentiality level of the subsurface data. Restricted data may be subject to JOA (Joint Operating Agreement) confidentiality clauses or regulatory disclosure restrictions.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data security standards

attributes.name: data_format
attributes.description: Digital file format of the log data. LAS (Log ASCII Standard) and DLIS (Digital Log Interchange Standard) are industry standards for wireline logs. ASCII, PDF, and TIFF used for reports and images.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - log data exchange standards

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Assessment of the technical quality and reliability of the acquired data. Influences confidence in petrophysical interpretation and formation evaluation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data quality assessment standards

attributes.name: depth_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for depth values. Feet (ft) is standard in North America; meters (m) is standard internationally.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - measurement unit standards

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Network or cloud storage path to the digital log file or analytical report. Enables retrieval of raw data for reprocessing and interpretation. Business-confidential data location.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data management standards

attributes.name: gor
attributes.description: Gas-Oil Ratio from PVT (Pressure Volume Temperature) analysis. Volume of gas produced per volume of oil at standard conditions. Critical for production facility design and reserves classification.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PVT analysis standards

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_saturation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pore space occupied by oil or gas. Calculated as 100 minus water saturation. Critical for OOIP (Original Oil in Place) and OGIP (Original Gas in Place) calculations.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - reserves estimation standards

attributes.name: interpretation_date
attributes.description: Date when the petrophysical interpretation or analytical results were finalized. Tracks data maturity and version control.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data lifecycle standards

attributes.name: interpretation_status
attributes.description: Stage of petrophysical interpretation and quality control. Raw data has not been interpreted; final data has been reviewed by geoscientists and approved for reserves estimation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data workflow standards

attributes.name: interpreted_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the petrophysicist or geoscientist who performed the log interpretation or sample analysis. Supports data lineage and quality assurance.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data governance standards

attributes.name: lithology
attributes.description: Rock type identified from core description or log interpretation. Examples: sandstone, limestone, dolomite, shale, siltstone. Fundamental for reservoir characterization.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - lithology classification standards

attributes.name: log_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the log or sample. For wireline: GR (Gamma Ray), resistivity, neutron-density, sonic, image logs. For core: conventional core, sidewall core. For fluid: PVT (Pressure Volume Temperature) sample, DST (Drill Stem Test) sample. For geochemical: TOC (Total Organic Carbon), vitrinite reflectance, Rock-Eval pyrolysis.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - log type taxonomy

attributes.name: log_type
attributes.description: Category of subsurface data acquisition. Wireline logs are run after drilling; LWD (Logging While Drilling) and MWD (Measurement While Drilling) are real-time; core samples are physical rock specimens; fluid samples are reservoir fluids; geochemical samples are for source rock analysis.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - petrophysical data classification

attributes.name: permeability_md
attributes.description: Measured permeability of core sample in millidarcies. Indicates the rock's ability to transmit fluids. Key parameter for reservoir deliverability and production forecasting.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - core analysis standards

attributes.name: porosity_percent
attributes.description: Measured or calculated porosity of the rock sample or logged interval. Represents the percentage of pore space available for hydrocarbon storage. Critical for reservoir quality assessment.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - petrophysical property standards

attributes.name: quality_comments
attributes.description: Free-text notes on data quality issues, acquisition problems, environmental corrections applied, or interpretation caveats. Provides context for data users.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - data documentation standards

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this log or sample data has been submitted to regulatory authorities (BSEE, BOEM, state oil and gas commissions) as part of drilling permit compliance or reserves reporting.
attributes.references: BSEE (Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement) - data submission requirements

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Sequential number for multiple logging runs or sample acquisitions in the same well. Differentiates repeat runs or multiple sampling events.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - logging run identification

attributes.name: sample_condition
attributes.description: Current physical state and availability of the core or fluid sample. Preserved samples are available for future analysis; depleted samples have been consumed by testing.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - sample management standards

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location where core or fluid samples are stored. May reference core warehouse facility, laboratory, or archive center. Business-confidential asset location.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - sample custody standards

attributes.name: toc_percent
attributes.description: Total Organic Carbon content of source rock sample. Indicates hydrocarbon generation potential. Key parameter for unconventional resource assessment.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - geochemical analysis standards

attributes.name: top_depth_md
attributes.description: Starting depth of the log interval or sample location along the wellbore path, measured from surface (kelly bushing or rotary table). Expressed in feet or meters.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - depth measurement standards

attributes.name: top_depth_tvd
attributes.description: Starting depth of the log interval or sample location measured vertically from surface. Critical for subsurface correlation and structural interpretation in deviated wells.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - depth measurement standards

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this record. Supports data governance and change management.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this well log record was last modified. Tracks data currency and version history for interpretation updates.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - date and time format standard

attributes.name: viscosity_cp
attributes.description: Fluid viscosity measured in centipoise at reservoir conditions. Affects flow behavior and recovery efficiency. Critical for heavy oil and EOR (Enhanced Oil Recovery) evaluation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - fluid property standards

attributes.name: vitrinite_reflectance
attributes.description: Vitrinite reflectance measurement indicating thermal maturity of source rock. Values >0.6% indicate oil generation window; >1.3% indicates gas generation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - thermal maturity assessment standards

attributes.name: water_saturation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pore space occupied by formation water. Complement of hydrocarbon saturation. Derived from resistivity logs or core analysis.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - petrophysical evaluation standards

products.name: formation
products.description: Reference master for stratigraphic formations and reservoir units relevant to exploration targeting and well evaluation. Captures formation name, stratigraphic age (period/epoch/stage), lithology type, depositional environment, average thickness, regional extent, source rock indicator flag, reservoir quality classification (I/II/III/IV), type section reference, and correlation to regional chronostratigraphic chart. Used for consistent stratigraphic nomenclature across G&G interpretation, prospect evaluation, well targeting, and cross-basin correlation studies. Aligns with AAPG stratigraphic nomenclature standards and ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart.

attributes.name: formation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stratigraphic formation record. Primary key for the formation master reference table.

attributes.name: average_permeability_md
attributes.description: Average permeability of the formation measured in millidarcies (mD). Critical for production forecasting, well completion design, and EOR (Enhanced Oil Recovery) feasibility assessment.
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: average_porosity_percent
attributes.description: Average porosity of the formation expressed as a percentage. Key petrophysical parameter for reservoir volumetrics and EUR (Estimated Ultimate Recovery) calculations.
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: average_thickness_ft
attributes.description: Average gross thickness of the formation measured in feet across its regional extent. Used for volumetric calculations, STOIIP (Stock Tank Oil Initially in Place) and OGIP (Original Gas in Place) estimates, and well planning.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: base_marker
attributes.description: Stratigraphic or seismic marker used to identify the base boundary of the formation. Used in conjunction with the top marker to define the formation interval in subsurface models.

attributes.name: chronostratigraphic_chart_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regional or international chronostratigraphic chart used for age correlation. Ensures consistency with ICS (International Commission on Stratigraphy) standards and regional basin frameworks.

attributes.name: completion_type_recommendation
attributes.description: Recommended well completion strategy for the formation (e.g., openhole, cased-hole perforation, horizontal multi-stage fracturing, gravel pack). Based on reservoir characteristics and production optimization studies.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary data source or system from which the formation attributes were derived (e.g., Landmark DecisionSpace, Schlumberger Petrel, regional geological survey, published literature). Supports data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: depositional_environment
attributes.description: Sedimentary environment in which the formation was deposited (e.g., marine shelf, deltaic, fluvial, lacustrine, deep marine, aeolian). Influences reservoir architecture, connectivity, and hydrocarbon distribution patterns.

attributes.name: drilling_hazard_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting known drilling hazards associated with the formation (e.g., overpressure, lost circulation zones, H2S presence, unstable shales). Critical for well planning and AFE (Authorization for Expenditure) risk assessment.
attributes.references: API RP 96 Deepwater Well Design and Construction

attributes.name: eur_estimate_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Estimated Ultimate Recovery per well for the formation, expressed in BOE (Barrels of Oil Equivalent). Used for economic evaluation, reserves booking, and portfolio ranking.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: exploration_maturity
attributes.description: Maturity level of exploration activity in the formation. Frontier = minimal data; Emerging = early exploration; Mature = well-understood with production history; Depleted = late-life or abandoned.

attributes.name: formation_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code or abbreviation for the formation used in well logs, seismic interpretation, and subsurface mapping. Enables rapid identification in operational systems such as Landmark DecisionSpace and Schlumberger Petrel.

attributes.name: formation_name
attributes.description: Official stratigraphic name of the geological formation following AAPG (American Association of Petroleum Geologists) nomenclature standards. Used for consistent identification across G&G (Geological and Geophysical) interpretation, prospect evaluation, and well targeting.

attributes.name: formation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the formation record. Active = in use for exploration and well planning; Inactive = no longer targeted; Under Review = pending geological re-evaluation; Deprecated = superseded by updated nomenclature.

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_type
attributes.description: Primary hydrocarbon type produced or expected from the formation. Used for play typing, prospect evaluation, and reserves classification under PRMS (Petroleum Resources Management System) standards.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date when the formation record was last updated or reviewed. Ensures data currency and supports audit trails for regulatory compliance and internal quality control.

attributes.name: lithology_type
attributes.description: Primary rock type or lithological composition of the formation. Critical for reservoir quality assessment, drilling hazard identification, and petrophysical modeling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sandstone|shale|limestone|dolomite|siltstone|conglomerate|chalk|marl|evaporite|coal|mixed — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 40 Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: net_to_gross_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of net reservoir thickness to gross formation thickness, expressed as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0). Indicates the proportion of the formation that is productive reservoir rock versus non-reservoir intervals.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: play_type
attributes.description: Exploration play type associated with the formation (e.g., structural trap, stratigraphic trap, combination trap, unconventional resource play). Used for prospect classification and portfolio management.

attributes.name: prms_resource_class
attributes.description: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) classification of resources associated with the formation. 1P = Proved Reserves, 2P = Proved plus Probable, 3P = Proved plus Probable plus Possible. Aligns with SPE/SEC reserves reporting standards.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: regional_extent
attributes.description: Geographic or basin-scale distribution of the formation (e.g., Gulf Coast Basin, Permian Basin, North Sea). Defines the area over which the formation is recognized and correlated.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes regarding the formation, including special geological features, correlation challenges, or operational considerations. Supports knowledge capture and cross-functional collaboration.

attributes.name: reservoir_quality_class
attributes.description: Reservoir quality classification based on porosity, permeability, and net-to-gross ratio. Class I represents excellent reservoir quality; Class IV represents poor quality; Non-Reservoir indicates non-productive intervals.

attributes.name: seal_quality
attributes.description: Assessment of the overlying seal or cap rock quality that prevents hydrocarbon migration. Critical for trap integrity evaluation and risk assessment in prospect generation.

attributes.name: source_rock_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the formation is recognized as a hydrocarbon source rock. True if the formation has demonstrated source rock potential based on TOC (Total Organic Carbon), maturity, and geochemical analysis.

attributes.name: stratigraphic_age_epoch
attributes.description: Geological epoch subdivision within the period (e.g., Early Cretaceous, Late Jurassic). Provides finer temporal resolution for stratigraphic correlation and basin analysis.

attributes.name: stratigraphic_age_period
attributes.description: Geological time period during which the formation was deposited (e.g., Jurassic, Cretaceous, Permian). Aligns with the ICS (International Commission on Stratigraphy) International Chronostratigraphic Chart.

attributes.name: stratigraphic_age_stage
attributes.description: Geological stage within the epoch (e.g., Albian, Aptian, Turonian). Finest level of chronostratigraphic resolution used for detailed correlation studies and regional play analysis.

attributes.name: thickness_range_max_ft
attributes.description: Maximum observed thickness of the formation in feet. Represents the upper bound of thickness variability, often associated with basin depocenters or structural lows.

attributes.name: thickness_range_min_ft
attributes.description: Minimum observed thickness of the formation in feet. Represents the lower bound of thickness variability across the basin or play fairway.

attributes.name: top_marker
attributes.description: Stratigraphic or seismic marker used to identify the top boundary of the formation in well logs and seismic data. Enables consistent correlation across wells and seismic surveys.

attributes.name: type_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the type section or stratotype location where the formation was originally defined and described. Provides the authoritative reference for stratigraphic nomenclature and correlation.

products.name: block
products.description: Master record for exploration license blocks and concession areas. Captures block name/number, country, offshore/onshore flag, water depth range, block area (sq km), license round, award date, expiration date, relinquishment schedule, minimum work program obligations (seismic km, well count), and regulatory body. Serves as the geographic unit for exploration activity organization — prospects, wells, surveys, and partner interests are all located within blocks. Links to basin for regional context. Integrates with Quorum Land System for license tracking.

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: Primary key for block

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Exploration blocks often contain production facilities; business needs this for block-level production reporting, joint venture accounting, infrastructure planning, and regulatory submissions. Role pr

attributes.name: basin_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sedimentary basin in which this block is located. Links to basin master data for regional geological context and play fairway analysis.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) - Basin Classification Standards

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company or entity designated as the operator for exploration activities in this block. The operator is responsible for day-to-day operations and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA), Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Exploration blocks are cost centers in oil-and-gas accounting; all block-related costs (seismic, G&G, lease maintenance) are tracked to specific cost centers for budgeting, variance analysis, and JV b

attributes.name: exploration_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.license. Business justification: Block should reference its parent exploration license. A block is awarded as part of a license, and license-level attributes (award_date, expiration_date, license_status, license_round) should be retr

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Exploration blocks are operated under Joint Operating Agreements when multiple parties hold working interests. JOA governs cost-sharing, voting rights, and operational decisions for all block activiti

attributes.name: joint_venture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint venture or partnership arrangement under which the block is being explored. Links to joint venture master data for partner tracking and cost allocation.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA), Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS)

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Exploration blocks are often subdivided into or overlap with leases. Regulatory filings, work program commitments, and commercial tracking require linking blocks to specific lease agreements for right

attributes.name: operating_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.operating_license. Business justification: Exploration blocks are governed by operating licenses (PSAs, concessions) defining authorized activities, work programs, and fiscal terms. Legal framework for block operations. Links block to its gove

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: International exploration blocks often operate under Production Sharing Agreements defining fiscal terms, cost recovery, and profit split. Links block-level exploration activities to PSA cost recovery

attributes.name: area_sq_km
attributes.description: Total geographic area of the exploration block in square kilometers as defined in the license agreement. Used for acreage tracking, relinquishment calculations, and work program planning.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Lease Area Standards

attributes.name: block_name
attributes.description: Common name or designation for the exploration block, often including geographic or regional identifiers for ease of reference.

attributes.name: block_number
attributes.description: Official block number or identifier assigned by the regulatory authority or licensing body. This is the externally-known business identifier used in regulatory filings, license agreements, and industry communications.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Block Numbering Standards, Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE)

attributes.name: cost_recovery_limit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of gross revenues that can be used for cost recovery under a PSA fiscal regime. Limits the contractors ability to recover exploration and development costs from production.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the sovereign jurisdiction in which the block is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this block record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a commercial hydrocarbon discovery has been made within the block. True if at least one discovery has been declared; false otherwise.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Discovery Classification

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exploration license becomes legally effective and operational activities may commence. May differ from award date due to regulatory approvals or contract execution timelines.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), Joint Operating Agreement (JOA)

attributes.name: environmental_sensitivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the block is located in or adjacent to an environmentally sensitive area requiring enhanced HSE protocols, such as marine protected areas, coral reefs, or critical habitats.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), International Organization for Standardization (ISO 14001)

attributes.name: first_discovery_date
attributes.description: Date of the first commercial hydrocarbon discovery within the block. Marks a significant milestone in the blocks exploration history and may trigger license extension or conversion rights.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), Regulatory Reporting Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_regime_type
attributes.description: Type of fiscal and contractual regime governing the exploration license. Determines cost recovery mechanisms, profit sharing, and taxation structures.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), International Fiscal Systems Standards

attributes.name: geological_risk_factor
attributes.description: Probability of geological success for the block, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1. Represents the chance of discovering commercial hydrocarbons based on play fairway analysis and geological risk assessment.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Risk Assessment Standards

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_type
attributes.description: Expected or discovered hydrocarbon type in the block. Indicates whether the block is prospective for oil, natural gas, condensate, or a mixed hydrocarbon system.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Hydrocarbon Classification

attributes.name: last_seismic_survey_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent seismic survey conducted over the block. Used to assess data currency and plan reprocessing or new acquisition campaigns.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this block record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data currency assessment.

attributes.name: minimum_work_program_seismic_km
attributes.description: Minimum number of kilometers of seismic survey data acquisition required under the exploration license work program. Represents a firm commitment to the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), Authorization for Expenditure (AFE)

attributes.name: minimum_work_program_well_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of exploration or appraisal wells required to be drilled under the exploration license work program. Represents a firm drilling commitment to the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), Authorization for Expenditure (AFE)

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest held by the company in this exploration block after deducting royalties and other burdens. NRI represents the actual economic share of production revenues.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA), Production Sharing Agreement (PSA)

attributes.name: offshore_onshore_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the block is located offshore (in marine waters) or onshore (on land). Critical for determining applicable regulatory frameworks, operational requirements, and cost structures.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE)

attributes.name: play_type
attributes.description: Geological play type or petroleum system classification for the block (e.g., structural trap, stratigraphic trap, combination trap). Used for portfolio segmentation and risk analysis.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) - Geological Classification Standards

attributes.name: primary_target_formation
attributes.description: Name of the primary geological formation or reservoir interval targeted for exploration drilling in this block. Represents the main prospective zone of interest.

attributes.name: prms_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the blocks resource potential according to the SPE PRMS framework. Indicates the maturity and certainty level of resource estimates (prospective resources, contingent resources, or reserves).
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS), U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

attributes.name: prospect_count
attributes.description: Number of identified prospects or leads within the block boundaries. Represents the inventory of drillable opportunities generated from geological and geophysical interpretation.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Prospect Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or regulatory authority responsible for administering the exploration license, enforcing compliance, and approving work programs for this block.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE), National Regulatory Authorities

attributes.name: relinquishment_schedule
attributes.description: Structured description of the mandatory relinquishment schedule specifying the percentage of block area that must be relinquished at defined intervals during the exploration term. Typically defined in the PSA or license agreement.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), Regulatory Compliance Framework

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or contextual information about the block that does not fit into structured fields. May include historical context, special conditions, or operational notes.

attributes.name: resource_potential_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Potential (Barrel of Oil Equivalent - BOE)
attributes.description: Estimated prospective resource potential of the block in barrels of oil equivalent. Represents the unrisked best estimate of recoverable hydrocarbons based on geological and geophysical analysis.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS)

attributes.name: royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Royalty rate percentage payable to the government or mineral rights owner on gross production from the block. Applicable under concession or royalty-based fiscal regimes.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA), Regulatory Fiscal Framework

attributes.name: seismic_data_availability
attributes.description: Indicates the type and extent of seismic survey data available for the block. Critical for prospect evaluation and drilling risk assessment.
attributes.references: Society of Exploration Geophysicists (SEG) - Seismic Data Standards

attributes.name: water_depth_max_m
attributes.description: Maximum water depth in meters within the block boundaries. Applicable only to offshore blocks. Critical for determining deepwater vs shallow water classification and associated technical challenges.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Bathymetric Standards

attributes.name: water_depth_min_m
attributes.description: Minimum water depth in meters within the block boundaries. Applicable only to offshore blocks. Used for drilling feasibility assessment and rig selection.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Bathymetric Standards

attributes.name: well_count
attributes.description: Total number of exploration, appraisal, or wildcat wells drilled within the block to date. Used for tracking drilling activity and work program compliance.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) - Well Classification Standards

attributes.name: working_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest held by the company in this exploration block. Working Interest represents the ownership share and corresponding obligation to fund exploration costs.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA), Production Sharing Agreement (PSA)

products.name: license
products.description: Master record for exploration licenses, permits, and concession agreements granted by regulatory authorities. Captures license number, license type (PSC, concession, JOA, license), issuing authority, effective date, expiry date, renewal options, work program commitments (seismic km, well count), bonus payments, royalty rate, and current status. SSOT for exploration entitlement and license compliance. Integrates with Quorum Land System.

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Primary key for license

attributes.name: basin_id
attributes.description: FK to exploration.basin

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: License acquisitions, renewals, and relinquishments require regulatory filings with authorities (SEC Form 10-K reserves disclosures, BOEM filings). Mandatory disclosure requirement. Links license to i

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Exploration licenses are cost objects; signature bonuses, work program commitments, and license maintenance costs are tracked to cost centers for accounting and JV partner billing. Required for cost c

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Exploration licenses with multiple interest holders operate under JOAs. Links license terms (regulatory) to JOA terms (commercial partnership). Required for tracking work program commitments, cost all

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.psa. Business justification: Exploration licenses in PSA jurisdictions are governed by PSA fiscal terms. Links regulatory license to commercial PSA for cost recovery eligibility, signature bonus tracking, and work program complia

attributes.name: acreage_gross
attributes.description: Total surface area covered by the exploration license in acres. Represents the full geographic extent of exploration rights regardless of working interest ownership.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - PRMS Area Definitions; Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Lease Acreage

attributes.name: acreage_net
attributes.description: Net acreage attributable to the company based on working interest (WI) percentage. Calculated as gross acreage multiplied by WI. Used for reserves reporting and portfolio valuation.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - PRMS Net Acreage; U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) - Reserves Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the exploration license is geographically located (e.g., USA, GBR, NOR). Used for regulatory jurisdiction and fiscal regime mapping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 - Country Codes; Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Jurisdiction Definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exploration license record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exploration license becomes legally binding and work program commitments commence. Marks the start of the license term.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Lease Effective Date; IFRS 6 - Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: environmental_assessment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) or Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) is required by the issuing authority before exploration activities can commence. True = assessment required; False = not required or already completed.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - NEPA Requirements; Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Environmental Review Process

attributes.name: environmental_assessment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the environmental assessment process. Tracks progress toward regulatory approval to commence exploration activities.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - NEPA Process; Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: estimated_resource_potential_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Resource Potential Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Estimated ultimate recovery (EUR) potential of the license area expressed in barrels of oil equivalent. Represents unrisked prospective resources (not yet classified as reserves). Used for portfolio valuation and investment prioritization.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) - Reserves Definitions

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exploration license term ends unless renewed or extended. After this date, all exploration rights revert to the issuing authority unless a production license is granted or renewal is approved.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Lease Expiration; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - PRMS License Term

attributes.name: geological_risk_factor
attributes.description: Probability of geological success (POS) for the license area, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1. Represents the likelihood that a prospect contains recoverable hydrocarbons. Used for risked resource valuation and portfolio optimization.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Risk Assessment Standards; American Association of Petroleum Geologists (AAPG) - Prospect Risking

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governmental or regulatory body that granted the exploration license (e.g., BOEM, state mineral board, national oil company, ministry of energy).
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM); Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE); Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC)

attributes.name: joint_venture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exploration license is held under a joint venture arrangement with multiple working interest partners. True = JV structure; False = single operator or non-JV arrangement.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Venture Accounting; American Petroleum Institute (API) - JOA Standards

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: Official license or permit number issued by the regulatory authority. This is the externally-known business identifier used in all regulatory correspondence and filings.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Lease and Grant Administration; Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) - Permit Requirements

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the exploration license. Active = in force and work program underway; Pending = application submitted awaiting approval; Suspended = temporarily halted by operator or regulator; Expired = term ended without renewal; Relinquished = voluntarily returned by operator; Terminated = cancelled by regulator or mutual agreement.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Lease Status Definitions; Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) - Compliance Status

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exploration entitlement. PSC = Production Sharing Contract, JOA = Joint Operating Agreement. Determines fiscal terms, ownership structure, and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); American Petroleum Institute (API) - Upstream Contracting Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the exploration license record was last updated in the system. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Format; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue the company is entitled to receive after deducting royalties, overriding royalty interests (ORRI), and government share. NRI = WI × (1 - royalty rate - ORRI).
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Revenue Interest Calculation; U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) - Reserves Disclosure

attributes.name: offshore_onshore_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exploration license covers offshore (subsea) or onshore (land-based) acreage. Determines applicable regulatory framework, HSE requirements, and operational complexity.
attributes.references: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) - Offshore vs Onshore Regulations; American Petroleum Institute (API) - Operational Standards

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company designated as the operator responsible for executing the exploration work program and managing day-to-day activities. The operator may or may not be the majority working interest holder.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Operating Agreement Standards; American Petroleum Institute (API) - Operator Responsibilities

attributes.name: operator_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operator entity. IOC = International Oil Company; NOC = National Oil Company; Independent = smaller independent E&P company; JV = Joint Venture entity.
attributes.references: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) - Operator Classification; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Industry Taxonomy

attributes.name: play_type
attributes.description: Geological play classification for the license area (e.g., structural trap, stratigraphic trap, unconventional shale, carbonate reef). Used for analog analysis and technical risk assessment.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Play Classification; American Association of Petroleum Geologists (AAPG) - Play Concepts

attributes.name: primary_target_formation
attributes.description: Name of the primary geological formation or reservoir interval targeted for exploration (e.g., Wolfcamp, Niobrara, Brent). Used for well planning and G&G correlation.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Stratigraphic Nomenclature; American Association of Petroleum Geologists (AAPG) - Formation Naming

attributes.name: prospect_count
attributes.description: Number of identified exploration prospects or leads within the license area based on G&G interpretation. Used for portfolio ranking and resource potential assessment.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - PRMS Prospect Definition; American Association of Petroleum Geologists (AAPG) - Prospect Evaluation

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the license agreement includes a contractual option to renew or extend the exploration term. True = renewal option exists; False = no renewal provision.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) - Upstream Contract Terms

attributes.name: renewal_term_years
attributes.description: Duration in years of the renewal or extension period if the renewal option is exercised. Null if no renewal option exists.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) - Upstream Contract Terms

attributes.name: resource_classification
attributes.description: PRMS-aligned classification of hydrocarbon resources within the license area. Prospective = undiscovered; Contingent = discovered but not yet commercial; Proved/Probable/Possible = reserves categories (1P/2P/3P).
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) - Reserves Classification

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of gross production or revenue payable to the mineral rights owner or government as royalty. Deducted from working interest to calculate net revenue interest.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Royalty Requirements; Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Royalty Accounting

attributes.name: seismic_data_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether 2D or 3D seismic data has been acquired and is available for interpretation within the license area. True = seismic data exists; False = no seismic coverage.
attributes.references: Society of Exploration Geophysicists (SEG) - Seismic Data Standards; Landmark DecisionSpace - Data Management

attributes.name: seismic_data_vintage_year
attributes.description: Year in which the most recent seismic survey was acquired for the license area. Used to assess data quality and determine need for reprocessing or new acquisition.
attributes.references: Society of Exploration Geophysicists (SEG) - Seismic Survey Standards

attributes.name: signature_bonus_amount
attributes.description: One-time upfront payment made to the issuing authority upon execution of the exploration license agreement. Typically non-refundable and independent of exploration success.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 - Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; American Petroleum Institute (API) - Upstream Fiscal Terms

attributes.name: signature_bonus_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the signature bonus payment (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this license data originated (e.g., Quorum Land System, Landmark DecisionSpace). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; NIST Cybersecurity Framework - Data Provenance

attributes.name: water_depth_max_meters
attributes.description: Maximum water depth in meters within the license area. Applicable only to offshore licenses. Critical for assessing technical feasibility and CAPEX requirements.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Bathymetric Data Standards; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Offshore Drilling Standards

attributes.name: water_depth_min_meters
attributes.description: Minimum water depth in meters within the license area. Applicable only to offshore licenses. Used for drilling rig selection and cost estimation.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Bathymetric Data Standards; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Offshore Drilling Standards

attributes.name: work_program_commitment_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of exploration activities (seismic, drilling, G&G studies) the operator is contractually obligated to spend during the license term. Used for AFE planning and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 - Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - AFE Standards

attributes.name: work_program_commitment_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the work program commitment amount.

attributes.name: work_program_seismic_km
attributes.description: Minimum number of kilometers of seismic survey (2D or 3D) the operator is contractually committed to acquire during the exploration phase. Failure to meet this commitment may result in penalties or license termination.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Exploration Plan Requirements; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Seismic Survey Standards

attributes.name: work_program_well_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of exploration or appraisal wells the operator is contractually committed to drill during the license term. Critical compliance metric tracked by regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) - Drilling Permit Requirements; American Petroleum Institute (API) - Well Planning Standards

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage ownership of operating rights and cost-bearing responsibility in the exploration license. WI holders fund exploration activities and receive production revenue net of royalties and government take.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Interest Billing; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - PRMS Ownership Definitions

products.name: prospect_resource_estimate
products.description: Transactional record capturing versioned prospect evaluations combining resource estimates and geological risk assessments. Stores estimate date, evaluator, methodology (volumetric, analog, simulation), low/mid/high case STOIIP/GIIP, recovery factor, EUR (1P/2P/3P), risked resource volumes, individual geological risk factor scores (reservoir presence/quality, trap integrity, seal effectiveness, charge adequacy, timing/migration), composite geological chance of success (GCoS), risk methodology (multiplicative/additive), economic risking parameters (EMV, risk-weighted NPV), PRMS resource category (Prospective/Contingent/Reserves with sub-classes), and peer review status. SSOT for all prospect-level risk and resource evaluation. Supports SEC reserves disclosure, SPE-PRMS 2018 compliance, investment decision gates, and portfolio risk management. Multiple versions per prospect track evaluation evolution over time.

attributes.name: prospect_resource_estimate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prospect resource estimate record. Primary key for this transactional evaluation entity.

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospect being evaluated. Links this resource estimate to the specific exploration prospect or play.

attributes.name: superseded_by_estimate_prospect_resource_estimate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer estimate version that supersedes this record. Enables version chain tracking and audit trail for estimate evolution.

attributes.name: charge_adequacy_risk_pct
attributes.description: Probability that sufficient hydrocarbon charge has migrated into the trap. Individual geological risk factor component.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for evaluator notes, assumptions, data quality observations, and technical commentary supporting the resource estimate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this resource estimate record was first created in the database. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: estimate_date
attributes.description: Date when this resource estimate was prepared. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this evaluation record.

attributes.name: estimate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this resource estimate version. Active is current, superseded indicates newer version exists, archived for historical record, withdrawn if invalidated.

attributes.name: estimate_version
attributes.description: Version number of this resource estimate. Multiple versions per prospect track evaluation evolution over time as new data becomes available.

attributes.name: eur_1p_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) One P (1P) Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Proved reserves (1P) estimated ultimate recovery in barrels of oil equivalent. Represents recoverable volumes with reasonable certainty per SEC and SPE-PRMS standards.

attributes.name: eur_2p_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Two P (2P) Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Proved plus probable reserves (2P) estimated ultimate recovery in barrels of oil equivalent. Represents best estimate of recoverable volumes per SPE-PRMS standards.

attributes.name: eur_3p_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) Three P (3P) Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Proved plus probable plus possible reserves (3P) estimated ultimate recovery in barrels of oil equivalent. Represents high-side estimate of recoverable volumes per SPE-PRMS standards.

attributes.name: evaluation_methodology
attributes.description: Technical methodology used to derive the resource estimate. Volumetric uses reservoir volume calculations, analog uses comparable field data, simulation uses reservoir modeling software.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Name of the geoscientist or engineer who prepared this resource estimate. Supports audit trail and technical accountability.

attributes.name: expected_monetary_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Monetary Value (EMV) United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Risk-weighted net present value of the prospect calculated as NPV multiplied by geological chance of success. Key metric for portfolio optimization and investment decisions.

attributes.name: geological_chance_of_success_pct
attributes.description: Composite probability that all geological risk factors are favorable and prospect contains commercial hydrocarbons. Calculated using risk methodology (multiplicative or additive).

attributes.name: giip_high_case_bcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Initially In Place (GIIP) High Case Billion Cubic Feet (BCF)
attributes.description: High case (P10) estimate of original gas in place in billion cubic feet. Represents optimistic scenario for gas prospects.

attributes.name: giip_low_case_bcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Initially In Place (GIIP) Low Case Billion Cubic Feet (BCF)
attributes.description: Low case (P90) estimate of original gas in place in billion cubic feet. Represents conservative scenario for gas prospects.

attributes.name: giip_mid_case_bcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Initially In Place (GIIP) Mid Case Billion Cubic Feet (BCF)
attributes.description: Mid case (P50) estimate of original gas in place in billion cubic feet. Represents best estimate scenario for gas prospects.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this resource estimate record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: peer_review_date
attributes.description: Date when peer review was completed. Tracks evaluation lifecycle and supports audit requirements.

attributes.name: peer_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of technical peer review process for this resource estimate. Ensures quality control and technical governance before investment decisions.

attributes.name: peer_reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of senior geoscientist or engineer who conducted peer review of this resource estimate. Supports technical accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: prms_resource_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) Resource Category
attributes.description: SPE-PRMS 2018 classification of resource maturity. Prospective resources are undiscovered, contingent resources are discovered but not yet commercial, reserves are discovered and commercial.

attributes.name: prms_resource_subclass
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) Resource Subclass
attributes.description: Detailed SPE-PRMS sub-classification. For prospective: play, lead, prospect. For reserves: PDP (proved developed producing), PDNP (proved developed non-producing), PUD (proved undeveloped).

attributes.name: recovery_factor_high_pct
attributes.description: High case recovery factor as percentage of OOIP or OGIP that can be economically produced. Optimistic estimate of reservoir producibility.

attributes.name: recovery_factor_low_pct
attributes.description: Low case recovery factor as percentage of OOIP or OGIP that can be economically produced. Conservative estimate of reservoir producibility.

attributes.name: recovery_factor_mid_pct
attributes.description: Mid case recovery factor as percentage of OOIP or OGIP that can be economically produced. Best estimate of reservoir producibility.

attributes.name: reservoir_presence_risk_pct
attributes.description: Probability that reservoir-quality rock is present at the prospect location. Individual geological risk factor component for chance of success calculation.

attributes.name: reservoir_quality_risk_pct
attributes.description: Probability that reservoir rock has sufficient porosity and permeability for commercial production. Individual geological risk factor component.

attributes.name: risk_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to combine individual geological risk factors into composite chance of success. Multiplicative multiplies all factors, additive uses weighted sum, hybrid combines both approaches.

attributes.name: risk_weighted_npv_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk-Weighted Net Present Value (NPV) United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Discounted cash flow value adjusted for geological and commercial risks. Used for economic ranking and capital allocation decisions.

attributes.name: risked_resource_high_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risked Resource High Case Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: High case recoverable resource volume adjusted by geological chance of success. Calculated as EUR high case multiplied by composite geological risk factor.

attributes.name: risked_resource_low_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risked Resource Low Case Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Low case recoverable resource volume adjusted by geological chance of success. Calculated as EUR low case multiplied by composite geological risk factor.

attributes.name: risked_resource_mid_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risked Resource Mid Case Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Mid case recoverable resource volume adjusted by geological chance of success. Calculated as EUR mid case multiplied by composite geological risk factor.

attributes.name: seal_effectiveness_risk_pct
attributes.description: Probability that cap rock or seal is present and effective to prevent hydrocarbon migration. Individual geological risk factor component.

attributes.name: stoiip_high_case_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Tank Oil Initially In Place (STOIIP) High Case Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: High case (P10) estimate of original oil in place in stock tank barrels. Represents optimistic scenario with 10% probability of exceeding this volume.

attributes.name: stoiip_low_case_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Tank Oil Initially In Place (STOIIP) Low Case Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Low case (P90) estimate of original oil in place in stock tank barrels. Represents conservative scenario with 90% probability of exceeding this volume.

attributes.name: stoiip_mid_case_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Tank Oil Initially In Place (STOIIP) Mid Case Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Mid case (P50) estimate of original oil in place in stock tank barrels. Represents best estimate scenario with 50% probability of exceeding this volume.

attributes.name: timing_migration_risk_pct
attributes.description: Probability that hydrocarbon generation, migration, and trap formation occurred in correct sequence. Individual geological risk factor component.

attributes.name: trap_integrity_risk_pct
attributes.description: Probability that structural or stratigraphic trap is present and intact to contain hydrocarbons. Individual geological risk factor component.

products.name: study
products.description: Master record for geological and geophysical (G&G) studies and interpretation work products. Covers basin analysis, AVO analysis, seismic attribute studies, source rock evaluation, structural interpretation, horizon and fault interpretation, depth conversion, and velocity modeling. Captures study title, study type, lead geoscientist, study period, software used (Petrel/DecisionSpace), interpretation method (manual/auto-tracking), key findings summary, confidence level, structural observations, and associated deliverables. SSOT for G&G intellectual work product inventory including seismic interpretation events. Integrates with Landmark DecisionSpace and Schlumberger Petrel.

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Primary key for study

attributes.name: basin_id

attributes.name: well_type

Supports reservoir characterization and G&G interpretation workflows.

attributes.name: core_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rock core sample record. Primary key for the core sample entity.
attributes.references: API RP 40 - Recommended Practices for Core Analysis

attributes.name: coring_contractor_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Coring contractors are specialized drilling service vendors - enables vendor performance tracking, cost analysis, and contract management for coring operations. Role prefix distinguishes from other dr

attributes.name: exploration_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the exploration or appraisal well from which this core sample was acquired.

attributes.name: formation_id
attributes.description: FK to exploration.formation

attributes.name: lease_id
