attributes.name: wellbore_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific wellbore from which the core was cut, supporting multi-lateral or sidetrack scenarios.

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the core analysis was completed by the laboratory.

attributes.name: analysis_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory or service company that performed the core analysis.

attributes.name: bottom_depth_md
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet or meters to the bottom of the core sample interval along the wellbore trajectory.

attributes.name: bottom_depth_tvd
attributes.description: True vertical depth in feet or meters to the bottom of the core sample interval, corrected for wellbore deviation.

attributes.name: bulk_density
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bulk Density Grams per Cubic Centimeter (g/cc)
attributes.description: Total density of the core sample including both rock matrix and pore fluids, in grams per cubic centimeter.

attributes.name: core_analysis_type
attributes.description: Type of laboratory analysis performed on the core sample. Routine analysis includes basic porosity and permeability; Special Core Analysis (SCAL) includes advanced tests like relative permeability and capillary pressure.

attributes.name: core_barrel_type
attributes.description: Type of core barrel used for the coring operation (e.g., conventional, wireline, rotary sidewall), affecting core quality and recovery.

attributes.name: core_diameter
attributes.description: Diameter of the core sample in inches or centimeters, determined by the core barrel size used.

attributes.name: core_length_cut
attributes.description: Total length of core attempted to be cut during the coring operation, in feet or meters.

attributes.name: core_length_recovered
attributes.description: Actual length of intact core recovered to surface, in feet or meters. Used to calculate core recovery percentage.

attributes.name: core_recovery_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of core recovered relative to the length cut, calculated as (core_length_recovered / core_length_cut) * 100. Key quality indicator for core data reliability.

attributes.name: core_run_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the coring operation run within the wellbore. Multiple core runs may occur at different depth intervals.

attributes.name: coring_date
attributes.description: Date when the core sample was physically cut and retrieved from the wellbore during drilling operations.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D12A - Drilling Event Documentation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this core sample record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depth_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all depth measurements in this core sample record.

attributes.name: fluid_saturation_gas
attributes.description: Percentage of pore space occupied by gas at the time of coring, measured through core analysis.

attributes.name: fluid_saturation_oil
attributes.description: Percentage of pore space occupied by oil at the time of coring, measured through core analysis.

attributes.name: fluid_saturation_water
attributes.description: Percentage of pore space occupied by water at the time of coring. Key input for Original Oil in Place (OOIP) calculations.

attributes.name: grain_density
attributes.business_glossary_term: Grain Density Grams per Cubic Centimeter (g/cc)
attributes.description: Density of the solid rock matrix in grams per cubic centimeter, excluding pore space. Used in porosity calculations.

attributes.name: lithology_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the rock characteristics including color, grain size, texture, sedimentary structures, and mineralogy observed by the geologist.

attributes.name: lithology_primary
attributes.description: Dominant rock type observed in the core sample based on visual and microscopic examination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sandstone|shale|limestone|dolomite|siltstone|conglomerate|coal|salt|anhydrite|chalk|marl|mudstone — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lithology_secondary
attributes.description: Secondary or interbedded rock type present in the core sample, if applicable.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this core sample record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: permeability_horizontal
attributes.description: Permeability measured parallel to bedding planes, in millidarcies. Important for understanding lateral fluid flow in the reservoir.

attributes.name: permeability_md
attributes.description: Measured permeability of the core sample in millidarcies, indicating the rocks ability to transmit fluids. Critical parameter for reservoir flow modeling.

attributes.name: permeability_vertical
attributes.description: Permeability measured perpendicular to bedding planes, in millidarcies. Critical for understanding vertical communication between reservoir layers.

attributes.name: porosity_percentage
attributes.description: Measured porosity of the core sample expressed as a percentage of total rock volume, representing the void space available for fluid storage.

attributes.name: preservation_method
attributes.description: Method used to preserve the core sample to maintain its original properties and prevent degradation.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or special conditions related to the core sample, coring operation, or analysis results.

attributes.name: sample_condition
attributes.description: Current physical condition of the core sample, assessing integrity and suitability for further analysis or re-examination.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this specific core sample for laboratory tracking and reference.

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the core sample indicating availability for analysis or disposition.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the core sample is stored, including facility name, warehouse, and bin/shelf identifier for retrieval.
attributes.references: API RP 40 - Core Storage and Preservation

attributes.name: top_depth_md
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet or meters to the top of the core sample interval along the wellbore trajectory.

attributes.name: top_depth_tvd
attributes.description: True vertical depth in feet or meters to the top of the core sample interval, corrected for wellbore deviation.

products.name: fluid_sample
products.description: Master record for reservoir fluid samples (PVT samples) collected during exploration well testing. Captures sample type (bottomhole/surface recombined), collection depth, collection date, reservoir temperature, reservoir pressure, fluid type (black oil/volatile oil/gas condensate/dry gas), API gravity, GOR, saturation pressure (bubble/dew point), viscosity, and PVT analysis laboratory. Feeds PVT modeling in reservoir domain.

attributes.name: fluid_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the reservoir fluid sample record. Primary key for the fluid sample entity.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade. Business justification: Exploration well fluid samples are matched to crude grades for assay comparison, refinery compatibility assessment, and marketing. Business process: crude assay programs link DST/sample data to tradea

attributes.name: exploration_well_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exploration or appraisal well from which this fluid sample was collected.
attributes.references: API RP 100 - Recommended Practice for Well Construction

attributes.name: formation_id
attributes.description: FK to exploration.formation

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Fluid samples are collected from wells on leased land. Ownership, regulatory reporting, and PVT analysis data rights are tied to lease agreements. Required for reservoir characterization and commercia

attributes.name: pvt_laboratory_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: PVT laboratories are analytical service vendors - critical for vendor qualification, quality control, and invoice validation for reservoir fluid analysis services. Role prefix reflects specialized lab

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reservoir or formation from which the fluid sample was obtained.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the liquid hydrocarbon phase, a measure of petroleum liquid density relative to water. Higher API gravity indicates lighter, less dense crude oil.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: c1_content_mole_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of methane (C1) in the fluid sample. Primary component of natural gas.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.1 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: c2_c5_content_mole_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ethane through Pentane (C2-C5) Content in Mole Percent
attributes.description: Combined mole percentage of ethane, propane, butane, and pentane in the fluid sample. These components constitute natural gas liquids (NGL).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.1 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: c6_plus_content_mole_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hexane Plus (C6+) Content in Mole Percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of hexane and heavier hydrocarbons in the fluid sample. Represents the heavier liquid hydrocarbon fraction.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.1 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: co2_content_mole_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Content in Mole Percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of carbon dioxide in the fluid sample. Important for corrosion assessment, processing requirements, and greenhouse gas accounting.
attributes.references: API RP 14E - Recommended Practice for Design and Installation of Offshore Production Platform Piping Systems

attributes.name: collected_by
attributes.description: Name of the person, crew, or contractor who collected the fluid sample.

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the fluid sample was collected from the well or formation.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: collection_depth_md_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collection Depth Measured Depth (MD) in Meters
attributes.description: Measured depth along the wellbore at which the fluid sample was collected, expressed in meters.
attributes.references: API RP 100 - Recommended Practice for Well Construction

attributes.name: collection_depth_tvd_m
attributes.business_glossary_term: Collection Depth True Vertical Depth (TVD) in Meters
attributes.description: True vertical depth below a reference datum (typically mean sea level or rotary kelly bushing) at which the fluid sample was collected, expressed in meters.
attributes.references: API RP 100 - Recommended Practice for Well Construction

attributes.name: contamination_type
attributes.description: Type of contamination detected in the fluid sample, if any. Common contaminants include drilling mud filtrate, completion fluids, or formation water.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fluid sample record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: fluid_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reservoir fluid based on phase behavior and hydrocarbon composition. Black oil: low shrinkage, low GOR; volatile oil: high shrinkage, high GOR; gas condensate: retrograde condensation; dry gas: primarily methane; wet gas: gas with liquid dropout.
attributes.references: SPE - Petroleum Fluid Phase Behavior Classification

attributes.name: gas_formation_volume_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of gas volume at reservoir conditions to gas volume at standard conditions. Accounts for pressure and temperature effects on gas volume.

attributes.name: gas_specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity of the gas phase relative to air (air = 1.0). Indicates the molecular weight and composition of the reservoir gas.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.1 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: gor_scf_stb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas-Oil Ratio (GOR) in Standard Cubic Feet per Stock Tank Barrel (SCF/STB)
attributes.description: Gas-oil ratio representing the volume of gas (at standard conditions) produced per barrel of oil (at stock tank conditions). Key parameter for reservoir fluid characterization and production forecasting.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Petroleum Resources Management System

attributes.name: h2s_content_mole_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Content in Mole Percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of hydrogen sulfide in the fluid sample. Critical for safety, corrosion management, and processing facility design.
attributes.references: API RP 55 - Recommended Practice for Oil and Gas Producing and Gas Processing Plant Operations Involving Hydrogen Sulfide

attributes.name: n2_content_mole_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of nitrogen in the fluid sample. Affects heating value and processing requirements.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.1 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: oil_formation_volume_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of oil volume at reservoir conditions to oil volume at stock tank conditions. Accounts for dissolved gas and thermal expansion effects.

attributes.name: oil_viscosity_cp
attributes.description: Dynamic viscosity of the oil phase at reservoir conditions, measured in centipoise. Critical parameter for reservoir simulation and production performance prediction.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: pvt_analysis_date
attributes.description: Date when the PVT laboratory analysis was completed.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: pvt_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the laboratory PVT analysis report document.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special conditions related to the fluid sample collection or analysis.

attributes.name: reservoir_pressure_psia
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reservoir Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch Absolute (PSIA)
attributes.description: Pressure of the reservoir at the sample collection depth, measured in pounds per square inch absolute. Critical input for PVT analysis and fluid phase behavior.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: reservoir_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the reservoir at the sample collection depth, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical input for PVT (Pressure Volume Temperature) analysis and phase behavior modeling.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or label assigned to the fluid sample for tracking and laboratory reference purposes.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: sample_quality_flag
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the fluid sample is representative of reservoir conditions or has been contaminated during collection or handling.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fluid sample from collection through laboratory analysis to archival.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fluid sample collection method. Bottomhole samples are collected downhole under reservoir conditions; surface recombined samples are reconstituted from separator gas and liquid; separator samples are collected at surface facilities; wellhead samples are collected at the wellhead; wireline formation tester samples are collected via formation testing tools.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: sample_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of the fluid sample collected, expressed in milliliters.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: sampling_tool_type
attributes.description: Type of downhole or surface sampling tool used to collect the fluid sample (e.g., wireline formation tester, drill stem test tool, separator sampling system).
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: saturation_pressure_psia
attributes.business_glossary_term: Saturation Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch Absolute (PSIA)
attributes.description: Bubble point pressure for oil systems or dew point pressure for gas condensate systems. The pressure at which the first gas bubble forms (oil) or first liquid droplet forms (gas condensate) during pressure decline.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: saturation_pressure_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the saturation pressure represents a bubble point (for oil systems) or dew point (for gas condensate systems).

attributes.name: solution_gas_oil_ratio_scf_stb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Solution Gas-Oil Ratio (Rs) in Standard Cubic Feet per Stock Tank Barrel (SCF/STB)
attributes.description: Volume of gas dissolved in oil at reservoir conditions, expressed as standard cubic feet of gas per stock tank barrel of oil. Key parameter for material balance calculations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fluid sample record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Water content in the fluid sample expressed in parts per million by weight. Important for hydrate formation prediction and processing design.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: lithology
attributes.description: Rock type or sediment composition of the sample (e.g., sandstone, shale, limestone, mudstone).

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the sample collection location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum).

attributes.name: measured_depth_m
attributes.description: Measured depth along the wellbore trajectory where the sample was collected, applicable for subsurface drilling samples.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the geochemical sample record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: oxygen_index_oi
attributes.description: Oxygen index from Rock-Eval pyrolysis, expressed as mg CO2/g TOC, used to classify kerogen type.

attributes.name: preservation_method
attributes.description: Method used to preserve the sample during transport and storage (e.g., refrigeration, freezing, chemical preservative).

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality control flag indicating whether the sample and analysis results meet quality standards.

attributes.name: s1_mg_hc_per_g_rock
attributes.description: S1 peak from Rock-Eval pyrolysis representing free hydrocarbons already present in the rock.

attributes.name: s2_mg_hc_per_g_rock
attributes.description: S2 peak from Rock-Eval pyrolysis representing hydrocarbons generated by thermal cracking of kerogen.

attributes.name: s3_mg_co2_per_g_rock
attributes.description: S3 peak from Rock-Eval pyrolysis representing CO2 generated from kerogen, used to calculate oxygen index.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the geochemical sample, typically assigned by the laboratory or field collection team.

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the geochemical sample in the laboratory and analysis workflow.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Classification of the geochemical sample based on the material collected (soil gas, water, cutting, core, outcrop, seep).

attributes.name: sample_weight_g
attributes.description: Weight of the geochemical sample in grams as received by the laboratory.

attributes.name: thermal_maturity_stage
attributes.description: Thermal maturity classification of the organic matter (immature, early mature, peak mature, late mature, post-mature, overmature).

attributes.name: tmax_celsius
attributes.description: Temperature at maximum hydrocarbon generation (Tmax) from Rock-Eval pyrolysis, a thermal maturity indicator.

attributes.name: toc_percent
attributes.description: Total organic carbon content of the sample expressed as weight percentage, a key indicator of source rock potential.

attributes.name: true_vertical_depth_m
attributes.description: True vertical depth from surface to the sample collection point, corrected for wellbore deviation.

attributes.name: vitrinite_reflectance_ro
attributes.description: Vitrinite reflectance measurement (Ro) indicating thermal maturity of organic matter, critical for hydrocarbon generation assessment.

products.name: discovery
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal declaration of a hydrocarbon discovery following a successful exploration well result. Captures discovery name, discovery date, discovery well reference, discovered fluid type (oil/gas/condensate), initial flow rate (IP), initial reservoir pressure, discovery depth, estimated in-place volumes (STOIIP/GIIP), PRMS resource classification at discovery, and regulatory notification date. SSOT for discovery events that trigger appraisal planning and reserves booking workflows.

attributes.name: discovery_id
attributes.description: Primary key for discovery

attributes.name: basin_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sedimentary basin containing the discovery.

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade. Business justification: Oil discoveries are characterized by crude grade (API, sulfur) for commerciality assessment and regulatory notification. Business process: discovery declarations to government specify crude grade for

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Discovery records require linkage to drilling execution for regulatory notification, reserves booking, AFE cost allocation, and commercial evaluation. Complements existing discovery_well_id (explorati

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead geologist responsible for the discovery evaluation and declaration.

attributes.name: license_block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exploration license or block within which the discovery was made.
attributes.references: BOEM Lease and Block Numbering System

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Discoveries must classify hydrocarbon product type (oil, gas, condensate, NGL) for reserve booking, regulatory reporting, and commerciality decisions. Real process: discovery evaluation reports specif

attributes.name: play_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geological play within which the discovery was made.

attributes.name: producing_well_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.well_asset. Business justification: Discovery events must link to producing well assets for reserves booking, commerciality declarations, regulatory notifications, and field development planning. Role prefix 'producing' distinguishes fr

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Discoveries that achieve commerciality become profit centers for P&L tracking; each discovery is tracked as a profit center for revenue, cost, and profitability reporting. Essential for asset-level fi

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prospect that was being tested when the discovery was made.

attributes.name: reservoir_formation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.formation. Business justification: Discoveries are made in specific reservoir formations. Currently discovery has reservoir_formation (STRING) and reservoir_age (STRING); these should be replaced with a FK to the formation master to en

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the discovered oil, indicating the density and quality of the crude oil. Higher values indicate lighter, more valuable crude.

attributes.name: commerciality_status
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the discovery is commercially viable for development based on technical and economic evaluation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the discovery is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the discovery record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depth_md_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Discovery Depth Measured Depth (MD) in Feet (ft)
attributes.description: Measured depth along the wellbore to the top of the discovered reservoir interval, measured in feet.

attributes.name: depth_tvd_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Discovery Depth True Vertical Depth (TVD) in Feet (ft)
attributes.description: True vertical depth from surface to the top of the discovered reservoir interval, measured in feet.
attributes.references: API RP 7G - Recommended Practice for Drill Stem Design and Operating Limits

attributes.name: discovery_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the discovery for internal tracking and regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Official date when the hydrocarbon discovery was formally declared, typically following successful well test results.

attributes.name: discovery_name
attributes.description: Official name assigned to the hydrocarbon discovery, typically reflecting geographic location or geological feature.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D12A - Naming Conventions for Oil and Gas Fields

attributes.name: discovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the discovery from initial declaration through appraisal to commercial determination.

attributes.name: eur_p10_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) P10 in Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent (MMBOE)
attributes.description: High estimate (P10) of the total recoverable hydrocarbon volume from the discovery, representing optimistic scenario.

attributes.name: eur_p50_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) P50 in Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent (MMBOE)
attributes.description: Best estimate (P50) of the total recoverable hydrocarbon volume from the discovery over its productive life, expressed in million barrels of oil equivalent.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS - Reserves and Resources Classification

attributes.name: eur_p90_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) P90 in Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent (MMBOE)
attributes.description: Low estimate (P90) of the total recoverable hydrocarbon volume from the discovery, representing conservative scenario.

attributes.name: fluid_type_detail
attributes.description: Detailed description of the discovered fluid characteristics including API gravity for oil or gas composition for gas discoveries.

attributes.name: giip_bcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Initially in Place (GIIP) in Billion Cubic Feet (Bcf)
attributes.description: Estimated volume of gas initially in place in the reservoir at discovery, expressed in billion cubic feet, before any production.

attributes.name: gor_scf_stb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas-Oil Ratio (GOR) in Standard Cubic Feet per Stock Tank Barrel (scf/stb)
attributes.description: Gas-oil ratio measured during the discovery well test, expressed as standard cubic feet of gas per stock tank barrel of oil.

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_saturation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of pore space filled with hydrocarbons in the discovered reservoir.

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_type
attributes.description: Primary type of hydrocarbon discovered (oil, natural gas, condensate, or associated gas).
attributes.references: API RP 40 - Recommended Practice for Core Analysis

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Rate in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Initial production rate of oil measured during the discovery well test, expressed in barrels of oil per day.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Recommended Practice for Sampling Petroleum Reservoir Fluids

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Rate in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD)
attributes.description: Initial production rate of gas measured during the discovery well test, expressed in thousand cubic feet per day.

attributes.name: initial_reservoir_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Reservoir Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Initial reservoir pressure measured during the discovery well test, expressed in pounds per square inch.
attributes.references: API RP 44 - Pressure Volume Temperature (PVT) Analysis

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the discovery record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_pay_thickness_ft
attributes.description: Thickness of the productive reservoir interval with sufficient porosity and hydrocarbon saturation, measured in feet.

attributes.name: permeability_md
attributes.description: Average permeability of the discovered reservoir, measured in millidarcies, indicating the ability of fluids to flow through the rock.

attributes.name: porosity_percent
attributes.description: Average porosity of the discovered reservoir, expressed as a percentage of total rock volume.

attributes.name: prms_maturity_subclass
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) Maturity Subclass
attributes.description: PRMS maturity subclass indicating the level of technical and commercial maturity (e.g., development pending, development on hold, development not viable).

attributes.name: prms_resource_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) Resource Class
attributes.description: PRMS classification of the discovered resources: 1P (proved), 2P (proved plus probable), 3P (proved plus probable plus possible), contingent, or prospective.

attributes.name: recovery_factor_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of in-place hydrocarbons that can be recovered from the discovery using primary and secondary recovery methods.

attributes.name: reservoir_temperature_f
attributes.description: Reservoir temperature measured at discovery depth, expressed in degrees Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: stoiip_mmbbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Stock Tank Oil Initially in Place (STOIIP) in Million Barrels (MMbbl)
attributes.description: Estimated volume of oil initially in place in the reservoir at discovery, expressed in million barrels, before any production.

attributes.name: water_depth_ft
attributes.description: Water depth at the discovery location for offshore discoveries, measured in feet. Null for onshore discoveries.

products.name: block_interest
products.description: Association record capturing working interest (WI) and participating interest ownership of exploration blocks and licenses by partner companies (IOCs, NOCs, independents). Captures partner company name, partner type (operator/non-operator), working interest percentage (WI%), net revenue interest (NRI%), carried interest flag, effective date, and partner approval status. Supports JOA/PSA partner management and JIB cost allocation for exploration activities. Complements the venture domain's JOA records.

attributes.name: block_interest_id
attributes.description: Primary key for block_interest

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: Reference to the exploration block or license area in which the partner holds interest. Links to the exploration block master data.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) governing the partners rights and obligations in the exploration block. Links to the JOA master data in the joint venture domain.

attributes.name: primary_block_commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner company (IOC, NOC, or independent) holding working interest in the exploration block. Links to the partner company master data.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) governing the partners rights and obligations in the exploration block. Links to the PSA master data in the joint venture domain. Null if JOA applies instead.

attributes.name: venture_working_interest_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.venture_working_interest. Business justification: Exploration block partner interests transition to production-phase venture working interests upon discovery/development. Links exploration-phase ownership to production-phase entitlements for continui

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Regulatory or joint venture approval status for the partners interest. Approved indicates all necessary approvals obtained; pending awaits decision; rejected indicates denial; conditional requires additional steps; not required if no approval needed.

attributes.name: area_of_mutual_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner is subject to an Area of Mutual Interest (AMI) clause (True), requiring them to offer participation to other partners for opportunities within a defined geographic area.

attributes.name: back_in_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of additional working interest the partner can acquire if back-in rights are exercised. Null if no back-in right exists.

attributes.name: back_in_right_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner has a back-in right (True) to increase their working interest upon commercial discovery or other triggering event.

attributes.name: billing_entity_code
attributes.description: Reference to the entity responsible for joint interest billing (JIB) for this partners share of exploration costs. Typically the operator. Links to the partner company master data.

attributes.name: carried_cost_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum amount in US dollars that the partner is carried for exploration costs. Null if not applicable or unlimited carry.

attributes.name: carried_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner is carried (True) or not carried (False) for exploration costs. Carried partners do not pay their proportionate share of costs until certain conditions are met (e.g., commercial discovery, payout).

attributes.name: carried_phase
attributes.description: Phase of operations during which the partner is carried. Common values include exploration, appraisal, development, production, or none if no carry arrangement exists.

attributes.name: consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partners explicit consent is required (True) for major exploration decisions (e.g., drilling authorization, AFE approval) or if majority vote suffices (False).

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which exploration costs are allocated to the partner. Proportionate allocates costs by working interest; carried exempts partner from costs; farmout applies to farmed-out interests; area of mutual interest applies to AMI arrangements.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction in which the exploration block is located. Used for regulatory and fiscal regime alignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this block interest record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: default_interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to overdue joint interest billing (JIB) payments. Specified in the JOA or PSA.
attributes.references: COPAS Joint Interest Billing Standards; JOA Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partners interest in the exploration block became effective. Typically the JOA or PSA execution date or regulatory approval date.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partners interest in the exploration block expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for indefinite or production-phase interests.

attributes.name: farmout_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partners interest was acquired via a farmout agreement (True), where the farmee earns interest by funding exploration activities on behalf of the farmor.

attributes.name: farmout_earn_in_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest the partner can earn by fulfilling farmout agreement obligations (e.g., drilling a well, funding seismic). Null if not a farmout arrangement.

attributes.name: fiscal_regime_type
attributes.description: Type of fiscal regime governing the exploration block. Concession (royalty/tax), PSC (Production Sharing Contract), RSC (Risk Service Contract), service contract, or hybrid.
attributes.references: SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); COPAS Standards

attributes.name: interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the partners interest in the exploration block. Active indicates current participation; pending awaits regulatory approval; suspended is temporarily inactive; relinquished or transferred indicates exit; expired indicates license expiration.
attributes.references: BOEM Lease Management; BSEE Regulatory Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this block interest record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest (NRI) held by the partner after deducting royalties, overriding royalty interest (ORRI), and other burdens. Represents the partners share of production revenue.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: non_consent_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner has the right to elect non-consent (True) on proposed exploration operations, thereby avoiding cost participation but forfeiting interest in the operation.

attributes.name: participating_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of participating interest in exploration activities and decision-making. May differ from working interest if carried interest arrangements exist.
attributes.references: PSA (Production Sharing Agreement) Standards; JOA Standards

attributes.name: partner_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the partner organization. IOC (International Oil Company), NOC (National Oil Company), independent, service company, government entity, or private equity.

attributes.name: partner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the partner role in the joint venture. Operator manages day-to-day operations; non-operator is a passive investor.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days within which the partner must pay their share of joint interest billings (JIB). Typically 30, 45, or 60 days per JOA terms.
attributes.references: COPAS Joint Interest Billing Standards; JOA Standards

attributes.name: preferential_right_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the partner has preferential rights (True) to acquire additional interest if another partner wishes to sell or relinquish their interest.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which regulatory authorities (BOEM, BSEE, or equivalent) approved the partners interest in the exploration block. Null if approval not required or still pending.
attributes.references: BOEM Lease Management; BSEE Regulatory Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory approval document or decision. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: relinquishment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner voluntarily relinquished their interest in the exploration block. Null if interest is still active or was transferred.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or clarifications regarding the partners interest in the exploration block.

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partners interest was transferred to another party. Null if interest is still held or was relinquished.

attributes.name: voting_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of voting rights held by the partner in joint venture decisions. May differ from working interest in some PSA or JOA structures.

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest (WI) held by the partner in the exploration block. Represents the partners share of capital expenditure (CAPEX) and operating expenditure (OPEX) obligations.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

products.name: well_result
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal post-drill well result evaluation for an exploration or appraisal well. Captures result date, well result classification (discovery/dry hole/shows only/technical success), pay zone summary (net pay thickness, number of pay intervals), hydrocarbon type encountered, pressure data (initial reservoir pressure, pressure gradient), formation evaluation summary, recommendation (appraise/develop/abandon), and post-drill resource estimate revision. Triggers prospect status update and discovery declaration workflow.

attributes.name: well_result_id
attributes.description: Primary key for well_result

attributes.name: evaluation_geologist_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tracks the geologist who performed post-drill evaluation. Essential for lessons-learned analysis, competency assessment, and discovery success tracking by individual. Replaces denormalized evaluation_

attributes.name: exploration_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the exploration or appraisal well that was drilled and evaluated. Links to the well master data product.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - Well Identification Standards

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Well results classify encountered hydrocarbons by product type for reserve booking and regulatory reporting. Business process: post-drill evaluation reports to government and JV partners specify produ

attributes.name: prospect_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the prospect that this well was drilled to test. Used to update prospect status and resource estimates post-drill.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PRMS standards

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this well result record is currently active and should be included in reporting and analytics. False indicates the record has been superseded or archived.

attributes.name: api_gravity_degrees
attributes.description: The API gravity of the crude oil sample, measured in degrees API. Higher values indicate lighter, more valuable crude. Measured from fluid samples collected during testing.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) - Crude Oil Characterization Standards

attributes.name: average_permeability_md
attributes.description: The arithmetic average permeability across all net pay intervals, measured in millidarcies. Derived from core analysis, well test analysis, or log-derived estimates. Critical for productivity assessment.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Core Analysis Standards

attributes.name: average_porosity_percent
attributes.description: The arithmetic average porosity across all net pay intervals, expressed as a percentage. Derived from wireline logs and core analysis. Key input for volumetric calculations.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Petrophysical Standards

attributes.name: average_water_saturation_percent
attributes.description: The arithmetic average water saturation across all net pay intervals, expressed as a percentage. Hydrocarbon saturation equals 100 minus water saturation. Derived from resistivity logs and capillary pressure data.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Petrophysical Evaluation

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The exploration business unit or operating division responsible for this well and prospect. Used for organizational reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: The formal classification of the well outcome based on post-drill evaluation. Discovery indicates commercial hydrocarbon accumulation found; dry hole indicates no hydrocarbons; shows only indicates non-commercial hydrocarbon presence; technical success indicates objectives met but commercial viability uncertain.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PRMS Resource Classification

attributes.name: commercial_success_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the well discovered commercially viable hydrocarbons that justify development investment. True indicates positive economic evaluation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Economic Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the well is located. Used for regulatory reporting and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this well result evaluation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discovery_declaration_date
attributes.description: The date when the discovery was formally declared to regulatory authorities and joint venture partners. Nullable if well was not a commercial discovery. Triggers regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: BSEE (Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement) - Discovery Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: discovery_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this well resulted in a commercial hydrocarbon discovery. True triggers discovery declaration workflow and regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) - Reserves Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: dst_test_conducted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a drill stem test was conducted to measure reservoir pressure, permeability, and fluid properties. True indicates dynamic reservoir data is available.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Well Testing Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_petrophysicist_name
attributes.description: The name of the lead petrophysicist responsible for formation evaluation, log interpretation, and reservoir property assessment.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Professional Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_reservoir_engineer_name
attributes.description: The name of the lead reservoir engineer responsible for well test analysis, productivity assessment, and EUR estimation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Professional Standards

attributes.name: formation_evaluation_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the formation evaluation results including wireline log interpretation, core analysis findings, fluid sampling results, and well test conclusions. Provides qualitative context for quantitative measurements.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Formation Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: gas_oil_ratio_scf_per_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Oil Ratio (GOR) (Standard Cubic Feet per Barrel)
attributes.description: The ratio of gas volume to oil volume produced, measured in standard cubic feet per barrel. Measured from drill stem test or initial production test. Critical for fluid characterization and facilities design.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Production Testing Standards

attributes.name: geological_success_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the well achieved its geological objectives (e.g., encountered predicted reservoir, confirmed trap closure). True indicates geological model was validated regardless of commercial outcome.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Exploration Success Metrics

attributes.name: gross_pay_thickness_ft
attributes.description: The total thickness in feet of all reservoir intervals encountered, including both net pay and non-pay intervals within the hydrocarbon-bearing formation.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Petrophysical Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: hydrocarbon_type_encountered
attributes.description: The type of hydrocarbon encountered during drilling and formation evaluation. Mixed indicates both oil and gas present in commercial quantities.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Hydrocarbon Classification

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Rate (Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: The initial production rate measured in barrels of oil per day during the first production test. Key indicator of well productivity and used for decline curve analysis.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Production Testing Standards

attributes.name: initial_production_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) Rate (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: The initial gas production rate measured in thousand cubic feet per day during the first production test. Used for gas well productivity assessment.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Production Testing Standards

attributes.name: initial_reservoir_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Reservoir Pressure (Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: The virgin reservoir pressure measured in pounds per square inch at the time of discovery, typically from drill stem test or wireline formation tester. Critical for reservoir drive mechanism assessment and production forecasting.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Pressure Volume Temperature (PVT) Analysis Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this well result evaluation record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_pay_thickness_ft
attributes.description: The cumulative thickness in feet of reservoir intervals that meet minimum cutoff criteria for porosity, permeability, and hydrocarbon saturation. Key metric for reservoir quality assessment.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Petrophysical Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: number_of_pay_intervals
attributes.description: The count of distinct reservoir intervals that meet net pay criteria. Multiple pay zones indicate stacked reservoir potential.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Reservoir Characterization

attributes.name: post_drill_eur_p10_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Post-Drill Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) P10 (Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent)
attributes.description: The revised P10 (high estimate, 10% probability of exceeding) estimate of ultimate recoverable hydrocarbons in million barrels of oil equivalent, based on actual well results.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PRMS Resource Classification

attributes.name: post_drill_eur_p50_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Post-Drill Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) P50 (Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent)
attributes.description: The revised P50 (median, 50% probability) estimate of ultimate recoverable hydrocarbons in million barrels of oil equivalent, updated based on actual well results. Used to update prospect and play resource assessments.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PRMS Resource Classification

attributes.name: post_drill_eur_p90_mmboe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Post-Drill Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) P90 (Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent)
attributes.description: The revised P90 (low estimate, 90% probability of exceeding) estimate of ultimate recoverable hydrocarbons in million barrels of oil equivalent, based on actual well results.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PRMS Resource Classification

attributes.name: pressure_gradient_psi_per_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Gradient (Pounds per Square Inch per Foot)
attributes.description: The rate of pressure increase with depth, measured in psi per foot. Used to determine fluid type and reservoir connectivity. Normal hydrostatic gradient is approximately 0.433 psi/ft for water.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Formation Pressure Analysis

attributes.name: primary_reservoir_formation
attributes.description: The name of the primary geological formation that contains the hydrocarbon accumulation. Used for play-level correlation and analogue analysis.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Stratigraphic Nomenclature

attributes.name: prms_resource_class_post_drill
attributes.business_glossary_term: Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS) Resource Class Post-Drill
attributes.description: The updated PRMS resource classification after well results are incorporated. 1P represents proved reserves, 2P represents proved plus probable, 3P represents proved plus probable plus possible. Contingent resources require further evaluation before development.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PRMS 2018 Standards

attributes.name: recommendation_code
attributes.description: The formal recommendation for next steps based on well results. Appraise indicates additional wells needed to delineate discovery; develop indicates commercial development justified; abandon indicates no further activity; suspend indicates temporary deferral; sidetrack indicates drilling additional wellbore from existing well.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Well Planning Standards

attributes.name: recommendation_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the technical and commercial rationale supporting the recommendation code. Includes discussion of reservoir quality, resource size, development costs, and economic viability.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Economic Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The name of the government agency or regulatory body with jurisdiction over this well and discovery. Examples include BSEE, BOEM, state oil and gas commissions, or national oil ministries.
attributes.references: BSEE (Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement) - Regulatory Framework

attributes.name: reservoir_temperature_f
attributes.description: The bottom hole temperature measured in degrees Fahrenheit at the reservoir depth. Critical for PVT analysis and production system design.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PVT Analysis Standards

attributes.name: result_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date when the formal post-drill well result evaluation was completed and documented. This is the business event date for the well result classification.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Well Evaluation Standards

attributes.name: secondary_reservoir_formation
attributes.description: The name of any secondary geological formation encountered with hydrocarbon shows or pay. Nullable if only one formation was productive.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - Stratigraphic Nomenclature

products.name: campaign_vendor_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between an exploration campaign and a vendor providing services or supplies. It captures the specific scope, contract terms, performance, and financial details that exist only in the context of a particular campaign-vendor relationship. Each record links one campaign to one vendor with attributes describing the nature and outcomes of that specific engagement.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas exploration operations, campaigns routinely engage multiple vendors simultaneously for different services (seismic contractors, drilling contractors, environmental consultants, logistics providers, equipment suppliers). Each vendor participates in multiple campaigns across different basins, license blocks, and time periods. Campaign managers actively manage these vendor engagements, tracking contract terms, scope, spend, and performance ratings specific to each campaign-vendor combination.

attributes.name: campaign_vendor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this campaign-vendor engagement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: exploration_campaign_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Campaign Vendor Engagement - Exploration Campaign Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the exploration campaign that engaged this vendor

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vendor providing services or supplies to this campaign

attributes.name: actual_spend
attributes.description: Actual expenditure incurred for this vendor on this campaign to date in USD, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the contract or purchase order governing this vendor engagement for the campaign, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: contracted_value
attributes.description: Total contracted value in USD for this vendor's services or supplies on this campaign, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor completed or is scheduled to complete their work or delivery for this campaign, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current status of this vendor engagement on this campaign, tracking the lifecycle of the vendor relationship within the campaign context.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating score assigned to this vendor for their work on this specific campaign, used for vendor evaluation and future selection decisions, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: scope_of_work
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope of work, deliverables, or services contracted from this vendor for this specific campaign, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of service or supply provided by the vendor to this campaign, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor commenced work or delivery of services/supplies for this campaign, as identified in the detection phase relationship data.

products.name: seismic_contract_line_item
products.description: This association product represents the contractual line item relationship between seismic surveys and procurement contracts in the oil and gas exploration business. It captures the commercial and delivery terms for seismic data acquisition or processing services delivered under a specific contract for a specific survey. Each record links one seismic survey to one procurement contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this contractual relationship, including scope definition, contracted versus actual deliverables, unit rates, milestone dates, and acceptance status. This is a core operational entity managed by both exploration and procurement teams to track multi-survey master service agreements and phased contract execution.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas exploration operations, seismic surveys are commonly delivered under multi-survey master service agreements where one procurement contract covers multiple surveys over time (one contract → many surveys). Conversely, large or complex surveys are frequently split across multiple contracts, with different contractors handling acquisition versus processing, or phased contracts for different survey areas (one survey → many contracts). The business actively manages contract line items at the survey-contract intersection, tracking scope, contracted versus actual deliverables (km), unit rates, milestone dates, acceptance status, and payment status for each survey-contract pair.

attributes.name: seismic_contract_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this seismic survey contract line item record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seismic Contract Line Item - Procurement Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the procurement contract that governs this seismic survey delivery. Identifies the master service agreement, acquisition contract, or processing contract under which this survey work is performed.

attributes.name: seismic_survey_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seismic Contract Line Item - Seismic Survey Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the seismic survey that is covered under this contract line item. Identifies which survey's acquisition or processing services are governed by this contractual relationship.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the seismic deliverable for this survey was formally accepted by Oil Gas technical team. Triggers final payment release and closes the line item delivery obligation.

attributes.name: acceptance_status
attributes.description: Current acceptance status of the seismic deliverable for this survey under this contract line item. Pending indicates deliverable not yet submitted, under_review indicates technical QC in progress, accepted indicates deliverable meets contract specifications, conditionally_accepted indicates minor deficiencies with agreed remediation, rejected indicates deliverable fails to meet contract quality standards and requires rework.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the seismic data deliverable for this survey was completed and delivered by the contractor. Used to assess schedule performance and determine if late delivery penalties apply.

attributes.name: actual_km_delivered
attributes.description: Actual line kilometers of seismic data delivered by the contractor for this survey under this contract line item. Used to calculate payment, assess contractor performance, and identify scope variances.

attributes.name: contract_line_item_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for this line item within the parent procurement contract. Used for referencing specific survey deliverables in contract documentation and invoicing (e.g., 'Line 3.2', 'Survey Deliverable A').

attributes.name: contracted_km
attributes.description: Total line kilometers of seismic data contracted to be acquired or processed under this line item. Represents the committed deliverable quantity against which actual delivery and payment are measured.

attributes.name: delivery_milestone_date
attributes.description: Contractually committed date by which the seismic data deliverable for this survey must be completed and delivered by the contractor. Used to track schedule compliance and trigger milestone payments or liquidated damages.

attributes.name: invoice_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor invoice(s) submitted for payment against this contract line item. Links the contractual deliverable to accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: line_item_value_usd
attributes.description: Total monetary value in United States Dollars for this contract line item, calculated as contracted_km × unit_rate_per_km or as a lump sum for fixed-price deliverables. Represents the financial commitment for this survey under this contract.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about this survey-contract relationship, including scope changes, delivery issues, quality concerns, or commercial negotiations specific to this line item.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status for this contract line item. Not_invoiced indicates deliverable not yet billed, invoiced indicates invoice received and under review, paid indicates full payment released, partially_paid indicates milestone or progress payment made, disputed indicates payment held due to quality or scope disagreement.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Description of technical or quality deficiencies that led to rejection of the seismic deliverable. Documents non-conformance with contract specifications (e.g., 'Signal-to-noise ratio below contracted threshold', 'Incomplete line coverage in NE quadrant').

attributes.name: survey_scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the seismic work scope covered under this contract line item for this specific survey. Defines what acquisition or processing services the contractor is obligated to deliver (e.g., '3D marine acquisition 500 sq km', 'Pre-stack depth migration processing').

attributes.name: unit_rate_per_km
attributes.description: Contracted unit rate in USD per line kilometer for seismic acquisition or processing services under this line item. Used to calculate line item value based on actual kilometers delivered.

products.name: block_permit
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory authorization relationship between exploration blocks and permits. It captures the specific permit requirements and compliance status for each block-permit combination. Each record links one exploration block to one permit with attributes that track the permit's applicability, effective dates, and compliance conditions specific to that block.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas operations, exploration blocks require multiple permits to operate (drilling permits, environmental permits, seismic survey permits, discharge permits, safety permits), and regulatory permits frequently cover multiple blocks within a geographic area or basin (regional environmental permits, area-wide discharge permits, multi-block drilling authorizations). The business actively manages these permit-block relationships, tracking block-specific effective dates, expiration schedules, compliance conditions, and renewal timelines.

attributes.name: block_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this block-permit authorization relationship. Primary key.

attributes.name: exploration_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the exploration block covered by this permit authorization

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the permit that authorizes activities on this block

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit application was submitted for this specific block. Tracks the timeline of permit acquisition for block-specific compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority approved this permit for this specific block. Used to track compliance timelines and regulatory approval history.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting compliance activities, inspections, violations, or special considerations for this permit as it applies to this block.

attributes.name: conditions_summary
attributes.description: Summary of permit conditions, restrictions, and requirements that are specific to this block. Captures block-specific environmental restrictions, operational limitations, or reporting requirements that may differ from general permit conditions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this permit becomes effective for this specific block. May differ from the permit's overall effective date if the permit covers multiple blocks with staggered timelines.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this permit authorization expires for this specific block. May differ from the permit's overall expiration if blocks have different renewal schedules.

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current status of this permit as it applies to this specific block. Tracks whether the permit is active, pending approval, expired, suspended, or revoked for this block.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the permit renewal must be submitted for continued authorization on this block. Critical for compliance planning and avoiding operational disruptions.
