domains.name: drilling
domains.description: Owns all drilling and well completion lifecycle data from spud to TD, including rig scheduling, well planning, directional drilling, BHA configuration, MWD/LWD logs, ROP tracking, NPT analysis, BOP certification, torque and drag analysis, drill stem testing, and P&A records. Manages AFE-level drilling cost tracking and well status across D&C programs. Aligns with API well classification standards and BSEE offshore drilling regulations.

products.name: drilling_well
products.description: Master record for every wellbore drilled or planned by Oil Gas, serving as the SSOT for well identity across the drilling domain. Captures API well number, well name, well type (exploratory, development, injection, disposal), well class, spud date, total depth (TD), measured depth (MD), true vertical depth (TVD), surface location coordinates (lat/long and UTM), bottom-hole location, field/block assignment, regulatory jurisdiction, BSEE/state permit number, well status (planned, drilling, completed, suspended, P&A), operator of record, and parent wellbore reference for sidetracks and multi-laterals. Aligns with API Bulletin D12A well classification standards and supports SEC reserves disclosure requirements. Every transactional record in the drilling domain references this product.

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Primary key for well

attributes.name: block_id
attributes.description: FK to exploration.block

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating company responsible for drilling and operating this wellbore. The operator holds the drilling permit and manages day-to-day operations on behalf of all working interest owners.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade. Business justification: Wells produce specific crude grades with distinct API gravity, sulfur content, and pricing differentials. Critical for crude marketing, pricing (benchmark + differential), custody transfer quality spe

attributes.name: emergency_response_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.emergency_response_plan. Business justification: Well-specific ERPs are required for high-risk wells (HPHT, H2S, deepwater). Plans must reference the covered well for worst-case discharge scenarios and response procedures.

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the oil or gas field where this wellbore is located. Fields represent geographic areas containing one or more reservoirs under the same structural feature. Used for reserves aggregation and field-level production reporting.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS Field Definition, SEC Reserves Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Completed wells are capitalized as fixed assets for depletion and impairment testing. New attribute needed; no existing candidate. Mandatory SEC and GAAP accounting requirement.

attributes.name: hse_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.hse_risk_assessment. Business justification: Well-specific risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, well control risk assessment) are conducted pre-spud. Assessments must reference the well for risk register and barrier management.

attributes.name: norm_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.norm_record. Business justification: NORM accumulates in drilling tubulars and equipment at certain wells. Records must identify the source well for disposal tracking, regulatory reporting, and worker exposure assessment.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Wells are drilled to meet specific offtake obligations under PSAs and joint operating agreements. Real business process: production planning where well development is directly tied to contractual volu

attributes.name: parent_wellbore_drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original wellbore from which this well was sidetracked or from which a multilateral branch originates. Null for original wellbores. Used to track wellbore family relationships and API number hierarchies.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D12A Sidetrack Numbering Convention

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: FK to compliance.permit

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Wells produce specific petroleum products (crude oil, natural gas, condensate). This link is essential for production accounting, reserves booking, custody transfer allocation, SEC reserves reporting,

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.reservoir. Business justification: Wells are drilled to access specific reservoirs. Core operational link for production allocation, reserves booking, field development planning, and regulatory reporting. Every producing well must be m

attributes.name: rig_id
attributes.description: FK to drilling.rig

attributes.name: api_well_number
attributes.description: Standardized 14-digit API well identifier assigned by regulatory authority. Format: state code (2) - county code (3) - unique well number (5) - optional sidetrack suffix (2). Serves as the industry-standard unique identifier for wellbores in the United States.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D12A - Well Identification and Numbering System

attributes.name: authorized_afe_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorized Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) Amount in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total budget authorized in the Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) for drilling and completion operations, expressed in USD. Used to track cost variance and trigger supplemental AFE approvals when exceeded.
attributes.references: COPAS AFE Standard Format, Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Approval Requirements

attributes.name: bop_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Blowout Preventer (BOP) pressure test and function test. BOP testing is required before drilling ahead and at regular intervals per API Specification 53 and BSEE regulations to ensure well control equipment integrity.
attributes.references: API Specification 53 - BOP Equipment, BSEE Well Control Requirements

attributes.name: bottom_hole_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the wellbore bottom hole location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). For deviated and horizontal wells, differs from surface location. Critical for reservoir drainage area calculations and spacing unit compliance.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D20, BSEE Directional Survey Requirements

attributes.name: bottom_hole_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the wellbore bottom hole location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). For deviated and horizontal wells, differs from surface location. Critical for reservoir drainage area calculations and spacing unit compliance.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D20, BSEE Directional Survey Requirements

attributes.name: casing_program_design
attributes.description: Summary description of the casing string design including conductor, surface casing, intermediate casing, and production casing depths and sizes. Example: 20-inch conductor to 100 ft, 13-3/8-inch surface to 3000 ft, 9-5/8-inch intermediate to 10000 ft, 7-inch production to TD.
attributes.references: API Specification 5CT - Casing and Tubing, Well Design Standards

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when well completion operations finished and the well was ready for production or injection. Marks the transition from drilling and completion (D&C) phase to production operations.
attributes.references: Production Operations Standard, SEC Reserves Disclosure

attributes.name: directional_drilling_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether directional drilling services were used. True indicates the well was intentionally deviated using Rotary Steerable System (RSS), mud motor, or other directional tools. Used for cost allocation and drilling performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: drilling_days_actual
attributes.description: Total calendar days from spud date to rig release date, including productive time and Non-Productive Time (NPT). Used for drilling performance analysis and Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) variance reporting.
attributes.references: IADC Drilling Performance Standards, AFE Tracking Guidelines

attributes.name: drilling_days_planned
attributes.description: Estimated drilling duration from Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) or well plan. Used to calculate drilling performance variance and identify wells exceeding planned duration.
attributes.references: AFE Authorization Standard, Well Planning Guidelines

attributes.name: dst_performed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a Drill Stem Test (DST) was performed during drilling operations. DST provides critical reservoir pressure, permeability, and fluid sample data used for reserves estimation and completion design.
attributes.references: API Recommended Practice 57 - Drill Stem Testing, Reservoir Engineering Standards

attributes.name: initial_production_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Initial production rate measured during the first 24-hour flow test after completion, expressed in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). Critical metric for well performance evaluation, reserves estimation, and completion effectiveness assessment.
attributes.references: SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS), State Production Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: initial_production_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Production (IP) in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD)
attributes.description: Initial gas production rate measured during the first 24-hour flow test after completion, expressed in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD). Used for gas well performance evaluation and reserves estimation.
attributes.references: SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS), State Production Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: measured_depth_ft
attributes.description: Total length of the wellbore measured along the actual drilled path from surface to bottom, expressed in feet. For deviated or horizontal wells, Measured Depth (MD) exceeds True Vertical Depth (TVD). Critical for drilling cost estimation and tubular design.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D20 - Well Survey Data, SPE Drilling Engineering Standards

attributes.name: mud_system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary drilling fluid system used. Water-based muds are environmentally preferred, oil-based and synthetic-based muds provide superior performance in challenging formations, and air or foam systems are used in underbalanced drilling.
attributes.references: API Specification 13A - Drilling Fluid Materials, Environmental Compliance Standards

attributes.name: mwd_lwd_vendor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Measurement While Drilling (MWD) and Logging While Drilling (LWD) Vendor
attributes.description: Name of the service company that provided Measurement While Drilling (MWD) and Logging While Drilling (LWD) services. MWD provides real-time directional and drilling parameter data, while LWD provides real-time formation evaluation logs.

attributes.name: plugged_abandoned_date
attributes.description: Date when the wellbore was permanently plugged and abandoned according to regulatory requirements. Marks the end of the wells operational lifecycle and triggers asset retirement obligation (ARO) accounting.
attributes.references: BSEE P&A Requirements, API Standard 65 - Abandonment, GAAP ARO Accounting

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wellbore record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standard, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wellbore record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standard, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority governing drilling and production operations for this wellbore. Federal offshore wells fall under Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) jurisdiction, while state wells are governed by state oil and gas commissions.
attributes.references: BSEE Regulatory Framework, State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations

attributes.name: rig_release_date
attributes.description: Date when the drilling rig was released from the wellbore after reaching Total Depth (TD) or completing drilling operations. Used to calculate drilling duration and rig utilization metrics.
attributes.references: Drilling Operations Standard, AFE Cost Tracking

attributes.name: spud_date
attributes.description: Date when drilling operations officially commenced (when the drill bit first penetrated the surface). Marks the beginning of the drilling phase and is used for Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: BSEE Drilling Permit Requirements, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: surface_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the wellbore surface location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping, lease boundary verification, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D20, BSEE Geographic Coordinate Requirements, ISO 6709

attributes.name: surface_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the wellbore surface location in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for Geographic Information System (GIS) mapping, lease boundary verification, and regulatory reporting.

products.name: drilling_afe
products.description: Authorization for Expenditure record governing the approved capital budget and actual cost tracking for drilling and completion operations. Header captures AFE number, AFE type (drilling, workover, P&A, sidetrack), approved CAPEX amount, supplemental AFE amounts, cost center, WBS element, approval date, approver hierarchy, joint venture partner split percentages, and AFE status (draft, approved, closed). Line-item detail captures cost date, cost category (rig day rate, mud and chemicals, bits, casing and tubing, cementing, directional services, logging, completion services, fuel, catering), vendor name, invoice reference, actual amount, cumulative spend vs budget, and variance flag. Serves as the financial control document linking drilling operations to SAP PS/CO cost tracking and JIB processing per COPAS standards.

products.name: npt_event
products.description: Non-Productive Time (NPT) and well control event record capturing every instance of unplanned downtime or well control incident during drilling operations. Records event start and end timestamps, duration in hours, event category (equipment failure, weather, stuck pipe, well control kick/influx, waiting on cement, waiting on orders, logistics delay), responsible party (operator vs contractor), rig system involved, estimated cost impact, corrective action taken, preventability flag, and for well control events: pit gain volume, shut-in drill pipe pressure (SIDPP), shut-in casing pressure (SICP), kill method, kill mud weight, and BSEE incident notification status.
