attributes.description: The calculated proportion or ratio used to allocate facility production to this well. Expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.235 represents 23.5% of facility production).

attributes.name: gas_allocation_variance_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Allocation Variance in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: The difference between facility metered gas volume and the sum of all allocated gas volumes to wells. Represents unallocated or over-allocated volumes requiring reconciliation.

attributes.name: gas_oil_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of gas production to oil production, expressed as cubic feet of gas per barrel of oil. Key reservoir performance indicator used for decline curve analysis and reservoir management.

attributes.name: gross_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Total allocated natural gas production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in thousand cubic feet. Represents 100% working interest volume.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: gross_ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Total allocated natural gas liquids production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in barrels. Includes condensate, propane, butane, and natural gasoline.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: gross_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total allocated oil production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in barrels. Represents 100% working interest volume.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

attributes.name: gross_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total allocated water production volume for the well before interest deductions, measured in barrels. Used for water-oil ratio (WOR) analysis and disposal tracking.
attributes.references: API RP 45 - Recommended Practice for Analysis of Oilfield Waters

attributes.name: jib_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this allocation was posted to the Joint Interest Billing system for partner invoicing. Links production volumes to revenue distribution and partner settlements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this allocation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail. Updated whenever any field in the record changes.

attributes.name: net_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Net allocated gas production volume after applying working interest decimal. Calculated as gross_gas_volume_mcf multiplied by working_interest_decimal. Used for partner revenue distribution.

attributes.name: net_ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Net allocated NGL production volume after applying working interest decimal. Calculated as gross_ngl_volume_bbl multiplied by working_interest_decimal. Used for partner revenue distribution.

attributes.name: net_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Net allocated oil production volume after applying working interest decimal. Calculated as gross_oil_volume_bbl multiplied by working_interest_decimal. Used for partner revenue distribution.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The ownership percentage representing the net revenue interest share after royalty and overriding royalty deductions. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.60 represents 60% NRI). Used for revenue distribution calculations.

attributes.name: oil_allocation_variance_bbl
attributes.description: The difference between facility metered oil volume and the sum of all allocated oil volumes to wells. Represents unallocated or over-allocated volumes requiring reconciliation.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the production allocation period. Defines the time window for which volumes are allocated.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the production allocation period. Typically daily or monthly allocation cycles.

attributes.name: production_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which production is allocated, expressed in YYYY-MM format. Used for monthly production reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when allocation variances were reconciled and the allocation was finalized. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of variance causes and reconciliation actions taken. Documents meter calibration issues, well downtime, measurement errors, or allocation method adjustments.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the variance reconciliation process. Indicates whether allocation variances have been investigated and resolved. Critical for audit trail and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation record must be included in regulatory production reports to BSEE, state agencies, or SEC reserves disclosure. True if regulatory reporting is required.

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the allocation calculation was executed. Used for audit trail and to track allocation process timing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system of record that originated this allocation data. Avocet Production Operations for daily allocation, OSIsoft PI for real-time data, SCADA for facility meters, manual entry for adjustments, or third-party for operator-provided data.

attributes.name: total_boe
attributes.description: Total production expressed in barrels of oil equivalent. Calculated by converting gas and NGL volumes to oil equivalent and summing with oil volumes. Used for standardized production reporting.

attributes.name: water_oil_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of water production to oil production, expressed as barrels of water per barrel of oil. Key indicator of reservoir water breakthrough and well performance decline.

attributes.name: working_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The ownership percentage representing the working interest share for this allocation record. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 represents 75% WI). Used to calculate net volumes from gross volumes.

products.name: monthly_production
products.description: Authoritative monthly production record aggregated and validated at the well and facility level for regulatory reporting. Stores certified monthly volumes of oil (BOPD average and total BBL), gas (MMCFD average and total MCF), water, and NGL by well and facility. Includes regulatory submission status, state agency report ID, BSEE submission reference, and certification sign-off. Distinct from daily_production in that monthly records are the legally certified volumes submitted to BSEE, state oil and gas commissions, and used for SEC reserves disclosure.
products.reference: BSEE OGOR (Oil and Gas Operations Report), State Production Reports

attributes.name: monthly_production_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the monthly production record. Primary key for the monthly production entity.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.term_contract. Business justification: Monthly production certification ties directly to term contract volume commitments for regulatory reporting, revenue recognition, and contract compliance verification. Standard oil-and-gas business pr

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Report identifier or confirmation number assigned by the state oil and gas commission upon submission of the monthly production report for onshore operations.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Monthly production is the basis for revenue recognition and must tie to cost centers for financial statement preparation, monthly close process, reserves reconciliation, and SEC reporting. Fundamental

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Monthly regulatory reports (Form 3160, state production reports) require API well number and drilling permit data. Reserves engineers calculate finding & development costs, EUR, and NPV using drilling

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the oil or gas field to which the well or facility belongs for geographic and reservoir aggregation.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Monthly production is the basis for partner billing, regulatory reporting, royalty calculations, and JIB statement preparation under Joint Operating Agreements.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the oil and gas lease under which the well or facility operates. Used for royalty calculation and land management.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Monthly regulatory reports to state agencies and BSEE require product-level classification of oil, gas, and NGL volumes. Mandatory for reserves booking and SEC financial reporting under ASC 932.

attributes.name: production_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production facility or battery where production is aggregated and measured.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Monthly production is the basis for profit center revenue recognition in monthly financial close, segment reporting, and performance evaluation. Essential for business unit profitability analysis and

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Monthly regulatory production reports (BSEE, state agencies) must reconcile with shipment/sales records for compliance and revenue verification. Links reported production to actual custody transfers,

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the operating company responsible for the well or facility during the production month.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate production volumes to the well or facility. Indicates whether volumes are directly measured or allocated from facility totals.

attributes.name: api_well_number
attributes.description: Standardized API well number assigned by regulatory authority for unique well identification in production reporting.
attributes.references: API Bulletin D12A - API Well Number Standard

attributes.name: artificial_lift_type
attributes.description: Type of artificial lift system used during the production month to enhance well productivity. Indicates the primary lift mechanism employed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|rod_pump|esp|gas_lift|plunger_lift|pcp|hydraulic_pump — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: boe_total
attributes.description: Total production expressed in barrels of oil equivalent (BOE), converting gas and NGL volumes to oil-equivalent barrels using standard conversion factors (typically 6 MCF = 1 BOE).

attributes.name: bsee_submission_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Submission Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or confirmation code assigned by BSEE upon successful submission of the monthly production report for offshore operations.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the monthly production record was certified and approved for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Production Reporting

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Status of the monthly production record in the certification and regulatory submission workflow. Indicates whether volumes have been validated and submitted.

attributes.name: certified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the production engineer or authorized personnel who certified the monthly production volumes as accurate and complete.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Production Reporting

attributes.name: condensate_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of condensate produced during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). Condensate is liquid hydrocarbon recovered from gas wells.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Reporting Standards

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or method from which the monthly production data was extracted. Indicates data lineage and quality assurance level.

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of non-productive time (NPT) during the month due to equipment failure, maintenance, or operational issues.

attributes.name: flared_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flared Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas flared during the month due to operational constraints or safety requirements, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF).

attributes.name: fuel_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas consumed as fuel for lease operations and equipment during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF).

attributes.name: gas_mcfd_average
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD) Average
attributes.description: Average daily gas production rate for the month, calculated as total gas volume divided by the number of production days. Expressed in MCFD.

attributes.name: gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Total volume of natural gas produced during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). This is the certified volume submitted to regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: gor
attributes.description: Gas-oil ratio for the month, calculated as the ratio of gas volume (MCF) to oil volume (BBL). Indicates reservoir performance and production characteristics.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest after deducting royalties and overriding royalty interests. Represents the operators share of production revenue.

attributes.name: ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Total volume of natural gas liquids (NGL) extracted during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). Includes ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline.

attributes.name: oil_bopd_average
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oil Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD) Average
attributes.description: Average daily oil production rate for the month, calculated as total oil volume divided by the number of production days. Expressed in BOPD.

attributes.name: oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of crude oil produced during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). This is the certified volume submitted to regulatory agencies.

attributes.name: production_days
attributes.description: Number of days the well or facility was actively producing during the month. Used to calculate average daily rates and uptime.

attributes.name: production_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which production volumes are reported, typically the first day of the month (YYYY-MM-01 format).

attributes.name: production_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the well or facility during the production month. Indicates whether the asset was actively producing or offline.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the monthly production record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the monthly production record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certified monthly production volumes were submitted to the regulatory agency (BSEE, state oil and gas commission).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or notes regarding the monthly production record, including operational issues or data quality concerns.

attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction to which the monthly production report is submitted. Determines the applicable reporting requirements and agency.

attributes.name: reservoir_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reservoir Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Average reservoir pressure during the production month, measured in pounds per square inch (PSI). Indicates reservoir energy and depletion status.

attributes.name: royalty_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Royalty Volume in Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Total production volume attributable to royalty interests, expressed in barrels of oil equivalent (BOE). Used for royalty payment calculation.

attributes.name: sales_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas sold or delivered to market during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). Excludes flared, vented, and fuel gas.

attributes.name: vented_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vented Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas vented during the month, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). Reported for environmental compliance and emissions tracking.

attributes.name: water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of produced water during the month, measured in barrels (BBL). Includes formation water and injected water produced back.

attributes.name: wellhead_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wellhead Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Average wellhead flowing pressure during the production month, measured in pounds per square inch (PSI). Used for production optimization and decline analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 11AR - Recommended Practice for Care and Use of Subsurface Pumps

attributes.name: wor
attributes.description: Water-oil ratio for the month, calculated as the ratio of water volume (BBL) to oil volume (BBL). Indicates water breakthrough and reservoir depletion.

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest held by the operator in the well or facility for the production month. Used for revenue and cost allocation.

products.name: artificial_lift
products.description: Master record for artificial lift installations on producing wells. Captures lift type (ESP, rod pump, gas lift, PCP, jet pump, plunger lift), installation date, design parameters (pump depth, motor rating, frequency, gas injection rate), current operating parameters, run life history, and optimization targets. Tracks ESP run life (days), failure mode, and mean time between failures (MTBF). Supports artificial lift optimization workflows and production enhancement programs.

attributes.name: artificial_lift_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the artificial lift installation record. Primary key for the artificial lift master data product.

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Artificial lift design (ESP depth, pump stages, gas lift injection point) depends on wellbore geometry, casing/tubing design, and deviation survey from drilling. Operators track lift installation cost

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment. Business justification: Artificial lift systems (ESPs, rod pumps, gas lift) are physical equipment assets requiring maintenance tracking, failure analysis, and lifecycle management. Links operational performance data to equi

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Artificial lift installations are capital projects authorized by AFEs for capital project tracking, equipment capitalization, ROI analysis, and cost control. Essential for tracking artificial lift cap

attributes.name: installer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Artificial lift installations are safety-critical well interventions requiring documented accountability for the installing technician. Oil & gas operations track installer identity for warranty claim

attributes.name: manufacturer_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Artificial lift equipment manufacturers are vendors for procurement tracking, warranty management, and vendor performance evaluation. Manufacturer field is denormalized string. Role prefix distinguish

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Artificial lift installations and repairs are capital/maintenance expenditures tracked via purchase orders. Links equipment to procurement for cost tracking, warranty management, and AFE reconciliatio

attributes.name: scada_tag_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) Tag ID
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier in the OSIsoft PI System or SCADA system for real-time data integration. Links artificial lift record to live operational data streams.

attributes.name: actual_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Production Rate (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Current actual production rate in barrels of oil per day achieved by the artificial lift system. Updated from real-time production data via OSIsoft PI System integration.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or historical context about the artificial lift installation. Used by field engineers and production technicians.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this artificial lift record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: design_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Design Production Rate (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Target production rate in barrels of oil per day that the artificial lift system was designed to achieve. Used for performance monitoring and optimization.

attributes.name: discharge_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Discharge Pressure (PSI - Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Pressure at the pump discharge in pounds per square inch. Used to calculate total dynamic head and system efficiency.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: failure_date
attributes.description: Date when the artificial lift system failed. Nullable for operating systems. Used to calculate mean time between failures and reliability metrics.

attributes.name: failure_mode
attributes.description: Description of the failure mode if the system has failed. Examples include motor failure, pump wear, electrical short, gas lock, rod parting. Used for failure analysis and MTBF tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Motor Failure|Pump Wear|Electrical Short|Gas Lock|Rod Parting|Tubing Leak|Cable Damage|Bearing Failure|Seal Failure — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: gas_injection_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Injection Rate (MCFD - Thousand Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Current gas injection rate for gas lift systems in thousand cubic feet per day. Null for non-gas-lift installations. Key optimization parameter for gas lift wells.
attributes.references: API RP 11V - Recommended Practice for Gas Lift

attributes.name: installation_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure for the artificial lift installation including equipment, labor, and services. Used for CAPEX tracking and economic analysis.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the artificial lift system was installed and commissioned in the well. Marks the start of the run life tracking period.

attributes.name: installation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the artificial lift installation. Externally-known unique code used in field operations and maintenance work orders.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent maintenance activity performed on the artificial lift system. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling via Maximo integration.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: lift_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the artificial lift system. Tracks lifecycle state from installation through decommissioning.

attributes.name: lift_type
attributes.description: Type of artificial lift system installed. ESP = Electric Submersible Pump, PCP = Progressive Cavity Pump. Determines the operating characteristics and optimization parameters.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this artificial lift record was last updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: motor_current_amps
attributes.description: Current draw of the ESP motor in amperes. Real-time parameter monitored via SCADA. Used for load analysis and efficiency calculations.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: motor_horsepower
attributes.description: Rated horsepower of the artificial lift motor. Applicable to ESP and rod pump systems. Determines power consumption and lifting capacity.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: motor_temperature_f
attributes.description: Current operating temperature of the ESP motor in degrees Fahrenheit. Monitored via downhole sensors. High temperature indicates potential motor failure risk.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: motor_voltage
attributes.description: Operating voltage of the ESP motor in volts. Standard values include 480V, 1000V, 2400V, 4160V. Critical for electrical system design and safety.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance activity. Calculated based on run life, operating conditions, and maintenance strategy.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: operating_cost_per_day_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Cost Per Day (United States Dollars)
attributes.description: Daily operating expense for the artificial lift system including power, maintenance, and monitoring. Used for lease operating expense tracking and economic optimization.

attributes.name: operating_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Current operating frequency of the variable speed drive in Hertz. Used to control ESP pump speed and production rate. Typical range 30-70 Hz.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: optimization_target
attributes.description: Primary optimization objective for this artificial lift installation. Drives automated control strategies in artificial lift optimization workflows.

attributes.name: power_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total electrical power consumption in kilowatt-hours. Used for operating expense tracking and energy efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: pump_depth_ft
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet at which the pump is set in the wellbore. Critical design parameter for ESP and rod pump installations.
attributes.references: API RP 11AR - Recommended Practice for Care and Use of Subsurface Pumps

attributes.name: pump_intake_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pump Intake Pressure (PSI - Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Pressure at the pump intake in pounds per square inch. Critical operating parameter for ESP systems. Low intake pressure indicates potential gas lock or insufficient reservoir pressure.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: pump_stages
attributes.description: Number of stages in the ESP or PCP pump assembly. Determines total head capacity and lifting capability of the system.
attributes.references: API RP 11S - Recommended Practice for Electric Submersible Pump Systems

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date when the artificial lift system was pulled from the well. Nullable for currently operating systems. Used to calculate run life duration.

attributes.name: run_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the artificial lift system has been operating since installation. Calculated as current date minus installation date for active systems, or removal date minus installation date for pulled systems. Key metric for reliability analysis.

attributes.name: stroke_length_inches
attributes.description: Length of the pumping stroke in inches for rod pump systems. Typical values range from 30 to 300 inches. Determines displacement per stroke.
attributes.references: API RP 11L - Recommended Practice for Design Calculations for Sucker Rod Pumping Systems

attributes.name: strokes_per_minute
attributes.description: Current pumping speed in strokes per minute for rod pump systems. Used to calculate pump displacement and production rate.
attributes.references: API RP 11L - Recommended Practice for Design Calculations for Sucker Rod Pumping Systems

attributes.name: target_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Optimal target frequency for ESP operation based on reservoir conditions and production targets. Used in artificial lift optimization workflows.

attributes.name: target_gas_injection_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Gas Injection Rate (MCFD - Thousand Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Optimal target gas injection rate for gas lift optimization. Used in production enhancement programs and nodal analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 11V - Recommended Practice for Gas Lift

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo work order number for the installation or most recent maintenance activity. Links to CMMS for asset lifecycle management.

products.name: downtime_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing production downtime and deferment events at the well or facility level. Records downtime start and end timestamps, downtime category (planned maintenance, equipment failure, weather, regulatory, market curtailment, pipeline constraint), deferred volumes by phase (oil BBL, gas MCF, NGL BBL), responsible party, and corrective action taken. Integrates with Maximo work orders for maintenance-related downtime. Supports NPT (Non-Productive Time) analysis and production efficiency reporting.

attributes.name: downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the downtime event record. Primary key for the downtime_event product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Downtime events have direct financial impact through deferred production (lost revenue) and must be tracked by cost center for variance analysis, production reporting, insurance claims, and performanc

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Production downtime root cause analysis often traces to drilling/completion issues (sand production from inadequate screen, casing leak, cement failure). Operators need drilling data to diagnose failu

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: FK to production.field

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Downtime events may trigger insurance claims or loss recognition posted to specific GL accounts for loss accounting, insurance recovery, and variance analysis. Required when downtime results in financ

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Downtime impacts partner entitlements, triggers force majeure clauses, affects AFE performance tracking, and may require partner notification under JOA terms.

attributes.name: production_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production facility experiencing downtime. Links to facility master data.

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation. Business justification: Downtime events can trigger regulatory violations when they breach permit conditions, emission limits, or safety requirements. Product has regulatory_reportable_flag and regulatory_report_number. Enfo

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context about the downtime event. Used by operations staff to document special circumstances or lessons learned.

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the corrective actions implemented to resolve the downtime event and restore production. Documents repair activities, part replacements, or operational adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this downtime event record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system from which the downtime event data was captured. Indicates whether the event was automatically detected by SCADA/PI or manually entered by operations staff.

attributes.name: deferred_boe
attributes.description: Total deferred production expressed in barrel of oil equivalent (BOE) units. Aggregates oil, gas, and NGL volumes using standard conversion factors for consolidated reporting.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) BOE Conversion Standard

attributes.name: deferred_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Gas Volume Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas production lost due to the downtime event, measured in thousand cubic feet (MCF). Used for deferment reporting and reserves impact analysis.

attributes.name: deferred_ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: Volume of natural gas liquids (NGL) production lost due to the downtime event, measured in barrels (BBL). Used for deferment reporting.

attributes.name: deferred_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of crude oil production lost due to the downtime event, measured in barrels (BBL). Used for deferment reporting and reserves impact analysis.

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the downtime event cause. Categorizes the root cause for NPT (Non-Productive Time) analysis and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Production Operations Classification

attributes.name: downtime_event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event. Tracks the event from initial detection through resolution and closure.

attributes.name: downtime_subcategory

products.name: forecast
products.description: Forward-looking production volume record at the well, facility, or field level covering both reserves-based forecasts and operational targets/budgets. Stores forecast period (monthly/annual), record type (decline curve forecast, type curve, simulation-based, budget target, stretch target, minimum commitment), forecast volumes by phase (oil BOPD, gas MMCFD, NGL BOPD), EUR (Estimated Ultimate Recovery), IP (Initial Production) rate, decline parameters (nominal/effective rate, b-factor), confidence classification (1P/2P/3P per PRMS for forecasts), approved-by and revision history for targets, and variance tracking against actuals. Supports SEC reserves disclosure input, CAPEX planning, reservoir management, and production performance management. Distinct from actual production records — this is the forward-looking plan and operational goal.
products.reference: SPE PRMS, SEC Rule 4-10(a) Reserves Disclosure

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Injection well monitoring for UIC compliance requires drilling data (casing/cement integrity, injection zone isolation). Operators track injection performance against drilling cost for EOR project eco

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the operating company or Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) operator responsible for the injection operation.
attributes.references: COPAS JOA Accounting Standards, Internal Organizational Hierarchy

attributes.name: eor_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.eor_scheme. Business justification: EOR injection records must link to specific EOR schemes for performance tracking, incremental recovery attribution, cost allocation, partner revenue sharing under PSAs, and SEC reserves booking. Curre

attributes.name: injection_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Injection records must comply with UIC permit conditions (max pressure, volume limits). Product has uic_permit_number and uic_compliance_flag. Compliance monitoring workflows require linking injection

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Injection operations incur costs (water sourcing, treatment, disposal) billed through JIB; essential for EOR cost recovery and partner allocation.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Each injection record must specify the fluid product for EOR tracking, UIC regulatory reporting, and carbon sequestration verification. Replaces denormalized injection_fluid_type with FK to product sp

attributes.name: production_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the injection facility or plant where the injection operation is managed.

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the reservoir receiving the injected fluid for pressure maintenance or Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR).

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate injection volumes when multiple wells share a common injection facility. Direct for individually metered wells, prorated for allocation based on well capacity or historical performance, estimated for calculated volumes, metered for direct measurement.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, API MPMS Chapter 20

attributes.name: bottomhole_injection_pressure
attributes.description: Calculated or measured injection pressure at the bottom of the well in the reservoir zone. Used for reservoir pressure maintenance tracking and fracture gradient monitoring.
attributes.references: SPE Pressure Transient Testing Standards, API RP 40

attributes.name: bottomhole_pressure_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for bottomhole injection pressure. Common units: PSI (pounds per square inch), KPA (kilopascals), BAR (bar), MPA (megapascals).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, anomalies, maintenance activities, or other contextual information related to the injection activity on this date.

attributes.name: cumulative_injection_volume
attributes.description: Total volume of fluid injected into the well from the start of injection operations through the injection date. Used for tracking total injection for reservoir management and Underground Injection Control (UIC) permit compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Underground Injection Control (UIC) Program, API Bulletin E3

attributes.name: cumulative_volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for cumulative injection volume. Common units: BBL (barrels), MCF (thousand cubic feet), MSTB (thousand pounds steam), M3 (cubic meters), MSCF (thousand standard cubic feet), KG (kilograms).

attributes.name: daily_injection_volume
attributes.description: Total volume of fluid injected on the injection date. Measured in barrels for liquids (Barrels of Water Injected Per Day - BWIPD) or thousand cubic feet for gas (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day - MCFD) or thousand pounds for steam (MSTBD).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 20 - Allocation Measurement, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the reliability and quality of the injection record data. Good for validated data, suspect for data requiring review, estimated for calculated or interpolated values, missing for incomplete data, invalid for data failing validation rules.
attributes.references: Internal Data Quality Framework, API Data Management Standards

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or method from which the injection data was captured. SCADA for Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition systems, manual for operator-entered data, PI System for OSIsoft PI historian, estimated for engineering calculations, calculated for derived values.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Standards, SCADA Data Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: eor_method
attributes.description: Specific Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) or Improved Oil Recovery (IOR) method employed. CO2 flood for carbon dioxide injection, steam flood for thermal recovery, polymer flood for mobility control, chemical flood for surfactant/alkaline flooding, Water Alternating Gas (WAG), Cyclic Steam Stimulation (CSS), Steam-Assisted Gravity Drainage (SAGD), or not_applicable for non-EOR injection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: co2_flood|steam_flood|polymer_flood|chemical_flood|wag|css|sagd|not_applicable — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SPE EOR Technical Standards, API Recommended Practice 42

attributes.name: fluid_quality_indicator
attributes.description: Qualitative or quantitative indicator of injected fluid quality. May include salinity for water, purity percentage for CO2, steam quality for thermal injection, or polymer concentration for chemical flooding.
attributes.references: API RP 45 - Recommended Practice for Analysis of Oilfield Waters, SPE EOR Standards

attributes.name: fluid_source
attributes.description: Source of the injected fluid. Examples include produced water from separation facilities, seawater for offshore waterflooding, purchased CO2 from industrial sources, or steam generated from boilers.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain Standard, API Bulletin E3

attributes.name: injection_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the injection activity occurred. Principal business event timestamp for daily injection reporting.

attributes.name: injection_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the well was actively injecting fluid during the injection date. Used to calculate uptime and injection efficiency.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System Data Model, SCADA Standards

attributes.name: injection_program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the injection program purpose. Waterflood for secondary recovery, gas_injection for Gas-Oil Ratio (GOR) management, Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) for tertiary recovery (CO2, steam, polymer), disposal for produced water disposal, pressure_maintenance for reservoir pressure support, storage for gas storage operations.
attributes.references: SPE Enhanced Oil Recovery Guidelines, API Bulletin E3

attributes.name: injection_rate
attributes.description: Average injection rate during the injection period, typically measured in barrels per day (BPD) for liquids or thousand cubic feet per day (MCFD) for gas. Derived from daily volume and injection duration.

attributes.name: injection_rate_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for injection rate. Common units: BPD (barrels per day), MCFD (thousand cubic feet per day), M3D (cubic meters per day), MSCFD (thousand standard cubic feet per day).

attributes.name: injection_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the injection well. Active indicates normal injection operations, suspended indicates temporary halt, shut_in indicates well is closed, maintenance indicates servicing, testing indicates well test in progress, planned indicates scheduled future injection.
attributes.references: Internal Operations Management Standard, API RP 11V8

attributes.name: injection_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature of the injected fluid at the wellhead, measured in degrees Fahrenheit or Celsius. Critical for steam injection and thermal Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) operations.
attributes.references: API RP 11V8, SPE Thermal Recovery Standards

attributes.name: injection_temperature_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for injection temperature. Common units: F (Fahrenheit), C (Celsius), K (Kelvin).

attributes.name: injection_volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the daily injection volume. Common units: BBL (barrels), MCF (thousand cubic feet), MSTB (thousand pounds steam), M3 (cubic meters), MSCF (thousand standard cubic feet), KG (kilograms).

attributes.name: injection_zone_depth
attributes.description: True Vertical Depth (TVD) to the top of the injection zone in feet or meters. Critical for Underground Injection Control (UIC) permit compliance and reservoir management.
attributes.references: API RP 65 - Cementing Shallow Water Flow Zones, EPA UIC Technical Guidance

attributes.name: injection_zone_depth_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Injection Zone Depth Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Unit of measure for injection zone depth. Common units: FT (feet), M (meters).

attributes.name: injection_zone_name
attributes.description: Name of the geological formation or reservoir zone receiving the injected fluid. Used for reservoir management and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: API Well Completion Standards, SPE Reservoir Characterization Guidelines

attributes.name: max_allowable_injection_pressure
attributes.description: Maximum injection pressure authorized by the Underground Injection Control (UIC) permit to prevent formation fracturing and ensure containment. Measured in PSI or kPa.
attributes.references: EPA UIC Program Technical Guidance, API RP 51

attributes.name: max_pressure_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for maximum allowable injection pressure. Common units: PSI (pounds per square inch), KPA (kilopascals), BAR (bar), MPA (megapascals).

attributes.name: record_created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this injection record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard, SOX Compliance Controls

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this injection record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard, SOX Compliance Controls

attributes.name: record_updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this injection record. Used for audit trail and change management.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard, SOX Compliance Controls

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this injection record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard, SOX Compliance Controls

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this injection record must be included in regulatory filings to Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE), state oil and gas commissions, or Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). True indicates reportable, False indicates internal tracking only.
attributes.references: BSEE Production Reporting Requirements, State Regulatory Agency Standards, EPA UIC Reporting

attributes.name: surface_injection_pressure
attributes.description: Injection pressure measured at the wellhead surface in pounds per square inch (PSI) or kilopascals (kPa). Critical for monitoring injection performance and preventing formation fracturing.
attributes.references: API RP 11V8 - Recommended Practice for Progressing Cavity Pump (PCP) Field Data Acquisition and Performance Monitoring

attributes.name: surface_pressure_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for surface injection pressure. Common units: PSI (pounds per square inch), KPA (kilopascals), BAR (bar), MPA (megapascals).

attributes.name: uic_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the injection activity is in compliance with Underground Injection Control (UIC) permit conditions. True indicates compliance, False indicates violation or non-compliance.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Parts 144-148, State UIC Program Requirements

attributes.name: working_interest_decimal
attributes.description: Decimal representation of the Working Interest (WI) ownership percentage for the injection well. Used for cost allocation and Joint Interest Billing (JIB) in joint venture operations.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards

products.name: run_ticket
products.description: Transactional record documenting crude oil and condensate custody transfer measurements at the tank battery or metering point. Captures run ticket number, measurement date and time, opening and closing gauge readings, gross standard volume (GSV), net standard volume (NSV), API gravity, BS&W (basic sediment and water) percentage, temperature correction factor, purchaser/transporter identity, and meter ticket reference. Run tickets are the legal basis for crude oil sales volumes and royalty calculations. Integrates with the revenue domain for invoice generation.
products.reference: API MPMS (Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards), LACT Unit Standards

attributes.name: run_ticket_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the run ticket record. Primary key for custody transfer documentation.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation company or carrier responsible for moving the crude oil or condensate from the custody transfer point.

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchaser or buyer entity receiving the crude oil or condensate.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Run tickets document crude oil sales and support royalty reporting (ONRR Form 2014) and production tax filings. Regulatory audit trails require linking run tickets to the filings they support for reve

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Crude oil sales and revenue accounting require well identification (API number, lease name) from drilling records for joint interest billing and royalty payments.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Run tickets document crude oil sales and must post to revenue GL accounts for revenue recognition, accounts receivable, sales reconciliation, and financial statement preparation. Essential for oil sal

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Run tickets document custody transfer and sales; basis for revenue allocation to partners, royalty calculations, and lifting entitlement reconciliation under JOAs.

attributes.name: meter_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the metering point or device used for volume measurement during custody transfer.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Run tickets document custody transfer of specific crude grades; product specification determines pricing differential and contract terms. Replaces denormalized product_type and crude_grade with proper

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales contract or offtake agreement governing the terms of this custody transfer and sale.

attributes.name: tank_battery_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tank battery facility where the custody transfer measurement occurred.

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity measurement of the crude oil or condensate, indicating density and quality. Higher API gravity indicates lighter, more valuable crude oil.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run ticket was approved by authorized personnel, marking it as ready for revenue accounting.

attributes.name: bsw_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of non-hydrocarbon content (sediment and water) in the crude oil or condensate sample. Used to calculate net standard volume.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 10 - Sediment and Water

attributes.name: closing_gauge_feet
attributes.description: Tank gauge reading in feet at the end of the custody transfer measurement period. Used to calculate final tank volume.

attributes.name: closing_gauge_inches
attributes.description: Tank gauge reading in inches at the end of the custody transfer measurement period. Provides fractional precision for closing volume calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run ticket record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this run ticket (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this run ticket is under dispute between operator and purchaser. True indicates active dispute requiring resolution.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is true. Documents the nature of the disagreement for resolution tracking.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Name of the truck driver or operator who performed the custody transfer pickup. Used for chain-of-custody documentation.

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Total revenue amount calculated as Net Standard Volume (NSV) multiplied by unit price. Basis for royalty and revenue distribution calculations.

attributes.name: gross_standard_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of crude oil or condensate measured at standard conditions (60°F, 14.696 psia) before deductions for Basic Sediment and Water (BS&W). Principal quantitative measurement for custody transfer.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the custody transfer measurement was performed.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 18.2 - Custody Transfer Standard

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the custody transfer measurement was completed. Principal business event timestamp for the run ticket transaction.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 18.2 - Custody Transfer Standard

attributes.name: meter_ticket_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this run ticket to the corresponding meter ticket or LACT (Lease Automatic Custody Transfer) unit record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this run ticket record was last modified. Audit trail for record lifecycle and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_standard_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of crude oil or condensate after deducting Basic Sediment and Water (BS&W) from Gross Standard Volume (GSV). This is the legally transferable volume used for sales and royalty calculations.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: observed_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Pressure of the crude oil or condensate at the time of measurement in pounds per square inch (PSI). Used for pressure correction calculations when applicable.

attributes.name: observed_temperature_f
attributes.description: Temperature of the crude oil or condensate at the time of measurement in degrees Fahrenheit. Used to calculate temperature correction factor.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction

attributes.name: opening_gauge_feet
attributes.description: Tank gauge reading in feet at the start of the custody transfer measurement period. Used to calculate initial tank volume.

attributes.name: opening_gauge_inches
attributes.description: Tank gauge reading in inches at the start of the custody transfer measurement period. Provides fractional precision for opening volume calculation.

attributes.name: operator_signature
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operator representative who authorized and signed the run ticket for custody transfer.

attributes.name: pricing_point
attributes.description: Geographic or contractual location where pricing is determined for this custody transfer (e.g., wellhead, pipeline inlet, refinery gate).

attributes.name: purchaser_signature
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the purchaser representative who acknowledged and signed the run ticket for custody transfer acceptance.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the run ticket was reconciled and finalized for revenue accounting and royalty distribution.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, exceptions, or special conditions related to this custody transfer run ticket.

attributes.name: run_ticket_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the custody transfer run ticket. Used for legal documentation and audit trails.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 18.2 - Custody Transfer Standard

attributes.name: run_ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the run ticket in the custody transfer and settlement workflow.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the tamper-evident seal applied to the transport vehicle or container to ensure custody transfer integrity.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of sulfur content in the crude oil or condensate. Determines sweet vs. sour classification and affects pricing and refining requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_correction_factor
attributes.description: Correction factor applied to convert observed volume at measured temperature to standard volume at 60°F. Calculated per API MPMS Chapter 11.1.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction

attributes.name: truck_number
attributes.description: Identification number of the transport truck or tanker used to haul the crude oil or condensate from the custody transfer point.

attributes.name: unit_price_per_bbl
attributes.description: Price per barrel of crude oil or condensate for this custody transfer. Used to calculate gross revenue.

products.name: gas_measurement
products.description: Transactional record capturing natural gas measurement at custody transfer and allocation meter points. Stores measurement period, meter station ID, raw gas volume (MCF), energy content (MMBtu), heating value (BTU/SCF), specific gravity, CO2 and H2S content (mol%), temperature and pressure base conditions, meter factor, and AGA calculation method (AGA-3, AGA-7, AGA-9). Supports gas sales volume determination, royalty calculations, and pipeline tariff billing. Integrates with the revenue domain for gas sales invoicing.
products.reference: AGA Report No. 3/7/9, API MPMS Chapter 14

attributes.name: gas_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the gas measurement record. Primary key for the gas measurement transaction.

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the buyer, seller, or transporter involved in the custody transfer. Used for gas sales invoicing and royalty calculations.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the gas sales or transportation contract associated with this measurement. Links measurement to commercial terms for pricing and invoicing.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who validated and approved the measurement. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Gas measurements drive revenue postings to GL accounts for gas sales accounting, revenue recognition, and financial statement preparation. Essential for natural gas revenue accounting and custody tran

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Gas measurements at custody transfer points drive revenue allocation, royalty calculations, partner settlements, and regulatory reporting under Joint Operating Agreements.

attributes.name: meter_station_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meter station where the gas measurement was recorded. Links to the physical meter station asset.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Gas custody transfer measurements must identify the product (sales gas, fuel gas, NGL) for contract settlement and BTU-based pricing. Required for pipeline quality specifications and commercial counte

attributes.name: aga_calculation_method
attributes.description: Standard calculation method used for gas flow measurement. AGA-3 for orifice meters, AGA-7 for turbine meters, AGA-9 for ultrasonic meters, AGA-11 for coriolis meters.
attributes.references: AGA Report No. 3 / AGA Report No. 7 / AGA Report No. 9

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate measured gas volumes among multiple wells or owners. Proportional allocation uses well test data; priority allocation follows contractual hierarchy; test-based uses recent well tests.

attributes.name: atmospheric_pressure_psia
attributes.business_glossary_term: Atmospheric Pressure (PSIA - Pounds per Square Inch Absolute)
attributes.description: Atmospheric pressure at the meter location in pounds per square inch absolute. Used to convert gauge pressure to absolute pressure for flow calculations.

attributes.name: base_pressure_psia
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base Pressure (PSIA - Pounds per Square Inch Absolute)
attributes.description: Standard reference pressure for volume correction, typically 14.73 psia. Contractually defined base condition for custody transfer calculations.

attributes.name: base_temperature_f
attributes.description: Standard reference temperature for volume correction, typically 60°F. Contractually defined base condition for custody transfer calculations.

attributes.name: co2_content_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of carbon dioxide in the gas stream. Important for heating value calculation, pipeline quality specifications, and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions reporting.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.1 - Collecting and Handling of Natural Gas Samples

attributes.name: compressibility_factor
attributes.description: Dimensionless factor accounting for deviation of real gas behavior from ideal gas law. Calculated using AGA-8 or other methods based on gas composition, temperature, and pressure.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.2 / AGA Report No. 8

attributes.name: corrected_volume_mcf
attributes.description: Gas volume corrected to standard base conditions (typically 14.73 psia and 60°F) in thousand cubic feet. This is the volume used for custody transfer and sales calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the gas measurement record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: differential_pressure_inches_h2o
attributes.description: Pressure drop across the orifice plate in inches of water column. Used in AGA-3 orifice meter flow calculations. Higher differential indicates higher flow rate.

attributes.name: energy_content_mmbtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Content (MMBtu - Million British Thermal Units)
attributes.description: Total energy content of the measured gas volume in million British thermal units. Calculated by multiplying corrected volume by heating value. Used for gas sales invoicing and pipeline tariff billing.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.5 - Calculation of Gross Heating Value

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Description of the method used to estimate gas volume when meter data is unavailable or invalid. Examples include historical average, adjacent meter correlation, or well test extrapolation.

attributes.name: flowing_pressure_psig
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flowing Pressure (PSIG - Pounds per Square Inch Gauge)
attributes.description: Pressure of the gas at the meter during measurement in pounds per square inch gauge. Used to correct volume to standard base conditions per AGA calculation methods.

attributes.name: flowing_temperature_f
attributes.description: Temperature of the gas at the meter during measurement in degrees Fahrenheit. Used to correct volume to standard base conditions per AGA calculation methods.

attributes.name: h2s_content_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of hydrogen sulfide in the gas stream. Critical for safety, corrosion management, and pipeline quality specifications. Sour gas typically contains >4 ppm H2S.

attributes.name: heating_value_btu_per_scf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Value (BTU per SCF - British Thermal Units per Standard Cubic Foot)
attributes.description: Gross heating value of the gas in BTU per standard cubic foot. Determined by gas chromatograph analysis or calculated from gas composition. Critical for energy-based sales contracts.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the gas measurement for daily production reporting and allocation. Used for aggregating daily production volumes (MCFD/MMCFD).

attributes.name: measurement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the gas measurement period ended. Defines the end of the custody transfer or allocation interval.

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the gas measurement transaction. Externally-known reference number used in custody transfer documentation and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the gas measurement period began. Defines the beginning of the custody transfer or allocation interval.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the gas measurement record. Validated measurements have passed quality checks; approved measurements are ready for billing; final measurements are locked for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gas measurement purpose. Custody transfer measurements are used for sales and royalty calculations; allocation measurements distribute production among wells or facilities; check measurements validate meter accuracy.

attributes.name: meter_factor
attributes.description: Correction factor applied to raw meter readings to account for meter calibration and performance characteristics. Determined through meter proving or calibration. Typically near 1.0000.

attributes.name: meter_tube_diameter_inches
attributes.description: Internal diameter of the meter tube in inches. Used in AGA-3 flow calculations to determine beta ratio (orifice diameter / pipe diameter).

attributes.name: methane_content_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of methane in the gas stream. Primary component of natural gas, typically 70-90%. Used in heating value calculation and compressibility factor determination.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the gas measurement record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking corrections and adjustments.

attributes.name: nitrogen_content_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of nitrogen in the gas stream. Affects heating value and compressibility. High nitrogen content reduces energy content and may require contract adjustments.

attributes.name: orifice_plate_size_inches
attributes.description: Diameter of the orifice plate opening in inches. Used in AGA-3 flow calculations. Must be smaller than pipe diameter to create differential pressure.

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: Data quality indicator for the measurement. Suspect measurements require review; estimated measurements use historical averages; failed measurements indicate meter malfunction.

attributes.name: raw_volume_mcf
attributes.description: Uncorrected gas volume measured at the meter in thousand cubic feet. This is the raw meter reading before applying temperature, pressure, and compressibility corrections.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.3 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding measurement conditions, anomalies, or adjustments. Used to document meter issues, estimation rationale, or custody transfer disputes.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Ratio of the density of the gas to the density of air at standard conditions. Used in flow calculation algorithms and compressibility factor determination. Typical range 0.55 to 0.75 for natural gas.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14.2 - Orifice Metering of Natural Gas

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the measurement was validated and approved for billing and regulatory reporting. Marks transition from draft to validated status.

attributes.name: field_id

attributes.name: joa_id

attributes.name: partner_id

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Production Sharing Agreement governing this entitlement split.

attributes.name: allocation_method

attributes.name: contractor_entitlement_gas_mcf

attributes.name: contractor_entitlement_oil_bbl

attributes.name: contractor_profit_share_pct
attributes.description: Contractor group's percentage share of profit oil and profit gas for this production period under the applicable PSA tier.

attributes.name: cost_gas_volume_mcf
attributes.description: Volume of gas allocated for cost recovery under the PSA terms, measured in thousand cubic feet.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, PSA Contract Terms

attributes.name: cost_oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of oil allocated for cost recovery under the PSA terms, measured in barrels.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, PSA Contract Terms

attributes.name: cost_recovery_limit_pct

Records event type (well workover, stimulation, recompletion, chemical treatment, choke change, pigging, SIMOPS restriction, regulatory shut-in, force majeure), event date and duration, event-specific parameters (e.g., choke bean size for choke changes, treatment volume for chemical treatments), impacted volumes, event description, and outcome. Provides an operational event log that contextualizes production performance changes and supports root cause analysis for production variance.

attributes.name: field_id

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.description: Quality indicator for the pressure measurement. Good data has passed all validation checks; suspect data may have anomalies; estimated data is interpolated; failed data did not meet quality criteria.

attributes.name: data_source

attributes.name: datum_depth_ft
attributes.description: Measured depth in feet at which the pressure measurement was taken. Critical for converting between bottomhole and surface pressures and for reservoir engineering calculations.

attributes.name: datum_depth_tvd_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Datum Depth True Vertical Depth (TVD) in Feet (ft)
attributes.description: True vertical depth in feet at which the pressure measurement was taken. Used for pressure gradient calculations and subsurface mapping. Critical for deviated and horizontal wells.

attributes.name: flowing_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flowing Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Bottomhole flowing pressure in PSI measured while the well is producing. Used to calculate productivity index and assess well performance.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Production Engineering Standards

attributes.name: gauge_accuracy_rating
attributes.description: Manufacturer-specified accuracy rating of the pressure gauge as a percentage of full scale. Typical values range from 0.1% to 1.0%. Used to assess measurement uncertainty.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) RP 11V2 - Gauge Accuracy Standards

attributes.name: gauge_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the pressure gauge was last calibrated. Critical for data quality assurance and regulatory compliance. Measurements taken with expired calibrations may be flagged for review.

attributes.name: gauge_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer of the pressure gauge instrument. Used for equipment tracking, calibration scheduling, and quality assurance.

attributes.name: gauge_model_number
attributes.description: Model number or designation of the pressure gauge instrument. Critical for understanding gauge specifications, accuracy ratings, and calibration requirements.

attributes.name: gauge_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the specific pressure gauge instrument used. Enables traceability to calibration records and maintenance history.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) Equipment Tracking Standards

attributes.name: gauge_type
attributes.description: Type of pressure gauge instrument used for the measurement. Mechanical gauges are traditional analog devices; electronic and memory gauges provide digital recording; permanent downhole gauges enable continuous monitoring.
