attributes.name: initial_reservoir_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Reservoir Pressure in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Original reservoir pressure in PSI before production began. Used as a baseline for calculating pressure depletion and recovery efficiency. Typically established from discovery well measurements.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - OOIP (Original Oil in Place) / OGIP (Original Gas in Place) Standards

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the reservoir pressure measurement was taken. Used for time-series analysis and decline curve modeling.

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the pressure measurement event. Externally-known reference number used in production surveillance reports and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: BSEE (Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement) Production Reporting Standards

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pressure measurement record. Indicates whether the data has been quality-checked and approved for use in reserves calculations and production forecasting.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the reservoir pressure measurement was recorded. Captures the exact moment of the pressure reading for high-resolution surveillance.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pressure measurement method. Static measurements are taken when the well is shut-in; flowing measurements are taken during production; buildup and drawdown are transient test types.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Well Testing Standards

attributes.name: permeability_md
attributes.description: Calculated or interpreted reservoir permeability in millidarcies derived from pressure transient analysis. Indicates the ease with which fluids flow through the reservoir rock.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Reservoir Characterization Standards

attributes.name: pressure_depletion_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of initial reservoir pressure that has been depleted. Calculated as (initial pressure - current pressure) / initial pressure * 100. Used to assess reservoir maturity and remaining reserves.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Reserves Estimation Standards

attributes.name: pressure_depletion_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Depletion in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Calculated pressure decline from initial reservoir pressure to current measured pressure in PSI. Key indicator of reservoir energy depletion and recovery efficiency.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Reservoir Engineering Standards

attributes.name: pressure_gradient_psi_per_ft
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Gradient in Pounds per Square Inch per Foot (PSI/ft)
attributes.description: Calculated pressure gradient in PSI per foot of depth. Derived from pressure and depth measurements. Used to identify fluid contacts, reservoir compartmentalization, and depletion patterns.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) Reservoir Engineering Standards

attributes.name: pressure_value_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pressure Value in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Measured reservoir pressure value in pounds per square inch. This is the primary quantitative result of the measurement and is used for production surveillance, decline analysis, and reserves estimation.
attributes.references: API (American Petroleum Institute) Pressure Measurement Standards

attributes.name: production_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Rate in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Oil production rate in BOPD (Barrels of Oil Per Day) at the time of the pressure measurement. Used to calculate productivity index and assess well performance.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - BOPD (Barrels of Oil Per Day) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: production_rate_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Rate in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD)
attributes.description: Gas production rate in MCFD (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day) at the time of the pressure measurement. Used for gas well performance analysis.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - MCFD (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day) Reporting Standards

attributes.name: productivity_index
attributes.description: Calculated productivity index representing the production rate per unit of pressure drawdown. Expressed as barrels per day per PSI. Key indicator of well deliverability and reservoir connectivity.
attributes.references: SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers) - PI (Productivity Index) Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reservoir pressure record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reservoir pressure record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: recorded_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that recorded the pressure measurement. Used for accountability and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the regulatory report or filing that includes this pressure measurement. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this pressure measurement is required for regulatory reporting to BSEE (Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement), state agencies, or SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) reserves disclosure.

attributes.name: service_company

attributes.name: shut_in_time_hours

attributes.name: skin_factor

attributes.name: static_pressure_psi

attributes.name: temperature_f

attributes.name: test_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the pressure test in hours. For buildup and drawdown tests, this represents the length of the transient test period.

attributes.name: validation_method

attributes.name: vented_volume_mscf

products.name: water_management
products.description: Records produced water handling and disposal activities including water cut tracking, water treatment volumes, disposal well injection volumes, and water recycling metrics

attributes.name: water_management_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the water management record. Primary key for the water management data product.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the production facility where water handling and treatment occurs. Links to the facility managing water operations.

attributes.name: drilling_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to drilling.drilling_well. Business justification: Produced water disposal planning requires drilling data (wellbore integrity, casing design) for UIC permit applications. Operators track water handling cost against drilling AFE for total well cost an

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the company or entity responsible for water management operations. Links to the operator managing produced water handling, treatment, and disposal.

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the oil and gas field where water management activities occur. Links to the geographic and operational field context.

attributes.name: injection_well_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the disposal well used for water injection. Links to the injection well receiving produced water for disposal.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Water disposal costs (treatment, injection, trucking) are operating expenses allocated to partners via JIB; critical for environmental compliance and cost recovery.

attributes.name: water_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Water disposal requires UIC permits for injection and NPDES permits for discharge. Compliance tracking and permit condition monitoring require linking water management records to authorizing permits.

attributes.name: chloride_content_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of chloride ions in the produced water measured in parts per million (PPM). High chloride levels contribute to corrosion and limit disposal and reuse options.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or explanations related to water management activities. Used to document operational issues, treatment anomalies, or regulatory communications.

attributes.name: cumulative_disposal_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of water injected into the disposal well since the start of injection operations. Measured in barrels and tracked for regulatory reporting and reservoir monitoring.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the reliability and validation status of the water management data. Used to identify records requiring review or correction before regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Origin or system from which the water management data was captured. Indicates whether data came from automated SCADA systems, manual field entry, laboratory analysis, or other sources.

attributes.name: discharge_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of treated water discharged to surface water bodies under NPDES permit authorization. Measured in barrels and subject to strict water quality standards.
attributes.references: EPA National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES)

attributes.name: disposal_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for disposing of produced water during the reporting period. Measured in United States Dollars and includes injection fees, transportation, and regulatory compliance costs.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Primary method used for final disposition of produced water. Indicates whether water is injected into disposal wells, discharged to surface water, recycled, or managed through other approved methods.

attributes.name: disposed_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of water injected into disposal wells for permanent subsurface disposal. Measured in barrels and must comply with UIC permit limits.

attributes.name: injection_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disposal Injection Pressure (Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Surface injection pressure at the disposal well measured in pounds per square inch (PSI). Must remain below maximum allowable injection pressure to maintain mechanical integrity and prevent fracturing.
attributes.references: EPA UIC Class II Well Requirements

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection of water management facilities and operations. Inspections verify compliance with permit conditions and environmental standards.

attributes.name: max_allowable_injection_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Allowable Injection Pressure (Pounds per Square Inch)
attributes.description: Maximum permitted surface injection pressure for the disposal well as specified in the UIC permit. Calculated to prevent formation fracturing and ensure containment.
attributes.references: EPA UIC Class II Well Requirements

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next regulatory inspection of water management operations. Based on permit requirements and regulatory agency inspection cycles.

attributes.name: oil_content_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of oil and grease in the produced water measured in parts per million (PPM). Critical parameter for assessing treatment effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the water management system. Indicates whether water handling operations are actively processing produced water.

attributes.name: permit_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current water management permit expires and must be renewed. Critical for ensuring continuous authorization for disposal, discharge, or recycling operations.

attributes.name: ph_level
attributes.description: Measure of acidity or alkalinity of the produced water on a scale of 0 to 14. Critical parameter for corrosion control, treatment process optimization, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: produced_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of water produced from the well measured in barrels. Represents gross water production before any treatment or disposal.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the water management record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: record_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which water management activities are recorded. Primary business event date for water handling operations.

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the water management record. External reference number used for tracking and reporting water handling activities.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the water management record was last modified. Audit field for tracking data changes and ensuring data integrity.

attributes.name: recycled_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of produced water that has been treated and reused for beneficial purposes such as hydraulic fracturing, enhanced oil recovery (EOR), or irrigation. Measured in barrels.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state with respect to water management permits and environmental regulations. Indicates whether operations meet all applicable UIC, NPDES, and state water quality requirements.

attributes.name: salinity_ppm
attributes.description: Total salt concentration in the produced water measured in parts per million (PPM). Indicates the level of dissolved salts that affect treatment options and disposal methods.

attributes.name: total_dissolved_solids_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of dissolved minerals and salts in the water measured in parts per million (PPM). High TDS levels indicate saline or brackish water requiring specialized treatment.

attributes.name: total_suspended_solids_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of suspended solid particles in the water measured in parts per million (PPM). Indicates the level of particulate matter that must be removed before disposal or reuse.

attributes.name: treated_water_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of produced water that has undergone treatment processes to remove oil, solids, and contaminants. Measured in barrels after treatment facility processing.

attributes.name: treatment_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for treating produced water during the reporting period. Measured in United States Dollars and includes chemical costs, energy consumption, and labor.

attributes.name: treatment_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of contaminants removed by the water treatment process. Calculated as the reduction in contaminant concentration from influent to effluent divided by influent concentration.

attributes.name: treatment_method
attributes.description: Primary technology or process used to treat produced water. Indicates the treatment approach employed to remove contaminants and prepare water for disposal, recycling, or discharge. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical_separation|chemical_treatment|filtration|membrane_separation|thermal_treatment|biological_treatment|electrocoagulation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: water_cut_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of water in the total fluid production stream. Calculated as water volume divided by total liquid volume (oil plus water) multiplied by 100. Critical metric for reservoir performance and artificial lift optimization.

attributes.name: water_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the origin or type of water being managed. Distinguishes between produced water from ongoing operations, flowback from hydraulic fracturing, and other water sources.

attributes.name: previous_water_management_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on water_management (previous_water_management_id)

products.name: separator

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating company responsible for this separator equipment and associated production operations.

attributes.name: equipment_id

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Separators are facility assets; capital costs (installation, replacement) and operating costs (maintenance, inspection) are allocated to partners under JOA.

attributes.name: manufacturer_vendor_id

attributes.name: production_facility_id

attributes.name: asset_code

attributes.name: calibration_status

attributes.name: commissioning_date

attributes.name: control_system_type

attributes.name: design_temperature_f

attributes.name: fabrication_year

attributes.name: inspection_interval_months

attributes.name: installation_cost_usd

attributes.name: installation_date

attributes.name: internals_type

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: material_specification

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection of the separator per regulatory requirements and risk-based inspection program.

attributes.name: operating_pressure_psi

attributes.name: operating_temperature_f
attributes.description: Normal operating temperature of the separator during production operations in degrees Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: operational_status

attributes.name: ownership_interest_pct

attributes.name: replacement_value_usd

attributes.name: safety_relief_valve_set_pressure_psi

attributes.name: scada_tag_prefix

attributes.name: separator_name

attributes.name: separator_type
attributes.description: Classification of separator based on phase separation capability. Two-phase separates gas and liquid; three-phase separates gas, oil, and water; test separator used for well testing; FWKO removes free water upstream of main separation.

attributes.name: tag_number

attributes.name: vessel_diameter_inches

attributes.name: artificial_lift_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the artificial lift equipment master record for this specific ESP installation.

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: field_id

attributes.name: joa_id

attributes.name: production_facility_id

attributes.name: scada_tag_id

attributes.name: alarm_code

attributes.name: alarm_description

attributes.name: casing_pressure_psi

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: data_quality_flag

attributes.name: data_source

attributes.name: differential_pressure_psi

attributes.name: fluid_level_depth_ft

attributes.name: fluid_rate_bfpd

attributes.name: intake_pressure_psi

attributes.name: measurement_date

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp

attributes.name: production_rate_bopd

attributes.name: pump_efficiency_percent

attributes.name: pump_setting_depth_ft
attributes.description: Measured depth at which the ESP is set in the wellbore in feet. Critical for calculating bottomhole pressure and pump performance.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this ESP performance record was first created in the data product. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.description: System timestamp when this ESP performance record was last modified. Supports change tracking and data governance requirements.

attributes.name: run_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the ESP has been operating since installation or last restart. Key metric for reliability analysis and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) calculation.

attributes.name: submergence_ft
attributes.description: Vertical distance in feet between the fluid level and the pump intake. Adequate submergence prevents gas lock and ensures stable pump operation.

attributes.name: target_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Desired operating frequency setpoint for the ESP variable speed drive in hertz. Used for automated control and optimization.

attributes.name: tubing_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Pressure measured at the wellhead tubing in pounds per square inch. Indicates flowing conditions and surface equipment backpressure.

attributes.name: vibration_mils
attributes.description: Vibration amplitude measured in mils (thousandths of an inch). Excessive vibration indicates mechanical issues such as bearing wear, shaft misalignment, or pump damage.

attributes.name: work_order_number

products.name: production_working_interest
products.description: This association product represents the ownership and operational participation relationship between a production well and a venture partner. It captures the partner's economic interest, revenue entitlement, and operational role in a specific well. Each record links one production well to one partner with attributes that define the partner's financial stake, operational responsibilities, and participation terms in that well. This is the foundational SSOT for joint venture accounting, revenue distribution, AFE cost allocation, and regulatory ownership reporting.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, a production well has multiple partners who each hold distinct working interest and net revenue interest percentages, and a partner holds interests in multiple wells across their portfolio. The business actively manages these working interest relationships as operational records with specific percentages, effective dates, operator designations, carried interest terms, and non-consent elections. This is the foundational relationship for joint venture accounting, AFE cost allocation, revenue distribution, and regulatory ownership reporting.

attributes.name: production_working_interest_id
attributes.description: Primary key for production_working_interest

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the Joint Operating Agreement that governs this working interest. Links to the contract that defines operational rights, voting procedures, and cost allocation rules.

attributes.name: production_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production well in which the partner holds working interest. Enables aggregation of partner interests across wells and well-level revenue/cost allocation.

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the venture partner who holds the working interest. Enables partner-level reporting of portfolio interests and revenue entitlements.

attributes.name: working_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this working interest record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner acquired this working interest through purchase, farm-in, or assignment. Used for asset tracking and regulatory change-of-operator reporting.

attributes.name: carried_interest_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this partner's interest is carried (costs paid by other partners) under a farm-in or carry agreement. Carried partners receive revenue but do not pay proportionate costs until payout conditions are met.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: System timestamp when this working interest record was created in the system.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner disposed of this working interest through sale, farm-out, or assignment. Null for currently held interests.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this working interest ownership became effective. Critical for time-based revenue and cost allocation. Typically corresponds to JOA execution date, farm-in effective date, or acquisition closing date.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this working interest ownership expires or was terminated. Null for active interests. Used for historical interest tracking and revenue allocation cutoff.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the economic interest type. Working-interest = cost-bearing operating interest; Royalty-interest = landowner non-cost-bearing interest; Overriding-royalty = carved-out non-cost-bearing interest; Production-payment = limited-term revenue interest; Net-profits-interest = revenue after costs.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partner's percentage entitlement to revenue from production after deducting royalties, overriding royalties, and other burdens. NRI is typically less than WI due to royalty burdens. Used for revenue distribution and production accounting.

attributes.name: non_consent_status
attributes.description: Status of the partner's participation election for this well. Consenting = partner approved AFE and pays costs; Non-consent = partner declined to participate and forfeits revenue until penalty recovered; Forced-pooled = regulatory pooling order; Pending = AFE vote outstanding.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this partner is the designated operator for this well under the JOA. Only one partner per well should have operator_flag = true. Operator has day-to-day operational control and submits AFEs.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the well has reached payout for this partner under carry or reversionary interest terms. Pre-payout = costs still being recovered; Post-payout = cost recovery complete, interest may revert; Not-applicable = no payout provisions.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: The partner's percentage ownership of capital costs and operating expenses for this well. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 25.5000 for 25.5%). Sum of all WI percentages for a well typically equals 100%. Used for AFE cost allocation and joint interest billing.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this working interest requires regulatory filing with state or federal agencies (e.g., BSEE Form APD, state change-of-operator notice). Used to trigger compliance workflows.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this working interest record.

attributes.name: updated_date
attributes.description: System timestamp when this working interest record was last modified.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this working interest record.

products.name: facility_plant_supply
products.description: This association product represents the supply contract between production facilities and petrochemical plants. It captures the commercial and operational arrangements for hydrocarbon feedstock delivery from upstream production facilities (gas plants, CPFs, wellpads) to downstream petrochemical manufacturing plants. Each record links one production facility to one petrochemical plant with contract capacity commitments, transportation arrangements, tariff rates, and effective dates that exist only in the context of this supply relationship.. Existence Justification: In integrated oil and gas operations, production facilities (gas plants, central processing facilities, wellpads) supply hydrocarbon feedstock to multiple downstream petrochemical plants through pipeline networks and gathering systems. Conversely, petrochemical plants source feedstock from multiple upstream production facilities to ensure supply reliability, optimize feedstock quality blending, and manage operational flexibility. The business actively manages these supply relationships as commercial contracts with capacity commitments, transportation arrangements, tariff rates, and effective dates.

attributes.name: facility_plant_supply_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the facility-to-plant supply contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: petchem_plant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Plant Supply - Petchem Plant Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the downstream petrochemical plant that receives hydrocarbon feedstock

attributes.name: pipeline_connection_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical pipeline or transportation infrastructure connecting the production facility to the petrochemical plant. References midstream pipeline network assets.

attributes.name: production_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Plant Supply - Production Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the upstream production facility that supplies hydrocarbon feedstock

attributes.name: contract_capacity_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Capacity Barrels Oil Per Day
attributes.description: Contracted liquid hydrocarbon delivery capacity in barrels of oil per day (BOPD) from the production facility to the petrochemical plant. Represents the committed supply volume for NGLs, condensate, or crude feedstock.

attributes.name: contract_capacity_mmcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Capacity Million Cubic Feet Per Day
attributes.description: Contracted natural gas delivery capacity in million cubic feet per day (MMCFD) from the production facility to the petrochemical plant. Represents the committed supply volume for gas feedstock to steam crackers or GTL units.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the facility-to-plant supply contract. Indicates whether feedstock delivery is active, temporarily suspended, or contract is under renegotiation.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Commercial structure of the supply contract. Firm contracts guarantee delivery, interruptible contracts allow curtailment, take-or-pay requires minimum offtake regardless of actual consumption.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility-to-plant supply contract record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility-to-plant supply contract becomes active and feedstock delivery commitments begin. Used for contract lifecycle management and supply planning.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility-to-plant supply contract record was last updated.

attributes.name: primary_feedstock_type
attributes.description: Main hydrocarbon product type delivered under this supply contract (e.g., Natural Gas, Ethane, Propane, Butane, Condensate, Crude Oil). Determines compatibility with petrochemical plant feedstock requirements.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility-to-plant supply contract expires or is terminated. Null for evergreen contracts. Used for contract renewal planning and feedstock sourcing strategy.

attributes.name: transportation_tariff
attributes.description: Transportation fee or tariff rate charged for moving hydrocarbon feedstock from the production facility to the petrochemical plant. Typically expressed in USD per barrel or USD per MMBTU. Critical for integrated margin optimization and transfer pricing.

products.name: facility_offtake_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the capacity allocation contract between production facilities and offtake agreements. It captures the specific volume commitments, time periods, and nomination rights that govern how production capacity from a facility is allocated to fulfill offtake obligations. Each record links one production facility to one offtake agreement with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship. Critical for production planning, revenue assurance, and managing competing offtake obligations across shared infrastructure.. Existence Justification: In oil-and-gas commercial operations, production facilities commonly supply multiple offtake agreements simultaneously (different buyers, different products, or time-shared capacity allocation), and offtake agreements routinely source from multiple facilities to ensure supply security, enable blending for quality specifications, and manage production variability. The allocation relationship is actively managed by commercial teams who track capacity commitments, priority rankings, and nomination rights for each facility-agreement pairing.

attributes.name: facility_offtake_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this facility-offtake allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Offtake Allocation - Offtake Agreement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the offtake agreement receiving allocated capacity

attributes.name: production_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Offtake Allocation - Production Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production facility providing capacity under this allocation

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_bopd
attributes.description: Oil production capacity allocated from this facility to this offtake agreement, measured in barrels of oil per day. Represents the contractual entitlement for this buyer from this specific facility.

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_mmcfd
attributes.description: Natural gas production capacity allocated from this facility to this offtake agreement, measured in million cubic feet per day. Used when the offtake agreement covers gas production.

attributes.name: allocation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this facility stops supplying production to this offtake agreement. Nullable for open-ended allocations. Used to manage facility transitions and contract amendments.

attributes.name: allocation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this facility begins supplying production to this offtake agreement. May differ from the offtake agreement effective date if the agreement sources from multiple facilities with staggered start dates.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this facility-offtake allocation. ACTIVE = currently supplying, SUSPENDED = temporarily halted (force majeure, maintenance), EXPIRED = allocation period ended, AMENDED = superseded by new allocation terms.

attributes.name: blending_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether production from this facility can be blended with production from other facilities to fulfill this offtake agreement. False when buyer requires segregated production for quality specifications or regulatory tracking.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system. Used for audit trail of commercial contract amendments.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this allocation record. Tracks changes to capacity allocations, priority rankings, or nomination rights.

attributes.name: nomination_rights
attributes.description: Type of nomination rights the buyer holds for this facility allocation. FIRM = guaranteed capacity, INTERRUPTIBLE = subject to curtailment, CONDITIONAL = requires advance notice, SWING = flexible within range. Determines operational priority during capacity constraints.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking of this offtake agreement relative to other agreements drawing from the same facility. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to resolve competing claims when facility throughput is constrained. Critical for take-or-pay dispute resolution.

products.name: facility_working_interest
products.description: This association product represents the ownership and operational interest relationship between production facilities and joint venture partners. It captures the legal and financial participation of each partner in a production facility, including ownership percentages, operator designation, and cost allocation methods. Each record links one production facility to one partner with attributes that define the partner's specific interest in that facility.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, production facilities are routinely co-owned by multiple partners under Joint Operating Agreements (JOAs) or Production Sharing Agreements (PSAs). A single processing plant, FPSO, or gathering station can have 2-10+ partners each holding different ownership and working interest percentages. Conversely, a single partner (e.g., Shell, ExxonMobil, or a national oil company) participates in dozens or hundreds of facilities across multiple fields and basins. The business actively manages these working interests for production allocation, joint interest billing, revenue distribution, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: facility_working_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this facility working interest record. Primary key.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement or Production Sharing Agreement that governs this partner's interest in the facility. Links to contract management system.

attributes.name: production_facility_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Working Interest - Production Facility Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production facility in which the partner holds an interest

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Facility Working Interest - Venture Partner Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the joint venture partner holding the interest

attributes.name: billing_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity to which joint interest bills should be sent for this partner's share of facility costs. May differ from the partner's primary entity due to subsidiary structures.

attributes.name: carried_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner's interest is carried (costs paid by other partners) until a specified payout threshold. Common in farm-in agreements where the farmor carries the farmee through drilling and completion.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate facility operating costs to this partner. WORKING_INTEREST = costs allocated per working interest percentage, REVENUE_INTEREST = costs allocated per revenue share, CUSTOM = special allocation per agreement, FIXED_FEE = partner pays fixed monthly fee.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this working interest record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this partner's interest in the facility became effective. Used for production allocation and cost recovery calculations. Typically the closing date of the farm-in, acquisition, or JOA execution.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this partner's interest in the facility expires or was divested. Null for active interests. Used to track historical ownership for audit and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this working interest. ACTIVE = partner is receiving production and paying costs, SUSPENDED = temporarily inactive, DIVESTED = interest sold or transferred, PENDING_TRANSFER = awaiting regulatory approval for transfer.

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this working interest record was last modified.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner is designated as the operator for this facility. Only one partner per facility should have this flag set to true. The operator is responsible for day-to-day operations and submits joint interest billings to non-operators.

attributes.name: ownership_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partner's ownership interest percentage in the production facility. Represents the partner's share of reserves and production entitlement. Must sum to 100% across all partners for a given facility.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Current payout status for carried or back-in interests. NOT_APPLICABLE = no carry arrangement, PRE_PAYOUT = costs still being carried, POST_PAYOUT = payout achieved and partner now paying costs, PARTIAL_PAYOUT = some cost categories paid.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Government or regulatory body approval number for this partner's interest in the facility. Required in jurisdictions where ownership transfers must be approved by mineral rights authorities.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partner's working interest percentage in the production facility. Represents the partner's share of operating costs and capital expenditures. May differ from ownership interest due to carried interests or back-in provisions.

products.name: well_contract_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between production wells and term contracts in oil and gas commercial operations. It captures the assignment of well production volumes to specific term contracts, enabling split allocations across multiple buyers, contract periods, and priority hierarchies. Each record links one production well to one term contract with allocation-specific attributes including volume splits, time periods, percentages, and delivery priorities that exist only in the context of this commercial allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas commercial operations, production from a single well is routinely allocated across multiple term contracts to fulfill obligations to different buyers, contract periods, or joint venture partners. Conversely, a single term contract typically receives production from multiple wells to meet volume commitments. This allocation relationship is actively managed by commercial operations teams who track volume splits, allocation percentages, time periods, and contract priorities for each well-contract pairing.

attributes.name: well_contract_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this well-to-contract allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Well Contract Allocation - Term Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the term contract receiving allocated production from this well

attributes.name: production_well_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Well Contract Allocation - Production Well Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production well whose output is being allocated to this term contract

attributes.name: allocated_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Specific volume of oil production in barrels allocated from this well to this term contract for the allocation period. Used for fixed-volume allocations and contract fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: allocated_volume_mcf
attributes.description: Specific volume of natural gas production in thousand cubic feet allocated from this well to this term contract for the allocation period. Used for gas contract fulfillment.

attributes.name: allocation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this well-to-contract allocation ceases. Nullable for ongoing allocations. Used to track historical allocations and contract transitions.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate allocation from this well to this contract: percentage (fixed percentage split), fixed_volume (specific volume commitment), priority_waterfall (sequential priority-based), pro_rata (proportional based on contract commitments).

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the wells total production allocated to this term contract. Used for proportional allocation models where multiple contracts share well output. Must be between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: allocation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this well-to-contract allocation becomes effective and production begins flowing to this contract. Critical for time-based allocation changes and contract transitions.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this allocation: active (currently allocating production), suspended (temporarily halted), expired (allocation period ended), pending (scheduled future allocation).

attributes.name: contract_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this contract allocation when multiple contracts compete for the same well production. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest). Used in allocation waterfall logic and take-or-pay contract fulfillment.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system. Used for audit trail and allocation history tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record. Used for change tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for business context, special instructions, or allocation-specific comments (e.g., joint venture agreements, regulatory requirements, temporary allocation adjustments).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created this allocation record. Used for audit and accountability.

products.name: well_afe_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the formal linkage between a production well and an Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) that funds specific work on that well. It captures the phase-specific cost allocation, timing, and budget performance for each well-AFE pairing. Each record links one production well to one AFE with attributes that track the financial relationship across the well lifecycle (drilling, completion, workover, abandonment). This enables tracking of multi-well AFEs (pad drilling programs covering 6-10 wells) and multi-AFE wells (a single well accumulating costs across 5+ AFEs over 20+ years).. Existence Justification: In oil and gas operations, wells accumulate costs across multiple AFEs throughout their lifecycle (initial drilling AFE, completion AFE, multiple workover AFEs over 20+ years, eventual abandonment AFE), and AFEs frequently cover multiple wells simultaneously (pad drilling programs authorize 6-10 wells under a single AFE, field-wide projects span dozens of wells). The business actively manages these well-AFE assignments to track phase-specific costs, allocate multi-well AFE budgets proportionally, and analyze well-level economic performance across the asset lifecycle.

attributes.name: well_afe_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this well-AFE assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Well Afe Assignment - Finance Afe Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the AFE that authorizes and funds the work on this well

attributes.name: production_well_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Well Afe Assignment - Production Well Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production well that is the subject of the AFE expenditure

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The actual cumulative costs incurred for this specific well under this AFE, representing the well-level slice of total AFE expenditures. Critical for well-level economic analysis and for reconciling multi-well AFE performance.

attributes.name: afe_phase
attributes.description: The phase or type of work that this AFE covers for this specific well: drilling (initial wellbore construction), completion (well completion and stimulation), workover (remedial work on producing well), facility (surface equipment and infrastructure), abandonment (plugging and abandonment), or other project types. Critical for understanding which lifecycle stage the costs apply to.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current status of this well-AFE assignment: planned (AFE approved but work not yet started), active (work in progress), completed (work finished and costs reconciled), cancelled (AFE assignment cancelled before completion). Supports operational tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: budget_variance
attributes.description: The budget variance (allocated budget minus actual cost) for this specific well under this AFE. Negative values indicate cost overruns at the well level. Enables well-level budget performance tracking even when the overall AFE may be on budget.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the work covered by this AFE for this specific well was completed and the AFE assignment was closed out. Enables calculation of project duration and supports cost reconciliation at the well-AFE level.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total AFE budget allocated to this specific well, used when a single AFE covers multiple wells (e.g., pad drilling program where one AFE covers 8 wells, each well might be allocated 12.5% of costs). Enables proportional cost tracking and variance analysis at the well level.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The accounting cost center code used for tracking costs for this well-AFE assignment, enabling integration with financial systems and supporting cost allocation across organizational units.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this well-AFE assignment became effective, typically the date when work commenced or the AFE was formally assigned to the well. Used for temporal tracking of which AFE was active for which well during which time period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about this well-AFE assignment, such as special circumstances, scope changes, or operational considerations that affect cost allocation or project execution.

attributes.name: primary_well_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the primary well for this AFE (true) or a secondary well in a multi-well AFE (false). For single-well AFEs, this is always true. For multi-well AFEs (e.g., pad drilling), one well is designated as primary for reporting purposes.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Refineries operate under multiple regulatory permits (Title V air permits, NPDES wastewater permits, RCRA hazardous waste permits). EPA facility IDs and state permit numbers are denormalized reference

attributes.name: primary_petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Refineries are configured and licensed to produce specific primary petroleum products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel). Essential for regulatory compliance reporting, production planning, and commercial s

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Refineries are profit centers for segment reporting and margin analysis. SEC reporting, management dashboards, and investment decisions require linking refinery operations to profit center structure f

attributes.name: alkylation_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of alkylation units installed at the refinery. Alkylation units combine light olefins with isobutane to produce high-octane gasoline blending components.

attributes.name: api_facility_number
attributes.description: Facility registration number assigned by the American Petroleum Institute for industry reporting and standards compliance.

attributes.name: cdu_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of crude distillation units installed at the refinery. CDUs perform the primary separation of crude oil into fractions based on boiling point ranges.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the refinery facility is located.

attributes.name: coker_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of delayed coking units installed at the refinery. Cokers thermally crack heavy residual oils into lighter products and petroleum coke.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the refinery facility was officially commissioned and began commercial operations. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the refinery is located. Used for regulatory compliance, tax jurisdiction, and international reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this refinery master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: dcs_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refinery distributed control system. Links the refinery master record to real-time process control and SCADA data.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the refinery based on its processing complexity and unit configuration. Integrated refineries have full conversion capabilities, hydroskimming refineries have basic distillation, conversion refineries focus on upgrading heavy crude, and specialty refineries produce niche products.

attributes.name: fcc_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of fluid catalytic cracking units installed at the refinery. FCC units convert heavy gas oils into lighter, more valuable products such as gasoline and light olefins using catalytic cracking.

attributes.name: hds_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of hydrodesulfurization units installed at the refinery. HDS units remove sulfur from petroleum fractions to meet environmental regulations and product specifications.

attributes.name: hydrocracker_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of hydrocracking units installed at the refinery. Hydrocrackers use hydrogen and catalysts to break down heavy oils into lighter, higher-value products.

attributes.name: is_tier_3_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refinery meets EPA Tier 3 gasoline sulfur standards requiring sulfur content below 10 ppm. Critical for regulatory compliance and product marketing.
attributes.references: EPA Tier 3 Vehicle Emission and Fuel Standards

attributes.name: is_ulsd_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the refinery has the capability to produce ultra-low sulfur diesel with sulfur content below 15 ppm as required by EPA regulations.

attributes.name: last_turnaround_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major turnaround or planned maintenance shutdown. Turnarounds are comprehensive maintenance events that occur every 3-5 years.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the refinery facility in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, logistics planning, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the refinery facility in decimal degrees. Used for mapping, logistics planning, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: nameplate_capacity_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Nameplate Capacity in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Maximum designed crude oil processing capacity of the refinery measured in barrels of oil per day under optimal operating conditions. This is the theoretical maximum throughput as designed by the engineering team.

attributes.name: nelson_complexity_index
attributes.description: Industry-standard measure of refinery complexity based on the relative cost and sophistication of processing units. Higher values indicate more complex refineries with greater conversion and upgrading capabilities. Typical range is 1.0 to 15.0.
attributes.references: Oil & Gas Journal - Nelson Complexity Index Methodology

attributes.name: next_turnaround_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next major turnaround or maintenance shutdown. Used for maintenance planning, budgeting, and production forecasting.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the refinery facility. Operating indicates normal production, turnaround indicates scheduled maintenance shutdown, idle indicates temporary suspension, decommissioned indicates permanent closure, and under construction indicates facility is being built.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the refinery facility. Wholly owned indicates 100% ownership by Oil Gas, joint venture indicates shared ownership with partners, leased indicates the facility is leased from another party, and operated indicates Oil Gas operates but does not own the facility.

attributes.name: pi_system_site_name
attributes.description: Site name in the OSIsoft PI System historian that stores real-time and historical process data for this refinery. Used for data integration and analytics.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the refinery facility location.

attributes.name: primary_feedstock_type
attributes.description: Predominant type of crude oil feedstock processed by the refinery. Light sweet crude has low sulfur and high API gravity, medium sour has moderate sulfur, heavy sour has high sulfur and low API gravity, synthetic is from oil sands, and blended is a mix of multiple crude types.
attributes.references: API Gravity and Sulfur Content Classification

attributes.name: refinery_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the refinery in operational systems, reports, and inter-facility communications. Typically 3-10 characters.

attributes.name: refinery_name
attributes.description: Official business name of the refinery facility as registered with regulatory authorities and used in operational reporting.

attributes.name: reformer_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of catalytic reforming units installed at the refinery. Reformers convert low-octane naphtha into high-octane gasoline blending components and produce hydrogen as a byproduct.

attributes.name: renewable_diesel_capacity_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Diesel Capacity in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Maximum production capacity for renewable diesel from bio-based feedstocks measured in barrels per day. Zero if the refinery does not have renewable diesel capability.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or primary administrative division where the refinery facility is located. Used for regulatory jurisdiction and tax purposes.

attributes.name: street_address
attributes.description: Physical street address of the refinery facility including street number, street name, and any building or unit identifiers.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the refinery location. Used for scheduling, shift management, and timestamp normalization in operational reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this refinery master record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: vdu_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of vacuum distillation units installed at the refinery. VDUs further process atmospheric residue from CDUs under vacuum to extract additional valuable products.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership interest held by Oil Gas in the refinery facility. Used for financial reporting, cost allocation, and revenue distribution in joint venture arrangements.

products.name: process_unit
products.description: Master record and SSOT for refinery process unit configuration and alarm management. Covers CDU, VDU, FCC, HDS, hydrocracker, reformer, alkylation, isomerization, coker, and treating units. Captures unit type, design capacity, feed type, operating pressure and temperature design limits, capacity constraints, DCS tag prefix, PI System historian tag group, Aspen HYSYS model reference, commissioning date, current operational status, and process alarm management including alarm tags, types (high/low/deviation/rate-of-change), priorities, acknowledgment and shelving status, operator response tracking, and root cause classification per ISA-18.2 alarm management standards and OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM requirements.

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refinery process unit. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent refinery facility where this process unit is located.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Process units (CDU, FCC, hydrocracker) are cost centers for activity-based costing. Unit-level cost tracking enables variance analysis, benchmarking, and optimization decisions. Standard refining acco

attributes.name: hse_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.hse_risk_assessment. Business justification: Process hazard analysis (PHA) per OSHA PSM assesses unit-specific risks (HAZOP, LOPA). Risk registers are organized by process unit for management of change, pre-startup safety reviews, and revalidati

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Process units in JV refineries need JOA linkage for unit-level capital project approvals, turnaround AFE authorization, and partner cost sharing. JOA voting thresholds apply to major unit modification

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Individual process units (FCC, hydrocracker, coker) require specific air emission permits under EPA Title V and state regulations. Each unit has emission limits, monitoring requirements, and complianc

attributes.name: permit_to_work_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.permit_to_work. Business justification: Permits to work authorize maintenance and operations on specific process units. Operational safety management systems require linking permits to units for isolation verification, energy control, and s

attributes.name: primary_petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Process units are designed for specific product outputs (FCC→gasoline, HDS→low-sulfur diesel, hydrocracker→jet fuel). Critical for unit performance KPIs, production planning, LP optimization models, a

attributes.name: refinery_id
attributes.description: FK to refining.refinery.refinery_id — MUST-HAVE: Enables linking process units to their parent refinery for capacity planning, turnaround scheduling, and yield optimization. Fundamental parent-child relationship.

attributes.name: unit_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each process unit (CDU, FCC, HDS, hydrocracker) has a designated shift supervisor responsible for safe operations, alarm response, and unit performance. Essential for shift handovers, incident investi

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this process unit record is currently active in the system.

attributes.name: alarm_acknowledgment_status
attributes.description: Current acknowledgment state of the alarm indicating whether it has been seen and acted upon by an operator.

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the alarm indicating urgency of operator response required.

attributes.name: alarm_root_cause_classification
attributes.description: Categorization of the underlying cause of the alarm for trend analysis and continuous improvement (e.g., equipment malfunction, process upset, operator error, design issue).

attributes.name: alarm_setpoint
attributes.description: Threshold value at which the alarm is triggered.

attributes.name: alarm_shelving_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alarm shelving will automatically expire and the alarm will be re-enabled.

attributes.name: alarm_shelving_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for shelving the alarm, required for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: alarm_shelving_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alarm has been temporarily suppressed (shelved) to prevent nuisance alarms during abnormal operations.

attributes.name: alarm_tag
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process alarm in the DCS or alarm management system.

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the alarm based on the condition being monitored (high limit, low limit, deviation from setpoint, rate of change, equipment failure, or safety-critical event).

attributes.name: aspen_hysys_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the Aspen HYSYS process simulation model for this unit used for optimization and planning.

attributes.name: capacity_constraint_description
attributes.description: Description of any operational constraints that limit the unit from achieving design capacity (e.g., downstream bottleneck, feedstock quality, equipment degradation).

attributes.name: capacity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the design capacity. BPD (Barrels Per Day), BOPD (Barrels of Oil Per Day), MCFD (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day), MMCFD (Million Cubic Feet per Day), MT/Day (Metric Tons per Day).

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the process unit was commissioned and placed into service.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this process unit record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dcs_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Standard tag prefix used in the DCS for all control points and instruments associated with this process unit.

attributes.name: design_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum throughput capacity of the process unit as designed, measured in barrels per day (BPD) for liquid units or thousand cubic feet per day (MCFD) for gas units.
attributes.references: API RP 750 - Process Unit Design Specifications

attributes.name: design_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Maximum operating pressure for which the process unit is designed, measured in pounds per square inch (PSI).
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII

attributes.name: design_temperature_f
attributes.description: Maximum operating temperature for which the process unit is designed, measured in degrees Fahrenheit.
attributes.references: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII

attributes.name: epa_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Reporting Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this process unit is subject to EPA emissions reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 - Standards of Performance for New Stationary Sources

attributes.name: feed_type
attributes.description: Primary feedstock type processed by this unit (e.g., crude oil, vacuum gas oil, naphtha, heavy gas oil).

attributes.name: last_turnaround_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent planned shutdown for major maintenance, inspection, and equipment replacement.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this process unit record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_turnaround_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned turnaround maintenance event.

attributes.name: operating_pressure_max_psi
attributes.description: Maximum safe operating pressure for the process unit in pounds per square inch (PSI).

attributes.name: operating_pressure_min_psi
attributes.description: Minimum safe operating pressure for the process unit in pounds per square inch (PSI).

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum safe operating temperature for the process unit in degrees Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum safe operating temperature for the process unit in degrees Fahrenheit.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the process unit indicating whether it is actively processing, under maintenance, or offline.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 PSM - Process Status Tracking

attributes.name: operator_response_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken by the operator in response to the alarm.

attributes.name: operator_response_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this alarm requires mandatory operator action or is informational only.

attributes.name: operator_response_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operator responded to the alarm.

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_group
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI System tag group identifier for real-time and historical process data collection from this unit.

attributes.name: process_safety_management_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the process unit based on process safety risk and regulatory requirements under OSHA PSM standards.

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code for the process unit used across systems and documentation.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Business name of the process unit (e.g., CDU-1, FCC-A, HDS-North).
attributes.references: API RP 750 - Refinery Process Unit Naming

attributes.name: unit_type
