products.name: crude_assay
products.description: Master reference record and SSOT for crude oil grade characterization, including API gravity, sulfur content (wt%), TAN (Total Acid Number), viscosity, pour point, distillation curve (TBP/ASTM D86), metal content (Ni, V, Fe), salt content, Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP), SARA fractions, and yield potential by cut. Linked to crude grade in the product domain. Used by Aspen HYSYS for feedstock blending optimization and CDU/VDU simulation. Each assay represents a specific crude grade's quality profile used for crude valuation, blend optimization, and unit yield prediction.

attributes.name: crude_assay_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the crude assay record. Primary key for the crude assay master data product.

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crude oil grade that this assay characterizes. Links to the crude grade master in the product domain.

attributes.name: hazardous_substance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.hazardous_substance. Business justification: Crude assays identify H2S content, NORM levels, and hazardous components. Safety data sheets, Tier II reporting, and worker exposure assessments require assay-to-substance linkage for hazard classific

attributes.name: price_differential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.price_differential. Business justification: Crude assay properties (API gravity, sulfur content, TAN) directly determine price differentials versus benchmark. Essential for crude valuation, procurement pricing, and margin optimization.

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the crude oil, measured in degrees API. Key indicator of crude density and quality; higher API gravity indicates lighter, more valuable crude. Typical range 10-50 degrees API.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: aromatic_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Aromatic hydrocarbon content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent (from SARA analysis: Saturates, Aromatics, Resins, Asphaltenes). Aromatic content affects product quality (cetane, smoke point) and processing severity requirements.
attributes.references: ASTM D2007 - Standard Test Method for Characteristic Groups in Rubber Extender and Processing Oils by the Clay-Gel Absorption Chromatographic Method (SARA Analysis)

attributes.name: asphaltene_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Asphaltene content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent. Asphaltenes are heavy, polar molecules that cause fouling, coking, and stability issues. High asphaltene content affects crude compatibility for blending and requires careful processing.
attributes.references: ASTM D6560 - Standard Test Method for Determination of Asphaltenes (Heptane Insolubles) in Crude Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: assay_date
attributes.description: Date when the crude oil sample was assayed or when the assay data was published. Used for assay currency and validity tracking.
attributes.references: ASTM D4057 - Standard Practice for Manual Sampling of Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: assay_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the laboratory or organization that performed the crude assay analysis. Used for assay quality validation and traceability.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: assay_name
attributes.description: Business name or identifier for this crude assay, typically including crude grade name and source location (e.g., 'Brent North Sea 2023', 'WTI Cushing Q1').

attributes.name: assay_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the detailed crude assay laboratory report. Links to the full assay documentation including all test results and distillation curves.

attributes.name: assay_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the assay record. Active assays are used for refinery planning and optimization; superseded assays are retained for historical analysis.

attributes.name: assay_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this assay. Crude assays are updated periodically as crude quality varies; version tracks the iteration.

attributes.name: carbon_residue_wt_pct
attributes.description: Conradson Carbon Residue (CCR) of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent. Indicates coke-forming tendency and asphaltene content. High CCR crude yields more residue and requires coking or residue upgrading capacity. Used for FCC feed quality assessment.
attributes.references: ASTM D189 - Standard Test Method for Conradson Carbon Residue of Petroleum Products; ASTM D4530 - Standard Test Method for Determination of Carbon Residue (Micro Method)

attributes.name: cetane_index
attributes.description: Calculated cetane index of the diesel fraction from the crude assay. Indicates diesel ignition quality; higher cetane index means better diesel quality. Used for crude valuation and diesel blending optimization.
attributes.references: ASTM D976 - Standard Test Method for Calculated Cetane Index of Distillate Fuels; ASTM D4737 - Standard Test Method for Calculated Cetane Index by Four Variable Equation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crude assay record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: diesel_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of diesel cut (typically 520-650°F / 271-343°C) from crude distillation. Diesel is a high-value middle distillate product; yield is a key crude valuation factor.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: distillation_method
attributes.description: Laboratory distillation method used to generate the crude assay distillation curve. TBP (True Boiling Point) provides the most detailed cut-by-cut yield data for refinery simulation. ASTM D86 is a simpler atmospheric distillation. ASTM D2892 and D5236 are standard crude assay distillation methods.
attributes.references: ASTM D2892 - Standard Test Method for Distillation of Crude Petroleum (15-Theoretical Plate Column); ASTM D5236 - Standard Test Method for Distillation of Heavy Hydrocarbon Mixtures (Vacuum Potstill Method)

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Flash point of the crude oil in degrees Celsius. Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical for HSE classification, storage tank design, and transportation safety (OSHA, NFPA, DOT regulations).
attributes.references: ASTM D93 - Standard Test Methods for Flash Point by Pensky-Martens Closed Cup Tester; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; NFPA 30

attributes.name: freeze_point_c
attributes.description: Freeze point of the kerosene/jet fuel fraction, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical specification for jet fuel to prevent fuel system icing at high altitude. ASTM D1655 Jet A specification requires maximum -40°C freeze point.
attributes.references: ASTM D2386 - Standard Test Method for Freezing Point of Aviation Fuels; ASTM D1655 - Standard Specification for Aviation Turbine Fuels

attributes.name: heavy_naphtha_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of heavy naphtha cut (typically 180-380°F / 82-193°C) from crude distillation. Heavy naphtha is primary feedstock for catalytic reforming to produce high-octane reformate and hydrogen.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: hydrogen_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Hydrogen content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent. Higher hydrogen content indicates more paraffinic crude with better product quality potential. Used in refinery hydrogen balance calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D5291 - Standard Test Methods for Instrumental Determination of Carbon, Hydrogen, and Nitrogen in Petroleum Products and Lubricants

attributes.name: iron_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Iron Content in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Iron (Fe) content in the crude oil, measured in parts per million (ppm). Iron indicates contamination from pipelines, storage tanks, or production equipment. High iron content can foul heat exchangers and poison catalysts.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Standard Test Methods for Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils and Residual Fuels by Flame Atomic Absorption Spectrometry

attributes.name: kerosene_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of kerosene cut (typically 380-520°F / 193-271°C) from crude distillation. Kerosene is feedstock for jet fuel and heating oil production.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: light_naphtha_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of light naphtha cut (typically C5-180°F / C5-82°C) from crude distillation. Light naphtha is feedstock for isomerization and reforming to produce high-octane gasoline blendstock.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crude assay record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nickel_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Nickel Content in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Nickel (Ni) content in the crude oil, measured in parts per million (ppm). Nickel and vanadium are catalyst poisons in FCC and hydroprocessing units. High-metal crudes require specialized processing or blending to reduce metal content.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Standard Test Methods for Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils and Residual Fuels by Flame Atomic Absorption Spectrometry

attributes.name: nitrogen_content_wt_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Nitrogen Content in Weight Parts Per Million (wt ppm)
attributes.description: Total nitrogen content of the crude oil, measured in weight ppm. Nitrogen compounds are catalyst poisons in hydrotreating and hydrocracking units and contribute to NOx emissions. High-nitrogen crudes require additional hydrotreating capacity.
attributes.references: ASTM D4629 - Standard Test Method for Trace Nitrogen in Liquid Petroleum Hydrocarbons by Syringe/Inlet Oxidative Combustion and Chemiluminescence Detection

attributes.name: pour_point_c
attributes.description: Pour point of the crude oil in degrees Celsius. Lowest temperature at which the crude will flow under gravity. Critical for cold-weather storage, pipeline transport, and tank heating requirements.
attributes.references: ASTM D97 - Standard Test Method for Pour Point of Petroleum Products

attributes.name: resin_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Resin content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent (from SARA analysis). Resins are polar compounds that contribute to crude stability and asphaltene solubility. High resin content can cause processing issues.
attributes.references: ASTM D2007 - Standard Test Method for Characteristic Groups in Rubber Extender and Processing Oils by the Clay-Gel Absorption Chromatographic Method (SARA Analysis)

attributes.name: rvp_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) in Pounds per Square Inch (psi)
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) of the crude oil, measured in psi at 100°F. Indicates volatility and light-end content. High RVP crude requires vapor recovery systems and affects storage tank design. Also used for gasoline blending RVP compliance (EPA seasonal RVP limits).
attributes.references: ASTM D323 - Standard Test Method for Vapor Pressure of Petroleum Products (Reid Method); EPA 40 CFR Part 80 Subpart E - RVP Standards for Gasoline

attributes.name: salt_content_ptb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salt Content in Pounds per Thousand Barrels (PTB)
attributes.description: Salt content of the crude oil, measured in pounds per thousand barrels (PTB). High salt content causes corrosion and fouling in crude distillation units. Crude desalting targets <1 PTB to protect downstream equipment.
attributes.references: ASTM D3230 - Standard Test Method for Salts in Crude Oil (Electrometric Method); API RP 571 - Damage Mechanisms Affecting Fixed Equipment in the Refining Industry

attributes.name: saturate_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Saturate (paraffin and naphthene) content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent (from SARA analysis). High saturate content indicates better quality crude with higher diesel and lube oil yield potential.
attributes.references: ASTM D2007 - Standard Test Method for Characteristic Groups in Rubber Extender and Processing Oils by the Clay-Gel Absorption Chromatographic Method (SARA Analysis)

attributes.name: smoke_point_mm
attributes.description: Smoke point of the kerosene fraction, measured in millimeters. Indicates aromatic content and combustion quality of jet fuel. Higher smoke point means lower aromatics and better jet fuel quality. ASTM D1655 jet fuel specification requires minimum 25mm smoke point.
attributes.references: ASTM D1322 - Standard Test Method for Smoke Point of Kerosene and Aviation Turbine Fuel; ASTM D1655 - Standard Specification for Aviation Turbine Fuels

attributes.name: source_location
attributes.description: Geographic origin or production field of the crude oil sample (e.g., 'North Sea', 'Permian Basin', 'Saudi Arabia'). Used for crude sourcing and logistics planning.

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity of the crude oil at 60°F/60°F (dimensionless ratio). Alternative density measure to API gravity, used in some international markets and process simulations.
attributes.references: ASTM D1298 - Standard Test Method for Density, Relative Density, or API Gravity of Crude Petroleum

attributes.name: sulfur_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Total sulfur content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent. Critical for refinery processing (HDS unit sizing), product quality (diesel/gasoline sulfur specs), and environmental compliance (EPA Tier 3 standards). Sweet crude <0.5%, sour crude >0.5%.
attributes.references: ASTM D4294 - Standard Test Method for Sulfur in Petroleum by Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence; EPA Tier 3 Gasoline Sulfur Standards

attributes.name: tan_mg_koh_per_g
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Acid Number (TAN) in Milligrams Potassium Hydroxide per Gram (mg KOH/g)
attributes.description: Total Acid Number (TAN) measured in mg KOH/g. Indicates naphthenic acid content; high TAN crude (>0.5) causes corrosion in refinery units (CDU/VDU overhead systems, heat exchangers). Critical for metallurgy selection and corrosion management.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 - Standard Test Method for Acid Number of Petroleum Products by Potentiometric Titration; NACE SP0403 - Avoiding Caustic Stress Corrosion Cracking of Carbon Steel Refinery Equipment

attributes.name: vacuum_residue_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of vacuum residue (typically 1050°F+ / 566°C+) from vacuum distillation. Vacuum residue is the heaviest fraction, used for asphalt, fuel oil, or fed to coking/residue upgrading units. High residue yield reduces refinery margin.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: vanadium_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vanadium Content in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Vanadium (V) content in the crude oil, measured in parts per million (ppm). Vanadium is a catalyst poison and causes high-temperature corrosion in furnaces and boilers. Critical for FCC catalyst selection and residue upgrading economics.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Standard Test Methods for Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils and Residual Fuels by Flame Atomic Absorption Spectrometry

attributes.name: vgo_yield_vol_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vacuum Gas Oil (VGO) Yield Volume Percent (vol%)
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of vacuum gas oil (VGO) cut (typically 650-1050°F / 343-566°C) from vacuum distillation. VGO is primary feedstock for FCC and hydrocracking units to produce gasoline and diesel.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: viscosity_cst_at_100c
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the crude oil at 100°C, measured in centistokes (cSt). Used for viscosity-temperature relationship modeling and high-temperature process unit design.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Standard Test Method for Kinematic Viscosity of Transparent and Opaque Liquids

attributes.name: viscosity_cst_at_40c
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the crude oil at 40°C, measured in centistokes (cSt). Affects pumpability, pipeline transport, and heat exchanger design. Heavy crudes have higher viscosity.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Standard Test Method for Kinematic Viscosity of Transparent and Opaque Liquids

attributes.name: water_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Water and sediment content of the crude oil, expressed as volume percent. Affects crude valuation (water is non-saleable), desalter performance, and corrosion risk. Custody transfer specifications typically require <0.5% water.
attributes.references: ASTM D4007 - Standard Test Method for Water and Sediment in Crude Oil by the Centrifuge Method; API MPMS Chapter 10 - Sediment and Water

attributes.name: wax_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Paraffin wax content of the crude oil, expressed as weight percent. High wax content affects pour point, pipeline flow, and cold-weather operability. Waxy crudes may require heating or dewaxing for transportation and processing.
attributes.references: ASTM D721 - Standard Test Method for Oil Content of Petroleum Waxes

products.name: feedstock_blend
products.description: Planned or actual blend of crude oil grades and intermediate feedstocks fed to a CDU or process unit during a defined processing period. Captures blend recipe (component crude grades, volume fractions, API gravity, sulfur, TAN), planned vs. actual volumes in barrels, blend date, target unit, blending rationale, and quality compliance status. Supports feedstock optimization and crude scheduling workflows.
products.reference: API MPMS Chapter 12 / Aspen HYSYS Blend Optimizer

attributes.name: feedstock_blend_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the feedstock blend record. Primary key for the feedstock blend entity.

attributes.name: blending_recipe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.blending_recipe. Business justification: A feedstock blend is executed according to a blending recipe; the FK ties the blend to its recipe for quality and cost analysis.

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade. Business justification: Feedstock blends specify crude grade composition for CDU feed optimization. Essential for crude procurement decisions, blend optimization models (Aspen PIMS), quality prediction, and margin analysis.

attributes.name: driving_nomination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.nomination. Business justification: Feedstock blending decisions are driven by customer nominations specifying crude grade, API gravity, sulfur content, and delivery timing. Links blend optimization to contractual commitments and enable

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.pipeline_nomination. Business justification: Feedstock blends may include pipeline-delivered crudes. Nomination tracking, volume confirmation, and crude slate planning require linking blends to pipeline nominations for supply assurance and feeds

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the refinery process unit (CDU, VDU, FCC, HDS, or other) that will receive or has received this feedstock blend.

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.product_specification. Business justification: Feedstock blending strategies must consider downstream product specification constraints (sulfur limits, octane targets, distillation curves) to ensure regulatory compliance. Links crude slate optimiz

attributes.name: source_production_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_facility. Business justification: Refineries track facility sources for feedstock blends to manage supply contracts, quality specifications, and integrated logistics. Critical for vertically integrated operators coordinating productio

attributes.name: source_production_well_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_well. Business justification: Integrated operators optimize feedstock blends using well-specific crude characteristics (API, sulfur, TAN) when sourcing directly from production. Enables upstream-downstream optimization and quality

attributes.name: source_reservoir_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.reservoir. Business justification: Feedstock blend optimization requires reservoir fluid characterization (API gravity, sulfur content, TAN, viscosity) to match processing unit capabilities and target product slate. Refiners reference

attributes.name: actual_total_volume_bbl
attributes.description: The actual total volume of the feedstock blend in barrels (BBL) that was processed through the target unit, measured upon completion or during operations.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the refinery operations manager, process engineer, or authorized personnel who approved this feedstock blend for execution.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this feedstock blend was formally approved for execution by authorized refinery personnel.

attributes.name: blend_api_gravity
attributes.description: The weighted average API gravity of the feedstock blend, a measure of petroleum liquid density relative to water. Higher API gravity indicates lighter, less dense crude oil. Calculated based on component crude grades and their volume fractions.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: blend_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the feedstock blend processing or feeding to the target unit was completed or is scheduled to complete.

attributes.name: blend_flash_point_c
attributes.description: The weighted average flash point temperature of the feedstock blend in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which vapors will ignite. Critical for HSE compliance and safe handling procedures.
attributes.references: ASTM D93 - Flash Point, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: blend_metals_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blend Metals Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: The weighted average total metals content (vanadium, nickel, iron) of the feedstock blend expressed in parts per million. Metals can cause catalyst deactivation and fouling in refinery process units.

attributes.name: blend_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation for this feedstock blend, used for operational identification and scheduling purposes.

attributes.name: blend_nitrogen_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blend Nitrogen Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: The weighted average nitrogen content of the feedstock blend expressed in parts per million. Nitrogen compounds can poison catalysts in downstream units such as FCC and hydrotreating units.

attributes.name: blend_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier or code assigned to this feedstock blend for tracking and reference in refinery operations and scheduling systems.

attributes.name: blend_pour_point_c
attributes.description: The weighted average pour point temperature of the feedstock blend in degrees Celsius, representing the lowest temperature at which the blend will flow. Important for storage and transportation planning.

attributes.name: blend_salt_content_ptb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blend Salt Content in Pounds per Thousand Barrels (PTB)
attributes.description: The weighted average salt content of the feedstock blend expressed in pounds per thousand barrels. High salt content can cause corrosion and fouling in crude distillation units and requires desalting operations.

attributes.name: blend_sediment_content_vol_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blend Sediment Content in Volume Percent (VOL%)
attributes.description: The weighted average sediment content of the feedstock blend expressed as volume percentage. Sediment can cause fouling and operational issues in refinery equipment.

attributes.name: blend_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the feedstock blend processing or feeding to the target unit began or is scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: blend_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feedstock blend. Planned indicates the blend recipe is designed but not yet approved, approved indicates ready for execution, in progress indicates currently being blended or fed to the unit, completed indicates the blend has been fully processed, cancelled indicates the blend was terminated before completion, and on hold indicates temporary suspension.

attributes.name: blend_sulfur_content_wt_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blend Sulfur Content in Weight Percent (WT%)
attributes.description: The weighted average sulfur content of the feedstock blend expressed as weight percentage. Critical for HDS unit planning, EPA emissions compliance, and product quality specifications.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1, EPA Clean Air Act

attributes.name: blend_tan
attributes.description: The weighted average Total Acid Number (TAN) of the feedstock blend, measured in milligrams of potassium hydroxide per gram of sample. TAN indicates the acidity and corrosivity of the crude oil, critical for refinery equipment integrity and corrosion management.

attributes.name: blend_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the feedstock blend was initiated or executed in the refinery operations, representing the principal business event timestamp for this blend.

attributes.name: blend_type
attributes.description: Classification of the feedstock blend based on its purpose and composition. Crude blend represents primary crude oil mixtures, intermediate blend represents processed stream mixtures, feedstock optimization represents cost or yield optimized recipes, emergency blend represents contingency blends, test blend represents experimental formulations, and standard recipe represents pre-approved recurring blends.

attributes.name: blend_viscosity_cst
attributes.description: The weighted average kinematic viscosity of the feedstock blend measured in centistokes at a standard temperature (typically 40°C or 100°C). Viscosity affects pumping, heating, and processing requirements.

attributes.name: blend_water_content_vol_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Blend Water Content in Volume Percent (VOL%)
attributes.description: The weighted average water content of the feedstock blend expressed as volume percentage. Water content affects processing efficiency and must be removed through desalting and dehydration operations.

attributes.name: blending_rationale
attributes.description: The primary business driver or reason for creating this specific feedstock blend. Cost optimization indicates minimizing feedstock cost, yield optimization indicates maximizing valuable product yields, quality compliance indicates meeting product specifications, feedstock availability indicates working with available crude grades, contract obligation indicates fulfilling supply agreements, and operational constraint indicates adapting to refinery limitations.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, quality observations, or other relevant information about this feedstock blend that may be useful for refinery operations and future reference.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this feedstock blend record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_margin_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Margin in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The estimated gross margin in USD from processing this feedstock blend, calculated as estimated product value minus estimated processing cost. Key metric for blend selection and refinery profitability analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_processing_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Processing Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The estimated total cost in USD to process this feedstock blend through the target unit, including feedstock acquisition cost, energy consumption, catalyst usage, and operational expenses. Used for economic evaluation and margin analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_product_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Product Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The estimated total market value in USD of the refined products expected from processing this feedstock blend, based on current market prices and target yield slate. Used for margin calculation and economic optimization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this feedstock blend record was last updated or modified, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: optimization_score
attributes.description: A calculated score (typically 0-100) representing how well this feedstock blend achieves the blending objectives (cost, yield, quality) compared to alternative blend recipes. Higher scores indicate better optimization performance.

attributes.name: planned_total_volume_bbl
attributes.description: The total planned volume of the feedstock blend in barrels (BBL) to be processed through the target unit during the defined processing period.

attributes.name: quality_compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the feedstock blend meets all required quality specifications and regulatory standards for processing in the target unit. Compliant indicates all specifications met, non-compliant indicates one or more specifications violated, pending review indicates awaiting quality assurance approval, conditionally approved indicates approved with operational restrictions, and requires adjustment indicates blend recipe needs modification.
attributes.references: API Refining Standards, EPA Clean Air Act

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system that originated this feedstock blend record, such as Aspen HYSYS process simulation system, refinery planning system, or DCS control system.

attributes.name: target_yield_distillates_pct
attributes.description: The target percentage yield of middle distillates (diesel, jet fuel, kerosene) expected from processing this feedstock blend, used for product slate planning.

attributes.name: target_yield_light_ends_pct
attributes.description: The target percentage yield of light ends (LPG, propane, butane) expected from processing this feedstock blend, used for product slate planning and yield optimization.

attributes.name: target_yield_naphtha_pct
attributes.description: The target percentage yield of naphtha expected from processing this feedstock blend, used for gasoline blending and petrochemical feedstock planning.

attributes.name: target_yield_residue_pct
attributes.description: The target percentage yield of residue (heavy fuel oil, asphalt, vacuum residue) expected from processing this feedstock blend, used for downstream unit planning and product slate optimization.

attributes.name: volume_variance_bbl
attributes.description: The difference between planned and actual total volume in barrels, calculated as actual minus planned. Positive values indicate over-processing, negative values indicate under-processing.

products.name: unit_run
products.description: Primary transactional record and SSOT for process unit operational performance and yield accounting. Covers a defined processing period (shift, day, or campaign) capturing actual throughput (BOPD or MCFD), feed rate, operating temperature, pressure, conversion rate, energy consumption (MMBtu), utility consumption, catalyst activity index, run length, DCS/PI System historian reference, and detailed yield accounting by product cut (LPG, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, gas oil, residue) including actual vs. planned output volumes and mass, liquid volume unaccounted for (LVUF), mass balance closure percentage, BOE conversion, and variance to Aspen HYSYS simulation targets. Supports yield optimization, loss accounting, and refinery planning.

attributes.name: unit_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the process unit operational run record. Primary key for unit run transactions.
attributes.references: API Recommended Practice 750 - Measurement of Petroleum and its Products

attributes.name: aspen_simulation_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the Aspen HYSYS process simulation model used for planning and variance analysis of this run.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the refinery facility where this unit run occurred.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Each unit run's emissions must be traceable to quarterly/ann

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific process unit equipment (CDU, VDU, FCC, HDS, etc.) that executed this run.
attributes.references: API Standard 510 - Pressure Vessel Inspection Code

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.incident. Business justification: Incidents during unit runs require operational context (feed rates, temperatures, pressures) for investigation. Process safety analysis links incident timing to run conditions to identify causal facto

attributes.name: primary_petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Each unit run targets a primary product output for yield accounting and product costing. Essential for production variance analysis, unit economics calculation, and reconciliation with refinery schedu

attributes.name: process_safety_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.process_safety_event. Business justification: Process safety events (LOPC, overpressure) occur during unit operations. PSE investigations require operational context from unit runs (feed rates, temperatures, catalyst age) to identify causal facto

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.process_unit. Business justification: unit_run is the transactional record of process unit operational performance. Currently links to equipment via equipment_id, but should also directly reference the process_unit master record. This nor

attributes.name: shift_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each unit run occurs under a shift supervisor's operational control. Critical for linking run performance to supervisory accountability, HSE incident investigation, alarm response evaluation, and perf

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the feedstock or product indicating density and quality classification per API standards.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: catalyst_activity_index
attributes.description: Measure of catalyst performance and activity level during the run, typically expressed as percentage of fresh catalyst activity.

attributes.name: catalyst_age_days
attributes.description: Number of days the catalyst has been in service at the time of this run for catalyst lifecycle management.

attributes.name: conversion_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of feedstock converted to lighter products during the run, key performance indicator for cracking units (FCC, hydrocracker).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this unit run record was first created in the data platform for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: dcs_historian_tag
attributes.description: Reference tag identifier in the DCS or PI System historian linking to real-time process data for this run.

attributes.name: diesel_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of diesel product cut produced during the run measured in barrels for yield accounting.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: electricity_consumption_mwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy consumed during the run measured in megawatt hours for utility tracking.
attributes.references: API Standard 540 - Electrical Installations in Petroleum Processing Plants

attributes.name: energy_consumption_mmbtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Consumption Million British Thermal Units (MMBtu)
attributes.description: Total energy consumed during the unit run measured in million British thermal units for energy efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: API Standard 560 - Fired Heaters for General Refinery Service

attributes.name: feed_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Feed Rate Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Average feedstock processing rate during the run expressed in barrels of oil per day for throughput analysis.

attributes.name: feedstock_mass_mt
attributes.description: Total mass of feedstock processed during the run measured in metric tons for mass balance calculations.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: feedstock_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crude oil or intermediate feedstock processed during this run (e.g., WTI, Brent, heavy sour, light sweet).

attributes.name: feedstock_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Total volume of feedstock processed during the run measured in barrels at standard conditions.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11 - Physical Properties Data

attributes.name: gas_oil_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of gas oil product cut produced during the run measured in barrels for yield accounting.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: kerosene_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of kerosene product cut produced during the run measured in barrels for yield accounting.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: liquid_volume_unaccounted_for_bbl
attributes.description: Difference between feedstock input volume and total product output volume, representing measurement uncertainty and losses.

attributes.name: lpg_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of LPG product cut produced during the run measured in barrels for yield accounting.

attributes.name: mass_balance_closure_percent
attributes.description: Percentage representing the ratio of total product mass to feedstock mass, indicating accuracy of mass accounting (target: 99-101%).

attributes.name: naphtha_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of naphtha product cut produced during the run measured in barrels for yield accounting.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: operating_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Pressure Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Average operating pressure of the process unit during the run measured in pounds per square inch.
attributes.references: API Standard 510 - Pressure Vessel Inspection Code

attributes.name: operating_temperature_c
attributes.description: Average operating temperature of the process unit during the run measured in degrees Celsius.
attributes.references: API Standard 530 - Calculation of Heater-Tube Thickness in Petroleum Refineries

attributes.name: planned_throughput_bbl
attributes.description: Target feedstock volume planned for this run based on refinery scheduling and optimization models.

attributes.name: residue_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of residue product cut produced during the run measured in barrels for yield accounting.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: ron_value
attributes.description: Research octane number of gasoline product cuts indicating anti-knock quality and blending value.
attributes.references: ASTM D2699 - Standard Test Method for Research Octane Number of Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: run_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the unit run in hours, calculated from start to end timestamp for cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the unit run processing period ended, marking the completion of the operational cycle.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 21

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the unit run, typically formatted as facility-unit-date-sequence for operational tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the unit run processing period began, marking the start of feedstock introduction to the unit.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 21 - Flow Measurement Using Electronic Metering Systems

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the unit run indicating operational state and data completeness.
attributes.references: API Standard 2610 - Design, Construction, Operation, Maintenance, and Inspection of Terminal and Tank Facilities

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operational run mode indicating the nature of the processing period.
attributes.references: API Recommended Practice 571 - Damage Mechanisms Affecting Fixed Equipment in the Refining Industry

attributes.name: steam_consumption_mt
attributes.description: Total steam utility consumed during the run measured in metric tons for utility cost allocation.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.description: Average sulfur content in the feedstock or product measured in parts per million for HDS unit performance and EPA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act - Tier 3 Gasoline Sulfur Standards

attributes.name: tan_mg_koh_per_g
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Acid Number (TAN) Milligrams Potassium Hydroxide per Gram (mg KOH/g)
attributes.description: Total acid number of the feedstock or product measured in mg KOH per gram, indicating corrosivity and processing requirements.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 - Standard Test Method for Acid Number of Petroleum Products by Potentiometric Titration

attributes.name: throughput_variance_bbl
attributes.description: Difference between actual and planned throughput volumes, indicating operational performance against plan.

attributes.name: total_output_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Output Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Total production output normalized to barrel of oil equivalent for standardized reporting and comparison.

attributes.name: total_product_mass_mt
attributes.description: Sum of all product cut masses produced during the run measured in metric tons for mass balance closure.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11

attributes.name: total_product_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Sum of all product cut volumes produced during the run measured in barrels for overall yield verification.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this unit run record was last modified for change tracking and data lineage.

Includes liquid volume unaccounted for (LVUF), mass balance closure percentage, BOE conversion, and variance to Aspen HYSYS simulation targets. Supports yield optimization, loss accounting, and refinery planning.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id

attributes.name: epa_reporting_flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: loss_category

attributes.name: lvuf_bbl

attributes.name: mass_variance_mt

attributes.name: measurement_method

attributes.name: planned_volume_bbl

attributes.name: quality_grade

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any adjustments, corrections, or special circumstances related to yield reconciliation for this record.

attributes.name: ron_value
attributes.description: Research Octane Number for gasoline/naphtha cuts. Measures the anti-knock properties of the fuel. Higher values indicate better performance.
attributes.references: ASTM D2699 - Standard Test Method for Research Octane Number

attributes.name: simulation_target_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Simulation Target Volume in Barrels (BBL) from Aspen HYSYS
attributes.description: Target volume for this product cut as predicted by Aspen HYSYS process simulation model, measured in barrels. Used for variance analysis against actual yields.

attributes.name: simulation_variance_bbl
attributes.description: Difference between actual volume and Aspen HYSYS simulation target (actual minus simulation), measured in barrels. Used to calibrate simulation models and identify process deviations.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_pct
attributes.description: Sulfur content of the product cut as a percentage by weight. Critical for HDS (Hydrodesulfurization) unit performance tracking and EPA emissions compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D4294 - Standard Test Method for Sulfur in Petroleum

attributes.name: tan_value
attributes.description: Total Acid Number of the product cut, measured in mg KOH/g. Indicates the acidity level and corrosivity of the petroleum product.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 - Standard Test Method for Acid Number

attributes.name: volume_variance_bbl
attributes.description: Difference between actual and planned volume (actual minus planned), measured in barrels. Positive values indicate over-production, negative values indicate under-production.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage yield of this product cut relative to total feedstock input. Calculated as (product volume / feedstock volume) * 100.

attributes.name: yield_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the yield record. Indicates the level of validation and reconciliation completed.

products.name: product_quality_test
products.description: Laboratory quality test result for a refined product stream or intermediate, capturing sample date/time, sample point (unit outlet, tank, pipeline), product grade, test method (ASTM, IP, ISO), measured properties (RON, MON, flash point, cloud point, pour point, viscosity, sulfur ppm, TAN, RVP, density, color), specification limits, pass/fail status, and certifying laboratory. Supports API refining standards compliance and product release decisions.

attributes.name: product_quality_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory quality test record. Primary key for the product quality test entity.

attributes.name: blend_event_id

attributes.name: blend_recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the blending recipe or formula used to produce the tested product. Enables correlation of quality results with blend component ratios and optimization of blending strategies.
attributes.references: API RP 500 - Recommended Practice for Classification of Locations for Electrical Installations at Petroleum Facilities

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.complaint. Business justification: Quality test results are directly referenced in customer complaint investigations for off-spec product claims. Links lab data to commercial dispute resolution, root cause analysis, and settlement calc

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the laboratory analyst who performed the test. Used for analyst performance tracking, training needs assessment, and quality control audits. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the analytical instrument used to perform the test (e.g., gas chromatograph, spectrophotometer, viscometer). Enables instrument performance tracking, calibration management, and root cause analysis of anomalous results.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Quality tests verify specific petroleum products meet specifications for custody transfer, regulatory compliance (EPA fuel standards), and customer contracts. Essential for product release certificati

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.process_unit. Business justification: product_quality_test.process_unit_code (STRING) should be normalized to process_unit_id FK. This allows joining to process_unit master to retrieve unit_name, unit_type, operational_status, and design

attributes.name: product_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.product_specification. Business justification: Quality tests validate product against specifications. product_quality_test.product_grade (STRING) should be normalized to product_specification_id FK. This allows joining to product_specification to

attributes.name: sample_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical sample collected from the refinery process stream, tank, or pipeline. Links the test result to the specific sample container and collection event.
attributes.references: ASTM D4057 - Standard Practice for Manual Sampling of Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipment. Business justification: Quality tests certify cargo specifications for shipments. BOL certification, customer quality claims, and custody transfer validation require linking test results to shipments for product release auth

attributes.name: test_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Laboratory quality tests consume reagents, solvents, and consumables tracked in material master. Real QC operations require material tracking for inventory replenishment, cost allocation per test meth

attributes.name: unit_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.unit_run. Business justification: Quality tests are performed on product streams produced by unit runs. Linking product_quality_test to unit_run establishes traceability from quality results back to the operational run that produced t

attributes.name: certification_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the test result was certified for product release. Used to track laboratory turnaround time and ensure timely product shipment.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Certification status indicating whether the test result has been reviewed and approved for product release. 'Certified' indicates approved for shipment; 'Pending Certification' indicates awaiting quality manager review; 'Rejected' indicates product does not meet release criteria; 'Provisional' indicates conditional release pending additional testing.

attributes.name: certified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality manager or authorized person who certified the test result for product release. Required for regulatory compliance and quality assurance audits. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments from the analyst or quality manager regarding unusual observations, test conditions, sample appearance, or other relevant notes. Supports quality investigation and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality test record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: deviation_from_spec
attributes.description: Calculated deviation of the measured value from the specification limit (positive indicates above max or below min, negative indicates within spec with margin). Used for quality trending and early warning of specification drift.

attributes.name: epa_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this test result is used for EPA regulatory compliance reporting (e.g., sulfur content for Clean Air Act compliance, benzene content for air toxics regulations). True indicates EPA-reportable test; False indicates internal quality control only.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act - Fuel Quality Standards

attributes.name: laboratory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the laboratory that performed the test (e.g., refinery on-site lab, third-party contract lab, regional quality center). Used for lab performance tracking and inter-laboratory comparison.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the laboratory facility that performed the analysis. Supports laboratory accreditation tracking and quality assurance audits.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Numerical result of the laboratory test for the specified property. Precision varies by test method and property type. Used for specification compliance checking and quality trending.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality test record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: quality_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this test record represents a quality control sample (e.g., blind duplicate, spiked sample, reference standard) rather than a production sample. True indicates QC sample; False indicates production sample.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: retest_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why a retest was required, such as 'Result outside expected range', 'Instrument calibration failure', 'Sample contamination suspected', or 'Quality control check failed'. Used for laboratory quality improvement.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: retest_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sample requires retesting due to questionable results, instrument malfunction, or quality control failure. True indicates retest is required; False indicates result is accepted.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: sample_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the physical sample was collected from the process unit, storage tank, or pipeline. Critical for correlating test results with production conditions and process parameters at the time of sampling.

attributes.name: sample_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location where the sample was collected, such as unit outlet, tank number, pipeline tap, or blending header. Enables spatial analysis of quality variation across the refinery.
attributes.references: API RP 500 - Recommended Practice for Classification of Locations for Electrical Installations at Petroleum Facilities

attributes.name: sample_point_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the sample collection location, including process unit name, equipment tag, and stream description (e.g., 'CDU Overhead Naphtha', 'FCC Gasoline Blending Header', 'Tank 101 Diesel Product').
attributes.references: API RP 500 - Recommended Practice for Classification of Locations for Electrical Installations at Petroleum Facilities

attributes.name: specification_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable value for the tested property per the product grade specification. Null if no maximum limit applies. Used for automated pass/fail determination.
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 - Standard Specification for Automotive Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: specification_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable value for the tested property per the product grade specification. Null if no minimum limit applies. Used for automated pass/fail determination.
attributes.references: ASTM D4814 - Standard Specification for Automotive Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: specification_target
attributes.description: Target or typical value for the tested property, representing the optimal quality aim for process control. May differ from regulatory limits to provide operating margin and reduce giveaway.
attributes.references: API RP 750 - Management of Process Hazards

attributes.name: test_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the laboratory analysis was performed. Used to track laboratory turnaround time and ensure test results are within validity windows for time-sensitive properties.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 - General Requirements for the Competence of Testing and Calibration Laboratories

attributes.name: test_method_code
attributes.description: Standardized test method code used for the analysis (e.g., 'ASTM D2699' for RON, 'ASTM D86' for distillation, 'ASTM D4294' for sulfur, 'IP 365' for flash point). Ensures reproducibility and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards - Petroleum Products and Lubricants

attributes.name: test_method_description
attributes.description: Full description of the test method standard, including the property being measured and the analytical technique (e.g., 'ASTM D2699 - Research Octane Number of Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel', 'ASTM D5453 - Sulfur by Ultraviolet Fluorescence').
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards - Petroleum Products and Lubricants

attributes.name: test_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the quality test, typically assigned by the laboratory information management system (LIMS) or refinery quality control system. Used for external reference and tracking.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: test_precision
attributes.description: Repeatability or reproducibility precision of the test method as defined by the standard method (e.g., ASTM precision statement). Used to assess measurement uncertainty and determine if differences are statistically significant.
attributes.references: ASTM E691 - Standard Practice for Conducting an Interlaboratory Study to Determine the Precision of a Test Method

attributes.name: test_property_name
attributes.description: Name of the physical or chemical property being measured (e.g., 'Research Octane Number', 'Sulfur Content', 'Flash Point', 'Viscosity', 'Density', 'Cloud Point', 'Pour Point', 'Reid Vapor Pressure', 'Total Acid Number').
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book - Petroleum Refining

attributes.name: test_result_status
attributes.description: Overall pass/fail status of the test result against specification limits. 'Pass' indicates all properties meet specifications; 'Fail' indicates one or more properties are out of specification; 'Conditional' indicates marginal results requiring review; 'Retest' indicates sample requires re-analysis; 'Pending' indicates test in progress; 'Cancelled' indicates test was voided.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the test result (e.g., 'octane number' for RON/MON, 'ppm' for sulfur, 'deg C' for flash point, 'cSt' for viscosity, 'kg/m3' for density, 'psi' for RVP, 'mg KOH/g' for TAN). Essential for correct interpretation and comparison.

products.name: refinery_schedule
products.description: Master record and SSOT for short-to-medium term refinery production scheduling, defining planned crude slate, unit throughputs, product slate targets, maintenance windows, and deviation tracking for a scheduling horizon (daily, weekly, monthly). Captures schedule version, planning period, crude receipt plan, CDU/VDU throughput targets by unit, product volume targets by grade, inventory drawdown plan, schedule status (draft, approved, active, superseded), LP model run reference, and deviation records including planned vs. actual variances, root cause categories, financial impact estimates, corrective actions, and resolution status. Integrates with Aspen HYSYS LP optimization.

attributes.name: refinery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refinery production schedule record. Primary key for the refinery schedule entity.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the refinery facility for which this schedule applies. Links to the facility master data.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id

attributes.name: consent_order_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Refinery schedules are created by planning engineers who optimize crude slates, product yields, and unit utilization using LP models. Critical for accountability, approval workflows, schedule change t

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Refinery production schedules are optimized against customer offtake commitments, term contracts, and lifting schedules tied to specific accounts. Links planned product slate to contractual obligation

attributes.name: primary_petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Refinery schedules plan production of specific product slates based on market demand and margin optimization. Essential for LP model runs, commercial planning, crude slate optimization, and financial

attributes.name: refinery_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.refinery. Business justification: A refinery schedule belongs to a specific refinery; linking schedule to refinery enables schedule‑centric reporting and eliminates redundant refinery identifiers stored elsewhere.

attributes.name: shipping_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.shipping_schedule. Business justification: Refinery production schedules drive logistics lifting schedules. Integrated planning, crude slate optimization, and product dispatch coordination require linking refinery schedules to shipping schedul

attributes.name: activated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule became the active operational plan. Marks the beginning of schedule execution.

attributes.name: actual_crude_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Actual crude oil throughput volume in barrels achieved during the planning period. Used for planned versus actual variance analysis.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the schedule was formally approved for execution. Marks transition from planning to operational commitment.

attributes.name: cdu_throughput_target_bpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Crude Distillation Unit (CDU) Throughput Target (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Planned daily throughput rate for the Crude Distillation Unit in barrels per day. Key operational target for primary refining capacity utilization.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Documented plan for addressing schedule deviations and preventing recurrence, including specific actions, responsibilities, and timelines.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this schedule record was first created in the system. Audit trail for schedule lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: crude_slate_plan

attributes.name: deviation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of schedule deviations, including specific events, impacts, and contributing factors.

attributes.name: deviation_root_cause_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the root cause for schedule deviations. Supports systematic analysis of planning accuracy and operational reliability.

attributes.name: deviation_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether planned versus actual variance tracking is active for this schedule. Enables performance monitoring and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: diesel_target_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Planned production volume of diesel fuel products in barrels for the planning period. Includes all diesel grades and ultra-low sulfur diesel.

attributes.name: fcc_throughput_target_bpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fluid Catalytic Cracking (FCC) Unit Throughput Target (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)

attributes.name: lpg_target_volume_bbl

attributes.name: maintenance_scope_description

attributes.description: Planned production volume of naphtha products in barrels for the planning period. Key petrochemical feedstock and gasoline blending component.

attributes.name: optimization_objective
attributes.description: Primary business objective used in the LP optimization model for this schedule. Defines the goal function for production planning.

attributes.name: planned_margin_usd
attributes.description: Forecasted gross refining margin in US dollars for the planning period based on the scheduled crude slate and product slate.

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the planning period covered by this schedule. Defines the end of the operational window for which production is planned.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the planning period covered by this schedule. Defines the beginning of the operational window for which production is planned.

attributes.name: product_slate_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planned refined product output mix, including product grades, target volumes, and quality specifications for the planning period.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of corrective actions for schedule deviations. Tracks progress from identification through resolution.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the refinery production schedule, used for cross-system reference and communication with operations teams.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the refinery schedule. Tracks progression from draft through approval to execution and eventual supersession.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule by planning horizon and frequency. Determines the granularity and scope of the production plan.

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number of the schedule, incremented each time the schedule is revised. Supports tracking of schedule evolution and change management.

attributes.name: superseded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this schedule was replaced by a newer version or subsequent schedule. Marks end of operational relevance.

attributes.name: target_crude_tan

attributes.name: target_gasoline_ron

attributes.name: total_crude_volume_bbl

attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards (MPMS)

attributes.name: variance_crude_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Difference between planned and actual crude throughput in barrels. Positive values indicate over-performance, negative values indicate under-performance.

attributes.name: vdu_throughput_target_bpd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vacuum Distillation Unit (VDU) Throughput Target (BOPD - Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Planned daily throughput rate for the Vacuum Distillation Unit in barrels per day. Targets secondary distillation capacity for heavy residue processing.

products.name: schedule_deviation
products.description: Record of deviations from the approved refinery schedule, capturing deviation date, affected unit or product stream, planned vs. actual throughput or yield, root cause category (equipment failure, feedstock quality, utility constraint, market demand change), financial impact estimate (OPEX variance, margin impact), corrective action taken, and resolution status. Supports operational performance management and schedule optimization.

attributes.name: hydrogen_consumption_isomerization_volume

attributes.name: hydrogen_import_volume

attributes.name: hydrogen_purity_import_percent

attributes.name: hydrogen_purity_reformer_percent

attributes.name: hydrogen_purity_smr_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Purity Steam Methane Reformer (SMR) Percentage
