The sap_production_order attribute on unit_run_record is a business reference that should be normalized to a FK relationship. C

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Run records drive profit center production volumes and margins. Required for P&L reporting and unit economics analysis.

attributes.name: turnaround_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to petrochemical.turnaround_event. Business justification: Unit run records during turnaround periods should reference the turnaround event for performance analysis and cost allocation. Cardinality: N:1 (many runs during same turnaround). Nullable: YES (most

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the supervisor or engineer who approved and validated this unit run record. Required for data governance, audit trail, and SOX financial controls compliance where production data feeds into financial reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP PP; COPAS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit run record was approved and validated by the responsible supervisor or engineer. Part of the record lifecycle audit trail. Required for SOX compliance and data governance controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP PP; COPAS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: avg_operating_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Average operating pressure of the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in kilopascals (kPa). Sourced from DCS/SCADA pressure transmitters via OSIsoft PI System historian. Key process variable for reaction kinetics, separation efficiency, and equipment integrity management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; DCS/SCADA; Aspen HYSYS; ASME B31.3

attributes.name: avg_operating_temp_c
attributes.description: Average operating temperature of the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in degrees Celsius. Sourced from DCS/SCADA thermocouple readings via OSIsoft PI System historian. Critical process variable for conversion rate optimization, catalyst performance, and product yield management.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; DCS/SCADA; Aspen HYSYS; API RP 530

attributes.name: btx_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Combined volume of BTX aromatics (Benzene, Toluene, and Xylene) produced during the run period, expressed in barrels. BTX is a high-value petrochemical product slate from reforming and cracking units. Used for yield accounting and specialty chemical production planning.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS Chapter 20; SAP PP; ASTM D3710

attributes.name: catalyst_activity_pct
attributes.description: Relative activity level of the process catalyst as a percentage of fresh catalyst baseline activity, measured during the run period. Declining catalyst activity indicates deactivation and triggers regeneration or replacement decisions. Critical for FCC, HDS, and reforming unit performance management.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API RP 19C; ASTM D3907 (FCC Catalyst Activity)

attributes.name: catalyst_addition_kg
attributes.description: Mass of fresh catalyst added to the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in kilograms. Tracks catalyst consumption rate for inventory management, cost accounting, and performance optimization. Relevant for continuous catalyst addition systems in FCC units.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Management; Maximo Asset Management; API RP 19C

attributes.name: conversion_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of feedstock converted to desired products during the run period, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 72.500 = 72.5%). Calculated from product yield measurements and mass balance data. Core KPI for unit performance benchmarking against design basis and Aspen HYSYS simulation targets.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API RP 19C; SPE Technical Standards

attributes.name: cooling_water_consumption_m3
attributes.description: Volume of cooling water consumed by the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in cubic metres. Used for water intensity benchmarking, utility cost allocation, and environmental compliance reporting under EPA and ISO 14001 standards.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this unit run record was first created in the system, either by automated DCS/SCADA ingestion via OSIsoft PI System or by manual data entry. Mandatory audit field for data lineage and silver layer record provenance.
attributes.references: NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SOX Section 302; Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the conversion unit was not in production during the run period, including both planned maintenance downtime and unplanned outages. Combined with on_stream_hours to reconcile the full run period duration. Feeds into reliability and availability KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management; API RP 19C

attributes.name: downtime_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the primary reason for unit downtime during the run period. Used for reliability analysis, maintenance planning, and production loss accounting. Sourced from Maximo work order classification and DCS alarm logs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PLANNED_MAINT|UNPLANNED_OUTAGE|FEEDSTOCK_SHORTAGE|UTILITY_FAILURE|PROCESS_UPSET|HSE_SHUTDOWN|TURNAROUND|OTHER — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; API RP 19C; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: energy_intensity_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Intensity (Barrel of Oil Equivalent per Barrel Feed)
attributes.description: Energy consumed per barrel of feedstock processed, expressed in Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) per barrel of feed. Calculated from total utility consumption (fuel gas, steam, power) normalized to feed throughput. Key energy efficiency KPI for benchmarking against industry standards and ISO 50001 targets.
attributes.references: ISO 50001 Energy Management; API RP 19C; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: ethylene_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of ethylene produced during the run period, expressed in barrels (or barrel equivalent). Primary high-value product from steam cracking and FCC operations. Used for product yield accounting, revenue attribution, and performance benchmarking against Aspen HYSYS simulation targets.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS Chapter 20; SAP PP

attributes.name: feed_rate_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Feed Rate (Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Volumetric feed rate of the primary feedstock to the conversion unit, expressed in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). For gas-phase units, this may be converted from MMCFD. Sourced from DCS/SCADA flow meters and validated against OSIsoft PI System historian tags. Core input for mass balance and yield calculations.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 20; OSIsoft PI System; Aspen HYSYS

attributes.name: feed_rate_mmcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Feed Rate (Million Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Volumetric feed rate of the primary feedstock expressed in Million Cubic Feet per Day (MMCFD), applicable for gas-phase conversion units such as NGL fractionators, GTL units, and gas crackers. Null for liquid-phase units where feed_rate_bopd is the primary measure.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14; OSIsoft PI System; Aspen HYSYS

attributes.name: feedstock_quality_api
attributes.description: American Petroleum Institute (API) gravity of the feedstock processed during this run period. Higher API gravity indicates lighter crude or condensate feedstock. Used for yield prediction, product quality forecasting, and feedstock valuation. Sourced from laboratory analysis or inline density meters.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 9; ASTM D287; API Gravity Standard

attributes.name: flare_volume_mmcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Flare Volume (Million Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Volume of gas flared from the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in MMCFD. Mandatory environmental reporting metric under EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart Ja and BSEE regulations. Used for GHG emissions calculations, ESG reporting, and flare minimization program tracking.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart Ja; BSEE; ISO 14001; ESG Reporting

attributes.name: fuel_gas_consumption_mmcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Gas Consumption (Million Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Volume of fuel gas consumed by the conversion unit for process heating, furnaces, and fired heaters during the run period, expressed in MMCFD. Key utility consumption metric for energy intensity calculations, OPEX allocation, and GHG emissions reporting under EPA 40 CFR Part 98.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98; OSIsoft PI System; Aspen HYSYS; ISO 14001

attributes.name: ghg_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions CO2 Equivalent (Metric Tonnes)
attributes.description: Total Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions from the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent (CO2e). Calculated from fuel gas consumption, flaring, and process vents per EPA 40 CFR Part 98 methodology. Required for EPA mandatory GHG reporting and ESG disclosures.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98; ISO 14001; GHG Protocol; ESG Reporting Standards

attributes.name: hysys_simulation_case
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Aspen HYSYS process simulation case used as the design basis or optimization target for this unit run record. Enables comparison of actual operating performance against simulation predictions for yield gap analysis and process optimization.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; SPE Technical Standards; API RP 19C

attributes.name: lpg_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — primarily propane and butane fractions — produced during the run period, expressed in barrels. Tracked separately from ethylene and propylene for product slate management, storage planning, and marketing allocation.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS Chapter 20; SAP PP; GPA 2145

attributes.name: mass_balance_closure_pct
attributes.description: Percentage closure of the mass balance for the run period, calculated as (total measured outputs / total measured inputs) × 100. Values near 100% indicate accurate measurement and minimal unaccounted losses. Deviations trigger investigation per API MPMS Chapter 20 loss control procedures. SSOT for yield accounting reconciliation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 20; Aspen HYSYS; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: ngl_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) recovered during the run period from NGL fractionation or gas processing units, expressed in barrels. Includes ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline fractions. Used for NGL product accounting and fractionation performance tracking.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS Chapter 20; GPA 2145; SAP PP

attributes.name: npt_hours
attributes.description: Hours of Non-Productive Time (NPT) during the run period — time when the unit was available but not producing at design capacity due to operational inefficiencies, process upsets, or waiting time. Distinct from planned downtime. Used for operational efficiency analysis and OPEX benchmarking.
attributes.references: API RP 19C; Maximo Asset Management; SAP PM

attributes.name: on_stream_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the conversion unit was in active production during the run period. Used to calculate on-stream factor (availability) and to normalize throughput and yield data for performance benchmarking. Excludes planned and unplanned downtime hours.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; API RP 19C; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: pi_tag_reference
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or reference string of OSIsoft PI System historian tag identifiers associated with this unit run record. Enables direct traceability from the silver layer record back to the real-time process data source for audit, reconciliation, and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Data Lineage Standard; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: power_consumption_mwh
attributes.description: Electrical energy consumed by the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in megawatt hours (MWh). Includes compressors, pumps, and auxiliary equipment. Used for energy intensity calculations, OPEX allocation, and ESG/GHG reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ISO 50001 Energy Management; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: propylene_yield_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of propylene produced during the run period, expressed in barrels. Key petrochemical product from FCC and steam cracking units. Used for yield accounting, polymerization feedstock planning, and LPG product slate management.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS Chapter 20; SAP PP

attributes.name: record_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the operating period captured in this run record. Daily records aggregate a full 24-hour period; shift records cover a single operating shift (typically 8 or 12 hours); hourly records are used for high-frequency process monitoring. Drives aggregation logic in yield accounting.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; OSIsoft PI System; API RP 19C

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the operating period for this unit run record. Used as the primary date dimension key for daily production reporting, yield accounting, and OPEX allocation. For shift-level records, this is the date of the shift start.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations; SAP PP; API RP 19C

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp marking the end of the operating period (shift or day) for this unit run record. Combined with run_start_timestamp to define the exact operating window for throughput, yield, and utility consumption calculations.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; DCS/SCADA; API RP 19C

attributes.name: run_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the unit run record, typically generated by the DCS/SCADA or Aspen HYSYS process historian. Format: URR-{UNIT_CODE}-{YYYYMMDD}-{SEQUENCE}. Used for cross-system reconciliation with OSIsoft PI System and SAP PP production orders.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Historian; OSIsoft PI System; SAP PP

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Principal real-world event timestamp marking the start of the operating period (shift or day) for this unit run record. Sourced from DCS/SCADA or OSIsoft PI System historian. Used as the primary business event time for performance trending and yield accounting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; DCS/SCADA; API RP 19C

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the unit run record. Draft indicates data entry in progress; submitted indicates pending supervisor review; approved indicates validated and accepted for yield accounting; rejected indicates returned for correction; closed indicates finalized and locked for reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order Status; Aspen HYSYS

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operating shift during which this run record was captured (e.g., A, B, C, D for rotating shifts, or DAY/NIGHT for two-shift operations). Null for daily aggregate records. Used for shift-level performance benchmarking and crew accountability.
attributes.references: SAP PP; Enablon HSE Management; Plant Operations Standard

attributes.name: steam_consumption_mt
attributes.description: Mass of steam consumed by the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in metric tonnes. Includes process steam, stripping steam, and utility steam. Used for energy intensity benchmarking, utility cost allocation, and plant-level OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Aspen HYSYS; ISO 50001 Energy Management

attributes.name: unaccounted_loss_bbl
attributes.description: Volume of feedstock or product that cannot be accounted for in the mass balance, expressed in barrels. Represents the difference between metered inputs and measured outputs after all known losses (flaring, sampling, drains) are accounted for. Triggers loss investigation when exceeding threshold. Reported to EPA for emissions compliance.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 20; EPA 40 CFR Part 98; PHMSA

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the petrochemical conversion unit technology. Examples include FCC (Fluid Catalytic Cracking), CDU (Crude Distillation Unit), VDU (Vacuum Distillation Unit), HDS (Hydrodesulfurization), NGL fractionator, steam cracker, GTL (Gas to Liquids), polymerization reactor, BTX extraction unit, LPG splitter. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FCC|CDU|VDU|HDS|NGL_FRACTIONATOR|STEAM_CRACKER|GTL|POLYMERIZATION|BTX_EXTRACTION|LPG_SPLITTER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 19C; Aspen HYSYS; SPE Technical Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this unit run record, including data corrections, resubmissions, or approval status changes. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SOX Section 302; Data Governance Standard

products.name: petrochemical_yield_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing actual product yield by fraction for each conversion unit run period, including ethylene, propylene, butadiene, benzene, toluene, xylene, LPG, naphtha, fuel oil, and specialty chemical outputs. Records planned yield targets from Aspen HYSYS simulation, actual achieved yields, yield variance, GOR equivalent, and mass balance closure percentage. Core entity for yield optimization and production planning reconciliation.

attributes.name: petrochemical_yield_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each yield record transaction in the petrochemical conversion unit run period. Primary key for the yield_record data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: conversion_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petrochemical conversion unit (e.g., steam cracker, FCC unit, NGL fractionator, polymerization reactor) that produced this yield record.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; Maximo Asset Management; SAP PM

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Yield performance impacts cost center efficiency metrics and variance analysis. Enables cost-per-unit tracking and benchmarking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production engineer responsible for validating and approving this yield record. Satisfies the PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for this transaction entity.

attributes.name: feedstock_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary feedstock material (e.g., naphtha, ethane, propane, LPG, gas oil) processed during this run period. Drives feedstock allocation and yield optimization analysis.
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Master; Aspen HYSYS

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Yield records track production of petroleum products (ethylene, propylene, benzene, toluene, xylene) requiring petroleum_product reference for production accounting, inventory valuation, margin analys

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petrochemical plant or facility where the conversion unit is located. Supports plant-level OPEX aggregation and multi-site reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to petrochemical.production_order. Business justification: Yield records are captured for production orders to track actual vs. planned yields. The sap_production_order_number attribute on yield_record is a business reference that should be normalized to a FK

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Yield drives profit center margin realization. Higher yields improve profitability; yield variance analysis is core to petrochemical margin management.

attributes.name: run_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the conversion unit run period during which this yield was recorded. Links to the operational run period master for scheduling and planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; SAP PP Production Order

attributes.name: simulation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Aspen HYSYS simulation run that generated the planned yield targets for this record. Enables traceability between actual production outcomes and simulation model predictions for model calibration.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; SAP PP

attributes.name: unit_run_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to petrochemical.unit_run_record. Business justification: Yield records are captured FOR specific unit run periods, tracking product yields by fraction for each run. The run_period_id attribute on yield_record is semantically equivalent to unit_run_record_id

attributes.name: actual_yield_pct
attributes.description: Actual overall product yield achieved as a percentage of feedstock charged during the run period. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian and laboratory analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; API MPMS Chapter 20; ISO 9001

attributes.name: benzene_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of benzene produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Aromatic compound used in styrene, cumene, and cyclohexane production. Subject to EPA MACT standards.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; EPA 40 CFR Part 63 Subpart F; API RP 505

attributes.name: butadiene_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of butadiene (1,3-butadiene) produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Synthetic rubber precursor recovered from C4 fraction of steam cracker output.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; EPA 40 CFR Part 63 Subpart II

attributes.name: catalyst_age_days
attributes.description: Number of days the current catalyst batch has been in service at the start of this run period. Used to model catalyst deactivation curves and predict yield decline in Aspen HYSYS simulations.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API RP 941; Maximo CMMS

attributes.name: catalyst_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the catalyst batch loaded in the conversion unit during this run period. Enables correlation of catalyst age, activity, and selectivity with yield performance for catalyst lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; Maximo Asset Management; API RP 941

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yield record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: energy_consumption_gj
attributes.description: Total energy consumed by the conversion unit during the run period in gigajoules. Includes steam, electricity, and fuel gas consumption. Key input for energy intensity KPIs and EPA GHG emissions reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98; ISO 50001 Energy Management; ESG Reporting

attributes.name: ethylene_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of ethylene produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Primary high-value olefin product from steam cracking operations. Tracked against Aspen HYSYS simulation targets.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; EPA 40 CFR Part 63 Subpart YY

attributes.name: feedstock_volume_mt
attributes.description: Total mass of feedstock charged to the conversion unit during the run period, expressed in metric tonnes. Denominator for yield percentage calculations and mass balance closure.

attributes.name: fuel_oil_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of fuel oil (heavy residue) produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Represents the bottom-of-barrel fraction; used as plant fuel or sold as bunker fuel.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; IMO MARPOL Annex VI

attributes.name: ghg_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions CO2 Equivalent (Metric Tonnes)
attributes.description: Total Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions from the conversion unit during the run period expressed in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent. Mandatory for EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart X reporting and ESG disclosure.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart X; ISO 14001; ESG/GHG Protocol

attributes.name: gor_equivalent
attributes.description: Gas-Oil Ratio (GOR) equivalent for the conversion unit run, expressed as standard cubic feet of gas per barrel of liquid product. Provides cross-domain comparability with upstream production metrics and supports BOE reporting.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS; API MPMS Chapter 20; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: lab_analysis_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the laboratory analysis report confirming product quality and composition for this run period. Provides traceability to LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) records for ISO 9001 compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Competence; API MPMS Chapter 8

attributes.name: lpg_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) — primarily propane and butane mix — produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Recovered from NGL fractionation or cracker C3/C4 streams.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS Chapter 14; GPA 2145

attributes.name: mass_balance_closure_pct
attributes.description: Percentage representing how closely total product outputs match total feedstock inputs on a mass basis (outputs / inputs × 100). Values near 100% indicate accurate measurement; deviations trigger investigation per API MPMS standards. Critical for EPA emissions reconciliation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 20; EPA 40 CFR Part 98; ISO 9001

attributes.name: naphtha_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of naphtha fraction produced during the run period in metric tonnes. May be recycled as cracker feedstock or sold as gasoline blendstock.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; EPA 40 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: npt_hours
attributes.description: Total Non-Productive Time (NPT) in hours during the run period due to unplanned shutdowns, equipment failures, or process upsets. Impacts yield totals and is tracked for reliability improvement programs.
attributes.references: API RP 17N; Maximo CMMS; SAP PM

attributes.name: on_stream_factor_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the run period during which the conversion unit was actively processing feedstock (on-stream hours / total run hours × 100). Accounts for planned and unplanned downtime within the period.
attributes.references: API RP 17N; Avocet Production Operations; SAP PM

attributes.name: operating_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Average operating pressure of the conversion unit during the run period in kilopascals. Critical process parameter for yield optimization and safety compliance; sourced from DCS/SCADA.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; ASME B31.3; API RP 520

attributes.name: operating_temperature_c
attributes.description: Average operating temperature of the conversion unit during the run period in degrees Celsius. Key process variable influencing product selectivity and yield distribution; sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Aspen HYSYS; API RP 520

attributes.name: opex_allocated_usd
attributes.description: Plant-level Operating Expenditure (OPEX) allocated to this conversion unit run period in US dollars. Includes energy, catalyst, maintenance, and overhead costs allocated via SAP CO cost center accounting. Used for unit cost of production analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; COPAS; IFRS/GAAP IAS 2

attributes.name: planned_yield_pct
attributes.description: Target overall product yield as a percentage of feedstock charged, derived from Aspen HYSYS process simulation for this run period. Baseline for variance analysis and production planning reconciliation.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; SAP PP

attributes.name: propylene_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of propylene produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Key petrochemical intermediate for polypropylene and acrylonitrile production.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; EPA 40 CFR Part 63

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Overall quality classification of the products produced during this run period based on laboratory analysis against ISO and customer specifications. Off-spec or downgraded product impacts revenue realization and triggers quality investigation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; API RP 2556; SAP QM

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this yield record, formatted as YR-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used for cross-system reconciliation with Aspen HYSYS simulation outputs and SAP PP production orders.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Naming Convention; SAP PP

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the yield record through its approval workflow. Draft indicates initial entry; validated indicates mass balance closure check passed; approved indicates sign-off by production engineer; closed indicates period locked for reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order Status; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for production engineer comments on notable events, process deviations, or exceptions during the run period that affected yield performance. Supports root cause analysis and audit review.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; SAP PP; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: run_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the conversion unit run period in hours, calculated from run start to run end timestamps. Used for throughput rate calculations and OPEX allocation.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; SAP PP; API RP 17N

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the conversion unit run period ended. Used to calculate run duration and annualized yield rates.

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the conversion unit run period commenced. Principal business event timestamp for this yield record. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System historian or DCS.

attributes.name: specialty_chemical_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of specialty chemical products (e.g., solvents, monomers, intermediates not classified in standard fractions) produced during the run period in metric tonnes.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP PP

attributes.name: toluene_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of toluene produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Aromatic solvent and chemical intermediate; may be hydrodealkylated to benzene or used in TDI production.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; EPA 40 CFR Part 63

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the petrochemical conversion unit technology. Determines applicable yield fractions, simulation models, and EPA emissions reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam_cracker|fcc|ngl_fractionator|polymerization|reformer|gtl|hds|vdu|cdu|specialty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 941; EPA 40 CFR Part 63; Aspen HYSYS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this yield record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: xylene_yield_mt
attributes.description: Actual mass of mixed xylenes (ortho, meta, para) produced during the run period in metric tonnes. Para-xylene is the primary feedstock for PTA and PET production.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; API MPMS; EPA 40 CFR Part 63

attributes.name: yield_variance_pct
attributes.description: Difference between actual yield percentage and planned yield percentage (actual minus planned). Negative values indicate underperformance versus Aspen HYSYS simulation targets. Key KPI for yield optimization.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS; SAP PP Variance Analysis; API RP 2556

products.name: product_catalog
products.description: Master catalog of petrochemical products manufactured or processed at petrochemical plants, including olefins (ethylene, propylene), aromatics (BTX), polymers (polyethylene, polypropylene), LPG, NGL fractions, GTL products, and specialty chemicals. Captures product name, chemical formula, CAS number, product grade, specification sheet reference, ISO quality standard, packaging type, and regulatory classification. Distinct from the enterprise product catalog — this is the petrochemical-specific product master.

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Primary key for product_catalog

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Petrochemical products (ethylene, propylene, benzene, BTX) are petroleum products requiring master catalog linkage for enterprise pricing benchmarks, HS codes, regulatory classification, and SEC repor

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the petrochemical plant or facility where this product is primarily manufactured or processed. Links the product to its production origin for plant-level OPEX allocation, capacity planning, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to SAP Plant (WERKS) in the Material Master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master (WERKS); SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: product_line_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this product to its commercial product line or business segment (e.g., Olefins, Aromatics, Polymers, LPG, Specialty Chemicals). Supports product portfolio management, revenue reporting by product line, and SAP CO Profitability Analysis (CO-PA).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Profitability Analysis; SAP MM Material Group

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the petrochemical product expressed in degrees API (°API), applicable to liquid hydrocarbon products such as condensates, naphtha, and GTL products. API gravity is inversely related to density and is used for product classification, pricing, and custody transfer per API MPMS standards.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1; ASTM D287; American Petroleum Institute (API)

attributes.name: astm_standard
attributes.description: ASTM International standard designation applicable to the product's quality testing and specification (e.g., ASTM D1835 for LPG, ASTM D4814 for gasoline blendstocks, ASTM D2163 for NGL analysis). Defines the test methods used to verify product quality against specification.
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards; American Petroleum Institute (API) Standards

attributes.name: boiling_point_c
attributes.description: Normal boiling point of the petrochemical product at atmospheric pressure expressed in degrees Celsius (°C). Used in process design, distillation column design, storage condition specification, and safety classification for flammable materials.
attributes.references: ASTM International; Aspen HYSYS Thermodynamic Properties; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) Registry Number assigned to the chemical substance by the American Chemical Society. Universally recognized identifier for chemical substances used in regulatory filings (EPA TSCA, REACH), safety data sheets, import/export documentation, and chemical inventory tracking.
attributes.references: American Chemical Society CAS Registry; EPA TSCA Section 8; EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006

attributes.name: chemical_formula
attributes.description: Standard molecular formula of the petrochemical product expressed in Hill notation (e.g., C2H4 for ethylene, C3H6 for propylene, C6H6 for benzene). Used for regulatory reporting, safety data sheets (SDS), and chemical inventory management per EPA and OSHA requirements.
attributes.references: IUPAC Nomenclature; EPA TSCA Chemical Inventory; OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost and pricing fields of this petrochemical product (e.g., USD, EUR, SAR). Ensures consistent currency denomination across cost management, financial reporting, and intercompany transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this petrochemical product record was first created in the master catalog. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: density_kg_per_m3
attributes.description: Standard density of the petrochemical product at reference conditions (typically 15°C and 1 atm) expressed in kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m³). Critical for volumetric-to-mass conversion in custody transfer, shipping, and inventory management. Used in Aspen HYSYS simulations and API gravity calculations.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 — Physical Properties; ASTM D1298; ISO 3675

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this petrochemical product was or is scheduled to be discontinued from the catalog. Null if the product is currently active. Used for product lifecycle management, customer notification planning, and inventory wind-down.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISO 9001:2015 Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product record is valid and active in the petrochemical product catalog. Used for product lifecycle management, pricing effectivity, and regulatory compliance tracking. Corresponds to SAP Material Master validity date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Validity; ISO 9001:2015 Document Control

attributes.name: feedstock_type
attributes.description: Primary feedstock or raw material from which this petrochemical product is derived or manufactured. Critical for feedstock allocation planning, cost of production analysis, and supply chain optimization. Supports Aspen HYSYS process simulation and SAP PP production planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: naphtha|ethane|propane|butane|NGL|natural_gas|crude_oil|condensate|mixed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; API Technical Standards

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Flash point of the petrochemical product expressed in degrees Celsius (°C), representing the lowest temperature at which vapors can ignite. Critical for fire hazard classification, storage and handling requirements, transport classification under PHMSA/IMDG, and HSE risk assessment.
attributes.references: ASTM D93; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; PHMSA 49 CFR; GHS Classification

attributes.name: ghg_emission_factor
attributes.description: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emission factor for this petrochemical product expressed in tonnes of CO2 equivalent per unit of production (tCO2e/MT or tCO2e/BBL). Used for Scope 1 and Scope 3 GHG emissions calculations, ESG reporting, and EPA GHG reporting under 40 CFR Part 98.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 GHG Reporting; ISO 14064 GHG Quantification; ESG Reporting Frameworks (GRI, TCFD); Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Primary hazard classification of the petrochemical product under the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals. Drives SDS requirements, packaging and labeling, transport documentation, and HSE risk assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flammable_gas|flammable_liquid|toxic|corrosive|oxidizer|explosive|non_hazardous|environmental_hazard — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev. 9; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA TSCA

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code assigned to the petrochemical product for international trade, customs declarations, and import/export documentation. Required for cross-border shipments and trade compliance. Typically 6-10 digits depending on jurisdiction.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System; U.S. Schedule B Export Codes; SAP S/4HANA GTS Global Trade Services

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this petrochemical product is classified as a controlled substance under applicable regulations (e.g., DEA Schedule, EPA Section 112(r) RMP threshold substances, OSHA PSM covered chemicals). Triggers additional regulatory controls, reporting obligations, and security requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Section 112(r) RMP; OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119; DEA Controlled Substances Act

attributes.name: iso_quality_standard
attributes.description: ISO quality standard or specification applicable to this petrochemical product (e.g., ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 4626 for solvents). Indicates the quality management framework under which the product is manufactured and certified. Used for customer qualification and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management; ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management; International Organization for Standardization

attributes.name: iupac_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) Chemical Name
attributes.description: Systematic chemical name assigned according to International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry (IUPAC) nomenclature rules. Provides an unambiguous scientific identifier for the chemical substance, used in regulatory submissions, patent filings, and technical documentation.
attributes.references: IUPAC Nomenclature of Organic Chemistry; EPA TSCA Chemical Inventory

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this petrochemical product record was most recently modified in the master catalog. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with source systems (SAP MM, Aspen HYSYS), and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: molecular_weight
attributes.description: Molecular weight of the petrochemical product expressed in grams per mole (g/mol). Used in process engineering calculations, yield optimization, and Aspen HYSYS process simulation for mass balance and thermodynamic modeling. Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: IUPAC Nomenclature; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; ASTM International

attributes.name: norm_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the petrochemical product or its production process involves Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM). NORM is commonly associated with NGL fractionation, produced water, and scale deposits in oil and gas processing. Drives waste disposal, worker protection, and regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EPA NORM Guidance; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1096; NRC Regulations; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Standard packaging or transport mode for the petrochemical product (e.g., bulk pipeline, bulk tanker, ISO container, drum, Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC), bag, pressurized cylinder, railcar). Drives logistics planning, storage requirements, and customer delivery specifications. Corresponds to SAP Handling Unit Management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_pipeline|bulk_tanker|ISO_container|drum|IBC|bag|cylinder|railcar — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Handling Unit Management; PHMSA 49 CFR Packaging Requirements; IMDG Code

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the petrochemical product into its primary chemical family or commercial category. Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: olefin|aromatic|polymer|NGL|LPG|GTL|specialty_chemical|solvent|fertilizer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Chemistry Council (ACC) Product Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the petrochemical product across business systems. Corresponds to the SAP Material Number (MATNR) in SAP S/4HANA MM. Used in procurement, sales orders, and production planning. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master (MATNR); API RP 11S

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Commercial or technical grade designation of the product indicating purity level, specification tier, or application suitability (e.g., polymer grade, chemical grade, fuel grade, food grade, pharmaceutical grade). Drives pricing, customer qualification, and quality control requirements. Corresponds to SAP Material Batch Classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management; ASTM International Product Standards

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full commercial or trade name of the petrochemical product (e.g., Ethylene, Propylene, Polyethylene HD, Benzene, LPG Propane, GTL Naphtha). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used in product catalogs, customer-facing documents, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Description; IUPAC Nomenclature

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the petrochemical product in the master catalog. Indicates whether the product is actively manufactured and sold, discontinued, under regulatory or quality review, in development, or blocked from transactions. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Corresponds to SAP Material Status (MMSTA).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Status (MMSTA); ISO 9001 Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Operational classification indicating whether the product is a finished product sold to customers, an intermediate used in further processing, a feedstock consumed in conversion units, a by-product, or a co-product of a primary reaction. Supports production planning in SAP PP and Aspen HYSYS process simulation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Material Type; Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation

attributes.name: production_process
attributes.description: Primary petrochemical manufacturing or conversion process used to produce this product (e.g., steam cracking for ethylene/propylene, NGL fractionation for LPG/NGL fractions, polymerization for polyethylene/polypropylene, Gas-to-Liquids (GTL) conversion). Supports process simulation in Aspen HYSYS and production planning in SAP PP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam_cracking|catalytic_reforming|NGL_fractionation|polymerization|GTL|FCC|hydrocracking|alkylation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; API RP 500; SPE Technical Standards

attributes.name: purity_min_pct
attributes.description: Minimum required purity of the petrochemical product expressed as a percentage (%). Defines the lower bound of the product quality specification for the primary component. Used in quality control, customer contracts, and regulatory compliance. Corresponds to SAP Batch Classification characteristic values.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; ISO 9001:2015; ASTM International Product Standards

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.description: European Union REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) registration number assigned by the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) for substances manufactured or imported into the EU in quantities above 1 tonne per year. Required for EU market access and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the petrochemical product under applicable environmental and chemical control regulations. Indicates whether the product is listed under EPA TSCA, registered under EU REACH, classified as a Volatile Organic Compound (VOC), Hazardous Air Pollutant (HAP), or controlled substance. Drives compliance reporting obligations.
attributes.references: EPA TSCA Section 8; EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; EPA Clean Air Act HAP List; OSHA

attributes.name: sds_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document management system link to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this petrochemical product, as required by OSHA HazCom Standard and GHS. The SDS contains hazard information, handling instructions, emergency response procedures, and regulatory classification data.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS (Globally Harmonized System); EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum shelf life of the petrochemical product in days from the date of manufacture, after which the product may no longer meet specification. Applicable to specialty chemicals, polymers, and reactive intermediates. Drives batch expiry management in SAP MM Batch Management and warehouse storage planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management — Shelf Life; ISO 9001:2015 Product Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: specification_sheet_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number or URL pointing to the official product specification sheet (also known as Technical Data Sheet or TDS) that defines the product's quality parameters, physical and chemical properties, and acceptance criteria. Used for customer qualification, quality audits, and ISO certification.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System — Document Control; SAP DMS Document Management

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per primary unit of measure for this petrochemical product, used for inventory valuation, production cost analysis, and variance reporting in SAP CO. Expressed in the company's functional currency. Confidential business data used for internal cost management and OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Standard Cost Estimate; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS/GAAP IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature for the petrochemical product expressed in degrees Celsius (°C). Defines the upper bound of the safe storage temperature range. Critical for preventing thermal decomposition, polymerization inhibitor depletion, or pressure buildup in storage vessels.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids; API RP 2003; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature for the petrochemical product expressed in degrees Celsius (°C). Defines the lower bound of the safe storage temperature range. Used for warehouse and tank farm design, HSE risk assessment, and logistics planning for temperature-sensitive products.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 Flammable Liquids; API RP 2003; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.description: Sulfur content of the petrochemical product expressed in parts per million (ppm) by weight. Critical quality parameter for fuel products, aromatics, and petrochemical feedstocks. Drives compliance with EPA fuel sulfur standards, EU fuel quality directives, and refinery Hydrodesulfurization (HDS) unit performance monitoring.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 80 Fuel Sulfur Standards; ASTM D5453; API Technical Standards; EU Fuel Quality Directive 2009/30/EC

attributes.name: tsca_inventory_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: EPA Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Inventory Status
attributes.description: Status of the petrochemical product on the EPA Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA) Chemical Substance Inventory. Indicates whether the substance is listed as active, inactive, exempt, or not listed. Active status is required for commercial manufacture or import in the United States.
attributes.references: EPA TSCA Section 8(b); 40 CFR Part 710; U.S. Environmental Protection Agency

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations (UN) four-digit number assigned to hazardous materials and dangerous goods for transport classification (e.g., UN1075 for LPG, UN1962 for ethylene). Required on shipping documents, labels, and placards for road, rail, sea, and air transport of hazardous petrochemical products.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods (Orange Book); PHMSA 49 CFR; IMDG Code

attributes.name: uom_alternate
attributes.description: Alternate unit of measure used for specific business contexts such as customer invoicing, regulatory reporting, or production measurement, when different from the primary UOM. Supports SAP alternate unit of measure conversion in the Material Master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MT|KG|BBL|MMBTU|KL|L|M3|LB — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master — Alternate UOM; API MPMS Chapter 11

attributes.name: uom_primary
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure used for commercial transactions, inventory management, and production reporting of this petrochemical product (e.g., MT for metric tonnes, BBL for barrels, MMBTU for gas products, KL for kiloliters). Corresponds to SAP Base Unit of Measure (MEINS) in the Material Master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MT|KG|BBL|MMBTU|KL|L|M3|LB — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master (MEINS); API MPMS; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: voc_content_pct
attributes.description: Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) content of the petrochemical product expressed as a percentage by weight (%). Required for EPA Clean Air Act compliance, state air quality permit conditions, and product labeling under VOC regulations. Relevant for solvents, aromatics, and light hydrocarbon products.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Section 183(e); 40 CFR Part 51 Appendix W; EPA VOC Regulations

products.name: quality_assay
products.description: Transactional record capturing laboratory quality assay results for petrochemical products and feedstocks at defined sampling points, including sample date, sample location (unit outlet, storage tank, pipeline), product or feedstock tested, test method (ASTM, ISO), measured properties (purity %, RON, sulfur ppm, viscosity, density, flash point, TAN, moisture content), pass/fail status against specification, and QC analyst sign-off. Supports ISO quality compliance and product certification.

attributes.name: quality_assay_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each laboratory quality assay record in the petrochemical domain. Primary key for the quality_assay data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete business event (lab test) with its own lifecycle, timestamps, party reference, and quantitative result.

attributes.name: compliance_corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.corrective_action. Business justification: Failed quality tests trigger corrective actions to address root causes (process adjustments, equipment repairs, procedure updates). Links assays to corrective actions for tracking investigation, imple

attributes.name: conversion_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to petrochemical.conversion_unit. Business justification: Quality assays are taken at specific conversion units (sample points) to monitor product quality and process performance. Linking assays to conversion units enables unit-level quality trending. Cardin

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Lab costs and quality control expenses are allocated to cost centers for budget tracking and cost control.

attributes.name: custody_transfer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.custody_transfer. Business justification: Quality assays at custody transfer points validate product specifications for commercial handover. Required for custody transfer documentation, quality claims resolution, and regulatory compliance (AP

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment. Business justification: Quality samples taken from specific equipment for condition monitoring, corrosion tracking, fitness-for-service assessment, and equipment performance trending. Required for RBI programs, equipment int

attributes.name: lab_instrument_equipment_id
attributes.description: Asset tag or equipment identifier of the analytical instrument used to perform the measurement, as registered in Maximo Asset Management (CMMS). Enables instrument-level traceability, calibration status verification, and maintenance correlation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.4 Equipment; Maximo Asset Management CMMS

attributes.name: original_assay_quality_assay_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original quality_assay record that this retest supersedes, when retest_flag is True. Enables lineage tracking between original and retest results and supports non-conformance root cause analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Quality assays of petrochemical products must reference petroleum_product master for specification compliance verification, custody transfer certification, certificate of quality generation, and regul

attributes.name: pipeline_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the pipeline segment from which the sample was drawn, when the sample point type is pipeline. Supports PHMSA pipeline quality monitoring requirements and product contamination detection.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; API MPMS Chapter 8.2

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petrochemical plant or processing facility where the sample was collected. Links the assay to plant-level OPEX, EPA environmental compliance reporting, and Aspen HYSYS process simulation context.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 63 National Emission Standards; ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management

attributes.name: primary_quality_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the laboratory analyst or QC technician responsible for conducting the assay and signing off on results. Supports traceability, competency verification, and ISO/IEC 17025 personnel qualification requirements.

attributes.name: process_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the petrochemical conversion unit (e.g., NGL fractionator, FCC unit, CDU, VDU, HDS unit, cracker) from which the sample was collected at the unit outlet. Links assay results to Aspen HYSYS process simulation models and unit performance KPIs.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; API RP 750 Process Hazard Analysis

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petrochemical product or feedstock being tested, such as LPG, NGL, ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, or specialty chemical. Links to product specification master and SAP PP production order.
attributes.references: API Technical Data Book; SAP PP Product Master

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PP production order under which the sampled batch was manufactured. Enables integration between quality assay results and production planning, cost allocation (OPEX), and yield reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; SAP PP-QM Integration

attributes.name: quality_spec_id
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable product quality specification document that defines the acceptance criteria (spec_min_value, spec_max_value) for this property. Specifications may be internal, customer-contractual, or regulatory.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.2.3 Review of Requirements; API Product Specifications

attributes.name: refinery_product_quality_test_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Refinery Product Quality Test Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to refining.product_quality_test. Business justification: When petrochemical plants receive refinery products as feedstock, they cross-reference refinery quality tests with their own incoming assays for custody transfer validation, quality reconciliation, an

attributes.name: sample_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the defined sampling location within the plant, such as unit outlet, storage tank nozzle, pipeline tap, or product loading arm. Sampling point determines applicable specification limits and test frequency.
attributes.references: ASTM D4057; API MPMS Chapter 8 Sampling

attributes.name: storage_tank_equipment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the storage tank from which the sample was drawn, when the sample point type is storage_tank. Used for tank quality management, blending decisions, and product segregation in the supply chain.
attributes.references: API Standard 650 Welded Tanks for Oil Storage; API MPMS Chapter 8

attributes.name: waiver_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.waiver. Business justification: Quality deviations from product specifications may require regulatory waivers for product release or continued operation. Quality_assay table tracks waiver_number; FK enables waiver approval workflow

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the QC supervisor approved the assay results and authorized product release or rejection. Distinct from created_timestamp and updated_timestamp; represents the formal quality gate event in the product release lifecycle.

attributes.name: assay_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the assay, used in laboratory information management systems, certificates of analysis, and product certification documents. Format: QA-{PLANT_CODE}-{YYYYMM} sequence.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Laboratory Competence; ASTM International Laboratory Practices

attributes.name: assay_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the assay record, tracking progression from sample receipt through laboratory analysis, QC review, and final approval or rejection. Drives product release and certification workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6 Release of Products and Services

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Production batch or lot number of the product or feedstock from which the sample was drawn, as assigned by SAP PP production order management. Links the assay result to a specific manufacturing batch for traceability, recall management, and certificate of analysis issuance.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.2 Identification and Traceability

attributes.name: calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the analytical instrument used for this assay must next be calibrated to maintain measurement traceability. If the assay was performed after the calibration due date, results may be flagged for review and the instrument quarantined.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.4.6 Calibration; Maximo Preventive Maintenance Scheduling

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued to the customer or downstream user upon product release. The COA documents all measured properties and their conformance status. Required for product certification and customer delivery documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6; ASTM E1578 Laboratory Information Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the quality assay record was first created in the laboratory information management system or data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: deviation_value
attributes.description: Calculated difference between the measured_value and the nearest specification limit (spec_min_value or spec_max_value) when the result is out of specification. Positive value indicates magnitude of exceedance; negative indicates margin within spec. Supports SPC and corrective action prioritization.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2 Nonconformity and Corrective Action; ASTM E2587 Statistical Process Control

attributes.name: lab_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Celsius within the laboratory at the time of measurement. Required by certain ASTM/ISO test methods (e.g., viscosity, density) where ambient conditions affect measurement accuracy and must be documented for result validity.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 Kinematic Viscosity; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 6.3 Facility and Environmental Conditions

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sampled material as feedstock entering a conversion unit, intermediate in-process stream, finished petrochemical product, utility fluid, or waste stream. Drives applicable specification set and regulatory reporting category.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Numeric result of the laboratory measurement for the specified property. Precision to six decimal places accommodates trace-level measurements such as sulfur in ppm and ultra-high-purity polymer specifications. Principal quantitative outcome of the assay transaction.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6 Evaluating Measurement Uncertainty; ASTM E29

attributes.name: measurement_uncertainty
attributes.description: Expanded measurement uncertainty (U) associated with the measured_value, expressed in the same unit as measurement_unit. Required by ISO/IEC 17025 for accredited laboratory reporting and used in borderline conformance decisions.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.6; JCGM 100:2008 GUM (Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement)

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measured_value, such as %, ppm, mg KOH/g (TAN), cSt (kinematic viscosity), kg/m3 (density), °C (flash point), or RON (dimensionless index). Must align with the test method standard unit.
attributes.references: ASTM International; SI Units (ISO 80000); API MPMS

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Conformance determination for the measured property against the applicable specification limits. Pass indicates the measured value is within spec_min_value and spec_max_value. Conditional pass may apply when a waiver or deviation has been approved. Drives product release, hold, or rework decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6 Release of Products and Services; API Q1

attributes.name: property_name
attributes.description: Name of the physical or chemical property being measured in this assay record, such as purity percentage, Research Octane Number (RON), sulfur content, kinematic viscosity, density, flash point, Total Acid Number (TAN), or moisture content. One record per property per sample.
attributes.references: ASTM International; API Technical Data Book; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for the analyst or QC supervisor to record observations, anomalies, instrument issues, sample handling notes, or any other contextual information relevant to the assay result. Supports root cause analysis and audit review.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.8.2 Minimum Requirements for Test Reports

attributes.name: replicate_count
attributes.description: Number of replicate measurements performed for this property in accordance with the test method's repeatability requirements. Typically 2–3 replicates per ASTM/ISO method. Used to validate reproducibility and calculate standard deviation.
attributes.references: ASTM E691 Interlaboratory Study; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.7

attributes.name: retest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assay record is a retest of a previously failed or inconclusive result. True when the assay was triggered by a prior non-conformance, enabling tracking of retest frequency and first-pass yield rates.

attributes.name: sample_condition
attributes.description: Visual or physical condition of the sample as observed upon receipt in the laboratory. Abnormal conditions such as contamination, phase separation, or off-spec appearance may invalidate results and trigger sample rejection or re-sampling.
attributes.references: ASTM D4057; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.4 Handling of Test Items

attributes.name: sample_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the physical sample was collected from the sampling point. Principal business event date for the assay, used for production batch correlation, trend analysis, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ASTM D4057 Practice for Manual Sampling of Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: sample_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical location from which the sample was drawn. Determines applicable ASTM/ISO sampling method, required sample volume, and chain-of-custody handling procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unit_outlet|storage_tank|pipeline|loading_arm|feed_inlet|product_header|blending_header — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sample_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the physical sample was collected, including timezone offset. Required for SCADA/PI System correlation, shift-level production tracking, and SIMOPS safety documentation.
attributes.references: ASTM D4057; OSIsoft PI System timestamp conventions

attributes.name: sample_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of the physical sample collected, expressed in millilitres. Must meet minimum volume requirements specified by the test method. Insufficient sample volume may require re-sampling and can delay product release.

attributes.name: spec_max_value
attributes.description: Upper bound of the product or feedstock specification for the measured property. Used in conjunction with spec_min_value to evaluate conformance. Null when only a minimum limit applies (e.g., RON minimum for gasoline blendstock).

attributes.name: spec_min_value
attributes.description: Lower bound of the product or feedstock specification for the measured property. Used to determine pass/fail status and calculate deviation from specification. Sourced from the applicable product quality specification sheet.

attributes.name: spec_target_value
attributes.description: Optimal or nominal target value for the measured property as defined in the product quality specification or process control plan. Used for process optimization, Aspen HYSYS model calibration, and yield optimization analytics.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: test_method_code
attributes.description: Standardized laboratory test method code used to measure the property, such as ASTM D86 (distillation), ASTM D4052 (density), ASTM D2622 (sulfur by XRF), ISO 3104 (kinematic viscosity), or UOP 539 (TAN). Ensures analytical reproducibility and inter-laboratory comparability.
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards; ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Clause 7.2 Method Selection

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the quality assay record, including result amendments, status changes, or QC sign-off updates. Supports audit trail and data integrity monitoring.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5 Documented Information

products.name: production_order
products.description: Transactional record representing a SAP PP production order for a petrochemical manufacturing run, capturing order number, plant, conversion unit, target product, planned start and end dates, planned feedstock quantity, planned output quantity, actual output quantity, order status (created, released, confirmed, closed), cost object assignment, and AFE reference for CAPEX-linked runs. Integrates with SAP PP module for production planning and cost settlement.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SAP PP production order record in the petrochemical domain. Primary key for the silver-layer lakehouse table. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP PP Module — Production Order Object

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost object (production order cost collector) to which all actual costs (material, labor, overhead, utilities) are settled. Enables product cost analysis and OPEX reporting per manufacturing run.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Cost Object Controlling (KKBC_ORD); COPAS Production Accounting; IFRS/GAAP Inventory Costing

attributes.name: catalyst_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active catalyst charge loaded in the conversion unit at the time of the production run. Enables catalyst performance tracking, deactivation monitoring, and regeneration cycle management across production orders.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Catalyst Management; API RP 941 Catalyst Handling; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: conversion_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific petrochemical conversion unit (e.g., NGL fractionator, steam cracker, FCC unit, polymerization reactor, GTL reactor) where the manufacturing run is executed. Supports unit-level performance and OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: Aspen HYSYS Process Unit Model; API RP 750 Process Hazard Management

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production planner or scheduler responsible for creating and managing the production order. Used for accountability tracking, workload analysis, and escalation routing in SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP PP Module — MRP Controller (AUFK.FEVOR); SAP HR Employee Master; SOX Segregation of Duties

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.equipment. Business justification: Production orders execute on specific equipment for work order linkage, equipment utilization tracking, maintenance planning coordination, and asset performance analysis. Required for OEE calculation

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Production orders for capital projects (new unit commissioning, major modifications) are AFE-controlled for budget authorization and cost tracking.

attributes.name: joa_id

attributes.name: permit_id
