attributes.name: demurrage_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours by which laytime used exceeded laytime allowed, forming the basis for demurrage charge calculation. Positive value indicates demurrage owed.

attributes.name: demurrage_rate_per_day
attributes.description: Contractual demurrage rate specified in the charter party, expressed as currency amount per day. Used to calculate total demurrage charges based on demurrage hours.

attributes.name: despatch_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours by which laytime used was less than laytime allowed, forming the basis for despatch payment calculation. Positive value indicates despatch earned.

attributes.name: despatch_rate_per_day
attributes.description: Contractual despatch rate specified in the charter party, typically calculated as a percentage (often 50%) of the demurrage rate, expressed as currency amount per day.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the counterparty has disputed the demurrage claim. True indicates an active dispute requiring resolution.

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: Date when the counterparty formally raised a dispute against the demurrage claim.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the counterparty for disputing the demurrage claim, including specific objections to laytime calculations, rate applications, or time exceptions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this demurrage claim record was last updated. Represents the record audit updated timestamp for tracking changes through the claim lifecycle.

attributes.name: laytime_allowed_hours
attributes.description: Total laytime hours contractually allowed under the charter party agreement for loading or discharge operations before demurrage charges begin to accrue.

attributes.name: laytime_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method specified in the charter party for calculating laytime across loading and discharge ports: reversible (combined), irreversible (separate), average, or separate calculations.

attributes.name: laytime_used_hours
attributes.description: Actual laytime hours consumed during the loading or discharge operation, calculated from Notice of Readiness (NOR) to completion of cargo operations.

attributes.name: notice_of_readiness_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vessel tendered Notice of Readiness to the port or terminal, marking the official start of laytime calculation.

attributes.name: operations_commenced_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when actual cargo loading or discharge operations began at the port or terminal.

attributes.name: operations_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when cargo loading or discharge operations were completed and the vessel was ready to depart, marking the end of laytime calculation.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the counterparty must remit payment for the agreed demurrage amount, typically specified in the charter party terms.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date when payment for the demurrage claim was received and reconciled in the financial system.

attributes.name: port_operation_type
attributes.description: Type of port operation during which demurrage occurred: loading operations, discharge operations, or both.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of petroleum product being transported during the voyage that incurred demurrage charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|natural_gas|lng|lpg|ngl|gasoline|diesel|jet_fuel|fuel_oil|petrochemicals — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal business unit, department, or individual responsible for managing and pursuing this demurrage claim.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the demurrage claim was fully settled and payment was received or agreed upon by both parties.

attributes.name: statement_of_facts_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the Statement of Facts document, which provides the official chronological record of vessel activities and time usage at the port.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation
attributes.description: References to supporting documents for the demurrage claim, including time sheets, statements of facts, NOR copies, port logs, and correspondence with the counterparty.

attributes.name: time_exceptions_hours
attributes.description: Total hours excluded from laytime calculation due to exceptions specified in the charter party (weather delays, equipment breakdown, force majeure, holidays, etc.).

attributes.name: time_exceptions_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the reasons for time exceptions, including weather events, mechanical failures, port congestion, or other force majeure circumstances.

attributes.name: vessel_imo_number
attributes.description: Unique seven-digit IMO ship identification number assigned by the International Maritime Organization for permanent vessel identification.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the vessel (tanker, LNG carrier, FPSO, or other marine transport asset) involved in the demurrage event.

products.name: pipeline_batch

attributes.name: charter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charter party agreement defining the nature of vessel hire arrangement. Voyage charter covers single voyage, time charter covers vessel hire for period, bareboat charter transfers full operational control, contract of affreightment covers multiple voyages.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the charter party contract becomes legally effective and binding on both parties. May differ from fixture date if subject to conditions precedent.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the charter party contract expires or terminates. For voyage charters, typically upon cargo discharge completion. For time charters, the end of the charter period.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: despatch_rate
attributes.description: Daily rate payable by the shipowner to the charterer when loading or discharge operations are completed before the allowed laytime expires. Typically half the demurrage rate.

attributes.description: Name of the port or terminal where the petroleum cargo will be discharged from the vessel. May include berth or jetty designation.

attributes.name: discharge_port_country

attributes.name: seal_numbers

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percentage

attributes.name: temperature_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: ullage_measurement

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: The acceptable percentage variance between nominated and measured quantities as defined in the commercial contract or industry standard, beyond which a quantity variance flag is raised.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for volume quantities: BBL (barrels), M3 (cubic meters), GAL (gallons), or L (liters).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 - Calculation of Petroleum Quantities

products.name: terminal_access_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual agreement between a terminal and a customer counterparty for storage and throughput services. It captures customer-specific capacity allocations, access rights, priority levels, tariff rate overrides, and nomination rights under terminal service agreements. Each record links one terminal to one customer counterparty with attributes that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas terminal operations, a single terminal serves multiple customer counterparties (IOCs, NOCs, traders, refiners) with contractually allocated storage capacity and throughput rights. Simultaneously, each customer counterparty typically has access agreements with multiple terminals across different geographic locations to support their supply chain network. These are formal commercial arrangements with customer-specific terms including allocated capacity, priority levels, tariff overrides, and nomination rights that cannot be stored on either the terminal or customer entity alone.

attributes.name: terminal_access_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the terminal access agreement record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terminal Access Agreement - Customer Counterparty Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer counterparty receiving terminal access rights

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the terminal providing storage and throughput services

attributes.name: access_rights_type
attributes.description: Classification of the access rights granted to the customer: dedicated (exclusive capacity), shared (pro-rata with other customers), interruptible (subject to curtailment), firm (guaranteed), or non-firm (best-effort basis). Determines priority during capacity constraints.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the terminal access agreement. Active agreements are in force; suspended agreements are temporarily inactive; expired agreements have passed their effective_until date; terminated agreements were cancelled before expiration.

attributes.name: allocated_capacity_bbl
attributes.description: Storage capacity in barrels (BBL) allocated to this customer under the terminal service agreement. Represents the customer's reserved or contracted capacity at this specific terminal.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number of the master terminal service agreement or contract document that governs this access arrangement. Links operational data to legal contract documentation.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this terminal access agreement record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Start date from which the terminal access agreement becomes active and the customer can exercise their access rights and allocated capacity.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: End date of the terminal access agreement. After this date, the customer's access rights, allocated capacity, and priority level expire unless renewed.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this terminal access agreement record.

attributes.name: minimum_throughput_commitment_bopd
attributes.description: Minimum daily throughput volume in barrels of oil per day (BOPD) that the customer has committed to move through the terminal. Used for take-or-pay provisions and capacity reservation enforcement.

attributes.name: nomination_rights
attributes.description: Defines the customer's rights to nominate volumes for loading or discharge at the terminal. Full rights allow unrestricted nominations up to allocated capacity; restricted rights require operator approval; none indicates capacity is operator-scheduled.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Customer's priority ranking for terminal access and scheduling during capacity constraints or operational disruptions. Priority_1 customers receive preferential treatment for loading/discharge scheduling and capacity allocation.

attributes.name: tariff_rate_override
attributes.description: Customer-specific tariff rate per barrel for storage and throughput services, overriding the standard published terminal tariff. Reflects negotiated commercial terms based on volume commitments or strategic relationship.

products.name: carrier_product_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Authorization/Approval between carrier and petroleum_product. It captures the carrier's qualification and approval to transport specific petroleum products with product-specific certifications, insurance coverage, handling capabilities, and performance tracking. Each record links one carrier to one petroleum_product with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas logistics operations, carriers must be individually qualified and approved to transport specific petroleum products due to varying hazmat certifications, insurance requirements, and handling capabilities. A carrier (pipeline, marine, truck, rail) can be authorized to transport multiple petroleum products (crude grades, refined fuels, petrochemicals), and each petroleum product can be transported by multiple carriers. The business actively manages these authorizations with product-specific approval dates, certification levels, insurance limits, and performance ratings.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the carrier master record

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the user who approved this carrier-product authorization. Provides audit trail for approval decisions.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the petroleum product master record

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carrier was approved to transport this specific petroleum product. Marks the beginning of the authorization period.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the carrier's authorization to transport this specific petroleum product. Tracks the lifecycle of the approval from pending through active to revoked/expired states.

attributes.name: approved_product_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of petroleum product types that the carrier is approved and qualified to transport, such as crude oil, LNG, LPG, NGL, refined products, and petrochemicals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|natural_gas|lng|lpg|ngl|gasoline|diesel|jet_fuel|fuel_oil|petrochemicals|condensate — promote to reference product] [Moved from carrier: This comma-separated list attribute in carrier is a denormalized representation of the many-to-many relationship. The proper model is to have individual authorization records for each carrier-product combination rather than a text list. This enables proper tracking of product-specific approval dates, certifications, and performance metrics.]

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carrier's authorization to transport this specific petroleum product expires and requires renewal or re-certification.

attributes.name: handling_rate_capability
attributes.description: The maximum volume or throughput rate (in barrels per day or metric tons per day) that the carrier is capable of handling for this specific petroleum product. Reflects equipment capacity, loading/unloading capabilities, and operational constraints specific to the product type.

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_level
attributes.description: The specific level of hazardous materials certification required and held by the carrier for transporting this particular petroleum product. Different products may require different certification levels based on hazard class and handling complexity.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_limit
attributes.description: The minimum insurance coverage amount required for the carrier to transport this specific petroleum product. High-value or high-risk products may require higher coverage limits than the carrier's general insurance.

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent performance review for this carrier-product combination. Used to track periodic assessments of carrier performance for specific product types.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special conditions, restrictions, or requirements specific to this carrier-product authorization (e.g., 'Approved for coastal routes only', 'Requires escort for quantities >10,000 bbl').

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating score (0.00 to 5.00) for this carrier's handling of this specific petroleum product. Tracks product-specific performance metrics such as on-time delivery, product quality maintenance, safety incidents, and compliance.

products.name: carrier_product_approval
products.description: This association product represents the approval and certification relationship between petrochemical products and transportation carriers. It captures the regulatory approval, handling certification, and performance management for each carrier-product combination. Each record links one petrochemical product to one carrier with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific approval relationship, including certification dates, hazmat endorsements, audit history, and performance ratings.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas petrochemical operations, carriers must obtain specific approvals and certifications to transport each type of petrochemical product due to varying hazmat classifications, handling requirements, and regulatory constraints. A single carrier (pipeline operator, marine shipper, trucking company) is certified to handle multiple petrochemical products (ethylene, propylene, benzene, polymers), and each petrochemical product requires multiple approved carriers to ensure supply chain resilience and competitive routing. The business actively manages these approvals as 'Carrier Product Approvals' with certification tracking, audit schedules, and performance ratings per carrier-product combination.

products.name: vessel_cargo_compatibility
products.description: This association product represents the operational approval and compatibility relationship between vessels and petroleum products. It captures vessel-product compatibility ratings, segregation capabilities, tank coating suitability, heating requirements, and vetting approval status. Each record links one vessel to one petroleum product with attributes that exist only in the context of this compatibility relationship. This is actively managed by marine operations and vetting teams to ensure safe cargo operations and regulatory compliance.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas marine operations, vessels are approved to carry multiple petroleum product types (crude grades, refined products, LNG, LPG, chemicals), and each product can be transported by multiple vessels. The business actively manages vessel-product compatibility through vetting programs, tank coating assessments, segregation capability reviews, and previous cargo history tracking. This is not a theoretical relationship but an operational necessity managed by marine operations, chartering, and vetting teams who maintain compatibility matrices to ensure safe cargo operations and regulatory compliance.

attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the vessel-product compatibility record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Vessel Cargo Compatibility - Petroleum Product Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the petroleum product master catalog

attributes.name: cargo_compatibility_rating
attributes.description: Operational approval status for carrying this specific petroleum product on this vessel. APPROVED indicates full clearance, RESTRICTED indicates conditional approval with limitations, PROHIBITED indicates vessel cannot carry this product, PENDING_REVIEW indicates vetting in progress.

attributes.name: contamination_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of contamination risk for this product on this vessel based on previous cargo history, tank cleaning effectiveness, and product sensitivity. HIGH or CRITICAL may require additional cleaning or prohibit loading.

attributes.name: segregation_capability

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements

attributes.name: tank_coating_compatibility

attributes.name: vetting_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of product-specific vetting approval. After this date, vessel requires re-inspection before carrying this product.

products.name: carrier_contract_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between a transportation carrier and a term contract. It captures carrier-specific commercial terms, volume commitments, service level agreements, and rates negotiated for transportation services under each term contract. Each record links one carrier to one term contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific carrier-contract relationship, enabling multi-carrier sourcing strategies and carrier performance management per contract.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas logistics operations, term contracts for petroleum product transportation routinely engage multiple carriers to ensure capacity redundancy, geographic coverage, and competitive pricing. Each carrier operates under carrier-specific rates, volume allocations, and service level agreements within the same master contract. Conversely, a single carrier typically provides services under multiple term contracts serving different customers, routes, or product types. This is an operational procurement pattern where logistics teams actively manage carrier engagements, track performance against contract-specific SLAs, and optimize multi-carrier sourcing strategies.

domains.name: customer
domains.description: Serves as the SSOT for all counterparty and customer identity data including IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, wholesale buyers, industrial consumers, retail distributors, and contract counterparties. Manages customer profiles, account hierarchies, credit terms, credit ratings, KYC compliance, delivery preferences, and commercial relationship classifications. Supports both B2B wholesale and downstream retail customer segments and credit risk management.

products.name: customer_counterparty
products.description: Master record for all counterparties and customers in the oil and gas value chain, including IOCs, NOCs, national refiners, independent traders, wholesale buyers, industrial consumers, retail distributors, and contract counterparties. Serves as the SSOT for counterparty identity, legal entity classification, registration details, domicile jurisdiction, tax identifiers, DUNS number, LEI (Legal Entity Identifier), credit classification, and relationship type. Supports both B2B wholesale upstream/midstream/downstream segments and retail distribution channels.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id

attributes.name: relationship_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Every customer counterparty has an assigned relationship manager (account executive/commercial manager) responsible for the commercial relationship, contract negotiations, credit monitoring, and reven

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Master data linkage for entities that are both customers and vendors (common in oil & gas for JV partners, trading houses, integrated operators). Business process: unified KYC/sanctions screening, con

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Counterparties often hold dual roles as venture partners and commercial customers. Critical for consolidated KYC, sanctions screening, credit risk assessment, and integrated relationship management ac

attributes.name: account_group_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Customer Account Group code that controls the field selection, number range, and partner functions for this counterparty in the SD and FI modules. Examples include domestic customers, export customers, one-time customers, and intercompany customers. Drives master data screen layout and business process routing.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the counterparty account. 'pending_kyc' indicates Know Your Customer (KYC) verification is in progress. 'blocked' indicates credit or compliance hold. 'suspended' indicates temporary restriction pending review. Drives order-to-cash and procure-to-pay eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Status; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; KYC/AML Regulatory Requirements

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the counterparty within the oil and gas value chain. Distinguishes International Oil Companies (IOCs), National Oil Companies (NOCs), independent traders, national refiners, wholesale buyers, industrial consumers, retail distributors, and contract counterparties. Drives commercial terms, credit policies, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IOC|NOC|independent_trader|refiner|wholesale_buyer|industrial_consumer|retail_distributor|contract_counterparty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Industry Classification; SAP S/4HANA Customer Account Group; OPEC Member Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX Section 404, COPAS record-keeping standards, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; COPAS Record Retention Standards

attributes.name: credit_classification
attributes.description: Internal credit classification of the counterparty based on external credit ratings and internal risk assessment. Drives credit limit assignment, payment terms, collateral requirements, and exposure management in oil and gas commodity trading and supply chain. Aligns with SAP Credit Management (FI-AR-CR) classifications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; COPAS Credit Risk Standards; Basel III Credit Risk Framework; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure in US Dollars (USD) for this counterparty across all outstanding transactions. Enforced in SAP Credit Management (FI-AR-CR) to control order-to-cash risk in petroleum product sales, LNG offtake, and petrochemical supply agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Credit Limit Standards; Basel III Exposure at Default

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Alphanumeric credit rating assigned by the designated credit rating agency (e.g., 'AAA', 'Baa2', 'BB+'). Used to determine counterparty creditworthiness, set credit limits, and manage financial exposure in crude oil trading, LNG offtake agreements, and downstream supply contracts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Moody's/S&P/Fitch Rating Scales; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the external credit rating agency that issued the counterparty's credit rating (e.g., Moody's, S&P, Fitch). 'internal' indicates the rating is based solely on Oil Gas's internal credit assessment model. Used alongside credit_rating to determine credit exposure limits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III External Rating Requirements; COPAS Credit Procedures

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transaction currency agreed with this counterparty (e.g., 'USD' for US Dollar, 'EUR' for Euro). Drives foreign exchange (FX) exposure management and financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration; IFRS/GAAP FX Reporting; FERC Reporting

attributes.name: customer_classification_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA customer classification code (Nielsen classification) used for statistical analysis, pricing strategy, and market segmentation of petroleum product customers. Supports downstream retail and B2B wholesale analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification; API Market Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Distribution Channel code defining how petroleum products are sold and delivered to this counterparty (e.g., wholesale, retail, direct, intercompany). Drives pricing condition determination and order management workflows in the SD module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Configuration; API Downstream Distribution Standards

attributes.name: domicile_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of legal domicile or principal place of business for the counterparty. Drives jurisdiction-specific regulatory compliance, sanctions screening, withholding tax rates, and export control requirements under OFAC and EAR.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; OFAC Sanctions List; BOEM/BSEE Jurisdiction Requirements; EPA Reporting

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for global business entity identification. Used for credit risk assessment, supplier qualification, and counterparty due diligence in oil and gas procurement and JV management.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; COPAS Counterparty Identification; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner DUNS

attributes.name: incorporation_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the legal entity was incorporated or registered. May differ from domicile country for multinational IOCs and NOCs operating through holding structures. Used for legal entity hierarchy mapping and PSA compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IFRS/GAAP Entity Domicile; Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) Jurisdiction Rules

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the default delivery and risk transfer conditions for petroleum product shipments with this counterparty. Critical for crude oil, LNG, LPG, and refined product logistics, insurance, and title transfer determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|CFR|DAP|DDP|FCA|EXW|CPT|CIP|DAT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: industry_segment
attributes.description: Oil and gas value chain segment in which the counterparty primarily operates. attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) due diligence process for this counterparty. 'verified' indicates completed and approved KYC. 'expired' indicates KYC documentation has lapsed and renewal is required. Mandatory for all counterparties under OFAC, FinCEN, and international AML regulations.

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: lei_code

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_pct
attributes.description: Default Net Revenue Interest (NRI) percentage applicable to this counterparty for revenue distribution calculations in joint venture and production sharing arrangements. Expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.750000 = 75%). Used in Quorum Land System and SAP JVA for division order processing and revenue allocation.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System Division Order Processing; SAP Joint Venture Accounting; COPAS NRI Calculation Standards; SEC Reserves Disclosure

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

attributes.name: price_group_code

attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code assigned to the child entity by a globally recognized LEI issuer. Mandatory for financial market participants under EMIR and Dodd-Frank reporting. Used for unambiguous entity identification in cross-border oil and gas trading and derivatives transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier (LEI); EMIR Reporting Requirements; Dodd-Frank Act; FERC Reporting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional business context, special conditions, or commentary related to the account hierarchy relationship (e.g., notes on corporate restructuring, merger/acquisition context, regulatory restrictions, or special commercial arrangements).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership held by the parent account in the child account (0.0000 to 100.0000). Critical for determining consolidation thresholds under IFRS 10, calculating proportionate credit exposure, and managing Working Interest (WI) and Net Revenue Interest (NRI) allocations in joint venture structures.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC Regulation S-X; COPAS Working Interest (WI) Standards

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the standard payment conditions applicable to this hierarchy relationship (e.g., 'NT30' = Net 30 days, 'NT60' = Net 60 days, 'CIA' = Cash in Advance). Drives accounts receivable aging, cash flow forecasting, and Joint Interest Billing (JIB) settlement terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Payment Terms; COPAS Joint Interest Billing (JIB) Standards; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: primary_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary transactional currency of this hierarchy relationship (e.g., USD for West Texas Intermediate (WTI) denominated contracts, EUR for European downstream operations). Used for consolidated credit exposure calculations and group-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Describes the nature of the parent-child relationship between the two accounts. 'parent_subsidiary' = majority-owned subsidiary; 'holding_affiliate' = holding company to affiliate; 'branch_office' = legal branch of parent entity; 'trading_affiliate' = trading house affiliate; 'jv_partner' = Joint Venture (JV) partner relationship; 'retail_franchise' = downstream retail franchise network. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent_subsidiary|holding_affiliate|branch_office|trading_affiliate|jv_partner|retail_franchise — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Hierarchy; JOA/PSA Industry Standards

attributes.name: sanctions_screened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account entity has been screened against applicable sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions) as part of the KYC and counterparty onboarding process (True = screened and cleared; False = not yet screened or screening failed).
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Compliance; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; FATF AML Standards

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Natural key or identifier of this hierarchy relationship record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., SAP customer hierarchy node ID, Quorum land system record ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and source systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Government-issued Tax Identification Number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) for the child entity. Required for Joint Interest Billing (JIB), royalty reporting, and regulatory tax filings. Sensitive business-confidential identifier subject to data protection controls.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Requirements; COPAS Joint Interest Billing (JIB) Standards; SOX Financial Controls; IFRS/GAAP Tax Reporting

attributes.name: voting_rights_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of voting rights held by the parent entity in the child entity. May differ from ownership percentage in cases of dual-class share structures or preference shares. Used for IFRS 10 control assessment and SEC disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SEC Regulation S-X; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Working Interest (WI) percentage held by the child account entity in joint venture operations governed by this hierarchy relationship. Represents the proportionate share of costs and revenues in Exploration and Production (E&P) operations. Used in Joint Interest Billing (JIB) and Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) cost allocation.
attributes.references: COPAS Working Interest (WI) Standards; SAP Joint Venture Accounting; SPE PRMS Framework; SEC Reserves Disclosure

products.name: delivery_point
products.description: Physical or logical delivery location associated with a customer account, including terminal name, port of loading/discharge, pipeline interconnect point, rack location, refinery gate, storage facility, geographic coordinates, country, region, delivery mode (pipeline, tanker, truck, rail), UNLOCODE, and operational status. Supports logistics scheduling, nomination management, and product delivery execution for crude oil, LNG, LPG, NGL, and refined product customers.

attributes.name: delivery_point_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the delivery point record. Primary key for the delivery_point data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a physical or logical delivery location managed by the business.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Delivery points (custody transfer meters, pipeline interconnects, terminals) are often lease-specific or serve production from specific leases. Critical for nomination scheduling, volume allocation, a

attributes.name: operations_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Each delivery point (terminal, pipeline interconnect, loading facility) has an assigned operations manager responsible for logistics coordination, HSE compliance, custody transfer, and daily operation

attributes.name: operator_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Delivery points (terminals, pipelines) are typically operated by third-party vendors. Business process: tariff management, custody transfer agreements, logistics service procurement, operator performa

attributes.name: address_line
attributes.description: Street address or physical location description of the delivery point facility. Classified as confidential organizational contact data. Used for logistics dispatch, trucking directions, and regulatory permit filings.

attributes.name: berth_number
attributes.description: Specific berth or jetty number at a port or marine terminal delivery point. Used for vessel scheduling, port authority coordination, and cargo nomination documentation. Applicable to tanker, LNG, and LPG delivery modes.
attributes.references: IMO Maritime Standards; UNECE LOCODE; API RP 1165

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the delivery point is located. Used for address resolution, logistics routing, and regulatory permit identification.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the delivery point is physically located (e.g., USA, GBR, NLD, SAU). Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination, export/import compliance, and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations; EPA Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery point record was first created in the system of record. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); ISO 55001 Asset Management; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: custody_transfer_point
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery point is a designated custody transfer point where title and measurement responsibility passes between parties. Custody transfer points require API MPMS-compliant metering, sampling, and quality certification. Critical for revenue accounting and joint interest billing (JIB).
attributes.references: API MPMS; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP SD Module

attributes.name: customs_port_code
attributes.description: Official customs authority port or entry point code assigned to this delivery location for import/export declaration purposes. Required for international crude oil, LNG, and refined product shipments. Aligns with CBP (U.S. Customs and Border Protection) or equivalent national customs authority codes.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP); UNECE Trade Facilitation; EPA Export Regulations

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which this delivery point was or is scheduled to be permanently decommissioned and removed from service. Nullable for active locations. Used for asset lifecycle management, contract termination planning, and regulatory P&A (Plug and Abandonment) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55001 Asset Management; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; API RP 1165

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Primary transportation mode used to deliver product at this delivery point (pipeline, tanker, truck, rail, or barge). Determines applicable logistics, tariff, and scheduling rules. Supports multi-modal delivery planning for crude oil, LNG, LPG, NGL, and refined products.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; FERC Tariff Regulations; API RP 1165

attributes.name: delivery_point_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique business identifier for the delivery point (e.g., terminal code, rack code, pipeline interconnect ID). Used in nominations, scheduling, and logistics communications with counterparties and operators. Aligns with SAP SD delivery location codes and Avocet Production Operations location identifiers.

attributes.name: delivery_point_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the delivery point (e.g., 'Houston Ship Channel Terminal', 'Cushing Pipeline Interconnect', 'Rotterdam LNG Discharge Berth 3'). Used in commercial documents, logistics scheduling, and customer-facing communications.

attributes.name: delivery_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery point by facility type. Drives logistics scheduling rules, product compatibility checks, and nomination workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: terminal|pipeline_interconnect|rack|refinery_gate|storage_facility|port_berth|fpso_offloading|lng_regasification|rail_siding|truck_loading — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 1165; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this delivery point became or becomes commercially and operationally active. Used for contract validity checks, nomination eligibility, and historical reporting. Aligns with SAP SD validity period management.
attributes.references: SAP SD Module; FERC Tariff Regulations; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Environmental operating permit number issued by the relevant regulatory authority (EPA, state environmental agency, or equivalent) for this delivery point facility. Required for HSE compliance tracking and regulatory reporting in Enablon HSE Management.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Regulations; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: h2s_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery point handles Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S)-bearing streams. H2S service locations require specialized safety equipment, personnel training, and HSE protocols per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 Process Safety Management and API RP 55.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 Process Safety Management; API RP 55; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or internal safety inspection conducted at this delivery point. Used for HSE compliance tracking, maintenance scheduling in Maximo Asset Management, and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery point in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, offshore/onshore classification, proximity analysis, and logistics route optimization. Supports integration with GIS systems.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; API RP 1165; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations

attributes.name: loading_arm_count
attributes.description: Number of loading or discharge arms available at the delivery point. Determines simultaneous loading capacity and influences scheduling of concurrent cargo operations (SIMOPS). Applicable to marine terminals, rack locations, and pipeline interconnects.
attributes.references: API RP 1165; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery point in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used for GIS mapping, offshore/onshore classification, proximity analysis, and logistics route optimization.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; API RP 1165; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations

attributes.name: max_vessel_dwt
attributes.description: Maximum vessel size in Deadweight Tonnes (DWT) that can be accommodated at this marine delivery point. Used for vessel compatibility screening during cargo scheduling and nomination management for crude oil and LNG tanker deliveries.
attributes.references: IMO Maritime Standards; API RP 1165; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations

attributes.name: metering_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the fiscal or allocation metering system installed at this delivery point, as registered in the OSIsoft PI System or SCADA/DCS. Used to link delivery volumes to measurement data for custody transfer, allocation, and revenue accounting.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 5 (Metering); OSIsoft PI System; FERC Metering Requirements

attributes.name: min_vessel_dwt
attributes.description: Minimum vessel size in Deadweight Tonnes (DWT) required to safely operate at this marine delivery point. Used alongside max_vessel_dwt for vessel compatibility screening during cargo scheduling.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory regulatory or internal safety inspection at this delivery point. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling in Maximo Asset Management and HSE compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: nomination_lead_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days in advance that a delivery nomination must be submitted for this delivery point. Drives nomination management workflows in Avocet Production Operations and SAP SD scheduling. Ensures operational readiness and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FERC Natural Gas Regulations; API RP 1165; Avocet Production Operations

attributes.name: norm_risk_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM) Risk Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery point has identified Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM) risk associated with produced water, scale, or sludge handling. NORM-flagged locations require specialized waste management, personnel monitoring, and regulatory reporting per EPA and state radiation control programs.
attributes.references: EPA NORM Regulations; OSHA Radiation Safety Standards; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: offshore_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivery point is located offshore (True) or onshore (False). Offshore delivery points are subject to BSEE/BOEM regulatory oversight, additional HSE requirements, and FPSO/marine logistics protocols.
attributes.references: BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations; API RP 2SK

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Description of the delivery point's operational hours (e.g., '24/7', 'Mon-Fri 06:00-22:00 Local', 'Daylight hours only'). Used for logistics scheduling, nomination window management, and customer delivery planning.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the delivery point. Controls whether the location is available for nomination and scheduling. 'suspended' indicates temporary unavailability; 'decommissioned' indicates permanent retirement from service.

attributes.name: pipeline_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the pipeline system or network to which this delivery point is connected (e.g., 'Colonial Pipeline', 'Trans-Alaska Pipeline System'). Applicable for pipeline_interconnect and terminal delivery point types. Used for tariff determination and FERC/PHMSA regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Natural Gas Pipeline Regulations; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the delivery point location. Used for logistics routing, tax jurisdiction determination, and regulatory compliance filings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Business-defined geographic region or operating area in which the delivery point is located (e.g., 'Gulf Coast', 'North Sea', 'Middle East', 'Asia Pacific'). Used for regional logistics planning, commercial reporting, and supply chain segmentation.
attributes.references: OPEC Regional Classification; API District Codes

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction governing this delivery point (e.g., 'FERC', 'BSEE', 'EPA Region 6', 'PHMSA', 'UK HSE'). Determines applicable safety, environmental, and operational compliance requirements. Used for regulatory reporting and permit management.
attributes.references: FERC Natural Gas Regulations; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; EPA Environmental Regulations; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative subdivision where the delivery point is located. Required for regulatory jurisdiction mapping (e.g., state environmental permits, PHMSA state pipeline safety programs) and tax/royalty reporting.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; EPA Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: storage_capacity_bbl
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the delivery point facility expressed in barrels (BBL). Principal quantitative fact for storage facilities, terminals, and FPSOs. Used for inventory planning, nomination management, and capacity allocation. Applicable to crude oil, NGL, LPG, and refined product locations.
attributes.references: API MPMS (Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards); API RP 1165

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: Applicable pipeline or terminal tariff code governing the transportation or throughput charges at this delivery point. Used for freight cost calculation, FERC tariff compliance, and SAP SD pricing condition determination.
attributes.references: FERC Tariff Regulations; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; SAP SD Module

attributes.name: throughput_capacity_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Throughput Capacity (Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Maximum throughput or loading/discharge rate of the delivery point expressed in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). Used for logistics scheduling, nomination management, and capacity constraint modeling. Applicable to terminals, racks, pipeline interconnects, and refinery gates.
attributes.references: API MPMS; FERC Tariff Regulations; API RP 1165

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the delivery point location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'Europe/Amsterdam', 'Asia/Riyadh'). Used to correctly interpret operating hours, nomination deadlines, and delivery timestamps in logistics and scheduling systems.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; FERC Natural Gas Regulations

attributes.name: unlocode
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port, terminal, or logistics location (e.g., USGLS for Galveston, NLRTM for Rotterdam). Mandatory for international trade documentation, LNG/LPG cargo nominations, and customs declarations. Aligns with UNECE Trade Facilitation standards.
attributes.references: UNECE LOCODE; FERC Natural Gas Regulations; IMO Maritime Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery point record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); NIST Cybersecurity Framework; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: water_depth_m
attributes.description: Water depth in metres at the offshore delivery point location. Applicable only to offshore berths, FPSO offloading points, and subsea pipeline interconnects. Used for vessel compatibility assessment and marine logistics planning.
attributes.references: BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations; BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; IMO Maritime Standards

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Credit risk profile for a counterparty or account, capturing credit limit (USD), credit rating (internal and external — S&P, Moody's, Fitch), credit rating date, credit watch status, collateral type (letter of credit, parent guarantee, prepayment), collateral amount, credit utilization, days sales outstanding (DSO), payment history score, credit review frequency, next review date, credit analyst, and credit hold flag. Supports credit risk management for crude oil trading, LNG offtake, and refined product wholesale transactions.

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the credit risk profile record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial account associated with this credit profile, supporting account hierarchy structures for multi-entity counterparties such as parent-subsidiary trading groups.

attributes.name: credit_limit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.credit_limit. Business justification: Links customer credit profiles to commercial credit limits for integrated credit risk management. Required for credit utilization monitoring, exposure reporting, and credit committee reviews that span

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty or customer entity for whom this credit profile is maintained. Links to the customer master record covering IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, wholesale buyers, and industrial consumers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: customer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Credit profile segment string should be a FK reference to the segment table. This enables consistent segmentation classification and allows joining to get full segment details. The segment string beco

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Credit provisions and allowances for doubtful accounts must post to specific GL accounts (bad debt expense, allowance accounts). Required for financial statement preparation and credit risk reporting.

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Credit assessment of venture partners for commercial exposure (equity crude sales, product supply). Required for partner credit risk management, trade receivables exposure tracking, credit limit setti

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit limit and terms were formally approved by the credit analyst or credit committee. Establishes the effective start of the current credit terms for this counterparty.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; SOX Section 404; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: collateral_amount_usd
attributes.description: Monetary value in US Dollars of the collateral or credit support instrument currently held against this counterparty's credit exposure. For letters of credit, this is the LC face value; for prepayments, the amount held on account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; UCP 600; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: collateral_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current collateral instrument (e.g., letter of credit, parent guarantee) expires. Critical for proactive renewal management to avoid unsecured exposure gaps in crude oil and LNG trading operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; UCP 600 (Letter of Credit); COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of credit support or collateral arrangement securing the counterparty's credit exposure. 'letter_of_credit' = bank-issued LC; 'parent_guarantee' = corporate guarantee from parent entity; 'prepayment' = advance payment required; 'cash_deposit' = cash margin held; 'surety_bond' = third-party bond; 'none' = unsecured. Common in crude oil trading and LNG offtake agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; UCP 600 (Letter of Credit); COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty by business role in the oil and gas value chain. IOC (International Oil Company), NOC (National Oil Company), refiner, trader, wholesale buyer, industrial consumer, or retail distributor. Drives credit policy application and risk tier assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IOC|NOC|refiner|trader|wholesale_buyer|industrial_consumer|retail_distributor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 11S; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Audit Trail; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: credit_analyst
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the credit analyst responsible for maintaining and reviewing this credit profile. Provides accountability and audit trail for credit decisions on crude oil trading, LNG offtake, and refined product wholesale accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; SOX Section 404; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: credit_committee_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current credit limit and terms have been formally approved by the credit committee, as required for counterparties above the credit analyst's delegated authority threshold. True = committee-approved; False = within analyst authority or pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; SOX Section 404; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: credit_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Current total outstanding credit exposure in US Dollars, representing the sum of open invoices, unconfirmed deliveries, and mark-to-market positions for crude oil, LNG, and refined product transactions with this counterparty.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is currently on credit hold, blocking new crude oil, LNG, or refined product shipments and transactions until the hold is resolved. True = hold active; False = no hold. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA SD order management to block delivery creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the active credit hold. 'overdue_payment' = outstanding invoices past due; 'limit_exceeded' = exposure exceeds approved limit; 'rating_downgrade' = credit rating fell below threshold; 'kyc_failure' = KYC compliance issue; 'sanctions_flag' = OFAC/sanctions screening hit; 'manual_hold' = credit analyst discretionary hold. Null when credit_hold_flag is False.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; FATF KYC Guidelines

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure in US Dollars for this counterparty across all crude oil trading, LNG offtake, and refined product wholesale transactions. Set by the credit committee and reviewed periodically. Denominated in USD as the functional currency for international petroleum transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credit analyst commentary, special conditions, exceptions, or contextual information relevant to the credit profile. May include notes on collateral negotiations, payment dispute history, or market intelligence affecting creditworthiness.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this counterparty's credit profile is formally reviewed and reaffirmed by the credit risk team. 'event_triggered' indicates review is initiated by a specific event (e.g., rating downgrade, payment default, material contract change) rather than a fixed schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Ratio of current credit exposure to approved credit limit, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 75.5000 = 75.5%). Used to monitor proximity to credit limit thresholds and trigger review or hold actions in crude oil and refined product trading operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: credit_watch_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is on credit watch and the directional outlook. 'none' = no watch; 'positive' = potential upgrade; 'negative' = potential downgrade; 'developing' = uncertain direction. Mirrors external agency watch terminology and is applied to both internal and external ratings.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings CreditWatch Methodology; Moody's Review Methodology; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the credit limit and exposure amounts (typically USD for international petroleum transactions, but may be EUR, GBP, or local currency for specific regional contracts).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: dso_days
attributes.description: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) — the average number of days this counterparty takes to pay invoices, calculated over the trailing review period. A key credit risk indicator for crude oil, LNG, and refined product wholesale transactions. Higher DSO indicates slower payment behavior.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Analytics

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current credit terms (limit, rating, collateral) are binding and applicable to transactions with this counterparty. Supports temporal validity tracking for credit agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date until which the current credit terms are valid. Null for open-ended credit arrangements. When populated, triggers renewal workflow before expiry to avoid lapse in credit coverage for active crude oil and LNG trading counterparties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: external_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent external credit rating (S&P, Moody's, or Fitch) was issued or last confirmed. Used to assess rating currency and trigger re-evaluation when ratings are stale relative to credit review policy.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management

attributes.name: fitch_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by Fitch Ratings for the counterparty (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-, BB, CCC). Provides a third-agency perspective for credit risk triangulation on significant crude oil trading and LNG offtake counterparties.
attributes.references: Fitch Ratings Methodology; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: Proprietary internal credit rating assigned by the company's credit risk team, reflecting the counterparty's creditworthiness based on financial analysis, payment history, and industry position. Uses a letter-grade scale (e.g., AAA, AA+, BB-) aligned with internal credit policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Section 404; IFRS 9

attributes.name: internal_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the internal credit rating was last assigned or reaffirmed by the credit risk team. Drives the credit review cycle and next review date calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: kyc_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current KYC verification expires and renewal is required. Drives compliance workflow alerts to ensure continuous KYC coverage for active crude oil, LNG, and refined product trading counterparties.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; FinCEN AML Guidelines

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance status for this counterparty. 'verified' = KYC checks passed and current; 'pending' = KYC in progress; 'expired' = KYC verification has lapsed and renewal is required; 'failed' = KYC checks failed; 'not_required' = exempt per policy. Mandatory for all trading counterparties under FATF and OFAC compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; FinCEN AML Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal credit review was completed and the credit profile was last reaffirmed or updated by the credit analyst or credit committee.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: moodys_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by Moody's Investors Service for the counterparty (e.g., Aaa, Aa1, Baa2, Ba3, Caa1). Used alongside S&P and Fitch ratings for comprehensive external credit assessment of major trading counterparties.
attributes.references: Moody's Rating Methodology; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal credit review of this counterparty. Calculated from last_review_date and credit_review_frequency. Used to drive workflow alerts in SAP S/4HANA and credit management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_history_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (typically 0–100) reflecting the counterparty's historical payment behavior, incorporating on-time payment rate, frequency of late payments, and dispute history across crude oil, LNG, and refined product transactions. Higher score indicates better payment performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the credit period and discount structure for this counterparty (e.g., NT30 = net 30 days, NT60 = net 60 days). Governs invoice due date calculation for crude oil liftings, LNG cargo invoices, and refined product deliveries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Payment Terms; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: profile_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the credit profile, used in credit review correspondence, JIB (Joint Interest Billing) documentation, and counterparty communications. Format: CP- followed by 6–12 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit profile record. 'active' indicates the profile is in force; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold; 'under_review' indicates a scheduled or triggered reassessment; 'closed' indicates the counterparty relationship has ended; 'pending_approval' indicates awaiting credit committee sign-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Internal risk tier classification for the counterparty, used to apply differentiated credit policies, collateral requirements, and monitoring intensity. Tier 1 = lowest risk (investment grade, strong payment history); Tier 4 = highest risk (sub-investment grade, poor payment history or limited financial information).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed against OFAC SDN, EU, and UN sanctions lists. Used to ensure screening currency and compliance with regulatory requirements for international petroleum trading.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Sanctions Regulations; UN Security Council Sanctions

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent OFAC and international sanctions screening for this counterparty. 'clear' = no matches; 'flagged' = potential match requiring review; 'under_review' = compliance team investigating; 'blocked' = confirmed sanctions match, all transactions prohibited.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Sanctions Regulations; UN Security Council Sanctions; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: sp_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by S&P Global Ratings for the counterparty (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-, BB, CCC). Used to supplement internal ratings for large IOC, NOC, and refiner counterparties in crude oil and LNG offtake agreements. Null if no S&P rating exists.
attributes.references: S&P Global Ratings Methodology; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credit profile record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Audit Trail; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

products.name: credit_event
products.description: Transactional record of credit-related events affecting a counterparty's credit profile, including credit limit changes, credit rating downgrades/upgrades, collateral calls, credit holds, credit releases, payment defaults, and credit review completions. Captures event type, event date, previous value, new value, triggering reason, approving authority, and associated exposure amount. Provides full audit trail for credit risk management and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: credit_event_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each credit event record. Primary key for the credit_event data product in the customer domain.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: The employee identifier of the individual who approved this credit event in the system of record. Provides a traceable link to the human approver for SOX audit purposes. Null for system-automated events.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: credit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific credit account or credit facility associated with this event. A customer may have multiple credit accounts across different business lines (e.g., crude trading, LNG, refined products).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management (FI-AR-CR); COPAS Standards

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty or customer whose credit profile is affected by this event. Links to the master customer record for IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, wholesale buyers, or industrial consumers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Customer Master; COPAS JIB Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Credit limit changes, payment defaults, and collateral postings trigger journal entries to specific GL accounts. Audit trail requirement for credit risk accounting and SOX controls.

attributes.name: reversed_event_credit_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original credit event that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal events for SOX compliance and credit history reconstruction.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Credit events involving venture partners as customers require integrated monitoring. Essential for partner credit event tracking, default risk assessment, cross-default provisions, and coordinated cre

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the credit event was formally approved by the designated approving authority. Distinct from event_timestamp (when the event occurred) and created_timestamp (when the record was created). Critical for SOX audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: The name or role of the individual, committee, or system that authorized this credit event. Examples: 'Credit Risk Committee', 'VP Credit Risk', 'Automated Credit Engine', 'CFO'. Required for SOX compliance to establish accountability for credit decisions affecting financial exposure.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: automated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit event was generated automatically by the credit management system (True) or was manually initiated by a credit analyst or committee (False). Supports audit trail analysis and system performance monitoring for automated credit controls in SAP FI Credit Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The internal business unit or division of Oil Gas that owns the credit relationship and is responsible for managing this credit event (e.g., 'Crude Trading', 'LNG Marketing', 'Refined Products', 'Petrochemicals', 'E&P Joint Ventures'). Used for credit risk reporting by segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of collateral demanded, posted, or released in connection with this credit event. Applicable for COLLATERAL_CALL and COLLATERAL_RELEASE event types. Includes letters of credit, bank guarantees, cash deposits, or parent company guarantees used to secure credit exposure in oil and gas trading.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collateral instrument associated with this credit event. LETTER_OF_CREDIT: documentary credit from a bank; BANK_GUARANTEE: unconditional bank guarantee; CASH_DEPOSIT: cash held as security; PARENT_GUARANTEE: guarantee from parent company of counterparty; PREPAYMENT: advance payment securing future deliveries. Null for non-collateral events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9; UCP 600 (Letters of Credit); COPAS Standards

attributes.name: contract_reference
