attributes.description: The reference number of the underlying commercial contract (e.g., crude oil sale agreement, LNG SPA, refined products supply contract, PSA, JOA) associated with this credit event. Provides traceability from the credit event back to the originating commercial agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; COPAS JOA Standards; API RP standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the counterparty's domicile or the jurisdiction governing the credit relationship. Used for country risk assessment, regulatory reporting, and sanctions screening in cross-border oil and gas transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC Sanctions Regulations; FATF AML Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this credit event record was first created in the system. Serves as the record audit creation timestamp for data lineage, SOX compliance, and lakehouse silver layer audit trail. Distinct from event_timestamp (when the business event occurred).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI; ISO 8601

attributes.name: credit_limit_new
attributes.description: The numeric credit limit in the designated currency that becomes effective after this event. Populated specifically for CREDIT_LIMIT_CHANGE events. Null for non-limit events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9; COPAS Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: credit_limit_previous
attributes.description: The numeric credit limit in the designated currency that was in place before this event. Populated specifically for CREDIT_LIMIT_CHANGE events to enable quantitative analysis of limit movements. Null for non-limit events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9; COPAS Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary amounts in this credit event (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro, GBP for British Pound). Supports multi-currency credit management for international counterparties in crude oil, LNG, and refined products trading.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the overdue payment has exceeded its contractual due date at the time of this credit event. Used for aging analysis, IFRS 9 expected credit loss staging (Stage 1/2/3), and credit risk reporting. Null for non-payment events.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments (Stages 1/2/3); SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the credit event takes effect and the new credit terms or conditions become operative. May differ from event_timestamp when events are backdated or scheduled for future activation (e.g., a credit limit change approved today but effective at month-end).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9; COPAS JIB Standards

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the credit event, formatted as CE-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and SOX compliance documentation to uniquely reference a specific credit action.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit event record. PENDING: event initiated but awaiting approval; ACTIVE: event is in effect; COMPLETED: event has been fully processed and closed; REVERSED: event was reversed due to error or dispute; CANCELLED: event was cancelled before taking effect.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the credit event occurred in the real world (e.g., when the credit hold was placed, when the rating downgrade was confirmed, when the payment default was declared). This is the principal business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit-related event that occurred. Drives downstream workflow and reporting. CREDIT_LIMIT_CHANGE: adjustment to approved credit limit; RATING_CHANGE: upgrade or downgrade of internal/external credit rating; COLLATERAL_CALL: demand for additional collateral; CREDIT_HOLD: suspension of credit facility; CREDIT_RELEASE: reinstatement of credit facility; PAYMENT_DEFAULT: counterparty failure to pay within contractual terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CREDIT_LIMIT_CHANGE|RATING_CHANGE|COLLATERAL_CALL|CREDIT_HOLD|CREDIT_RELEASE|PAYMENT_DEFAULT|CREDIT_REVIEW_COMPLETED|CREDIT_WATCH|COVENANT_BREACH|MARGIN_CALL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit event condition expires or is scheduled for review. Applicable for temporary credit holds, collateral calls with deadlines, or time-limited credit limit changes. Null for permanent events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: exposure_amount
attributes.description: The total outstanding credit exposure to the counterparty at the time of this credit event, expressed in the event currency. Represents the sum of open invoices, in-transit shipments, and mark-to-market derivatives exposure. Critical for credit risk management and IFRS 9 expected credit loss calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; COPAS Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty's Know Your Customer (KYC) verification was current and valid at the time of this credit event. A value of True confirms KYC compliance; False indicates KYC was expired or incomplete, which may have contributed to a credit hold or review.
attributes.references: FATF AML/KYC Guidelines; OFAC Sanctions; SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The updated value of the credit attribute after this event is applied. Stores the after-state for audit trail purposes. For CREDIT_LIMIT_CHANGE, this is the new limit amount as a string; for RATING_CHANGE, this is the new rating code (e.g., 'BB-'); for CREDIT_HOLD, this is the new status. Stored as STRING to accommodate heterogeneous event types.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, context, or instructions related to this credit event. May include analyst observations, counterparty communications summary, escalation notes, or remediation actions. Supports credit review documentation and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: payment_default_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the overdue or defaulted payment that triggered a PAYMENT_DEFAULT credit event. Represents the outstanding invoice amount not paid within contractual terms. Null for non-default events.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; COPAS JIB Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: The prior value of the credit attribute before this event was applied. Stores the before-state for audit trail purposes. For CREDIT_LIMIT_CHANGE, this is the prior limit amount as a string; for RATING_CHANGE, this is the prior rating code (e.g., 'BBB+'); for CREDIT_HOLD, this is the prior status. Stored as STRING to accommodate heterogeneous event types.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: rating_agency
attributes.description: The source of the credit rating referenced in this event. INTERNAL: proprietary internal credit scoring model; SP: S&P Global Ratings; MOODYS: Moody's Investors Service; FITCH: Fitch Ratings; DBRS: DBRS Morningstar. Applicable for RATING_CHANGE events. Null for non-rating events.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: rating_new
attributes.description: The credit rating code assigned to the counterparty after this rating change event (e.g., 'BB+', 'Ba1', 'BBB-'). Follows the rating scale of the designated rating_agency. Null for non-rating events.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; S&P/Moody's/Fitch Rating Scales

attributes.name: rating_previous
attributes.description: The credit rating code assigned to the counterparty before this rating change event (e.g., 'BBB+', 'Baa1', 'A-'). Follows the rating scale of the designated rating_agency. Null for non-rating events.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; S&P/Moody's/Fitch Rating Scales

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit event has been reversed (True) due to error, dispute resolution, or system correction. When True, the reversed_event_id field identifies the original event being reversed. Supports SOX audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which the next credit review must be completed following this event. Drives credit review workflow and ensures periodic reassessment of counterparty creditworthiness in accordance with credit policy. Particularly important after CREDIT_HOLD or RATING_CHANGE events.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IFRS 9; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty was screened against applicable sanctions lists (OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions) at the time of this credit event. Required for regulatory compliance in international oil and gas trading operations.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Regulations; EU Sanctions Regulations; UN Security Council Sanctions; FATF Guidelines

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The document number in the originating source system (e.g., SAP FI document number, trading system transaction ID) that corresponds to this credit event. Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Management; SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system that generated or recorded this credit event. SAP_FI: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting Credit Management module; MANUAL: manually entered by credit analyst; TRADING_SYSTEM: generated by commodity trading and risk management system; EXTERNAL_FEED: received from external credit bureau or rating agency data feed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: trigger_category
attributes.description: Structured classification of the root cause category that triggered this credit event. Enables trend analysis and portfolio-level credit risk reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PAYMENT_BEHAVIOR|EXTERNAL_RATING|FINANCIAL_DETERIORATION|MARKET_CONDITIONS|PERIODIC_REVIEW|COVENANT_BREACH|REGULATORY|COUNTERPARTY_REQUEST|COLLATERAL_SHORTFALL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the business reason or triggering condition that caused this credit event. Examples include: 'Counterparty missed payment on crude oil invoice #INV-2024-001234', 'External rating downgrade by S&P from BBB to BB+', 'Commodity price volatility increased mark-to-market exposure beyond threshold', 'Annual credit review completed'. Required for SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this credit event record was last modified in the system. Tracks subsequent updates such as status changes, approval completions, or reversal processing. Required for data lineage and SOX audit trail in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COPAS Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI; ISO 8601

products.name: kyc_record
products.description: Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance record for each counterparty, capturing KYC status, verification date, KYC tier (enhanced due diligence, standard, simplified), beneficial ownership disclosure, sanctions screening result (OFAC, EU, UN), politically exposed person (PEP) flag, anti-money laundering (AML) risk rating, document collection status, KYC expiry date, compliance officer, and next review date. Mandatory for all trading counterparties under FATF, OFAC, and internal compliance frameworks.

attributes.name: kyc_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the KYC compliance record. Primary key for the kyc_record data product in the customer domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC Compliance Framework; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.commercial_counterparty. Business justification: KYC compliance tracking requires linking customer KYC records to commercial trading counterparties. Essential for regulatory reporting, trading eligibility verification, and ensuring commercial transa

attributes.name: primary_kyc_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance officer responsible for approving, maintaining, and periodically reviewing this KYC record. The compliance officer is accountable for the accuracy and completeness of the KYC file under internal governance and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; SOX Section 302; Internal Compliance Governance Policy

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Venture partners acting as customers require KYC verification for commercial transactions. Essential for consolidated compliance management, regulatory screening of partner-customers, AML/sanctions co

attributes.name: adverse_media_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse media screening has identified negative news, regulatory actions, legal proceedings, or reputational risk associated with the counterparty or its beneficial owners. Adverse media findings may trigger enhanced due diligence or relationship termination.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal Adverse Media Screening Policy; Wolfsberg Group AML Principles

attributes.name: adverse_media_review_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which adverse media screening was conducted for this counterparty. Adverse media screening must be refreshed periodically and upon any material risk event or sanctions alert.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal Adverse Media Screening Policy; Wolfsberg Group AML Principles

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk rating assigned to the counterparty based on a composite assessment of jurisdiction risk, business type, transaction patterns, PEP status, and sanctions exposure. Determines monitoring frequency and trading limits.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; EU AMLD4; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); Internal AML Risk Policy

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC record received final compliance approval, authorizing the counterparty for trading and commercial engagement. Distinct from verification_date which marks completion of the verification process.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Approval Workflow Policy

attributes.name: beneficial_ownership_disclosed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty has fully disclosed its ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) holding 25% or more ownership interest, as required under FATF Recommendation 24 and FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule. Mandatory for all trading counterparties.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 24; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule 31 CFR 1010.230; EU AMLD4 Article 30

attributes.name: counterparty_legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the counterparty as recorded in official corporate documents and used for KYC identity verification. Applies to IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, wholesale buyers, and other commercial counterparties.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; OFAC Compliance Framework; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty by business role in the oil and gas value chain. Distinguishes between International Oil Companies (IOCs), National Oil Companies (NOCs), refiners, traders, wholesale buyers, industrial consumers, retail distributors, and contract counterparties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IOC|NOC|refiner|trader|wholesale_buyer|industrial_consumer|retail_distributor|contract_counterparty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; API Industry Classification Standards; Internal Customer Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the counterparty is legally incorporated or registered. Used for sanctions screening, OFAC/EU/UN list matching, and jurisdictional risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; OFAC Compliance Framework; FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions List; EU AMLD4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KYC record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail anchor for the record's lifecycle and supports SOX compliance audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Internal Data Governance Audit Policy

attributes.name: credit_risk_linked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KYC record has been linked to an active credit risk assessment and credit limit in the credit management system. KYC approval is a prerequisite for credit limit assignment for trading counterparties.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Risk Policy; COPAS Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: document_collection_status
attributes.description: Status of the collection of required KYC documentation from the counterparty, including certificate of incorporation, articles of association, beneficial ownership declarations, financial statements, and authorized signatory lists. Incomplete documentation blocks trading approval.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; Internal KYC Document Checklist Policy

attributes.name: document_expiry_date
attributes.description: Earliest expiry date among the key KYC documents collected for this counterparty (e.g., certificate of good standing, trade license). When any document expires, the document_collection_status must be updated and renewal initiated.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Document Management Policy

attributes.name: eu_sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of screening the counterparty against the European Union consolidated sanctions list. Mandatory for all EU-jurisdiction trading activities and European counterparties. A confirmed match prohibits transactions under EU law.
attributes.references: EU Consolidated Sanctions List; EU Regulation 2580/2001; EU AMLD4; Internal Sanctions Compliance Policy

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current KYC record expires and a renewal review is required. Determined by KYC tier: Enhanced Due Diligence records typically expire annually, Standard every two years, Simplified every three years per internal compliance policy.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Renewal Policy; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: fatf_framework_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Framework Version
attributes.description: Version of the FATF Recommendations framework under which this KYC record was prepared and assessed (e.g., FATF 2012 Revised Recommendations, FATF 2023 Update). Ensures traceability of compliance assessments to the applicable regulatory standard version.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations (2012, as revised); Internal Compliance Framework Versioning Policy

attributes.name: jurisdiction_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification of the counterparty's country of incorporation based on FATF grey/black lists, OFAC sanctioned country lists, and internal country risk policy. Drives KYC tier assignment and enhanced due diligence requirements.
attributes.references: FATF High-Risk Jurisdictions; OFAC Sanctioned Countries List; EU High-Risk Third Countries List

attributes.name: kyc_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this KYC compliance record, used for audit trails, regulatory submissions, and compliance officer tracking. Format: KYC- followed by alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; OFAC Compliance Framework; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KYC compliance record indicating whether the counterparty has passed, is under review, or has failed the KYC process. Drives trading eligibility and credit decisions.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; OFAC Compliance Framework; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: kyc_tier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Due Diligence Tier
attributes.description: Classification of the level of due diligence applied to this counterparty. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) applies to high-risk counterparties such as state-owned NOCs, PEPs, or entities in high-risk jurisdictions. Standard applies to typical IOC/trading counterparties. Simplified applies to low-risk, regulated entities.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FATF Recommendation 19; EU 4th Anti-Money Laundering Directive (AMLD4); FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent periodic KYC review was completed. Distinct from verification_date (initial verification) and next_review_date (scheduled future review). Used to track review cadence compliance and identify overdue reviews.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Periodic Review Policy

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic KYC review. May differ from expiry_date if an interim review is triggered by a risk event, sanctions alert, or change in counterparty ownership structure.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Periodic Review Policy; OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: ofac_screening_result
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Sanctions Screening Result
attributes.description: Result of screening the counterparty against the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and Blocked Persons List. A confirmed match prohibits all transactions. Potential matches require compliance officer review.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; 31 CFR Parts 500-598; Executive Orders on Sanctions; Internal Sanctions Compliance Policy

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the counterparty was first onboarded into the KYC compliance program. Represents the start of the commercial relationship from a compliance perspective and anchors the KYC lifecycle timeline.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; Internal Counterparty Onboarding Policy

attributes.name: pep_category
attributes.description: Specific category of PEP classification when pep_flag is true. Distinguishes between domestic PEPs (e.g., government ministers), foreign PEPs (e.g., heads of state), international organization PEPs, close associates, and family members. Relevant for NOC counterparties with government-affiliated executives.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12; EU AMLD4 Article 3(9); FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty or any of its beneficial owners is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) — a current or former senior government official, state-owned enterprise executive, or close associate. PEP status mandates Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) per FATF Recommendation 12.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12; EU AMLD4 Article 20; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for KYC rejection when kyc_status is 'rejected'. Documents the specific compliance deficiency, sanctions match, or documentation failure that resulted in rejection. Required for audit trail and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Rejection Documentation Policy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: review_trigger
attributes.description: Reason that initiated the most recent KYC review. Distinguishes between scheduled periodic reviews and event-driven reviews triggered by sanctions alerts, changes in beneficial ownership, adverse media findings, risk escalations, or regulatory requests.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; Internal KYC Event-Driven Review Policy; OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric composite risk score (0.00–100.00) calculated from the weighted combination of jurisdiction risk, AML risk rating, PEP status, sanctions exposure, adverse media findings, and beneficial ownership complexity. Higher scores indicate greater compliance risk. Used to prioritize enhanced due diligence and monitoring resources.
attributes.references: FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; Internal KYC Risk Scoring Methodology; Wolfsberg Group AML Principles

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the counterparty was screened against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists. Sanctions screening must be refreshed at defined intervals and upon any material change in counterparty ownership or jurisdiction.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; Internal Sanctions Screening Policy

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of this KYC record in the originating compliance management system (e.g., Enablon HSE Management or dedicated KYC platform). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the operational system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage and Audit Policy; SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: trading_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is currently eligible for crude oil, natural gas, LNG, NGL, or refined product trading based on the current KYC status, sanctions screening results, AML risk rating, and document collection completeness. Set to false when KYC is expired, rejected, or sanctions match is confirmed.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; FATF Recommendation 10; Internal Trading Counterparty Eligibility Policy

attributes.name: ubo_count
attributes.description: Number of ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) identified and disclosed for this counterparty. A UBO is any natural person holding 25% or more direct or indirect ownership or control. Used to assess ownership complexity and completeness of beneficial ownership disclosure.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 24; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule 31 CFR 1010.230; EU AMLD4 Article 30

attributes.name: un_sanctions_screening_result
attributes.description: Result of screening the counterparty against the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list. Applies globally to all counterparties regardless of jurisdiction. A confirmed match prohibits all transactions under international law.
attributes.references: UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Charter Article 41; Internal Sanctions Compliance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this KYC record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every status change, review completion, sanctions screening refresh, or document update. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Internal Data Governance Audit Policy

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC verification process was completed and the counterparty's identity and documentation were confirmed by the compliance team. Marks the start of the KYC validity period.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; FinCEN Customer Due Diligence Rule; OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance waiver expires when waiver_flag is true. After this date, trading eligibility is automatically suspended until full KYC compliance is restored. Null when no waiver is in effect.
attributes.references: Internal KYC Waiver Policy; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal compliance waiver has been granted for this KYC record, allowing temporary trading eligibility despite incomplete documentation or pending review. Waivers require senior compliance authority approval and are time-limited.
attributes.references: Internal KYC Waiver Policy; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; SOX Section 302

products.name: kyc_document
products.description: Individual KYC compliance document submitted by or collected for a counterparty, including document type (certificate of incorporation, trade license, audited financials, beneficial ownership declaration, sanctions clearance certificate), document reference number, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, document status (valid, expired, pending review), storage reference, and verification officer. Supports document lifecycle management for KYC renewal and regulatory audit.

attributes.name: kyc_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each KYC compliance document record in the system. Primary key for the kyc_document entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior compliance officer or manager who formally approved or rejected this KYC document in the internal approval workflow. Supports SOX segregation of duties and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty (IOC, NOC, refiner, trader, wholesale buyer, industrial consumer, retail distributor, or contract counterparty) for whom this KYC document was submitted or collected.

attributes.name: kyc_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.kyc_record. Business justification: Critical parent-child relationship: KYC documents belong to a KYC record. This links individual compliance documents to their parent KYC assessment record, enabling proper document management and audi

attributes.name: primary_kyc_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal compliance officer or analyst responsible for verifying and approving this KYC document. Supports accountability, segregation of duties, and SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The internal approval workflow status of the KYC document, distinct from document_status. Tracks whether the compliance team has formally approved, rejected, escalated, or is pending approval of the document for onboarding or renewal purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; COPAS

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the KYC document was formally approved or rejected by the approver. Provides a precise audit trail for regulatory examination and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) of the counterparty entity as declared in the beneficial ownership documentation. Required for AML compliance and FATF beneficial ownership transparency standards.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule; SOX

attributes.name: beneficial_owner_nationality
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the nationality of the ultimate beneficial owner. Used for sanctions screening, jurisdictional risk assessment, and FATF compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; OFAC

attributes.name: beneficial_ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of ownership held by the declared ultimate beneficial owner in the counterparty entity. Typically a threshold of 25% or more triggers UBO disclosure requirements under AML regulations.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; FinCEN Beneficial Ownership Rule; SOX

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the body or authority that certified the document (e.g., notary public, embassy, apostille authority). Populated only when document_certified is True.
attributes.references: Hague Apostille Convention; FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to record observations, exceptions, escalation notes, or contextual information related to the KYC document review. Confidential as it may contain sensitive compliance assessments.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; SOX; EU AML Directive; SEC

attributes.name: counterparty_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the counterparty associated with this KYC document. Segments include International Oil Company (IOC), National Oil Company (NOC), refiner, trader, wholesale buyer, industrial consumer, retail distributor, or contract counterparty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ioc|noc|refiner|trader|wholesale_buyer|industrial_consumer|retail_distributor|contract_counterparty — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KYC document record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOX and regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; FATF Recommendations; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SEC

attributes.name: document_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the KYC document has been certified (e.g., notarized, apostilled, or certified by a recognized authority) as required by the applicable regulatory jurisdiction. True when certification is confirmed.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; Hague Apostille Convention; EU AML Directive

attributes.name: document_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or ISO 639-2 language code of the original document (e.g., 'en', 'ar', 'fr', 'zh'). Determines whether a certified translation is required for compliance review.
attributes.references: ISO 639; FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive

attributes.name: document_reference_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique reference number or serial number assigned to this document by the issuing authority or the counterparty. Used for cross-referencing with regulatory filings and audit trails.

attributes.name: document_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the KYC document was obtained — whether submitted directly by the counterparty, collected via a third-party KYC agency, retrieved from a public registry, gathered internally, or received from a regulatory body.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; SOX

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KYC document indicating whether it is valid, expired, pending review, rejected, superseded by a newer version, or under renewal. Drives KYC renewal workflows and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC; EU AML Directive; SOX

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the KYC compliance document submitted by or collected for the counterparty. Covers certificate of incorporation, trade license, audited financials, beneficial ownership declaration, sanctions clearance certificate, and tax registration certificate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: certificate_of_incorporation|trade_license|audited_financials|beneficial_ownership_declaration|sanctions_clearance_certificate|tax_registration_certificate|power_of_attorney|bank_reference_letter|environmental_permit|insurance_certificate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC; EU AML Directive; SOX; SEC

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the KYC document, used when a counterparty submits an updated or revised version of a previously held document. Supports document lifecycle management and supersession tracking.

attributes.name: enhanced_due_diligence_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is required for this counterparty based on the risk rating, jurisdiction, or document type. True triggers additional compliance review steps per FATF high-risk country guidance.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; OFAC

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the KYC document expires and is no longer considered valid for compliance purposes. Null for documents with no expiry (e.g., certificates of incorporation). Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC; EU AML Directive; SOX

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was officially issued or certified by the issuing authority. Used to determine document age, validity windows, and renewal scheduling.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governmental body, regulatory agency, or recognized institution that issued or certified this KYC document (e.g., Companies House, SEC, local trade registry, national tax authority, OFAC).
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC; BSEE; BOEM; EPA; SEC

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this document was issued. Used for sanctions screening, jurisdictional compliance, and cross-border regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FATF Recommendations; OFAC; EU AML Directive

attributes.name: kyc_program_type
attributes.description: Classifies the KYC compliance program under which this document was collected — Standard KYC for routine counterparties, Enhanced KYC for high-risk or PEP-linked entities, Simplified KYC for low-risk regulated entities, or Periodic Review for renewal cycles.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; FinCEN; SOX

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KYC document record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and data lineage requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX; FATF Recommendations; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SEC

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the KYC document must be renewed or re-submitted to maintain compliance. Calculated based on expiry date and internal renewal lead-time policy. Drives automated renewal notifications.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; SOX

attributes.name: politically_exposed_person_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty or beneficial owner associated with this KYC document is classified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) per FATF definitions. True requires enhanced due diligence and senior management approval.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; OFAC; SOX

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the KYC document was received by the Oil Gas compliance team from the counterparty. Distinct from issue date; used to track submission timeliness and onboarding SLA compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary regulatory jurisdiction governing the compliance requirements for this KYC document. Determines which AML, sanctions, and KYC regulations apply.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FATF Recommendations; OFAC; EU AML Directive; FERC; BSEE

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for rejection when approval_status is 'rejected'. Documents the compliance rationale for audit trail and counterparty communication purposes.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; SOX; EU AML Directive

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the KYC document was reviewed or verified by the compliance officer. Supports audit trail requirements and regulatory examination readiness.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; SOX; SEC; EU AML Directive

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: The number of months between mandatory periodic reviews of this KYC document, determined by the counterparty risk rating and KYC program type. Drives automated renewal scheduling (e.g., 12 months for standard, 6 months for high-risk).
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; SOX

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to this KYC document based on counterparty jurisdiction, document type, and compliance assessment. Drives enhanced due diligence requirements and review frequency. Confidential as it reflects internal credit and compliance risk assessment.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; Basel III; SOX

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed for this KYC document. Used to determine whether re-screening is required based on elapsed time or updated sanctions lists.
attributes.references: OFAC; EU Sanctions; FATF Recommendations; SOX

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of the OFAC and international sanctions list screening performed against the counterparty and document details. Cleared indicates no match; Flagged requires escalation; Pending awaits screening completion; Not Applicable for document types exempt from screening.
attributes.references: OFAC; EU Sanctions; UN Security Council Resolutions; FATF Recommendations

attributes.name: storage_reference
attributes.description: The path, URI, or reference key pointing to the physical or digital storage location of the KYC document (e.g., document management system path, SharePoint URL, S3 object key, or DMS record ID). Enables retrieval for audit and regulatory examination.
attributes.references: SOX; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; ISO 14001; SEC

attributes.name: translation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certified translation of this KYC document is required because the original is not in the business operating language. True when translation is needed; False when the document is already in an accepted language.

attributes.name: translation_storage_reference
attributes.description: Storage path or URI for the certified translation of the KYC document, when translation_required is True. Null when no translation is needed.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; SOX

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity and validity of the KYC document. Options include manual review by compliance officer, third-party agency verification, automated screening tools, notarized copy, or certified original.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; EU AML Directive; SOX; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

products.name: segment
products.description: Market segmentation classification for counterparties and accounts, defining segment code, segment name, segment description, industry vertical (refining, petrochemical, power generation, marine bunkering, aviation, retail distribution), customer tier (strategic, key account, standard, spot), geographic region, revenue band, volume band, and segment review date. Enables targeted commercial strategies, pricing differentiation, and portfolio analysis across the downstream customer base.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for segment

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Customer segments are owned by commercial strategy managers who define segmentation criteria, manage portfolio allocation, and drive pricing/terms strategies. reviewed_by and approved_by are denormali

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification was formally approved by the authorized commercial approver. Supports SOX compliance, audit trail, and governance documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Oil Gas Commercial Governance Policy

attributes.name: collateral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether counterparties in this segment are required to provide collateral (letter of credit, bank guarantee, or cash deposit) as a condition of trading. True = collateral mandatory; False = collateral not required. Driven by credit risk rating and segment tier.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Credit Risk Management Policy; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: commercial_channel
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which the segment transacts, distinguishing B2B wholesale, downstream retail, spot market, term contract, and exchange-traded channels. Supports pricing differentiation and channel-specific commercial strategies.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Strategy Framework; FERC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Primary contract type governing commercial relationships with counterparties in this segment. Term Contract: long-term supply agreement; Spot: single-cargo transaction; PSA (Production Sharing Agreement): upstream revenue sharing; JOA (Joint Operating Agreement): joint venture operations; Offtake Agreement: committed volume purchase; Framework Agreement: master commercial terms.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Contracts and Procurement Policy; COPAS JOA Standards; SPE PSA Guidelines

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty category that this segment targets. Distinguishes between International Oil Companies (IOCs), National Oil Companies (NOCs), independent refiners, commodity traders, wholesale buyers, industrial consumers, retail distributors, and contract counterparties. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IOC|NOC|refiner|trader|wholesale_buyer|industrial_consumer|retail_distributor|contract_counterparty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Counterparty Classification; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; Oil Gas Commercial Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this segment record was first created in the Oil Gas enterprise lakehouse Silver layer. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; ISO 8601 Date/Time Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate credit exposure in US Dollars permitted for counterparties classified within this segment. Established through credit risk assessment and approved per Oil Gas credit authority matrix. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD credit management to block orders exceeding the limit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Credit Management; COPAS Credit Standards; SOX Financial Controls; Oil Gas Credit Risk Policy

attributes.name: credit_risk_rating
attributes.description: Aggregate credit risk rating assigned to the segment, reflecting the creditworthiness profile of counterparties within this classification. Aligned with standard credit rating scales (AAA through CCC). Drives credit limit setting, payment term differentiation, and collateral requirements. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COPAS Credit Risk Standards; SOX Financial Controls; Oil Gas Credit Risk Management Policy; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: customer_tier
attributes.description: Commercial relationship tier assigned to the segment, reflecting strategic importance, volume commitment, and service level entitlement. Strategic: top-tier IOCs/NOCs with long-term offtake agreements; Key Account: significant volume buyers; Standard: regular contracted buyers; Spot: transactional buyers without long-term commitment.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Relationship Management Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: default_payment_term_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days allowed for payment settlement for counterparties in this segment, as configured in SAP S/4HANA FI/SD payment terms. Typical values: 0 (prepayment), 7, 14, 30, 45, 60 days. Drives accounts receivable management and working capital planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; Oil Gas Credit Policy

attributes.name: discount_authority_level
attributes.description: Minimum organizational authority level required to approve pricing discounts or differentials for counterparties in this segment. Drives commercial governance and pricing approval workflows in SAP S/4HANA SD. Classified confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Governance Policy; SOX Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Authorization

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this segment classification becomes effective and applicable for counterparty assignment and commercial operations. Supports temporal validity management and historical segment analysis.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period Management; IFRS/GAAP Effective Date Standards

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active segment. Supports temporal validity management, segment lifecycle tracking, and historical reporting.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period Management

attributes.name: esg_classification
attributes.description: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) classification assigned to the segment based on the aggregate ESG profile of counterparties within it. Supports ESG-aligned commercial strategy, green financing requirements, and sustainability reporting under GHG/EPA frameworks.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Regulations; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ESG Reporting Standards; Oil Gas Sustainability Policy

attributes.name: external_segment_ref
attributes.description: External reference code or identifier for this segment as used in counterparty-facing communications, industry classification systems, or partner systems. Enables cross-system reconciliation and counterparty-facing segment identification.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; API Industry Classification Standards

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the primary geographic region associated with the segment (e.g., APAC, EMEA, AMER, MEA). Enables regional portfolio analysis, pricing benchmarking against WTI/Brent/Dubai markers, and geographic commercial strategy alignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166 Regional Codes; Oil Gas Geographic Classification Standard

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Standard International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the default delivery and risk transfer terms for commercial transactions with counterparties in this segment. FOB (Free on Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance Freight) are most common in crude oil trading.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; Oil Gas Commercial Trading Policy; FERC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The primary industry vertical classification of the segment, defining the downstream end-use market served. Drives product slate alignment, pricing benchmarks, and commercial strategy. Values: refining, petrochemical, power_generation, marine_bunkering, aviation, retail_distribution.
attributes.references: API Industry Classification; Oil Gas Commercial Segmentation Policy

attributes.name: kyc_requirement_level
attributes.description: Level of Know Your Customer (KYC) due diligence required for counterparties in this segment. Standard: routine KYC checks; Enhanced: heightened due diligence for higher-risk counterparties (e.g., NOCs in sanctioned-adjacent jurisdictions, traders); Simplified: reduced checks for low-risk, well-established counterparties.
attributes.references: FATF KYC Guidelines; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; Oil Gas Compliance Policy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification was most recently reviewed and validated by the commercial strategy team. Provides audit trail for segment governance and ensures compliance with periodic review requirements.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Governance Policy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: min_order_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Volume (Barrels of Oil Equivalent)
attributes.description: Minimum transaction volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE) required for counterparties in this segment to qualify for standard commercial terms. Below this threshold, spot pricing or premium terms apply. Supports supply chain optimization and order management in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: API Measurement Standards; SPE BOE Conversion Guidelines; Oil Gas Commercial Policy

attributes.name: portfolio_weight_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage weight of this segment within the overall downstream customer portfolio by revenue or volume. Used for portfolio balancing, commercial planning, and strategic allocation decisions. Sum of all active segment weights should equal 100%.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Strategy Framework; IFRS/GAAP Revenue Reporting

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_mode
attributes.description: Primary logistics and delivery mode preferred by counterparties in this segment for product offtake. Pipeline: onshore pipeline delivery; Tanker: crude/product tanker; FPSO (Floating Production Storage and Offloading): offshore loading; Truck: road tanker; Rail: rail car; LNG_vessel: liquefied natural gas carrier.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; BSEE Offshore Operations; Oil Gas Supply Chain Management Policy

attributes.name: pricing_benchmark
attributes.description: The primary commodity price benchmark used for pricing differentiation within this segment. West Texas Intermediate (WTI), Brent, Dubai for crude; HSFO/LSFO for fuel oil; JKM for LNG; NBP/Henry Hub for natural gas. Drives formula-based pricing in term contracts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WTI|Brent|Dubai|HSFO|LSFO|JKM|NBP|Henry_Hub — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Market Pricing Standards; OPEC Reference Basket; Oil Gas Commercial Pricing Policy

attributes.name: pricing_formula_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing methodology applied to commercial transactions with counterparties in this segment. Fixed: agreed price for contract duration; Formula-linked: price tied to benchmark (WTI, Brent, Dubai) plus differential; Index-based: linked to published price indices; Negotiated: bilateral negotiation per cargo; Spot market: prevailing market price. Classified confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: FERC Market Pricing Standards; Oil Gas Commercial Pricing Policy; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: primary_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the primary country of operation for counterparties in this segment. Used for regulatory compliance, sanctions screening, and country-risk credit assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC Sanctions Compliance; Oil Gas KYC Policy

attributes.name: product_slate
attributes.description: Description of the primary petroleum product slate supplied to counterparties in this segment. Examples: crude oil grades (WTI, Brent, Arab Light), refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, HSFO, LSFO), NGLs, LPG, LNG, petrochemicals (ethylene, propylene, benzene). Drives product-specific pricing and supply planning.
attributes.references: API Product Classification; SPE PRMS Product Definitions; Oil Gas Product Management Policy

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether counterparties in this segment are subject to mandatory regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., SEC reserves disclosure, BOEM/BSEE reporting, FERC market conduct reporting, EPA emissions reporting). True = regulatory reporting required; False = standard commercial reporting only.
attributes.references: SEC Reserves Disclosure Requirements; BOEM/BSEE Reporting; FERC Market Conduct; EPA Reporting; Oil Gas Regulatory Compliance Policy

attributes.name: revenue_band_code
attributes.description: Coded classification of the annual revenue band associated with counterparties in this segment (e.g., RB_TIER1_GT500M, RB_TIER2_100M_500M, RB_TIER3_LT100M). Supports credit risk tiering, pricing authority levels, and commercial prioritization.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Credit Risk Management Policy; COPAS Financial Classification Standards

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic commercial review of this segment's classification criteria, tier assignments, pricing strategy, and portfolio weight. Ensures segment definitions remain aligned with market conditions and commercial strategy.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Governance Policy; SOX Internal Controls Review Cycle

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether counterparties in this segment require mandatory OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening prior to transaction execution. True = mandatory screening; False = screening not required (e.g., pre-cleared domestic government entities). Critical for regulatory compliance in international oil and gas trading.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Regulations; UN Security Council Sanctions; EU Sanctions Regime; Oil Gas Compliance Policy

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric business code identifying the market segment, used as the externally-known short identifier across commercial systems including SAP S/4HANA SD module and downstream reporting. Examples: REFIN_STRAT, PETROCHEM_KEY, MARINE_SPOT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification; Oil Gas Commercial Standards

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the market segment, including its commercial purpose, qualifying criteria, target counterparty profile, and strategic intent within the downstream customer portfolio.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the market segment used in commercial reporting, pricing differentiation, and portfolio analysis. Examples: Strategic Refiners – Asia Pacific, Key Account Petrochemicals – EMEA.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Strategy Framework; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Segmentation

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the market segment classification. Active: segment is in use for commercial operations and customer assignment; Inactive: segment is no longer used for new assignments; Under Review: segment is being reassessed for commercial strategy alignment; Deprecated: segment has been superseded and archived.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification Lifecycle

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this segment classification originated. SAP_SD: SAP S/4HANA Sales and Distribution module; CRM: Customer Relationship Management system; MANUAL: manually created by commercial team; LEGACY: migrated from legacy system.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; SAP S/4HANA Integration Standards

attributes.name: strategic_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the segment's strategic commercial priority relative to other segments, where 1 represents the highest priority. Used for supply allocation decisions during constrained production periods, commercial resource prioritization, and executive portfolio reporting.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Commercial Strategy Framework; OPEC Production Quota Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp recording when this segment record was most recently modified in the Oil Gas enterprise lakehouse Silver layer. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Data Governance Policy; ISO 8601 Date/Time Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: volume_band_code
attributes.description: Coded classification of the annual contracted or transacted volume band for counterparties in this segment, expressed in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE) or BOPD/MCFD equivalents (e.g., VB_HIGH_GT1MMBOE, VB_MED_100K_1MMBOE, VB_LOW_LT100KBOE). Drives volume-based pricing tiers and supply allocation priority.
attributes.references: API Volume Classification; Oil Gas Supply Chain Management Policy; PRMS Volume Standards

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to express volume thresholds for the volume band classification. Standard oil and gas volume units: BOE (Barrel of Oil Equivalent), BOPD (Barrels of Oil Per Day), MCFD (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day), MMCFD (Million Cubic Feet per Day), BBL (Barrel), MT (Metric Tonne).
attributes.references: API Measurement Standards; SPE Volume Reporting Guidelines

products.name: customer_price_index_preference
products.description: Customer-level pricing index preferences and benchmark configurations, capturing preferred price index (WTI, Brent, Dubai, Platts, Argus), pricing basis (FOB, CIF, DES, DAP), differential (premium/discount in USD/BBL or USD/MMBTU), pricing period (month of loading, month after loading), quotation period, and applicable product category. Supports commercial deal structuring, contract pricing configuration, and back-office settlement for crude oil and products trading.

attributes.name: customer_price_index_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer price index preference record. Primary key for the price_index_preference data product in the customer domain.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Pricing preferences can be account-specific. Different accounts under the same counterparty may have different pricing terms, indices, and formulas based on their specific commercial agreements.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Pricing formulas and index preferences require commercial manager approval before contract execution. Regulatory requirement in many jurisdictions for price risk management. approved_by is denormalize

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial contract or sales agreement under which this pricing index preference applies. Supports back-office settlement and deal structuring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; FERC Regulations; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this price index preference is configured. Links to the customer master record in the SSOT customer domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: JOA partners may elect specific pricing bases for their equity crude offtake. Enables JOA partner-specific pricing elections, equity crude pricing administration, and partner commercial terms manageme

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Price index preferences specify pricing formulas for specific petroleum products (crude grades, refined products, NGLs). Commercial teams configure product-specific pricing differentials and indices f

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The commercial approval workflow status for this pricing index preference. 'draft' indicates under preparation; 'pending_approval' indicates submitted for commercial review; 'approved' indicates authorized for use in contracts; 'rejected' indicates not approved; 'withdrawn' indicates recalled by the submitter.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Controls; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this pricing index preference was formally approved by the authorized commercial manager. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: ceiling_price_usd
attributes.description: The maximum price per unit (in the differential_unit currency) above which the effective price will not rise, regardless of the benchmark index movement. Provides price protection for the buyer in volatile market conditions. Expressed in the same unit as differential_usd.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this price index preference record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the price index and differential are denominated. Typically USD for international crude oil and products trading. Supports multi-currency commercial agreements and financial settlement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; FERC Regulations

attributes.name: delivery_location_code
attributes.description: The standardized code identifying the delivery point or terminal associated with this pricing preference (e.g., Cushing OK for WTI, Rotterdam for Brent products). Aligns the pricing basis with the physical delivery location for FOB/CIF/DES pricing.
attributes.references: API Standards; FERC Regulations; PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations

attributes.name: differential_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the pricing differential. USD per barrel (USD/BBL) for crude oil and liquid products; USD per MMBTU for natural gas and LNG; USD per metric ton (USD/MT) for petrochemicals; USD per thousand cubic feet (USD/MCF) or USD per gigajoule (USD/GJ) for gas contracts.
attributes.references: API Standards; FERC Regulations; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: differential_usd
attributes.description: The premium or discount applied to the benchmark price index, expressed in USD per barrel (BBL) for crude oil and refined products, or USD per MMBTU for natural gas. A positive value indicates a premium above the index; a negative value indicates a discount below the index. Critical for commercial deal structuring and back-office settlement.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; API Standards; FERC Regulations; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this price index preference becomes effective and applicable to commercial transactions with the customer. Used to manage temporal validity of pricing configurations and support contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this price index preference expires and is no longer applicable. Nullable for open-ended preferences. Supports contract pricing configuration and temporal validity management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: The externally-known reference number or identifier for this pricing preference as recorded in the counterparty's system or in the commercial contract documentation. Supports reconciliation with customer and broker records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: floor_price_usd
attributes.description: The minimum price per unit (in the differential_unit currency) below which the effective price will not fall, regardless of the benchmark index movement. Provides price protection for the seller in volatile market conditions. Expressed in the same unit as differential_usd.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary geographic region or destination country associated with this pricing preference. Used for regional pricing analytics, regulatory compliance, and export/import pricing differentiation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Geographic Codes; API Standards; FERC Regulations; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations

attributes.name: index_grade
attributes.description: The specific crude oil grade or product specification associated with the benchmark index (e.g., 'WTI Cushing', 'Dated Brent', 'Dubai Fateh', 'Arab Light', 'Urals'). Provides granularity beyond the index code for precise commercial and settlement purposes.
attributes.references: API Standards; Platts Global Energy Benchmarks; Argus Media Pricing

attributes.name: index_publication_source
attributes.description: The authoritative price reporting agency or exchange that publishes the benchmark index used for pricing. Examples include Platts (S&P Global Commodity Insights), Argus Media, ICIS, OPIS, Reuters, Bloomberg, ICE, NYMEX, or CME. Determines the contractually agreed source of truth for price settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PLATTS|ARGUS|ICIS|OPIS|REUTERS|BLOOMBERG|ICE|NYMEX|CME — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Platts Global Energy Benchmarks; Argus Media Pricing; FERC Regulations; IOSCO Principles for Oil Price Reporting Agencies

attributes.name: is_formula_based
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference uses a complex formula expression (TRUE) rather than a simple index-plus-differential structure (FALSE). When TRUE, the pricing_formula field contains the authoritative pricing expression.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: is_provisional_pricing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing preference uses provisional pricing (TRUE) with subsequent final price adjustment, or direct final pricing (FALSE). When TRUE, provisional_price_usd is used for initial invoicing and a price adjustment invoice is issued after settlement.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The commercial market segment classification for this pricing preference. Distinguishes between B2B wholesale (IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders), downstream retail distributors, industrial consumers, utilities, government entities, and commodity traders. Supports segmented pricing analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; API Standards; FERC Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional commercial context, special conditions, negotiation notes, or exceptions associated with this pricing index preference. Not used for formula expressions (see pricing_formula).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: preference_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label or short description identifying this pricing index preference configuration, used for display in commercial deal structuring and contract management interfaces.

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price index preference record. 'active' indicates the preference is in use for pricing; 'pending' indicates awaiting approval; 'expired' indicates past the effective period; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer preference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: price_index_code
attributes.description: The preferred benchmark price index used for pricing. Common indices include West Texas Intermediate (WTI), Brent, Dubai, Platts, Argus, Henry Hub (natural gas), National Balancing Point (NBP), Japan Korea Marker (JKM), OPIS, and ICE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WTI|BRENT|DUBAI|PLATTS|ARGUS|HENRY_HUB|NBP|JKM|OPIS|ICE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Standards; Platts Global Energy Benchmarks; Argus Media Pricing; ICE Exchange Rules; FERC Regulations

attributes.name: price_index_description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the benchmark price index, providing additional context beyond the code (e.g., 'West Texas Intermediate Cushing Oklahoma', 'Dated Brent North Sea'). Supports reporting and contract documentation.
attributes.references: Platts Global Energy Benchmarks; Argus Media Pricing; API Standards

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The delivery and pricing basis (Incoterms) agreed with the customer. FOB (Free on Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DES (Delivered Ex Ship), DAP (Delivered at Place), DAT (Delivered at Terminal), FCA (Free Carrier). Determines risk transfer point and freight cost allocation in crude oil and products trading.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; API Standards; FERC Regulations; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: pricing_formula
attributes.description: The full pricing formula expression as defined in the commercial contract, capturing complex multi-index blends, conditional differentials, or formula-based pricing structures (e.g., '0.5 * WTI + 0.5 * BRENT - 1.50'). Supports advanced deal structuring beyond simple index plus differential configurations.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: pricing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the price index is re-evaluated or re-set for ongoing supply agreements. 'daily' for spot-linked contracts; 'monthly' for term contracts using monthly average indices; 'quarterly' for longer-term supply agreements.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; FERC Regulations

attributes.name: pricing_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the pricing period convention for determining the applicable benchmark price. 'month_of_loading' uses the average index price during the cargo loading month; 'month_after_loading' uses the following month; 'average_of_period' uses a defined averaging window; 'spot' uses the day-of-transaction price; 'custom' uses a bespoke period defined in the contract.
attributes.references: API Standards; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; FERC Regulations; Platts Global Energy Benchmarks

attributes.name: provisional_price_usd
attributes.description: The provisional or estimated price per unit used for initial invoicing before the final benchmark index price is published and the settlement lag period has elapsed. Common in crude oil trading where final prices are determined after cargo delivery.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: quotation_period_days
