attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Quality or quantity complaints on JOA production require JOA dispute resolution procedures. Critical for JOA partner complaint tracking, crude quality dispute resolution, measurement discrepancy inves

attributes.name: jv_partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the JV partner or co-venturer involved in the complaint when jv_partner_involved is True. Links to the JV partner master record for notification and cost allocation under the Joint Interest Billing (JIB) process.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting; JOA; COPAS

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Complaints reference specific petroleum products with quality issues (off-spec sulfur, contamination, wrong grade delivered). Quality management and root cause analysis require linking complaints to p

attributes.name: prior_complaint_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous complaint record when repeat_complaint is True. Enables complaint lineage tracking and recurrence pattern analysis for continuous improvement and root cause elimination.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Complaints frequently reference specific sales orders for product quality, delivery, or invoicing issues. Required for root cause analysis, credit note processing, and customer satisfaction tracking l

attributes.name: source_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Customer product quality complaints often trace to upstream vendor/supplier issues (contamination, off-spec material, blending errors). Business process: root cause analysis, vendor performance impact

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the complaint was formally resolved and closed. Used to calculate resolution cycle time and SLA compliance. Null until complaint reaches resolved or closed status.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; SAP S/4HANA SD — Notification Completion Date

attributes.name: agreed_settlement_usd
attributes.description: Final agreed financial settlement amount in US Dollars upon complaint resolution. May differ from claimed_amount_usd following negotiation or investigation. Triggers credit note issuance or payment adjustment in SAP FI.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; COPAS; SAP S/4HANA FI — Credit Memo

attributes.name: cargo_reference
attributes.description: Cargo or lifting reference number identifying the specific shipment, parcel, or delivery associated with the complaint. Links to cargo scheduling and vessel nomination records. Critical for short delivery, vessel delay, and product quality complaints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Document; Avocet Production Operations — Cargo Allocation

attributes.name: claimed_amount_usd
attributes.description: Financial value of the customer's claim in US Dollars. Applicable to invoice disputes, pricing discrepancies, demurrage claims, and short delivery financial impacts. Used for credit risk assessment and financial provisioning under IFRS 15.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; COPAS; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: claimed_volume_bbl
attributes.description: Volume quantity in barrels (BBL) that the customer claims was short-delivered, off-spec, or otherwise in dispute. Applicable primarily to short delivery and product quality complaints. Expressed in standard barrels at 60°F per API MPMS standards.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 — Physical Properties; API RP 2003

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the complaint was originally submitted by the customer. Telex is included as it remains in use for formal maritime and cargo communications in the oil and gas industry. Supports channel analytics and intake process optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Notification Origin; ISO 10002:2018

attributes.name: complaint_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the complaint type. Drives routing to the appropriate resolution team and root cause analysis framework. Categories align with oil and gas commercial operations: product_quality (off-spec crude/products), short_delivery (volume shortfall), invoice_dispute (billing error), vessel_delay (FPSO/tanker scheduling), documentation_error (bill of lading, COA), pricing_discrepancy (WTI/Brent differential disputes).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Notification Type; API RP 2003; ISO 10002:2018

attributes.name: complaint_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer formally raised or submitted the complaint. Represents the principal business event date for SLA measurement and regulatory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Notification Date

attributes.name: complaint_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the complaint as submitted by the customer. Captures the full context of the issue including specific parameters, quantities, dates, and circumstances. Classified confidential as it may contain commercially sensitive counterparty information.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; SAP S/4HANA SD — Notification Long Text

attributes.name: complaint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the complaint workflow. Drives SLA monitoring, escalation triggers, and management reporting. 'pending_customer' indicates awaiting customer response; 'escalated' indicates breach of resolution SLA or senior management involvement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Notification Status; ISO 10002:2018 Customer Satisfaction — Guidelines for Complaints Handling

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) implemented to address the root cause and prevent recurrence. Supports continuous improvement tracking and regulatory compliance demonstration.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management; API Q1/Q2

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the complaint record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Represents the audit trail creation timestamp, distinct from complaint_date (business event) and receipt_timestamp (system receipt). Supports data lineage and SOX audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: SAP credit memo or credit note document number issued to the customer as part of the complaint resolution. Populated upon financial settlement for invoice disputes, pricing discrepancies, or short delivery claims. Links to SAP FI accounts receivable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Credit Memo; IFRS 15; COPAS

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_outcome
attributes.description: Customer's expressed satisfaction level following complaint resolution. Captured via formal feedback mechanism or account manager assessment. Drives customer relationship health scoring and retention risk identification.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; ISO 10004:2018 Customer Satisfaction — Monitoring and Measuring

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric satisfaction rating provided by the customer following resolution, typically on a scale of 1 to 10. Complements the qualitative customer_satisfaction_outcome field. Used for KPI reporting and account health monitoring.

attributes.name: delivery_reference
attributes.description: Outbound delivery or bill of lading number associated with the complaint. Distinct from cargo_reference in that it represents the logistics execution document rather than the commercial cargo nomination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Outbound Delivery; PHMSA Pipeline Delivery Records

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint has been formally escalated to senior management or a specialist team. True when escalation_owner_id is populated and formal escalation process has been triggered.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; SAP S/4HANA SD — Notification Escalation

attributes.name: hse_incident_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated HSE incident record in Enablon HSE Management system, when the complaint has triggered a parallel safety or environmental incident investigation. Null when hse_related is False.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management — Incident Reference; OSHA 29 CFR 1904

attributes.name: hse_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint has an associated Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) implication, such as a product quality issue involving H2S content, NORM contamination, or a delivery incident with environmental impact. Triggers parallel HSE incident workflow in Enablon.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR; EPA 40 CFR; Enablon HSE Management; API RP 55

attributes.name: invoice_reference
attributes.description: SAP billing document or invoice number relevant to the complaint, particularly for invoice dispute and pricing discrepancy categories. Enables direct linkage to financial records for credit note or adjustment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Billing Document; COPAS Accounting Procedures; IFRS 15

attributes.name: jv_partner_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Joint Venture (JV) partner or Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) co-venturer is implicated in the complaint, requiring notification and coordination under the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA). Triggers JV accounting and partner notification workflows.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting — JV Partner; JOA Standard Terms; COPAS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent modification to the complaint record in the data platform. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance. Supports SOX compliance and data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the complaint was received and registered in the system. Used for SLA clock start and audit trail purposes. Distinct from complaint_date which captures the business event date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Notification Creation Time

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally communicated complaint reference number shared with the customer for tracking purposes. Follows the format COMP-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in all customer-facing correspondence and SAP SD service notification references.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Service Notification Number

attributes.name: regulatory_body_notified
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority notified in connection with the complaint (e.g., EPA, BSEE, PHMSA, FERC). Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is True. Supports regulatory compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; PHMSA; FERC; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint involves a matter requiring notification to a regulatory body (e.g., EPA for environmental product quality issues, BSEE for offshore delivery failures, PHMSA for pipeline delivery incidents). Triggers compliance workflow in Enablon HSE Management.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; PHMSA 49 CFR; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: repeat_complaint
attributes.description: Indicates whether this complaint represents a recurrence of a previously resolved complaint from the same customer for the same root cause or issue type. Signals ineffective corrective action and triggers enhanced investigation under continuous improvement protocols.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2 — Nonconformity and Corrective Action

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the actions taken to resolve the complaint, including investigation findings, corrective measures applied, and any commercial settlement agreed. Classified confidential due to commercially sensitive content.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; SAP S/4HANA SD — Notification Resolution Text

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the identified root cause of the complaint. Supports systemic trend analysis and continuous improvement programs. process_failure: upstream or downstream process deviation; equipment_failure: metering, pumping, or vessel equipment; human_error: operational or administrative error; supplier_issue: third-party or JV partner failure; logistics_failure: transportation or scheduling failure; measurement_error: API MPMS measurement discrepancy.
attributes.references: API RP 2003; ISO 10002:2018; Enablon HSE Management — Root Cause Analysis

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the identified root cause following investigation. Provides specific technical or operational context beyond the root_cause_category classification. Used for corrective action planning and lessons learned documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; API RP 2003; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Business impact severity rating assigned at intake or triage. Critical: potential regulatory breach, HSE implication, or major commercial loss. High: significant financial impact or key account at risk. Medium: moderate operational impact. Low: minor administrative issue. Drives SLA target assignment and escalation thresholds.

attributes.name: sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the complaint resolution exceeded the target resolution date, constituting an SLA breach. True when actual_resolution_date exceeds target_resolution_date or when complaint remains open past target date. Drives management reporting and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Original system identifier or notification number from the operational system of record (e.g., SAP SD service notification number, CRM case ID) from which this complaint record was sourced. Supports data lineage and reconciliation with upstream systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Service Notification; Data Governance — Lineage

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular detail within the complaint category. Examples include: off-spec sulfur content, density out-of-range, TAN exceedance, RON shortfall, volume meter discrepancy, demurrage claim, laytime dispute, letter of credit discrepancy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: off_spec_sulfur|off_spec_density|off_spec_tan|off_spec_ron|volume_meter|demurrage|laytime|lc_discrepancy|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API MPMS (Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Contractually or operationally committed date by which the complaint must be resolved. Derived from complaint severity and SLA policy. Used for SLA breach monitoring and escalation triggering.
attributes.references: ISO 10002:2018; SAP S/4HANA SD — Notification Required End Date

products.name: sanctions_screening
products.description: Sanctions screening event record for a counterparty, capturing screening date, screening type (onboarding, periodic, triggered), screening lists checked (OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated, UN Security Council, HM Treasury), screening result (clear, match, potential match), match details, disposition (cleared, escalated, blocked), compliance officer decision, decision date, and regulatory reporting obligation flag. Mandatory for all counterparties under OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions compliance frameworks.
products.reference: OFAC SDN / EU Consolidated Sanctions List

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each sanctions screening event record. Primary key for the sanctions_screening data product in the customer domain. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete compliance event with its own lifecycle, timestamps, party reference, and outcome.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Consolidated List; HM Treasury Financial Sanctions List

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Sanctions screening can be account-specific, not just counterparty-level. Accounts may require separate screening based on their specific commercial activities, jurisdictions, or transaction patterns.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Sanctions screening, compliance monitoring, and regulatory reporting costs are allocated to legal/compliance cost centers for overhead tracking and compliance program cost management.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty or customer record that was screened. Links the sanctions screening event to the master customer/counterparty entity (IOC, NOC, refiner, trader, wholesale buyer, industrial consumer, retail distributor, or contract counterparty). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501; EU Regulation 2580/2001; UN Security Council Resolution 1267

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance officer or authorized reviewer who reviewed the screening result and recorded the disposition decision. Links to the workforce/employee master for accountability and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; SOX Section 302/404; FATF Recommendation 10; OSHA Compliance Records

attributes.name: kyc_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the KYC record associated with this counterparty at the time of screening. Links the sanctions screening event to the broader KYC compliance record for integrated AML/sanctions risk management. Supports cross-referencing between sanctions screening outcomes and KYC status.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; EU 4th/5th Anti-Money Laundering Directive

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Sanctions screening of venture partners in their customer capacity is required for commercial transactions. Critical for OFAC/EU/UN sanctions compliance, partner transaction screening, regulatory repo

attributes.name: adverse_media_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse media (negative news) was identified for this counterparty during the screening event, such as reports of corruption, bribery, sanctions violations, or involvement in illicit activities. Adverse media findings may trigger enhanced due diligence or re-screening.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 10; OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; EU 4th/5th Anti-Money Laundering Directive

attributes.name: blocking_action_taken
attributes.description: Indicates whether a blocking action was executed as a result of this screening event, such as freezing assets, blocking a transaction, or suspending the counterparty account in accordance with OFAC or applicable sanctions authority requirements.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501; EU Regulation 2580/2001 Article 2; UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 Section 17

attributes.name: compliance_officer_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the compliance officer documenting the rationale for the disposition decision, investigation findings, or escalation justification. Retained as part of the regulatory audit record.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Recommendation 10; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: counterparty_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the counterparty's country of incorporation or primary operations at the time of screening. Used for jurisdiction risk assessment and country-level sanctions embargo checks (e.g., Iran, Russia, North Korea, Cuba, Syria).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; OFAC Country-Based Sanctions Programs; EU Restrictive Measures; UN Security Council Embargoes

attributes.name: counterparty_name_screened
attributes.description: The exact legal name of the counterparty as submitted to the sanctions screening engine at the time of screening. This may differ from the current master record name if the entity has undergone a name change, ensuring a point-in-time audit record of what was screened.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; FATF Recommendation 10; KYC/AML Best Practices

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty being screened by their commercial relationship type with Oil Gas. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ioc|noc|refiner|trader|wholesale_buyer|industrial_consumer|retail_distributor|contract_counterparty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Industry Classification; IOC/NOC Counterparty Taxonomy; COPAS Counterparty Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sanctions screening record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; ISO 27001

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: The final compliance disposition assigned to this screening event following human review. 'cleared' = reviewed and confirmed not a sanctions match; 'escalated' = referred to senior compliance or legal counsel; 'blocked' = counterparty blocked from transacting; 'pending_review' = awaiting compliance officer decision; 'false_positive' = confirmed algorithmic false positive, no action required.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Recommendation 10; EU Regulation 2016/1675; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance officer or authorized reviewer recorded the final disposition decision for this screening event. Required for regulatory audit trails and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; SOX Section 302/404; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for escalating this screening event to senior compliance, legal counsel, or management. Applicable when disposition is 'escalated'. Examples: 'Confirmed SDN match', 'Beneficial owner PEP identified', 'Jurisdiction under OFAC comprehensive sanctions', 'Unresolved potential match above threshold'.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Recommendation 10; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: eu_consolidated_list_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Union (EU) Consolidated Sanctions List Checked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EU Consolidated List of Persons, Groups, and Entities Subject to EU Financial Sanctions was included in this screening event. Required for EU-nexus counterparties and transactions under EU Regulation 2580/2001 and related Council Regulations.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 2580/2001; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; Council Regulation (EC) No 881/2002

attributes.name: hm_treasury_list_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: His Majesty's (HM) Treasury Financial Sanctions List Checked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the UK HM Treasury Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) Consolidated List was included in this screening event. Required for UK-nexus counterparties and transactions post-Brexit under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018.
attributes.references: UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018; HM Treasury OFSI Consolidated List; UK Financial Sanctions Guidance

attributes.name: jurisdiction_risk_level
attributes.description: Risk classification of the counterparty's jurisdiction at the time of screening, based on FATF country risk ratings, OFAC country-based sanctions programs, and internal country risk policy. 'prohibited' = country subject to comprehensive sanctions embargo (e.g., Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Syria).
attributes.references: FATF Country Risk Ratings; OFAC Country-Based Sanctions Programs; EU Restrictive Measures by Country; UN Security Council Embargoes

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sanctions screening record was last modified, such as when a disposition decision was recorded or a compliance officer updated the outcome. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; ISO 27001

attributes.name: license_exemption_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for any OFAC specific license, EU derogation, or other regulatory exemption that authorizes a transaction with a sanctioned or potentially sanctioned counterparty. Null if no license or exemption applies. Critical for documenting authorized exceptions.
attributes.references: OFAC Specific License Program; EU Council Regulation Derogation Provisions; UK OFSI License Reference

attributes.name: list_version_date
attributes.description: The publication or effective date of the sanctions list versions used during this screening event. Ensures the audit record captures which version of the lists was current at the time of screening, critical for demonstrating due diligence.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List Publication Date; EU Consolidated Sanctions List Update Date; UN Security Council Consolidated List Update Date

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Algorithmic confidence score (0.00–100.00) produced by the sanctions screening engine indicating the degree of similarity between the screened counterparty and a listed entity. Scores above the configured threshold trigger a 'potential_match' or 'match' result requiring human review. Used for risk-based triage and audit documentation.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; Enablon HSE Management Compliance Module

attributes.name: match_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The minimum algorithmic match score percentage configured in the screening engine at the time of this screening event that triggers a 'potential_match' result requiring human review. Retained for audit purposes to document the sensitivity of the screening methodology applied.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; Screening Engine Configuration Audit

attributes.name: matched_entity_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned to the matched entity on the relevant sanctions list (e.g., OFAC SDN UID, EU list reference number, UN reference number). Null if no match. Used for precise cross-referencing with regulatory list databases.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List UID; EU Consolidated Sanctions List Reference; UN Security Council Consolidated List Reference

attributes.name: matched_entity_name
attributes.description: The name of the sanctioned entity or individual on the screening list that was matched or potentially matched against the counterparty. Null if screening_result is 'clear'. Retained for audit trail and regulatory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Consolidated List; HM Treasury OFSI List

attributes.name: matched_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific sanctions list on which a match or potential match was identified (e.g., 'OFAC SDN', 'EU Consolidated', 'UN Security Council', 'HM Treasury OFSI'). Null if screening_result is 'clear'. Critical for compliance officer investigation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Consolidated List; HM Treasury OFSI List

attributes.name: next_screening_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which the next periodic sanctions screening must be completed for this counterparty, calculated based on the counterparty's risk tier and screening frequency policy. Drives the compliance calendar and automated screening workflow.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Recommendation 10; EU Regulation 2016/1675; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: ofac_sdn_list_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List Checked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List was included in this screening event. Mandatory for all US-nexus transactions and counterparties under 31 CFR Part 501.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501; OFAC SDN List; US Treasury Department Sanctions Programs

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty or any of its beneficial owners has been identified as a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) during this screening event. PEP status elevates the counterparty's risk profile and may require enhanced due diligence under FATF Recommendation 12.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendation 12; EU 4th/5th Anti-Money Laundering Directive; OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the mandatory regulatory report was submitted to the relevant sanctions authority. Null if regulatory_reporting_required is False or report has not yet been submitted. Critical for demonstrating timely compliance with reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501.604; EU Regulation 2580/2001 Article 4; UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory report has been submitted to the relevant authority (e.g., OFAC, EU competent authority, OFSI). Applicable only when regulatory_reporting_required is True. Used to track compliance with mandatory reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501.604; EU Regulation 2580/2001; UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sanctions screening event triggers a mandatory regulatory reporting obligation (e.g., OFAC blocked property report, SAR filing, EU competent authority notification). True = reporting required; False = no reporting obligation. Drives downstream compliance workflow.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501.604; EU Regulation 2580/2001 Article 4; UN Security Council Resolution 1267; UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018

attributes.name: review_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance officer completed their review and recorded the final disposition for this screening event. Used to measure review turnaround time against internal SLA targets and regulatory timeliness requirements.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; SOX Section 302/404; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: screening_engine
attributes.description: Name and version of the sanctions screening software or service used to execute this screening event (e.g., 'Dow Jones Watchlist', 'Refinitiv World-Check', 'LexisNexis Bridger', 'Accuity Firco'). Required for audit trail and to assess screening methodology adequacy.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; ISO 27001

attributes.name: screening_frequency_code
attributes.description: The scheduled screening frequency applicable to this counterparty based on their risk tier and compliance policy. Determines the cadence for periodic re-screening. 'daily' = continuous monitoring for highest-risk counterparties; 'annual' = lowest-risk counterparties.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Risk-Based Approach Guidance; Internal Compliance Policy

attributes.name: screening_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier assigned to this screening event, used for audit trails, regulatory correspondence, and compliance officer tracking. Format: SCR-{YYYY}-{8-digit sequence}. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; COPAS Compliance Standards; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: screening_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the automated sanctions list matching process. 'clear' = no match found on any screened list; 'match' = confirmed match against a sanctioned entity; 'potential_match' = algorithmic hit requiring human review; 'inconclusive' = insufficient data to determine match status. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category (non-monetary compliance event).
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List Matching Guidelines; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Resolution 1267; HM Treasury Financial Sanctions

attributes.name: screening_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sanctions screening event workflow. 'pending' = queued for screening; 'in_progress' = screening underway; 'completed' = screening concluded with a disposition; 'escalated' = referred to senior compliance officer or legal; 'cancelled' = screening voided. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; EU Regulation 2016/1675; FATF Recommendation 10

attributes.name: screening_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the sanctions screening was executed against the applicable screening lists. This is the principal real-world event time for the screening transaction, distinct from record creation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: OFAC 31 CFR Part 501; FATF Recommendation 10; EU Regulation 2580/2001

attributes.name: screening_trigger_event
attributes.description: Description of the specific business event that triggered this screening, particularly for 'triggered' and 'ad_hoc' screening types. Examples: 'New contract execution', 'Ownership change notification', 'Adverse media alert', 'Country risk upgrade', 'Credit limit increase', 'Joint venture partner addition'.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Recommendation 10; EU Regulation 2016/1675

attributes.name: screening_type
attributes.description: Classification of the screening event by its business trigger. 'onboarding' = initial screening at counterparty onboarding; 'periodic' = scheduled recurring review; 'triggered' = event-driven re-screening (e.g., adverse media, ownership change, country risk change); 'ad_hoc' = manual compliance officer request; 'renewal' = screening at contract or credit renewal.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Program Guidelines; FATF Recommendation 10; EU Regulation 2016/1675; BSEE Counterparty Compliance

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or reference number from the originating operational system that initiated or recorded this sanctions screening event (e.g., Enablon HSE Management compliance module reference, SAP S/4HANA vendor master screening reference, or KYC workflow system reference). Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master; Enablon HSE Management Compliance Module; NIST Cybersecurity Framework Data Lineage

attributes.name: un_security_council_list_checked
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations (UN) Security Council Consolidated List Checked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the UN Security Council Consolidated List (maintained under UNSCR 1267 and successor resolutions) was included in this screening event. Applies globally to all counterparties under international sanctions obligations.
attributes.references: UN Security Council Resolution 1267; UN Security Council Resolution 1988; UN Security Council Resolution 2253

products.name: customer_volume_commitment
products.description: Customer volume commitment record under a term supply agreement, capturing commitment period (annual, quarterly, monthly), minimum committed volume (BBL, MT, MMBTU), maximum contracted volume, take-or-pay obligation, make-up period, product grade, delivery point, actual delivered volume to date, shortfall volume, shortfall penalty rate, and commitment status. Supports commercial contract performance monitoring and revenue forecasting for term offtake customers.

attributes.name: customer_volume_commitment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer volume commitment record. Primary key for this entity. Entity Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a binding contractual volume obligation under a term supply agreement.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Volume commitments are often account-specific, not just counterparty-level. An account represents a specific commercial relationship with its own terms, and volume commitments are tied to that relatio

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent term supply or offtake agreement under which this volume commitment is established. Links the commitment to its governing commercial contract.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Contract (VA41/VA42); FERC; COPAS

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (IOC, NOC, refiner, trader, wholesale buyer, or industrial consumer) who holds this volume commitment obligation under the term supply agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Customer Master (KNA1); COPAS

attributes.name: delivery_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.delivery_point. Business justification: Volume commitment delivery_point string should be a FK reference to the delivery_point master table. This enables proper referential integrity and standardization of delivery locations. The delivery_p

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal commercial manager or account manager responsible for monitoring and managing this volume commitment, including shortfall notifications, nomination coordination, and customer relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Representative; COPAS

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Shortfall penalties, makeup rights, and deferred revenue from take-or-pay contracts post to specific GL accounts. Required for revenue recognition (ASC 606) and contract liability accounting.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Volume commitments may reference JOA partner offtake obligations and take-or-pay provisions. Supports JOA partner commitment tracking, equity crude offtake agreements, shortfall penalty calculation, a

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Volume commitments are product-specific (e.g., 50,000 bopd of Brent crude, 100 MMcfd of pipeline gas). Take-or-pay contracts require tracking committed volumes by petroleum product for shortfall calcu

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Take-or-pay commitments and shortfall penalties impact field/asset-level P&L tracked by profit center. Required for revenue assurance, contract performance monitoring, and field-level margin analysis.

attributes.name: accrued_shortfall_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of shortfall penalties accrued against this commitment to date, calculated as shortfall_volume multiplied by shortfall_penalty_rate, expressed in currency_code. Used for revenue forecasting, accounts receivable provisioning, and commercial contract performance monitoring.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI/SD Modules; SOX

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: The internal business unit or profit center code responsible for this volume commitment, used for revenue attribution, OPEX/CAPEX allocation, and management reporting. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA CO module profit center structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Profit Center Accounting; COPAS; SOX

attributes.name: commitment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for commercial and operational notes related to this volume commitment, including special conditions, waivers, amendments, or contextual information relevant to contract performance monitoring. Classified confidential due to commercially sensitive contract terms.

attributes.name: commitment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this volume commitment record, used in commercial correspondence, invoicing, and contract performance reporting. Typically assigned by the SAP SD contract management module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Scheduling Agreement; COPAS

attributes.name: commitment_period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commitment measurement period — annual, quarterly, monthly, or spot. Determines the cadence at which minimum volume obligations are assessed and shortfall penalties are calculated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Scheduling Agreement; FERC Natural Gas Tariff Regulations; COPAS

attributes.name: commitment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the volume commitment. 'active' indicates the commitment period is in force; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold; 'fulfilled' indicates the minimum committed volume has been met; 'shortfall' indicates the customer has not met the minimum take-or-pay obligation; 'terminated' indicates the commitment has been cancelled; 'pending' indicates awaiting activation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year number (e.g., 1, 2, 3) within a multi-year term supply agreement to which this volume commitment record applies. Supports multi-year offtake agreements where annual committed volumes may escalate or de-escalate across contract years.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15; COPAS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this volume commitment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage, SOX compliance, and Silver Layer data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the shortfall penalty rate and any financial settlement amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency commercial agreements in international oil and gas marketing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: delivered_volume_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative actual volume delivered to the customer against this commitment from the start of the commitment period to the most recent measurement date, expressed in volume_uom. Used to calculate remaining obligation and shortfall exposure. Sourced from Avocet Production Operations daily production allocation.
attributes.references: Avocet Production Operations — Production Allocation; API MPMS; COPAS

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: The primary mode of transportation by which committed volumes are delivered to the customer at the delivery point. Determines logistics planning, scheduling, and applicable tariff structures.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations; API MPMS; SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Modules

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country to which committed volumes are to be delivered. Used for export compliance, sanctions screening, and regulatory reporting to BOEM, BSEE, and EPA.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC Export Regulations; EPA; BOEM; BSEE; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date on which this volume commitment period becomes binding and the minimum volume obligation begins to accrue. Aligns with the contract commencement date or the start of the applicable commitment period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; COPAS

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this volume commitment period expires and the minimum volume obligation ceases to accrue. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen commitments. Used to determine the commitment window for shortfall calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; COPAS

attributes.name: force_majeure_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the force majeure event was resolved and normal volume commitment obligations resumed. Nullable if the force majeure event is still active. Used to determine the period of obligation suspension.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: force_majeure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a force majeure event has been declared for this commitment period, suspending the customer's minimum volume obligation and associated shortfall penalty accrual. True = force majeure declared and active; False = normal commercial terms apply.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; FERC

attributes.name: force_majeure_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the force majeure event was formally declared, suspending volume commitment obligations. Populated only when force_majeure_flag is True. Used to calculate the duration of obligation suspension for contract performance reporting.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The International Commercial Terms (INCOTERMS 2020) code governing the transfer of risk, cost, and title for volumes delivered under this commitment. Determines the delivery point obligations and insurance responsibilities between seller and buyer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|CFR|DAP|DDP|FCA|EXW|CPT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: INCOTERMS 2020 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD Module; API MPMS

attributes.name: invoiced_shortfall_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of shortfall penalties that have been formally invoiced to the customer under this commitment to date, expressed in currency_code. Distinguishes between accrued (estimated) and billed (invoiced) shortfall amounts for accounts receivable and revenue recognition purposes.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Modules; SOX

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this volume commitment record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: makeup_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days following the end of the commitment period during which the customer may make up shortfall volumes from a prior period without incurring the shortfall penalty. A make-up right allows the customer to lift deferred volumes in a subsequent period to offset previously paid or accrued penalties.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; FERC Natural Gas Tariff Regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: makeup_volume_available
attributes.description: The remaining volume the customer is entitled to lift as make-up against previously paid shortfall penalties, expressed in volume_uom. Tracks the outstanding make-up entitlement balance that has not yet been exercised within the make-up period.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; FERC Natural Gas Tariff Regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: max_contracted_volume
attributes.description: The maximum volume the seller is obligated to supply and the customer is entitled to lift during the commitment period, expressed in volume_uom. Defines the ceiling of the seller's delivery obligation and caps the customer's offtake entitlement under the term supply agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15; COPAS; FERC

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the delivered_volume_to_date, shortfall_volume, makeup_volume_available, and accrued_shortfall_penalty_amount figures were last calculated and recorded. Provides the temporal reference point for all volume and financial performance metrics on this record.
attributes.references: API MPMS; Avocet Production Operations; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS

attributes.name: min_committed_volume
attributes.description: The minimum volume the customer is contractually obligated to take or pay for during the commitment period, expressed in the unit of measure defined by volume_uom. This is the take-or-pay (TOP) floor quantity. Failure to lift this volume triggers shortfall penalty calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Scheduling Agreement; IFRS 15; COPAS; FERC Natural Gas Tariff

attributes.name: nomination_deadline_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days prior to the delivery period start by which the customer must submit a volume nomination to the seller. Governs the commercial scheduling process and determines the latest date for volume scheduling in the supply chain.
attributes.references: FERC Natural Gas Tariff Regulations; API MPMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: The benchmark price index to which the committed volume pricing is linked when pricing_basis is 'index_linked' or 'spot_differential' (e.g., WTI NYMEX, Brent ICE, Henry Hub NYMEX, Platts Dated Brent). Used for invoice calculation and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: FERC; NYMEX/CME Group; ICE; Platts; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The pricing mechanism governing the commercial value of volumes delivered under this commitment. 'fixed' = agreed fixed price per unit; 'index_linked' = tied to a benchmark index (e.g., WTI, Brent, Henry Hub); 'formula' = calculated via a contractual formula; 'spot_differential' = spot price plus/minus a negotiated differential.
attributes.references: FERC Natural Gas Tariff; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days prior to the commitment expiry date by which the customer must provide written notice to exercise the renewal option. Populated only when renewal_option_flag is True. Supports contract expiry management and commercial relationship planning.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the term supply agreement governing this commitment includes a renewal option that the customer may exercise at or before the effective_until date. True = renewal option exists; False = no renewal option. Supports commercial contract lifecycle management and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Leases; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS

attributes.name: shortfall_penalty_rate
attributes.description: The contractual penalty rate applied per unit of shortfall volume when the customer fails to meet the minimum committed volume (take-or-pay obligation). Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code per volume_uom unit. Used to calculate the shortfall penalty invoice amount.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15; FERC

attributes.name: shortfall_volume
attributes.description: The volume by which the customer's actual deliveries fall short of the minimum committed volume at the end of the commitment period, expressed in volume_uom. Calculated as max(0, min_committed_volume - delivered_volume_to_date). A positive value triggers shortfall penalty invoicing.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15

attributes.name: take_or_pay_pct
attributes.description: The take-or-pay (TOP) percentage of the maximum contracted volume that the customer must either lift or pay for during the commitment period. For example, 80% means the customer must take or pay for at least 80% of the maximum contracted volume. Used to derive the minimum committed volume when expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; FERC Natural Gas Tariff Regulations; IFRS 15

attributes.name: tolerance_pct
attributes.description: The contractually permitted percentage variance (plus or minus) around the nominated or committed volume within which actual deliveries are considered compliant without triggering shortfall or excess penalties. For example, 5% means actual delivery between 95% and 105% of nominated volume is acceptable.
attributes.references: API MPMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Scheduling Agreement Tolerance; FERC

attributes.name: volume_escalation_pct
attributes.description: The contractually agreed annual percentage by which the minimum committed volume escalates (or de-escalates if negative) from one contract year to the next. Supports long-term offtake agreements with volume ramp-up provisions common in LNG and pipeline gas supply contracts.
attributes.references: FERC Natural Gas Tariff; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which all volume fields (minimum committed, maximum contracted, delivered, shortfall) are expressed. BBL = Barrels, MT = Metric Tonnes, MMBTU = Million British Thermal Units, MCF = Thousand Cubic Feet, MMCF = Million Cubic Feet, BOE = Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE). Consistent UOM is required for contract performance monitoring and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards (MPMS); SPE PRMS; FERC

products.name: customer_product_approval
products.description: Customer-level approved product list (APL) record specifying which petroleum products, crude grades, or petrochemical products a customer is approved to purchase, including product code, grade specification, approved quality parameters (API gravity, sulfur, viscosity, flash point), approval date, approving authority, approval basis (technical qualification, regulatory license, end-use declaration), expiry date, and approval status. Ensures regulatory and commercial compliance for product sales.

attributes.name: customer_product_approval_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer-level approved product list (APL) record. Primary key for the product_approval entity. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a binding commercial authorization governing which petroleum products, crude grades, or petrochemical products a customer is approved to purchase.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; API RP standards

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific commercial account under which this product approval is issued. Supports account-level APL management within a customer hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Account Management

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the employee who formally approved this product authorization record. Enables traceability to the specific individual for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA HR Module

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom this product approval is granted. Links to the customer master record in the SSOT customer domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Customer Master

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Customer-approved products must map to procured materials for supply chain planning and approved vendor list (AVL) management. Business process: material qualification workflow, customer specification

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Product approvals qualify specific petroleum products for sale to customers based on technical specifications, regulatory licenses, and customer facility compatibility. Gate-keeping process before nom

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: Approved API gravity specification for the product, measured in degrees API. Defines the density-based quality parameter the customer is authorized to receive. Applicable primarily to crude oil and condensate approvals. Null for non-crude products.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) — API Gravity Standard; ASTM D287

attributes.name: approval_basis
attributes.description: The commercial or regulatory basis upon which this product approval was granted. Technical qualification indicates the customer has demonstrated technical capability to handle the product. Regulatory license indicates a government-issued permit. End-use declaration indicates the customer has declared the intended use of the product.
attributes.references: EPA regulations; PHMSA pipeline safety regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 Process Safety Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the product approval was formally granted and signed off by the approving authority. Represents the principal business event date for this authorization record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS accounting standards

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this product approval record, used in commercial correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Format: APL-{CustomerCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: API RP 11S; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Management

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the product approval record. Active indicates the customer is currently authorized to purchase the product. Suspended indicates a temporary hold. Revoked indicates permanent cancellation. Pending indicates awaiting final authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Customer Condition Status; COPAS standards

attributes.name: approval_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product approval by its commercial and operational nature. Standard approvals are routine term authorizations. Provisional approvals are temporary pending full qualification. Conditional approvals carry specific conditions precedent. Emergency approvals are expedited for operational continuity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Types; COPAS standards

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or designation of the organizational role or individual (e.g., Commercial Director, Product Manager, Credit Committee) that granted this product approval. Supports audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Internal Controls; COPAS standards

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the master sales contract, term supply agreement, or spot contract under which this product approval is issued. Links the APL record to the governing commercial agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; COPAS contract standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product approval record was first created in the system. Mandatory audit field for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Audit Trail; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Approved mode of delivery for the product to the customer. Constrains logistics and transportation planning. Relevant for PHMSA pipeline safety compliance and FERC transportation regulations.
attributes.references: PHMSA pipeline safety regulations; FERC transportation regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this product approval becomes binding and the customer is authorized to place purchase orders for the approved product. Aligns with contract commencement or qualification completion date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this product approval expires and the customer's authorization to purchase the product lapses. Null indicates an open-ended approval with no fixed expiry. Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: end_use_declaration
attributes.description: Customer's declared intended end-use for the approved product (e.g., refinery feedstock, power generation, petrochemical feedstock, retail distribution, export). Required for regulatory compliance, export control, and sanctions screening under OFAC and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA end-use regulations; OFAC export control compliance; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 172

attributes.name: export_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product approval is subject to export control regulations (e.g., EAR, ITAR, or country-specific export licensing requirements). When true, additional regulatory license verification is required before each shipment.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC export controls; EPA export regulations

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Approved minimum flash point temperature in degrees Celsius for the product. Critical safety and regulatory parameter for product handling, storage, and transportation classification under PHMSA and OSHA hazardous materials regulations.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 173 — Hazardous Materials; ASTM D93; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.description: Maximum approved Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) content in parts per million (ppm) for the product specification. Critical safety parameter for sour crude and sour gas approvals. Governs handling requirements and HSE compliance under OSHA and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1000 — H2S exposure limits; EPA Clean Air Act; API RP 55

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: DOT/PHMSA hazardous materials classification code for the approved product (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 2.1 Flammable Gas). Required for transportation compliance documentation and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 172 — Hazardous Materials Table; DOT hazmat classification

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the approved delivery terms and risk transfer point for this product approval. Governs title transfer, insurance, and freight responsibility in petroleum product sales contracts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|DDP|DAP|FCA|CFR|EXW — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; IFRS 15 — Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's Know Your Customer (KYC) verification was confirmed as current and valid at the time this product approval was granted. Ensures AML and sanctions compliance prior to product authorization.
attributes.references: FATF Recommendations; OFAC sanctions compliance; Enablon HSE Management compliance module

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this product approval record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 — Audit Trail; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: max_volume_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Approved Volume (Barrels of Oil Per Day)
attributes.description: Maximum daily purchase volume in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD) the customer is authorized to lift under this approval. Supports production allocation, supply planning, and OPEC quota compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: OPEC production quota framework; SAP S/4HANA SD Volume Contracts; Avocet Production Operations

attributes.name: max_volume_mcfd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Approved Volume (Thousand Cubic Feet per Day)
attributes.description: Maximum daily purchase volume in Thousand Cubic Feet per Day (MCFD) for natural gas and NGL product approvals. Null for liquid product approvals. Supports FERC-regulated gas marketing compliance.
attributes.references: FERC natural gas marketing regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Volume Contracts

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and revalidation of this product approval. Calculated from approval_date and review_frequency. Triggers automated compliance workflow in Enablon HSE Management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; Enablon HSE Management compliance scheduling

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Approved pricing mechanism or benchmark index for this product approval (e.g., WTI-linked, Brent-linked, Platts index, fixed price). Defines the commercial pricing framework under which the customer may purchase the product.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: regulatory_license_expiry
attributes.description: Expiry date of the government-issued regulatory license or permit associated with this product approval. Sales must be suspended if the license expires. Triggers compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: EPA licensing requirements; PHMSA 49 CFR; BSEE offshore regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_license_number
attributes.description: Government-issued license or permit number authorizing the customer to purchase, handle, or transport the specified product. Required for controlled substances, hazardous materials, and export-controlled products. Issued by EPA, PHMSA, BSEE, or equivalent authority.
attributes.references: EPA licensing requirements; PHMSA 49 CFR; BSEE offshore regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this product approval must be reviewed and revalidated. Drives compliance calendar and renewal workflow. Annual review is standard for most petroleum product approvals.
attributes.references: SOX internal controls; COPAS standards; SAP S/4HANA SD periodic review

attributes.name: ron
attributes.description: Approved Research Octane Number (RON) specification for gasoline and blending component approvals. Defines the anti-knock quality parameter the customer is authorized to purchase. Null for non-gasoline products.
attributes.references: ASTM D2699 — Research Octane Number; API fuel quality standards; EPA Tier 3

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer was screened against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists prior to granting this product approval. Mandatory compliance check for all petroleum product sales authorizations.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; SOX compliance

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational system record for this product approval (e.g., SAP S/4HANA SD condition record number, Quorum Land System reference). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; NIST Cybersecurity Framework — Data Provenance

attributes.name: sulfur_content_pct
attributes.description: Maximum approved sulfur content (% weight) for the product specification. Critical quality parameter for crude oil (sweet vs. sour classification) and refined products (ULSD, gasoline). Supports EPA and PHMSA regulatory compliance for product sales.
attributes.references: EPA Tier 3 Fuel Standards; ASTM D4294; API Bulletin 2509C

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for suspending or revoking this product approval (e.g., KYC expiry, sanctions hit, credit hold, regulatory license lapse, quality non-compliance). Populated when approval_status is suspended or revoked.
attributes.references: OFAC compliance; COPAS standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Credit Management

attributes.name: tan_max
attributes.description: Maximum approved Total Acid Number (TAN) in mg KOH/g for crude oil or refined product approvals. High TAN values indicate corrosive crude that requires specialized refinery equipment. Null for non-applicable products.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 — Total Acid Number; API Bulletin 2509C; Aspen HYSYS corrosion modeling

attributes.name: technical_qualification_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the technical qualification assessment, site inspection report, or laboratory certification that forms the basis for this product approval. Applicable when approval_basis is technical_qualification.
attributes.references: API RP standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: viscosity_cst
attributes.description: Approved kinematic viscosity specification in centistokes (cSt) at the reference temperature for the product. Relevant for fuel oils, lubricants, bitumen, and heavy crude approvals. Null for gaseous products.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to the maximum approved volume fields for this product approval. Ensures unambiguous interpretation of volume constraints across crude oil, gas, NGL, and petrochemical product types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOPD|MCFD|MMCFD|MT|BBL|MT_MONTH|BBL_MONTH — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards (MPMS); SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure

products.name: end_use_declaration
products.description: Customer end-use declaration record certifying the intended use of purchased petroleum products, including declaration reference, declaration date, product, declared end use (power generation, petrochemical feedstock, marine bunker, aviation fuel, retail distribution, industrial fuel), declared quantity, destination country, regulatory license number, signatory name, signatory authority, and declaration validity period. Required for export compliance, sanctions compliance, and product diversion prevention.
products.reference: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) / OFAC End-Use Controls

attributes.name: end_use_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the end-use declaration record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete compliance document with its own lifecycle, signatory, and validity period.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal compliance officer or trade compliance analyst responsible for reviewing and approving this end-use declaration.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; SOX Internal Controls; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: prior_declaration_end_use_declaration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous end-use declaration record that this declaration amends, renews, or replaces. Null for initial declarations. Enables declaration lineage tracking.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the end-use declaration was formally approved by the compliance officer following successful review. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: compliance_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the internal trade compliance review of this end-use declaration. 'not_started' = awaiting review; 'in_progress' = under active review; 'approved' = compliance review passed; 'rejected' = failed compliance review; 'waived' = review waived under documented exception.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the petroleum product sales contract or term agreement under which the purchase covered by this end-use declaration is made. Links the declaration to the commercial transaction for audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; COPAS Accounting Standards; Internal Contract Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this end-use declaration record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Audit trail field conforming to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the end-use declaration was formally signed and issued by the customer or counterparty. This is the principal business event date of the document.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework; API RP 100

attributes.name: declaration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this end-use declaration document, used for correspondence with customers, regulators, and trade compliance authorities. Format: EUD-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821; OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the end-use declaration. 'draft' indicates preparation in progress; 'submitted' indicates received from customer; 'under_review' indicates compliance review in progress; 'approved' indicates validated and accepted; 'rejected' indicates failed compliance review; 'expired' indicates validity period lapsed; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer declaration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|expired|superseded — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

attributes.name: declaration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the declaration document: 'initial' for first-time declarations for a new purchase arrangement; 'renewal' for periodic re-issuance of an existing declaration; 'amendment' for modification of a previously approved declaration; 'replacement' for a declaration superseding a rejected or expired one.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: declared_end_use
attributes.description: The intended end use of the purchased petroleum product as declared by the customer. Permissible values: 'power_generation' (electricity generation at power plants), 'petrochemical_feedstock' (feedstock for petrochemical manufacturing), 'marine_bunker' (marine vessel bunkering fuel), 'aviation_fuel' (aviation turbine fuel for aircraft), 'retail_distribution' (downstream retail fuel distribution), 'industrial_fuel' (industrial heating, process fuel). Critical for export compliance and product diversion prevention.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework; EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821; PHMSA Regulations

attributes.name: declared_quantity
attributes.description: The volume or quantity of petroleum product covered by this end-use declaration as declared by the customer. Used in conjunction with declared_quantity_unit to express the full measurement.
attributes.references: API MPMS (Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards); U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

attributes.name: declared_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the declared quantity. BBL = Barrels (standard petroleum volume unit per API MPMS); MT = Metric Tonnes; MMBTU = Million British Thermal Units (for gas); MCF = Thousand Cubic Feet; MMCF = Million Cubic Feet; KL = Kilolitres.
attributes.references: API MPMS (Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards); ASTM International

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country where the petroleum product will be delivered and consumed as per the declared end use. Critical for export licensing, OFAC sanctions screening, and trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; OFAC Sanctions List; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

attributes.name: destination_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific facility, terminal, refinery, power plant, or industrial installation where the petroleum product will be consumed or processed as per the declared end use.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework
