attributes.name: digital_signature_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the end-use declaration was executed with a legally recognized digital or electronic signature (True) or as a wet-ink physical signature (False). Relevant for e-signature legal validity under applicable jurisdiction.
attributes.references: U.S. Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (ESIGN); EU eIDAS Regulation; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

attributes.name: diversion_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this end-use declaration has been flagged as presenting a risk of petroleum product diversion — i.e., the declared end use may not reflect the actual intended use or the product may be re-exported to a sanctioned destination. True = diversion risk identified; False = no diversion risk.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework; Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) Red Flag Indicators

attributes.name: document_format
attributes.description: File format of the stored end-use declaration document. PDF = Portable Document Format (most common for signed declarations); DOCX = Microsoft Word; TIFF = scanned image; XML = structured electronic format; EDI = Electronic Data Interchange.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Record-Keeping Requirements (15 CFR Part 762)

attributes.name: document_storage_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the scanned or digitally signed end-use declaration document stored in the enterprise document management system (e.g., SAP DMS or SharePoint). Enables retrieval of the original signed document for audit.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Record-Keeping Requirements (15 CFR Part 762)

attributes.name: end_use_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description providing additional detail on the specific end use of the petroleum product beyond the declared_end_use category, including facility name, process description, or specific application context.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: World Customs Organization Harmonized System tariff classification code for the petroleum product, required for export licensing, customs declarations, and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this end-use declaration record was most recently modified in the Silver Layer data product. Supports change tracking, incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 8601; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: license_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the regulatory export license or import permit referenced in regulatory_license_number. Used to trigger license renewal workflows and prevent shipments under expired authorizations.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

attributes.name: license_issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency or regulatory body that issued the regulatory license or permit referenced in regulatory_license_number (e.g., 'U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security', 'BOEM', 'UK Export Control Joint Unit').
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); BOEM; Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code identifying the specific petroleum product (e.g., crude oil grade, refined product, NGL, LPG, LNG) covered by this end-use declaration. Aligns with the product catalogue used in SAP S/4HANA MM module.
attributes.references: API Recommended Practice; SAP S/4HANA MM Product Master

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the petroleum product covered by this declaration (e.g., 'Arabian Light Crude', 'Jet A-1 Aviation Fuel', 'LPG Propane', 'Marine Fuel Oil 0.5%S').
attributes.references: API Recommended Practice; ASTM International Product Standards

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Customer purchase order number associated with the petroleum product transaction covered by this end-use declaration. Used to cross-reference the declaration against the commercial order in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module; COPAS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_license_number
attributes.description: The export license, import permit, or regulatory authorization number issued by the relevant government authority (e.g., BIS export license, BOEM permit, national energy ministry authorization) that governs the purchase and end use of the petroleum product.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); BOEM Regulations; Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for rejection when compliance_review_status is 'rejected'. Documents the specific compliance deficiency, missing information, or regulatory concern that caused the declaration to fail review.
attributes.references: OFAC Compliance Framework; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent sanctions screening was performed for this end-use declaration, covering destination country, end-use facility, and signatory.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of the OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions screening performed on the destination country, end-use facility, and signatory associated with this declaration. 'pending' = not yet screened; 'cleared' = no matches found; 'flagged' = potential match requiring review; 'escalated' = confirmed match escalated to compliance team.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

attributes.name: signatory_authority
attributes.description: The legal basis under which the signatory is authorized to execute the end-use declaration on behalf of the customer entity. Values: 'board_resolution', 'power_of_attorney', 'delegated_authority', 'corporate_officer', 'authorized_signatory'.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework; Corporate Governance Standards

attributes.name: signatory_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the signatory, used for correspondence, declaration acknowledgement, and compliance follow-up communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual who signed the end-use declaration on behalf of the customer or counterparty organization. Required for legal enforceability and compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: Official job title or position of the signatory within the customer organization (e.g., 'Chief Procurement Officer', 'VP Supply Chain', 'Authorized Trading Representative'), used to verify signatory authority.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational system record from which this end-use declaration was ingested into the Silver Layer (e.g., SAP S/4HANA document number, Enablon compliance record ID). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the signed end-use declaration was received and formally submitted to Oil Gas for compliance processing. May differ from declaration_date if the document was signed earlier and submitted later.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: The expiry date of the end-use declaration validity period. After this date the declaration is no longer accepted for new shipments and must be renewed. Null indicates open-ended validity subject to regulatory review.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821; OFAC Compliance Framework

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The start date of the period during which this end-use declaration is considered valid and binding for the declared petroleum product purchases.
attributes.references: U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR); EU Dual-Use Regulation 2021/821

products.name: bank_detail
products.description: Customer banking and settlement instruction record capturing bank name, SWIFT/BIC code, IBAN or account number, correspondent bank details, beneficiary name, currency, payment routing preference, intermediary bank, and verification status. Required for accounts receivable settlement, letter of credit processing, and wire transfer execution across international crude oil, LNG, and refined product transactions.

attributes.name: bank_detail_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank detail record. Primary key for customer banking and settlement instruction records.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer account associated with this banking instruction. Supports multiple bank details per customer account for different currencies or payment types.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or counterparty associated with this bank detail record. Links to the customer master data for IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, wholesale buyers, industrial consumers, and retail distributors.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who approved this bank detail record. Required for segregation of duties and audit trail in financial controls per SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the beneficiary account holder as registered with the bank. Must match KYC records and contract counterparty legal name for compliance and payment processing.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Status of internal approval workflow for this bank detail record. Approved records are eligible for payment processing; pending approval requires management review; rejected records are blocked; under review indicates compliance investigation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bank detail record was approved for payment processing. Required for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: bank_address_city
attributes.description: City location of the beneficiary bank branch. Used for payment routing and correspondent bank identification in international settlements.

attributes.name: bank_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary address line of the beneficiary bank branch. Required for wire transfer instructions and correspondent banking relationships.

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the bank location. Critical for sanctions compliance, correspondent banking relationships, and regulatory reporting in cross-border petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: bank_detail_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bank detail record. Active records are eligible for payment processing; pending verification requires compliance review; suspended records are temporarily blocked; expired records require renewal.

attributes.name: bank_detail_type
attributes.description: Classification of the banking instruction by purpose and payment method. Primary is the default settlement account; alternate provides backup routing; escrow supports joint venture and production sharing agreement settlements; letter of credit for trade finance.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the beneficiary bank institution. Required for wire transfer execution and accounts receivable settlement across international crude oil, LNG, and refined product transactions.

attributes.name: beneficiary_address_city
attributes.description: City of the beneficiary address. Required for payment routing and compliance screening in international crude oil and LNG settlements.

attributes.name: beneficiary_address_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the beneficiary address. Used for sanctions screening, jurisdiction risk assessment, and regulatory reporting in international petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: beneficiary_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary address line for the beneficiary. Required for international wire transfer compliance and anti-money laundering verification in cross-border petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Name of the ultimate beneficiary receiving the payment. May differ from account holder name in cases of third-party payment arrangements or joint venture settlements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bank detail record was first created in the system. Required for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for this bank account. Supports multi-currency settlement requirements for international crude oil, LNG, and refined product transactions denominated in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and other currencies.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this bank detail record becomes active and eligible for payment processing. Supports time-bound banking instructions and planned account transitions.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date until which this bank detail record remains valid. Nullable for open-ended banking instructions. Used for temporary accounts, escrow arrangements, and time-limited joint venture settlements.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number for beneficiary account identification in SEPA and international markets. Used primarily for European and Middle Eastern counterparties in petroleum product settlements.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_account_number
attributes.description: Account number at the intermediary bank for routing the payment. Required for correspondent banking chains in international crude oil and LNG settlements.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the intermediary or correspondent bank used for routing international payments. Required when direct correspondent banking relationship does not exist between payer and beneficiary banks.

attributes.name: intermediary_bank_swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intermediary Bank Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC)
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code for the intermediary bank. Used for multi-hop international wire transfers in complex cross-border petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the bank detail has been validated against KYC records and beneficial ownership documentation. Required for anti-money laundering compliance in international petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional payment instructions, special handling requirements, or compliance notes. Used for documenting joint venture partner splits, letter of credit references, or regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: payment_instruction_reference
attributes.description: Additional payment reference or remittance information to be included in wire transfer instructions. Used for invoice reconciliation and joint venture partner identification in petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: payment_routing_preference
attributes.description: Preferred payment network or clearing system for settlement execution. SWIFT for international wire transfers, ACH for US domestic batch payments, SEPA for European transfers, Fedwire and CHIPS for US real-time gross settlement, TARGET2 for European central bank settlements, RTGS for real-time gross settlement in various jurisdictions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: swift|ach|sepa|fedwire|chips|target2|rtgs — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority order for payment processing when multiple bank details exist for the same customer account. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for automatic payment routing in accounts receivable settlement.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for this bank detail record. Used for cross-system reconciliation and customer communication regarding payment instructions.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number for US domestic wire transfers and ACH payments. Used for domestic crude oil and refined product settlements with US-based counterparties.
attributes.references: American Bankers Association (ABA) Routing Number Standard

attributes.name: sanctions_screened
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the bank and beneficiary have been screened against OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated, UN Security Council, and HM Treasury sanctions lists. Required before processing any payment in crude oil, LNG, or refined product transactions.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent sanctions screening for this bank detail record. Must be current within regulatory requirements before payment execution.

attributes.name: sort_code
attributes.description: Six-digit bank sort code for UK domestic payments. Used for settlements with UK-based refiners, traders, and wholesale buyers in the petroleum sector.
attributes.references: UK Payments Administration Sort Code Standard

attributes.name: swift_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC)
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code identifying the beneficiary bank for international wire transfers. Eight or eleven character code used for cross-border payment routing in crude oil, LNG, and refined product transactions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bank detail record was last modified. Required for audit trail and change tracking in financial master data.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the bank detail record was last verified through test transaction, bank confirmation letter, or third-party validation service. Required for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the bank account details. Test transaction sends small amount for confirmation; bank letter requires official bank documentation; third-party service uses external validation providers; customer declaration relies on signed attestation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of bank detail verification process. Verified indicates successful validation of account ownership and routing information; pending indicates awaiting compliance review; failed indicates validation errors; expired indicates reverification required.

attributes.name: previous_bank_detail_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bank_detail (previous_bank_detail_id)

products.name: tax_registration
products.description: Customer tax registration and fiscal identity record per jurisdiction, capturing tax identification number (TIN), VAT/GST registration number, withholding tax rate, tax exemption certificate reference, tax residency country, permanent establishment status, treaty benefit eligibility, and registration validity dates. Required for correct invoice tax treatment, withholding compliance, and cross-border petroleum product sales.

attributes.name: tax_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer tax registration record. Primary key for the tax registration entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Tax registrations can be account-specific in multi-jurisdiction scenarios. Different accounts under the same counterparty may operate in different tax jurisdictions with separate registration requirem

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer counterparty entity for which this tax registration applies. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: primary_tax_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the tax compliance officer responsible for verifying and maintaining this tax registration record.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for this tax registration record: draft (being prepared), pending_review (awaiting approval), approved (validated and active), rejected (failed validation).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax registration record was approved. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax registration record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_storage_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the stored tax registration documentation in the document management system. Enables retrieval of supporting documents for audit.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this tax registration becomes valid and should be applied to invoices and payments. Start of the registration validity period.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date when this tax registration expires or is no longer valid. Null for open-ended registrations. System must not apply this registration after this date.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the government tax authority or agency that issued this registration (e.g., IRS, HMRC, ATO). Provides context for registration validation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the tax jurisdiction where this registration is valid. Critical for determining applicable tax treaties and withholding rates.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or sub-national jurisdiction where the tax registration applies. Relevant for federal systems with state-level taxation (e.g., USA, Canada).

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the tax registration details were last verified with the tax authority or through official documentation. Used for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Entity Name for Tax Registration
attributes.description: The official legal name of the customer entity as registered with the tax authority. Must match tax documentation exactly for compliance.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and verification of tax registration details. Ensures ongoing compliance with tax regulations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or context regarding this tax registration. Used for documenting exceptions or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: permanent_establishment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has a permanent establishment in the jurisdiction. True if PE exists, affecting tax treaty application and withholding requirements.

attributes.name: registered_address_city
attributes.description: City of the registered address on file with the tax authority.

attributes.name: registered_address_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the registered address on file with the tax authority.

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the registered address on file with the tax authority. Required for tax correspondence and compliance verification.

attributes.name: registered_address_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the registered address on file with the tax authority.

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer was officially registered with the tax authority in this jurisdiction. Historical record of initial registration.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: The unique tax registration number or business identifier assigned by the tax authority in the jurisdiction. This is the externally-known identifier for tax purposes.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax registration: active (valid and in use), inactive (not currently used), suspended (temporarily halted by authority), pending (awaiting approval), expired (validity period ended), or revoked (cancelled by authority).

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: The category of tax registration: TIN (Tax Identification Number), VAT (Value Added Tax), GST (Goods and Services Tax), sales tax, withholding tax, or excise tax registration.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the tax registration was rejected during approval workflow. Null if approved or pending.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this tax registration record originated (e.g., SAP, Oracle, legacy system). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier or key of this tax registration record in the source system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate issued by the tax authority. Required for audit trail when applying tax exemptions to petroleum product sales.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the tax exemption certificate expires. System must revert to standard tax treatment after this date unless renewed.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer holds a valid tax exemption certificate for this jurisdiction. True if exempt, false otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_form_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the tax form or supporting documentation was received from the customer. Used for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_form_type
attributes.description: Type of tax form or documentation on file (e.g., W-9, W-8BEN, W-8BEN-E, VAT certificate). Indicates the nature of tax documentation supporting this registration.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The primary tax identification number assigned by the national tax authority. Used for income tax reporting and withholding compliance. May be the same as registration_number for TIN-type registrations.

attributes.name: tax_residency_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the customers tax residency. Determines treaty benefit eligibility and withholding tax obligations for cross-border petroleum transactions.

attributes.name: treaty_article_reference
attributes.description: Specific article or section of the tax treaty that grants the withholding rate reduction or exemption. Used for compliance documentation.

attributes.name: treaty_benefit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is eligible for reduced withholding tax rates under a bilateral tax treaty. True if eligible, false otherwise.

attributes.name: treaty_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the tax treaty that provides benefit eligibility. Null if no treaty applies.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT or GST registration number issued by the tax authority. Required for VAT invoice issuance and input tax credit claims on petroleum product sales.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable withholding tax rate percentage for payments to this customer in this jurisdiction. Used to calculate tax withholding on invoices and payments for cross-border petroleum sales.

attributes.name: superseded_tax_registration_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on tax_registration (superseded_tax_registration_id)

products.name: customer_term_contract
products.description: This association product represents the commercial contract between account and petroleum_product. It captures product-specific supply agreements that define contracted volumes, pricing mechanisms, delivery obligations, and quality specifications. Each record links one account to one petroleum_product with contractual terms that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship. Supports multi-product supply agreements where a single counterparty holds multiple product-specific contracts.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas commercial operations, accounts (counterparties) routinely hold multiple simultaneous term contracts for different petroleum products (crude grades, refined products, LNG, petrochemicals), and each petroleum product is sold to multiple accounts under separate contractual terms. The detection reasoning explicitly identifies term_contract as the junction entity with product-specific attributes: contracted volumes, pricing formulas, differentials, delivery terms, and quality tolerances. This is a classic operational M:N relationship where the contract itself is a managed business entity.

attributes.name: customer_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Primary key for customer_term_contract

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commercial account that is party to this term contract

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the petroleum product covered by this term contract

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the term contract. Used in commercial correspondence and legal documentation.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the master commercial contract or framework agreement governing this account relationship. Links to the contract management system for term offtake, tolling, or long-term supply agreements. [Moved from account: This attribute currently exists in the account product but represents a master contract reference. In a multi-product supply agreement scenario, each product has its own contract terms. The contract_reference in account may represent a framework agreement, while term_contract captures product-specific contracts. If contract_reference is truly product-specific (not a framework), it should move to term_contract as contract_number.]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; COPAS JOA Standards

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the term contract. Drives eligibility for order placement and delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commercial contract structure. Aligns with account_classification in the account master.

attributes.name: contracted_volume
attributes.description: Committed volume quantity for this product under the term contract. Expressed in the product's standard unit of measure (barrels, cubic meters, metric tons).

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: System timestamp when this term contract record was created.

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: Incoterms and delivery obligations specific to this product-account contract. May override account-level default delivery terms.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this term contract becomes legally effective and delivery obligations commence.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this term contract expires or terminates. Drives contract renewal workflows.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: System timestamp when this term contract record was last updated.

attributes.name: minimum_offtake_volume
attributes.description: Minimum volume the counterparty is obligated to purchase under take-or-pay provisions. Null if take_or_pay_flag is false.

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: Fixed differential (premium or discount) applied to the pricing benchmark for this product-account combination. Expressed in currency per unit (e.g., USD/BBL).

attributes.name: pricing_formula
attributes.description: Commercial pricing mechanism defining how the contract price is calculated. May reference benchmark indices (WTI, Brent, HH), fixed prices, or formula-based calculations with differentials.

attributes.name: quality_tolerance
attributes.description: Acceptable quality specification ranges for this product under this contract. Defines tolerances for API gravity, sulfur content, and other product-specific quality parameters.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Contract renewal mechanism defining how the contract may be extended beyond the expiration date.

attributes.name: take_or_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes take-or-pay provisions requiring minimum volume offtake regardless of actual delivery.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for contracted volume. Must align with product's standard UOM.

products.name: delivery_point_product_capability
products.description: This association product represents the operational capability and configuration for handling a specific petroleum product at a specific delivery point. It captures product-specific handling parameters, storage allocation, throughput limits, quality specifications, and segregation requirements that exist only in the context of this delivery point-product combination. Each record links one delivery point to one petroleum product with attributes that define how that product can be received, stored, and delivered at that facility.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas logistics operations, delivery points (terminals, ports, pipeline interconnects, refineries) are multi-product facilities that handle multiple petroleum products with product-specific operational configurations. A single terminal may handle crude oil, diesel, jet fuel, and LPG, each requiring different storage tanks, segregation protocols, heating systems, and throughput limits. Conversely, a single petroleum product (e.g., Brent crude) is delivered through multiple delivery points globally (North Sea terminals, Rotterdam, Cushing). The business actively manages product handling capabilities at each facility, tracking which products can be received/delivered where, with what specifications, and under what operational constraints.

attributes.name: delivery_point_product_capability_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this delivery point product capability record. Primary key.

attributes.name: delivery_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Delivery Point Product Capability - Delivery Point Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the delivery point facility where this product handling capability exists

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Delivery Point Product Capability - Petroleum Product Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the petroleum product that can be handled at this delivery point

attributes.name: allocated_storage_capacity_bbl
attributes.description: Storage capacity in barrels allocated specifically for this product at this delivery point. Product-specific allocation from the facility's total storage capacity. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as storage_capacity_bbl.

attributes.name: allocated_throughput_capacity_bopd
attributes.description: Maximum throughput rate in barrels per day allocated for this product at this delivery point. Product-specific throughput limit. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning as throughput_capacity_bopd.

attributes.name: blanketing_gas_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether inert gas blanketing is required for this product at this delivery point (e.g., for volatile products or oxidation-sensitive products). Safety and quality requirement.

attributes.name: capability_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this product handling capability. Controls whether nominations and scheduling can reference this capability.

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Special certifications or approvals required for handling this product at this delivery point (e.g., IMO certification, EPA permits, product-specific safety certifications).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this product handling capability became or becomes effective at this delivery point. Supports temporal tracking of capability changes. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this product handling capability expires or was discontinued at this delivery point. Null indicates currently active capability.

attributes.name: handling_capability
attributes.description: Operational capability mode for this product at this delivery point. Defines whether the facility can receive, deliver, or both for this specific product. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: heating_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether heating systems must be used for this product at this delivery point (e.g., for heavy crude or high pour-point products). Operational requirement flag.

attributes.name: loading_arm_compatibility
attributes.description: Specific loading arms or berths at this delivery point that are compatible with this product. References berth_number or loading arm identifiers from the delivery point.

attributes.name: max_batch_size_bbl
attributes.description: Maximum batch size in barrels for receiving or delivering this product at this delivery point. Operational constraint based on tankage and throughput.

attributes.name: min_batch_size_bbl
attributes.description: Minimum batch size in barrels for receiving or delivering this product at this delivery point. Operational constraint for scheduling.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Primary hydrocarbon product category handled at this delivery point. Determines applicable measurement standards, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements. Supports product compatibility validation during nomination and scheduling. [Moved from delivery_point: The product_category attribute in delivery_point is too coarse-grained. A delivery point handles multiple specific petroleum products, not just one category. This attribute should either be removed (derivable from the M:N relationship) or represents only the PRIMARY category, which is insufficient for multi-product facilities. The M:N relationship provides the true product-level granularity.] [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|lng|lpg|ngl|refined_products|petrochemicals|natural_gas — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API MPMS; API RP 1165; EPA Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: quality_specifications
attributes.description: Product-specific quality specifications and acceptance criteria required for this product at this delivery point. May reference quality spec documents or inline criteria. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

attributes.name: segregation_requirements
attributes.description: Segregation and contamination prevention requirements for this product at this delivery point. Defines whether dedicated tankage or pipeline segregation is required. Explicitly identified in detection reasoning.

products.name: license_interest
products.description: This association product represents the ownership interest relationship between counterparties and operating licenses in the oil and gas value chain. It captures the contractual participation of each counterparty in a specific operating license, including their working interest percentage, net revenue interest, operator status, and the temporal validity of their participation. Each record links one counterparty to one operating license with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship. This is the operational system of record for PSA/JOA interest tracking and production entitlement calculations.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas operations, operating licenses (exploration blocks, production licenses, PSAs) are typically held by multiple counterparties through joint operating agreements (JOAs) or production sharing agreements (PSAs). Each counterparty holds a specific working interest percentage and net revenue interest in each license, and each counterparty participates in multiple licenses across their portfolio. The business actively manages these participation records for production entitlement calculations, cost allocation, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: license_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each license interest record representing a counterparty's participation in an operating license.

attributes.name: counterparty_customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the counterparty who holds an interest in the operating license. Represents the participant in the PSA/JOA agreement.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to customer_counterparty. Identifies the participant holding the interest.

attributes.name: operating_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the operating license in which the counterparty holds an interest. Represents the licensed area or facility covered by the participation agreement.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this license interest record was created in the system. Used for audit and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this counterparty's interest in the operating license became effective. Used for temporal tracking of ownership changes, farm-ins, and farm-outs.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this counterparty's interest in the operating license expires or was terminated. Null indicates current active interest. Used for tracking historical participation and ownership transitions.

attributes.name: joa_signatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this counterparty is a signatory to the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) governing this license. Non-signatory participants may hold interests through assignment or farm-in agreements.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this license interest record was last modified. Used for audit and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_pct
attributes.description: The counterparty's net revenue interest percentage in this specific operating license. Represents the share of production revenue after royalties and other burdens. Used for production entitlement calculations.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this counterparty is the designated operator for this operating license. The operator is responsible for day-to-day operations and typically has the largest working interest. Only one participant per license should have operator_flag = true.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the counterparty's participation in this operating license. ACTIVE indicates current participation with entitlement to production. SUSPENDED indicates temporary halt due to regulatory or contractual issues. TERMINATED indicates participation has ended. PENDING indicates interest is under negotiation or regulatory approval.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this counterparty's interest has reached payout under the PSA or JOA terms. PRE_PAYOUT means capital costs are still being recovered. POST_PAYOUT means capital has been recovered and different revenue sharing terms apply. NOT_APPLICABLE for licenses without payout provisions.

attributes.name: working_interest_pct
attributes.description: The counterparty's working interest percentage in this specific operating license. Represents the share of capital expenditure and operating costs borne by this participant. Sum of all working interests for a license typically equals 100%.

products.name: counterparty_joa_participation
products.description: This association product represents the commercial participation relationship between customer counterparties and Joint Operating Agreements. It captures commercial offtake arrangements, pricing elections, and participation terms for counterparties who are commercial buyers or sellers under a JOA, distinct from working interest partners. Each record links one customer counterparty to one JOA with attributes that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint ventures, a single counterparty (e.g., a refiner or trader) can have commercial offtake or supply arrangements with multiple JOAs across different assets, and each JOA typically has multiple commercial counterparties beyond the working interest partners (offtakers, refiners, marketers, transporters). These commercial participation arrangements are actively managed operational relationships with specific terms, pricing elections, volume entitlements, and status tracking that belong to the relationship itself, not to either the counterparty master record or the JOA governance document.

attributes.name: counterparty_joa_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each counterparty JOA commercial participation record

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Counterparty Joa Participation - Customer Counterparty Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer counterparty participating in the JOA commercial arrangement

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Joint Operating Agreement under which the commercial participation is governed

attributes.name: commercial_relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the counterparty's commercial participation in the JOA. ACTIVE indicates ongoing commercial activity; SUSPENDED indicates temporary halt; TERMINATED indicates relationship ended; PENDING_APPROVAL indicates awaiting JOA partner approval

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier for the commercial contract or agreement that governs this counterparty's participation in the JOA

attributes.name: equity_offtake_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty has elected to take equity offtake (in-kind production allocation) under the JOA rather than cash settlement. True indicates physical offtake; false indicates cash or no offtake election

attributes.name: offtake_volume_entitlement_bbl
attributes.description: The volume of production in barrels that the counterparty is entitled to offtake under this JOA commercial arrangement, if applicable. Null for non-offtake roles

attributes.name: participation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the counterparty's commercial participation in the JOA became effective, marking the start of offtake rights or supply obligations

attributes.name: participation_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the counterparty's commercial participation in the JOA ended or is scheduled to end, if applicable. Null indicates ongoing participation

attributes.name: preferred_pricing_basis
attributes.description: The pricing benchmark or mechanism preferred by the counterparty for commercial transactions under this JOA. BRENT, WTI, DUBAI are crude benchmarks; PLATTS and ARGUS are pricing services; FIXED indicates fixed price; FORMULA indicates custom pricing formula

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the counterparty's commercial role in relation to the JOA. OFFTAKER indicates the counterparty purchases production; SUPPLIER provides goods or services; MARKETING_AGENT handles sales; REFINING_PARTNER processes crude; TRANSPORTATION_PROVIDER handles logistics

domains.name: product
domains.description: Serves as the SSOT for the petroleum product catalog including crude oil grades (WTI, Brent, sour/sweet), natural gas specifications, LNG, LPG, NGL streams, refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, fuel oil), and petrochemicals. Manages product quality specifications, API gravity, sulfur content, RON ratings, pricing benchmarks, and regulatory product classifications across the entire value chain.

products.name: petroleum_product
products.description: Master catalog and Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for all petroleum product identities across the value chain. Each product record represents a distinct marketable product — crude oil grades (WTI, Brent, Maya, Urals), natural gas, LNG, LPG, NGL fractions, refined fuels (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, fuel oil, naphtha), and petrochemicals. Captures product type discriminator, product family/subfamily, API gravity, sulfur content, phase state, regulatory product codes, and lifecycle status. All downstream entities (quality specs, assays, pricing, blending, classifications) reference this master via FK.
products.reference: API Product Classification / PRMS Commodity Classification

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the petroleum product record. Primary key for the petroleum product master catalog.

attributes.name: product_steward_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Product stewardship is fundamental in oil-and-gas operations. Each petroleum product requires a technical owner responsible for specifications, regulatory compliance, quality standards, and lifecycle

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity measurement in degrees API. Indicates the density of petroleum liquids relative to water. Light crude >31.1°, medium 22.3-31.1°, heavy <22.3°. Critical for pricing, refining yield optimization, and transportation planning.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Temperature and Pressure Volume Correction Factors for Generalized Crude Oils, Refined Products, and Lubricating Oils

attributes.name: blending_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is used as a blending component (True) or sold as a finished product (False). Blending components include naphtha, reformate, alkylate, MTBE, ethanol.

attributes.name: boe_conversion_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Conversion Factor
attributes.description: Conversion factor to normalize product volume to Barrel of Oil Equivalent for reserves reporting and production aggregation. Typically 1.0 for crude oil, ~6.0 for natural gas (6 mcf = 1 BOE).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10, SPE PRMS

attributes.name: carbon_intensity_g_mj
attributes.description: Lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions intensity in grams of CO2 equivalent per megajoule of energy. Used for LCFS compliance, carbon trading, and ESG reporting.
attributes.references: California LCFS, EU Renewable Energy Directive (RED II), ISO 14067 Carbon Footprint of Products

attributes.name: cetane_number
attributes.description: Cetane number for diesel fuel products. Measures ignition quality and combustion performance. Typical range 40-55. Null for non-diesel products.
attributes.references: ASTM D613 - Standard Test Method for Cetane Number of Diesel Fuel Oil

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: density_kg_m3
attributes.description: Density at standard conditions (15°C, 1 atm) in kilograms per cubic meter. Used for volume-to-mass conversions, custody transfer, and inventory management.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1, ISO 12185 - Crude Petroleum and Petroleum Products - Determination of Density

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was discontinued or phased out from the catalog. Null for active products. Used for product lifecycle management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this product record became active in the catalog. Used for temporal product lifecycle tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: epa_fuel_category
attributes.description: EPA fuel category classification for environmental compliance and emissions reporting. Examples: Conventional Gasoline, Reformulated Gasoline (RFG), Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel (ULSD).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 80 - Regulation of Fuels and Fuel Additives

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Flash point temperature in degrees Celsius. Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical for safety classification and transportation regulations.
attributes.references: ASTM D93 - Standard Test Methods for Flash Point by Pensky-Martens Closed Cup Tester, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: DOT/UN hazard classification for transportation and storage. Examples: Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 2.1 Flammable Gas. Determines packaging, labeling, and handling requirements.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 173, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: heating_value_mj_kg
attributes.description: Gross heating value (higher heating value) in megajoules per kilogram. Represents energy content of the fuel. Used for energy balance calculations and pricing.
attributes.references: ASTM D240 - Standard Test Method for Heat of Combustion of Liquid Hydrocarbon Fuels by Bomb Calorimeter

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: International Harmonized System tariff classification code. Used for customs declarations, import/export documentation, and trade compliance. 6-10 digit code depending on jurisdiction.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, U.S. Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this product record. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the product in the catalog. Determines availability for trading, production planning, and commercial transactions.

attributes.name: origin_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or basin where the product is typically sourced or produced. Examples: Permian Basin, North Sea, Middle East, Gulf Coast. Used for supply chain planning and quality differentiation.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group indicating degree of danger: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger). Used for transportation classification and packaging requirements.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, PHMSA 49 CFR Part 173

attributes.name: phase_state
attributes.description: Physical phase state of the product at standard temperature and pressure conditions. Determines storage, handling, and transportation requirements.
attributes.references: API Standards, ASME B31.3 Process Piping

attributes.name: pour_point_c
attributes.description: Pour point temperature in degrees Celsius. Lowest temperature at which the product will flow under prescribed conditions. Important for cold weather operations and storage.
attributes.references: ASTM D97 - Standard Test Method for Pour Point of Petroleum Products

attributes.name: pricing_benchmark
attributes.description: Reference pricing index or benchmark used for commercial valuation. Examples: WTI (West Texas Intermediate), Brent ICE, Henry Hub, Platts, Argus. Links product to market pricing mechanisms.
attributes.references: CME Group, ICE Futures, Platts, Argus Media

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the petroleum product. Used across trading, logistics, and commercial systems. Examples: WTI-CRUDE-01, BRENT-ICE, ULSD-10PPM.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Hierarchical product family grouping for reporting and analytics. Examples: Light Sweet Crude, Heavy Sour Crude, Reformulated Gasoline, Conventional Diesel, Ethylene, Propylene.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the petroleum product. Examples: West Texas Intermediate Crude Oil, Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel, Liquefied Natural Gas, Propane.

attributes.name: product_subfamily
attributes.description: Secondary hierarchical classification within the product family. Provides granular segmentation for specialized product variants.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Primary classification discriminator for the petroleum product. Defines the major product family within the value chain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|natural_gas|lng|lpg|ngl|gasoline|diesel|jet_fuel|fuel_oil|naphtha|kerosene|petrochemical|lubricant|asphalt|wax|other — 16 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_product_code
attributes.description: Government or regulatory agency product classification code. Used for EPA reporting, SEC reserves disclosure, FERC filings, and state regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR, SEC Regulation S-K Item 1200, FERC regulations

attributes.name: renewable_content_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of renewable or bio-based content in the product. Used for Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) compliance, Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) reporting, and ESG metrics. Zero for conventional petroleum products.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 80 Subpart M - Renewable Fuel Standard, California LCFS

attributes.name: ron_rating
attributes.description: Research Octane Number for gasoline products. Measures resistance to engine knock. Typical range 87-98 RON. Null for non-gasoline products.
attributes.references: ASTM D2699 - Standard Test Method for Research Octane Number of Spark-Ignition Engine Fuel

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum storage duration in days before product quality degradation or specification non-compliance. Null for products with indefinite shelf life under proper storage conditions.

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to detailed product specification document or standard. Examples: ASTM D975 for diesel fuel, ASTM D4814 for gasoline, API 5L for line pipe steel grade.
attributes.references: ASTM Standards, API Standards, ISO Standards

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum recommended storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Prevents thermal degradation, excessive vapor generation, and safety hazards.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 19.1, NFPA 30 Flammable and Combustible Liquids Code

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum recommended storage temperature in degrees Celsius. Critical for maintaining product quality and preventing solidification or phase separation.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 19.1 - Evaporative Loss Measurement, NFPA 30 Flammable and Combustible Liquids Code

attributes.name: sulfur_content_pct
attributes.description: Sulfur content expressed as weight percentage. Sweet crude <0.5%, sour crude >0.5%. Critical for environmental compliance (EPA, IMO 2020), refining complexity, and product pricing differentials.
attributes.references: API Standards, EPA Tier 3 Gasoline Sulfur Standards, IMO 2020 Marine Fuel Sulfur Cap

attributes.name: tan_value
attributes.description: Total Acid Number expressed in mg KOH/g. Measures acidity and corrosiveness of crude oil and refined products. High TAN (>0.5) indicates corrosive crude requiring special metallurgy.

attributes.name: tradeable_commodity_flag

attributes.name: environmental_classification

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: grade_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the crude grade by market role. Benchmark: globally traded pricing reference (WTI, Brent). Equity: company-owned production stream. Spot: opportunistic market purchase. Proprietary: custom refinery blend. Blend: mixed crude stream.

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the crude grade used in trading systems, refinery planning, and commercial contracts. Examples: WTI_CUSHING, BRENT_DATED, DUBAI_OMAN, URALS_RCMB, MAYA, ARAB_LIGHT.

attributes.name: grade_name
attributes.description: Full commercial name of the crude oil grade. Examples: West Texas Intermediate Cushing, Dated Brent, Dubai/Oman, Urals RCMB, Maya, Arab Light, Bonny Light.

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Content in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide content measured in parts per million (ppm). H2S is highly toxic and corrosive. Concentrations >100 ppm require special handling procedures and safety equipment. Critical for HSE risk assessment.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1000, API RP 55 - Safe Practices for Gas and Oil Well Servicing

attributes.name: metals_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Metals Content in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Total metals content (vanadium, nickel, iron) measured in parts per million (ppm). Metals poison refinery catalysts and reduce equipment life. High metals content reduces crude value and requires specialized processing.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Standard Test Methods for Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this crude grade record. Supports audit trail and data stewardship accountability.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards, SOX Controls

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crude grade record was last modified. Tracks data currency and supports change management processes.

attributes.name: nitrogen_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Nitrogen Content in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Nitrogen content measured in parts per million (ppm). Nitrogen compounds poison refinery catalysts and contribute to NOx emissions. Typical range: 100-5000 ppm. Impacts refining economics and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D4629 - Standard Test Method for Trace Nitrogen in Liquid Petroleum Hydrocarbons

attributes.name: origin_basin
attributes.description: Geological basin or region where the crude oil is produced. Examples: Permian Basin, North Sea, Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin, Ghawar Field, Orinoco Belt. Used for supply chain planning and geopolitical risk assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Exploration and Production Standards, SPE Basin Classification

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the crude oil origin. Examples: USA, GBR, SAU, RUS, VEN, NGA. Used for trade compliance, sanctions screening, and supply chain risk management.

attributes.name: origin_field_name
attributes.description: Specific oil field or production area where the crude is produced. Examples: Cushing Hub, Forties Field, Ghawar, Samotlor, Cantarell. Provides granular supply chain traceability and quality consistency tracking.

attributes.name: pour_point_c
attributes.description: Pour point temperature in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which the crude oil will flow under gravity. Critical for cold climate operations, storage, and transportation planning.
attributes.references: ASTM D97 - Standard Test Method for Pour Point

attributes.name: pricing_differential_usd_per_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pricing Differential in United States Dollars (USD) per Barrel (BBL)
attributes.description: Typical pricing differential versus the benchmark index in USD per barrel. Positive values indicate premium to benchmark; negative values indicate discount. Reflects quality, location, and market factors. Confidential commercial data.

attributes.name: refinery_compatibility_rating
attributes.description: Overall compatibility rating for processing in company refineries. Excellent: ideal crude slate component. Good: suitable with standard processing. Fair: requires blending or special handling. Poor: limited use cases. Restricted: requires capital upgrades or special metallurgy.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification for transportation and handling. May include DOT hazard class, UN number, IMDG classification, and special handling requirements. Example: UN 1267 Petroleum Crude Oil Class 3 Flammable Liquid.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 172 - Hazardous Materials Table, IMDG Code, UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: salt_content_ptb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salt Content in Pounds per Thousand Barrels (PTB)
attributes.description: Salt content measured in pounds per thousand barrels (PTB). High salt content causes corrosion and fouling in refinery equipment. Desalting is required before processing. Typical specification: <10 PTB for refinery feed.
attributes.references: ASTM D3230 - Standard Test Method for Salts in Crude Oil

attributes.name: sulfur_classification
attributes.description: Binary classification of crude oil by sulfur content. Sweet: ≤0.5% sulfur (lower processing cost, higher value). Sour: >0.5% sulfur (requires additional HDS processing, lower value). Key pricing and refinery selection criterion.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percent
attributes.description: Sulfur content by weight percentage. Critical quality parameter for refining economics and environmental compliance. Sweet crude: ≤0.5% sulfur. Sour crude: >0.5% sulfur. Impacts hydrodesulfurization (HDS) processing costs.
attributes.references: API Standards, EPA Tier 3 Gasoline Sulfur Standards

attributes.name: tan_value
attributes.description: Total Acid Number measured in mg KOH/g, indicating the acidity of the crude oil. High TAN (>0.5) causes corrosion in refinery equipment and requires special metallurgy. Critical for refinery compatibility assessment and pricing adjustments.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 - Standard Test Method for Acid Number

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this crude grade from origin to delivery point. Pipeline: long-distance pipeline network. Tanker: ocean-going crude carrier. Rail: rail tank car. Truck: tank truck. Barge: inland waterway barge.

attributes.name: viscosity_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity measured in centistokes (cSt) at reference temperature (typically 40°C or 100°F). Indicates flow characteristics and pumpability. High viscosity crude requires heating for transportation and processing.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Standard Test Method for Kinematic Viscosity

attributes.name: viscosity_reference_temp_c
attributes.description: Reference temperature in degrees Celsius at which viscosity was measured. Standard temperatures are 40°C or 100°C. Required for accurate viscosity comparison and pipeline flow calculations.

attributes.name: wax_content_percent
attributes.description: Paraffin wax content by weight percentage. High wax content can cause pipeline blockages in cold conditions and affects refinery processing. Typical range: 0-30%.
attributes.references: ASTM D721 - Standard Test Method for Oil Content of Petroleum Waxes

attributes.name: yield_diesel_percent
attributes.description: Typical diesel and middle distillate yield percentage from refinery processing. Includes diesel, jet fuel, and kerosene streams. Medium crudes typically yield 30-40% middle distillates. Key driver of refinery margin.
attributes.references: Internal Refining Technical Standards, Crude Assay Data

attributes.name: yield_gasoline_percent
attributes.description: Typical gasoline yield percentage from refinery processing of this crude grade. Includes naphtha and reformate streams. Light sweet crudes typically yield 25-35% gasoline. Critical for refinery economics and crude selection.
attributes.references: Internal Refining Technical Standards, Crude Assay Data

attributes.name: yield_residual_percent
attributes.description: Typical residual fuel oil yield percentage from atmospheric and vacuum distillation. Heavy crudes yield 30-50% residuals. High residual yield reduces refinery margin unless coking or other upgrading capacity is available.
attributes.references: Internal Refining Technical Standards, Crude Assay Data

products.name: quality_spec
products.description: Defines the authoritative quality specification envelope for each petroleum product — the acceptance limits used in custody transfer, refinery gate receipt, and regulatory compliance. Captures parameter name, minimum/maximum/target values, test method (ASTM, EN, IP standard number), and applicable market or contract context. Typical parameters include API gravity range, sulfur content (wt%), RON/MON for gasolines, cetane number for diesel, flash point, viscosity, cloud/pour/freeze point, smoke point for jet fuel, and H2S limits. Each spec record links to petroleum_product and serves as the reference for pass/fail determination in quality_test_result.

products.name: assay
products.description: Versioned crude oil and condensate assay records containing full physicochemical characterization data. Each assay captures TBP distillation curve, ASTM D86 yields by cut point (naphtha, kerosene, diesel, VGO, residue), density and viscosity profiles, sulfur/nitrogen distribution across fractions, metals content (Ni, V, Fe), UOPK characterization factor, naphthenic acid (TAN) profile, and wax/asphaltene content. Assays are versioned by analysis date and linked to crude_grade. Primary consumers are refinery planning (LP models, Aspen HYSYS), crude evaluation, and trading (quality-based pricing adjustments).

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the crude oil or condensate assay record. Primary key for the product assay entity.

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the crude oil or condensate measured at 60°F. Key quality indicator inversely related to density. Light crudes have higher API gravity (>31.1°), heavy crudes lower (<22.3°).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: aromatics_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Total aromatic hydrocarbon content as volume percent. Aromatics affect octane number in gasoline, cetane number in diesel, and smoke point in jet fuel.

attributes.name: asphaltene_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Asphaltene content as weight percent. High asphaltene content affects crude stability, blending compatibility, and processing difficulty in heavy oil upgrading.

attributes.name: assay_status

attributes.name: diesel_yield_vol_pct

attributes.name: distillation_method

attributes.references: ASTM D86, ASTM D2892, ASTM D5236

attributes.name: flash_point_f
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors above the crude will ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety parameter for storage and transportation classification.

attributes.name: gross_heating_value_btu_per_lb

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide content in parts per million. H2S is highly toxic and corrosive. Crudes with >100 ppm H2S require special handling and safety protocols.
attributes.references: ASTM D5705 - Measurement of Hydrogen Sulfide in the Vapor Phase Above Residual Fuel Oils

attributes.name: hydrogen_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Hydrogen content as weight percent. Higher hydrogen content indicates more paraffinic character and better refining yields. Used in hydrogen balance calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D5291 - Instrumental Determination of Carbon, Hydrogen, and Nitrogen

attributes.name: iron_content_ppm
attributes.description: Iron metal content in parts per million. Elevated iron indicates contamination from pipelines, storage tanks, or production equipment.

attributes.name: kerosene_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of kerosene fraction (380-520°F) from distillation. Kerosene is used for jet fuel and heating oil production.
attributes.references: ASTM D86 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Atmospheric Pressure

attributes.name: mercaptan_sulfur_ppm
attributes.description: Mercaptan sulfur content in parts per million. Mercaptans are odorous sulfur compounds that must be removed or converted in refining to meet product specifications.
attributes.references: ASTM D3227 - Mercaptan Sulfur in Gasoline, Kerosene, Aviation Turbine, and Distillate Fuels

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assay record was last modified. Tracks updates to assay data as new analyses are performed or corrections are made.

attributes.name: naphtha_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of naphtha fraction (IBP-380°F) from ASTM D86 or True Boiling Point (TBP) distillation. Naphtha is feedstock for gasoline blending and petrochemical reforming.

attributes.name: nickel_content_ppm
attributes.description: Nickel metal content in parts per million. Nickel and vanadium are catalyst poisons in FCC and hydrocracking units, concentrated in heavy residue fractions.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils

attributes.name: nitrogen_content_ppm
attributes.description: Total nitrogen content in parts per million. Nitrogen compounds poison catalysts in fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) and hydrotreating units.

attributes.name: olefins_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Olefin (unsaturated hydrocarbon) content as volume percent. Olefins are typically low in crude oil but increase in thermally cracked products. Affect stability and gum formation.
