attributes.name: pour_point_f
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which the crude oil will pour or flow under prescribed conditions. Critical for pipeline transportation and storage in cold climates.
attributes.references: ASTM D97 - Pour Point of Petroleum Products

attributes.name: reid_vapor_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure measured in pounds per square inch at 100°F. Indicates volatility and light-end content. Important for safety and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D323 - Vapor Pressure of Petroleum Products (Reid Method)

attributes.name: residue_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of vacuum residue (1050°F+). Residue is processed in coking, visbreaking, or deasphalting units, or used as fuel oil or asphalt feedstock.
attributes.references: ASTM D1160 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Reduced Pressure

attributes.name: salt_content_ptb
attributes.description: Salt content expressed as pounds per thousand barrels (PTB). High salt content causes corrosion in crude distillation unit (CDU) overhead systems and requires desalting.
attributes.references: ASTM D3230 - Salts in Crude Oil (Electrometric Method)

attributes.name: sample_source
attributes.description: Geographic source or field location where the crude oil or condensate sample was collected for assay analysis. Important for tracking regional quality variations.

attributes.name: saturates_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Saturated hydrocarbon (paraffins and naphthenes) content as volume percent. Saturates are desirable for diesel cetane number and lube oil base stocks.
attributes.references: ASTM D1319 - Hydrocarbon Types in Liquid Petroleum Products by Fluorescent Indicator Adsorption

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity of the crude relative to water at standard conditions (60°F/60°F). Used in volume-to-mass conversions and refinery yield calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D4052 - Density and Relative Density of Liquids

attributes.name: sulfur_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Total sulfur content of the whole crude expressed as weight percent. Critical for classifying crude as sweet (<0.5%) or sour (>0.5%) and determining hydrodesulfurization (HDS) requirements.
attributes.references: ASTM D4294 - Sulfur in Petroleum Products by Energy Dispersive X-ray Fluorescence

attributes.name: tan_mg_koh_per_g
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Acid Number (TAN) in mg KOH/g
attributes.description: Total Acid Number representing naphthenic acid content, measured in milligrams of potassium hydroxide per gram of sample. High TAN crudes (>0.5) cause corrosion in refinery equipment.
attributes.references: ASTM D664 - Acid Number of Petroleum Products by Potentiometric Titration

attributes.name: uopk_characterization_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Universal Oil Products (UOP) K Characterization Factor
attributes.description: UOP K characterization factor calculated from boiling point and specific gravity. Indicates paraffinic (K>12), naphthenic (K=11-12), or aromatic (K<11) character of the crude.

attributes.name: vanadium_content_ppm
attributes.description: Vanadium metal content in parts per million. High vanadium content (>50 ppm) requires special catalyst formulations and impacts refinery economics.
attributes.references: ASTM D5863 - Determination of Nickel, Vanadium, Iron, and Sodium in Crude Oils

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this assay record. Multiple assays may exist for the same crude grade over time as new laboratory analyses are performed or field conditions change.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Physical Properties Data

attributes.name: vgo_yield_vol_pct
attributes.description: Volume percent yield of vacuum gas oil fraction (650-1050°F). VGO is feedstock for fluid catalytic cracking (FCC) and hydrocracking units to produce gasoline and diesel.
attributes.references: ASTM D1160 - Distillation of Petroleum Products at Reduced Pressure

attributes.name: viscosity_at_100f_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity measured at 100°F in centistokes. Affects pumping requirements, pipeline pressure drop calculations, and refinery processing.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Kinematic Viscosity of Transparent and Opaque Liquids

attributes.name: viscosity_at_210f_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity measured at 210°F in centistokes. Used with 100°F viscosity to calculate viscosity index and temperature-viscosity relationships.
attributes.references: ASTM D445 - Kinematic Viscosity of Transparent and Opaque Liquids

attributes.name: water_content_vol_pct
attributes.description: Water and sediment content as volume percent. Affects custody transfer measurements and must be removed before refining to prevent equipment damage.
attributes.references: ASTM D4007 - Water and Sediment in Crude Oil by Centrifuge Method

attributes.name: wax_content_wt_pct
attributes.description: Paraffin wax content as weight percent. High wax content affects pour point, pipeline flow, and requires dewaxing in lube oil production.
attributes.references: ASTM D721 - Oil Content of Petroleum Waxes

products.name: refined_product
products.description: Master entity for finished refined petroleum products including motor gasoline (MOGAS), aviation gasoline (AVGAS), jet fuel (Jet A, Jet A-1), diesel (ULSD, HSFO), marine fuel oil (VLSFO, HSFO), LPG, naphtha, kerosene, bitumen, and lubricant base oils. Captures product grade, specification standard, blending component flag, export/domestic classification, and applicable excise/duty category.

attributes.name: refined_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refined petroleum product. Primary key for the refined product master entity.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Links refined product catalog (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, fuel oil) to petroleum_product master. petroleum_product is the SSOT for all petroleum product identities. Removes product_code, product_name

attributes.name: product_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel) require product manager ownership for specification compliance, blending optimization, pricing strategy, and market allocation. Critical for downstream co

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Refined products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel) are managed by downstream profit centers for margin analysis, crack spread tracking, and refinery performance measurement.

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity measurement of the refined product, indicating density relative to water. Higher values indicate lighter products. Measured in degrees API.

attributes.name: aromatics_content_percent
attributes.description: Total aromatics content as percentage by volume. Affects combustion characteristics and emissions. Regulated in many jurisdictions for environmental compliance.

attributes.name: ash_content_percent
attributes.description: Ash content as percentage by mass, representing inorganic residue after combustion. Important for fuel oils and indicates potential for deposit formation.

attributes.name: benzene_content_percent
attributes.description: Benzene content as percentage by volume. Regulated for environmental and health reasons, particularly in gasoline products. EPA Tier 3 limits benzene to 0.62% annual average.

attributes.name: blending_component_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this product is a blending component (True) used to create finished products, or a finished product itself (False). Blending components include reformate, alkylate, MTBE, ethanol.

attributes.name: carbon_residue_percent
attributes.description: Carbon residue (Conradson or Ramsbottom method) as percentage by mass, indicating tendency to form carbonaceous deposits. Relevant for heavier fuel products.

attributes.name: cetane_number
attributes.description: Cetane number for diesel products, measuring ignition quality and combustion performance. Higher values indicate better ignition characteristics. Typical range 40-60.

attributes.name: cold_filter_plugging_point_celsius
attributes.description: Cold Filter Plugging Point (CFPP) in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which diesel fuel will pass through a standardized filter. Critical for cold weather operability.

attributes.name: color_astm
attributes.business_glossary_term: American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) Color
attributes.description: ASTM color designation of the product (e.g., ASTM D1500 scale 0.5-8.0 for petroleum products, or Saybolt color for lighter products). Indicates product purity and quality.

attributes.name: copper_strip_corrosion
attributes.description: Copper strip corrosion test result (e.g., 1a, 1b, 2a), indicating corrosiveness of the product to copper and copper alloys. Important for fuel system compatibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: density_kg_per_m3
attributes.description: Density of the refined product measured in kilograms per cubic meter (kg/m³) at standard temperature (15°C). Used for volume-to-mass conversions and custody transfer.

attributes.name: distillation_range_celsius
attributes.description: Distillation temperature range in degrees Celsius (e.g., 150-250°C), indicating the boiling point distribution of hydrocarbon components. Defines volatility characteristics.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this product specification became effective and available for commercial transactions. Used for managing specification changes and product transitions.

attributes.name: excise_duty_category
attributes.description: Excise duty or tax category code applicable to this product under relevant tax jurisdictions. Determines applicable excise rates and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Regulations, Local Tax Authority Guidelines

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this product specification expires or is superseded. Null for products with indefinite availability. Used for managing product lifecycle and specification transitions.

attributes.name: export_domestic_classification
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the product is sold domestically, exported internationally, or both. Affects pricing, taxation, and regulatory compliance requirements.

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Flash point temperature in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source. Critical safety and transportation classification parameter.

attributes.name: freeze_point_celsius
attributes.description: Freeze point temperature in degrees Celsius, particularly relevant for jet fuel. The temperature at which hydrocarbon crystals form, affecting fuel flow and filter plugging.

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff classification code (6-10 digits) for international trade and customs purposes. Used for import/export documentation and duty calculation.

attributes.name: hazard_class
attributes.description: Hazard classification for transportation and storage (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids). Determines handling, storage, and transportation requirements.
attributes.references: PHMSA Hazardous Materials Regulations, IMDG Code

attributes.name: heating_value_mj_per_kg
attributes.description: Net (lower) heating value of the product in megajoules per kilogram (MJ/kg), representing energy content. Used for energy balance calculations and pricing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: lubricity_microns
attributes.description: Lubricity measurement in microns (wear scar diameter at 60°C), indicating lubricating properties of diesel fuel. Critical for fuel injection system protection, especially in ULSD.

attributes.name: olefins_content_percent
attributes.description: Olefins content as percentage by volume. Influences gasoline stability and emissions. Subject to regulatory limits in some markets.

attributes.name: oxygenate_content_percent
attributes.description: Oxygenate content (ethanol, MTBE, ETBE) as percentage by volume. Mandated in many jurisdictions for emissions reduction. Affects fuel properties and compatibility.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Fuel Standard, ASTM D4815

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group classification (I=high danger, II=medium danger, III=low danger) indicating degree of hazard for transportation purposes.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: pour_point_celsius
attributes.description: Pour point temperature in degrees Celsius, the lowest temperature at which the product will flow. Critical for cold weather operability and storage.

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Specific grade or quality designation of the refined product (e.g., Premium, Regular, Ultra Low Sulfur, High Sulfur, Grade A-1, ISO 8217 RMG380). Defines quality tier within product type.

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refined product in the catalog. ACTIVE=currently produced and sold, INACTIVE=temporarily not available, DISCONTINUED=permanently removed from catalog, PENDING_APPROVAL=awaiting regulatory or commercial approval, RESTRICTED=limited availability or special authorization required.

attributes.name: ron_rating
attributes.description: Research Octane Number rating for gasoline products, measuring resistance to engine knocking. Applicable to MOGAS and AVGAS products. Typical range 87-100.

attributes.name: sediment_content_percent
attributes.description: Sediment and particulate content as percentage by mass. Indicates product cleanliness and potential for filter plugging and equipment wear.

attributes.name: smoke_point_mm
attributes.description: Smoke point measurement in millimeters for jet fuel and kerosene, indicating burning quality and tendency to produce smoke. Higher values indicate cleaner combustion.

attributes.name: specification_standard
attributes.description: Industry or regulatory specification standard governing product quality (e.g., ASTM D975, EN 590, ISO 8217, DEF STAN 91-91). Defines the technical requirements the product must meet.
attributes.references: ASTM International, ISO Standards, API Standards

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.description: Sulfur content of the refined product measured in parts per million (ppm). Critical for environmental compliance and product classification (e.g., ULSD typically <15 ppm).
attributes.references: EPA Tier 3 Standards, EN 590, ASTM D2622

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: UN number for hazardous materials classification and transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline, UN1202 for diesel). Required for shipping documentation and safety compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: vapor_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) measured in kilopascals (kPa), indicating volatility and evaporation tendency. Critical for gasoline products and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: viscosity_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the product measured in centistokes (cSt) at a specified temperature. Indicates flow characteristics, particularly important for fuel oils and lubricants.

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.description: Water content measured in parts per million (ppm). Excessive water can cause corrosion, microbial growth, and operational issues. Critical quality parameter for all refined products.

products.name: ngl_stream
products.description: Master catalog for Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) streams and fractions including ethane, propane, normal butane, isobutane, natural gasoline (C5+), and mixed NGL. Captures stream composition (mol%), heating value, vapor pressure (RVP), shrinkage factor, fractionation train origin, and applicable NGL pricing index (Mont Belvieu, Conway). Used by gas processing, petrochemical feedstock planning, and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: ngl_stream_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NGL stream record. Primary key for the NGL stream master catalog.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the gas processing facility or plant where the NGL stream originates.

attributes.name: equipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fractionation train or gas processing facility where this NGL stream is produced.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: NGL streams from joint venture gas processing plants are governed by JOAs. Business process: NGL fractionation cost allocation, product split calculations among partners, partner entitlement by NGL co

attributes.name: primary_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: NGL streams may be sourced from specific vendors (gas processors, fractionators) for supply agreements. Enables sourcing strategy, supply reliability tracking, and vendor relationship management for N

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: NGL streams (ethane, propane, butane) are revenue-generating products managed by midstream profit centers for product margin tracking and fractionation economics.

attributes.name: stream_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: NGL fractionation streams require operational supervisor assignment for quality control, composition monitoring (ethane, propane, butane ratios), and safety management (H2S, mercury content). Essentia

attributes.name: autoignition_temperature_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Autoignition temperature of the NGL stream in degrees Fahrenheit, used for fire safety and process design.
attributes.references: ASTM E659 - Standard Test Method for Autoignition Temperature of Chemicals

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Primary NGL component classification identifying the dominant hydrocarbon fraction in the stream. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ethane|propane|normal_butane|isobutane|natural_gasoline|mixed_ngl|pentanes_plus — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NGL stream record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customs_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System tariff code for the NGL stream used in international trade and customs declarations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this NGL stream specification became effective in the product catalog and operational systems.

attributes.name: ethane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of ethane (C2H6) in the NGL stream composition, critical for petrochemical feedstock specifications.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this NGL stream specification expires or is scheduled for decommissioning. Null for active indefinite streams.

attributes.name: flash_point_fahrenheit
attributes.description: Flash point temperature of the NGL stream in degrees Fahrenheit, critical for safety and handling procedures.
attributes.references: ASTM D56 - Standard Test Method for Flash Point by Tag Closed Cup Tester

attributes.name: fuel_blending_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this NGL stream is approved for blending into motor fuels or heating fuels.

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide content in the NGL stream measured in parts per million, critical for safety and product quality specifications.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: Hazard classification code for the NGL stream per DOT/PHMSA regulations for transportation and handling safety.
attributes.references: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) 49 CFR Part 172

attributes.name: heating_value_btu_per_gallon
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heating Value in British Thermal Units (BTU) per Gallon
attributes.description: Gross heating value of the NGL stream measured in BTU per gallon, used for energy content specification and pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: isobutane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of isobutane (i-C4H10) in the NGL stream composition, important for alkylation feedstock and blending operations.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NGL stream record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_quality_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent laboratory quality test performed on this NGL stream to verify composition and specifications.
attributes.references: Gas Processors Association (GPA) Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: mercury_content_ppb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mercury Content in Parts Per Billion (PPB)
attributes.description: Mercury content in the NGL stream measured in parts per billion, important for equipment protection and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D6350 - Standard Test Method for Mercury in Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this NGL stream record, used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: normal_butane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of normal butane (n-C4H10) in the NGL stream composition.

attributes.name: pentanes_plus_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of pentanes and heavier hydrocarbons (C5+) in the NGL stream, also known as natural gasoline component.

attributes.name: petrochemical_feedstock_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this NGL stream is designated for use as petrochemical feedstock (ethylene cracking, alkylation, etc.).

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Pricing methodology used for commercial transactions of this NGL stream.

attributes.name: pricing_index
attributes.description: Primary pricing index or hub used for commercial valuation of this NGL stream (e.g., Mont Belvieu, Conway).
attributes.references: OPIS (Oil Price Information Service) NGL Pricing Standards

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade or specification designation for the NGL stream (e.g., HD-5 Propane, Commercial Propane, Polymer Grade Propylene).

attributes.name: propane_mol_percent
attributes.description: Mole percentage of propane (C3H8) in the NGL stream composition.

attributes.name: purity_percent
attributes.description: Purity percentage of the primary component in the NGL stream, critical for petrochemical feedstock and product specifications.

attributes.name: regulatory_product_code
attributes.description: Regulatory product classification code assigned by governing bodies (EPA, FERC, state agencies) for compliance reporting and tracking.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Product Classification Standards

attributes.name: shrinkage_factor_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Shrinkage Factor Percent
attributes.description: Percentage shrinkage factor representing the volume loss during NGL extraction from raw natural gas, used for production allocation and revenue calculations.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Guidelines

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity of the NGL stream relative to water at 60°F, used for volume-to-mass conversions and custody transfer calculations.
attributes.references: ASTM D1657 - Standard Test Method for Density or Relative Density of Light Hydrocarbons

attributes.name: specification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional specification details, quality variances, seasonal adjustments, or special handling instructions for the NGL stream.

attributes.name: storage_classification
attributes.description: Storage method classification for the NGL stream based on its physical properties and handling requirements.
attributes.references: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 58 - Liquefied Petroleum Gas Code

attributes.name: stream_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the NGL stream used across operations, typically assigned by the gas processing facility or fractionation plant.

attributes.name: stream_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the NGL stream or fraction (e.g., Ethane Product, Propane Mix, C5+ Natural Gasoline).

attributes.name: stream_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the NGL stream in the product catalog and production operations.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sulfur Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Total sulfur content in the NGL stream measured in parts per million, important for product quality and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: ASTM D5623 - Standard Test Method for Sulfur Compounds in Light Petroleum Liquids

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary transportation mode used for moving this NGL stream from the processing facility to downstream markets or storage.
attributes.references: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Regulations

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations identification number for the NGL stream used in international transportation and hazardous materials documentation.
attributes.references: United Nations Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: vapor_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) in Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure of the NGL stream measured in PSI at 100°F, critical for transportation safety and product specifications.
attributes.references: ASTM D323 - Standard Test Method for Vapor Pressure

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Content in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Water content in the NGL stream measured in parts per million, critical for pipeline transportation specifications and corrosion prevention.

products.name: lng_specification
products.description: Master specification entity for Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) cargoes and terminal products. Captures methane content (mol%), higher heating value (HHV), Wobbe Index, C2/C3/C4+ composition, nitrogen content, liquefaction train origin, regasification terminal, LNG quality band (lean/rich), and applicable SPA quality tolerance windows. Used by LNG trading, shipping scheduling, and terminal operations.
products.reference: ISO 13686 Natural Gas Quality / GIIGNL LNG Handbook

attributes.name: lng_specification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the LNG specification record. Primary key for the LNG specification master data entity.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Links LNG specification templates to the petroleum_product master catalog. petroleum_product is described as the SSOT for all petroleum product identities. This FK connects LNG specifications to the p

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: LNG products are managed by LNG business unit profit centers for commercial performance tracking, cargo margin analysis, and SPA (Sales and Purchase Agreement) profitability.

attributes.name: specification_author_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: LNG specifications require technical author assignment for Wobbe index compliance, heating value validation, and SPA (Sales and Purchase Agreement) quality terms. Critical for cargo acceptance, regasi

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: LNG supply contracts reference vendor-specific quality specifications and delivery terms. Links LNG quality specs to supplier for contract management, quality assurance, and custody transfer in LNG tr

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this LNG specification was formally approved by the designated authority and released for operational use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technical authority or commercial manager who approved this LNG specification for operational use.

attributes.name: butane_plus_content_mol_pct
attributes.description: Combined content of butane and heavier hydrocarbons (C4+) expressed as mole percent (mol%). Higher C4+ content increases heating value and may require NGL extraction before pipeline injection.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: carbon_dioxide_content_mol_pct
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide content expressed as mole percent (mol%). CO2 is typically removed during liquefaction to prevent freezing. Specification limits are usually below 50 ppm.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: Classification of the LNG cargo delivery terms. Spot cargoes are one-time purchases; term cargoes are under long-term contract. FOB (Free On Board), DES (Delivered Ex-Ship), and CIF (Cost Insurance Freight) indicate delivery responsibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LNG specification record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this LNG specification becomes effective and applicable for cargo nominations, terminal operations, and quality assurance testing.

attributes.name: ethane_content_mol_pct
attributes.description: Ethane content expressed as mole percent (mol%) of the LNG composition. Ethane is a key component of Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) and affects heating value and Wobbe Index.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this LNG specification expires or is superseded by a revised specification. Nullable for specifications with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: gross_heating_value_btu_per_scf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Heating Value British Thermal Units Per Standard Cubic Foot
attributes.description: Gross heating value (higher heating value) expressed in British Thermal Units per standard cubic foot (BTU/scf) at 60°F and 14.73 psia. Common unit in North American LNG markets. Typical range is 1,000-1,100 BTU/scf.
attributes.references: ASTM D3588 Standard Practice for Calculating Heat Value

attributes.name: higher_heating_value_mj_per_nm3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Higher Heating Value (HHV) Megajoules Per Normal Cubic Meter
attributes.description: Higher heating value (gross calorific value) of the LNG when regasified, expressed in megajoules per normal cubic meter (MJ/Nm³) at standard conditions (15°C, 1 atm). Typical range is 38-42 MJ/Nm³. Used for energy content billing and pipeline compatibility assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: hydrogen_sulfide_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Content Parts Per Million
attributes.description: Hydrogen sulfide content expressed in parts per million (ppm). H2S is a toxic and corrosive contaminant that must be removed during gas processing. Typical specification limit is less than 4 ppm.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LNG specification record was last modified or updated in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: liquefaction_train_origin
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the liquefaction train or facility where this LNG specification originates. Different trains at the same plant may produce slightly different compositions.

attributes.name: lower_heating_value_mj_per_nm3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lower Heating Value (LHV) Megajoules Per Normal Cubic Meter
attributes.description: Lower heating value (net calorific value) of the LNG when regasified, expressed in megajoules per normal cubic meter (MJ/Nm³) at standard conditions. LHV excludes the latent heat of water vapor condensation.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: mercury_content_ng_per_nm3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mercury (Hg) Content Nanograms Per Normal Cubic Meter
attributes.description: Mercury content expressed in nanograms per normal cubic meter (ng/Nm³). Mercury causes corrosion of aluminum heat exchangers in liquefaction plants and must be removed to trace levels, typically below 10 ng/Nm³.
attributes.references: ISO 6978 Natural Gas Determination of Mercury

attributes.name: methane_content_mol_pct
attributes.description: Methane content expressed as mole percent (mol%) of the LNG composition. Typical range is 85-99 mol%. Critical for heating value calculation and regasification planning.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this LNG specification record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: ngl_extraction_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Extraction Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) extraction is required before pipeline injection due to high C2+ content. True if extraction is required; False otherwise.

attributes.name: nitrogen_content_mol_pct
attributes.description: Nitrogen content expressed as mole percent (mol%). Nitrogen is an inert diluent that reduces heating value and Wobbe Index. Typical specification limits are 0.1-1.0 mol%.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this LNG specification, such as seasonal variations, blending requirements, or operational constraints.

attributes.name: oxygen_content_ppm
attributes.description: Oxygen content expressed in parts per million (ppm). Oxygen is removed during liquefaction to prevent combustion risk and corrosion. Typical specification limit is less than 10 ppm.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: pipeline_injection_compatible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the regasified LNG meets the receiving pipeline gas quality specifications without further processing or blending. True if compatible; False if NGL extraction or blending is required.

attributes.name: pricing_benchmark
attributes.description: Pricing benchmark or index used for this LNG specification. JKM (Japan Korea Marker), TTF (Title Transfer Facility - European hub), HH (Henry Hub - US), Brent crude oil, JCC (Japan Crude Cocktail), or custom formula.

attributes.name: propane_content_mol_pct
attributes.description: Propane content expressed as mole percent (mol%) of the LNG composition. Propane contributes to heating value and is extracted as Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) in some terminals.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: quality_band
attributes.description: Classification of LNG quality based on heating value and composition profile. Lean LNG has lower heating value and minimal heavier hydrocarbons; rich LNG contains higher C2+ content and greater heating value.

attributes.name: quality_tolerance_window_pct
attributes.description: Allowable percentage deviation from the specified composition and heating value parameters as defined in the SPA. Typical tolerance is ±2-5% for key parameters.

attributes.name: regasification_terminal
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regasification terminal or Floating Storage and Regasification Unit (FSRU) where this LNG specification is intended for delivery and vaporization.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification code for the LNG product under applicable jurisdictions (e.g., UN number, hazard class, customs tariff code). Used for transportation, customs, and safety compliance.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: relative_density
attributes.description: Relative density (specific gravity) of the regasified LNG compared to air at the same temperature and pressure. Dimensionless value typically in the range 0.55-0.70. Used for Wobbe Index calculation and pipeline flow modeling.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

attributes.name: spa_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA) that defines this LNG specification and quality tolerance windows. Links the specification to the commercial contract.

attributes.name: specification_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the LNG specification, used in Sales and Purchase Agreements (SPA), terminal operations, and cargo documentation.

attributes.name: specification_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title for the LNG specification, typically referencing the quality band, terminal, or contract reference.

attributes.name: specification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the LNG specification. Active specifications are in use for cargo nominations and terminal operations; draft specifications are under development; archived specifications are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: total_sulfur_content_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Sulfur Content Parts Per Million
attributes.description: Total sulfur content including H2S, mercaptans, and other sulfur compounds, expressed in parts per million (ppm). Pipeline specifications typically require total sulfur below 20 ppm.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the LNG specification document, following semantic versioning (major.minor). Incremented when specification parameters are revised or updated.

attributes.name: water_content_ppm
attributes.description: Water content expressed in parts per million (ppm). Water must be removed during liquefaction to prevent hydrate formation and ice blockage. Typical specification is less than 1 ppm.

attributes.name: wobbe_index_mj_per_nm3
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wobbe Index Megajoules Per Normal Cubic Meter
attributes.description: Wobbe Index (WI) of the regasified LNG, calculated as HHV divided by the square root of relative density, expressed in MJ/Nm³. The Wobbe Index determines interchangeability of gas in burner applications. Typical range is 48-52 MJ/Nm³.
attributes.references: ISO 6976 Natural Gas Calculation of Calorific Values

products.name: petrochemical_product
products.description: Master catalog for petrochemical products manufactured from hydrocarbon feedstocks — including ethylene, propylene, benzene, toluene, xylenes (BTX), methanol, ammonia, polyethylene (HDPE/LDPE/LLDPE), polypropylene, PVC, styrene, and specialty chemicals. Captures CAS number, molecular formula, purity grade, feedstock type, process route, and applicable chemical safety classification (GHS/REACH).
products.reference: CAS Registry / REACH Regulation / GHS Classification

attributes.name: petrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the petrochemical product. Primary key for the petrochemical product master catalog.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Petrochemical products from joint venture petrochemical facilities are governed by JOAs. Business process: Petrochemical JOA cost recovery, product allocation among partners, partner offtake rights, a

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Links petrochemical product catalog to petroleum_product master. petroleum_product is the SSOT for all petroleum product identities across the value chain. Petrochemicals (ethylene, propylene, benzene

attributes.name: primary_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Petrochemical feedstocks often sourced from specific vendors (refineries, chemical plants). Enables sourcing strategy, supply reliability tracking, and vendor relationship management for petrochemical

attributes.name: product_safety_data_sheet_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Product Safety Data Sheet Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.safety_data_sheet. Business justification: Every petrochemical product requires a current SDS per OSHA HazCom standard. Links product to its authoritative hazard communication document, eliminating denormalized hazard data from product table.

attributes.name: product_steward_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Petrochemical products require steward ownership for GHS classification, REACH registration, TSCA compliance, and SDS maintenance. Essential for HSE regulatory compliance, feedstock selection decision

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Petrochemical products are managed by downstream chemicals profit centers for segment reporting, product line profitability, and integrated margin optimization.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to every chemical substance described in the open scientific literature. Critical for regulatory compliance and safety data sheet (SDS) management.
attributes.references: CAS Registry, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, GHS Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the petrochemical product record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the petrochemical product was or will be discontinued from the product portfolio. Null if the product is still active. Used for phase-out planning, customer notifications, and inventory liquidation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the petrochemical product record became active and available for commercial transactions, production planning, and inventory management. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: epa_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the petrochemical product is subject to EPA reporting requirements such as Toxics Release Inventory (TRI), Chemical Data Reporting (CDR), or Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP). True if reporting is mandatory; false otherwise.
attributes.references: EPA TRI (40 CFR Part 372), EPA CDR (40 CFR Part 711), EPA GHGRP (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: feedstock_type
attributes.description: Primary hydrocarbon feedstock used in the manufacturing process of the petrochemical product. Naphtha and ethane are common steam cracker feedstocks; natural gas is used for methanol and ammonia production; crude oil fractions are used for aromatics extraction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: naphtha|ethane|propane|butane|natural_gas|crude_oil|gas_condensate|refinery_offgas — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Standards, Aspen HYSYS Process Simulation Standards

attributes.name: greenhouse_gas_emissions_factor
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emissions factor per unit of product manufactured or consumed, expressed in metric tons CO2e per unit. Used for carbon footprint calculations, ESG reporting, and climate risk assessment.
attributes.references: EPA GHGRP (40 CFR Part 98), GHG Protocol, ISO 14064

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: Ten-digit classification code used by U.S. Customs and Border Protection for import/export documentation and tariff determination. Format: XXXX.XX.XX.XX. Required for international trade compliance and duty calculation.
attributes.references: Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), World Customs Organization (WCO)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the petrochemical product record was most recently updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the product in its commercial lifecycle. Active products are available for sale and production; inactive products are temporarily unavailable; discontinued products are no longer manufactured; under development products are in pilot or scale-up phase; regulatory review products await approval; phased out products are being withdrawn from market.
attributes.references: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Standards, ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: molecular_formula
attributes.description: Chemical formula representing the types and numbers of atoms in a molecule of the petrochemical product (e.g., C2H4 for ethylene, C6H6 for benzene).

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Primary packaging or transportation mode for the petrochemical product. Bulk liquid and solid are for large-volume shipments; ISO tanks and railcars for intermodal transport; IBCs (Intermediate Bulk Containers) and drums for medium volumes; bags for solid products; cylinders for compressed gases; pipeline for continuous transport. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_liquid|bulk_solid|iso_tank|railcar|truck|ibc_tote|drum|bag|cylinder|pipeline — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 173, IMDG Code, API Standards

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Market index or benchmark used for pricing the petrochemical product (e.g., Mont Belvieu ethylene, ICIS benzene, Platts propylene). Defines the reference point for contract pricing and market valuation.
attributes.references: ICIS Pricing, Platts Petrochemical Assessments, Argus Media

attributes.name: process_route
attributes.description: Manufacturing process or technology route used to produce the petrochemical product (e.g., steam cracking, catalytic reforming, polymerization, alkylation, oxidation). Identifies the production pathway and technology licensor if applicable.
attributes.references: Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) Standards, Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) Documentation

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the petrochemical product type. Olefins include ethylene and propylene; aromatics include benzene, toluene, xylenes (BTX); polymers include polyethylene, polypropylene, PVC; intermediates include methanol, styrene; solvents include toluene, xylene; specialty chemicals include additives and performance chemicals; fertilizers include ammonia and urea. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: olefins|aromatics|polymers|intermediates|solvents|specialty_chemicals|fertilizers — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Chemistry Council (ACC) Product Classification, SPE Standards

attributes.name: product_specification_document
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the detailed product specification document containing complete technical data, test methods, quality parameters, and customer requirements. Used by quality control, sales, and technical service teams.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Document Control, Internal Quality Management System

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the product category (e.g., HDPE, LDPE, LLDPE for polyethylene; ortho-xylene, meta-xylene, para-xylene for xylenes). Provides granular segmentation for inventory and sales management.
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards, ISO Petrochemical Standards

attributes.name: purity_grade
attributes.description: Specification of the chemical purity level of the product expressed as a percentage or grade designation (e.g., 99.5% purity, polymer grade, chemical grade, technical grade). Critical for quality assurance and customer specifications.

attributes.name: purity_percentage
attributes.description: Numerical representation of the chemical purity as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used for quality control, pricing, and customer contract specifications.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: European Union registration number for chemical substances manufactured or imported in quantities of one tonne or more per year. Required for sales into EU markets and demonstrates compliance with REACH regulation.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)

attributes.name: safety_data_sheet_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision to the Safety Data Sheet for the petrochemical product. SDS must be updated when new hazard information becomes available or regulatory requirements change. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200, GHS Rev. 9

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the petrochemical product can be stored under recommended conditions while maintaining specification quality. After this period, product testing or disposal may be required. Null indicates indefinite shelf life under proper storage.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, Manufacturer Product Specifications

attributes.name: standard_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure used for inventory, sales, and reporting of the petrochemical product. Kilograms (kg) and metric tons (mt) for mass; gallons (gal), barrels (bbl), cubic meters (m3) for volume; standard cubic feet (scf), thousand cubic feet (mcf), million standard cubic feet (mmscf) for gases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|mt|lb|gal|bbl|m3|scf|mcf|mmscf — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11, ISO 80000, COPAS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum recommended temperature for safe and stable storage of the petrochemical product, measured in degrees Celsius. Above this temperature, the product may degrade, polymerize, or pose increased safety risks.

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum recommended temperature for safe and stable storage of the petrochemical product, measured in degrees Celsius. Below this temperature, the product may solidify, crystallize, or exhibit undesirable physical changes.

attributes.name: tsca_status
attributes.description: Regulatory status under the U.S. Toxic Substances Control Act. Active substances are on the TSCA inventory and can be manufactured/imported; inactive substances require notification before commercial activity; exempt substances are excluded from TSCA; PMN (Pre-Manufacture Notice) required for new chemicals not on inventory.
attributes.references: TSCA Section 8(b) Inventory, EPA 40 CFR Part 720

attributes.name: voc_content_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of volatile organic compounds in the petrochemical product by weight or volume. Used for air quality compliance, emissions calculations, and regulatory reporting under Clean Air Act and state regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Method 24, 40 CFR Part 51 Subpart F, State Implementation Plans (SIPs)

products.name: pricing_benchmark
products.description: Manages pricing benchmarks and price indices for petroleum products — WTI, Brent, Dubai/Oman, Henry Hub, JKM (Japan Korea Marker), TTF, NBP, Platts ULSD, MOPS (Mean of Platts Singapore), and crack spreads. Captures benchmark name, commodity type, pricing agency (Platts, Argus, ICIS), quotation frequency, currency, unit of measure ($/bbl, $/MMBtu, $/MT), and effective date range. Used by commercial, revenue, and trading domains for price formula construction.
products.reference: Platts / Argus / ICIS Price Reporting Agencies

attributes.name: pricing_benchmark_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product pricing benchmark record. Primary key for the product pricing benchmark entity.

attributes.name: differential_benchmark_id
attributes.description: For differential or basis benchmarks, reference to the parent benchmark against which the differential is calculated (e.g., Dubai/Oman differential to Brent, Mars differential to WTI). Null for absolute price benchmarks.

attributes.name: assessment_window_end
attributes.description: For daily assessed benchmarks, the end time of the assessment window during which market activity is observed (e.g., 16:30 London time for Brent, 14:30 US Central for WTI). Defines the close of the price discovery period.
attributes.references: Platts Market on Close (MOC) Methodology, Argus Assessment Window Specifications

attributes.name: assessment_window_start
attributes.description: For daily assessed benchmarks, the start time of the assessment window during which market activity is observed (e.g., 16:00 London time for Brent, 14:30 US Central for WTI). Critical for understanding price discovery timing.
attributes.references: Platts Market on Close (MOC) Methodology, Argus Assessment Window Specifications

attributes.name: benchmark_code
attributes.description: Short code or ticker symbol for the pricing benchmark (e.g., WTI, BRENT, HH, JKM, TTF, NBP, MOPS). Used for system integration and trading platform identification.
attributes.references: Bloomberg Ticker Standards, Reuters Instrument Code (RIC)

attributes.name: benchmark_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the pricing benchmark including its market significance, typical use cases, and any special characteristics or calculation methodologies that commercial and trading teams need to understand.

attributes.name: benchmark_name
attributes.description: The official name of the pricing benchmark or price index (e.g., West Texas Intermediate, Brent Crude, Henry Hub, Japan Korea Marker, Title Transfer Facility, National Balancing Point, Mean of Platts Singapore).
attributes.references: Platts Methodology Guide, Argus Media Methodology, ICIS Pricing Methodology

attributes.name: benchmark_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing benchmark. Active benchmarks are currently published and used in contracts, inactive are no longer published but historical data exists, suspended are temporarily halted, discontinued are permanently retired.

attributes.name: benchmark_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing benchmark by market instrument type. Spot represents immediate delivery prices, futures are exchange-traded contracts, forward are OTC contracts, swap are differential contracts, index are composite calculations, and average are time-weighted averages.
attributes.references: ISDA Definitions, CME Group Contract Specifications

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The petroleum product category that this benchmark represents. Crude oil includes WTI and Brent, natural gas includes Henry Hub and TTF, LNG includes JKM, refined products include gasoline and diesel, and petrochemicals include ethylene and propylene. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|natural_gas|lng|lpg|ngl|gasoline|diesel|jet_fuel|fuel_oil|petrochemical — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Product Classification, EIA Petroleum Product Categories

attributes.name: contract_month
attributes.description: For futures and forward benchmarks, the delivery or settlement month (e.g., January 2024, Q1 2024, Summer 2024). Null for spot benchmarks. Used for forward curve construction.
attributes.references: CME Group Contract Month Codes, ICE Futures Trading Calendar

attributes.name: contract_symbol
attributes.description: For exchange-traded benchmarks, the official contract symbol or ticker used on the trading platform (e.g., CL for NYMEX WTI Crude, BZ for ICE Brent Crude, NG for NYMEX Henry Hub Natural Gas).
attributes.references: Exchange Contract Specifications, Bloomberg Ticker Standards

attributes.name: crack_spread_type
attributes.description: For refining margin benchmarks, the crack spread configuration (e.g., 3-2-1 crack spread representing 3 barrels crude to 2 barrels gasoline and 1 barrel distillate, 5-3-2 crack spread). Null for non-refining benchmarks.
attributes.references: CME Group Crack Spread Specifications, Refining Margin Calculation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benchmark record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the benchmark is quoted (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Essential for multi-currency price formula calculations and foreign exchange risk management.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The upstream system or data feed from which benchmark prices are received (e.g., Bloomberg Terminal, Reuters Eikon, Platts Direct Feed, CME DataMine). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: delivery_basis
attributes.description: The Incoterms delivery basis for the benchmark price (e.g., FOB for Free on Board, CIF for Cost Insurance and Freight, DAP for Delivered at Place). Determines which party bears transportation and insurance costs.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: The physical or notional delivery point or hub associated with the benchmark (e.g., Cushing Oklahoma for WTI, Sullom Voe for Brent, Henry Hub Louisiana for natural gas). Defines the geographic basis for the price.
attributes.references: CME Group Delivery Specifications, ICE Futures Contract Specifications

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this benchmark definition ceased to be effective. Null for currently active benchmarks. Used for temporal validity and contract transition management when benchmarks are discontinued or redefined.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this benchmark definition became effective and available for use in price formulas and contracts. Used for temporal validity and historical price formula reconstruction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this benchmark record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: minimum_price_increment
attributes.description: The smallest price movement or tick size for the benchmark (e.g., $0.01 per barrel for crude oil futures, $0.001 per MMBtu for natural gas). Used for price precision and rounding rules in contracts.
attributes.references: Exchange Trading Rules, CME Group Tick Size Specifications

attributes.name: price_adjustment_formula
attributes.description: The mathematical formula or methodology used to adjust the benchmark for quality, location, or timing differences (e.g., API gravity adjustment formula, sulfur premium/discount schedule). Used in commercial price formula construction.

attributes.name: pricing_agency
attributes.description: The price reporting agency or exchange that publishes and maintains this benchmark (e.g., Platts, Argus Media, ICIS, CME Group, ICE, NYMEX). Critical for price formula construction and contract settlement.
attributes.references: IOSCO PRA Principles, Price Reporting Agency Code of Conduct

attributes.name: publication_time
attributes.description: The standard time at which the benchmark price is officially published each day or period (e.g., 17:00 London time for Platts assessments, 14:30 US Central for NYMEX settlement). Used for price formula effective time determination.
attributes.references: Platts Publication Schedule, CME Group Settlement Time Standards

attributes.name: quality_specification
attributes.description: The product quality parameters that define the benchmark grade (e.g., API gravity 39.6 degrees and sulfur content 0.24% for WTI, API gravity 38 degrees and sulfur content 0.37% for Brent). Used for quality adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: API Gravity Standards ASTM D287, Sulfur Content ASTM D4294

attributes.name: quotation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the pricing benchmark is published or updated. Real-time for exchange-traded instruments, daily for most spot assessments, monthly for term contract indices.
attributes.references: Platts Assessment Methodology, Argus Methodology and Reference Guide

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: The regulatory classification of the benchmark under financial market regulations (e.g., critical benchmark under EU BMR, IOSCO PRA principles compliant, CFTC regulated). Important for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: EU Benchmark Regulation (BMR), IOSCO Principles for Price Reporting Agencies, CFTC Regulations

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The method by which contracts referencing this benchmark are settled. Cash or financially settled means no physical delivery occurs, physical or physically delivered means actual commodity transfer is required.
attributes.references: ISDA Definitions, CME Group Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The time zone in which the benchmark assessment or trading occurs (e.g., US/Central, Europe/London, Asia/Singapore). Essential for coordinating global trading and settlement activities.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database, ISO 8601 Time Zone Designations

attributes.name: trading_exchange
attributes.description: For exchange-traded benchmarks, the name of the futures exchange where the contract trades (e.g., NYMEX, ICE Futures Europe, CME Group, TOCOM). Null for OTC or assessed benchmarks.
attributes.references: Exchange Trading Rules, CFTC Designated Contract Market Registry

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit in which the benchmark price is expressed (e.g., $/bbl for crude oil, $/MMBtu for natural gas, $/MT for petrochemicals, $/gallon for refined products). Critical for price conversion and normalization.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 12 Calculation of Petroleum Quantities, COPAS Bulletin 47

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: The number of active commercial contracts, pricing agreements, or revenue formulas that currently reference this benchmark. Used for impact analysis when benchmarks change or are discontinued.

products.name: classification
products.description: Unified reference taxonomy mapping petroleum products to external and internal classification hierarchies. Covers HS (Harmonized System) 6/8/10-digit tariff codes, UN/NA dangerous goods numbers, EPA fuel registration categories, FERC commodity codes, SEC reporting categories, country-specific import/export tariff schedules, excise duty categories, FTA preferential rates, and internal product family/subfamily hierarchy. Each record links a petroleum_product to a classification scheme, code value, jurisdiction, effective date, and duty/rate where applicable. Supports customs declarations, regulatory reporting, trade compliance, and cross-domain product categorization.
products.reference: HS Nomenclature / UN Model Regulations / EPA 40 CFR / FERC Form 2

attributes.name: classification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product classification record. Primary key for the product classification entity.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petroleum product being classified. Links to the master product catalog covering crude oil grades, natural gas specifications, LNG, LPG, NGL streams, refined products, and petrochemicals.

attributes.name: classification_code
attributes.description: The specific code value within the classification scheme. For HS codes: 6/8/10-digit tariff code. For UN/NA: dangerous goods number. For EPA: fuel registration category code. For FERC: commodity code. For SEC: reporting category code. For TARIFF: country-specific tariff schedule code. For EXCISE: duty category code. For FTA: preferential rate code. For INTERNAL: product family or subfamily code.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, EPA 40 CFR Part 80, FERC Gas Tariff, SEC Industry Guide 2

attributes.name: classification_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the classification code. Provides business context and interpretation of the code value for reporting and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: classification_source
attributes.description: The source or authority that determined this classification. Regulatory Authority = assigned by EPA, FERC, SEC, or other government body. Customs Broker = determined by licensed customs broker for import/export. Internal Tax = assigned by internal tax department. Internal Compliance = assigned by internal compliance team. Third Party Consultant = determined by external classification consultant.

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the classification record. Active = currently in use, Inactive = no longer applicable, Pending = awaiting regulatory approval or internal validation, Superseded = replaced by a newer classification.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: The confidence level or certainty of the classification assignment. Confirmed = validated by regulatory authority or expert. Probable = high confidence based on product specifications and industry standards. Provisional = preliminary classification pending validation or regulatory ruling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product classification record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_class
attributes.description: The UN/DOT hazard class for dangerous goods classification. Examples: Class 3 (Flammable Liquids) for crude oil and refined products, Class 2.1 (Flammable Gas) for natural gas and LPG. Nullable for non-hazardous products.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Parts 171-180), Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA)

attributes.name: duty_rate
attributes.description: The applicable duty or tax rate associated with this classification code, expressed as a percentage or per-unit amount. Used for customs declarations, excise duty calculations, and trade compliance. Nullable for non-tariff classifications.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, Country-Specific Tariff Schedules

attributes.name: duty_rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the duty rate. Percent = ad valorem duty as percentage of value, USD per BBL = duty per barrel of oil, USD per gallon = duty per gallon of refined product, USD per ton = duty per metric ton, USD per MMBTU = duty per million British thermal units for natural gas.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Tariff Schedules

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this classification becomes valid and applicable for the product. Supports time-variant classification as tariff codes, regulations, and internal taxonomies evolve.

attributes.name: epa_fuel_category
attributes.description: The EPA fuel registration category for refined petroleum products. Used for environmental compliance, emissions reporting, and fuel quality standards. Examples: Conventional Gasoline, Reformulated Gasoline (RFG), Ultra-Low Sulfur Diesel (ULSD), Heating Oil. Nullable for non-fuel products.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 80 (Regulation of Fuels and Fuel Additives), EPA Fuel Registration Database

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this classification ceases to be valid. Nullable for classifications that remain active indefinitely. Supports historical tracking and regulatory compliance audits.

attributes.name: ferc_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Commodity Code
attributes.description: The FERC commodity code used for natural gas pipeline tariff filings and wholesale market reporting. Applicable to natural gas, LNG, and NGL products. Nullable for crude oil and refined products.
attributes.references: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Uniform System of Accounts for Natural Gas Companies, FERC Gas Tariff Filing Requirements

attributes.name: fta_program
attributes.description: The specific Free Trade Agreement or trade preference program under which preferential rates apply. Examples: USMCA (United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement), CAFTA-DR (Central America-Dominican Republic FTA), GSP (Generalized System of Preferences). Nullable if no preferential program applies.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Free Trade Agreements, World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: internal_product_family
attributes.description: The top-level internal product hierarchy classification. Used for internal reporting, profitability analysis, and cross-domain product categorization.

attributes.name: internal_product_subfamily
attributes.description: The second-level internal product hierarchy classification within the product family. Examples: Light Sweet Crude, Heavy Sour Crude, Dry Gas, Wet Gas, Conventional Gasoline, Reformulated Gasoline, Jet A, Jet A-1, Olefins, Aromatics. Provides granular categorization for analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The country, region, or regulatory authority for which this classification applies. Uses 3-letter ISO country codes (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, SAU) or regulatory body abbreviations (e.g., EPA, FERC, SEC). For global standards like HS or UN, may be set to GLOBAL.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this product classification record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this product classification record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special considerations for this classification. May include references to product specifications, regulatory guidance, or internal decision criteria.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: The UN packing group indicating the degree of danger for dangerous goods. I = high danger, II = medium danger, III = low danger. Applicable only to dangerous goods classifications.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Parts 171-180)

attributes.name: preferential_rate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this classification qualifies for preferential duty rates under a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) or other trade preference program. True = preferential rate applies, False = standard duty rate applies.
attributes.references: Free Trade Agreement (FTA) Rules of Origin, U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Trade Preference Programs

attributes.name: ruling_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of any official ruling, determination, or binding decision from a regulatory authority or customs agency that supports this classification. Examples: CBP ruling number, EPA determination letter number, FERC order number. Nullable if no formal ruling exists.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) Rulings Database, EPA Determination Letters, FERC Orders

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: The classification taxonomy or standard being applied. HS = Harmonized System tariff codes, UN_NA = United Nations/North America dangerous goods numbers, EPA = Environmental Protection Agency fuel registration categories, FERC = Federal Energy Regulatory Commission commodity codes, SEC = Securities and Exchange Commission reporting categories, TARIFF = country-specific import/export tariff schedules, EXCISE = excise duty categories, FTA = Free Trade Agreement preferential rates, INTERNAL = internal product family/subfamily hierarchy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HS|UN_NA|EPA|FERC|SEC|TARIFF|EXCISE|FTA|INTERNAL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System, UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, EPA Fuel Registration, FERC Uniform System of Accounts, SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: sec_reporting_category

attributes.description: The SEC reporting category for petroleum reserves and production disclosure. Used for financial reporting and reserves classification under SEC Industry Guide 2. Examples: Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Natural Gas Liquids (NGL), Condensate. Nullable for downstream refined products and petrochemicals.
attributes.references: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Industry Guide 2 (Disclosure by Oil and Gas Producing Companies), SEC Regulation S-K Item 1200

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this product classification record. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: quality_test_result
products.description: Transactional record of laboratory quality test results performed on petroleum product samples at custody transfer points, tank farms, loading terminals, and refinery gates. Captures sample ID, test date, test method (ASTM D86, D4052, D5453, D1298), parameter tested, measured value, unit, pass/fail against spec, laboratory ID, and certificate of quality (CoQ) reference. Links to petroleum_product, product_quality_spec, and the relevant shipment or batch.

attributes.name: quality_test_result_id

attributes.name: laboratory_id

attributes.name: laboratory_vendor_id

attributes.name: original_test_quality_test_result_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original quality test result ID if this is a retest, enabling traceability of quality investigations.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petroleum product being tested (crude oil grade, refined product, LNG, LPG, NGL, petrochemical).

attributes.name: quality_spec_id

attributes.name: sample_id

attributes.name: shipment_id

attributes.name: test_equipment_id

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Production batch or lot number of the petroleum product being tested, enabling traceability to production run.

attributes.name: coq_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the Certificate of Quality document issued based on this test result, provided to buyer at custody transfer.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Physical Properties Data, Custody Transfer Documentation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality test result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: custody_transfer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result is associated with a custody transfer event requiring Certificate of Quality for commercial settlement.

attributes.name: deviation_from_spec
attributes.description: Calculated difference between the measured value and the specification limit (positive indicates above max or below min specification).

attributes.name: equipment_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the test equipment was last calibrated, ensuring measurement accuracy and traceability.

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation certificate number or code demonstrating the laboratory meets ISO/IEC 17025 or equivalent quality standards.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality test result record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: measured_value

attributes.name: measurement_uncertainty
