attributes.name: parameter_tested
attributes.description: Name of the quality parameter being measured (e.g., API Gravity, Sulfur Content, RON, Flash Point, Pour Point, Viscosity, Reid Vapor Pressure, Distillation Temperature, TAN).

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured value meets the specification requirements (pass), fails to meet requirements (fail), meets requirements with conditions (conditional), or requires retesting (retest).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result is required for regulatory compliance reporting (EPA, BSEE, state environmental agencies).
attributes.references: EPA Regulations, BSEE Requirements, State Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text comments or observations recorded by the laboratory technician regarding sample condition, test anomalies, or special handling.

attributes.name: retest_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this test is a retest of a previous sample due to out-of-spec results or quality dispute.

attributes.name: sample_collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the product sample was collected from the custody transfer point, tank, or pipeline.

attributes.name: sample_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the sample was collected (e.g., Tank 101, Loading Rack 3, Custody Transfer Meter Station A, Refinery Gate 2).

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Type of sample collected: composite (blended from multiple points), spot (single point in time), running (continuous during transfer), or automatic (system-collected).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 8.1 - Manual Sampling of Petroleum and Petroleum Products

attributes.name: specification_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable value for the tested parameter as defined in the product quality specification.

attributes.name: specification_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable value for the tested parameter as defined in the product quality specification.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date when the laboratory quality test was performed on the sample.

attributes.name: test_method_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the laboratory test method used (e.g., ASTM D86 for distillation, ASTM D4052 for density, ASTM D5453 for sulfur content, ASTM D1298 for API gravity, ASTM D2699 for RON).
attributes.references: ASTM International Standards, API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards (MPMS), ISO Standards, Institute of Petroleum (IP) Standards

attributes.name: test_method_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the test method used (e.g., Standard Test Method for Distillation of Petroleum Products at Atmospheric Pressure).

attributes.name: test_pressure
attributes.description: Pressure at which the test was conducted, relevant for vapor pressure and other pressure-dependent measurements.

attributes.name: test_priority
attributes.description: Priority classification of the test: routine (standard schedule), urgent (expedited), regulatory (compliance-driven), or dispute (quality claim investigation).

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current status of the test in the laboratory workflow.

attributes.name: test_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature at which the test was conducted, critical for temperature-dependent properties like viscosity and density.

attributes.name: test_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the laboratory quality test was completed, including time zone information.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the measured value is expressed (e.g., degrees API for gravity, ppm or wt% for sulfur, cSt for viscosity, degrees C/F for temperature, kPa/psi for pressure, mg KOH/g for TAN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: degrees API|ppm|wt%|cSt|mmHg|degC|degF|kPa|psi|mg KOH/g — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SI Units, API Standards, ASTM Standards

products.name: certificate_of_quality

Captures cargo/batch reference, product grade, loading port, vessel/pipeline, date of analysis, all tested parameters with results vs. specification limits, issuing laboratory, inspector name, and digital certificate number. Legally binding document used in trade settlement, dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: certificate_of_quality_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the Certificate of Quality record. Primary key for the certificate_of_quality product.

attributes.name: cargo_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cargo or batch for which this certificate was issued. Links to the cargo nomination or shipment record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: COQ issuance costs (inspection, lab analysis, certification) are allocated to terminal or trading cost centers for custody transfer expense tracking in oil-and-gas operations.

attributes.name: issuing_inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Certificates of Quality require certified inspector assignment for custody transfer validation, cargo acceptance, and regulatory compliance. Essential for marine operations, export/import documentatio

attributes.name: issuing_laboratory_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Third-party laboratories issuing CoQs are vendors in procurement system. Critical for custody transfer, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance in commodity trading and supply chain operations.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Certificates of quality for cargoes lifted under JOA partner entitlements require JOA linkage. Business process: Partner lifting certification, JOA entitlement verification, cargo allocation documenta

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Certificates of Quality issued at lease delivery points for custody transfer and export. Links product quality certification to lease production for cargo documentation. Business process: cargo loadin

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the petroleum product being certified (crude oil grade, refined product, LNG, LPG, NGL, petrochemical).

attributes.name: analysis_date
attributes.description: Date on which the laboratory analysis and testing of the product sample was performed. May differ from issue date.

attributes.name: api_gravity
attributes.description: API gravity of the crude oil or petroleum product, measured in degrees API. Key quality parameter for crude oil classification (light, medium, heavy).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11.1 - Volume Correction Factors

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Production batch or lot number of the petroleum product being certified. Used for traceability across the supply chain.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique certificate number issued by the laboratory or inspection authority. Used for legal reference and trade settlement.
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 11 - Physical Properties Data

attributes.name: certificate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Certificate of Quality. Tracks whether the certificate is in draft, officially issued, amended, superseded by a newer version, voided, or under dispute.

attributes.name: cetane_index
attributes.description: Cetane index for diesel fuel. Indicates the ignition quality of diesel fuel. Higher values indicate better ignition characteristics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this Certificate of Quality record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: digital_signature
attributes.description: Cryptographic digital signature or hash of the certificate for authenticity verification. Prevents tampering and ensures document integrity.

attributes.name: discharge_port
attributes.description: Name of the destination port or terminal where the cargo will be or was discharged. Used for trade settlement and logistics tracking.

attributes.name: distillation_fbp_c
attributes.description: Final Boiling Point from distillation analysis in degrees Celsius. Maximum temperature reached during distillation testing.

attributes.name: distillation_ibp_c
attributes.description: Initial Boiling Point from distillation analysis in degrees Celsius. First temperature at which vapor is produced during distillation testing.

attributes.name: distillation_t50_c
attributes.description: Temperature at which 50% of the product has been distilled. Key indicator of the product's volatility profile.

attributes.name: distillation_t90_c
attributes.description: Temperature at which 90% of the product has been distilled. Important for fuel performance and emissions characteristics.

attributes.name: flash_point_c
attributes.description: Flash point of the product in degrees Celsius. Critical safety parameter for handling, storage, and transportation classification.
attributes.references: ASTM D93, ASTM D56, IMO IMDG Code

attributes.name: inspector_certification
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the inspector (e.g., API Inspector certification, state chemist license). Validates inspector qualifications.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Quality was officially issued by the laboratory or inspection authority. Legally binding date for trade settlement.

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation standard and certificate number of the issuing laboratory (e.g., ISO/IEC 17025:2017, UKAS accreditation number). Validates laboratory competence.

attributes.name: loading_port
attributes.description: Name of the port, terminal, or facility where the cargo was loaded. Critical for custody transfer documentation.

attributes.name: meets_specification_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether all tested parameters meet the specified quality limits. True if product is on-spec, False if off-spec.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this Certificate of Quality record was last modified. Tracks amendments, corrections, or status changes.

attributes.name: mon_rating
attributes.description: Motor Octane Number for gasoline products. Measures fuel performance under high-load conditions. Used with RON to calculate (R+M)/2 octane rating.

attributes.name: pour_point_c
attributes.description: Pour point of the product in degrees Celsius. Indicates the lowest temperature at which the product will flow. Important for cold weather operations.

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Specific grade or quality designation of the product (e.g., WTI, Brent, Premium Unleaded 95 RON, Jet A-1, ULSD). Industry-standard product classification.

attributes.name: quantity_loaded

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the loaded quantity. Common units: BBL (barrels), MT (metric tons), M3 (cubic meters), GAL (gallons), LTR (liters).

attributes.name: reid_vapor_pressure_psi
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reid Vapor Pressure (RVP) Pounds per Square Inch (PSI)
attributes.description: Reid Vapor Pressure measured in PSI. Indicates the volatility of gasoline and light petroleum products. Critical for environmental and safety compliance.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text remarks, notes, or observations from the inspector or laboratory. May include special conditions, deviations, or clarifications.

attributes.name: ron_rating
attributes.description: Research Octane Number for gasoline products. Measures the fuel's resistance to knocking during combustion. Key specification for motor gasoline.

attributes.name: salt_content_ptb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salt Content Pounds per Thousand Barrels (PTB)
attributes.description: Salt content measured in pounds per thousand barrels. Important for refinery processing and corrosion prevention.

attributes.name: sampling_date
attributes.description: Date on which the product sample was collected from the cargo, tank, or pipeline for laboratory testing.

attributes.name: sampling_point
attributes.description: Physical location or equipment identifier where the product sample was collected (e.g., loading arm, tank outlet, pipeline meter station).

attributes.name: specific_gravity
attributes.description: Specific gravity (relative density) of the product at standard conditions. Used for volume-to-mass conversions and quality assessment.

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Industry specification or standard against which the product was tested (e.g., ASTM D975 for diesel, EN 590, ISO 8217 for marine fuels). Defines acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_pct
attributes.description: Sulfur content of the product expressed as weight percentage. Critical for environmental compliance and product classification (sweet vs. sour crude).

attributes.name: tan_value
attributes.description: Total Acid Number measured in mg KOH/g. Indicates the acidity of crude oil. High TAN crudes are corrosive and require special refinery processing.

attributes.name: vessel_imo_number
attributes.description: Unique seven-digit IMO number assigned to the vessel for international identification. Used for regulatory compliance and tracking.

attributes.name: vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the vessel, tanker, or pipeline through which the product was transported. Applicable for marine and pipeline shipments.

attributes.name: viscosity_cst
attributes.description: Kinematic viscosity of the product measured in centistokes at a specified temperature. Critical for fuel oil and heavy crude specifications.

attributes.name: viscosity_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius at which the viscosity was measured. Typically 40°C or 50°C for petroleum products.

attributes.name: water_content_pct
