products.name: commercial_price_index_preference
products.description: This association product represents the pricing preference relationship between customer counterparties and commodity price indices. It captures the customer's preferred benchmark indices for pricing agreements, including negotiated differentials, price floors/ceilings, and validity periods. Each record links one customer counterparty to one price index with relationship-specific attributes that govern how that index is applied in commercial transactions with that customer.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas commercial operations, customers negotiate pricing agreements that reference multiple commodity price indices (e.g., Brent for European contracts, WTI for North American contracts, Dubai for Asian contracts) depending on product type, delivery location, and contract terms. Each customer-index combination has relationship-specific attributes including negotiated differentials, price floors/ceilings, and validity periods that cannot be stored on either the customer or the index entity alone. The detection phase explicitly identified an existing price_index_preference association product with these relationship attributes already in the operational model.

attributes.name: commercial_price_index_preference_id
attributes.description: Primary key for commercial_price_index_preference

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Price Index Preference - Customer Counterparty Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer or counterparty who has this price index preference

attributes.name: price_index_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Price Index Preference - Price Index Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commodity price index that is preferred by this customer

attributes.name: price_index_preference_price_index_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer price index preference record. Primary key.

attributes.name: applicable_product_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of commodity product types to which this price index preference applies (e.g., crude_oil, refined_products, natural_gas). Allows customers to have different index preferences for different product categories.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price index preference automatically renews at the end of the effective_until period. True means the preference rolls over unless explicitly terminated; false means it expires and requires renegotiation.

attributes.name: ceiling_price_usd
attributes.description: Maximum price in USD per unit that will be charged to this customer regardless of how high the index price rises. Protects the customer from extreme market spikes while allowing the seller to benefit from index-linked pricing. Null if no ceiling is negotiated.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master sales agreement, pricing contract, or framework agreement that governs this price index preference. Links the preference to the legal contract documentation.

attributes.name: differential_usd
attributes.description: Negotiated price differential in USD applied to the published index price for this customer. Positive values indicate a premium above the index; negative values indicate a discount below the index. This differential reflects customer-specific pricing agreements based on volume, relationship, credit terms, or delivery logistics.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this price index preference becomes effective and can be used in pricing calculations for this customer. Typically aligned with contract effective dates or pricing agreement start dates.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this price index preference remains valid for this customer. After this date, the preference expires unless renewed. Null indicates an open-ended preference subject to contract terms.

attributes.name: floor_price_usd
attributes.description: Minimum price in USD per unit that will be charged to this customer regardless of how low the index price falls. Protects the seller from extreme market downturns while providing the customer with index-linked pricing benefits. Null if no floor is negotiated.

attributes.name: negotiated_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial manager or trader who negotiated this price index preference with the customer. Used for accountability and relationship management.

attributes.name: negotiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which this price index preference was negotiated and agreed with the customer. May differ from effective_from if there is a lag between agreement and implementation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special terms, conditions, or context about this price index preference that are not captured in structured fields. May include references to side letters, special delivery terms, or market conditions at time of negotiation.

attributes.name: preference_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of this price index preference when a customer has multiple active index preferences for different products or contract types. Rank 1 indicates primary preference, rank 2 secondary, etc. Used to determine which index to apply when multiple are valid.

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this price index preference. Active preferences are currently used in pricing calculations. Pending indicates negotiated but not yet effective. Inactive indicates temporarily suspended. Expired indicates the validity period has ended.

products.name: contract_pricing_term
products.description: This association product represents the pricing term relationship between term contracts and pricing agreements in oil & gas commercial operations. It captures the specific pricing arrangement applied to a contract during a defined period, including volume tiers, product grades, and priority sequencing when multiple pricing agreements may apply to the same contract. Each record links one term contract to one pricing agreement with attributes that govern how pricing is calculated for specific delivery scenarios.. Existence Justification: In oil & gas commercial operations, term contracts frequently require multiple pricing agreements to handle different scenarios: seasonal pricing variations, volume-tiered pricing structures, product grade differentials, and time-phased pricing transitions. Conversely, a single master pricing agreement (e.g., a published basin differential or a standard counterparty pricing formula) is routinely applied across multiple term contracts. Commercial teams actively manage these pricing term assignments as contracts are amended, market conditions change, or volume commitments are restructured.

attributes.name: contract_pricing_term_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for this contract pricing term record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Pricing Term - Term Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the term contract to which this pricing term applies

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Pricing Term - Pricing Agreement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the pricing agreement that defines the pricing formula and differentials

attributes.name: amendment_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the contract amendment or addendum that established or modified this pricing term. Links pricing changes to formal contract modifications for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this pricing term record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific pricing term becomes applicable to the contract. May differ from both the contract effective date and the pricing agreement effective date, as pricing terms can be amended or added during contract lifecycle.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific pricing term ceases to apply to the contract. Allows for time-bound pricing arrangements within longer-term contracts (e.g., seasonal pricing, promotional periods, or phased pricing transitions).

attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this pricing term record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.description: Numeric priority order for applying this pricing term when multiple pricing agreements could apply to the same contract scenario. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used to resolve pricing logic when overlapping conditions exist (e.g., general pricing vs. promotional pricing).

attributes.name: product_grade
attributes.description: Specific product grade or quality specification to which this pricing term applies (e.g., WTI_LIGHT_SWEET, BRENT_CRUDE, HENRY_HUB_GAS, DIESEL_ULSD). A single contract may have different pricing agreements for different product grades.

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this pricing term: draft (under negotiation), active (currently in effect), suspended (temporarily inactive), expired (past expiration date), superseded (replaced by newer term).

attributes.name: volume_tier_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum volume threshold (in contract UOM) at which this pricing term applies. Null indicates no upper limit for this tier. Used in conjunction with volume_tier_minimum to define tiered pricing bands.

attributes.name: volume_tier_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum volume threshold (in contract UOM) at which this pricing term becomes applicable. Enables tiered pricing structures where different pricing agreements apply at different volume levels (e.g., 0-10K BBL at one price, 10K-50K BBL at another).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this pricing term record.

domains.name: revenue
domains.description: Manages revenue recognition, invoicing, payment processing, accounts receivable, JIB (Joint Interest Billing) statements, royalty payments, tariff charges, and cash application for crude oil sales, refined product sales, and petrochemical revenues. Owns invoice data, payment terms, revenue allocation, credit notes, and dispute resolution. Supports COPAS-compliant billing procedures, IFRS/GAAP revenue recognition standards (successful-efforts and full-cost methods), and SOX compliance. Integrates with SAP FI/SD.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to customers (IOCs, NOCs, refiners, traders, industrial consumers) for crude oil sales, refined product sales, LNG/LPG/NGL deliveries, and petrochemical revenues. Captures invoice number, date, due date, billing period, type (commercial, intercompany, JIB, royalty, tariff), currency, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, payment terms (net days, early payment discount, late interest rate), status (draft, issued, disputed, paid, cancelled), and COPAS billing method indicator. SSOT for all outbound billing documents in the revenue domain.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the receivable was created. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods. Used for monthly financial close and reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 205 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the receivable was created. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-over-year analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 205 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code for the receivable. Maps to the chart of accounts for financial statement reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP ASC 210 Balance Sheet, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent dunning notice was sent to the customer. Used to schedule the next dunning cycle and track collection activity.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dunning Management, COPAS Credit and Collections Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the receivable record was last updated. Tracks changes to balance, status, or other attributes for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, SAP FI-AR Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment applied to this receivable. Used for payment tracking and cash application analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Payment Processing, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment applied to this receivable. Used to track payment activity and customer payment behavior.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Payment Processing, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: legal_referral_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was referred to legal counsel for collection action. Indicates escalation to litigation or formal legal demand.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, SAP FI-AR Legal Collections

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: The original invoiced amount when the receivable was first created. Represents the total amount owed before any payments, credits, or adjustments.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid balance remaining on the receivable after applying payments, credits, and adjustments. Used for aging analysis and expected credit loss provisioning.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, GAAP ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Losses

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is on an installment payment plan for this receivable. True if payment plan is active; false otherwise.
attributes.references: COPAS Credit and Collections Standards, SAP FI-AR Payment Plans

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center responsible for the revenue and receivable. Used for internal management reporting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Accounting, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date revenue was recognized for this receivable per IFRS 15 or GAAP ASC 606 revenue recognition standards. May differ from invoice date based on performance obligation satisfaction.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the receivable that has been written off as uncollectible. May be partial or full write-off. Impacts bad debt expense and expected credit loss reserves.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Model, GAAP ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Losses

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was written off. Used for financial reporting and audit trail. Write-offs must be approved per SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Derecognition, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this receivable has been written off as uncollectible. True if written off; false otherwise. Write-offs require management approval and are reported for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Derecognition, GAAP ASC 326 Credit Losses, SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the write-off. Common reasons include customer bankruptcy, uncollectible after legal action, small balance administrative write-off, or disputed amount settlement.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

products.name: cash_application
products.description: Records the matching and allocation of incoming payments to open receivable items. Captures application date, payment reference, invoice reference, applied amount, unapplied amount, application method (automatic, manual, partial), short payment amount, overpayment amount, tolerance amount, clearing document number, bank statement line reference, and application status (matched, partially matched, unmatched, on-account). Supports automated cash application workflows integrated with SAP FI bank statement processing and lockbox operations.

attributes.name: cash_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cash application record. Primary key for the cash application entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this cash application. Identifies the party making the payment.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Cash applications processed within specific legal entities for GL posting, bank reconciliation, and financial reporting in oil & gas operations.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice or receivable item to which the payment is being applied. May be null for on-account payments.

attributes.name: jib_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the JIB statement if this cash application relates to joint venture billing. Links payment to COPAS-compliant joint interest billing processes.

attributes.name: payer_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Cash application to JV partner receivables drives partner netting statements and cash call reconciliation. Required for accurate partner account balancing and dispute resolution in joint operations.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the incoming payment that is being applied to receivables. Links to the payment transaction that triggered this cash application event.

attributes.name: primary_cash_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who processed the cash application. Used for audit trail and accountability in manual application scenarios.

attributes.name: revenue_payment_term_id
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this cash application. Determines discount eligibility and due date calculations.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.royalty_owner. Business justification: Cash applications may apply to royalty owner payments for suspense clearing, requiring owner tracking for proper payment reconciliation and suspense account resolution.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was applied to the receivable item. Represents the business event date for revenue recognition and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payment was applied to the receivable. Automatic indicates system-matched application, manual indicates user intervention, partial indicates split application, lockbox indicates bank lockbox processing, electronic indicates EDI or API-based application.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the cash application transaction. Used for tracking and reference in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current status of the cash application. Matched indicates full application to invoice, partially matched indicates partial application, unmatched indicates payment received but not yet applied, on-account indicates payment held for future application, reversed indicates application has been reversed, pending indicates awaiting approval or processing.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the cash application was processed in the system. Used for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that was successfully applied to the receivable item. Represents the portion of the payment allocated to this specific invoice or receivable.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cash application was approved, if approval workflow is required. Used for audit trail and process compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: bank_statement_line_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item on the bank statement from which this payment originated. Links cash application to bank reconciliation processes.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or operating segment to which this cash application belongs. Used for segment reporting and revenue allocation.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI clearing document number generated when the payment is matched and cleared against the open receivable item. Used for financial reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code associated with the revenue or receivable being cleared. Used for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cash application record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cash application amounts. Indicates the currency in which the payment was received and applied.

attributes.name: days_to_pay
attributes.description: Number of days between invoice date and payment application date. Used for customer payment behavior analysis and DSO calculations.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount granted to the customer as part of this cash application. Reflects payment terms incentives for prompt payment.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment or invoice is under dispute. True if there is an active dispute affecting this cash application, false otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for payment dispute if dispute flag is true. Used for dispute tracking and resolution workflow.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Original due date of the invoice to which payment is being applied. Used to calculate days sales outstanding and aging analysis.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied when converting payment currency to functional currency. Used for multi-currency cash application and financial reporting.

attributes.name: functional_currency_applied_amount
attributes.description: The applied amount converted to the company functional currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the cash application is posted. Typically represents accounts receivable or cash clearing accounts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the cash application. Used to document special circumstances, manual adjustments, or customer communications.

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the payment exceeds the invoice total. Represents excess funds that may be refunded or held on-account for future invoices.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center code for internal management reporting. Used to allocate revenue and cash collections to organizational profit centers.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cash application was reversed, if applicable. Null if the application has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cash application has been reversed. True if the application was subsequently reversed due to error or dispute, false otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why the cash application was reversed. Provides audit trail for reversal decisions.

attributes.name: royalty_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cash application relates to royalty payments for oil and gas production. True if the payment is for royalty obligations, false otherwise.

attributes.name: short_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the payment falls short of the invoice total. Represents underpayment that may require follow-up or write-off.

attributes.name: tolerance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of variance allowed between payment and invoice total for automatic matching. Small differences within tolerance are automatically cleared without manual intervention.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that remains unapplied and is held on-account. Represents funds received but not yet allocated to specific invoices.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cash application record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: writeoff_amount
attributes.description: The amount written off as uncollectible or immaterial as part of this cash application. Used when short payments fall within write-off thresholds.

products.name: credit_note
products.description: Formal credit document issued to customers to reverse or reduce previously billed amounts due to pricing adjustments, quality claims, volume disputes, measurement corrections, or contractual price reopeners. Captures credit note number, original invoice reference, credit reason code (quality claim, volume adjustment, price correction, measurement dispute, contractual adjustment), credit amount, date, approval status, approver, and reissuance flag. Supports COPAS-compliant billing adjustment procedures and IFRS 15 revenue reversal requirements.

attributes.name: credit_note_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit note record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer or counterparty receiving the credit. Links to the customer master for account reconciliation and accounts receivable management.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Credit notes for facility downtime, processing quality issues, capacity shortfalls, or service level agreement breaches must reference the facility for root cause tracking and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: cargo_nomination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.cargo_nomination. Business justification: Credit notes adjust cargo nomination billing for BL shortfalls, quality claims, or demurrage disputes. Operational necessity for cargo-level billing corrections.

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the joint venture partner if this credit note relates to joint interest billing (JIB) adjustments. Nullable for non-JV transactions.
attributes.references: COPAS JIB Standards, SAP Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underlying sales contract or term agreement governing the original transaction. Nullable for spot sales. Supports contractual compliance and price reopener tracking.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Credit notes issued by specific legal entities for revenue adjustments, financial reporting, and audit compliance in oil & gas operations.

attributes.name: complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.complaint. Business justification: Credit notes issued for quality claims, volume disputes, or service failures must reference the originating customer complaint for audit trail, root cause tracking, and customer satisfaction measureme

attributes.name: credited_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: JV credit notes must identify the partner receiving credit for accurate partner account reconciliation, netting statement adjustments, and dispute tracking. Essential for partner-specific credit manag

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the formal dispute or claim case that triggered this credit note, if applicable. Nullable for non-dispute credits. Supports dispute resolution tracking and legal compliance.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager who approved the credit note issuance. Supports SOX audit trails and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice that this credit note adjusts or reverses. Links to the invoice product for traceability.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Credit notes for JV billing disputes must reference the governing JOA for proper allocation, dispute resolution per JOA terms, and audit compliance. Links credit adjustments to joint operating agreeme

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Credit notes for production revenue adjustments must reference lease for proper revenue reallocation to working interest and royalty owners per lease terms.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Credit notes adjust offtake agreement billing for measurement disputes, quality claims, or pricing corrections. Operational necessity for post-lifting billing adjustments.

attributes.name: original_credit_note_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original credit note if this is a reissue or correction. Nullable for first-time issuances. Supports version tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Credit notes adjust billing for specific products due to quality deviations, volume disputes, or pricing corrections. Direct product reference required for quality claim validation and revenue adjustm

attributes.name: quality_test_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.quality_test_result. Business justification: Credit notes cite specific lab test results as evidence for quality-based claims. Linking to test results provides audit trail for off-spec product credits, supports dispute resolution, and ensures SO

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.sales_order. Business justification: Credit notes issued against sales orders for volume shortfalls, quality claims, or pricing adjustments. Direct operational link for order-level billing corrections.

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation. Business justification: Credit notes issued for billing corrections discovered during compliance audits or violation investigations. Links revenue adjustments to root cause compliance events for audit trail and SOX controls.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) in which the credit note is recognized for financial reporting purposes. Supports period-end close and revenue reconciliation.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: AFE number associated with the joint venture project if this credit note relates to JIB adjustments. Nullable for non-JV transactions. Supports COPAS-compliant cost allocation.
attributes.references: COPAS AFE Guidelines, SAP Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the credit note. Tracks progression through approval gates required by SOX controls and revenue policy.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Internal Revenue Policy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the credit note was formally approved. Supports audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center or profit center to which the credit note is allocated for internal management reporting. Supports segment profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Controlling, Internal Management Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the credit note record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the credit being issued, in the transaction currency. Represents the amount to be reversed or reduced from the customer's accounts receivable balance.

attributes.name: credit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit note was formally issued to the customer. Used for revenue recognition reversal timing and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the credit note, typically following a company-specific numbering convention (e.g., CN-20240001234). Used for customer communication and audit trails.

attributes.name: credit_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for issuing the credit note. Supports root-cause analysis and dispute resolution tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Internal Revenue Policy

attributes.name: credit_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the reason for the credit, including specific circumstances, claim details, or contractual clause references. Supports audit and customer communication.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency revenue operations.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the credit note revenue reversal is posted. Supports financial reporting and chart of accounts compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts, GAAP

attributes.name: measurement_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit note was issued due to a custody transfer measurement dispute (e.g., meter calibration error, tank gauging discrepancy). Supports measurement integrity audits.
attributes.references: API MPMS Standards, Custody Transfer Procedures

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the credit note record. Supports audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the credit note record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, instructions, or context related to the credit note. Supports customer communication and internal documentation.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to the credit note settlement (e.g., Net 30, Immediate, Applied to AR Balance). Supports cash application and accounts receivable management.
attributes.references: COPAS Billing Guidelines, Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit note transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from credit_date due to period-end cutoffs or approval delays.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary adjustment due to price corrections, contractual price reopeners, or index adjustments. Nullable if credit is not price-related. Supports pricing dispute resolution.

attributes.name: quality_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit note was issued due to a product quality claim (e.g., off-spec crude, contamination, API gravity variance). Supports quality assurance tracking and supplier performance analysis.
attributes.references: API Quality Standards, Internal QA Policy

attributes.name: reissue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit note is a reissue or correction of a previously issued credit note. Supports audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the credit will be settled with the customer (e.g., cash refund, accounts receivable credit, offset against future invoices, partner netting). Supports cash management and AR reconciliation.
attributes.references: COPAS Billing Guidelines, Internal Treasury Policy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount being reversed or adjusted by this credit note (e.g., sales tax, VAT, excise duty). Supports tax compliance and reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code, VAT Directive, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or authority under which the tax adjustment applies (e.g., US-Federal, UK-HMRC, TX-State). Supports multi-jurisdictional tax reporting.

attributes.name: volume_adjustment_quantity
attributes.description: Physical quantity adjustment (in barrels, cubic feet, or metric tons) that triggered the credit note, if applicable. Nullable for non-volume-related credits. Supports measurement reconciliation and custody transfer audits.
attributes.references: API MPMS Standards, Custody Transfer Procedures

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume adjustment quantity. Common values: BBL (barrels), MCF (thousand cubic feet), MT (metric tons), GAL (gallons). Nullable if no volume adjustment applies.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the credit note record. Supports audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.

products.name: revenue_allocation
products.description: Records the allocation of gross production revenue to individual working interest owners, royalty owners, and cost recovery accounts under PSA and JOA structures. Captures allocation period, allocation method (volumetric, entitlement, lifting), gross revenue, allocated revenue by owner, WI percentage, NRI percentage, cost recovery amount (for PSA profit oil splits), profit oil percentage, government take, partner entitlement volume, overlift/underlift position, and allocation status. Supports IFRS/GAAP revenue recognition under successful-efforts and full-cost methods.
products.reference: SAP JVA Revenue Allocation / Avocet Production Allocation

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the revenue allocation record.

attributes.name: allocated_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Revenue allocation to working interest owners requires partner identification for entitlement calculation, partner equity reporting, and distribution statements. Reuses existing owner_id for mineral o

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue allocations to cost centers for joint venture accounting, working interest tracking, and AFE cost recovery in oil & gas operations.

attributes.name: division_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.division_order. Business justification: Revenue allocation follows division order decimal interests as the authoritative source for owner entitlement calculations - required for accurate revenue distribution and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: jib_statement_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Joint Interest Billing statement that includes this revenue allocation, used for partner billing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Joint Operating Agreement governing the revenue allocation and cost sharing among partners.
attributes.references: AAPL Form 610 Model Form Operating Agreement

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Revenue allocation must reference lease agreements to properly distribute revenue according to lease terms, working interest provisions, and royalty rates - core to production revenue accounting.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Revenue allocation distributes offtake agreement proceeds to JV partners based on working interest. Core PSA/JOA revenue distribution process for production sharing and joint operations.

attributes.name: offtake_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.offtake_entitlement. Business justification: Revenue allocation calculates partner entitlements based on offtake agreements and working interest percentages. Direct link required for distributing production revenue according to contractual entit

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Revenue allocation distributes product-specific entitlements to JV partners and PSA participants. Core joint venture accounting requires linking allocated revenue to exact product grades with their pr

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue allocations to profit centers for segment P&L reporting, field-level profitability analysis, and management reporting in oil & gas operations.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the oil and gas property or lease from which production revenue is generated.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Production Sharing Agreement governing cost recovery and profit oil splits with government or national oil company.

attributes.name: reservoir_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservoir.reservoir. Business justification: PSA/JOA revenue allocation requires reservoir-level entitlement calculations for cost recovery, profit oil splits, and working interest distributions. Allocation runs reference reservoir OOIP/OGIP for

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the working interest owner, royalty owner, or partner receiving the allocated revenue.

attributes.name: accounting_method
attributes.description: The accounting method applied for revenue recognition (successful efforts, full cost, or entitlement method for PSA arrangements).
attributes.references: IFRS 6 / ASC 932 Oil and Gas Accounting

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume
attributes.description: The actual volume of production physically lifted or taken by the partner during the allocation period.

attributes.name: ad_valorem_tax_amount
attributes.description: The ad valorem (property) tax amount allocated to the owner based on their ownership interest and the assessed value of the property.

attributes.name: allocated_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The revenue amount allocated to the specific owner based on their ownership interest and allocation method.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate revenue among owners (volumetric based on production share, entitlement based on contractual rights, lifting based on actual offtake, net-back based on realized prices).

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: The current status of the revenue allocation record in the allocation workflow (draft, preliminary, final, adjusted, disputed, approved).

attributes.name: cost_recovery_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue allocated to cost recovery under a Production Sharing Agreement before profit oil is split between contractor and government.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the revenue amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this allocation is under dispute by one or more partners (True = disputed, False = not disputed).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the dispute if the allocation is flagged as disputed.

attributes.name: entitlement_volume_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the partner entitlement volume (BOE = Barrel of Oil Equivalent, BBL = Barrel, MCF = Thousand Cubic Feet, MMCF = Million Cubic Feet, MT = Metric Ton, GAL = Gallon).

attributes.name: government_take_amount
attributes.description: The total revenue amount allocated to the government or national oil company, including royalties, taxes, and profit oil share under PSA.

attributes.name: gross_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The total gross revenue from production sales before allocation to individual owners, expressed in the functional currency.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue allocation record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nri_percentage
attributes.description: The net revenue interest percentage held by the owner, representing their share of revenue after deducting royalties and overriding royalties from working interest.

attributes.name: orri_percentage
attributes.description: The overriding royalty interest percentage carved out of the working interest, representing a share of revenue without bearing costs.

attributes.name: overlift_underlift_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the overlift or underlift position, calculated by multiplying the volume imbalance by the applicable product price.

attributes.name: overlift_underlift_volume
attributes.description: The difference between actual lifted volume and entitlement volume, representing an overlift (positive) or underlift (negative) position that must be reconciled in future periods.

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: The type of ownership interest held by the owner receiving the allocation (e.g., working interest, royalty interest, overriding royalty interest).

attributes.name: partner_entitlement_volume
attributes.description: The volume of production (in barrels of oil equivalent) that the partner is entitled to lift based on their ownership interest and allocation method.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the allocation period, typically the last day of the production month.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the allocation period, typically the first day of the production month.

attributes.name: price_differential
attributes.description: The difference between the benchmark price (e.g., WTI, Brent) and the realized price, reflecting quality adjustments, location basis, and transportation costs.

attributes.name: processing_deduction
attributes.description: The amount deducted from gross revenue to cover gas processing, treating, or conditioning costs.

attributes.name: production_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which production revenue is being allocated.

attributes.name: profit_oil_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of profit oil (revenue after cost recovery) allocated to the contractor under a Production Sharing Agreement.

attributes.name: realized_price_per_unit
attributes.description: The actual price realized per unit of production after adjustments for quality, transportation, and market differentials.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the allocated revenue is recognized in the financial statements under IFRS 15 or ASC 606 revenue recognition standards.

attributes.name: royalty_percentage
attributes.description: The royalty percentage applicable to the owner if they hold a royalty interest, representing their share of gross revenue without bearing costs.

attributes.name: run_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch allocation run that generated this allocation record, used for audit trail and reprocessing.

attributes.name: severance_tax_amount
attributes.description: The severance or production tax amount deducted from the allocated revenue, typically based on state or provincial regulations.

attributes.name: transportation_deduction
attributes.description: The amount deducted from gross revenue to cover transportation costs from wellhead to point of sale.

attributes.name: wi_percentage
attributes.description: The working interest percentage held by the owner in the property, representing their share of costs and gross revenue before royalties.

products.name: tariff_charge
