attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Payment Terms

attributes.name: copas_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term complies with COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) standard billing procedures for Joint Interest Billing (JIB) and petroleum accounting. True if COPAS-compliant; False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which payment is expected (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro, GBP for British Pound). Determines the currency for discount and interest calculations.

attributes.name: discount_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from invoice date within which payment must be received to qualify for the early payment discount (e.g., 10 in 2/10 Net 30 terms). Null if no early payment discount is offered.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Payment Terms

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered for early payment within the discount period (e.g., 2.00 for 2% discount in 2/10 Net 30 terms). Null if no early payment discount is offered.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payment term is no longer available for use on new invoices. Null for open-ended terms. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Master Data

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payment term becomes effective and available for use on invoices. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Master Data

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the net due date during which late payment interest is not assessed, providing a buffer before penalties begin. Null if no grace period is granted.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Commercial Contract Standards

attributes.name: installment_count
attributes.description: Number of scheduled installment payments for installment-type payment terms. Null for non-installment terms.

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of installment payments for installment-type payment terms (e.g., monthly, quarterly, semi-annual). Null for non-installment terms.

attributes.name: jib_standard_term_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: JIB (Joint Interest Billing) Standard Term Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment term is a standard term used for JIB (Joint Interest Billing) statements under Joint Operating Agreements (JOA). True if this is a JIB standard term; False otherwise.

attributes.name: late_payment_interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate (percentage) applied to overdue balances after the net due date has passed. Expressed as annual percentage rate (APR). Null if no late payment penalty is assessed.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Commercial Contract Standards

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this payment term record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: net_due_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from invoice date by which full payment is due without penalty (e.g., 30 for Net 30, 45 for Net 45, 60 for Net 60). Used to calculate invoice due date.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Payment Terms

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or business context related to this payment term (e.g., negotiated terms for specific customers, regional variations, contract references).

attributes.name: payment_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term. Active terms are available for use on new invoices; inactive terms are no longer available but remain for historical reference; deprecated terms are being phased out; pending approval terms are awaiting finance approval before activation.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Master Data

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Product category to which this payment term applies. Crude oil sales, natural gas sales, LNG (Liquefied Natural Gas) sales, NGL (Natural Gas Liquids) sales, LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) sales, refined product sales (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel), petrochemical sales, service revenues, JIB (Joint Interest Billing) statements, or all categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil|natural_gas|lng|ngl|lpg|refined_product|petrochemical|service|jib|all — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_impact
attributes.description: Describes how this payment term affects revenue recognition timing under IFRS 15 / ASC 606. None indicates no impact on recognition timing; deferred indicates revenue recognition is delayed until payment milestones; accelerated indicates early recognition based on payment terms; variable consideration indicates the payment term introduces variable consideration requiring constraint assessment.

attributes.name: sap_fi_payment_term_key
attributes.description: Four-character SAP Financial Accounting (FI) module payment term key used for integration with SAP S/4HANA accounts receivable and invoicing processes. Maps this payment term to the corresponding SAP master data record.
attributes.references: SAP FI Configuration, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: term_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the payment term (e.g., NET30, NET45, NET60, 2_10_NET30). Used as the business key for lookup and integration with SAP FI payment term master.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP FI Payment Terms

attributes.name: term_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment term conditions, including any special instructions or business rules applicable to crude oil sales, LNG sales, refined product sales, or petrochemical revenues.

attributes.name: term_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term (e.g., Net 30 Days, 2% 10 Net 30, Net 45 Days End of Month).

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment term structure. Standard terms are simple net-due arrangements; early payment discount terms offer a percentage reduction for payment within a discount period; installment terms allow multiple scheduled payments; prepayment requires payment before delivery; consignment defers payment until product is sold; letter of credit terms require bank-backed payment guarantee.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this payment term record in the system.

products.name: customer_credit
products.description: Credit limit and creditworthiness management records for customers and JIB partners to control exposure risk in petroleum product sales. Captures credit account reference, customer reference, credit limit amount, currency, credit exposure (outstanding AR + open orders), available credit, credit rating (internal), external credit rating agency, credit rating date, credit review date, credit hold flag, credit hold reason, collateral type (letter of credit, parent guarantee, cash deposit), collateral amount, collateral expiry date, and credit analyst. Supports SOX-compliant credit approval workflows and IFRS 9 expected credit loss assessment.

attributes.name: customer_credit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer credit record. Primary key for the customer credit entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or Joint Interest Billing (JIB) partner for whom this credit limit is established. Links to the customer master record in SAP FI/SD.

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.commercial_counterparty. Business justification: Customer credit limits track counterparty creditworthiness for commercial transactions. Core credit risk management linking AR credit exposure to trading counterparty master data.

attributes.name: available_credit_amount
attributes.description: Remaining credit capacity calculated as credit limit minus credit exposure. Determines whether new orders can be accepted without credit hold.

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Face value of the collateral instrument in the credit account currency. Reduces net credit exposure for risk assessment purposes.

attributes.name: collateral_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the collateral instrument expires or must be renewed. Triggers proactive renewal workflows to maintain credit coverage.

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral or credit enhancement instrument securing the credit exposure. Common in Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) and Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) contexts.
attributes.references: COPAS Joint Interest Billing Standards, JOA Credit Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer credit record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: credit_account_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the credit account. Used in customer communications and credit review documentation.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Current total credit exposure calculated as outstanding Accounts Receivable (AR) plus open sales orders. Updated in real-time from SAP FI/SD to support credit hold decisions.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is currently on credit hold. When true, new sales orders are blocked pending credit resolution. Enforced in SAP SD order processing.

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for placing the customer on credit hold. Supports root cause analysis and dispute resolution workflows.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount covered by the trade credit insurance policy for this customer. May be less than the total credit limit.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer credit exposure is covered by trade credit insurance. Reduces net credit risk for insured accounts.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the trade credit insurance covering this customer. Used for claims filing in case of customer default.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure authorized for this customer. Represents the ceiling for outstanding Accounts Receivable (AR) plus open sales orders. Used in SOX-compliant credit approval workflows.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss Assessment, SOX Credit Control Framework

attributes.name: credit_limit_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credit limit became effective. Supports historical credit limit tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: credit_limit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credit limit expires and must be reviewed or renewed. Null for indefinite credit limits.

attributes.name: credit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from credit analysts regarding special credit considerations, payment history observations, or risk mitigation actions.

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the external credit rating agency that provided the external credit rating (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Moody's, Standard & Poor's, Fitch).

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit account. Active accounts are eligible for new transactions; suspended or closed accounts require credit manager approval.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit limit amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Aligns with SAP FI currency configuration.

attributes.name: days_sales_outstanding
attributes.description: Average number of days this customer takes to pay invoices. Key performance indicator for credit risk assessment and working capital management.

attributes.name: external_credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned by external credit rating agency (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Moody's, S&P). Provides independent third-party creditworthiness assessment.

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal creditworthiness assessment assigned by the credit analyst. Scale ranges from AAA (highest quality) to D (default). Used for IFRS 9 expected credit loss provisioning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: jib_partner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit account is for a Joint Interest Billing (JIB) partner under a Joint Operating Agreement (JOA). JIB partners have specialized credit terms per COPAS standards.
attributes.references: COPAS Joint Interest Billing Standards, JOA Credit Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer credit record was last updated. Tracks the recency of credit information for risk assessment purposes.

attributes.name: past_due_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of invoices currently past their due date. Triggers credit hold and collection escalation workflows when thresholds are exceeded.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code assigned to this customer (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Determines invoice due dates and early payment discount eligibility. Aligns with SAP FI payment terms master data.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: Working Interest (WI) percentage held by this JIB partner in the joint venture. Used to calculate proportional billing amounts and credit exposure allocation.

products.name: deferred_revenue
products.description: Tracks revenue amounts received or billed but not yet recognized under IFRS 15 / ASC 606 due to unsatisfied performance obligations, take-or-pay arrangements, or advance payments. Captures deferred revenue balance, originating invoice or contract reference, customer, product type, deferral reason (advance payment, take-or-pay, bill-and-hold, minimum volume shortfall), deferred amount, recognition schedule, expected recognition date, recognized-to-date amount, remaining deferred balance, and SAP FI deferred revenue account. Supports period-end close and SEC revenue disclosure requirements.
products.reference: IFRS 15 Contract Liability / SAP FI Deferred Revenue

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the deferred revenue record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or joint venture partner who made the advance payment or is subject to the take-or-pay arrangement.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.facility. Business justification: Deferred revenue from take-or-pay contracts, prepaid processing fees, or capacity reservations must track to specific facilities for performance obligation fulfillment and ASC 606 revenue recognition.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying contract or agreement that governs the revenue recognition terms. May reference a PSA, JOA, or term contract.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Deferred revenue from take-or-pay, prepayments, or PSA cost pools reported in regulatory filings. Required for PSA quarterly reporting and government financial statement reconciliation.

attributes.name: deferring_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Deferred revenue by JV partner is needed for partner equity reporting, partner-specific balance sheet preparation, and working interest-based revenue recognition schedules. Supports partner financial

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Deferred revenue posted to specific GL accounts for balance sheet reporting, revenue recognition schedules, and financial compliance in oil & gas.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating invoice that generated the deferred revenue. Links to the invoice master record in SAP FI.

attributes.name: jib_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the JIB statement if the deferred revenue relates to joint venture billing under COPAS standards. Links to joint interest billing records.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Deferred revenue from take-or-pay obligations or prepayments needs lease context for performance obligation tracking and proper revenue recognition timing per lease terms.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Deferred revenue tracks product-specific prepayments and performance obligations under IFRS 15. Revenue recognition schedules depend on product delivery milestones and quality acceptance, requiring di

attributes.name: recognition_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the detailed revenue recognition schedule that defines the timing and amounts of periodic revenue recognition entries for this deferred revenue.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (e.g., 2024-01, 2024-Q1) in which the deferred revenue entry was created or last modified. Used for period-end close and financial reporting.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or operating segment responsible for the deferred revenue. May represent upstream E&P, downstream refining, or petrochemical divisions.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center associated with the deferred revenue, used for internal management reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created the deferred revenue record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the deferred revenue record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deferred revenue amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deferral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue was initially deferred. Typically the invoice date or payment receipt date when the performance obligation was identified as unsatisfied.

attributes.name: deferral_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the business reason for deferring revenue recognition. Aligns with IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation criteria.

attributes.name: deferral_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why revenue recognition was deferred, including specific contractual terms or performance obligations that remain unsatisfied.

attributes.name: deferral_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique reference number for the deferred revenue entry, used for tracking and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: deferral_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deferred revenue entry. Tracks whether the revenue is still deferred, partially recognized, fully recognized, or reversed.

attributes.name: expected_recognition_end_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date when all deferred revenue is expected to be fully recognized, based on the contract term or performance obligation completion schedule.

attributes.name: expected_recognition_start_date
attributes.description: The anticipated date when revenue recognition is expected to begin based on the contractual terms or performance obligation schedule.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the deferred revenue entry was created. Used for annual financial reporting and multi-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified the deferred revenue record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the deferred revenue record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The net revenue interest percentage after deducting royalties and overriding royalty interests. Used for accurate revenue allocation in joint venture scenarios.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or special instructions related to the deferred revenue entry. Used by accounting staff for documentation purposes.

attributes.name: original_deferred_amount
attributes.description: The total revenue amount initially deferred at the time of invoice or payment receipt. Represents the full performance obligation value that was not immediately recognizable.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the unsatisfied performance obligation(s) that caused the revenue deferral. May include delivery commitments, service obligations, or contractual milestones.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center associated with the deferred revenue, used for segment reporting and internal performance measurement.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The revenue recognition method applied to this deferred revenue entry, as prescribed by IFRS 15 / ASC 606. Indicates whether revenue is recognized at a point in time or over time, and the specific pattern used.

attributes.name: recognized_to_date_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative revenue amount that has been recognized to date from the original deferred balance. Updated as performance obligations are satisfied over time.

attributes.name: remaining_deferred_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding deferred revenue balance that has not yet been recognized. Calculated as original deferred amount minus recognized to date amount.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deferred revenue entry was reversed, if applicable. Used when a contract is cancelled or modified and the deferral is no longer valid.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the deferred revenue entry was reversed, such as contract cancellation, customer refund, or contract modification.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deferred revenue entry is material and must be disclosed in SEC financial reporting filings (10-K, 10-Q).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deferred revenue entry is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures. True if the entry is material and requires enhanced controls.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The working interest percentage applicable to this deferred revenue entry if it relates to joint venture operations. Represents the ownership share in the revenue stream.

products.name: intercompany_billing
products.description: Intercompany billing transactions between affiliated entities within the corporate group for crude oil transfers, product exchanges, infrastructure usage, and shared services. Captures document number, billing entity, receiving entity, transaction type (crude transfer, product exchange, pipeline tariff, processing fee, management fee), billing period, volume, unit price, total amount, transfer pricing method, arms-length price reference, tax jurisdiction, withholding tax rate, withholding tax amount, and net amount. Supports OECD transfer pricing compliance, BEPS country-by-country reporting, and intercompany elimination controls.
products.reference: SAP FI Intercompany Billing / OECD Transfer Pricing

attributes.name: intercompany_billing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany billing transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Intercompany transactions require employee accountability for transfer pricing documentation, BEPS compliance, and tax authority audits. Creator tracking supports arms-length pricing defense and withh

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Intercompany charges between JV entities must reference the governing JOA for proper cost allocation, transfer pricing validation, and elimination in consolidated JV financial statements.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Transfer pricing documentation requires product-specific details for tax compliance and BEPS reporting. Intercompany transactions must reference product master data for arms-length pricing validation

attributes.name: primary_intercompany_company_code_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the affiliated legal entity issuing the intercompany invoice or charge.

attributes.name: receiving_entity_company_code_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the affiliated legal entity receiving the intercompany invoice or charge.

attributes.name: revenue_payment_term_id
attributes.description: Payment terms for the intercompany billing transaction (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Due on Receipt).

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: Intercompany transactions subject to SOX transfer pricing controls. Links intercompany billing to specific SOX control tests for arms-length pricing validation and BEPS compliance.

attributes.name: arms_length_price_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the market benchmark or comparable transaction used to establish the arms-length price for transfer pricing compliance (e.g., WTI index, Brent crude, published tariff schedule).

attributes.name: beps_country_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO two-letter country code for OECD BEPS country-by-country reporting requirements, identifying the jurisdiction of the transaction.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this intercompany billing transaction.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this intercompany billing transaction.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area code representing the operational segment (e.g., upstream, downstream, midstream) for financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code associated with the intercompany billing transaction for internal cost allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the intercompany billing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique document number for the intercompany billing transaction, used for reference and reconciliation across affiliated entities.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due from the receiving entity to the billing entity.

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this intercompany transaction should be eliminated in consolidated financial statements (True = eliminate, False = retain).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the intercompany billing transaction is posted in the financial system.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of the intercompany billing transaction before any adjustments, taxes, or withholdings.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the intercompany billing record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the intercompany billing record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net amount payable after deducting withholding tax and any other adjustments from the gross amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context, explanations, or special instructions related to the intercompany billing transaction.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date when payment was received or processed for the intercompany billing transaction.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the intercompany billing transaction: pending (awaiting payment), paid (payment received), overdue (past due date), disputed (under dispute resolution), cancelled (transaction voided).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany billing transaction was posted to the general ledger in the financial system.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center code associated with the intercompany billing transaction for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the original source document (e.g., sales order, delivery note, service agreement) that triggered the intercompany billing transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transaction is a reversal or correction of a previous intercompany billing entry (True = reversal, False = original transaction).

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original intercompany billing transaction that is being reversed by this entry, if applicable.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this intercompany billing transaction is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit requirements (True = subject to SOX controls, False = not subject).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO country or jurisdiction code where the transaction is subject to taxation and withholding requirements.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany transaction occurred or was recognized for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction: crude transfer (crude oil movement between entities), product exchange (refined product swap), pipeline tariff (infrastructure usage charge), processing_fee (refining or processing service), management_fee (corporate overhead allocation), or shared_service (shared support function charge).

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: OECD-compliant transfer pricing method applied: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price), RPM (Resale Price Method), CPM (Cost Plus Method), TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method), PSM (Profit Split Method).
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per unit of volume for the intercompany transaction, expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Quantity of crude oil, refined product, or natural gas transferred or exchanged in the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the transaction volume: BBL (barrels for crude oil), MMBTU (million British thermal units for gas), MCF (thousand cubic feet for gas), MT (metric tons), GAL (gallons for refined products).

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total withholding tax amount deducted from the gross billing amount, expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_rate
attributes.description: Applicable withholding tax rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 for 15%) applied to the intercompany transaction per tax treaty or local regulation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the intercompany billing record.

products.name: take_or_pay

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Take-or-pay obligations disclosed in PSA regulatory filings and FERC gas contract filings. Required for government contract compliance reporting and regulatory transparency of minimum volume commitmen

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_volume_commitment. Business justification: Take-or-pay obligations in revenue domain enforce volume commitments tracked in customer domain. Direct link required for calculating shortfall volumes, invoicing deficiency charges, tracking makeup r

attributes.name: delivery_point_id

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the invoice record in the invoicing system for the take-or-pay shortfall billing.

attributes.name: offtake_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.offtake_agreement. Business justification: Take-or-pay provisions commonly embedded in offtake agreements (gas sales, LNG contracts). Direct contractual link for minimum volume commitment tracking and deficiency payment calculation.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id

attributes.name: carryforward_balance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the carry-forward balance volume, representing deferred revenue liability until make-up is utilized or entitlement expires.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: carryforward_balance_volume
attributes.description: The remaining make-up volume entitlement that has not yet been utilized and is carried forward to future periods (makeup_volume_entitlement - makeup_volume_utilized).

attributes.name: contract_price_per_unit
attributes.description: The contractual price per unit of volume applicable to the take-or-pay obligation for this period. Used to calculate shortfall payment amount.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the contract (e.g., contract number, SPA reference code) under which the take-or-pay obligation is defined.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this take-or-pay obligation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (contract price, shortfall amount, make-up credit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|AUD|CAD|CHF|SGD|AED — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the shortfall payment that is deferred as a liability on the balance sheet, representing the obligation to deliver make-up volume or refund if not utilized.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the take-or-pay obligation or shortfall amount is currently under dispute by the counterparty. True if disputed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for dispute, if dispute_flag is True. Captures counterparty objections to volume measurement, pricing, or contract interpretation.

attributes.name: force_majeure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a force majeure event was declared by either party during the obligation period, potentially excusing non-performance of take-or-pay obligations. True if force majeure applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person or system process that last modified this record, supporting audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this take-or-pay obligation record was last updated, capturing any changes to volumes, amounts, status, or make-up utilization.

attributes.name: makeup_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the make-up period. After this date, unused make-up entitlements typically expire and shortfall payments become final revenue.

attributes.name: makeup_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period during which the buyer may take additional volume to make up for previously paid shortfalls, if contract allows make-up rights.

attributes.name: makeup_volume_entitlement
attributes.description: The cumulative volume the buyer is entitled to take in future periods as make-up for this shortfall, if contract permits make-up rights. Typically equals shortfall_volume.

attributes.name: makeup_volume_utilized
attributes.description: The volume that has been taken by the buyer under make-up rights for this specific shortfall obligation, reducing the carry-forward balance.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine actual taken volume. Values: meter (custody transfer meter reading), allocation (pro-rata allocation from production), nomination (buyer nomination accepted as actual), actual_lifting (physical cargo lifting for LNG).
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: minimum_contracted_volume
attributes.description: The minimum volume the buyer is obligated to take (or pay for if not taken) during the obligation period, expressed in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: obligation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the measurement period for this take-or-pay obligation.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: obligation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the measurement period for this take-or-pay obligation (typically monthly, quarterly, or annual).
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: obligation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the take-or-pay obligation. Values: in_compliance (buyer met minimum volume), shortfall (buyer did not meet minimum, payment due), makeup_active (shortfall paid, make-up period open), makeup_expired (make-up period closed, revenue recognized), disputed (shortfall amount under dispute), waived (obligation waived by seller).

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Contractual due date for the counterparty to remit the shortfall payment, per the terms of the gas sales agreement or SPA.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shortfall payment was received from the counterparty, triggering cash application and revenue recognition assessment.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Status of revenue recognition for the shortfall payment under IFRS 15. Values: deferred (payment received but revenue deferred due to make-up rights), recognized (revenue fully recognized), partially_recognized (some make-up utilized, partial recognition), reversed (revenue reversed due to dispute or contract modification).
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: revenue_recognized_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the shortfall amount that has been recognized as revenue in the financial statements, net of any deferred revenue for outstanding make-up entitlements.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: shortfall_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the buyer must pay for the shortfall volume (shortfall_volume * contract_price_per_unit), representing the take-or-pay penalty or deficiency payment.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: shortfall_volume
attributes.description: The difference between minimum contracted volume and actual taken volume (minimum_contracted_volume - actual_taken_volume). Positive value indicates a shortfall; zero or negative indicates full compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this take-or-pay obligation data originated (e.g., SAP FI/SD, SAP Joint Venture Accounting, Quorum Land System, custom contract management system).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this take-or-pay obligation record is subject to SOX internal controls for revenue recognition and financial reporting. True if SOX-controlled, False otherwise.

attributes.name: top_invoice_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the invoice issued for the take-or-pay shortfall payment, linking this obligation to accounts receivable and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all volume fields in this record. Common values: MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet), MMCF (Million Cubic Feet), MMCFD (Million Cubic Feet per Day), BCF (Billion Cubic Feet), MMBTU (Million British Thermal Units), MT (Metric Tons for LNG), BBL (Barrels), GAL (Gallons). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MCF|MMCF|MMCFD|BCF|MMBTU|MT|BBL|GAL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API MPMS Chapter 14 - Natural Gas Fluids Measurement

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seller has waived the take-or-pay obligation for this period (e.g., due to force majeure, commercial negotiation, or contract amendment). True if waived, False otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for waiving the take-or-pay obligation, if waiver_flag is True. Captures business rationale and supporting documentation reference.

products.name: credit_review
products.description: This association product represents the credit review and approval workflow between customer credit accounts and employees. It captures the multi-level approval process required for credit limit establishment, periodic reassessment, and credit risk management. Each record links one customer credit account to one employee (credit analyst, credit manager, CFO) with their specific role, review findings, and approval authority level in the credit decision chain.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas credit management, customer credit accounts undergo multi-level approval workflows involving multiple employees at different authority levels (credit analyst, credit manager, CFO) based on credit limit size and risk rating. Each customer credit account has multiple employees review it over time (initial assessment, periodic reviews, limit increase requests), and each employee reviews multiple customer credit accounts. The business actively manages these credit reviews as operational records with specific review dates, recommendations, approval authority levels, and outcomes.

attributes.name: credit_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this credit review record. Primary key for the credit review association.

attributes.name: customer_credit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customer credit account being reviewed

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the employee performing or approving the credit review

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: The approval authority level of the employee in this review. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data. Determines which credit limit thresholds this employee can approve. Values: analyst (up to $50K), manager (up to $500K), director (up to $2M), cfo (unlimited).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit review record was created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual who approved the current credit limit (e.g., Credit Manager, CFO, Credit Committee). Supports SOX segregation of duties requirements. [Moved from customer_credit: This captures the role/authority level of the approver, which varies by employee and by review. In the association, this becomes approval_authority_level linked to the specific employee performing that review step.]

attributes.name: credit_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credit limit was approved by the authorized credit manager. Part of SOX-compliant credit approval audit trail. [Moved from customer_credit: This date represents when a specific employee approved the credit limit. In a multi-level approval workflow, there may be multiple approval dates (analyst recommends on date 1, manager approves on date 2, CFO approves on date 3). These dates belong in the credit_review association linked to the specific approving employee.]

attributes.name: credit_rating_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credit rating (internal or external) was assigned or last updated. Used to track rating staleness and trigger periodic reviews. [Moved from customer_credit: This date represents when a credit rating was assigned, which is the outcome of a credit review performed by a specific employee. This date belongs in the credit_review association as review_date to link the rating assignment to the employee who performed the assessment.]

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic credit review is scheduled. Ensures timely reassessment of customer creditworthiness per SOX credit control policies. [Moved from customer_credit: This is the scheduled next review date, but the actual review history (when reviews were performed, by whom, with what outcome) belongs in the credit_review association. The customer_credit table can retain next_review_date for scheduling, but completed review dates belong in the association.]

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: Credit analyst or manager recommendation resulting from this review. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data. Values: approve, approve_with_conditions, reject, escalate (to higher authority), hold (pending additional information).

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when this credit review was performed by the employee. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and rationale documented by the employee during their credit review. Captures risk assessment findings, justification for recommendation, and conditions or concerns.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of this review step in the approval workflow. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data. Values: approved (employee approved at their level), rejected (employee rejected), pending (awaiting employee action), escalated (sent to higher authority).

attributes.name: review_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order of this review in the multi-level approval chain for this customer credit account. 1 = initial analyst review, 2 = manager approval, 3 = director/CFO approval.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this review record. Values: draft (in progress), submitted (awaiting approval), completed (finalized), superseded (replaced by newer review).

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Type of credit review being performed. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data. Values: initial_assessment (new customer), periodic_review (scheduled), limit_increase_request (customer requested increase), credit_hold_review (evaluating hold release), annual_reassessment (mandatory annual review).

attributes.name: reviewed_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit amount being reviewed or recommended by this employee. May differ from current limit if this is a limit increase request or reassessment.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_score
attributes.description: Quantitative risk score assigned by the employee during this review. Scale 1-100 where higher scores indicate higher credit risk. Used for SOX-compliant credit approval workflows.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit review record was last updated.

domains.name: land
domains.description: Manages mineral rights, surface rights, lease acquisitions, title opinions, and division order processing. Owns lease agreements, working interest (WI), net revenue interest (NRI), ORRI tracking, royalty owner data, acreage positions, lease expiry management, and surface use agreements. Supports regulatory compliance for lease reporting and revenue distribution. Integrates with Quorum Land System.

products.name: lease
products.description: Core master record for oil and gas mineral rights leases. Captures the authoritative lease agreement details including lessor/lessee identification, lease type (oil and gas, mineral, surface), effective date, primary term, bonus consideration, delay rental provisions, royalty rate, acreage, legal description (township/range/section), county, state, and lease status (active, expired, held by production, released). Integrates with Quorum Land System as the primary lease master. Serves as the SSOT for all lease-level data consumed by royalty, JIB, and production allocation processes.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the lessee acquired or executed the lease agreement. May differ from the effective date if the lease was backdated.

attributes.name: api_lease_number

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: county

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: delay_rental_amount
attributes.description: Annual payment made to the lessor to maintain the lease without drilling during the primary term. Typically expressed as dollars per acre per year.

attributes.name: depth_restriction_feet

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement becomes legally binding and effective. Marks the start of the lease term.

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: federal_lease_number

attributes.name: field_name

attributes.name: first_production_date
attributes.description: Date when commercial production first commenced on the lease. Triggers held-by-production status and extends the lease beyond the primary term.

attributes.name: formation_restriction
attributes.description: Specific geologic formation or stratigraphic interval covered by the lease. May limit production to certain zones.

attributes.name: gross_acres

attributes.name: last_production_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent production activity on the lease. Used to monitor continuous production requirements for held-by-production status.

attributes.name: lease_name
attributes.description: Common name or title of the lease, often derived from geographic location or lessor name.

attributes.name: lease_number

attributes.name: lease_status

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease agreement type. Distinguishes between oil and gas leases, mineral leases, surface leases, royalty interests, and overriding royalty interests.

attributes.name: legal_description

attributes.name: lessee_name
attributes.description: Name of the party acquiring the lease rights (operator or working interest owner). Typically the oil and gas company.

attributes.name: lessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the party granting the lease rights (mineral rights owner). May be an individual, corporation, or government entity.

attributes.name: net_acres

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent

attributes.name: range

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue or volume paid to the lessor as royalty. Typical values range from 12.5% to 25%.

attributes.name: section
attributes.description: Section number within the township and range. Sections are typically one square mile (640 acres) and numbered 1-36.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the leased property is located. Two-letter abbreviation (e.g., TX, OK, AB).

attributes.name: surface_use_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a separate surface use agreement exists for access and operations. True if surface rights are separately negotiated.

attributes.name: title_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent title opinion was issued by legal counsel. Confirms the lessors ownership and the validity of the lease.

attributes.name: title_opinion_status
attributes.description: Status of the title opinion review. Indicates whether the title is clear, has defects, is pending review, or not required.

attributes.name: township
attributes.description: Township designation in the Public Land Survey System (PLSS). Identifies the north-south position of the land parcel.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage ownership of the operating rights and obligations in the lease. Represents the lessees share of costs and revenues before royalty deductions.

products.name: mineral_right

Tracks mineral interest type (fee mineral, royalty interest, ORRI, non-participating royalty interest), ownership fraction, legal description, county, state, formation-specific rights, depth limitations, and severance history. Serves as the SSOT for mineral ownership data distinct from the lease instrument itself. Supports title chain analysis and acreage position reporting.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Mineral rights grant extraction rights for specific petroleum products. Critical for determining legal production authority by product type. Business process: pre-drill legal review verifies product-s

attributes.references: GAAP - Asset Capitalization Standards; SEC - Oil and Gas Reserves Disclosure; COPAS - Capital Cost Guidelines

attributes.name: acquisition_date

attributes.name: county

attributes.references: API - Well Logging Standards; State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations

attributes.name: encumbrance_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any liens, mortgages, judgments, or other encumbrances affecting the mineral right. Includes creditor name, amount, and recording information. Used for title curative and payment suspension decisions.
attributes.references: American Bar Association - Title Standards; State Recording Statutes

attributes.name: encumbrance_flag
