attributes.references: American Bar Association - Title Standards; Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) - Secured Transactions

attributes.name: estimated_ultimate_recovery_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Ultimate Recovery Barrels of Oil Equivalent (EUR BOE)
attributes.description: Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) for this mineral right in barrels of oil equivalent. Represents total expected production over the life of the property. Used for reserves booking, asset valuation, and economic analysis.
attributes.references: SPE - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); SEC - Oil and Gas Reserves Disclosure

attributes.name: first_production_date
attributes.description: Date of first commercial production from this mineral right. Used to determine lease holding requirements, primary term expiration, and reserves booking eligibility under SEC and PRMS guidelines.
attributes.references: SEC - Oil and Gas Reserves Disclosure; SPE - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS)

attributes.name: formation_name
attributes.description: Geological formation or reservoir to which the mineral right applies. Some mineral rights are severed by depth or formation, restricting ownership to specific stratigraphic intervals.
attributes.references: American Association of Petroleum Geologists (AAPG) - Stratigraphic Nomenclature; State Geological Surveys

attributes.name: last_production_date
attributes.description: Date of most recent production from this mineral right. Used to monitor continuous production requirements for lease maintenance and identify shut-in or abandoned properties.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations; COPAS - Production Reporting Standards

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the land parcel to which the mineral right applies. Typically includes section, township, range, county, and state information following Public Land Survey System (PLSS) or metes and bounds format.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Public Land Survey System; State Land Office Standards

attributes.name: mineral_interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of mineral interest held. Fee mineral represents full ownership of subsurface rights. Royalty interest (RI) is a share of production free of costs. Overriding Royalty Interest (ORRI) is carved from working interest. Non-Participating Royalty Interest (NPRI) receives royalty but has no lease execution rights. Working Interest (WI) bears costs and receives revenue. Net Profits Interest receives share after costs.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) - Land and Lease Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: mineral_right_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or reference number assigned to the mineral right for external communication and tracking. May be assigned by land department or derived from legal description.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Mineral Right Object

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this mineral right record. Used for accountability, audit trail, and change management.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) - Internal Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework - Access Control

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this mineral right record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) - Internal Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework - Audit Logging

attributes.name: net_mineral_acres
attributes.description: Net mineral acres calculated as gross acres multiplied by ownership fraction. Represents the effective acreage owned for reserves and production allocation purposes.
attributes.references: SPE - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); SEC - Reserves Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest
attributes.description: Net Revenue Interest (NRI) is the decimal interest in production revenue after deducting royalty, overriding royalty interest (ORRI), and other burdens from Working Interest (WI). Used for revenue distribution and economic analysis. NRI = WI × (1 - Royalty - ORRI).
attributes.references: COPAS - Joint Interest Billing Standards; SPE - Economic Evaluation Guidelines

attributes.name: overriding_royalty_interest
attributes.description: Overriding Royalty Interest (ORRI) is a share of production revenue carved from Working Interest, free of operating costs but burdened by production costs. Expressed as a decimal fraction. Used for revenue distribution calculations.
attributes.references: COPAS - Revenue Distribution Standards; American Association of Professional Landmen (AAPL) - Lease Standards

attributes.name: owner_address
attributes.description: Mailing address for the mineral right owner. Used for royalty payment distribution, tax reporting, and legal correspondence. Must be kept current for unclaimed property compliance.
attributes.references: COPAS - Division Order Standards; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the mineral right owner. May be an individual, trust, estate, corporation, or partnership. Used for division order processing and revenue distribution.
attributes.references: COPAS - Division Order Standards; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: owner_tax_code
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the mineral right owner. Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals or Employer Identification Number (EIN) for entities. Required for IRS Form 1099 reporting of royalty payments.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Publication 515; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) - Data Protection Requirements

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity type of the mineral right owner. Determines tax reporting requirements, payment processing rules, and documentation standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|trust|estate|corporation|partnership|limited_liability_company|joint_venture|government_entity — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Form 1099 Requirements; COPAS - Owner Classification Standards

attributes.name: ownership_fraction
attributes.description: Decimal representation of the ownership percentage or fraction of the mineral right. For example, 0.125 represents 1/8th mineral interest. Used to calculate revenue distribution and acreage positions.
attributes.references: COPAS - Joint Interest Billing Standards; SPE - Reserves Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the well or property has reached payout (recovered drilling and completion costs). Some ORRI or back-in interests change after payout. Used for revenue distribution and interest reversion tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS - Payout Accounting Standards; Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Payout Provisions

attributes.name: producing_status
attributes.description: Current production status of the mineral right. Producing indicates active production. Held by production means lease is maintained by production from other tracts. Non-producing indicates no current production but lease is active. Shut-in indicates temporary cessation. Expired or released indicates lease has terminated.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations; COPAS - Production Reporting Standards

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mineral right record. Active indicates current ownership and operational relevance. Inactive indicates ownership has been transferred or lease has expired. Pending verification indicates title examination in progress. Archived indicates historical record retained for audit purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX - Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: reserves_category
attributes.description: Classification of reserves associated with this mineral right per SPE PRMS and SEC guidelines. Proved Developed Producing (PDP) are currently producing. Proved Developed Non-Producing (PDNP) are drilled but not producing. Proved Undeveloped (PUD) require additional capital. Probable (2P) and Possible (3P) have lower certainty.
attributes.references: SPE - Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS); SEC - Regulation S-X Rule 4-10; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Reserves Definitions

attributes.name: royalty_rate
attributes.description: Decimal representation of the royalty rate applicable to production from this mineral right. Typically ranges from 0.125 (1/8) to 0.25 (1/4). Used for revenue distribution and Net Revenue Interest (NRI) calculations.
attributes.references: COPAS - Revenue Distribution Standards; State Oil and Gas Lease Regulations

attributes.name: severance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mineral estate was severed from the surface estate. Null if mineral and surface rights were never unified. Critical for title chain analysis and determining priority of interests.
attributes.references: State Property Law; American Bar Association - Mineral Title Standards

attributes.name: severance_instrument_type
attributes.description: Type of legal instrument that created the severance of mineral rights from surface rights. Used for title opinion preparation and chain of title verification.
attributes.references: American Bar Association - Mineral Title Standards; State Recording Statutes

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province in which the mineral right is located. Determines applicable regulatory framework, severance tax rates, and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau - Geographic Standards; State Oil and Gas Regulatory Agencies

attributes.name: suspended_payment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether royalty or revenue payments to this mineral right owner are currently suspended. True indicates payments are being held in suspense due to title defects, missing documentation, or legal disputes.
attributes.references: COPAS - Suspense Accounting Standards; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for suspended payments. Title defect indicates unmarketable title. Missing W-9 indicates tax documentation not received. Deceased owner indicates estate not probated. Address unknown triggers unclaimed property reporting. Legal dispute indicates litigation. Bankruptcy indicates automatic stay. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: title_defect|missing_w9|deceased_owner|address_unknown|legal_dispute|bankruptcy|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COPAS - Suspense Accounting Standards; Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Backup Withholding Rules; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: working_interest
attributes.description: Working Interest (WI) is the operating interest that bears the cost of exploration, development, and production. Expressed as a decimal fraction. Used for Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) allocation and Joint Interest Billing (JIB).
attributes.references: COPAS - Joint Interest Billing Standards; Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards

products.name: tract
products.description: Master record for a defined land parcel or tract used as the fundamental geographic unit for land administration. Captures legal description (metes and bounds, township/range/section/quarter), gross acres, net acres, county, state, basin, play, GIS polygon reference, surface ownership, and mineral ownership status. Tracts are the foundational spatial unit to which leases, wells, and acreage positions are tied. Integrates with GIS systems for spatial analysis.

attributes.name: tract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tract record. Primary key for the tract entity.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Tracts are developed via AFE-funded drilling/facility projects. Critical for acreage-level cost tracking and land department reporting on capital deployed per tract. Standard upstream land-to-capital

attributes.name: basin_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to exploration.basin. Business justification: Tracts are located within geological basins. Basin context is essential for land valuation, leasing strategy, play-based acreage aggregation, and resource potential assessment. Removes denormalized ba

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Tracts require permits for surface disturbance, drilling, environmental activities, and land use. Essential for tracking permit coverage across land holdings and ensuring compliance before operations

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company acquired rights to the tract, either through lease, purchase, or other conveyance.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; Quorum Land System

attributes.name: api_county_code
attributes.description: Three-digit API county code assigned by the American Petroleum Institute for standardized geographic identification in oil and gas reporting.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Bulletin D12A - API Well Number Standard

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the tract centroid in decimal degrees. Used for spatial indexing and proximity analysis.
attributes.references: World Geodetic System 1984 (WGS84); ISO 6709 Geographic Coordinates

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the tract centroid in decimal degrees. Used for spatial indexing and proximity analysis.
attributes.references: World Geodetic System 1984 (WGS84); ISO 6709 Geographic Coordinates

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special conditions, or operational remarks related to the tract.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Tract Management Module

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country in which the tract is located.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish in which the tract is located. Critical for regulatory reporting and tax jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau Geographic Standards; State Regulatory Agencies

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the tract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the tract record originated, typically Quorum Land System or legacy land management system.

attributes.name: environmental_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tract is subject to environmental restrictions or protected area designations that limit operations.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Regulations; Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Environmental Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company's rights to the tract expire, if applicable. Used for lease expiry management and renewal tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; Quorum Land System

attributes.name: gis_polygon_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or coordinate set linking the tract to its spatial polygon representation in the GIS system. Enables spatial analysis and mapping.
attributes.references: ESRI ArcGIS Standards; Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) Standards

attributes.name: gross_acres
attributes.description: Total surface area of the tract in acres, representing the full geographic extent without adjustment for ownership interest.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Land and Lease Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: land_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the tract based on its current development and production status. Used for reserves booking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Reserves Disclosure Rules; Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) PRMS

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the tract record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; SOX Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the tract using metes and bounds, township/range/section/quarter notation, or other legally recognized land description methods. Critical for title and ownership verification.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Public Land Survey System (PLSS); State Land Office Standards

attributes.name: mineral_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity or individual holding mineral rights to the tract. Critical for lease acquisition and royalty payment.

attributes.name: mineral_ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of mineral rights ownership for the tract. Indicates whether mineral rights are owned in fee, leased, or severed from surface rights. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee|leased|federal|state|private|tribal|severed|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Mineral Estate Records; State Land Office Standards

attributes.name: net_acres
attributes.description: Net acreage representing the company's proportional ownership or leasehold interest in the tract, calculated as gross acres multiplied by working interest or net revenue interest.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Land and Lease Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest held by the company in the tract. Represents the company's share of production revenue after royalty and overriding royalty deductions.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Joint Operations Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: overriding_royalty_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue payable as overriding royalty interest, carved out of the working interest. Does not bear operating costs.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Joint Operations Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: play
attributes.description: Name of the geologic play or prospective formation associated with the tract. Identifies the target hydrocarbon-bearing zone.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) Nomenclature; USGS Play Assessment Standards

attributes.name: quarter_section
attributes.description: Quarter section designation (e.g., NE, SW, NW, SE) or further subdivision (e.g., NE/NW) within the section.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Public Land Survey System (PLSS)

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Range designation in the Public Land Survey System (PLSS), typically expressed as a number followed by direction (e.g., 3E, 8W).
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Public Land Survey System (PLSS)

attributes.name: regulatory_district
attributes.description: Regulatory district or field office jurisdiction under which the tract falls. Used for permit applications and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State Oil and Gas Commission Districts; Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Regions

attributes.name: royalty_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue payable to mineral rights owners as royalty. Typically ranges from 12.5% to 25% depending on lease terms.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Land and Lease Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: section
attributes.description: Section number within the township and range, typically 1-36 in the PLSS grid system.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Public Land Survey System (PLSS)

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province in which the tract is located. Used for regulatory compliance and jurisdictional reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Subdivision Codes; U.S. Postal Service State Abbreviations

attributes.name: surface_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity or individual holding surface ownership rights to the tract. Used for surface use agreement negotiations.

attributes.name: surface_ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of surface ownership rights for the tract. Determines surface use rights and access requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee|leased|federal|state|private|tribal|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Land Status Records; State Land Office Standards

attributes.name: surface_use_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a surface use agreement is in place for the tract. True if agreement exists, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Surface Use Module

attributes.name: title_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent title opinion was issued for the tract. Used to track currency of title examination.

attributes.name: title_opinion_status
attributes.description: Status of the legal title opinion for the tract. Indicates whether title has been examined and cleared for operations.
attributes.references: American Bar Association (ABA) Title Standards; State Bar Association Title Opinion Standards

attributes.name: township
attributes.description: Township designation in the Public Land Survey System (PLSS), typically expressed as a number followed by direction (e.g., 5N, 12S).
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Public Land Survey System (PLSS)

attributes.name: tract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title assigned to the tract for identification purposes.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Tract Management Module

attributes.name: tract_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the tract, typically assigned by the land department or external authority. Used for external reference and reporting.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Tract Management Module

attributes.name: tract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tract record. Indicates whether the tract is actively managed, pending acquisition, or has been released.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Tract Management Module

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest held by the company in the tract. Represents the company's share of costs and operations before royalty deductions.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Joint Operations Standards; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

products.name: royalty_owner
products.description: Master record for individuals or entities entitled to receive royalty payments from oil and gas production. Captures owner name, owner type (individual, trust, corporation, government), tax identification number (TIN/EIN/SSN), mailing address, payment preferences, 1099 reporting status, backup withholding flag, deceased/estate status, and contact information. Serves as the SSOT for royalty owner identity data used in division order processing and revenue distribution. Integrates with Quorum Land System owner master.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the royalty owner record. Primary key for the royalty owner entity.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account for electronic payment disbursement. Required for ACH payment processing.

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backup withholding is required on royalty payments. True when owner fails to provide valid TIN or IRS notifies of underreporting. Requires 24% federal withholding on payments.

attributes.name: backup_withholding_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate for backup withholding on royalty payments when backup withholding flag is true. Typically 0.2400 (24%) per IRS regulations.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for electronic payment disbursement via ACH or wire transfer. Required when payment method is electronic.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the royalty owner payment account.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the financial institution for electronic payment processing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the royalty owner record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cumulative_payments_to_date
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of all royalty payments disbursed to the owner since inception. Used for lifetime value analysis and 1099 reporting threshold determination.

attributes.name: date_of_death
attributes.description: Date the royalty owner was declared deceased. Used for estate processing, final payment calculation, and transfer of ownership to estate or heirs.

attributes.name: deceased_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the royalty owner is deceased. True triggers estate processing workflow and payment suspension pending estate documentation.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic correspondence, payment notifications, and division order delivery.

attributes.name: estate_representative_name
attributes.description: Full name of the executor, administrator, or personal representative managing the deceased owner estate. Used for estate payment processing and correspondence.

attributes.name: estate_tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN) assigned to the estate for tax reporting purposes. Required for payments to estates exceeding IRS thresholds.

attributes.name: foreign_person_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the royalty owner is a foreign person or entity for US tax purposes. True for non-US persons, triggering Form W-8BEN requirements and potential withholding under IRC Chapter 3.

attributes.name: foreign_withholding_rate
attributes.description: Percentage rate for foreign tax withholding on royalty payments to non-US persons. Default is 0.3000 (30%) unless reduced by tax treaty.

attributes.name: form_1099_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the royalty owner requires IRS Form 1099-MISC reporting for annual royalty income. True for US persons receiving $600 or more in annual royalty payments.

attributes.name: interest_owner_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier assigned to the royalty owner in the land and lease management system. Used for cross-system integration and division order processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the royalty owner record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the most recent royalty payment disbursed to the owner. Used for payment history and trend analysis.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent royalty payment disbursed to the owner. Used for payment history tracking and dormancy analysis.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for royalty payment remittance and correspondence. Includes street number, street name, and unit/suite number if applicable.

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional address details such as apartment number, building name, or care-of information.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City name for the royalty owner mailing address.

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the royalty owner mailing address. Determines international payment processing and tax withholding requirements.

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the royalty owner mailing address. Used for payment delivery and tax jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code for the royalty owner mailing address. Uses two-letter state abbreviations for US addresses or province codes for international addresses.

attributes.name: minimum_payment_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount required before issuing a royalty payment to the owner. Payments below this threshold are held and accumulated until the threshold is met. Reduces administrative costs for small payments.

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or entity entitled to receive royalty payments. For individuals, includes first, middle, and last name. For entities, includes full legal business name.

attributes.name: owner_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty owner record. Active owners receive payments; deceased owners trigger estate processing; suspended owners require resolution before payment.

attributes.name: owner_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty owner entity type. Determines tax treatment, reporting requirements, and payment processing rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|trust|estate|corporation|partnership|limited_liability_company|government — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which royalty payments are disbursed to the owner. Determines payment cycle and accumulation period.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for royalty payment disbursement. Determines payment processing workflow and banking information requirements.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: primary_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the royalty owner. Used for payment inquiries, division order questions, and ownership verification.

attributes.name: suspended_payment_balance
attributes.description: Dollar amount of royalty payments currently held in suspense due to missing documentation, address issues, or ownership disputes. Released when issues are resolved.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for suspending royalty payments to the owner. Examples include missing tax forms, invalid address, ownership dispute, deceased without estate documentation, or regulatory hold.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the royalty owner. May be Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals, Employer Identification Number (EIN) for entities, or Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for foreign entities. Used for IRS 1099 reporting and tax withholding compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515, IRS Form W-9, IRS Form W-8BEN

attributes.name: tax_treaty_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for tax treaty application. Used to determine reduced withholding rates for foreign royalty owners under bilateral tax treaties.

attributes.name: w8_form_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the IRS Form W-8. W-8 forms are generally valid for three years from signing. After expiration, default 30% withholding applies until new form is received.

attributes.name: w8_form_received_date
attributes.description: Date the IRS Form W-8BEN or W-8BEN-E (Certificate of Foreign Status) was received from the foreign royalty owner. Required for non-US persons to claim tax treaty benefits and reduced withholding rates.

attributes.name: w9_form_received_date
attributes.description: Date the IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) was received from the royalty owner. Required for US persons to certify TIN and avoid backup withholding.

products.name: division_order
products.description: Authoritative document establishing the decimal interest each owner holds in production from a specific well or lease for revenue distribution purposes. Captures well/lease reference, owner reference, interest type (WI, NRI, ORRI, royalty), decimal interest fraction, effective date, termination date, division order status (active, suspended, pending title), and title opinion reference. Division orders are the legal basis for all royalty and working interest payments. Integrates with Quorum Land System division order module.

attributes.name: division_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the division order record. Primary key for the division order entity.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Standards

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Division orders allocate revenue by specific product type (oil vs gas vs NGL) with different pricing and tax treatment. Required for accurate royalty payment calculations. Business process: monthly re

attributes.description: Reference to the pooled unit or communitization agreement under which production is allocated across multiple leases. Applicable for unitized operations where production is shared across participating leases.

attributes.name: previous_division_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior division order record that this division order supersedes. Used to maintain historical chain of ownership and interest changes. Nullable for initial division orders.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the royalty owner, working interest partner, or overriding royalty interest holder who receives revenue distribution. Links to the owner master data containing contact and payment information.

attributes.name: title_opinion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal title opinion document that validates the owner's interest and supports the division order. Links to the title opinion master data containing attorney certification and legal review details.
attributes.references: American Association of Professional Landmen (AAPL) - Title Opinion Standards

attributes.name: tract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific tract or land parcel within the lease from which production is allocated. Used for multi-tract leases where different owners may have interests in different tracts.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Land Tract Identification Standards

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: Division orders are issued to venture partners for their share of production revenue. Venture_partner_id enables partner-level revenue allocation, payment processing, and 1099 reporting for joint vent

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which production and revenue are allocated to this division order. Well indicates allocation based on individual well production. Lease indicates allocation across all wells on the lease. Unit indicates allocation based on unit participation. Tract indicates allocation to specific land tract. Proportionate indicates allocation based on decimal interest across multiple sources.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Allocation Method Standards

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Financial Controls and Approval Authority

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether backup withholding is required for this owner due to missing or incorrect Tax Identification Number (TIN). True when backup withholding applies, false otherwise. Backup withholding rate is typically 24% per IRS regulations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Backup Withholding Requirements

attributes.name: cost_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interest holder is responsible for bearing their proportionate share of operating costs and capital expenditures. True for working interest owners, false for royalty and overriding royalty interest holders who receive revenue net of costs.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Cost Allocation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this division order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: decimal_interest
attributes.description: The precise decimal fraction representing the owner's proportionate share of production revenue or costs. Expressed as a decimal value (e.g., 0.125 for 12.5% interest). This is the authoritative value used for all revenue distribution calculations and royalty payments.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Decimal Interest Calculation Standards

attributes.name: division_order_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the division order, typically formatted as DO- prefix followed by alphanumeric code. Used for external reference and communication with royalty owners and working interest partners.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Standards

attributes.name: division_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the division order. Active indicates revenue distribution is occurring. Suspended indicates temporary hold on payments due to title issues or disputes. Pending Title indicates awaiting title opinion clearance. Terminated indicates division order is no longer in effect. Draft indicates division order is being prepared. Under Review indicates legal or accounting review in progress.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Status Classification

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this division order becomes legally binding and revenue distribution begins. Typically aligned with first production date, title opinion date, or ownership transfer date.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Effective Date Standards

attributes.name: gross_acres
attributes.description: The total acreage of the lease or tract from which the owner's interest is derived. Used in net acres calculation and reserve allocation.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Reserves Allocation Standards

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the decimal interest for this division order. Net Acres indicates calculation based on net acreage ownership. Proportionate Share indicates calculation based on lease or unit participation. Unit Formula indicates calculation per unit operating agreement. Custom indicates special calculation per lease terms or legal requirements.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Interest Calculation Standards

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership interest type. WI (Working Interest) represents operational ownership and cost-bearing interest. NRI (Net Revenue Interest) represents the net share of production revenue after royalties. ORRI (Overriding Royalty Interest) represents a carved-out interest from working interest. Royalty represents landowner mineral rights interest. Mineral Interest represents subsurface mineral ownership. Leasehold Interest represents the lessee's interest in the lease.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Interest Type Classification

attributes.name: minimum_payment_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum dollar amount that must accumulate before a revenue payment is issued to the owner. Amounts below this threshold are carried forward to the next payment period. Typically set to reduce administrative costs for small interest holders.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Payment Threshold Standards

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this division order record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this division order record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record is changed. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: net_acres
attributes.description: The owner's net acreage interest calculated as gross acres multiplied by decimal interest. Represents the effective acreage ownership for revenue and reserve allocation purposes.
attributes.references: Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Reserves Allocation Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the division order. May include details about title issues, ownership complexities, payment instructions, or historical context.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Documentation Standards

attributes.name: owner_signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the owner signed and returned the division order document. Used to track owner acknowledgment and agreement to the stated interest and terms. Nullable if owner signature is not required or not yet received.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Execution Standards

attributes.name: owner_signature_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed division order has been received from the owner. True when signed document is on file, false when signature is pending or not required. Some jurisdictions allow payment without signature after a statutory waiting period.
attributes.references: State Division Order Statutes - Signature Requirements

attributes.name: participating_area_acres
attributes.description: The acreage within the unit or lease that is allocated to this division order for production sharing purposes. Used in unit allocation calculations to determine proportionate share of unit production.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Unit Allocation Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which revenue payments are distributed to the owner. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for electronic bank transfers, Wire Transfer for same-day electronic payments, Check for paper check mailing, Direct Deposit for recurring electronic deposits.
attributes.references: NACHA (National Automated Clearing House Association) - Payment Standards

attributes.name: percentage_interest
attributes.description: The owner's interest expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.5000 for 12.5%). Derived from decimal_interest for reporting and display purposes. Stored separately for business user convenience.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Interest Reporting Standards

attributes.name: revenue_deck
attributes.description: The revenue distribution deck or payment group to which this division order is assigned. Used to batch and process revenue payments for owners with similar payment timing and processing requirements.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Revenue Distribution Standards

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking changes to the division order. Incremented each time the division order is amended due to ownership changes, interest corrections, or title updates. Used for audit trail and historical tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Amendment Standards

attributes.name: statutory_payment_date
attributes.description: The date after which payment may legally commence without owner signature, as defined by state division order statutes. Typically 120-180 days after division order is mailed to owner. Used to ensure compliance with state payment timing requirements.
attributes.references: State Division Order Statutes - Payment Timing Requirements

attributes.name: suspense_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue payments were first placed in suspense. Used for aging analysis and regulatory compliance reporting of suspended funds.
attributes.references: State Unclaimed Property Laws - Suspense Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: suspense_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue payments for this division order are currently held in suspense due to title defects, missing owner information, or legal disputes. True when payments are suspended, false when payments are being distributed normally.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Suspense Accounting Standards

attributes.name: suspense_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why revenue payments are held in suspense. Title Defect indicates unresolved ownership issues. Missing Tax ID indicates required tax documentation not provided. Address Unknown indicates inability to locate owner. Legal Dispute indicates litigation affecting ownership. Probate Pending indicates estate settlement in progress. Bankruptcy indicates owner in bankruptcy proceedings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Title Defect|Missing Tax ID|Address Unknown|Legal Dispute|Probate Pending|Bankruptcy|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Suspense Reason Classification

attributes.name: tax_withholding_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate at which federal or state income tax is withheld from revenue payments. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.24 for 24% withholding). Applied for non-resident owners or when required by tax regulations.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Withholding Tax Requirements

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this division order ceases to be effective. Nullable for active, ongoing division orders. Populated when ownership changes, lease expires, or well is plugged and abandoned.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Division Order Termination Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this division order record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Record Retention and Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: land_working_interest
products.description: Master record tracking ownership interests in a lease or well, including working interest (WI), overriding royalty interest (ORRI), and other non-royalty interests. For WI: captures the obligation to bear a proportionate share of exploration, development, and operating costs, WI owner (operator or non-operator), WI decimal fraction, NRI decimal fraction. For ORRI: captures non-cost-bearing interests carved from the working interest entitling the holder to a fraction of gross production revenue, ORRI holder, creation instrument, termination conditions (convertible, payout-based). Common attributes: interest type, decimal fraction, lease reference, well reference, effective date, assignment history reference, participation status, and current status. Supports JIB billing, AFE cost allocation, and interest chain-of-title tracking. Integrates with Quorum Land System.

attributes.name: land_working_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the working interest record. Primary key for the working interest master data.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.joa. Business justification: Working interest records reference the governing JOA for cost allocation, voting rights, and non-consent provisions. Joa_id links interest ownership to the operating agreement framework.

attributes.name: pooling_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.pooling_unit. Business justification: Working interests can be defined at the pooling unit level (unitized interests) in addition to lease-level or well-level WI. When a lease is pooled into a unit, the WI is often redefined at the unit l

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (operator or non-operator partner) who holds this working interest. Links to the joint venture partner or operator master record.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest was assigned or transferred to the current owner. Used for chain-of-title tracking.

attributes.name: assignment_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the legal document that created or transferred this working interest. Used for title opinion and chain-of-title verification.

attributes.name: assignment_instrument_type
attributes.description: The type of legal instrument by which this working interest was created or transferred. Deed = mineral deed, Assignment = assignment of interest, Farmout = farmout agreement, Lease = oil and gas lease, PSA = Production Sharing Agreement, JOA = Joint Operating Agreement.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this working interest. Used for operational context and exception handling.

attributes.name: conversion_trigger
attributes.description: The condition that triggers conversion of this interest to another type, if applicable. Payout = converts after payout, Time-Based = converts after a specified date, Production-Based = converts after cumulative production threshold, Event-Based = converts upon a specific event.

attributes.name: convertible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interest is convertible to another interest type (e.g., ORRI converts to WI after payout). True = convertible, False = not convertible.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which costs are allocated to this working interest. Proportionate = costs allocated by WI decimal, Non-Consent = non-consenting party penalty provisions apply, Penalty = penalty interest rate applies, Carried = costs borne by another party.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: division_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this working interest is subject to division order processing for revenue distribution. True = division order applies, False = not subject to division order.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest ownership becomes effective. Used for revenue and cost allocation calculations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest ownership expires or terminates, if applicable. Null for indefinite interests.

attributes.name: interest_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or reference number assigned to this working interest for tracking and reporting purposes. May be system-generated or externally assigned.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ownership interest type. WI = Working Interest (cost-bearing), ORRI = Overriding Royalty Interest (non-cost-bearing), NRI = Net Revenue Interest, RI = Royalty Interest, COPAS = COPAS-defined interest category.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS)

attributes.name: jib_billing_code
attributes.description: The billing code used for Joint Interest Billing (JIB) cost allocation and invoicing for this working interest. Aligns with COPAS JIB standards.

attributes.name: land_working_interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the working interest record. Active = currently in effect, Inactive = not currently in effect, Suspended = temporarily suspended, Terminated = permanently ended, Pending = awaiting activation.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest record was last modified in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: nri_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the net revenue interest after deducting royalties, overriding royalties, and other burdens from the working interest. Represents the owner's share of revenue. Example: 0.1875 = 18.75% NRI.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest owner is the designated operator of the lease or well. True = operator, False = non-operator partner.

attributes.name: orri_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the overriding royalty interest, if applicable. ORRI is a non-cost-bearing interest carved from the working interest. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the owner's participation status in operations and cost-bearing. Participating = actively bearing costs, Non-Participating = not bearing costs but retaining interest, Carried = costs borne by another party, Back-In = right to re-enter after payout, Farmed-Out = interest assigned to another party.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) Standards, COPAS Guidelines

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: The date on which payout was achieved for this working interest, if applicable. Null if payout has not been reached or does not apply.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the working interest has reached payout (recovery of capital costs). Pre-Payout = costs not yet recovered, Post-Payout = costs recovered and interest may revert or change, Not-Applicable = payout provisions do not apply.

attributes.name: revenue_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method by which revenue is allocated to this working interest. Proportionate = revenue allocated by NRI decimal, Net = net of royalties and burdens, Gross = gross production share, Payout-Based = allocation changes after payout.

attributes.name: reversion_date
attributes.description: The date on which this working interest reverted or is scheduled to revert to another party, if applicable. Null if reversion has not occurred or does not apply.

attributes.name: reversion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this working interest is subject to reversion provisions (e.g., interest reverts to another party after payout or upon certain conditions). True = reversion applies, False = no reversion.

attributes.name: reversion_trigger
attributes.description: The condition that triggers reversion of this working interest, if applicable. Payout = reverts after payout, Time-Based = reverts after a specified date, Production-Based = reverts after cumulative production threshold, Event-Based = reverts upon a specific event.

attributes.name: royalty_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the landowner or mineral rights holder royalty interest burden on this working interest. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this working interest record originated (e.g., Quorum Land System, SAP JV Accounting). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: suspense_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether revenue payments for this working interest are currently held in suspense due to title issues, missing documentation, or other administrative holds. True = in suspense, False = not in suspense.

attributes.name: suspense_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason revenue payments are held in suspense for this working interest, if applicable. Null if not in suspense.

attributes.name: termination_condition
attributes.description: Free-text description of the conditions under which this working interest terminates, if applicable. May reference payout, production thresholds, time limits, or other contractual provisions.

attributes.name: title_opinion_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the title opinion document that validates the chain-of-title for this working interest. Used for legal and compliance verification.

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: The current status of the title for this working interest. Clear = title is clear and marketable, Defective = title defects identified, Curative-Pending = curative work in progress, Disputed = title is under dispute.

attributes.name: wi_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the working interest ownership percentage. Represents the proportionate share of costs and gross production the owner is obligated to bear. Example: 0.25 = 25% WI.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

products.name: title_opinion
products.description: Legal document prepared by an attorney or landman providing an opinion on the validity of title to mineral rights for a specific tract or lease. Captures opinion date, attorney/firm, title status (marketable, defective, curative required), depth limitations, exceptions and reservations, prior conveyances reviewed, and associated lease or tract. Includes curative action tracking as detail records: curative type (missing heir affidavit, probate, correction deed, ratification, release of lien), assigned landman, due date, completion date, curative status, and resolution notes. Title opinions are required before drilling and for division order preparation. The integrated curative workflow ensures marketable title before significant capital is committed.

attributes.name: title_opinion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the title opinion record. Primary key.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Title opinions are AFE-funded curative/due diligence expenses. Standard land department cost allocation for pre-drill title work. Links legal review costs to capital project budgets.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Title opinions support regulatory filings for lease acquisitions, assignments, and pooling units. Required documentation for regulatory approval processes and compliance with state title requirements.

attributes.name: tertiary_title_approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: attorney_name
