attributes.description: Commission paid to external broker for facilitating the lease acquisition. Null for direct acquisitions without broker involvement.

attributes.name: competitive_bid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease was acquired through a competitive bidding process (true) or through direct negotiation (false). Relevant for federal and state lease sales.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease acquisition record was first created in the land system. Audit trail for data lineage and record creation tracking.

attributes.name: delay_rental_amount
attributes.description: Annual delay rental payment amount required to maintain the lease during the primary term without drilling. May be per-acre or total amount.

attributes.name: depth_rights_from_ft
attributes.description: Minimum depth in feet below surface for which mineral rights were acquired. Defines the top of the depth interval covered by the lease.

attributes.name: depth_rights_to_ft
attributes.description: Maximum depth in feet below surface for which mineral rights were acquired. Defines the bottom of the depth interval covered by the lease. Null indicates rights to all depths.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement was signed by all parties. Distinct from acquisition date, which may be the effective date specified in the lease.

attributes.name: formation_target
attributes.description: Primary geologic formation or reservoir target for the lease acquisition. Identifies the stratigraphic interval of interest for exploration and development.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease primary term expires if production has not commenced. Critical date for lease expiry management and drilling obligation tracking.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Lease Expiry Tracking

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when lease acquisition negotiations commenced with the lessor. Tracks the duration of the acquisition workflow from initial contact to execution.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest acquired in the lease. Represents the company's share of production revenue after royalty and overriding royalty deductions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional details about the lease acquisition, including special terms, negotiation history, or unique conditions.

attributes.name: primary_term_years
attributes.description: Duration of the lease primary term in years. Period during which the lease remains valid without production, typically 3-5 years for oil and gas leases.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a Pugh clause that releases unproductive acreage at the end of the primary term. Important for lease retention and acreage management.

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease was officially recorded in the county or parish land records. Establishes legal priority and public notice.

attributes.name: recording_reference
attributes.description: Official recording reference number or book and page citation from the county land records. Enables retrieval of the recorded lease document.

attributes.name: royalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue reserved for the lessor as royalty. Standard royalty burden negotiated in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: surface_use_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a separate surface use agreement was negotiated with the surface owner. Relevant when mineral and surface rights are severed.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Surface Rights Management

attributes.name: title_opinion_date
attributes.description: Date when the title opinion was issued certifying the lessor's ownership of mineral rights. Critical for validating lease enforceability.

attributes.name: total_acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the lease acquisition including bonus payment, broker fees, legal fees, title work, and other acquisition-related expenses. Full CAPEX amount for financial reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease acquisition record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: working_interest_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest acquired in the lease. Represents the company's share of costs and production before royalty deductions.

products.name: lease_expiry
products.description: Tracks lease expiration events, extension actions, and held-by-production (HBP) status for all active leases. Captures primary term expiration date, extension option terms, delay rental due dates, rental amounts, HBP well references, continuous drilling clause requirements, Pugh clause applicability, and expiry action taken (renewed, released, extended, HBP confirmed). Critical for acreage management and avoiding inadvertent lease expirations. Supports automated expiry alert workflows.
products.reference: Quorum Land System — Lease Expiry Management

attributes.name: lease_expiry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lease expiry event record.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lease agreement that is subject to expiry tracking.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the well that is holding the lease by production. Null if lease is not HBP or if multiple wells hold the lease.

attributes.name: acreage_at_risk
attributes.description: The total acreage (gross or net) that is at risk of being lost if the lease expires without renewal, extension, or HBP confirmation.

attributes.name: alert_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which an automated alert notification was sent to stakeholders regarding the upcoming lease expiry.

attributes.name: alert_notification_recipient
attributes.description: The email address or user identifier of the recipient(s) who received the expiry alert notification.

attributes.name: continuous_drilling_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a continuous drilling clause requiring ongoing drilling activity to maintain the lease.

attributes.name: continuous_drilling_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the next well must be spudded to satisfy the continuous drilling clause requirements. Null if no continuous drilling clause applies.

attributes.name: delay_rental_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of delay rental payment required per acre or per lease to extend the primary term.

attributes.name: delay_rental_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the delay rental amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: delay_rental_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which delay rental payment must be made to extend the lease for another year during the primary term.

attributes.name: estimated_reserves_at_risk_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Reserves At Risk Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The estimated proved or probable reserves (in barrels of oil equivalent) that could be lost if the lease expires without being held by production or extended.

attributes.name: expiry_action_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiry action was taken or is scheduled to be taken.

attributes.name: expiry_action_responsible_party
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the land professional or team responsible for managing the expiry action.

attributes.name: expiry_action_taken
attributes.description: The action taken or planned in response to the lease expiry event: renewed (new lease executed), released (lease terminated), extended (option exercised), HBP confirmed (held by production), under review, or pending decision.

attributes.name: expiry_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of expiry event being tracked: primary term expiration, extension period expiration, option deadline, continuous drilling clause deadline, or Pugh clause partial release.

attributes.name: expiry_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, decisions, or special circumstances related to the lease expiry event.

attributes.name: extension_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which an extension period expires if an extension option has been exercised. Null if no extension is in effect.

attributes.name: extension_option_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee has an option to extend the lease term beyond the primary term expiry.

attributes.name: extension_option_exercise_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the lessee must exercise the extension option to extend the lease term. Null if no extension option exists.

attributes.name: extension_option_payment_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount required to exercise the extension option, typically expressed per acre or as a lump sum.

attributes.name: extension_option_term_years
attributes.description: The number of years by which the lease can be extended if the extension option is exercised. Null if no extension option exists.

attributes.name: hbp_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease is currently held by production, meaning it has producing wells that keep the lease valid beyond the primary term.
attributes.references: Oil and Gas Lease Law - HBP Doctrine

attributes.name: hbp_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which HBP status was last verified through production records or well test data.

attributes.name: hbp_well_api_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Held-By-Production (HBP) Well American Petroleum Institute (API) Number
attributes.description: The API well number of the well holding the lease by production, providing a standardized well identifier.

attributes.name: lease_bonus_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the lease bonus amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: lease_bonus_paid
attributes.description: The total lease bonus amount paid at lease acquisition, representing the sunk cost at risk if the lease is allowed to expire.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_at_risk
attributes.description: The net revenue interest percentage that is at risk of being lost if the lease expires, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.75 for 75%).

attributes.name: primary_term_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the primary term of the lease expires, after which the lease must be held by production or extended to remain valid.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contains a Pugh clause that allows partial release of non-producing acreage at the end of the primary term.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which non-producing acreage is scheduled to be released under the Pugh clause provisions. Null if no Pugh clause or no release pending.

attributes.name: pugh_clause_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of Pugh clause: horizontal (acreage-based), vertical (depth-based), both, or none if no Pugh clause exists.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lease expiry record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this expiry tracking record: active (monitoring ongoing), resolved (action completed), cancelled (no longer applicable), or archived (historical record).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lease expiry record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required regulatory filing was submitted or is scheduled to be submitted. Null if no filing is required.
attributes.references: BOEM / State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory filing or notification is required with state or federal agencies upon lease expiry or release.
attributes.references: BOEM / State Oil and Gas Commission Regulations

attributes.name: working_interest_at_risk
attributes.description: The working interest percentage that is at risk of being lost if the lease expires, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.875 for 87.5%).

products.name: delay_rental
products.description: Transactional record for delay rental payments made to lessors to maintain a lease in force during the primary term before drilling commences. Captures rental due date, rental amount, payment date, payment method, lessor payee, lease reference, rental period covered, and payment confirmation status. Delay rentals are a contractual obligation — missed payments can result in lease termination. Integrates with accounts payable for payment processing.

attributes.name: delay_rental_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delay rental payment transaction. Primary key for the delay rental record.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating company responsible for making the delay rental payment on behalf of working interest owners.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user identifier of the person who approved the delay rental payment for processing. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Delay rental payments must be coded to specific GL accounts for expense recognition, lease maintenance cost tracking, and JIB billing to working interest partners. Required for financial statement pre

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the oil and gas lease agreement for which this delay rental payment is made. Links to the lease master record.

attributes.name: payee_tax_id
attributes.description: The tax identification number (TIN or EIN) of the payee for IRS 1099 reporting and tax compliance purposes.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral rights owner or lessor who receives the delay rental payment. Links to the party master record.

attributes.name: acreage_covered
attributes.description: The total number of acres covered by this delay rental payment. May differ from total lease acreage if partial acreage is being held.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The AFE number under which this delay rental payment is authorized and budgeted. Links the payment to capital or operating budget approval.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the delay rental payment was approved for processing by the authorized approver or land department.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The accounting cost center or business unit code to which this delay rental expense is charged for financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delay rental payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: drilling_commenced_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether drilling operations have commenced on the lease. Once drilling begins, delay rental obligations typically cease.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the rental due date during which payment can still be made without lease termination, as specified in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: jib_statement_number
attributes.description: The JIB statement number if this delay rental payment is being billed to non-operating working interest partners for their proportionate share.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delay rental payment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_amount
attributes.description: Additional penalty amount assessed for delay rental payments made after the due date, if specified in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: lease_primary_term_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the lease is currently in its primary term. Delay rentals are only applicable during the primary term before drilling commences.

attributes.name: lease_termination_risk_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the delay rental payment is overdue and the lease is at risk of automatic termination per lease terms.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the lessor or designated payee receiving the delay rental payment. May differ from lessor if payment is assigned.

attributes.name: payment_confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the payment has been successfully delivered and cleared with the lessor or financial institution.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the delay rental payment was made or is scheduled to be made. Critical for determining lease continuation compliance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to make the delay rental payment to the lessor.

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the delay rental payment, including special circumstances, disputes, or payment arrangements.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment system (check number, wire confirmation, ACH trace number) that confirms the payment transaction.

attributes.name: rental_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount of the delay rental payment due to the lessor. Typically calculated as dollars per acre per year as specified in the lease agreement.

attributes.name: rental_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the delay rental payment amount. Typically USD for United States operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|MXN|BRL|AUD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rental_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the delay rental payment must be made to maintain the lease in force. Missing this date can result in automatic lease termination per lease terms.

attributes.name: rental_payment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the delay rental payment transaction. Used for external reference and tracking in accounts payable systems.

attributes.name: rental_period_end_date
attributes.description: The ending date of the lease period covered by this delay rental payment. Defines the coverage window for the rental obligation.

attributes.name: rental_period_start_date
attributes.description: The beginning date of the lease period covered by this delay rental payment. Typically aligns with the lease anniversary date.

attributes.name: rental_rate_per_acre
attributes.description: The contractual delay rental rate per acre as specified in the lease agreement. Used to calculate the total rental amount based on leased acreage.

attributes.name: rental_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delay rental payment. Tracks whether the payment obligation has been fulfilled, is pending, or has issues.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system from which this delay rental record originated (e.g., Quorum Land System, SAP, custom land management system).

attributes.name: working_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The working interest ownership percentage (expressed as decimal) responsible for this delay rental payment. Used when multiple working interest owners share rental obligations.

products.name: surface_use_agreement
products.description: Master record for all surface access agreements including surface use agreements (SUAs) and right-of-way (ROW) easements. For SUAs: covers agreements with surface owners to permit access for drilling, facility installation, and operations. For ROWs: covers pipeline, road, and utility easements granting passage across surface tracts. Common attributes: agreement type (SUA, pipeline ROW, road ROW, utility ROW), grantor/surface owner, tract reference, permitted activities, compensation terms (one-time payment, annual rental, damage payments, per-rod rate), term (fixed or perpetual), easement dimensions (width, length for ROW), reclamation obligations, restricted areas, regulatory filing reference, and agreement status. Distinct from mineral lease — surface rights and mineral rights may be severed. Required for regulatory permitting, HSE compliance, and pipeline operations.

attributes.name: surface_use_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the surface use agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Surface damages and easement compensation are AFE costs charged to drilling/facility projects. Standard upstream cost allocation for surface rights acquisition tied to capital budgets.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: Surface agreements are formalized as procurement contracts with landowners for access/damages. Links land rights to contract management system for payment terms, insurance, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: grantor_id
attributes.description: FK to land.party

attributes.name: grantor_party_id
attributes.description: FK to land.party

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Surface use agreements are negotiated in conjunction with leases to secure surface access for drilling and production operations. While SUA already has tract_id, adding lease_id links the surface agre

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: FK to land.party

attributes.name: tract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the surface tract or parcel covered by this agreement. Links to the land tract master record.

attributes.name: access_restrictions
attributes.description: Specific restrictions on access timing, methods, or conditions, such as seasonal restrictions, notification requirements, or limitations on heavy equipment use.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the surface use agreement or right-of-way easement. Format: SUA-NNNNNN for surface use agreements, ROW-NNNNNN for right-of-way easements.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Agreement Numbering Standard

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surface use agreement. Draft: under negotiation; Pending Approval: awaiting internal or regulatory approval; Active: in force; Suspended: temporarily inactive; Terminated: ended by mutual agreement; Expired: term ended; Cancelled: voided before execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|terminated|expired|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Agreement Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the surface access agreement. Surface Use Agreement (SUA) covers drilling and facility operations; Pipeline ROW, Road ROW, and Utility ROW cover linear easements; Access Easement covers general access rights; Temporary Workspace covers short-term construction areas.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: annual_rental_amount
attributes.description: Annual recurring rental payment to the grantor. Applicable when compensation type is annual rental. Null for one-time or per-rod compensation.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Interest Billing Standards

attributes.name: compensation_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary compensation amount paid or payable to the grantor under the agreement. For one-time payments, the lump sum; for annual rentals, the annual amount; for per-rod rates, the total calculated amount.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Interest Billing Standards

attributes.name: compensation_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the compensation amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: Method by which the grantor is compensated for surface access. One-time payment: lump sum at signing; Annual rental: recurring annual fee; Per-rod rate: payment per linear rod of easement; Damage payment: compensation for crop or property damage; No compensation: granted without payment.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) - Joint Interest Billing Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the jurisdiction of the surface tract (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish in which the surface tract is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surface use agreement record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: damage_payment_terms
attributes.description: Description of terms for compensating the grantor for crop damage, property damage, or loss of use during operations. May include per-acre rates, appraisal-based compensation, or fixed schedules.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: easement_length_ft
attributes.description: Length of the right-of-way easement corridor in feet. Applicable to pipeline ROW, road ROW, and utility ROW agreements. Null for surface use agreements without linear easement dimensions.
attributes.references: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) - Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: easement_width_ft
attributes.description: Width of the right-of-way easement corridor in feet. Applicable to pipeline ROW, road ROW, and utility ROW agreements. Null for surface use agreements without linear easement dimensions.
attributes.references: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) - Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surface use agreement becomes legally binding and operational activities may commence.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surface use agreement term ends. Null for perpetual easements or agreements with no fixed term.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: hse_compliance_notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Compliance Notes
attributes.description: Notes on Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance requirements specific to this agreement, such as spill prevention plans, noise restrictions, or environmental monitoring obligations.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) - Workplace Safety Standards; Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Minimum required liability insurance coverage amount in the agreement currency. Null if insurance is not required.

attributes.name: insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operator is required to maintain liability insurance covering surface activities under this agreement. True if insurance is required; False if not required.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) - Workplace Safety Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surface use agreement record was last updated in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal land description of the surface area covered by the agreement, typically using metes and bounds, lot and block, or government survey system (section, township, range).
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Public Land Survey System

attributes.name: notarized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement has been notarized. True if notarized; False if not notarized. Notarization may be required for recording in county land records.
attributes.references: State Recording Statutes - Land Record Requirements

attributes.name: operator_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the operator or company representative signed the agreement.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Agreement Execution Tracking

attributes.name: per_rod_rate
attributes.description: Compensation rate per rod (16.5 feet) of linear easement. Applicable to pipeline and utility ROW agreements using per-rod pricing. Null if compensation type is not per-rod.

attributes.name: permitted_activities
attributes.description: Detailed description of the activities authorized under the agreement, such as drilling operations, facility construction, pipeline installation, road construction, seismic surveys, or utility placement.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: reclamation_obligations
attributes.description: Detailed description of reclamation and restoration obligations, including topsoil replacement, reseeding, erosion control, removal of structures, and timeline for completion.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Surface Reclamation Standards

attributes.name: reclamation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operator is obligated to reclaim and restore the surface to its original or agreed-upon condition after operations cease. True if reclamation is required; False if not required or if easement is perpetual.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Surface Reclamation Standards

attributes.name: recorded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement has been recorded in the county land records or registry of deeds. True if recorded; False if not recorded.
attributes.references: State Recording Statutes - Land Record Requirements

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agreement was recorded in the county land records. Null if not yet recorded.
attributes.references: State Recording Statutes - Land Record Requirements

attributes.name: recording_reference
attributes.description: County clerk or recorder reference number, book and page, or instrument number for the recorded agreement. Null if not recorded.
attributes.references: State Recording Statutes - Land Record Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for any regulatory filing, permit, or approval associated with this surface use agreement, such as Bureau of Land Management (BLM) right-of-way grant number or state pipeline permit number.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Right-of-Way Management; Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) - Pipeline Permitting

attributes.name: restricted_areas
attributes.description: Description of areas within the tract where access or activities are restricted or prohibited, such as residential zones, water sources, cultural sites, or environmentally sensitive areas.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) - Environmental Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province in which the surface tract is located. Use two-letter abbreviation (e.g., TX, OK, AB).

attributes.name: surface_owner_consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surface owner or grantor signed and consented to the agreement.
attributes.references: Quorum Land System - Agreement Execution Tracking

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Duration structure of the agreement. Fixed term: specific start and end dates; Perpetual: no expiration (common for pipeline ROW); As needed: temporary access for specific activities; Project duration: tied to the life of a specific project or well.
attributes.references: API RP 51R - Onshore Oil and Gas Recommended Practice for Land Management

attributes.name: total_acreage
attributes.description: Total surface acreage covered by the agreement. For linear easements, calculated from width and length. For surface use agreements, the total disturbed or leased acreage.
attributes.references: Bureau of Land Management (BLM) - Land Measurement Standards

products.name: lease_amendment
products.description: Transactional record capturing formal amendments to existing lease agreements, including ratifications, modifications to royalty rates, depth severances, acreage reductions (Pugh clause releases), extension agreements, and pooling amendments. Captures amendment type, effective date, original lease reference, changed terms, consideration paid, and execution status. Maintains the full amendment history for each lease to support title chain integrity and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: lease_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lease amendment record. Primary key.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - Joint Interest Billing Standards

attributes.name: lessee_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessee (operator or working interest owner) party executing the amendment. Links to the party master for lessee information.

attributes.name: lessor_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessor (mineral rights owner) party executing the amendment. Links to the party master for lessor information.

attributes.name: operator_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the designated operator party after the amendment. May differ from lessee if operator assignment is modified. Links to the party master.

attributes.name: original_lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original lease agreement being amended. Links to the parent lease record to maintain title chain integrity.
attributes.references: COPAS - Land and Lease Management Standards

attributes.name: superseded_by_amendment_lease_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to a later amendment that supersedes or replaces this amendment. Null if this amendment is current. Supports amendment history tracking.

attributes.name: title_opinion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the title opinion that supports or validates this amendment. Links to the title opinion record for chain of title verification.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA) - Title Opinion Standards

attributes.name: amended_net_revenue_interest
attributes.description: New net revenue interest percentage established by the amendment, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.60 for 60% NRI). Applicable when amendment modifies revenue interests. Null if NRI is not changed.
attributes.references: COPAS - Net Revenue Interest (NRI) Calculation Standards

attributes.name: amended_primary_term_months
attributes.description: New primary term duration in months established by the amendment. Applicable when amendment type is extension. Null if primary term is not changed.

attributes.name: amended_royalty_rate
attributes.description: New royalty rate established by the amendment, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.1875 for 18.75%). Applicable when amendment type is royalty modification. Null if royalty rate is not changed.

attributes.name: amended_working_interest

products.name: orri
products.description: Master record for Overriding Royalty Interests (ORRI) — non-cost-bearing interests carved out of the working interest that entitle the holder to a fraction of gross production revenue. Captures ORRI holder, decimal fraction, lease or well reference, creation instrument, effective date, termination conditions (convertible ORRI, payout-based ORRI), and current status. ORRIs are commonly granted to geologists, brokers, and landmen as compensation. Distinct from royalty interests which are carved from the mineral estate.

attributes.description: Reference to the lease from which this ORRI is carved. ORRIs are typically associated with a specific lease or well.

attributes.description: Reference to the party (individual or entity) who holds the ORRI. Commonly geologists, brokers, landmen, or consultants who were granted the interest as compensation.

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to venture.partner. Business justification: ORRI holders are often venture partners. Venture_partner_id tracks the payee, enables payment processing, supports JIB netting, and ensures proper tax reporting for partner-held overriding royalties.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific well to which this ORRI applies, if the ORRI is well-specific rather than lease-wide.

attributes.name: conversion_trigger

attributes.name: convertible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ORRI is convertible to another interest type (typically working interest) under specified conditions.

attributes.name: cost_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ORRI holder bears any costs. By definition, ORRIs are non-cost-bearing, so this should typically be False. Included for completeness and exception handling.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the ORRI property is located.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: The county in which the lease or well associated with this ORRI is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this ORRI record was first created in the system.

attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the legal instrument that created the ORRI, used for title research and audit purposes.

products.name: unit_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation of a lease in a pooling or unitization unit. It captures the contractual and regulatory relationship between a lease and the pooling unit it participates in, including allocation factors, participating acreage, interest percentages, and participation status. Each record links one lease to one pooling unit with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship. This is a critical operational entity for revenue accounting, joint interest billing, and production allocation processes.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas land administration, a pooling unit combines multiple leases to develop a common reservoir, and a single lease can participate in multiple pooling units if it covers acreage in different formations or geographic areas. The business actively manages unit participation through unit operating agreements, participation schedules maintained in land systems, and detailed allocation factors used by revenue accounting and joint interest billing systems. This is a recognized operational relationship with contractual, regulatory, and financial significance.

attributes.name: cost_bearing_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lease participation bears its proportional share of drilling and operating costs. Values: cost_bearing (pays proportional costs), non_cost_bearing (receives revenue only), carried_interest (costs carried by other parties), back_in_after_payout (becomes cost-bearing after payout).

products.name: lease_tract
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of specific tracts to oil and gas leases. It captures the fundamental land administration relationship where a single lease can cover multiple non-contiguous tracts, and a single tract can be included in multiple overlapping leases (e.g., different depths, different mineral rights, or stacked leases). Each record links one lease to one tract with acreage allocations, interest percentages, and effective dates that exist only in the context of this specific lease-tract combination.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas land administration, leases routinely cover multiple non-contiguous tracts (a single lease agreement can span dozens of tracts across a field), and tracts are frequently included in multiple leases simultaneously due to depth severance (stacked leases at different depths), split mineral rights (separate oil vs gas leases), or overlapping lease periods during transitions. Land departments actively manage lease-tract assignments through acreage schedules, tract participation records, and amendment tracking, with specific acreage allocations, interest percentages, and effective dates maintained for each lease-tract combination.

products.name: lease_interest
products.description: This association product represents the Working Interest Position between customer_counterparty and lease. It captures the joint operating agreement terms that define each counterparty's ownership stake, revenue entitlement, and operational responsibilities in a specific oil and gas lease. Each record links one customer_counterparty to one lease with attributes that exist only in the context of this co-ownership relationship, including working interest percentage, net revenue interest, operator designation, and cost-bearing obligations.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint ventures, multiple counterparties (IOCs, NOCs, independent operators) routinely hold simultaneous working interest positions in a single lease, and each counterparty typically holds interests across a portfolio of multiple leases. The business actively manages these working interest positions as operational records with specific attributes (working interest %, net revenue interest %, operator designation, effective dates) that belong to neither the counterparty nor the lease alone, but to the specific counterparty-lease combination. This is the core business concept of 'Lease Interest' or 'Working Interest Position' tracked in land systems and consumed by royalty, JIB, and production allocation processes.

attributes.name: lease_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each working interest position record. Primary key for the lease_interest association.

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the counterparty holding the working interest position in this lease. Identifies the party (IOC, NOC, independent operator, or working interest owner) with ownership stake and revenue entitlement.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the oil and gas lease in which the counterparty holds a working interest position. Identifies the specific mineral rights agreement subject to joint ownership.

attributes.name: acquisition_method
attributes.description: Method by which this counterparty acquired their working interest position. Original lease indicates they were a party to the initial lease agreement. Farm-in indicates they earned interest through drilling or development obligations. Assignment indicates purchase from another working interest owner. Used for audit trail and title verification.

attributes.name: cost_bearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this counterparty bears their proportionate share of lease operating costs and capital expenditures. In some carried interest arrangements, a party may hold working interest without bearing costs during initial development. Used for joint interest billing (JIB) and AFE cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: System timestamp when this lease interest record was created in the land system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this counterparty's working interest position became effective. Marks the start of their ownership stake, cost-bearing obligations, and revenue entitlement. Critical for production allocation and royalty calculation temporal logic.

attributes.name: interest_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of interest held by this counterparty in the lease. Distinguishes between standard working interest (cost-bearing ownership), overriding royalty interest (revenue share without costs), carried interest (non-cost-bearing during payout), and back-in interest (contingent future interest after payout). Determines cost allocation and revenue distribution treatment.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue this counterparty receives after deducting royalties, overriding royalties, and other burdens from their working interest. Calculated as working_interest_percent minus all revenue deductions. Used for production allocation and revenue distribution.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this counterparty is designated as the operator of the lease. The operator is responsible for day-to-day operations, drilling, production, and regulatory compliance. Typically only one working interest owner per lease has operator_flag = true.

attributes.name: overriding_royalty_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of production revenue carved out of the working interest and paid to a third party. Does not bear operating costs. [Moved from lease: This attribute currently exists in the lease product but represents a specific party's ORRI carve-out, not a lease-level aggregate. Multiple parties may hold different ORRI percentages in the same lease. This attribute belongs in the lease_interest association to support multiple ORRI holders per lease.]

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this working interest position has reached payout (recovery of capital costs). Pre-payout indicates the counterparty is still recovering their investment. Post-payout indicates capital has been recovered and different revenue sharing terms may apply. Relevant for carried interest and back-in interest arrangements.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this counterparty's working interest position terminated due to sale, assignment, or lease expiration. Null indicates the interest is currently active. Used to track historical ownership changes and calculate revenue entitlement periods.

attributes.name: updated_date
attributes.description: System timestamp when this lease interest record was last modified. Used for change tracking and data synchronization with downstream systems (royalty, JIB, production allocation).

attributes.name: working_interest_percent
attributes.description: Percentage ownership of the operating rights and cost-bearing obligations in the lease held by this counterparty. Represents the party's share of capital expenditures, operating expenses, and gross production. Sum of all working interests in a lease typically equals 100%.

domains.name: venture
domains.description: Manages joint operating agreements (JOA), production sharing agreements (PSA), farm-in/farm-out arrangements, and partner relationships. Owns partner equity positions, working interest registers, AFE approvals, joint interest billing (JIB), cost recovery tracking, profit oil/gas splits, partner netting, and cash call management. Supports COPAS accounting standards and SEC partner disclosure. Integrates with SAP Joint Venture Accounting.

products.name: joa
products.description: Master record for Joint Operating Agreements governing co-ownership and operational responsibilities among working interest partners for a specific asset, block, or contract area. Captures JOA type, effective/expiry dates, governing law, operator designation, non-operator rights, voting thresholds for ordinary and special resolutions, default and forfeiture provisions, COPAS accounting election (2005/2019), overhead rate method, and amendment history. Serves as the foundational legal instrument linking all joint venture cost sharing, revenue allocation, AFE approvals, and partner governance in the venture domain.

SSOT for all PSA-level entitlement, cost recovery, and profit split calculations.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: PSAs require designated operator representative employee for government liaison, regulatory compliance reporting, and cost recovery submissions. Essential for tracking accountability in host country r

attributes.description: Reference to the partner entity designated as the operator for this PSA. The operator manages day-to-day operations and is typically the largest working interest holder.

attributes.name: psa_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the National Oil Company or host government entity that is the counterparty to this PSA.

attributes.name: arbitration_forum
attributes.description: Designated arbitration body or forum for dispute resolution (e.g., International Chamber of Commerce, London Court of International Arbitration, UNCITRAL). Specifies the mechanism for resolving contractual disputes.

attributes.name: contract_area
attributes.description: Geographic description or block designation of the exploration and production area covered by this PSA. May reference offshore blocks, onshore concessions, or field names.
attributes.references: BOEM (Bureau of Ocean Energy Management) - Lease Area Standards

attributes.name: contractor_profit_share_percent
attributes.description: Base percentage of profit oil/gas allocated to contractors after cost recovery. Used when profit_oil_split_method is fixed_percentage. For tiered or R-factor methods, this represents the initial or minimum contractor share.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_recovery_carryforward_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether unrecovered costs from prior periods may be carried forward to future periods for recovery. True means contractors can accumulate cost pools; False means costs not recovered in a period are forfeited.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: cost_recovery_ceiling_percent
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of gross production (in value terms) that contractors may recover as cost oil/gas in any given period. Typical range is 40-80%. Prevents excessive cost recovery in high-production periods.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this PSA record in the system. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSA record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which financial terms (bonuses, expenditure commitments, cost recovery) are denominated. Typically USD for international PSAs.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Method used to depreciate capital expenditures for cost recovery purposes. Unit of production ties depreciation to actual production volumes. Immediate expensing allows full cost recovery in the period incurred.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 - Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources / COPAS Standards

attributes.name: development_period_years
attributes.description: Duration in years allocated for the development and production phase. May be extended based on field life and economic production thresholds.

attributes.name: domestic_market_obligation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of contractor entitlement that must be sold to the domestic market at a regulated or discounted price. Common in PSAs to ensure host country energy security. Also known as DMO.
attributes.references: Host Government Energy Policy / OPEC Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the PSA terms become binding and cost recovery and entitlement calculations commence. May differ from signature date pending government approvals.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_standard
attributes.description: Reference to the environmental, health, and safety (EHS) standards and regulations that contractors must comply with under this PSA. May reference host country regulations, international standards (ISO 14001), or lender requirements (Equator Principles).
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management / EPA Standards / Host Country EHS Regulations

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PSA contract term ends, unless extended by mutual agreement or automatic extension clauses. Nullable for contracts with indefinite terms subject to production thresholds.

attributes.name: exploration_period_years
attributes.description: Duration in years allocated for the exploration phase under the PSA. During this period, contractors conduct seismic surveys, drilling, and appraisal activities.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law that applies to the interpretation and enforcement of the PSA. Typically the host country law, but may reference international arbitration frameworks.

attributes.name: government_profit_share_percent
attributes.description: Base percentage of profit oil/gas allocated to the host government after cost recovery. Used when profit_oil_split_method is fixed_percentage. For tiered or R-factor methods, this represents the initial or maximum government share.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: host_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the host government or jurisdiction where the PSA is executed.

attributes.name: local_content_requirement_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of goods, services, and workforce that must be sourced locally from the host country. Used to promote local economic development and employment.

attributes.name: minimum_expenditure_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum capital expenditure (CAPEX) amount that contractors must invest during the exploration period to satisfy work obligations. Expressed in USD. Non-compliance may trigger penalties or contract termination.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: minimum_work_obligation
attributes.description: Description of the minimum exploration and appraisal work commitments (e.g., seismic surveys, number of wells to be drilled) that contractors must complete during the exploration period. Failure to meet obligations may result in penalties or relinquishment.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this PSA record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSA record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: production_bonus_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount due to the host government when the production_bonus_threshold_bopd is achieved. May be recoverable as cost oil depending on PSA terms. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: production_bonus_threshold_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Bonus Threshold Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Daily production threshold in barrels of oil per day (BOPD) or barrel of oil equivalent (BOE) that triggers a production bonus payment to the host government. Multiple tiers may exist; this represents the first or primary threshold.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: profit_oil_split_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to determine the split of profit oil/gas between the host government and contractors. R-factor is cumulative revenue divided by cumulative costs. Production tier is based on daily or cumulative production volumes. Sliding scale adjusts split based on field profitability.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: psa_name
attributes.description: The business name or title of the PSA, typically referencing the contract area or field name.

attributes.name: psa_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique contract number or identifier assigned to this PSA by the host government or National Oil Company (NOC). Used for legal reference and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: psa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PSA. Active indicates the contract is in force and production/cost recovery is occurring. Suspended or force majeure indicates temporary halt. Terminated or expired indicates contract end. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|negotiation|executed|active|suspended|force_majeure|terminated|expired — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: relinquishment_schedule
attributes.description: Description of the phased relinquishment of contract area that contractors must return to the host government over the exploration and development periods. Typically expressed as percentage of area to be relinquished at specific milestones.
attributes.references: BOEM (Bureau of Ocean Energy Management) - Lease Relinquishment Standards

attributes.name: ring_fencing_rule
attributes.description: Defines whether cost recovery and profit calculations are performed at the contract level (all fields aggregated), field level (each field independent), or block level. Ring fencing prevents cross-subsidization of costs between profitable and unprofitable areas.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of gross production paid to the host government as royalty before cost recovery and profit split. Typically ranges from 5-20%. Royalty is deducted from gross production before calculating cost oil and profit oil.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: signature_bonus_amount
attributes.description: One-time upfront payment made by contractors to the host government upon signing the PSA. Typically non-recoverable as cost oil. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PSA was formally signed by all parties. Used for legal and audit purposes.

attributes.name: stabilization_clause
attributes.description: Legal provision that protects contractors from adverse changes in host government fiscal or regulatory terms during the PSA term. Describes the scope and duration of fiscal stability guarantees.

attributes.name: state_participation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage equity participation by the host government or NOC in the contractor group. State participation entitles the government to a share of contractor entitlement and obligates them to fund their proportionate share of costs. Also known as carried interest if the state does not fund costs.
attributes.references: COPAS (Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies) - PSA Accounting Standards

attributes.name: training_and_technology_transfer_obligation
attributes.description: Description of contractor obligations to provide training, capacity building, and technology transfer to host country nationals and institutions. May include scholarship programs, technical training, and knowledge sharing.

products.name: partner
products.description: Master record for each legal entity participating in a joint venture, JOA, or PSA. Captures partner legal name, entity type (IOC, NOC, independent, government), country of incorporation, API partner code, SAP vendor/partner number, contact details, credit rating, and partner classification. Prefixed 'venture_' to avoid collision with the customer domain's counterparty records. SSOT for partner identity within the venture domain.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Primary key for partner

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Operating partners and major non-operators are legal entities with company codes for intercompany JIB settlements, netting transactions, and consolidated financial reporting. Required for intercompany

attributes.name: counterparty_id

attributes.name: annual_revenue_amount

attributes.name: annual_revenue_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the annual revenue amount.

attributes.name: api_partner_code
attributes.description: Standardized partner identifier assigned by the American Petroleum Institute for industry-wide partner identification and data exchange.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Functional role of the partner in joint venture operations. Operator manages day-to-day operations; non-operator holds interest but does not operate; working interest owner bears proportionate costs; royalty owner receives revenue without cost burden; overriding royalty owner holds carved-out interest; area of mutual interest indicates exploration partnership.

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction where the partner entity is legally incorporated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance allowed for the partner before requiring prepayment or additional security under joint interest billing terms.

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit limit amount.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: External credit rating assigned by a recognized rating agency (e.g., Moodys, S&P, Fitch). Used for partner risk assessment, cash call management, and default provisions in JOA.

attributes.name: default_interest_rate_percent

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for business entity identification and credit assessment.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the partner organization. IOC = International Oil Company, NOC = National Oil Company, independent = independent producer, government = government entity, private_equity = financial investor, service_company = oilfield service provider.

attributes.name: is_government_entity
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the partner is a government or state-owned entity. True = government entity; False = private entity. Used for PSA compliance and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: is_operator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this partner serves as the operator for any joint venture properties. True = partner is an operator; False = partner is non-operator only.

attributes.name: kyc_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent Know Your Customer due diligence process was completed for this partner, including identity verification, beneficial ownership disclosure, and sanctions screening.

attributes.name: kyc_review_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Review Due Date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic KYC review is required for this partner to maintain compliance with anti-money laundering and sanctions regulations.
attributes.references: Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Recommendations; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner master record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: legal_name

attributes.name: partner_status

attributes.name: partnership_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner exited all joint venture relationships with the company, either through sale of interest, withdrawal, or termination. Null for active partners.

attributes.name: partnership_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner first entered into a joint venture, JOA, or PSA relationship with the company. Used for partner tenure analysis and relationship management.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days allowed for partner to remit payment after joint interest billing invoice date, as defined in the JOA or PSA.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines; JOA Model Form

attributes.name: primary_contact_email

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact for joint venture operations, AFE approvals, and partner communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone

attributes.name: registered_address_line1

attributes.name: registered_address_line2

attributes.name: registered_city

attributes.name: registered_country

attributes.name: registered_postal_code

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the partners registered legal address.

attributes.name: sanctioned_entity_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the partner is subject to international trade sanctions or export controls. True = sanctioned; False = not sanctioned. Used for compliance screening and OFAC reporting.

attributes.name: sap_partner_number
attributes.description: Unique partner master record identifier in SAP Joint Venture Accounting module. Used for joint interest billing, partner netting, and AFE management.

attributes.name: sap_vendor_number
attributes.description: Unique vendor master record identifier in SAP S/4HANA system. Links partner to accounts payable, procurement, and joint interest billing processes.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or common name used for operational reporting, dashboards, and internal communications.

attributes.name: stock_exchange_ticker

attributes.references: SEC EDGAR; Stock Exchange Listing Standards

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the partner entity. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, VAT number in EU).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary tax jurisdiction for the partner. May differ from country of incorporation for tax domicile purposes.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Official website URL of the partner organization for reference and due diligence purposes.

products.name: venture_working_interest
products.description: SSOT register of working interest (WI) positions held by each partner in each JOA or PSA-covered asset. attributes.name: venture_working_interest_id

Changes in working interest trigger regulatory disclosure requirements under se

attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner must provide AFE approval for capital expenditures on the asset.

attributes.description: The dollar threshold above which this partner's AFE approval is required, expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: assignment_date

attributes.name: assignment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the assignment or conveyance document that established or modified this working interest position.

attributes.name: billing_allocation_method

attributes.name: carried_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this working interest position is carried (costs borne by another party) during a specified phase of operations.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: non_consent_penalty_percentage
attributes.description: The penalty percentage applied to a partner's working interest if they elect non-consent status, as defined in the JOA.

attributes.name: nri_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of net revenue interest held by the partner after deducting royalties and overriding royalty interests. Represents the partner's share of production revenue.

attributes.name: operator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner is the designated operator for the asset under this agreement.

attributes.name: orri_percentage

attributes.name: partner_netting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this partner participates in partner netting arrangements for joint interest billing settlements.

attributes.name: payout_status

attributes.name: venture_working_interest_status

attributes.name: wi_percentage
