products.name: lifting_entitlement
products.description: Tracks each partner's crude oil and natural gas lifting entitlement, actual lifting volumes, and cumulative overlift/underlift imbalance positions under a JOA or PSA. Captures entitlement volume (BOE), actual lifted volume, cargo reference, lifting date, product grade, pricing basis, and in-kind vs. in-value settlement election. After merging overlift_underlift: also maintains cumulative imbalance position including opening balance, period variance, cumulative imbalance volume and value at reference price, settlement method, and settlement status. SSOT for partner lifting management and imbalance equalization.

attributes.name: lifting_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lifting entitlement record. Primary key for the lifting entitlement entity.

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the oil or gas field from which the lifting entitlement originates.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement under which this lifting entitlement is governed.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Lifting entitlements are calculated from production on specific leases. Lease_id ties entitlement volumes to source property, enabling accurate partner allocation and royalty burden deduction.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint venture partner who holds this lifting entitlement.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Partner lifting entitlements are for specific petroleum products (crude, condensate, LNG). Business process: Partner crude/product lifting schedules, entitlement balancing by product type, imbalance t

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Production Sharing Agreement under which this lifting entitlement is governed. Nullable if governed by JOA instead.

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume_bbl
attributes.description: The actual volume of crude oil or liquids physically lifted by the partner, expressed in barrels. Null for gas-only liftings.

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Lifted Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The actual volume physically lifted by the partner during this transaction, expressed in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE).

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Lifted Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: The actual volume of natural gas physically lifted by the partner, expressed in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF). Null for oil-only liftings.

attributes.name: cargo_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the physical cargo or shipment associated with this lifting, if applicable. Links to logistics and transportation records.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lifting entitlement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_imbalance_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Imbalance Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the cumulative overlift or underlift position, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: cumulative_imbalance_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Imbalance Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative overlift or underlift position for this partner across all lifting transactions to date, expressed in BOE. Positive indicates net overlift, negative indicates net underlift.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record. Typically USD for international oil and gas transactions.

attributes.name: entitlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the production period for which this entitlement is calculated.

attributes.name: entitlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the production period for which this entitlement is calculated.

attributes.name: entitlement_volume_bbl
attributes.description: The partners calculated entitlement volume for crude oil or liquids, expressed in barrels. Null for gas-only entitlements.

attributes.name: entitlement_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entitlement Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The partners calculated entitlement volume for the period, expressed in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE) for standardized comparison across product types.

attributes.name: entitlement_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entitlement Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: The partners calculated entitlement volume for natural gas, expressed in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF). Null for oil-only entitlements.

attributes.name: imbalance_value_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Imbalance Value in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: The monetary value of the imbalance for this transaction, calculated as imbalance volume multiplied by reference price, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: imbalance_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Imbalance Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The difference between entitlement and actual lifted volume for this transaction (actual minus entitlement), expressed in BOE. Positive indicates overlift, negative indicates underlift.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this lifting entitlement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: lifting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the partner physically lifted or took delivery of the crude oil or natural gas volumes.

attributes.name: lifting_point_location
attributes.description: The physical location or facility where the product was lifted, such as a terminal, platform, or pipeline delivery point.

attributes.name: lifting_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the lifting entitlement transaction, used for partner communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The method or standard used to measure the lifted volumes, such as custody transfer meters, tank gauging, or flow meters.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards (MPMS)

attributes.name: measurement_ticket_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the official measurement ticket or run ticket documenting the lifted volumes.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partners Net Revenue Interest (NRI) percentage after deducting royalties and overriding royalty interests, used for revenue allocation.

attributes.name: opening_imbalance_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Opening Imbalance Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative imbalance position at the start of this entitlement period, before this lifting transaction is applied.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The pricing benchmark or index used to determine the reference price, such as West Texas Intermediate (WTI), Brent, or Henry Hub for natural gas.

attributes.name: quality_adjustment_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Adjustment Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: Volume adjustment applied due to product quality variance from specification, expressed in BOE. Can be positive or negative.

attributes.name: quality_specification_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lifted product met the contractual quality specifications. True if specifications were met, False if not.

attributes.name: reference_price_per_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reference Price per Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The reference price per BOE used to value the imbalance position, typically based on the contract pricing mechanism or market index.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this lifting entitlement transaction.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the imbalance was settled or is scheduled to be settled. Null if settlement is pending.

attributes.name: settlement_election
attributes.description: The partners election for how they wish to settle their entitlement: in-kind (take physical product) or in-value (receive cash equivalent).

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The method by which the imbalance will be settled: in-kind (physical volume adjustment), in-value (cash settlement), cash-out (immediate cash payment), or carry-forward (deferred to future period).

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The current status of the imbalance settlement process: pending (not yet initiated), in-progress (settlement underway), settled (completed), or disputed (under review).

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation used for the lifting: pipeline, tanker, truck, rail, or barge.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partners Working Interest (WI) percentage in the field or well at the time of this lifting, used to calculate entitlement.

products.name: overlift_underlift
products.description: Tracks cumulative overlift and underlift imbalance positions per partner per JOA/PSA asset. Captures opening balance, current period lifting variance, cumulative imbalance volume (BOE), imbalance value at reference price, settlement method (cash or in-kind), and settlement status. Enables equalization calculations and supports partner dispute resolution for production imbalances.

attributes.name: overlift_underlift_id
attributes.description: Primary key for overlift_underlift

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement under which this imbalance is tracked.

attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Overlift/underlift imbalances are tracked by specific petroleum product. Business process: Partner imbalance settlement by product type, product-specific tolerance thresholds, imbalance valuation usin

attributes.name: primary_overlift_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint venture partner who holds this overlift or underlift position.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Production Sharing Agreement under which this imbalance is tracked, if applicable.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producing asset (field, platform, or facility) where the imbalance occurred.

attributes.name: actual_lifted_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Lifted Volume Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The actual volume of production in barrels of oil equivalent that the partner physically lifted or took delivery of during the current period.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the imbalance calculation: draft (under preparation), pending approval (submitted for partner review), approved (accepted by all parties), or rejected (disputed or requiring revision).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or system that approved the imbalance calculation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the imbalance calculation was approved by the authorized party.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the imbalance: entitlement-based (PSA cost recovery and profit oil), working interest-based (JOA proportional share), PSA formula (specific contractual formula), or custom (bespoke calculation per agreement).

attributes.name: closing_balance_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Closing Balance Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative overlift or underlift imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent at the end of the reporting period, calculated as opening balance plus current period variance.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the imbalance position, settlement arrangements, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this imbalance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_period_variance_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Period Variance Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The difference between actual lifted volume and entitled volume for the current period in barrels of oil equivalent. Positive values indicate overlift; negative values indicate underlift.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the imbalance position is currently under dispute by one or more partners.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the dispute, if applicable, such as disagreement on entitled volumes, pricing methodology, or measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dispute was resolved and the imbalance position was agreed upon by all parties.

attributes.name: entitled_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Entitled Volume Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The volume of production in barrels of oil equivalent that the partner is entitled to lift during the current period based on their working interest or PSA entitlement.

attributes.name: imbalance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the reporting period for which this imbalance position is calculated.

attributes.name: imbalance_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the reporting period for which this imbalance position is calculated.

attributes.name: imbalance_status
attributes.description: The current status of the imbalance position: overlift (partner lifted more than entitled), underlift (partner lifted less than entitled), balanced (no imbalance), pending settlement (awaiting equalization), settled (equalized), or disputed (under partner dispute resolution).

attributes.name: imbalance_value_usd
attributes.description: The monetary value of the closing imbalance position in United States Dollars, calculated as closing balance multiplied by reference price.

attributes.name: jib_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the Joint Interest Billing statement that includes this imbalance position for partner invoicing and netting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this imbalance record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: nri_percentage
attributes.description: The partners net revenue interest percentage in the asset at the time of the imbalance calculation, representing the share of production revenue after royalties and burdens.

attributes.name: opening_balance_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Opening Balance Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The cumulative overlift or underlift imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent at the beginning of the reporting period. Positive values indicate overlift; negative values indicate underlift.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: The market price index or benchmark used to determine the reference price for valuing the imbalance, such as WTI, Brent, Henry Hub, or a contractual formula.

attributes.name: reference_price_per_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reference Price Per Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The reference price per barrel of oil equivalent used to value the imbalance position, typically based on market index prices such as WTI or Brent.

attributes.name: settlement_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the imbalance position was fully settled or equalized.

attributes.name: settlement_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the imbalance position must be settled or equalized according to the JOA or PSA terms.

attributes.name: settlement_method
attributes.description: The method by which the imbalance will be settled: in-kind (through future production adjustments), cash (monetary settlement), hybrid (combination of in-kind and cash), or not applicable (no settlement required).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this imbalance record was extracted, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or Avocet Production Operations.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tolerance Threshold Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The maximum allowable imbalance volume in barrels of oil equivalent before settlement is required, as defined in the JOA or PSA.

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum allowable imbalance as a percentage of entitled volume before settlement is required, as defined in the JOA or PSA.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The partners working interest percentage in the asset at the time of the imbalance calculation, used to determine entitled volumes.

products.name: jv_budget
products.description: Annual and multi-year joint venture work program and budget (WP&B) approved by the operating committee for a JOA or PSA. Captures budget year, work program description, total gross budget, operator share, non-operator shares by WI, CAPEX/OPEX split, AFE references, budget revision number, and operating committee approval date. Distinct from the corporate finance budget — this is the joint account budget owned by the venture domain.
products.reference: Work Program and Budget (WP&B) — JOA / AIPN

attributes.name: jv_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Joint venture budgets feed into corporate budgets for annual planning, capital allocation, and budget-to-actual variance analysis. Essential for consolidated budget preparation and operating committee

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint operating agreement or production sharing agreement that this budget supports.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: JV budgets allocate capital and operating spend across leases. Lease-level budget tracking is required for variance analysis, AFE reconciliation, and lease-level profitability reporting.

attributes.name: opcom_meeting_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the operating committee meeting at which this budget was reviewed and approved, enabling traceability to meeting minutes and resolutions.

attributes.name: submitted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: JV budget submissions require tracking submitting employee for approval workflow, accountability, and operating committee review. Critical for tracking budget preparation responsibility and approval c

attributes.name: abandonment_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to plug and abandonment activities, including well plugging, facility decommissioning, site restoration, and environmental remediation.

attributes.name: afe_reference_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of AFE numbers associated with this budget, linking the budget to specific authorizations for expenditure that detail individual projects or work scopes within the overall work program.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operating committee chairperson or authorized representative who formally approved the budget on behalf of the joint venture partners.

attributes.name: budget_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date of the budget period, marking the close of the fiscal period for which this budget is authorized.

attributes.name: budget_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the budget period, marking when expenditures under this budget may begin to be incurred and allocated.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the budget: draft (under preparation), submitted (sent to operating committee), approved (authorized by operating committee), rejected (not approved), revised (amended after initial approval), active (in execution), closed (fiscal period ended). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|revised|active|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by planning horizon and purpose: annual (standard yearly budget), multi-year (long-term capital program), supplemental (mid-year adjustment), emergency (unplanned urgent expenditure), or AFE-specific (tied to a single Authorization for Expenditure).

attributes.name: budget_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which this budget applies, expressed as a four-digit year (e.g., 2024). For multi-year budgets, this represents the starting year.

attributes.name: capex_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total gross budget allocated to capital expenditures, including drilling, completion, facility construction, and major equipment purchases that will be capitalized per accounting standards.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, clarifications, or special conditions related to the budget, including operating committee feedback, partner concerns, or execution constraints.

attributes.name: completion_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to well completion activities, including perforation, stimulation, fracturing, wellhead installation, and initial production equipment.

attributes.name: contingency_amount_usd
attributes.description: Absolute dollar amount of contingency reserve included in the total budget, providing a buffer for cost overruns or unplanned expenditures.

attributes.name: contingency_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total budget allocated as contingency reserve for unforeseen costs, scope changes, or risk mitigation, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budget amounts. While amounts are stored in USD, this field documents the original currency if the budget was prepared in a different currency and converted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USD|CAD|GBP|EUR|AUD|NOK|BRL|MXN — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: drilling_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated specifically to drilling operations, including rig costs, drilling fluids, casing, cementing, and directional drilling services.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the original budget currency to USD, if applicable. Rate is expressed as units of original currency per 1 USD.

attributes.name: facilities_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to production facilities, including construction, expansion, or upgrade of processing plants, pipelines, storage tanks, and surface equipment.

attributes.name: hse_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to health, safety, and environmental programs, including safety training, environmental monitoring, spill prevention, and regulatory compliance activities.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.

attributes.name: non_operator_share_usd
attributes.description: The aggregate allocated share of all non-operating partners in the total budget, representing the combined financial obligation of all non-operators for the work program.

attributes.name: operating_committee_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the operating committee formally approved this budget, authorizing the operator to proceed with the work program and incur expenditures.

attributes.name: operator_share_usd
attributes.description: The operator's allocated share of the total budget based on their working interest percentage, representing the operator's financial obligation for the work program.

attributes.name: operator_wi_pct
attributes.description: The operator's working interest percentage in the joint venture, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 45.00 for 45%). Used to calculate the operator's share of costs and revenues.

attributes.name: opex_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total gross budget allocated to operating expenditures, including lease operating expenses, production costs, routine maintenance, and day-to-day operational activities that will be expensed in the current period.

attributes.name: overhead_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate operator overhead costs to the joint venture budget: fixed rate (flat fee), percentage (of direct costs), actual cost (pass-through), or COPAS standard (per COPAS accounting guidelines).

attributes.name: overhead_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for operator overhead charges included in the work program budget, covering administrative, technical, and support services provided by the operator.

attributes.name: overhead_rate_pct
attributes.description: Overhead rate applied to direct costs to calculate operator overhead charges, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Applicable when overhead allocation method is percentage-based.

attributes.name: production_operations_budget_usd
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to ongoing production operations, including well servicing, artificial lift, chemical treatments, and routine production maintenance.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date when the current revision of the budget was created or amended. For the original budget, this is the initial submission date.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number tracking amendments to the original budget. Initial approved budget is revision 0; subsequent amendments increment this counter.

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the budget was revised, documenting the business justification for amendments such as scope changes, cost overruns, new opportunities, or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this budget record originated, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or another joint venture management system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this budget record in the source system, enabling traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: total_gross_budget_usd
attributes.description: Total authorized budget amount in US dollars for the joint venture work program before allocation to partners. Represents 100% of the budgeted expenditure across all working interest owners.

attributes.name: work_program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the planned work program activities covered by this budget, including drilling operations, production optimization, facility maintenance, and other joint venture activities.

products.name: operating_committee
products.description: Master record for the Operating Committee (OpCom) established under each JOA, representing the governance body of partner representatives with voting rights over joint operations. Captures committee name, associated JOA, meeting frequency, quorum requirements, voting threshold for ordinary vs. special resolutions, and current chairperson. SSOT for JOA governance structure.
products.reference: Operating Committee — JOA / AIPN Model Form

attributes.name: operating_committee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Operating Committee record. Primary key.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement under which this Operating Committee is established. Links the committee to its governing JOA.

attributes.name: primary_operating_venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner party currently serving as chairperson of the Operating Committee. The chairperson typically facilitates meetings, sets agendas, and ensures procedural compliance.

attributes.name: quaternary_operating_partner_id
attributes.description: FK to venture.partner

attributes.name: tertiary_operating_chairperson_party_venture_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tertiary Operating Chairperson Party Venture Partner Id
attributes.description: FK to venture.partner

attributes.name: afe_approval_authority_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) Approval Authority USD
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount of an AFE that the Operating Committee can approve without requiring additional partner consent or escalation. Expressed in US dollars.

attributes.name: chairperson_rotation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the chairperson role rotates among partner representatives. Annual means yearly rotation; biennial means every two years; fixed means the chairperson does not rotate; rotating means rotation occurs but on an irregular schedule.

attributes.name: committee_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the Operating Committee in internal systems and reporting. Facilitates quick reference and system integration.

attributes.name: committee_name
attributes.description: The official name of the Operating Committee as designated in the JOA. Typically includes the asset or field name for identification.

attributes.name: confidentiality_requirement
attributes.description: Indicates whether Operating Committee proceedings, minutes, and decisions are subject to confidentiality obligations under the JOA. True means confidentiality is required; false means no specific confidentiality obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Operating Committee record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: decision_authority_scope
attributes.description: A textual description of the scope of decision-making authority granted to the Operating Committee under the JOA. Defines what types of operational, financial, and strategic decisions the committee can make.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The primary method specified in the JOA for resolving disputes that arise within the Operating Committee. Arbitration involves binding third-party arbitration; mediation involves facilitated negotiation; litigation involves court proceedings; expert determination involves a technical expert's binding decision.

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Operating Committee was formally dissolved or disbanded. Null for active committees. Marks the end of the committee's governance authority.

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Operating Committee was formally established under the JOA. Marks the beginning of the committee's governance authority.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: The jurisdiction and legal framework under which the Operating Committee operates and resolves disputes. Typically aligns with the JOA's governing law.

attributes.name: last_meeting_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent Operating Committee meeting. Used to track meeting cadence and governance activity.

attributes.name: meeting_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which the Operating Committee convenes for regular meetings as stipulated in the JOA. As-needed indicates meetings are called on an ad-hoc basis.

attributes.name: meeting_location
attributes.description: The primary physical or virtual location where Operating Committee meetings are held. May include city, office address, or virtual meeting platform details.

attributes.name: minutes_retention_years
attributes.description: The number of years that meeting minutes and committee records must be retained for audit, compliance, and legal purposes. Aligns with regulatory and contractual requirements.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this Operating Committee record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this Operating Committee record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_meeting_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Next Scheduled Meeting Date
attributes.description: The date of the next scheduled Operating Committee meeting. Facilitates planning and ensures partners are aware of upcoming governance events.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for capturing additional context, special provisions, or operational notes related to the Operating Committee that do not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Meeting Notice Period Days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days advance notice required before a scheduled Operating Committee meeting. Ensures all partners have adequate time to prepare and attend.

attributes.name: operating_committee_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the Operating Committee. Active committees are currently governing joint operations; inactive committees are temporarily not meeting; suspended committees have paused governance due to disputes or force majeure; dissolved committees have been permanently disbanded.

attributes.name: proxy_voting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether partner representatives are permitted to vote by proxy if they cannot attend a meeting in person. True means proxy voting is allowed; false means representatives must attend to vote.

attributes.name: quorum_requirement_pct
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of working interest or voting rights that must be represented at a meeting for the committee to conduct official business and make binding decisions. Expressed as a percentage of total working interest.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this Operating Committee record originated. Typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or a contract management system. Supports data lineage and integration traceability.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this Operating Committee record in the source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: total_member_count
attributes.description: The total number of partner representatives who are members of the Operating Committee. Each JOA partner typically appoints one or more representatives.

attributes.name: virtual_meeting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether Operating Committee meetings may be conducted virtually via teleconference or video conference. True means virtual meetings are permitted; false means in-person attendance is required.

attributes.name: voting_basis
attributes.description: The method by which votes are weighted in committee decisions. Working interest means votes are proportional to each party's working interest percentage; one vote per party means each partner has equal voting power regardless of interest; hybrid combines both methods for different decision types.

attributes.name: voting_threshold_ordinary_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Voting Threshold for Ordinary Resolutions Percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of affirmative votes required to pass ordinary resolutions or routine operational decisions. Typically expressed as a percentage of working interest represented at the meeting.

attributes.name: voting_threshold_special_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee Voting Threshold for Special Resolutions Percentage
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of affirmative votes required to pass special resolutions involving major decisions such as large capital expenditures, changes to the JOA, or operator replacement. Typically higher than ordinary resolution threshold.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this Operating Committee record. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: opcom_meeting
products.description: Records each Operating Committee meeting including meeting date, location, agenda items, quorum achieved flag, resolutions passed, voting results per partner, minutes reference, and action items. Provides the audit trail for partner governance decisions including AFE approvals, budget adoptions, operator changes, and work program modifications.

attributes.name: opcom_meeting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Operating Committee meeting record. Primary key for the opcom_meeting product.

attributes.name: chairperson_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner entity that served as chairperson for this Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Joint Operating Agreement under which this Operating Committee meeting is convened. Links the meeting to the governing JOA framework.

attributes.name: secretary_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Operating committee meetings require designated secretary employee for minutes preparation, records management, and resolution tracking. Critical for JOA governance and legal compliance with meeting d

attributes.name: action_items_count
attributes.description: The total number of action items assigned during the Operating Committee meeting that require follow-up by partners or the operator.

attributes.name: afe_approvals_count
attributes.description: The number of Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) proposals that were approved during this Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: agenda_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal agenda document distributed prior to or at the meeting.

attributes.name: agenda_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of the key agenda items and topics discussed during the Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: attendees_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of partners and representatives who attended the Operating Committee meeting, including attendance mode (in-person, virtual).

attributes.name: budget_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether an annual or project budget was approved during this Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: chairperson_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who chaired the Operating Committee meeting. Classified as restricted personal identifiable information.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the Operating Committee meeting record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: meeting_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the Operating Committee meeting was held or is scheduled to be held.

attributes.name: meeting_end_time
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the Operating Committee meeting concluded, including time zone information.

attributes.name: meeting_location
attributes.description: Physical location or virtual platform where the Operating Committee meeting was held (e.g., Houston Office, Microsoft Teams, Zoom).

attributes.name: meeting_location_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the physical meeting location, if applicable. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: meeting_location_city
attributes.description: City where the Operating Committee meeting was held.

attributes.name: meeting_location_country_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Operating Committee (OpCom) Meeting Location Country Code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the meeting location (e.g., USA, GBR, NOR).

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the Operating Committee meeting, typically sequential or formatted per JOA convention (e.g., OPCOM-2024-001).

attributes.name: meeting_start_time
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the Operating Committee meeting commenced, including time zone information.

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Operating Committee meeting: scheduled for future date, in progress during the meeting, completed with minutes finalized, cancelled before occurrence, postponed to a later date, or adjourned without completion.

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting type: regular scheduled meetings, special meetings called for specific purposes, emergency meetings for urgent matters, annual meetings, or extraordinary meetings per JOA provisions.

attributes.name: minutes_approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the meeting minutes were formally approved by the Operating Committee.

attributes.name: minutes_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the meeting minutes have been formally reviewed and approved by the Operating Committee members.

attributes.name: minutes_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the official meeting minutes document that records discussions, decisions, and action items.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified the Operating Committee meeting record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the Operating Committee meeting record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: next_meeting_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next Operating Committee meeting, if determined during this meeting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context related to the Operating Committee meeting that do not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: operator_change_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a change of operator was discussed or approved during this Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: quorum_achieved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the required quorum of partners (as defined in the JOA) was present to conduct official business and pass binding resolutions.

attributes.name: quorum_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of working interest or voting rights required to achieve quorum for this meeting, as specified in the JOA.

attributes.name: resolutions_passed_count
attributes.description: The total number of formal resolutions that were passed during the Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the Operating Committee meeting record originated (e.g., SAP Joint Venture Accounting, SharePoint).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Operating Committee meeting record in the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: total_voting_interest_represented_pct
attributes.description: The aggregate percentage of working interest or voting rights represented by partners present or voting at the meeting.

attributes.name: work_program_modified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether modifications to the joint venture work program were approved during this Operating Committee meeting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created the Operating Committee meeting record in the system.

products.name: carried_interest
products.description: Tracks carried interest arrangements where one partner (the carrier) funds another partner's (the carried party) share of costs during an exploration or development phase, to be recovered from future production revenues. Captures carry type (full/partial), carry period, carry amount, recovery mechanism (gross/net), recovery rate, cumulative recovered amount, and outstanding carry balance. Supports complex E&P financing structures.

attributes.name: carried_interest_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the carried interest arrangement. Primary key.

attributes.name: afe_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.afe_budget. Business justification: Carried interest arrangements track costs against specific AFE budgets for recovery calculations and payout determination. Essential for farmout economics and partner cost recovery in oil-and-gas join

attributes.name: drilling_afe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AFE document that authorizes the expenditures covered by this carried interest arrangement.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint operating agreement under which this carried interest arrangement is established.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.lease. Business justification: Carry agreements are tied to specific lease interests. Lease_id defines the scope of carry, enables tracking of carried costs by lease, and determines reversion working interest upon payout.

attributes.name: primary_carried_carrier_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner who is funding the carried party's share of costs during the carry period.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production sharing agreement if this carried interest is part of a PSA structure. Nullable for JOA-only arrangements.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Carried interest tracking requires WBS elements for cost accumulation, recovery monitoring, and payout calculation. Critical for farmout economics tracking and carried party cost recovery reporting.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific asset (well, field, lease, or facility) to which this carried interest arrangement applies.

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: Total interest amount in base currency that has accrued on the outstanding carry balance to date.

attributes.name: back_in_right_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carried party has the right to back-in to the project after payout by reimbursing the carrier for carried costs.

attributes.name: back_in_wi_percentage
attributes.description: Working interest percentage the carried party can back-in to if they exercise their back-in right. Nullable if no back-in right exists.

attributes.name: carried_interest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carried interest arrangement.

attributes.name: carried_wi_percentage
attributes.description: The working interest percentage of the carried party that is being carried by the carrier partner.

attributes.name: carry_agreement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the carried interest arrangement, typically referenced in AFE documents and joint interest billing.

attributes.name: carry_amount_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount in base currency that the carrier will fund on behalf of the carried party. Nullable for unlimited carry arrangements.

attributes.name: carry_phase
attributes.description: The operational phase during which the carry applies: exploration, appraisal, development, drilling, or completion.

attributes.name: carry_type
attributes.description: Type of carry arrangement: full (100% of costs carried), partial (percentage of costs carried), casing_point (carry until casing point decision), or production (carry until first production).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carried interest record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_carried_amount
attributes.description: Total amount in base currency that has been carried by the carrier partner to date, including all costs funded on behalf of the carried party.

attributes.name: cumulative_recovered_amount
attributes.description: Total amount in base currency that has been recovered by the carrier partner to date through the agreed recovery mechanism.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this carried interest arrangement.

attributes.name: default_provision
attributes.description: Contractual provisions that apply if the carried party defaults on obligations or if the carrier fails to fund agreed costs.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the carried interest arrangement becomes effective and cost carrying begins.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the carried interest arrangement expires or the carry period ends. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.

attributes.name: forfeiture_provision
attributes.description: Terms under which the carried party may forfeit their interest if they fail to meet obligations or if recovery conditions are not met.

attributes.name: interest_accrual_method
attributes.description: Method of interest calculation on the outstanding carry balance: simple (interest on principal only), compound (interest on principal plus accrued interest), or none (no interest).

attributes.name: interest_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the outstanding carry balance if the carry agreement includes interest accrual. Nullable if no interest applies.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this carried interest record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carried interest record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications regarding the carried interest arrangement.

attributes.name: outstanding_carry_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance in base currency that remains to be recovered by the carrier partner. Calculated as cumulative_carried_amount minus cumulative_recovered_amount.

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: Date when the carried interest was fully recovered and payout was achieved. Nullable until payout is complete.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Current payout status of the carry arrangement: pre_payout (no recovery started), in_payout (recovery in progress), post_payout (fully recovered), or suspended (recovery temporarily halted).

attributes.name: recovery_mechanism
attributes.description: Method by which the carrier recovers carried costs: gross_revenue (from gross production revenue), net_revenue (from net revenue after royalties), production_volume (from carried party's production volumes), or cost_allocation (through future cost allocations).

attributes.name: recovery_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to carried costs for recovery calculation. For example, 2.0 means carrier recovers twice the carried amount. Default is 1.0 for dollar-for-dollar recovery.

attributes.name: recovery_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the carried party's revenue or production that is applied to recover the carried costs. For example, 50% means half of carried party's revenue goes to carrier until carry is recovered.

attributes.name: reversion_nri_percentage
attributes.description: Net revenue interest percentage that reverts to the carrier partner after payout is achieved. Nullable if no reversion applies.

attributes.name: reversion_wi_percentage
attributes.description: Working interest percentage that reverts to the carrier partner after payout is achieved. Nullable if no reversion applies.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carried interest arrangement must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality thresholds or partner reporting requirements.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this carried interest record originated, typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or partner accounting system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this carried interest record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this carried interest record.

products.name: state_participation
products.description: Tracks the host government or NOC's back-in or carried participation rights under a PSA or concession agreement. Captures participation type (back-in right, free carry, paid participation), participation percentage, exercise trigger (discovery, FID, production), exercise date, consideration paid, and current participation status. Supports PSA entitlement calculations and SEC disclosure of government participation terms.
products.reference: State Participation / Back-in Right — PSA/PSC standard

attributes.name: state_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the state participation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: concession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the concession agreement under which this state participation is granted, if applicable.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting - Concession Module

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production sharing agreement under which this state participation is granted.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting - PSA Module

attributes.name: afe_approval_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state participation interest holder has AFE approval rights and must approve expenditures above a threshold. True if approval rights exist, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - AFE Approval Provisions

attributes.name: afe_approval_threshold_usd
attributes.description: The minimum AFE amount (in USD) that requires approval from the state participation interest holder. Null if no approval rights or no threshold applies.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - AFE Approval Provisions

attributes.name: back_in_right_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this participation is a back-in right (True) or an immediate participation (False). Back-in rights allow the government to acquire interest after a discovery or milestone.

attributes.name: carried_through_phase
attributes.description: The project phase through which the state participation interest is carried (i.e., costs borne by other partners): exploration, appraisal, development, production, full field life, or none if not a carried interest.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Carried Interest Provisions

attributes.name: cash_call_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state participation interest is subject to cash call obligations for ongoing capital and operating expenditures. True if the state must fund its proportionate share, False if carried or exempt.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - Cash Call Procedures

attributes.name: consideration_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the consideration amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: consideration_paid_amount
attributes.description: The monetary consideration paid by the host government to acquire the participation interest, if any. Zero for free carry or back-in rights with no payment obligation.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 - Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: cost_recovery_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state participation interest is eligible to recover historical exploration and development costs from cost oil/gas under the PSA. True if eligible, False if the state enters with no cost recovery rights (typical for free carry).
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) - Cost Recovery Provisions

attributes.name: cost_recovery_limit_usd
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative amount of historical costs that the state may recover from its share of cost oil/gas, expressed in USD. Null if no limit applies or if cost recovery is not permitted.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) - Cost Recovery Provisions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this state participation record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the state participation becomes effective for cost recovery, entitlement, and revenue sharing purposes.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - Effective Date Convention

attributes.name: entitlement_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the states production entitlement under this participation: working interest (proportionate share of gross production), profit oil split (share of profit oil/gas after cost recovery), net revenue interest (share of net revenue), hybrid (combination of methods), or other.
attributes.value_regex: working interest|profit oil split|net revenue interest|hybrid|other

attributes.name: exercise_date
attributes.description: The date on which the host government formally exercised its participation right by notifying the operator or consortium.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting - Transaction Date

attributes.name: exercise_deadline_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the host government must notify the operator of its intent to exercise the participation right. Null if no deadline applies.

attributes.name: exercise_trigger_event
attributes.description: The contractual event or milestone that enables or requires the host government to exercise its participation right: commercial discovery, final investment decision (FID), first production, development plan approval, reserves booking, field declaration, production threshold, or cumulative production milestone. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial discovery|final investment decision|first production|development plan approval|reserves booking|field declaration|production threshold|cumulative production milestone — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state participation arrangement expires or terminates, if applicable. Null for indefinite participation.

attributes.name: host_government_entity_code
attributes.description: Reference to the host government or National Oil Company (NOC) exercising the participation right.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting - Partner Master

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this state participation record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this state participation record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

attributes.name: non_consent_option_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state participation interest holder has the right to elect non-consent on discretionary operations under the JOA. True if non-consent is available, False if the state must participate in all approved operations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications regarding the state participation arrangement.

attributes.name: operator_consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operator or JOA partners formally consented to the state participation, if consent was required.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Transfer and Assignment Provisions

attributes.name: operator_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operator or other JOA partners must consent to the state exercising its participation right. True if consent is required, False if the right is automatic upon exercise.
attributes.references: Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) - Transfer and Assignment Provisions

attributes.name: participation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the state participation arrangement, typically assigned by the operator or regulatory authority.

attributes.name: participation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of working interest that the host government or NOC holds or may acquire under this participation arrangement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 15.000000 for 15%).
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines - Working Interest Allocation

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the state participation: pending (right exists but not yet exercised), exercised (government has elected to participate), active (participation is in effect), expired (option period lapsed), waived (government declined to exercise), or terminated (participation ended).
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting - Status Management

attributes.name: participation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the state participation mechanism: back-in right (government option to acquire interest post-discovery), free carry (government interest with no cost obligation), paid participation (government pays proportionate share), carried interest (costs recovered from production), state equity (direct ownership), or royalty participation (in-kind royalty converted to equity).
attributes.value_regex: back-in right|free carry|paid participation|carried interest|state equity|royalty participation

attributes.name: profit_gas_split_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of profit gas allocated to the state under this participation arrangement, if different from the standard PSA profit gas split. Null if standard PSA terms apply.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) - Profit Gas Allocation

attributes.name: profit_oil_split_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of profit oil allocated to the state under this participation arrangement, if different from the standard PSA profit oil split. Null if standard PSA terms apply.
attributes.references: Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) - Profit Oil Allocation

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the relevant regulatory authority approved the state participation, if approval was required.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Assignment and Transfer Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory or ministerial approval is required to formalize the state participation. True if approval is required, False if the participation is self-executing under the PSA.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) - Assignment and Transfer Regulations

attributes.name: reversion_trigger_event
attributes.description: The event that triggers reversion of additional working interest to the state: payout, cumulative production milestone, contract expiry, field abandonment, reserves depletion, or none if no reversion applies.

attributes.name: reversion_wi_percentage
attributes.description: The working interest percentage that reverts to the state after payout or at a specified milestone, if applicable. Null if no reversion clause exists.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this state participation arrangement must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality or impact on reserves and entitlements. True if disclosure is required, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 102 - Description of Property

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state participation was terminated, if applicable. Null if the participation is still active or pending.
attributes.references: SAP Joint Venture Accounting - Transaction Date

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the state participation was terminated (e.g., contract expiry, government waiver, field abandonment, regulatory change).

attributes.name: trigger_date
attributes.description: The date on which the trigger event occurred, initiating the governments right or obligation to participate.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this state participation record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard - Audit Trail

products.name: royalty_obligation
products.description: Master record for royalty obligations owed to mineral rights owners, governments, or overriding royalty interest holders under lease, JOA, or PSA terms. Captures royalty type (gross overriding, net profits interest, government royalty), royalty rate or sliding scale tiers, production basis (gross/net), payment frequency, payee details, and applicable deductions. Distinct from the land domain's lease royalty — this entity tracks the venture-level royalty obligation and payment status.

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for royalty_obligation

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the producing asset (well, field, or facility) from which this royalty obligation is derived.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint operating agreement under which this royalty obligation is established.

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mineral lease or land lease under which this royalty obligation is owed.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) Lease Standards

attributes.name: payee_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the venture partner or external party to whom the royalty is owed.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production sharing agreement governing this royalty obligation, if applicable.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.royalty_owner. Business justification: Venture-level royalty obligations (overriding royalties, net profits interests) are paid to specific royalty owners. Royalty_owner_id enables payment processing, 1099 reporting, and suspense account m

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The hydrocarbon commodity to which this royalty obligation applies: crude oil, natural gas, natural gas liquids (NGL), condensate, or all hydrocarbons.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative cost recovery amount before royalty rate changes or payout is achieved, if stipulated in PSA or JOA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty obligation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_royalty_paid_amount
attributes.description: Total cumulative royalty amount paid to the payee since the effective date of this obligation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which royalty payments are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: deduction_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether post-production costs (transportation, processing, compression) may be deducted before calculating royalty (True/False).

attributes.name: deduction_type
attributes.description: Description of allowable deductions: transportation costs, processing fees, compression charges, marketing expenses, or none if gross royalty.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this royalty obligation becomes effective and royalty accrual begins.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this royalty obligation terminates or expires. Null for perpetual obligations.

attributes.name: interest_rate_late_payment_pct
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to late or overdue royalty payments, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent royalty payment made to the payee.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent royalty payment made to the payee.

attributes.name: minimum_royalty_amount
attributes.description: Minimum royalty payment amount per period, regardless of production volume, if stipulated in the agreement.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this royalty obligation record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications regarding this royalty obligation.

attributes.name: payee_tax_code
attributes.description: Tax identification number of the payee for IRS 1099 reporting and withholding compliance.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which royalty payments are made to the payee: monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or upon sale of production.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the end of the production period within which royalty payment is due.

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: Date on which payout was achieved and the royalty rate changed, if applicable.

attributes.name: payout_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the obligation is subject to payout provisions and current payout state: not applicable (no payout clause), pre-payout (costs not yet recovered), or post-payout (costs recovered, full royalty rate applies).

attributes.name: production_basis
attributes.description: Defines whether royalty is calculated on gross production (before any deductions), net production (after operating costs), working interest share, or net revenue interest share.

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the royalty obligation, used for external communication and reporting.

attributes.name: royalty_obligation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty obligation: active (accruing and payable), suspended (temporarily halted), terminated (ended), pending approval (awaiting contract execution), disputed (under legal review), or paid out (obligation fully satisfied).

attributes.name: royalty_rate_percent
attributes.description: Fixed royalty rate expressed as a percentage of production value or volume. Null if sliding scale or tiered structure applies.

attributes.name: royalty_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification or variant of the royalty type, capturing jurisdiction-specific or contract-specific nuances.

attributes.name: royalty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the royalty obligation. Gross overriding royalty interest (ORRI) is paid from gross production before costs; net profits interest (NPI) is paid after cost recovery; government royalty is owed to state or federal authorities; landowner royalty is owed to mineral rights owners; production payment is a fixed-volume or fixed-value obligation; carried interest royalty is owed when a carried party begins paying.

attributes.name: sap_jva_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Joint Venture Accounting (JVA) Document Number
attributes.description: SAP Joint Venture Accounting system document number for this royalty obligation, used for integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty obligation must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality or partner relationship (True/False).
attributes.references: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Regulation S-K

attributes.name: sliding_scale_basis
attributes.description: The metric on which the sliding scale royalty rate is calculated: production volume thresholds, commodity price tiers, cumulative recovery milestones, or time-based phases.

attributes.name: sliding_scale_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the royalty rate varies based on production volume, price, or cumulative recovery (True/False).

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for suspension of royalty payments: production shut-in, force majeure, payee dispute, regulatory hold, or other cause.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the royalty obligation was terminated, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of the royalty obligation: lease expiration, asset abandonment, buyout, mutual agreement, or contract breach.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this record.

products.name: royalty_payment
products.description: Transactional record of each royalty payment disbursed to a royalty interest holder. Captures payment period, production volume basis, gross value, royalty rate applied, deductions (transportation, processing), net royalty amount, payment date, check/wire reference, and payee confirmation. Supports COPAS accounting standards and SEC royalty disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: royalty_payment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for royalty_payment

attributes.name: joa_id

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
