attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the oil and gas property or lease from which production generated this royalty payment.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production sharing agreement governing this royalty payment, if applicable.

attributes.name: royalty_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the royalty interest holder receiving this payment. May be a mineral rights owner, landowner, or overriding royalty interest (ORRI) holder.

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating company responsible for making this royalty payment on behalf of the working interest owners.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific well asset that produced the hydrocarbons generating this royalty payment.

attributes.name: ad_valorem_tax
attributes.description: The amount of ad valorem (property) tax withheld from the royalty payment, if the royalty owner is responsible for their proportionate share of property taxes.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: The check number if the payment method was check. Null for electronic payment methods.

attributes.name: compression_deduction
attributes.description: The amount deducted from gross production value to cover the cost of compressing natural gas for transportation, if allowed under the lease terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this royalty payment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this royalty payment record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: division_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the division order that establishes the royalty owner's decimal interest and payment instructions for this property.

attributes.name: gas_price_per_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Price Per Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: The realized price per thousand cubic feet of natural gas used to calculate the gross value of gas production for royalty purposes.

attributes.name: gas_volume_mcf
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gas Volume in Thousand Cubic Feet (MCF)
attributes.description: The volume of natural gas produced during the production month that is subject to this royalty payment, measured in thousand cubic feet.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards

attributes.name: gathering_deduction
attributes.description: The amount deducted from gross production value to cover the cost of gathering hydrocarbons from multiple wells to a central facility, if allowed under the lease terms.

attributes.name: gross_production_value
attributes.description: The total value of oil, gas, and NGL production before any deductions. Calculated as the sum of (volume × price) for each product type.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The amount of interest paid to the royalty owner for late payment, if the payment was made after the contractual due date and interest is required by statute or lease terms.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to calculate late payment interest, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this royalty payment record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount disbursed to the royalty owner after all deductions and tax withholdings have been applied to the royalty amount.

attributes.name: net_royalty_value
attributes.description: The net value subject to royalty calculation after all allowable deductions have been applied to the gross production value.

attributes.name: ngl_price_per_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Price Per Barrel (BBL)
attributes.description: The realized price per barrel of natural gas liquids used to calculate the gross value of NGL production for royalty purposes.

attributes.name: ngl_volume_bbl
attributes.business_glossary_term: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Volume in Barrels (BBL)
attributes.description: The volume of natural gas liquids produced during the production month that is subject to this royalty payment, measured in barrels.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards

attributes.name: oil_price_per_bbl
attributes.description: The realized price per barrel of oil used to calculate the gross value of oil production for royalty purposes. May be based on posted price, index price, or actual sales price.

attributes.name: oil_volume_bbl
attributes.description: The volume of crude oil produced during the production month that is subject to this royalty payment, measured in barrels.
attributes.references: API Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards

attributes.name: other_tax_withholding
attributes.description: Any other tax amounts withheld from the royalty payment, such as federal or state income tax withholding for non-resident royalty owners.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the royalty payment was disbursed to the royalty owner.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which the royalty payment must be disbursed to avoid late payment penalties or interest charges.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which the royalty payment was disbursed to the royalty owner.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for this royalty payment transaction, typically assigned by the operator or joint venture accounting system.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the royalty payment transaction.

attributes.name: processing_deduction
attributes.description: The amount deducted from gross production value to cover the cost of processing raw natural gas or treating crude oil, if allowed under the lease terms.

attributes.name: production_month
attributes.description: The calendar month for which production volumes are being paid. Royalty payments are typically made one or two months in arrears of production.

attributes.name: royalty_amount
attributes.description: The calculated royalty payment amount due to the royalty owner, computed as net royalty value multiplied by the royalty interest decimal.

attributes.name: royalty_interest_decimal
attributes.description: The decimal fraction representing the royalty owner's share of production, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125 for 12.5% or 1/8th royalty).

attributes.name: severance_tax
attributes.description: The amount of state or local severance tax withheld from the royalty payment, if the royalty owner is responsible for their proportionate share of production taxes.

attributes.name: suspense_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this royalty payment is being held in suspense due to title issues, missing owner information, or other administrative holds.

attributes.name: suspense_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the royalty payment is being held in suspense, if the suspense flag is true.

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: The sum of all allowable deductions (transportation, processing, compression, gathering, and other) applied to the gross production value before calculating the net royalty amount.

attributes.name: transportation_deduction
attributes.description: The amount deducted from gross production value to cover the cost of transporting hydrocarbons from the wellhead to the point of sale, if allowed under the lease terms.

attributes.name: wire_reference_number
attributes.description: The wire transfer or ACH reference number if the payment method was electronic. Null for check payments.

Captures audit period, auditing partner, audit scope (CAPEX, OPEX, overhead), audit commencement date, findings summary, disputed amounts, agreed adjustments, and final settlement. Supports COPAS audit procedures and partner dispute resolution.

products.name: default_notice
products.description: Records formal default notices issued to non-paying or non-performing partners under JOA default provisions. Captures defaulting partner, default type (cash call non-payment, AFE non-consent, work program failure), notice date, cure period, default amount, forfeiture risk, and resolution status. Tracks the full default lifecycle from notice through cure, forfeiture, or negotiated settlement.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint operating agreement under which this default notice is issued.

attributes.name: lease_id

attributes.name: cure_date

attributes.name: cure_deadline_date
attributes.description: Final date by which the defaulting partner must cure the default to avoid forfeiture or other remedies as specified in the JOA.

attributes.name: cure_period_days

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: default_amount

attributes.name: default_interest_rate_pct

attributes.name: election_status

attributes.description: Method used to allocate production revenue for recoupment purposes in joint interest billing statements. Defines how revenue is distributed between consenting and non-consenting partners during the penalty period.

attributes.description: Penalty multiplier applied to the non-consenting partner's share of operation costs. Typical values range from 200% to 500%, with 300% being common. Defines the total recoupment amount consenting partners must recover before reinstating the non-consenting partner.

attributes.name: non_consent_share_cost
attributes.description: The non-consenting partner's proportionate share of the operation cost based on their working interest. This is the base amount before penalty multiplier is applied.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or special conditions related to the non-consent election. Captures context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: nri_forfeited_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of net revenue interest forfeited by the non-consenting partner during the recoupment period. Reflects the revenue share temporarily transferred to consenting partners.

attributes.name: operation_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of the operation subject to non-consent, as stated in the AFE. Used to calculate the non-consenting partner's share and penalty obligation.

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Type of JOA operation subject to the non-consent election. Defines the nature of the capital project the partner declined to fund.

attributes.name: penalty_recoupment_amount
attributes.description: Total amount that must be recouped by consenting partners before the non-consenting partner is reinstated. Calculated as non_consent_share_cost multiplied by non_consent_penalty_multiplier.

attributes.name: recouped_amount_to_date

attributes.name: recoupment_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which consenting partners fully recovered the penalty recoupment amount. Triggers reinstatement of the non-consenting partner's working interest.

attributes.name: recoupment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which recoupment of the non-consent penalty began. Typically coincides with first production or revenue allocation from the operation.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the non-consenting partner's working interest and net revenue interest were reinstated following full penalty recoupment. Partner resumes normal participation rights.

attributes.name: reinstatement_status
attributes.description: Status of the non-consenting partner's reinstatement to full working interest participation. Indicates whether penalty has been fully recouped and rights restored.

attributes.name: remaining_recoupment_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding balance of penalty recoupment amount that consenting partners have yet to recover. Calculated as penalty_recoupment_amount minus recouped_amount_to_date.

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this non-consent election must be disclosed in SEC filings due to materiality thresholds or partner reporting obligations. True if SEC disclosure is required.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this non-consent election record originated. Typically SAP Joint Venture Accounting or similar JV management system.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this non-consent election record in the source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.

attributes.name: wi_forfeited_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of working interest forfeited by the non-consenting partner during the recoupment period. This interest reverts to consenting partners until the non-consent penalty is recovered.

products.name: agreement_type
products.description: Reference data classifying the types of venture agreements managed in the domain, including JOA, PSA, PSC, concession agreement, farm-in/farm-out, unitization agreement, and carried interest arrangement. Captures type code, type name, governing body standard, typical term length, and applicable jurisdictions. Provides standardized classification for agreement-level reporting and regulatory disclosure.
products.reference: Venture Agreement Classification — AIPN / COPAS / SPE

attributes.name: agreement_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for agreement_type

attributes.name: abandonment_liability_allocation
attributes.description: Describes how plugging and abandonment (P&A) costs and liabilities are allocated among parties under this agreement type. Proportional to WI is most common for JOA; some PSAs place responsibility on the operator or government; others require equal sharing or case-by-case negotiation.
attributes.references: BSEE Decommissioning Regulations, COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: afe_approval_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type requires formal AFE approval processes for capital and operating expenditures. True for JOA and most operating agreements; may be false for some PSAs where the NOC controls budgets directly.

attributes.name: agreement_type_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of this agreement type, including its purpose, typical use cases, key characteristics, and how it differs from other agreement types. Provides context for users selecting agreement types during data entry and reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_type_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this agreement type in the reference data system. Active types are available for new agreements; inactive types are retained for historical agreements but not used for new contracts; deprecated types are being phased out; under review types are being evaluated for addition or modification.

attributes.name: applicable_jurisdictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of countries or jurisdictions where this agreement type is commonly used or legally recognized (e.g., USA, CAN, NOR, BRA, MYS, IDN). Supports geographic filtering and regulatory compliance analysis.
attributes.references: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), International Petroleum Regulatory Frameworks

attributes.name: cash_call_mechanism_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type uses a cash call mechanism for funding joint operations, where the operator issues periodic billing statements to non-operators for their share of costs. True for JOA; false for most PSAs where cost recovery is handled through production allocation.

attributes.name: copas_billing_code_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Billing Code Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether COPAS standardized billing codes are used for joint interest billing under this agreement type. True for JOA and most US-based operating agreements; may be false for international PSAs that use different accounting standards.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type includes cost recovery provisions allowing contractors to recover exploration and development costs from production revenues before profit splits. Typically true for PSA and PSC types; false for JOA and concession agreements.
attributes.references: SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS), Host Country Fiscal Terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this agreement type record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail for reference data management.

attributes.name: default_overhead_rate_method
attributes.description: Standard method for calculating overhead charges under this agreement type. Fixed percentage applies a standard rate to direct costs; actual cost passes through real overhead; COPAS rate uses published industry rates; negotiated means parties agree case-by-case; not applicable for agreements without overhead provisions.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Standard dispute resolution mechanism specified for this agreement type. Arbitration is common for international PSAs; litigation for domestic JOAs; expert determination for technical disputes; mediation for commercial issues; OPCOM vote for operational decisions; not specified if left to individual agreement terms.
attributes.references: AIPN Model Form Agreements, AAPL Form 610

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this agreement type classification became effective in the reference data system. Used for temporal reporting and historical analysis of agreement type usage.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_standard
attributes.description: The environmental, health, and safety (HSE) standard or framework typically required under this agreement type (e.g., ISO 14001, API RP 75, Host Country Environmental Law, International Finance Corporation Performance Standards). May reference multiple standards separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: ISO 14001, API Recommended Practice 75, EPA Regulations

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this agreement type classification expires or was deprecated in the reference data system. Null for active types. Used to maintain historical accuracy when agreement type definitions change.

attributes.name: governing_body_standard
attributes.description: The industry body or regulatory framework that provides the standard template or guidance for this agreement type (e.g., AAPL Form 610 Model Form Operating Agreement, AIPN Model Production Sharing Agreement, Host Country Petroleum Law). May reference multiple standards separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: American Association of Professional Landmen (AAPL), Association of International Petroleum Negotiators (AIPN)

attributes.name: local_content_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type typically includes local content requirements mandating minimum percentages of local goods, services, or employment. Common in PSAs and concession agreements in developing countries; less common in JOAs in mature basins.
attributes.references: Host Country Petroleum Laws, Local Content Regulations

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this agreement type record was last modified in the system. Part of standard audit trail for reference data management.

attributes.name: non_consent_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type includes non-consent provisions allowing parties to opt out of proposed operations with specified penalties or interest dilution. Common in JOA; less common in PSA structures.
attributes.references: AAPL Form 610 Model Form Operating Agreement

attributes.name: operator_designation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type requires the formal designation of an operator party responsible for day-to-day operations and joint interest billing. True for JOA and most operating agreements; false for some PSAs where the NOC retains operational control.

attributes.name: profit_split_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type involves profit oil or profit gas sharing between government/NOC and contractor parties. True for PSA and PSC; false for JOA and most other agreement types where revenue is allocated by working interest.
attributes.references: SPE Petroleum Resources Management System (PRMS), Host Country Fiscal Terms

attributes.name: ring_fencing_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement type includes ring-fencing provisions that prevent cost recovery or tax consolidation across multiple contract areas or projects. Common in PSAs to protect government revenue; not applicable to most JOAs.
attributes.references: Host Country Fiscal Terms, International Tax Frameworks

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether agreements of this type typically require disclosure in SEC filings for publicly traded companies. True for material JOAs, PSAs, and farm-in/out transactions that affect reserves or financial position; false for minor or routine agreements.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 601, SEC Oil and Gas Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_type
attributes.description: Describes the level of restriction on transferring interests under this agreement type. Unrestricted allows free assignment; preferential right gives existing parties first refusal; operator consent requires operator approval; government approval requires host country consent; prohibited means transfers are not allowed.
attributes.references: AIPN Model Form Agreements, Host Country Petroleum Laws

attributes.name: type_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping similar agreement types for analytical and reporting purposes. Operating agreements govern joint operations (JOA), fiscal agreements define government/contractor splits (PSA/PSC), transfer agreements convey interests (farm-in/out), unitization agreements pool resources across boundaries, and financing agreements structure carried interests.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the agreement type (e.g., JOA, PSA, PSC, FARM-IN, FARM-OUT, UNIT, CARRY). Used for system integration and reporting classification.

attributes.name: type_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the venture agreement type (e.g., Joint Operating Agreement, Production Sharing Agreement, Production Sharing Contract, Farm-In Agreement, Farm-Out Agreement, Unitization Agreement, Carried Interest Arrangement).

attributes.name: typical_term_length_years
attributes.description: Standard or typical duration in years for agreements of this type, from effective date to expiry. Used for planning and forecasting purposes. Null if term length varies widely or is indefinite.

attributes.name: usage_notes
attributes.description: Additional guidance or notes for users on when and how to apply this agreement type classification. May include examples, edge cases, or references to specific business processes or system integrations.

attributes.name: working_interest_allocation_method
attributes.description: Describes how working interest is allocated among parties under this agreement type. Fixed percentage for JOA; sliding scale or production-based for some PSAs; cost-based for carried interest arrangements; not applicable for pure service contracts.

products.name: joa_contract_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of procurement contracts (including rig contracts and master service agreements) to Joint Operating Agreements. In joint venture operations, a single procurement contract often serves multiple JOAs simultaneously, and each JOA may utilize multiple contracts. Each record captures the allocation percentage, billing method, cost recovery eligibility, and overhead rate specific to each JOA-contract pairing, enabling accurate cost allocation and joint interest billing across working interest partners.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, procurement contracts (especially rig contracts and master service agreements) routinely serve multiple Joint Operating Agreements simultaneously, and each JOA utilizes multiple contracts. The business actively manages contract allocations as a distinct operational entity, tracking allocation percentages, billing methods, cost recovery eligibility, and JOA-specific overhead rates for each JOA-contract pairing to enable accurate joint interest billing and cost sharing among working interest partners.

attributes.name: joa_contract_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this JOA contract allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Joa Contract Allocation - Procurement Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the procurement contract being allocated to the JOA.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Joint Operating Agreement that this contract allocation serves.

attributes.name: afe_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) that approved this contract allocation to the JOA. Required when contract costs exceed the JOA's AFE approval threshold. Links contract spending to partner-approved capital and operating budgets.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the business rationale for this contract allocation, any special terms negotiated with non-operating partners, or operational context relevant to cost allocation and billing.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the procurement contract costs that are allocated to this specific JOA. Used when a single contract serves multiple JOAs to proportionally distribute costs. Sum of allocation percentages across all JOAs for a given contract should equal 100%.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this contract allocation. Active indicates the allocation is currently in effect. Suspended indicates temporary halt. Expired indicates the allocation period has ended. Terminated indicates early termination. Pending Approval indicates the allocation is awaiting partner approval per JOA voting thresholds.

attributes.name: billing_method
attributes.description: The method used to bill contract costs to this JOA. Direct means costs are billed entirely to this JOA. Proportional uses the allocation percentage. AFE-Based ties billing to specific Authorization for Expenditure approvals. Actual Usage bills based on measured consumption. Fixed Allocation uses predetermined amounts regardless of actual usage.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The accounting cost center code used for joint interest billing of costs from this contract allocation. Enables proper cost tracking and reporting in the operator's accounting system and partner billing statements.

attributes.name: cost_recovery_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs from this contract allocation are eligible for cost recovery under the JOA terms and applicable Production Sharing Contract or other upstream agreements. False indicates non-recoverable costs that must be borne by working interest partners without reimbursement from production revenue.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this contract allocation to the JOA becomes effective. May differ from the contract's overall effective date if the contract is added to the JOA mid-term or if allocation percentages change over time.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when this contract allocation to the JOA expires or terminates. Nullable if the allocation continues for the full contract term. Used to track changes in contract allocation over time as JOAs are amended or assets are transferred.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contract allocation record was last modified, including changes to allocation percentage, billing method, or status.

attributes.name: overhead_rate
attributes.description: The overhead rate applied to this contract allocation for this specific JOA, which may differ from the JOA's standard overhead rate based on contract type or negotiated terms. Used to calculate overhead charges in joint interest billing.

products.name: joa_wbs_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) working interest and budget responsibility to specific Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) elements for capital project tracking. It captures the phase-specific budget allocations, working interest percentages, and capitalization rules that govern how joint venture partners share costs and track capital expenditures across exploration, development, and production project phases. Each record links one JOA to one WBS element with attributes that exist only in the context of this cost allocation relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, a single Joint Operating Agreement commonly governs multiple capital projects across different lifecycle phases (exploration wells, development facilities, production infrastructure), each tracked as separate WBS elements in the project accounting system. Conversely, large multi-venture fields or shared infrastructure projects (e.g., a processing facility serving multiple JOAs) require a single WBS element to track costs that must be allocated across multiple JOAs based on working interest percentages. The business actively manages these allocations to ensure proper AFE-to-WBS mapping, partner cost sharing, and capitalization treatment.

attributes.name: joa_wbs_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this JOA-to-WBS allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: joa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the Joint Operating Agreement that governs cost sharing and working interest for this allocation.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Joa Wbs Allocation - Wbs Element Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the WBS element (project cost object) to which JOA working interest and budget allocation rules apply.

attributes.name: afe_reference_number
attributes.description: The Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) document number that authorizes this specific allocation of JOA budget to the WBS element. Links project authorization to joint venture cost sharing.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this JOA-to-WBS allocation indicating whether it is actively used for cost tracking and partner billing.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the WBS element budget that is allocated to this specific JOA, reflecting the working interest share or contractual cost allocation. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs posted to this WBS element under this JOA should be capitalized to fixed assets (true) or expensed (false). Governs settlement rules for Asset Under Construction (AUC). Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this JOA-to-WBS allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this JOA-to-WBS allocation becomes effective for cost tracking and AFE approval purposes. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this JOA-to-WBS allocation expires or is superseded, if applicable. Null if allocation remains active.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this JOA-to-WBS allocation record was last modified.

attributes.name: settlement_rule_override
attributes.description: Optional override of the default WBS settlement rule for costs incurred under this specific JOA allocation. Used when JOA-specific capitalization or cost center settlement differs from standard WBS configuration.

attributes.name: work_program_phase
attributes.description: The phase of the work program or project lifecycle that this WBS element represents within the JOA scope (e.g., exploration, development, production). Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The working interest percentage applicable to this specific WBS element under this JOA. May differ from the overall JOA working interest if phase-specific or project-specific allocations apply. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

products.name: partner_vendor_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the qualification and approval relationship between joint venture partners and their approved vendors. It captures partner-specific vendor qualification status, approved scope of work, performance ratings, and contract value limits. Each record links one partner to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this partner-vendor relationship, enabling partners to maintain independent approved vendor lists within joint ventures.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint ventures, each partner maintains independent approved vendor lists with partner-specific qualification criteria, performance ratings, and contract value limits. A single vendor can be qualified by multiple partners (each with different scopes and limits), and each partner qualifies multiple vendors. This is an operational business process where partners actively manage, review, and update vendor qualifications as part of JOA/PSA governance.

attributes.name: partner_vendor_qualification_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Partner Vendor Qualification - Partner Vendor Qualification Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the partner_vendor_qualification association

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the qualified vendor in the procurement system

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Partner Vendor Qualification - Venture Partner Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the joint venture partner who maintains this vendor qualification

attributes.name: approved_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the partner representative who approved this vendor qualification

attributes.name: approved_by_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the partner representative who approved this vendor qualification (e.g., Procurement Manager, Operations Director)

attributes.name: approved_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope of work, services, or materials that this vendor is approved to provide for this specific partner. May differ from partner to partner based on their standards and requirements.

attributes.name: contract_value_limit
attributes.description: Maximum contract value that this vendor is approved to execute for this specific partner without additional approval. Partner-specific limit based on vendor capability assessment and risk tolerance.

attributes.name: contract_value_limit_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value limit amount

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner-vendor qualification record was created in the system

attributes.name: hse_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the vendor has been verified to meet this partner's specific Health, Safety, and Environmental standards

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this partner-vendor qualification record was last updated

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner last reviewed or re-evaluated this vendor qualification

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this vendor qualification by the partner

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing partner-specific conditions, restrictions, or observations about this vendor qualification

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: Partner-specific performance rating of the vendor based on past delivery, quality, HSE compliance, and responsiveness. Each partner maintains independent performance assessments.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was qualified or approved by this partner for procurement activities

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the partner-specific vendor qualification expires and requires renewal or re-evaluation

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the vendor for this specific partner. Values: Qualified, Conditional, Suspended, Expired, Under Review. Each partner maintains independent qualification status.

products.name: partner_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the cost allocation relationship between joint venture partners and cost centers in joint operating agreements. It captures the working interest percentage, allocation methodology, and billing arrangements that govern how costs accumulated in each cost center are distributed to participating partners. Each record links one partner to one cost center with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific partner-cost center allocation arrangement.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint ventures, multiple partners share ownership and costs across multiple cost centers based on their working interest percentages defined in Joint Operating Agreements (JOAs). A partner participates in multiple JOAs, each with numerous cost centers (drilling, production, G&A), and each cost center accumulates costs that must be allocated to multiple partners according to their respective working interests. The business actively manages these allocation relationships, tracking partner-specific percentages, billing methods, effective dates, and AFE authorizations for each partner-cost center combination.

attributes.name: partner_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this partner-cost center allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to finance.cost_center identifying the cost center in this allocation relationship

attributes.name: joint_venture_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific joint venture or JOA under which this allocation is governed. Provides context for the contractual basis of the allocation arrangement.

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to venture.partner identifying the partner in this allocation relationship

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The AFE number associated with this allocation, linking the partner-cost center relationship to a specific capital or operating authorization approved by the joint venture partners.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to allocate costs from this cost center to this partner. PROPORTIONAL = based on working interest %, FIXED = predetermined amount, STEP_DOWN = hierarchical allocation, ACTIVITY_BASED = driver-based allocation, DIRECT = directly assigned costs.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this allocation relationship. ACTIVE = costs are being allocated, SUSPENDED = temporarily paused, PENDING = approved but not yet effective, TERMINATED = allocation has ended.

attributes.name: billing_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether costs allocated through this relationship should be included in joint interest billing (JIB) to the partner. True = costs are billable to partner, False = costs are tracked for reporting but not billed (e.g., operator-absorbed costs).

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which costs allocated through this relationship are billed to the partner. Determines the joint interest billing cycle for this partner-cost center combination.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this partner-cost center allocation arrangement becomes effective. Supports time-variant allocation relationships as working interests change due to farm-ins, farm-outs, or JOA amendments.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this partner-cost center allocation arrangement expires or is superseded by a new arrangement. Null indicates the allocation is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this allocation record.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record.

attributes.name: working_interest_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of costs from this cost center that are allocated to this partner, based on their working interest in the joint venture. Sum of all partner percentages for a given cost center should equal 100%.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this allocation record.

products.name: partner_account_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the account determination rule between venture partners and general ledger accounts. It captures partner-specific GL account assignments for automated posting of joint venture transactions including receivables, payables, revenue share, and cost recovery. Each record links one partner to one GL account with assignment rules, effective dates, and account usage type that exist only in the context of this relationship. Core to JV accounting automation per COPAS standards.. Existence Justification: In joint venture accounting operations, each partner requires multiple GL account assignments for different transaction types (receivables, payables, revenue share, cost recovery, cash calls), and each GL account serves multiple partners across the venture portfolio. The relationship represents partner-specific account determination rules that drive automated posting in JV accounting systems—a core operational configuration managed by venture accountants and referenced by every JV transaction posting routine.

attributes.name: partner_account_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this partner-account assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to finance.gl_account. Identifies which GL account is assigned to this partner.

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to venture.partner. Identifies which partner this account assignment applies to.

attributes.name: account_assignment_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or condition defining when this GL account should be automatically selected for this partner. May reference transaction type, AFE category, cost center, or other posting logic criteria used by the JV accounting automation engine.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used when multiple account assignments could apply to the same partner and transaction type. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by posting automation to resolve assignment conflicts.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this account assignment. ACTIVE = in use for posting, INACTIVE = disabled, PENDING = configured but not yet effective, SUPERSEDED = replaced by newer assignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this account assignment record was created. Audit trail.

attributes.name: default_credit_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the default GL account for credit postings to this partner for the specified partner_account_type. Used by automated posting routines to determine account selection.

attributes.name: default_debit_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the default GL account for debit postings to this partner for the specified partner_account_type. Used by automated posting routines to determine account selection.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this partner-account assignment becomes active and should be used for transaction posting. Supports time-based account assignment changes (e.g., new fiscal year, contract amendment, partner restructuring).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this partner-account assignment is no longer active. Null indicates indefinite assignment. Supports historical tracking of account assignment changes over time.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this account assignment record. Audit trail for configuration changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this account assignment record was last modified. Audit trail.

attributes.name: partner_account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account assignment indicating the transaction type this GL account handles for this partner. Values: RECEIVABLE (amounts owed by partner), PAYABLE (amounts owed to partner), REVENUE_SHARE (partner revenue distribution), COST_RECOVERY (cost reimbursement), CASH_CALL (partner funding requests), INTEREST_INCOME, INTEREST_EXPENSE, SUSPENSE (temporary holding), OTHER.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this account assignment record. Audit trail for configuration changes.

products.name: filing_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation of joint venture partners in regulatory filings submitted to governing bodies. It captures each partner's role, working interest, signatory status, and approval for multi-party regulatory submissions including joint SEC disclosures, PSA amendments, BSEE offshore reports, and FERC filings. Each record links one partner to one regulatory filing with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas joint venture operations, multiple partners participate in single regulatory filings (e.g., joint SEC 10-K proved reserves disclosures, PSA amendment filings to BOEM, FERC pipeline tariff submissions). Each partner has a specific role, working interest percentage, and approval status for each filing. Conversely, each partner participates in multiple regulatory filings across different JOAs, PSAs, and operating agreements over time. This is an operational relationship actively managed through compliance workflows.

attributes.name: filing_participation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each partner participation record in a regulatory filing

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory filing in which this partner is participating

attributes.name: venture_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the joint venture partner participating in this regulatory filing

attributes.name: approval_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the approving contact for correspondence and audit verification purposes.

attributes.name: approval_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual from the partner organization who provided approval or signature for this filing. Required for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this partner formally approved or signed off on this regulatory filing. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance for material disclosures.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this partner for this regulatory filing. Tracks workflow progression through multi-party approval process required for joint submissions.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes from the partner regarding their participation in this filing, including conditions, reservations, or clarifications.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this filing participation record was first created in the compliance system.

attributes.name: partner_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the partner in the context of this specific regulatory filing. Operator submits on behalf of JV, Non-Operator reviews and approves, Government Partner may have special reporting rights.

attributes.name: signatory_flag

domains.name: hse
domains.description: Manages Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance including incident reporting, permit-to-work (PTW), SIMOPS coordination, LDAR programs, NORM handling, H2S monitoring, GHG and ESG emissions tracking, spill reporting, environmental monitoring, and audit findings. Supports OSHA, EPA, BSEE, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 regulatory compliance. Integrates with Enablon HSE Management for audit and compliance workflows.

products.name: incident
products.description: Unified HSE event register serving as the single master record for all health, safety, and environmental events including safety observations, near-misses, first-aid cases, recordable injuries, illnesses, fatalities, spills, fires, explosions, process safety events (API RP 754 Tier 1/2), and behavioral observations. Captures event type, severity classification (OSHA recordable, lost-time, fatality, PSE tier), API RP 754 process safety indicator classification, location, date/time, initial description, H2S exposure flag, NORM involvement, loss of primary containment (LOPC) details, observer/reporter identity, immediate actions taken, and regulatory notification requirements. Supports behavior-based safety (BBS) programs, leading/lagging indicator tracking, and BSEE/OSHA incident reporting. Integrates with Enablon HSE Management incident reporting module. Serves as the SSOT for all HSE event data across the enterprise.

attributes.description: The business unit or division responsible for the facility where the incident occurred. Used for organizational reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: capa_count
attributes.description: Total number of corrective and preventive actions generated from this investigation. Used to track investigation thoroughness and action item management.

attributes.name: contributing_factors
attributes.description: Comprehensive description of all contributing factors identified during the investigation. Includes environmental conditions, equipment conditions, human factors, and organizational factors that contributed to the incident.
attributes.references: API RP 754 Process Safety Incident Investigation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investigation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: equipment_failure_analysis
attributes.description: Technical analysis of any equipment, machinery, or system failures that contributed to or resulted from the incident. Includes failure modes, maintenance history review, and design deficiencies.

attributes.name: evidence_collected
attributes.description: Description of physical evidence, photographs, video recordings, witness statements, documents, and other materials collected during the investigation.

attributes.name: external_consultant_name
attributes.description: Name of the external consulting firm or expert organization engaged to support the investigation, if applicable.

attributes.name: external_consultant_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether external subject matter experts or consulting firms were engaged to support the investigation.

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the investigation findings including key conclusions, identified causes, and high-level recommendations. Used for management reporting and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: human_factors_analysis
attributes.description: Analysis of human performance factors including fatigue, workload, competency, communication failures, situational awareness, and decision-making that contributed to the incident.
attributes.references: OSHA Human Factors in Incident Investigation

attributes.name: immediate_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the immediate or proximate causes that directly led to the incident. Captures the events or conditions immediately preceding the incident.

attributes.name: investigation_closure_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation was officially closed after all corrective actions were verified and documentation finalized.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: investigation_completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation was formally completed and findings documented. Used to track compliance with regulatory investigation timelines.

attributes.name: investigation_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigation Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for conducting the investigation including labor, external consultants, testing, analysis, and travel expenses. Reported in USD.

attributes.name: investigation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique investigation reference number assigned by the HSE management system. Format: INV-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: investigation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the investigation based on incident severity, potential consequences, and regulatory requirements. Determines resource allocation and timeline expectations.

attributes.name: investigation_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the complete investigation report document stored in the document management system. Provides access to detailed findings, evidence, and supporting documentation.

attributes.name: investigation_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the formal investigation was initiated. Regulatory requirements often mandate investigation start within specific timeframes after incident occurrence.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the investigation in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from initiation through completion and closure.

attributes.name: investigation_team_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of investigation team member names or identifiers. Includes subject matter experts, safety personnel, operations representatives, and other stakeholders involved in the investigation.

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigation depth and scope. Determines the rigor and methodology applied based on incident severity and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: BSEE Incident Investigation and Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Key lessons learned from the investigation that should be communicated across the organization to prevent similar incidents. Supports continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

attributes.name: management_review_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation findings were formally reviewed by management. Used to track governance and oversight compliance.

attributes.name: management_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings require formal review and approval by senior management or executive leadership.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this investigation record. Supports audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this investigation record was last updated. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: procedural_deficiencies
attributes.description: Documentation of any inadequate, missing, or poorly followed procedures, work instructions, or operating guidelines identified during the investigation.

attributes.name: rca_methodology
attributes.description: The structured root cause analysis methodology applied during the investigation. Common methods include TapRoot, Bow-Tie, 5-Why, Fishbone (Ishikawa), Fault Tree Analysis, and Barrier Analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: taproot|bow_tie|five_why|fishbone|fault_tree|barrier_analysis|change_analysis|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 754 Process Safety Performance Indicators

attributes.name: recommendations_summary
attributes.description: Summary of all recommendations made by the investigation team to prevent recurrence. Links to detailed corrective and preventive action records.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investigation findings require formal notification to regulatory authorities such as OSHA, BSEE, EPA, or state agencies.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submission_date
attributes.description: The date when the investigation report was submitted to regulatory authorities. Used to track compliance with mandatory reporting timelines.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory investigation report has been submitted to the appropriate authorities.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the fundamental or systemic root causes identified through the RCA methodology. Describes the underlying organizational, procedural, or systemic failures that allowed the incident to occur.

attributes.name: systemic_causes
attributes.description: Description of systemic or organizational causes such as inadequate management systems, insufficient training programs, poor safety culture, or deficient procedures that enabled the incident.

attributes.name: witness_count
attributes.description: Total number of witnesses interviewed during the investigation. Used to assess investigation thoroughness.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, team, or organizational unit assigned ownership and accountability for completing the corrective action.

attributes.name: responsible_party_email

attributes.description: Level of work authorization or permit authority granted upon successful completion of this training (e.g., Confined Space Entrant, Hot Work Authorized, BOP Operator).

products.name: hazardous_substance
products.description: Master record for hazardous chemicals, NORM materials, and facility-level chemical inventories at oil and gas operations. Captures substance identity (name, CAS number, chemical family, physical state), hazard properties (flash point, H2S content, OSHA hazard classification), NORM-specific attributes (radionuclide type Ra-226/Ra-228/Pb-210, activity level pCi/g or Bq/kg, NORM classification), regulatory thresholds (EPA CERCLA reportable quantity, SARA Title III Tier II threshold), SDS reference, and facility-level inventory data (maximum/average daily quantity, storage type, storage location, reporting year). Supports OSHA HazCom, EPA SARA Title III Section 312 Tier II reporting to SERCs/LEPCs, PHMSA hazardous materials compliance, and state radiation control program NORM requirements.
products.reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom / EPA SARA Title III

attributes.name: hazardous_substance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hazardous substance master record. Primary key for the hazardous substance entity.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the oil and gas facility where this hazardous substance is stored, used, or handled. Links to facility master data for location-specific inventory and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: feedstock_id

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master.
