attributes.name: petroleum_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.petroleum_product. Business justification: Petroleum products classified as hazardous substances require integrated management linking product specifications to SDS, SARA Title III reporting, OSHA hazard communication, and emergency response p

attributes.name: product_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to petrochemical.product_catalog. Business justification: Petrochemical products (ethylene, benzene, toluene, xylene) are hazardous substances. GHS classification, SDS management, and regulatory reporting (TRI, Tier II) require linking products to hazardous

attributes.name: activity_level_bq_per_kg
attributes.description: Radioactivity concentration of NORM material measured in becquerels per kilogram (Bq/kg). International System of Units (SI) measurement for NORM classification.
attributes.references: IAEA Safety Standards, State Radiation Control Programs

attributes.name: activity_level_pci_per_g
attributes.description: Radioactivity concentration of NORM material measured in picocuries per gram (pCi/g). Used to determine regulatory classification and disposal requirements.
attributes.references: State Radiation Control Programs, EPA 40 CFR 192

attributes.name: average_daily_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: Average amount of the substance present at the facility per day during the reporting year, measured in pounds. Required for EPA SARA Title III Tier II reporting.

attributes.name: carcinogen_classification
attributes.description: Cancer hazard classification from authoritative sources (e.g., IARC Group 1 Known Human Carcinogen, NTP Known to be Human Carcinogen, OSHA Select Carcinogen). Critical for worker protection and medical surveillance programs.
attributes.references: IARC Monographs, NTP Report on Carcinogens, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1003

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique numerical identifier assigned by the Chemical Abstracts Service to chemical substances for regulatory tracking and SDS cross-reference.

attributes.name: chemical_family
attributes.description: Broad classification of the chemical substance by molecular structure or functional group (e.g., hydrocarbons, alcohols, acids, amines, sulfides).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hazardous substance record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Approved disposal or treatment method for the substance or its waste (e.g., incineration, landfill, recycling, neutralization, licensed NORM disposal facility). Must comply with federal and state waste regulations.

attributes.name: emergency_response_procedure
attributes.description: Summary of emergency response actions for spills, leaks, or exposures involving this substance. References facility emergency response plans and SDS Section 6 (Accidental Release Measures).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120, EPA 40 CFR 112, Facility Emergency Response Plan

attributes.name: epa_cercla_reportable_quantity_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA) Reportable Quantity (Pounds)
attributes.description: Threshold quantity in pounds above which a release of this substance must be reported to the National Response Center under CERCLA Section 103. Null if substance is not a CERCLA hazardous substance.

attributes.name: exposure_limit_mg_per_m3
attributes.description: OSHA Permissible Exposure Limit (PEL) or ACGIH Threshold Limit Value (TLV) for airborne concentration, measured in milligrams per cubic meter. Used for industrial hygiene monitoring and worker protection.

attributes.name: exposure_limit_ppm
attributes.description: OSHA Permissible Exposure Limit (PEL) or ACGIH Threshold Limit Value (TLV) for airborne concentration, measured in parts per million. Used for industrial hygiene monitoring and worker protection.

attributes.name: flash_point_f
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the substance will ignite in the presence of an ignition source, measured in degrees Fahrenheit. Critical for flammability classification and storage requirements.

attributes.name: ghs_pictogram_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GHS pictogram codes (e.g., GHS02 Flame, GHS06 Skull and Crossbones, GHS08 Health Hazard) required on labels and SDS.

attributes.name: h2s_content_ppm
attributes.description: Concentration of hydrogen sulfide gas in the substance measured in parts per million. Critical for sour gas/crude handling, worker safety, and OSHA exposure monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hazardous substance record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: maximum_daily_quantity_lbs
attributes.description: Maximum amount of the substance present at the facility on any single day during the reporting year, measured in pounds. Required for EPA SARA Title III Tier II reporting.

attributes.name: nfpa_704_flammability_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 704 Flammability Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 flammability hazard rating on a scale of 0 (will not burn) to 4 (extremely flammable). Used for emergency response and facility hazard communication signage.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for the Identification of the Hazards of Materials for Emergency Response

attributes.name: nfpa_704_health_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 704 Health Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 health hazard rating on a scale of 0 (minimal hazard) to 4 (severe hazard). Used for emergency response and facility hazard communication signage.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for the Identification of the Hazards of Materials for Emergency Response

attributes.name: nfpa_704_instability_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 704 Instability Rating
attributes.description: NFPA 704 instability (reactivity) hazard rating on a scale of 0 (stable) to 4 (may detonate). Used for emergency response and facility hazard communication signage.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for the Identification of the Hazards of Materials for Emergency Response

attributes.name: nfpa_704_special_hazard
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 704 Special Hazard
attributes.description: NFPA 704 special hazard symbols: W (reacts with water), OX (oxidizer), SA (simple asphyxiant), COR (corrosive). Used for emergency response and facility hazard communication signage.
attributes.references: NFPA 704 Standard System for the Identification of the Hazards of Materials for Emergency Response

attributes.name: norm_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the material based on radionuclide activity levels: non-NORM (no detectable radioactivity), NORM-exempt (below regulatory thresholds), NORM-regulated (above thresholds, requires controls), NORM-licensed (requires state radiation control program license).
attributes.references: State Radiation Control Programs, EPA 40 CFR 192, IAEA Safety Standards

attributes.name: osha_hazard_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Hazard Classification
attributes.description: OSHA Globally Harmonized System (GHS) hazard classification codes for the substance (e.g., Flammable Liquid Category 2, Acute Toxicity Category 3, Carcinogen Category 1A).

attributes.name: phmsa_hazard_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Hazard Class
attributes.description: Department of Transportation (DOT) hazard class and division for transportation of the substance (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 2.1 Flammable Gas, Class 6.1 Toxic Substance).
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR 172, DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical form of the substance under normal storage and handling conditions at the facility.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Required personal protective equipment for handling the substance (e.g., chemical-resistant gloves, safety goggles, respirator, flame-resistant clothing). Derived from SDS Section 8 (Exposure Controls/Personal Protection).

attributes.name: radionuclide_type
attributes.description: Specific radioactive isotopes present in NORM materials (e.g., Ra-226, Ra-228, Pb-210, Po-210) commonly found in oil and gas scale, sludge, and produced water.
attributes.references: State Radiation Control Programs, EPA 40 CFR 192

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the inventory quantities and regulatory reporting data apply. Tier II reports are submitted annually by March 1 for the previous calendar year.

attributes.name: sara_title_iii_section_313_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA) Title III Section 313 Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substance is listed as a toxic chemical subject to annual Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) reporting under EPCRA Section 313.

attributes.name: sara_title_iii_tier_ii_threshold_lbs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act (SARA) Title III Tier II Threshold (Pounds)
attributes.description: Threshold quantity in pounds above which the substance must be reported on annual Tier II inventory reports to State Emergency Response Commissions (SERCs) and Local Emergency Planning Committees (LEPCs) under EPCRA Section 312.

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier or document control number for the current Safety Data Sheet (formerly MSDS) for this substance, used for document management and regulatory compliance verification.

attributes.name: sds_manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer, importer, or responsible party listed on the Safety Data Sheet for the substance.

attributes.name: sds_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision of the Safety Data Sheet. OSHA requires SDS to be updated within three months of new hazard information becoming available.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage area, tank, warehouse, or containment unit within the facility where the substance is kept (e.g., Tank 101, Chemical Storage Building A, Drum Storage Yard).

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Type of containment or storage system used for the substance at the facility, relevant for spill prevention and emergency response planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bulk_tank|drum|tote|cylinder|pipeline|underground_storage_tank|aboveground_storage_tank — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: substance_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the substance at the facility: active (in use), discontinued (no longer used but may have residual inventory), restricted (use limited by internal policy), banned (prohibited by regulation or company policy).

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit identification number assigned by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods for hazardous materials transportation (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline, UN1075 for LPG).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, PHMSA 49 CFR 172

attributes.name: waste_code
attributes.description: EPA hazardous waste code(s) if the substance or its residues are regulated as hazardous waste under RCRA (e.g., D001 Ignitable, F037 Petroleum Refinery Primary Oil/Water/Solids Separation Sludge). Used for waste characterization and disposal.

products.name: chemical_inventory
products.description: Facility-level chemical inventory record tracking quantities of hazardous chemicals stored and used at oil and gas facilities. Captures facility, storage location, hazardous substance, maximum daily quantity, average daily quantity, storage type (above-ground tank, underground tank, container), physical and health hazard flags, and reporting year. Supports EPA SARA Title III Section 312 Tier II annual chemical inventory reporting to state emergency response commissions (SERCs) and local emergency planning committees (LEPCs).
products.reference: EPA SARA Title III Section 312 Tier II Reporting

attributes.name: chemical_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chemical inventory record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the oil and gas facility where the chemical is stored. Links to facility master data.

attributes.name: hazardous_substance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hse.hazardous_substance. Business justification: Chemical inventory records are facility-specific instances of hazardous substances from the master substance catalog. Business reality: Tier II reporting and chemical inventory management reference ma

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Chemical inventory reconciliation requires linkage to material master for accurate stock tracking, automated reorder triggers, regulatory threshold monitoring (Tier II reporting), and consistency betw

attributes.name: petchem_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to petrochemical.plant. Business justification: Chemical inventories are facility-specific. SARA Title III Tier II reporting requires plant-level chemical inventory submission to SERC, LEPC, and fire departments annually.

attributes.name: primary_chemical_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the HSE personnel or system user who created this chemical inventory record in the Enablon HSE Management system.

attributes.name: average_daily_quantity
attributes.description: Average amount of the hazardous chemical present at the facility during the reporting year. Calculated as the sum of daily quantities divided by the number of days the chemical was present.

attributes.name: confidential_location_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the specific storage location is withheld from public disclosure under trade secret provisions. Must be justified to EPA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this chemical inventory record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: ehs_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical is classified as an Extremely Hazardous Substance under SARA Title III Section 302. EHS chemicals trigger additional emergency planning requirements.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility contact person for emergency response related to this chemical. Required for Tier II reporting.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency phone number for the facility contact person. Must be accessible to first responders.

attributes.name: fire_department_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date the Tier II report was submitted to the local fire department for emergency response planning. Annual deadline is March 1.

attributes.name: hazard_category
attributes.description: Primary hazard category classification for Tier II reporting: fire hazard, sudden release of pressure, reactive, immediate (acute) health hazard, or delayed (chronic) health hazard.

attributes.name: health_hazard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical presents health hazards such as toxicity, carcinogenicity, corrosivity, or sensitization per OSHA Hazard Communication Standard.

attributes.name: inventory_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the chemical inventory record, typically assigned by the facility or HSE system. Used for external reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current status of the chemical inventory at the facility. Active indicates ongoing storage, depleted indicates consumed, transferred indicates moved to another facility, disposed indicates waste disposal.

attributes.name: last_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or verification of the chemical quantity at the facility.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this chemical inventory record was last modified. Tracks changes for regulatory audit purposes.

attributes.name: lepc_submitted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Local Emergency Planning Committee (LEPC) Submitted Date
attributes.description: Date the Tier II report was submitted to the Local Emergency Planning Committee. Annual deadline is March 1.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the chemical manufacturer or supplier as listed on the Safety Data Sheet.

attributes.name: maximum_daily_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum amount of the hazardous chemical present at the facility on any single day during the reporting year. Reported in pounds or gallons depending on physical state.

attributes.name: mixture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical is a pure substance or a mixture of multiple components. Mixtures require reporting of hazardous constituents.

attributes.name: physical_hazard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical presents physical hazards such as flammability, explosivity, reactivity, or oxidizing properties per OSHA Hazard Communication Standard.

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical state of the chemical under normal storage conditions at the facility.

attributes.name: product_identifier
attributes.description: Manufacturer's product code or identifier for the specific chemical formulation. Used to match inventory to SDS.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the chemical quantities reported. Tier II reporting typically uses pounds for solids and gallons for liquids.

attributes.name: regulatory_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments related to regulatory compliance, exemptions, or special reporting considerations for this chemical inventory.

attributes.name: reporting_threshold_exceeded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chemical quantity exceeds the Tier II reporting threshold (10,000 pounds for most chemicals, 500 pounds or Threshold Planning Quantity for EHS chemicals).

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this chemical inventory is reported to regulatory authorities. Tier II reporting is annual.

attributes.name: sds_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Safety Data Sheet on file for this chemical. SDS must be current and accessible to workers.

attributes.name: serc_submitted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Emergency Response Commission (SERC) Submitted Date
attributes.description: Date the Tier II report was submitted to the State Emergency Response Commission. Annual deadline is March 1.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific location within the facility where the hazardous chemical is stored (e.g., tank farm, warehouse, process unit, storage yard).

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Type of storage vessel or container used for the hazardous chemical. Critical for emergency response planning and spill containment.

products.name: safety_observation
products.description: Safety observation and near-miss record capturing field-level safety observations reported by workers and supervisors. Captures observation type (unsafe act, unsafe condition, near-miss, positive observation), observer identity, observation date, location, description of observed behavior or condition, immediate action taken, risk severity rating, and follow-up action required flag. Supports behavior-based safety (BBS) programs and leading indicator tracking per API RP 754.

attributes.name: equipment_id

attributes.name: hse_risk_assessment_id

attributes.name: pipeline_segment_id

attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor who reported the safety observation. Links to workforce or personnel master data.

attributes.name: tertiary_safety_verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual who verified closure of the observation and effectiveness of corrective actions.

attributes.name: well_asset_id

attributes.name: actual_closure_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the observation was closed after verification that corrective actions were completed and effective.

attributes.name: attachments_count
attributes.description: Count of supporting documents, photographs, or other evidence files attached to the observation record in the HSE management system.

attributes.name: bbs_program_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this observation was captured as part of a formal behavior-based safety program. True if part of BBS program.
attributes.references: API RP 754 Process Safety Performance Indicators

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or operating division responsible for the facility or operation where the observation was made (e.g., upstream E&P, midstream, downstream refining).

attributes.name: closure_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that corrective actions were implemented and effective before closing the observation (e.g., field inspection, photographic evidence, supervisor sign-off).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the safety observation record was first created in the HSE management system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: follow_up_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether additional follow-up corrective action is required beyond the immediate action taken. True if further action is needed.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or operational area where the observation occurred, used for regional HSE performance tracking and benchmarking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: observation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the safety observation was made in the field. This is the business event date, distinct from system record timestamps.

attributes.name: observation_description

attributes.name: observation_number

attributes.name: observation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the safety observation in the workflow: open (newly reported), under review (being assessed), action assigned (corrective action initiated), closed (resolved), or cancelled.

attributes.name: observation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the safety observation occurred, supporting shift-level and time-of-day analysis for behavior-based safety programs.

attributes.name: observation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety observation: unsafe act (behavior-based), unsafe condition (physical hazard), near-miss (potential incident), positive observation (safe behavior recognition), stop work authority exercise, or general hazard identification.
attributes.references: API RP 754, ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Management

attributes.name: observer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who made the safety observation. Classified as restricted PII for confidentiality in behavior-based safety programs.

attributes.name: observer_role
attributes.description: Job role or position of the observer at the time of observation (e.g., field operator, supervisor, safety officer, contractor).
attributes.references: API RP 754 Process Safety Performance Indicators

attributes.name: permit_to_work_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated permit to work if the observation was made during permitted work activities. Links to PTW system for cross-reference.
attributes.references: API RP 754, OSHA Process Safety Management

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the observation involves a condition or near-miss that meets regulatory reporting thresholds to OSHA, BSEE, EPA, or other authorities. True if reportable.
attributes.references: OSHA Recordkeeping Requirements, BSEE Incident Reporting, EPA Release Reporting

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or supervisor assigned responsibility for addressing the observation.

attributes.name: risk_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the likelihood or probability that the observed hazard could result in an incident. Rated using standard risk assessment terminology.

attributes.name: risk_matrix_score
attributes.description: Numerical risk score calculated from the risk matrix combining severity and likelihood ratings. Used for prioritization of corrective actions.

attributes.name: risk_severity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the potential severity of consequences if the observed hazard or unsafe condition were to result in an incident. Rated as low, medium, high, or critical based on risk matrix methodology.

attributes.name: stop_work_authority_exercised

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the observation and any required corrective actions should be resolved and closed, based on risk priority.

attributes.name: work_activity
attributes.description: Description of the work activity or operation being performed at the time of the observation (e.g., drilling operations, hot work, confined space entry, lifting operations).

products.name: ldar_inspection
products.description: This association product represents the inspection event between an LDAR survey and an individual equipment component. It captures the specific inspection details for each component examined during a survey, including measurement readings, leak detection results, and inspector observations. Each record links one LDAR survey to one component with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific inspection.. products.name: incident_substance_involvement
products.description: This association product represents the involvement of hazardous substances in HSE incidents. It captures the operational reality that incidents can involve multiple hazardous substances (e.g., a multi-chemical spill, exposure to multiple NORM materials) and that each substance can be involved in multiple incidents over time. Each record links one incident to one hazardous_substance with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement: quantity released, exposure levels, personnel affected, containment methods, and regulatory threshold breach status. This is a first-class operational entity used for EPCRA Section 313 release reporting, RMP accident history documentation, substance-specific risk profiling, and ESG reporting of cumulative releases by chemical.. Existence Justification: In oil and gas HSE operations, incidents routinely involve multiple hazardous substances simultaneously (e.g., a wellhead blowout releasing crude oil, H2S gas, and NORM-contaminated produced water; a tank battery fire involving multiple stored chemicals). Conversely, each hazardous substance is involved in multiple incidents over time, requiring cumulative release tracking for EPCRA Section 313 reporting and substance-specific risk profiling. HSE managers actively manage these incident-substance relationships as operational records during incident investigation, documenting substance-specific release quantities, exposure levels, containment methods, and regulatory threshold breaches.

attributes.name: cost_center_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: days_overdue

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: escalation_contact

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_days

attributes.name: esg_category

attributes.name: event_reference_number

attributes.name: event_status

attributes.name: event_type

attributes.name: extended_due_date

attributes.name: extension_granted

attributes.name: form_type

attributes.name: ghg_related

attributes.name: owner_department

attributes.name: penalty_exposure_usd

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: recurrence_end_date

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern

attributes.name: regulatory_authority

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the regulatory reporting period covered by this compliance event. Together with reporting_period_start, defines the data window for which the regulatory submission or action applies.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the regulatory reporting period covered by this compliance event (e.g., beginning of the fiscal quarter for SEC filings, start of the calendar year for EPA GHG reports, beginning of the OPEC quota period).

attributes.name: scheduled_date

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: submission_method

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Supports SOX internal controls, ESG reporting, and regulatory closure documentation.

attributes.name: violation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each regulatory violation, notice of violation (NOV), or non-compliance finding record. Primary key for the violation data product.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility, asset, or operational site where the violation occurred or was identified (e.g., refinery, offshore platform, pipeline segment, well pad).

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific physical asset (equipment, pipeline, well, vessel) directly associated with the violation, as tracked in Maximo Asset Management.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management

EPA enforcement actions and state notices of violation reference lab results as evid

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date the formal appeal was filed with the regulatory authority or administrative review body. Null if no appeal has been filed. Used to track appeal deadlines and statute of limitations.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC Administrative Appeals Procedures

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Status of any formal appeal filed against the violation finding or assessed penalty: not_appealed, appeal_filed (submitted to authority), appeal_pending (under review), appeal_granted (violation or penalty reduced/dismissed), appeal_denied, or appeal_withdrawn.
attributes.references: EPA Administrative Procedures; BSEE Appeals; OSHA Review Commission; FERC Appeals; SEC Administrative Proceedings

attributes.name: capa_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Completion Date
attributes.description: Actual date the CAPA plan was fully implemented and all corrective actions were completed. Null if CAPA is still in progress. Compared against capa_target_date to assess timeliness of corrective response.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: capa_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan developed to address the root cause of the violation and prevent recurrence. Includes specific corrective steps, process changes, and preventive measures.
attributes.references: ISO 45001; ISO 14001; API RP 75; Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: capa_effectiveness_review
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Effectiveness Review
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the implemented CAPA has been effective in preventing recurrence of the violation: not_started, in_progress (review underway), effective (no recurrence observed), partially_effective (improvement noted but not fully resolved), or ineffective (recurrence observed, additional action required).
attributes.references: ISO 45001; ISO 14001; API RP 75; Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: capa_responsible_party
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Responsible Party
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or organizational unit accountable for implementing the CAPA plan (e.g., Operations Manager, HSE Director, Facility Superintendent). Supports accountability tracking and SOX control ownership.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 45001; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: capa_target_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Target Date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for full implementation of the CAPA plan. Used to monitor corrective action progress against regulatory response deadlines and internal compliance milestones.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: capa_verification_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Verification Method
attributes.description: Description of the method used to verify that the CAPA has been effectively implemented (e.g., regulatory inspection, internal audit, third-party verification, monitoring data review, management walkthrough). Required for regulatory closure documentation.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; ISO 45001; ISO 14001; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date the violation was formally closed by the regulatory authority or verified as resolved through internal compliance review. Null if the violation remains open. Used for regulatory closure documentation and ESG reporting.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM Closure Procedures; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the violation record was first created in the compliance management system (Enablon HSE Management or SAP S/4HANA). Supports audit trail, SOX internal controls, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: Date the violation was first identified, whether through regulatory inspection, internal audit, self-disclosure, or monitoring system alert. Distinct from the date the NOV was formally issued. Critical for calculating response timelines and regulatory reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: EPA Compliance Monitoring; BSEE Inspection Program; OSHA Inspection; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: discovery_source
attributes.description: Source through which the violation was identified: regulatory_inspection (government inspector), internal_audit (company HSE or compliance audit), self_disclosure (voluntary company disclosure to regulator), monitoring_system (SCADA/PI System automated alert), third_party_audit (independent auditor), or employee_report (internal report or near-miss notification).
attributes.references: EPA Self-Disclosure Policy; BSEE Inspection Program; OSHA; Enablon HSE Management; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date the non-compliant condition or activity ceased, either through corrective action or regulatory determination. Null if the violation is ongoing. Used with violation_start_date to calculate total duration of non-compliance.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA Enforcement Procedures

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation is related to Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions reporting, monitoring, or control requirements. True if GHG-related; False otherwise. Supports ESG reporting, EPA GHG Reporting Program compliance, and carbon disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98); ESG Reporting Frameworks; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: internal_reference_number
attributes.description: Company-assigned internal tracking number for the violation record, used for cross-referencing with SAP S/4HANA compliance modules and Enablon HSE Management case management.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Management Standard; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or internal audit function that issued the violation or non-compliance finding (e.g., EPA, BSEE, OSHA, PHMSA, FERC, BOEM, SEC, state environmental agency, internal HSE audit). Used for regulatory correspondence routing and authority-specific reporting.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; SEC; OPEC; API

attributes.name: issuing_authority_type
attributes.description: Classification of the issuing authority jurisdiction: federal (EPA, BSEE, OSHA, PHMSA, FERC, BOEM, SEC), state (state environmental or safety agency), local (municipal authority), international (OPEC, foreign regulator), or internal_audit (company internal compliance or HSE audit finding).
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; SEC

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or regulatory jurisdiction in which the violation occurred and is being adjudicated (e.g., US state code such as TX, LA, AK, or country code such as USA, GBR, NGA). Supports multi-jurisdictional compliance reporting and OPEC quota compliance tracking.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; BOEM; FERC; PHMSA; OPEC; ISO 3166

attributes.name: nov_issue_date
attributes.description: Date the Notice of Violation (NOV) or formal non-compliance finding was officially issued by the regulatory authority or internal audit function. Used to calculate regulatory response deadlines and statute of limitations.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM Enforcement Procedures

attributes.name: nov_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned Notice of Violation (NOV) number or citation reference issued by the regulatory authority. Serves as the official government-assigned identifier for the violation. Used for regulatory correspondence and closure documentation.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM Enforcement Procedures

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary penalty assessed by the regulatory authority for the violation, in the currency specified by penalty_currency. Null if no monetary penalty has been assessed. Used for financial exposure tracking, CAPEX/OPEX impact analysis, and SEC disclosure assessment.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; BSEE Civil Penalties; OSHA Penalty Schedule; PHMSA Penalty Policy; FERC Civil Penalties; SEC Enforcement; COPAS; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: penalty_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the assessed penalty amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international regulatory jurisdictions.

attributes.name: penalty_paid_date
attributes.description: Date the monetary penalty was paid in full or the final installment was remitted to the regulatory authority. Null if payment has not been completed. Used for financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA FI module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; COPAS; IFRS/GAAP; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: penalty_payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the assessed monetary penalty: not_assessed (no penalty levied), assessed_unpaid (penalty issued but not yet paid), partially_paid, paid_in_full, waived (penalty formally waived by authority), or under_appeal (payment suspended pending appeal outcome).
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC Civil Penalty Procedures; COPAS; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the operating permit, environmental permit, or license whose conditions were violated (e.g., air permit, NPDES permit, BSEE operating permit, BOEM lease permit). Links the violation to the specific permit instrument in the compliance permit register.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES; BSEE Operating Permit; BOEM Lease Permit; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: regulation_cited
attributes.description: Specific regulation, rule, statute, or standard cited in the violation (e.g., 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart OOOO, 30 CFR Part 250, 29 CFR 1910.119, 49 CFR Part 195, FERC Order 636, SOX Section 302/404). Enables regulatory citation tracking and trend analysis by rule.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; BSEE 30 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR; FERC; SEC SOX; BOEM 30 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: Name of the specific regulatory program or framework under which the violation was cited (e.g., Clean Air Act Title V, NPDES Stormwater, BSEE SEMS, OSHA PSM, PHMSA Integrity Management, SEC Regulation S-K, FERC Gas Tariff, BOEM OCSLA). Enables program-specific compliance trend analysis.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; SEC; API RP 75

attributes.name: repeat_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this violation is a repeat occurrence of a previously cited violation at the same facility or for the same regulation within the lookback period defined by the issuing authority. True if repeat; False if first occurrence. Repeat violations typically attract enhanced penalties under EPA, OSHA, and BSEE enforcement policies.
attributes.references: EPA Penalty Policy; OSHA Repeat Violation Policy; BSEE Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the violation record: open (newly identified, no action taken), in_progress (corrective action underway), closed (fully resolved and verified), appealed (formal appeal filed with authority), contested (company disputes the finding), pending_verification (corrective action completed, awaiting regulatory confirmation). Drives compliance calendar and SOX control reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; BSEE Enforcement; EPA Compliance Assurance; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the company must submit a formal response, corrective action plan, or abatement plan to the issuing authority. Drives compliance calendar alerts and SOX control monitoring.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM Enforcement Procedures; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the violation as determined through investigation (e.g., equipment failure, procedural non-compliance, human error, inadequate training, design deficiency, management system gap). Supports corrective action planning and recurrence prevention.
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001; Enablon HSE Management; OSHA Process Safety Management

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized category of the root cause for trend analysis and systemic issue identification: equipment_failure, human_error, procedural (non-compliance with procedure), management_system (gap in management system), design_deficiency, or external_factor (weather, third-party action).
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001; ISO 14001; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: sec_disclosure_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Disclosure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation meets the materiality threshold requiring disclosure in SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K) under SEC Regulation S-K Item 103 (legal proceedings) or other applicable disclosure requirements. True if disclosure is required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the violation indicating its potential impact on operations, environment, safety, or regulatory standing. Critical: immediate threat to life, environment, or operations; Major: significant regulatory exposure; Moderate: notable non-compliance; Minor: administrative or procedural; Informational: observation only.
attributes.references: BSEE Enforcement Policy; EPA Penalty Policy; OSHA Violation Classification; API RP 75

attributes.name: sox_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SOX internal control or control objective that was impacted or tested as a result of this violation. Used for SOX Section 302/404 compliance documentation and internal control deficiency reporting.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/404; PCAOB Auditing Standards; SAP S/4HANA GRC

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date the non-compliant condition or activity began, as determined by investigation or regulatory finding. Used to calculate duration of non-compliance and assess penalty exposure under per-day penalty frameworks (e.g., EPA Clean Air Act, PHMSA).
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act; PHMSA 49 CFR; BSEE 30 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the violation record in the compliance management system. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: High-level domain category of the violation: environmental (emissions, spills, waste), safety (HSE/OSHA), financial (SEC/SOX/COPAS), operational (production, process), reporting (regulatory filings), or permitting (permit/license compliance). Supports ESG reporting and compliance dashboard segmentation.
attributes.references: EPA; OSHA; SEC; COPAS; BSEE; ISO 14001; ISO 45001

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the non-compliant condition, activity, or omission as stated in the NOV or internal audit finding. Includes the specific regulatory requirement that was not met and the observed deviation.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM NOV Documentation Standards

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the violation by its nature: regulatory citation (specific rule breach), permit condition (permit term exceeded), license condition, reporting failure (missed or inaccurate filing), operational exceedance (production/emission limit exceeded), safety violation, environmental exceedance, or financial reporting non-compliance. attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; API RP 75

products.name: compliance_corrective_action

Tracks action description, responsible party, target completion date, actual completion date, verification method, effectiveness review, and linkage to the originating violation or audit finding. Supports regulatory closure documentation.

attributes.name: compliance_corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the corrective and preventive action (CAPA) record. Primary key for the corrective_action data product. [Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER]

attributes.description: Identifier of the facility, installation, or asset location where the violation or compliance gap occurred and where the corrective action is being implemented (e.g., offshore platform, refinery, pipeline segment, processing plant).

Real business process: remediation services contracting. Links CAPA to master service agreement when corrective a

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_master. Business justification: Corrective actions requiring specific materials or parts (replacement valves, safety equipment). Real business process: corrective action materials planning. Links CAPA to specific material when equip

attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory permit or license record associated with this corrective action, when the action is required to maintain permit compliance or restore permit conditions (e.g., air permit, discharge permit, drilling permit).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 585; PHMSA 49 CFR

attributes.name: primary_compliance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual (employee or contractor) assigned as the primary owner accountable for executing and completing the corrective action. Links to the workforce or personnel master. Required for regulatory closure documentation.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; API RP 75; ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Corrective actions requiring equipment or materials trigger purchase orders. Real business process: corrective action procurement execution. Links CAPA to specific PO when materials/equipment purchase

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Corrective actions often require vendor services (remediation contractors, equipment suppliers, consulting engineers). Real business process: corrective action execution via procurement. Links CAPA to

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo Asset Management work order created to execute the physical or maintenance activities required by this corrective action (e.g., equipment repair, LDAR survey, BOP inspection). Links compliance management to asset maintenance execution.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; API RP 75; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; ISO 55001:2014

attributes.name: action_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific corrective or preventive action to be taken, including the scope of work, methodology, and expected outcome. Supports regulatory closure documentation and audit evidence packages.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the corrective action record. Drives compliance calendar tracking and regulatory closure documentation. Transitions: open → in_progress → pending_verification → closed. Overdue is a system-flagged state when target completion date is exceeded.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: action_title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the corrective action. Used as the primary display label in compliance dashboards, regulatory submissions, and management reports.

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the action as corrective (addressing a known violation or nonconformance), preventive (proactively eliminating potential causes), immediate (emergency interim measure), systemic (root-cause-driven process change), or regulatory_directed (mandated by a regulatory authority such as BSEE, EPA, or PHMSA).
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; API RP 75; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corrective action was fully implemented and all required activities were completed. Compared against target_completion_date to assess timeliness and regulatory compliance. Null until the action is completed.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: actual_cost_usd
attributes.description: Actual total cost in US dollars incurred to implement the corrective action upon completion. Compared against estimated_cost_usd for budget variance analysis and financial reporting. Null until the action is completed and costs are finalized.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; IFRS/GAAP; COPAS; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: capa_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the corrective and preventive action record. Used in regulatory submissions, audit correspondence, and government reporting. Format: CAPA-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; API RP 75; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, management commentary, or contextual information related to the corrective action that does not fit into structured fields. Supports audit trail documentation and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: compliance_domain
attributes.description: Business compliance domain to which this corrective action belongs, enabling cross-domain analytics and portfolio management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hse|environmental|financial|operational|safety|pipeline|offshore|reserves|process_safety|esg — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; SOX; SEC Regulation S-K; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this corrective action record was first created in the data system. Distinct from initiated_timestamp which reflects the business event time. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the effectiveness review was conducted to assess whether the corrective action successfully prevented recurrence of the violation or compliance gap. Typically performed 30-90 days after action closure.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; API RP 75; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_notes
attributes.description: Narrative documentation of the effectiveness review findings, including evidence of recurrence prevention, residual risks identified, and any follow-up actions recommended. Supports regulatory audit evidence packages.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; API RP 75; BSEE SEMS II; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: effectiveness_review_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the post-implementation effectiveness review assessing whether the corrective action successfully eliminated the root cause and prevented recurrence. Supports continuous improvement tracking and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; API RP 75; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: esg_category
attributes.description: ESG reporting category to which this corrective action contributes, enabling aggregation for ESG disclosures, sustainability reports, and investor reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: environmental|social|governance|safety|ghg_emissions|spill|waste|biodiversity|human_rights — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ESG Reporting Frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD); EPA 40 CFR; ISO 14001:2015; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: estimated_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total cost in US dollars to implement the corrective action, including labor, materials, contractor services, and equipment. Used for CAPEX/OPEX budgeting, AFE preparation, and financial reporting under SOX and IFRS/GAAP.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; IFRS/GAAP; COPAS; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; API RP 75

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility or installation where the corrective action is being implemented. Retained directly on the record for regulatory reporting and correspondence where the facility master may not be accessible.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the corrective action was formally initiated and entered into the compliance management system. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Used to calculate response time against regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this corrective action record. Supports change tracking, SOX internal controls, and regulatory audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 7.5; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the corrective action based on regulatory risk, safety impact, and potential penalty exposure. Critical actions typically involve imminent regulatory deadlines or safety-critical systems (e.g., BOP integrity, H2S exposure controls).
attributes.references: API RP 75; BSEE SEMS II; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 6.1; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corrective action addresses a recurring violation or compliance gap that has previously been subject to a corrective action. Recurrence triggers escalated regulatory scrutiny and may indicate systemic management system failure under BSEE SEMS II.
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS II; API RP 75; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory body or governing authority whose requirement, inspection finding, or directive triggered or is associated with this corrective action (e.g., BSEE for offshore safety, EPA for environmental violations, PHMSA for pipeline safety, OSHA for workplace safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BSEE|EPA|PHMSA|OSHA|FERC|BOEM|SEC|OPEC|API|STATE|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR; FERC 18 CFR; BOEM 30 CFR Part 585

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory code, rule, or standard citation that was violated or is being addressed by this corrective action (e.g., '30 CFR 250.1920', '40 CFR 60.18', '49 CFR 195.452'). Used in regulatory correspondence and closure documentation.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; FERC 18 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally acknowledged and accepted the closure of the corrective action, confirming that all regulatory requirements have been satisfied. Null until regulatory closure is confirmed.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: regulatory_closure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal regulatory closure documentation must be submitted to a regulatory authority (e.g., BSEE, EPA, PHMSA) upon completion of this corrective action. Drives the compliance calendar and submission workflow.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline_date
attributes.description: Externally mandated deadline imposed by a regulatory authority (e.g., BSEE, EPA, PHMSA) for completion of the corrective action. Distinct from the internal target_completion_date. Breach of this date may result in penalties, fines, or escalated enforcement action.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or tracking identifier assigned by the regulatory authority upon submission of the corrective action plan or closure documentation (e.g., BSEE incident number, EPA enforcement case number, PHMSA corrective action order number).
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit accountable for executing the corrective action (e.g., HSE, Drilling, Production, Refining, Regulatory Affairs). Used for workload distribution reporting and compliance performance analytics.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; API RP 75; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 5.3

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned as the primary owner accountable for executing and completing the corrective action. Retained directly on the record for regulatory reporting and audit documentation where the workforce system may not be accessible.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the root cause type to enable trend analysis and systemic improvement tracking across the compliance portfolio. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_factor|process_failure|equipment_failure|management_system|regulatory_gap|environmental|design_deficiency|contractor_performance — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; BSEE SEMS II; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the identified root cause(s) of the violation, nonconformance, or compliance gap that necessitated this corrective action. Derived from root cause analysis (RCA) methodologies such as 5-Why or fishbone analysis.
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 10.2; Enablon HSE Management; BSEE SEMS II

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the corrective action must be fully implemented and verified. May be set by internal management or mandated by a regulatory authority as part of a Notice of Violation (NOV) or Consent Order response deadline.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the verification activity was performed to confirm effective implementation of the corrective action. Required for regulatory closure packages submitted to BSEE, EPA, PHMSA, or other authorities.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; API RP 75

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the corrective action has been effectively implemented. Options include physical inspection, internal audit, functional test, document review, field observation, or independent third-party audit as required by regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; API RP 75; BSEE SEMS II; Enablon HSE Management

products.name: regulatory_audit
products.description: Master record of regulatory audits and inspections conducted by government agencies or internal compliance teams, including individual findings. Tracks audit type (BSEE inspection, EPA audit, OSHA inspection, internal SOX audit), auditing authority, facility or asset audited, audit date range, lead auditor, scope, overall audit outcome, and detailed findings (specific deficiency, regulation cited, risk classification, recommended corrective action, responsible party, resolution status). Distinct from HSE incident records — this captures formal compliance audit events and their outcomes.
products.reference: BSEE SEMS Audit, EPA Compliance Evaluation Inspection, OSHA Programmed Inspection

attributes.name: regulatory_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory audit or inspection record in the compliance domain. Primary key for the regulatory_audit data product.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, asset, or operational unit subject to the audit (e.g., offshore platform, refinery, pipeline segment, processing plant, well). Links the audit to the physical asset being inspected for asset-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; Maximo Asset Management — Asset Registry

attributes.name: audit_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: Regulatory audit services procured via service contracts with auditing firms. Real business process: audit services contracting. Links audit to master service agreement for recurring audit services.

attributes.name: auditing_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: External regulatory audits conducted by third-party auditing firms tracked as vendors. Real business process: regulatory audit services procurement. Replaces text auditing_authority with FK to vendor

attributes.name: compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.certification. Business justification: Regulatory audits are often performed to verify certifications (e.g., ISO audits, SEMS audits). The certification table has last_audit_date and next_audit_date suggesting audits are performed ON certi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Audit preparation, response, and penalty costs are allocated to facility or compliance cost centers for budget tracking and variance analysis. Essential for tracking penalty_amount and remediation cos

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Official identifier of the lead auditor — government badge/credential number for agency inspectors, or employee ID for internal auditors. Supports verification of auditor credentials and chain-of-custody for audit documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1903.7; BSEE Inspector Credentialing; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: applicable_regulation
attributes.description: Primary regulatory citation or standard under which the audit is conducted (e.g., '30 CFR Part 250', '40 CFR Part 60', '29 CFR 1910.119', '49 CFR Part 195', 'SOX Section 404', 'API RP 75'). Provides the legal basis for the audit and its findings.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1926; PHMSA 49 CFR; SOX; API Standards

attributes.name: audit_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory audit or inspection formally concluded. Nullable for audits still in progress. Used to compute audit duration and trigger post-audit reporting deadlines.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA Audit Policy; OSHA 29 CFR 1903; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: audit_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the audit by the governing agency or internal compliance team (e.g., BSEE inspection number, EPA audit case number, OSHA citation number, internal SOX audit ID). Used for cross-referencing with agency records and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: BSEE Inspection Program; EPA Audit Policy; OSHA Inspection Reference; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: audit_report_number
attributes.description: Official document number of the formal audit report issued by the auditing authority or internal compliance team. Used for document management, regulatory correspondence, and records retention compliance. Distinct from the audit_reference_number which is the case/inspection identifier.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management — Document Management; BSEE Inspection Report Numbering; SOX Section 404 Audit Report

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the regulatory areas, operational processes, systems, or equipment covered by the audit (e.g., 'Well control equipment and BOP testing procedures', 'Air emissions monitoring and LDAR program', 'Pipeline integrity management program', 'SOX IT general controls — SAP S/4HANA FI module'). Defines the boundaries of the audit engagement.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR Part 63; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; SOX Section 404; API RP 75

attributes.name: audit_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory audit or inspection formally commenced. Used to calculate audit duration, track compliance calendar obligations, and support regulatory reporting timelines.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA Audit Policy; OSHA 29 CFR 1903; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the regulatory audit record, from scheduling through final closure. Drives compliance calendar management and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management — Audit Lifecycle; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit or inspection by the type of regulatory authority or internal program conducting it. Drives applicable regulatory framework, citation standards, and reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BSEE_INSPECTION|EPA_AUDIT|OSHA_INSPECTION|PHMSA_INSPECTION|FERC_AUDIT|BOEM_INSPECTION|INTERNAL_SOX|INTERNAL_HSE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1926; PHMSA 49 CFR; FERC 18 CFR; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cited_regulation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory citation, code section, or standard violated as identified in the finding (e.g., '30 CFR 250.440(a)', '40 CFR 60.18(c)', '29 CFR 1910.119(e)(1)', 'API RP 14C Section 4.2'). Provides the legal basis for each individual finding and drives citation-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1926; PHMSA 49 CFR; API Standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the corrective action was completed and verified. Compared against corrective_action_due_date to assess timeliness of remediation. Required for regulatory closure submissions and SOX control effectiveness documentation.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; SOX Section 404; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the corrective action for the finding must be completed, as stipulated by the regulatory agency or internal compliance policy. Drives compliance calendar management and escalation triggers for overdue remediation items.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; SOX Section 404 Remediation Timeline

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current resolution status of the corrective action for the finding. OVERDUE status triggers escalation to compliance management and potential regulatory notification. Supports compliance dashboard reporting and audit closure tracking.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management — Corrective Action Tracking; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; SOX Section 404 Remediation Status; EPA Audit Resolution Policy

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the audited facility or operation is located (e.g., USA, GBR, NOR, SAU). Supports multinational compliance reporting, ESG disclosures, and country-level regulatory obligation tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SEC Regulation S-K; ESG Reporting Frameworks (GRI, SASB Oil & Gas Standard)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory audit record was first created in the compliance management system. Supports audit trail integrity, SOX internal control documentation, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail Requirements; Enablon HSE Management — Record Audit; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: critical_finding_count
attributes.description: Number of findings classified as critical or high-risk severity within this audit. Critical findings typically require immediate corrective action and executive notification. Supports risk-based compliance prioritization and SEC/BSEE mandatory disclosure assessments.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; SOX Section 302 Material Weakness Definition; API RP 75

attributes.name: esg_category
attributes.description: ESG pillar classification of the audit for sustainability and ESG reporting purposes. Environmental audits cover GHG emissions, LDAR, spill prevention. Social audits cover OSHA safety, workforce. Governance audits cover SOX, FCPA, financial controls. Supports ESG disclosure obligations under SEC climate rules, GRI, and SASB Oil & Gas Standard.
attributes.references: SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; GRI Standards; SASB Oil & Gas Exploration & Production Standard; ISO 14001; ISO 45001; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the facility, asset, or operational unit subject to the audit (e.g., 'Thunder Horse PDQ Platform', 'Baytown Refinery', 'Gulf Coast Pipeline Segment 7'). Retained for reporting and audit trail clarity independent of the facility master record.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; API RP 75

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audited facility or asset by operational category. Determines applicable regulatory standards and inspection protocols. FPSO = Floating Production Storage and Offloading. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OFFSHORE_PLATFORM|ONSHORE_WELL|REFINERY|PIPELINE|PROCESSING_PLANT|TERMINAL|FPSO|PETROCHEMICAL_PLANT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; API RP 75

attributes.name: finding_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual findings, deficiencies, or observations identified during the audit. Provides a summary metric for audit severity assessment and compliance trend analysis without requiring aggregation of the findings detail records.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management — Audit Finding Tracking; SOX Section 404 Deficiency Reporting

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific deficiency, non-conformance, or observation identified during the audit. Includes the nature of the violation, the condition observed, and the regulatory requirement that was not met. Core field for corrective action planning and regulatory response.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; EPA Audit Finding Documentation; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; SOX Section 404 Deficiency Description

attributes.name: finding_risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk severity level assigned to the individual finding based on potential safety, environmental, financial, or regulatory impact. CRITICAL findings may require immediate shutdown or regulatory notification. Drives corrective action prioritization and escalation protocols per HSE and SOX frameworks.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; SOX Section 302 Material Weakness vs. Significant Deficiency; API RP 75; ISO 45001

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit involves greenhouse gas emissions compliance, including methane emissions monitoring, GHG reporting under EPA 40 CFR Part 98, or carbon capture and storage (CCS) program compliance. Supports ESG reporting and SEC climate disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 (GHG Reporting Rule); SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; ESG Reporting Frameworks; ISO 14001

attributes.name: h2s_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit involves H2S (Hydrogen Sulfide) safety compliance, including detection systems, emergency response plans, and worker protection measures. H2S is a critical safety hazard in oil and gas operations subject to OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 and API RP 55.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 (PSM); API RP 55 H2S Safety; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250 Subpart D; ANSI/ASSE Z390.1

attributes.name: is_repeat_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the finding is a recurrence of a previously identified deficiency at the same facility or for the same regulatory requirement. Repeat findings typically attract enhanced regulatory scrutiny, higher penalties, and mandatory escalation under BSEE, EPA, and OSHA enforcement policies.
attributes.references: BSEE Repeat Violation Policy; EPA Audit Resolution Policy — Repeat Violations; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; SOX Section 404 Repeat Deficiency

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the regulatory audit record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, SOX internal control documentation, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse architecture.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail Requirements; Enablon HSE Management — Record Audit; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: lead_auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary auditor or inspector responsible for conducting the audit. For government inspections, this is the agency inspector of record. For internal audits, this is the lead internal auditor. Required for audit trail integrity and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1903.7; BSEE Inspection Program; SOX Section 404; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: norm_related
attributes.business_glossary_term: Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material (NORM) Related Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit involves NORM (Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material) compliance, which is a specific regulatory concern in oil and gas production operations. NORM findings require specialized handling, disposal, and regulatory reporting under EPA and state radiation control programs.
attributes.references: EPA NORM Guidance; NRC Regulations; State Radiation Control Programs; API RP 7H1 NORM Management

attributes.name: overall_outcome
attributes.description: The aggregate result or conclusion of the audit as determined by the auditing authority. Drives escalation, enforcement action, and executive compliance reporting. A VIOLATION_ISSUED outcome triggers mandatory corrective action tracking and potential regulatory penalty assessment.
attributes.references: BSEE Inspection Outcome Classification; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; OSHA Citation and Penalty Procedures; SOX Section 302/404 Deficiency Classification

attributes.name: penalty_amount
