attributes.description: Monetary penalty or fine assessed by the regulatory agency as a result of the audit findings, expressed in the reporting currency. Nullable when no financial penalty is assessed. Supports financial liability tracking, CAPEX/OPEX impact analysis, and SEC disclosure obligations for material regulatory penalties.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.1400; EPA 40 CFR Part 19; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.15; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 190; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: penalty_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multinational operations where penalties may be assessed in local currency. Supports financial consolidation and IFRS/GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS/GAAP Financial Reporting Standards; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: penalty_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the assessed regulatory penalty must be paid to the governing agency. Drives accounts payable scheduling and financial liability management. Nullable when no penalty is assessed.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.1400; EPA 40 CFR Part 19; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.15; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 190

attributes.name: prior_audit_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the prior audit in which the same or related finding was previously identified. Used to establish repeat-finding linkage for regulatory enforcement escalation and trend analysis. Nullable for first-occurrence findings.
attributes.references: BSEE Repeat Violation Policy; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; OSHA Repeat Citation Standards

attributes.name: recommended_corrective_action
attributes.description: Narrative description of the corrective action recommended by the auditor to remediate the identified finding. May be prescribed by the regulatory agency or proposed by the internal compliance team. Forms the basis for the corrective action plan (CAP) and regulatory response submissions.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; SOX Section 404 Remediation; Enablon HSE Management — Corrective Action Module

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic or legal jurisdiction under which the audit is conducted (e.g., 'Federal — Gulf of Mexico OCS', 'State — Texas Railroad Commission', 'Federal — EPA Region 6', 'International — North Sea UKCS'). Determines applicable regulatory framework and reporting obligations for multinational operations.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; EPA Regional Authority; FERC 18 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: The specific regulatory program or rule set under which the audit is conducted (e.g., 'SEMS — Safety and Environmental Management System', 'LDAR — Leak Detection and Repair', 'Pipeline Integrity Management', 'SEC Reserves Disclosure', 'OPEC Quota Compliance', 'ESG Reporting'). Maps the audit to the governing compliance framework.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250 Subpart S (SEMS); EPA 40 CFR Part 63 (LDAR); PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10; OPEC Production Quota Framework; ISO 14001

attributes.name: report_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal audit report was officially issued by the auditing authority or internal compliance team. Triggers response deadlines and corrective action plan submission timelines under applicable regulatory frameworks.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the company must submit a formal written response or corrective action plan to the auditing authority. Calculated from report_issued_date per applicable regulatory requirements. Drives compliance calendar management and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 190; FERC 18 CFR

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the company submitted its formal written response or corrective action plan to the auditing authority. Compared against response_due_date to assess regulatory response timeliness and compliance with submission deadlines.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250.193; EPA Audit Resolution Policy; OSHA 29 CFR 1903.19; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 190

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, team, or organizational unit accountable for implementing the corrective action for the finding. Typically the operations manager, HSE manager, or process owner for the audited facility or function.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management — Responsibility Assignment; SOX Section 302 Management Certification; API RP 75 SEMS Responsibility Matrix

products.name: compliance_audit_finding
products.description: Individual findings identified during a regulatory audit or compliance inspection. Each finding records the specific deficiency or observation, applicable regulation or standard cited, risk classification, recommended corrective action, responsible party, and resolution status. Links to the parent regulatory audit and may generate corrective action records.
products.reference: BSEE SEMS Audit Finding, ISO 14001 Nonconformity, SOX Control Deficiency

attributes.name: compliance_audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual audit finding record within the compliance domain. Serves as the primary key for this entity. [Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER]
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SOX Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational facility, installation, or asset location where the finding was identified (e.g., offshore platform, refinery unit, pipeline segment, processing plant). Enables geographic and asset-level compliance analytics.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent regulatory audit or compliance inspection from which this finding was generated. Links the finding to its originating audit event.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee, contractor, or organizational unit accountable for implementing the corrective action for this finding. Supports accountability tracking and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls Framework; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment, well, pipeline, or physical asset associated with the finding. Links to the asset management system (Maximo) for maintenance and integrity tracking.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; ISO 55001 Asset Management; API RP 580

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SOX internal control identifier that this finding relates to, if applicable. Links compliance findings to the financial controls framework for SOX Section 302/404 reporting and internal audit purposes.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302 and 404; COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SEC Financial Reporting

attributes.name: actual_penalty_usd
attributes.description: Actual monetary penalty assessed by the regulatory agency for this finding, in US dollars. Populated after enforcement action is finalized. Supports financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP and SOX disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; BSEE Civil Penalties; PHMSA Civil Penalties; OSHA Penalty Structure; IFRS/GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: audit_finding_source
attributes.description: Origin of the finding: regulatory_inspection (government agency), internal_audit (company-initiated), third_party_audit (external certification body), self_assessment (operational self-check), incident_investigation (post-incident review), management_review (leadership review). Supports audit program analytics.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 14001; ISO 45001; API RP 75; BSEE; EPA

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the auditor or inspector who identified and documented this finding. May be an internal compliance officer, external regulatory inspector (e.g., BSEE inspector), or third-party auditor.
attributes.references: BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or agency the auditor represents (e.g., BSEE, EPA, internal HSE department, third-party certification body). Distinguishes regulatory inspections from internal audits.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The organizational business unit or division responsible for the area where the finding was identified (e.g., Upstream E&P, Refining, Petrochemicals, Supply Chain, Midstream). Supports organizational compliance performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Internal Controls Framework; ESG Reporting

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the finding was formally closed after verification that the corrective action was completed and effective. Null if the finding remains open.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls Framework; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the recommended or planned corrective action to address the finding. Includes specific remediation steps, process changes, or engineering controls required to achieve compliance.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring; ISO 14001

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the finding was identified. Determines applicable regulatory framework (e.g., USA for BSEE/EPA/OSHA, GBR for NSOAF, NOR for PSA Norway). Supports multinational compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; BSEE; EPA; BOEM; FERC; PHMSA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this audit finding record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and SOX data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls Framework; NIST Cybersecurity Framework; ISO 55001 Asset Management

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the corrective action or remediation for this finding must be completed. Used for compliance calendar tracking and overdue escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the facility or installation where the finding was identified. Retained as a denormalized field for regulatory submissions and compliance reports.
attributes.references: BSEE; BOEM; PHMSA; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: Business domain or functional category of the finding (e.g., HSE, Production Operations, Financial Controls, Environmental Compliance, Pipeline Integrity, Offshore Safety). Enables cross-domain analytics and trend reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hse|environmental|financial_controls|production_operations|pipeline_integrity|offshore_safety|land_lease|joint_venture|asset_management|workforce — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE; EPA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; SOX

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific deficiency, non-conformance, observation, or violation identified during the audit. Includes factual evidence and context observed by the auditor.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this finding, formatted as AF-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in regulatory correspondence, corrective action plans, and government submissions.
attributes.references: BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring; API RP 75

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audit finding: open (newly identified), in_progress (corrective action underway), pending_verification (remediation submitted, awaiting confirmation), closed (fully resolved and verified), overdue (past due date without resolution), disputed (finding contested by responsible party).
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; SOX Internal Controls Framework; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement

attributes.name: finding_title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the nature of the audit finding or deficiency identified during the regulatory inspection or compliance review.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: finding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the finding by its nature: non_conformance (clear violation), observation (potential issue), opportunity_for_improvement (best practice gap), major_finding (significant regulatory breach), minor_finding (minor deviation), positive_finding (commendable practice). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_conformance|observation|opportunity_for_improvement|major_finding|minor_finding|positive_finding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; API RP 75

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding relates to greenhouse gas emissions, carbon reporting, or climate-related regulatory compliance (e.g., EPA GHG reporting, LDAR violations, flaring non-compliance). Supports ESG and CCS reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 GHG Reporting; ESG Reporting Frameworks; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: Regulatory agency or standards body that issued the regulation or standard cited in the finding (e.g., BSEE, EPA, OSHA, PHMSA, FERC, BOEM, SEC, API, ISO). Supports regulatory reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BSEE|EPA|OSHA|PHMSA|FERC|BOEM|SEC|API|ISO|COPAS|SPE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: BSEE; EPA; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; SEC; API; ISO 14001; ISO 45001; COPAS

attributes.name: hse_impact_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Impact Category
attributes.description: Classification of the HSE impact domain of the finding: safety (personnel safety), health (occupational health), environmental (emissions, spills, NORM), process_safety (PSM/SIMOPS), security (physical/cyber), no_impact (administrative finding). Supports ESG and HSE reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; API RP 75; OSHA PSM; EPA; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the audit finding was formally identified and documented during the inspection or audit. Represents the principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; SOX Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: potential_penalty_usd
attributes.description: Estimated monetary penalty exposure in US dollars associated with this finding if not remediated within the required timeframe. Used for financial risk assessment, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and SOX financial controls disclosure.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; BSEE Civil Penalties; PHMSA Civil Penalties; OSHA Penalty Structure; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: prior_finding_number
attributes.description: Finding number of the previous occurrence if this is a repeat finding. Enables traceability of recurring non-conformances and supports escalation decisions by regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory code, standard, or rule cited as the basis for the finding (e.g., 30 CFR Part 250, 40 CFR Part 60, OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119, API RP 14C, PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195). Directly links the finding to the applicable legal or industry standard.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; FERC 18 CFR; API Standards

attributes.name: regulation_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the regulation, standard, or governing body requirement cited in the finding (e.g., 'Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals', 'National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants'). Complements the citation code for readability.
attributes.references: BSEE; EPA; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; API; ISO 14001; ISO 45001

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the finding or associated violation notice was formally submitted to the relevant regulatory agency. Null if no submission is required or submission has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: BSEE; EPA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; SEC Reserves Disclosure

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding requires formal submission or notification to a regulatory agency (e.g., BSEE incident report, EPA violation notice, PHMSA safety report). Drives compliance calendar and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; EPA 40 CFR; PHMSA 49 CFR; FERC 18 CFR; BOEM

attributes.name: repeat_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a recurrence of a previously identified deficiency at the same facility or for the same regulation. Repeat findings carry elevated regulatory risk and may trigger enforcement escalation by BSEE, EPA, or OSHA.
attributes.references: BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; EPA Compliance Monitoring; OSHA Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual, team, or organizational unit responsible for resolving the audit finding. Retained as a denormalized field for reporting and regulatory submissions where the workforce record may not be accessible.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement; SOX Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk severity level assigned to the finding based on potential impact to safety, environment, regulatory compliance, or financial integrity. Critical findings require immediate escalation per HSE and regulatory protocols.
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; BSEE Safety and Environmental Management Systems; EPA Risk Management

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Identified root cause of the deficiency or non-conformance as determined through root cause analysis (RCA). Supports systemic improvement and recurrence prevention in HSE and compliance programs.
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; Enablon HSE Management; OSHA Process Safety Management

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trend analysis across findings: human_factor, process_failure, equipment_failure, management_system, training_deficiency, design_deficiency.
attributes.references: API RP 75; ISO 45001; OSHA Process Safety Management; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to this audit finding record. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls Framework; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the corrective action was verified as complete and effective by the designated verifier. Distinct from the closed_date, which is the formal administrative closure date.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify that the corrective action has been effectively implemented: document_review, physical_inspection, interview, testing, observation, third_party_audit. Required for closure of findings under ISO 14001 and ISO 45001.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or authority who verified that the corrective action was completed and the finding is eligible for closure. May be an internal compliance officer or external regulatory inspector.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; ISO 14001; ISO 45001; BSEE Inspection and Enforcement

products.name: compliance_sec_reserves_disclosure
products.description: Transactional record of SEC-mandated proved reserves disclosures filed annually under SEC Rule 4-10. Captures 1P (proved), 2P, and 3P reserve quantities by category (PDP, PUD, PDNP), commodity type (oil, gas, NGL), geographic region, and reporting period. Tracks SEC filing reference, independent engineer certification, revision history, and PRMS classification alignment. Supports annual 10-K and 20-F filings.
products.reference: SEC Rule 4-10(a), SPE PRMS, SEC Form 10-K Item 2

attributes.name: compliance_sec_reserves_disclosure_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Reserves Disclosure ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SEC reserves disclosure record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Entity Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete annual regulatory filing event with a clear lifecycle (draft → submitted → accepted → amended → superseded).

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (company or subsidiary) responsible for this SEC reserves disclosure filing. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE linking to the organizational master. Required for consolidated vs. subsidiary-level reporting under SEC Rule 4-10.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10; SOX Section 302; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: SEC reserves disclosures are regulatory filings submitted to the SEC under Rule 4-10. The sec_reserves_disclosure table has filing_reference_number, filing_date, and form_type which duplicate regulato

attributes.name: crude_grade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crude_grade. Business justification: SEC reserves reporting requires crude grade classification (light/heavy, sweet/sour) for proved reserves categorization. Critical for 10-K filings and standardized measure calculations per SEC Regulat

attributes.name: independent_engineer_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Independent petroleum engineers certifying reserves are vendors providing reserves certification services. Real business process: SEC reserves audit services procurement. Replaces text independent_eng

attributes.name: product_price_history_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_history. Business justification: SEC requires 12-month average pricing for standardized measure calculations in 10-K reserves disclosures. Links specific price records used for proved reserves valuation per Regulation S-X Rule 4-10.

attributes.name: acquisitions_quantity
attributes.description: Reserves added through property acquisitions during the reporting period, expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Required component of the SEC reserves rollforward table per Regulation S-K Item 1203.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203(a)(4); SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential amendment number for this disclosure record (0 = original filing; 1 = first amendment; 2 = second amendment, etc.). Supports version control and audit trail for SEC filing amendments (10-K/A or 20-F/A).
attributes.references: SEC EDGAR Amendment Filing Requirements; SOX Section 302/906; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: as_of_date
attributes.description: The effective date as of which proved reserves quantities are estimated and reported, typically December 31 of the reporting year per SEC Rule 4-10 requirements.

attributes.name: boe_conversion_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Conversion Factor
attributes.description: The conversion factor used to express gas reserves in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE). Industry standard is 6 Mcf per BOE, but companies may use alternative factors. Required for cross-commodity comparability in SEC filings.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10; API RP 2556; SPE-PRMS 2018; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The hydrocarbon commodity type for which reserves are being disclosed: oil (crude oil), gas (natural gas), NGL (Natural Gas Liquids), condensate, or synthetic oil. SEC Rule 4-10 requires separate disclosure by commodity type.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the jurisdiction where the reserves are located (e.g., USA, GBR, NGA). Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping and OPEC quota compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202; BOEM; BSEE

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reserves disclosure record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: disclosure_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the reserves disclosure record. Tracks progression from internal preparation through SEC acceptance and any subsequent amendments. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.

attributes.name: divestiture_quantity
attributes.description: Reserves removed due to property divestitures and sales during the reporting period, expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Required component of the SEC reserves rollforward table per Regulation S-K Item 1203.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203(a)(5); SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: eur_quantity
attributes.description: The Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) for the associated reserves, representing the total quantity of hydrocarbons expected to be economically recovered over the life of the property. Expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Supports SEC supplemental disclosures and investor analytics.
attributes.references: SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202; API Standards

attributes.name: extensions_discoveries_quantity
attributes.description: Reserves additions from extensions of existing proved areas and new field discoveries during the reporting period, expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Required component of the SEC reserves rollforward table per Regulation S-K Item 1203.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203(a)(3); SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: field_name
attributes.description: The name of the oil or gas field, reservoir, or producing area to which these reserves are attributed. Used for field-level reserves aggregation, SEC geographic disclosure, and alignment with Schlumberger Petrel reservoir models.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202; SPE-PRMS 2018; Schlumberger Petrel; Landmark DecisionSpace

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or country where the reserves are located (e.g., USA, GBR, NGA, SAU). SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202 requires disclosure of proved reserves by geographic area. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or defined regional groupings.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(2); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; BOEM Offshore Leasing Regulations

attributes.name: independent_engineer_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserves estimate for this disclosure record has been certified or audited by a qualified independent petroleum engineer or engineering firm, as required or elected under SEC Rule 4-10 and Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(7).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(7); SPE Petroleum Engineering Standards; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: internal_engineer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company's internal qualified petroleum engineer or technical person primarily responsible for overseeing the reserves estimation process, as required to be disclosed under SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(7).
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(7); SPE Petroleum Engineering Standards

attributes.name: joint_venture_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserves are held under a joint venture, joint operating agreement (JOA), or production sharing agreement (PSA/PSC). Joint venture reserves require proportional consolidation or equity method treatment per IFRS 11 and SEC guidance.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10; IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements; JOA Standards; SAP Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest
attributes.description: The company's net revenue interest percentage (decimal fraction, e.g., 0.875000 = 87.5%) in the reserves being disclosed. NRI determines the company's share of production revenue after deducting royalties and burdens. Critical for SEC net reserves calculation.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(16); SPE-PRMS 2018; Quorum Land System; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: offshore_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reserves are located in an offshore environment (True) or onshore (False). Offshore reserves are subject to BSEE and BOEM regulatory oversight in addition to SEC disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: BSEE Offshore Safety Regulations; BOEM Offshore Leasing; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: price_benchmark
attributes.description: The commodity price benchmark or index used as the basis for the 12-month average price calculation (e.g., WTI = West Texas Intermediate, Brent = ICE Brent Crude, Henry_Hub = Henry Hub Natural Gas). Required for transparency in SEC reserves pricing methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WTI|Brent|Henry_Hub|LLS|ANS|Dubai|custom — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(22)(v); FERC Natural Gas Pricing; API Price Reporting

attributes.name: prior_year_quantity
attributes.description: The beginning-of-period proved reserves quantity (i.e., the prior year's ending balance) used as the opening balance in the SEC reserves rollforward reconciliation table per Regulation S-K Item 1203. Expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203; SPE-PRMS 2018; SFAS 69 / ASC 932-235

attributes.name: prms_classification
attributes.description: The SPE-PRMS 2018 resource classification for this disclosure: Reserves (commercial, technically recoverable), Contingent Resources (discovered but not yet commercial), or Prospective Resources (undiscovered). SEC Rule 4-10 aligns with PRMS Reserves classification.
attributes.references: SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Rule 4-10(a)(22); SPE Technical Standards

attributes.name: production_quantity
attributes.description: Total production volumes extracted during the reporting year for the specified commodity and region, expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Deducted from beginning reserves in the SEC rollforward reconciliation per Regulation S-K Item 1203.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203(a)(2); SPE-PRMS 2018; Avocet Production Operations

attributes.name: proved_reserves_quantity
attributes.description: The net proved reserves quantity for the specified commodity type, reserve subcategory, and geographic region as of the as-of date. Expressed in the unit defined by quantity_unit. This is the principal quantitative fact (QUANTITATIVE_RESULT) of this disclosure record.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(22); SPE-PRMS 2018 Section 2; SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202

attributes.name: psa_contract_type
attributes.description: The type of contractual arrangement governing the reserves: PSA = Production Sharing Agreement; JOA = Joint Operating Agreement; concession = traditional concession; service_contract = risk service contract; royalty_tax = royalty/tax regime. Affects reserves entitlement calculation methodology.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(1); SPE-PRMS 2018 Section 2.1.3; IFRS 6; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: pud_development_plan_year
attributes.description: For PUD reserves, the fiscal year in which development drilling or capital investment is scheduled to commence, per the company's five-year development plan. SEC Rule 4-10 requires PUD reserves to have a specific development plan within five years of initial booking.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(31)(ii); SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203(b); SPE-PRMS 2018

attributes.name: pud_years_booked
attributes.description: Number of consecutive years this PUD location has been carried in the proved undeveloped reserves category. SEC guidance limits PUD bookings to five years unless specific circumstances justify longer periods; this field supports compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(31)(ii); SEC CDI (Compliance and Disclosure Interpretations) on PUD; SPE-PRMS 2018

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the proved reserves quantity: MBBLS = Thousand Barrels (oil/NGL/condensate); MMBBLS = Million Barrels; BCFE = Billion Cubic Feet Equivalent (gas); MMCFE = Million Cubic Feet Equivalent; MBOE = Thousand Barrels of Oil Equivalent; MMBOE = Million Barrels of Oil Equivalent.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10; API Measurement Standards; SPE-PRMS 2018; COPAS Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) for which proved reserves are being disclosed. SEC Rule 4-10 mandates annual reserves disclosure as of December 31 of the reporting year.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a); SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202; SPE-PRMS 2018

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: SPE-PRMS reserves classification tier: 1P = Proved reserves (SEC-mandated minimum disclosure); 2P = Proved plus Probable; 3P = Proved plus Probable plus Possible. SEC Rule 4-10 requires 1P disclosure; 2P and 3P are supplemental.
attributes.references: SPE-PRMS 2018 Section 2; SEC Rule 4-10(a)(22); SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202

attributes.name: reserve_subcategory
attributes.description: Proved reserves development status subcategory: PDP = Proved Developed Producing (currently producing wells); PDNP = Proved Developed Non-Producing (completed but not producing); PUD = Proved Undeveloped (requires future capital investment). Required for SEC 10-K disclosure.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(6)(7)(31); SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(2)

attributes.name: reservoir_name
attributes.description: The specific reservoir or formation name within the field to which these reserves are attributed (e.g., Permian Wolfcamp, Eagle Ford Shale). Supports sub-field granularity for reservoir management and SEC supplemental disclosures.
attributes.references: SPE-PRMS 2018; Schlumberger Petrel Reservoir Modeling; Landmark DecisionSpace

attributes.name: revision_quantity
attributes.description: Net upward or downward revision to proved reserves quantities from the prior year's disclosure, expressed in the same unit as proved_reserves_quantity. Positive values indicate upward revisions; negative values indicate downward revisions. Required for SEC rollforward reconciliation.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203; SPE-PRMS 2018 Section 3; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary reason for reserves revisions during the reporting period (e.g., price revisions, performance revisions, technical reinterpretation, infill drilling results). Required for SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203 qualitative disclosure of material changes.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 1203(a); SPE-PRMS 2018; SEC Rule 4-10

attributes.name: standardized_measure_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flows (USD)
attributes.description: The SEC-mandated standardized measure of discounted future net cash flows from proved reserves, expressed in USD. Calculated using 12-month average first-day-of-month prices and a 10% annual discount rate per SFAS 69 / ASC 932. Required supplemental oil and gas disclosure.
attributes.references: SFAS 69 / ASC 932-235; SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10; IFRS 6; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: twelve_month_avg_price
attributes.description: The unweighted arithmetic average of the first-day-of-month commodity price for the 12 months of the reporting year, used as the SEC-mandated pricing basis for proved reserves estimation and standardized measure calculation. Expressed in USD per barrel (oil/NGL) or USD per Mcf (gas).
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(22)(v); SEC Regulation S-K Item 1202(a)(1); WTI/Henry Hub benchmarks

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this reserves disclosure record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for audit trail and change tracking purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: working_interest
attributes.description: The company's working interest percentage (decimal fraction, e.g., 0.500000 = 50%) in the property or lease associated with these reserves. WI represents the obligation to bear costs of exploration, development, and production.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 4-10(a)(32); SPE-PRMS 2018; Quorum Land System; JOA Standards

products.name: esg_report
products.description: Master record of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports and disclosures published by the company. Tracks reporting framework (GRI, SASB, TCFD, API ESG), reporting period, GHG emissions data (Scope 1, 2, 3), flaring volumes, water usage, spill counts, workforce safety metrics, and social investment figures. Supports investor relations, regulatory ESG mandates, and voluntary sustainability commitments.
products.reference: GRI Standards, SASB Oil and Gas Standard, TCFD Framework, API ESG Guidance

attributes.name: esg_report_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Report ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ESG report record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete, lifecycle-managed disclosure event with its own identity, workflow states, and audit trail.
attributes.references: GRI Standards; SASB Standards; TCFD Recommendations; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: assurance_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_contract. Business justification: ESG assurance services procured via service contracts with verification firms. Real business process: ESG assurance services contracting. Links ESG report to master service agreement for recurring ass

attributes.name: assurance_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: ESG report assurance providers (third-party verification firms) are vendors providing assurance services. Real business process: ESG assurance services procurement. Replaces text assurance_provider wi

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or organizational unit responsible for publishing this ESG report. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category. Links to the corporate entity master.
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021 GRI 2; SEC Regulation S-K; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: ESG reports are regulatory disclosures published for stakeholders and may be filed with regulatory bodies (e.g., SEC climate disclosure rules). The esg_report table already has regulatory_submission_i

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_counterparty. Business justification: ESG reports are published by legal entities (counterparties) for sustainability disclosure. Real process: tracking which counterparty published each ESG report for joint venture ESG reporting, operato

attributes.name: product_emission_factor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.emission_factor. Business justification: ESG reports calculate Scope 1/2/3 GHG emissions using product-specific emission factors (kg CO2e per barrel). Required for CDP, TCFD, and GRI disclosures linking emissions to product portfolios.

attributes.name: refined_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.refined_product. Business justification: ESG reports track carbon intensity, renewable content, benzene levels by refined product grade. Required for CDP, TCFD, and voluntary sustainability disclosures linking emissions to specific product p

attributes.name: reporting_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: ESG reports are published by legal entities (accounts) for sustainability disclosure. Real process: entity-level ESG reporting requires linking reports to accounts for consolidation, audit trails, and

attributes.name: assurance_level
attributes.description: Level of third-party assurance obtained for the ESG report. Limited assurance provides moderate confidence; reasonable assurance provides high confidence equivalent to a financial audit. Absence of assurance must be disclosed per GRI and TCFD guidance.
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021 GRI 5; ISAE 3000; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: The reference year against which GHG emissions reductions and intensity improvements are measured. Required by TCFD and SBTi to contextualize progress toward climate targets. Typically the year the company established its emissions reduction commitment.
attributes.references: TCFD Metrics and Targets; GHG Protocol; Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi); SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: board_oversight_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Board of Directors has formally reviewed and approved the ESG report and the company's climate-related governance disclosures. Required by TCFD governance pillar and SEC climate disclosure rules.
attributes.references: TCFD Recommendations — Governance Pillar; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; GRI 2-12; SOX

attributes.name: carbon_offset_mt
attributes.description: Total volume of verified carbon offset credits retired or applied during the reporting period, expressed in metric tonnes CO2e. Used to calculate net GHG emissions position. Offsets must be verified under recognized standards (e.g., Gold Standard, VCS/Verra).
attributes.references: TCFD Metrics and Targets; GHG Protocol; Gold Standard; Verra VCS; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ESG report record was first created in the system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: energy_consumption_gj
attributes.description: Total energy consumed from all sources (fuel combustion, purchased electricity, steam, and other energy) during the reporting period, expressed in gigajoules (GJ). Required by GRI 302-1 and SASB energy metrics for oil and gas operations.
attributes.references: GRI 302-1; SASB EM-EP-130a.1; API ESG Disclosure Framework; ISO 50001

attributes.name: esg_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the primary external ESG rating agency that assessed the company during the reporting period (e.g., MSCI, Sustainalytics, S&P Global CSA, CDP, ISS ESG). Used for investor relations and benchmarking purposes.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; API ESG Disclosure Framework; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: esg_rating_score
attributes.description: ESG rating or score assigned by the primary external rating agency for the reporting period (e.g., AAA, AA, A for MSCI; 0-100 for S&P CSA; A-F for CDP). Stored as STRING to accommodate varying agency scoring scales.
attributes.references: MSCI ESG Ratings; S&P Global CSA; CDP Scoring Methodology; Sustainalytics; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: fatality_count
attributes.description: Total number of work-related fatalities (employees and contractors) during the reporting period. A critical safety metric required by OSHA, GRI 403-9, and SASB. Zero fatalities is the industry target under Life-Saving Rules frameworks.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; GRI 403-9; SASB EM-EP-320a.1; API RP 97; IOGP Report 2019

attributes.name: flaring_volume_mmscf
attributes.description: Total volume of natural gas flared during the reporting period, expressed in million standard cubic feet (MMscf). Flaring is a critical environmental metric for oil and gas companies subject to BSEE, EPA, and World Bank Zero Routine Flaring initiative reporting requirements.
attributes.references: BSEE NTL 2016-N01; EPA 40 CFR Part 60; SASB EM-EP-110a.1; World Bank Zero Routine Flaring by 2030; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: ghg_intensity_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Intensity per Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: GHG emissions intensity expressed as metric tonnes CO2e per Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) produced during the reporting period. Normalizes absolute emissions against production volume, enabling peer benchmarking. Key metric per SASB EM-EP-110a.2 and API ESG framework.
attributes.references: SASB EM-EP-110a.2; API ESG Disclosure Framework; TCFD Metrics and Targets; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: lost_time_incident_rate
attributes.description: Lost Time Incident Rate (LTIR) for the reporting period, calculated as (number of lost time incidents × 200,000) / total hours worked. Measures incidents resulting in at least one day away from work. Reported per OSHA and API standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; API RP 97; GRI 403-9; SASB EM-EP-320a.1

attributes.name: methane_emissions_mt
attributes.description: Total methane (CH4) emissions from all sources during the reporting period, expressed in metric tonnes of CH4. Methane intensity is a key ESG metric for oil and gas companies tracked by SASB, API, and the Oil and Gas Methane Partnership (OGMP 2.0). Includes fugitive, vented, and combustion-related methane.
attributes.references: SASB EM-EP-110a.1; API Compendium; EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart W; OGMP 2.0; GRI 305-1

attributes.name: net_zero_target_year
attributes.description: The calendar year by which the company has committed to achieving net zero GHG emissions. Null if no net zero commitment has been made. Disclosed per TCFD strategy pillar and increasingly required by institutional investors and ESG rating agencies.
attributes.references: TCFD Recommendations; Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi); API ESG Disclosure Framework; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which the ESG report was officially published and made available to external stakeholders including investors, regulators, and the public.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K; GRI Standards 2021; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: renewable_energy_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total energy consumption sourced from renewable energy (solar, wind, hydro, geothermal, biomass) during the reporting period. Tracks progress toward clean energy transition commitments and ESG targets.
attributes.references: GRI 302-1; SASB; TCFD Metrics and Targets; API ESG Disclosure Framework; RE100

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the ESG report, formatted as ESG-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE} (e.g., ESG-2024-0001). Used in investor communications, regulatory submissions, and audit references. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: GRI Standards; SEC Regulation S-K; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ESG report. Tracks progression from internal drafting through external publication. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|under_review|approved|published|withdrawn|superseded — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GRI Standards; TCFD Recommendations; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ESG report by publication cadence and scope. Annual reports cover a full fiscal year; integrated reports combine financial and ESG disclosures; supplemental reports address specific topics such as climate or water.
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021 GRI 1; TCFD Recommendations; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: report_url
attributes.description: Publicly accessible URL where the published ESG report can be accessed by investors, regulators, and other stakeholders. Null for draft or internal reports not yet published.
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021; SEC Regulation S-K; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: reporting_framework
attributes.description: Primary sustainability reporting framework applied for this disclosure. Common frameworks in oil and gas include GRI (Global Reporting Initiative), SASB (Sustainability Accounting Standards Board), TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures), and API ESG Disclosure Framework. Multiple frameworks may apply; this field captures the primary one. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GRI|SASB|TCFD|API_ESG|CDP|ISSB|UNGC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021; SASB EM-EP-000; TCFD Recommendations 2017; API ESG Disclosure Framework 2020

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the reporting period covered by this ESG disclosure (typically December 31 of the fiscal year). Together with reporting_period_start defines the measurement boundary for all ESG metrics.
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021 GRI 1; SASB Standards; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: First day of the reporting period covered by this ESG disclosure (typically January 1 of the fiscal year). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (day-level precision for annual/semi-annual reports).
attributes.references: GRI Standards 2021 GRI 1; SASB Standards; TCFD Recommendations; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: scope1_ghg_emissions_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 1 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions (Metric Tonnes CO2e)
attributes.description: Total direct Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions from sources owned or controlled by the company during the reporting period, expressed in metric tonnes of CO2 equivalent (CO2e). Includes combustion of fuels in company-owned equipment, flaring, venting, and fugitive emissions. Required by EPA GHG Reporting Rule and SEC climate disclosure rules.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; GRI 305-1; SASB EM-EP-110a.1; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: scope2_ghg_emissions_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 2 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions (Metric Tonnes CO2e)
attributes.description: Total indirect GHG emissions from the generation of purchased electricity, steam, heat, or cooling consumed by the company during the reporting period, expressed in metric tonnes CO2e. Reported on both location-based and market-based methods per GHG Protocol.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance; GRI 305-2; SASB EM-EP-110a.1; EPA 40 CFR Part 98; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: scope3_ghg_emissions_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emissions (Metric Tonnes CO2e)
attributes.description: Total value-chain indirect GHG emissions not included in Scope 2, expressed in metric tonnes CO2e. For oil and gas, the dominant Scope 3 category is Category 11 (use of sold products — combustion of sold hydrocarbons by end customers). Voluntary under most frameworks but increasingly required by investors and regulators.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard; GRI 305-3; TCFD Recommendations; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: social_investment_usd
attributes.description: Total monetary value of voluntary social investment and community development expenditures during the reporting period, expressed in US dollars. Includes community programs, local content spending, education, and infrastructure contributions. Reported per GRI 413 and API ESG framework.
attributes.references: GRI 413-1; API ESG Disclosure Framework; SASB; ISO 26000

attributes.name: sox_controls_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the internal controls over ESG data collection and reporting have been verified as part of the SOX compliance program. Supports integration of ESG metrics into financial reporting internal control frameworks.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302 and 404; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; COSO Framework

attributes.name: spill_count
attributes.description: Total number of hydrocarbon spills to the environment (land or water) above the reportable threshold during the reporting period. Includes crude oil, refined products, and chemical spills. Required by BSEE, EPA, and PHMSA reporting obligations.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; EPA 40 CFR Part 112; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; GRI 306-3; SASB EM-EP-160a.1

attributes.name: spill_volume_bbls
attributes.description: Total volume of hydrocarbons spilled to the environment during the reporting period, expressed in barrels (bbls). Distinct from spill count — captures severity of spill events. Required by BSEE, EPA, and PHMSA.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; EPA 40 CFR Part 112; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; GRI 306-3; SASB EM-EP-160a.1

attributes.name: total_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked by all employees and contractors during the reporting period. Used as the denominator for calculating TRIR, LTIR, and other safety rate metrics. Required by OSHA and API safety reporting standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; API RP 97; GRI 403-9; SASB EM-EP-320a.1

attributes.name: total_workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of employees (full-time and part-time) employed by the reporting entity at the end of the reporting period. Excludes contractors unless otherwise noted. Required by GRI 2-7 and SASB social metrics.
attributes.references: GRI 2-7; SASB EM-EP-320a.1; SEC Regulation S-K Human Capital Disclosure

attributes.name: trir
attributes.description: Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) for the reporting period, calculated as (number of recordable incidents × 200,000) / total hours worked. Industry-standard OSHA safety metric reported per API RP 97 and required in ESG disclosures. Lower values indicate better safety performance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; API RP 97; GRI 403-9; SASB EM-EP-320a.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this ESG report record. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GRI Standards; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: venting_volume_mmscf
attributes.description: Total volume of natural gas intentionally vented to the atmosphere during the reporting period, expressed in million standard cubic feet (MMscf). Venting is separately tracked from flaring per EPA and BSEE requirements and is a key component of Scope 1 GHG emissions.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart W; BSEE; SASB EM-EP-110a.1; GRI 305-1

attributes.name: water_recycled_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of water recycled or reused within operations during the reporting period, expressed in cubic metres. Demonstrates water efficiency and circular water management practices. Tracked per GRI 303 and SASB water metrics.
attributes.references: GRI 303-3; SASB EM-EP-140a.1; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: water_withdrawn_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of water withdrawn from all sources (surface water, groundwater, produced water, municipal supply) during the reporting period, expressed in cubic metres. Key water stewardship metric per GRI 303 and SASB EM-EP-140a.1.
attributes.references: GRI 303-3; SASB EM-EP-140a.1; API ESG Disclosure Framework; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: women_in_leadership_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of senior management and board-level positions held by women at the end of the reporting period. Tracks gender diversity at leadership levels, a distinct metric from overall workforce gender diversity per GRI 405-1.
attributes.references: GRI 405-1; SEC Regulation S-K Human Capital Disclosure; TCFD Governance Pillar; API ESG Disclosure Framework

attributes.name: women_in_workforce_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total workforce that identifies as women at the end of the reporting period. Key diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) metric required by GRI 405-1 and increasingly by institutional investors and ESG rating agencies.
attributes.references: GRI 405-1; SASB; SEC Regulation S-K Human Capital Disclosure; API ESG Disclosure Framework

products.name: opec_quota_position
products.description: Transactional record tracking the company's or member state's OPEC production quota allocation, actual production volumes, and compliance position for each quota period. Captures allocated quota in BOPD, actual production reported, variance from quota, quota adjustment notifications, and OPEC secretariat correspondence. Supports OPEC compliance reporting and production curtailment planning.
products.reference: OPEC Production Quota Agreement, OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report

attributes.name: opec_quota_position_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) Quota Position ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each OPEC quota position record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: OPEC quota positions require production reports to be filed with the OPEC secretariat. The table has production_report_submission_date and production_report_ref. Adding regulatory_filing_id FK links t

attributes.name: actual_production_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Production Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The actual average daily crude oil production volume reported for the quota period, expressed in BOPD. Sourced from OSIsoft PI System production historian and Avocet Production Operations daily allocation data. This is the figure submitted to the OPEC Secretariat.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Monthly Production Survey; Avocet Production Operations; OSIsoft PI System

attributes.name: allocated_quota_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Quota Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The official OPEC-assigned production quota for the member country or company for the quota period, expressed in Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD). This is the baseline entitlement as communicated by the OPEC Secretariat and forms the compliance benchmark.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Quota Notification; SEC Reserves Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the quota position record was formally approved by the designated approver for submission to the OPEC Secretariat. Part of the SOX-compliant internal control audit trail.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); Internal Compliance Governance Framework

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the senior manager or executive who approved the production report and quota compliance position for submission to the OPEC Secretariat. Supports SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); Internal Compliance Governance Framework

attributes.name: baseline_reference_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Baseline Reference Production Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The reference production level (in BOPD) used by OPEC as the baseline from which quota cuts or increases are calculated. Typically corresponds to a specific historical production month agreed upon in the ministerial conference decision.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Quota Notification

attributes.name: compensation_plan_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Compensation Plan Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The agreed additional production curtailment (in BOPD below quota) committed by the member for the current period as part of a formal compensation plan to offset prior overproduction. Null if no compensation plan is active.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Compensation Plan Notification

attributes.name: compliance_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the designated compliance officer or regulatory affairs manager responsible for overseeing OPEC quota compliance for this period. Used for accountability tracking and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Governance Framework; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the quota position for the period. 'compliant' = production within quota; 'overproduced' = production exceeds quota; 'underproduced' = production below quota; 'pending_verification' = awaiting final production data; 'disputed' = member disputes OPEC assessment; 'compensating' = member is executing a compensation plan for prior overproduction.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring Framework; OPEC Statute

attributes.name: condensate_excluded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether natural gas condensate volumes have been excluded from the reported production figure in accordance with OPEC quota measurement conventions. True = condensate excluded; False = condensate included. OPEC quotas historically apply to crude oil only, excluding condensate.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Quota Measurement Conventions; OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions

attributes.name: conference_decision_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number or identifier of the OPEC Ministerial Conference decision that established or last amended the quota allocation for this period (e.g., Decision 178 of the 186th Extraordinary Meeting). Provides traceability to the governing OPEC resolution.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Statute Article 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OPEC quota position record was first created in the Silver Layer data product, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit creation trail required for SOX compliance and data lineage.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); Internal Data Governance Standards; ISO 8601

attributes.name: crude_type_code
attributes.description: API or industry-standard code identifying the crude oil grade or stream included in the production volume (e.g., Arab Light, Basrah Heavy, Bonny Light). Relevant where OPEC quota applies to specific crude streams or where condensate exclusions apply.
attributes.references: American Petroleum Institute (API) Crude Classification; OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework

attributes.name: cumulative_overproduction_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cumulative Overproduction Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The running cumulative overproduction volume (in BOPD) carried forward from prior periods that has not yet been compensated through production curtailment. A non-zero value triggers a compensation obligation under OPEC ministerial decisions.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring Framework

attributes.name: curtailment_plan_status
attributes.description: Status of the internal production curtailment plan developed to ensure compliance with the OPEC quota for this period. 'not_required' = production within quota; 'planned' = curtailment plan drafted; 'active' = curtailment being executed; 'completed' = curtailment achieved; 'deferred' = curtailment postponed.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Reporting Standards; OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring Framework

attributes.name: curtailment_target_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Curtailment Target Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The planned production reduction (in BOPD) required to bring actual production into compliance with the effective quota. Derived from the curtailment plan and used to guide field-level production scheduling decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Reporting Standards; OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring Framework

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the actual_production_bopd figure was sourced for this quota period. Supports data lineage, audit, and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSIsoft_PI|Avocet|SAP_S4HANA|Manual_Entry|SCADA|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI System; Avocet Production Operations; SAP S/4HANA; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the basis for the dispute raised against the OPEC Secretariat's compliance assessment, including the nature of the disagreement, supporting data references, and the resolution sought. Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: OPEC Statute; OPEC Secretariat Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member country or company has formally disputed the OPEC Secretariat's assessment of production volumes or compliance status for this quota period. True = dispute raised; False = no dispute. Triggers escalation workflow.
attributes.references: OPEC Statute; OPEC Secretariat Dispute Resolution Procedures

attributes.name: effective_quota_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Effective Quota Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The net effective production ceiling for the period in BOPD, calculated as allocated_quota_bopd minus voluntary_cut_bopd minus compensation_plan_bopd. Represents the actual production target the member must not exceed to remain fully compliant.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring Framework; OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions

attributes.name: esg_ghg_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the production volumes in this quota position are included in the company's ESG/GHG emissions reporting scope. True = included in GHG inventory; False = excluded. Supports alignment between OPEC production compliance and EPA/ESG emissions disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program; ESG Reporting Framework; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: internal_review_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of the internal review and approval process for this quota position record before submission to the OPEC Secretariat. 'draft' = initial entry; 'under_review' = compliance team reviewing; 'approved' = management approved; 'submitted' = filed with OPEC; 'closed' = period finalized.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Governance Framework; SOX Internal Controls; Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: member_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the OPEC member state to which this quota position applies (e.g., SAU, IRQ, ARE, IRN, KWT, VEN, NGA, LBY, GAB, COG, GNQ, AGO). Used to align production data with OPEC secretariat country-level reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; OPEC Statute; OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework

attributes.name: member_country_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the OPEC member country corresponding to the member_country_code. Provides human-readable identification for reporting and correspondence with the OPEC Secretariat.
attributes.references: OPEC Statute; OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the next OPEC Ministerial Conference or Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee (JMMC) meeting at which this quota may be reviewed or adjusted. Used for compliance calendar planning and curtailment strategy.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Schedule; OPEC Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee (JMMC)

attributes.name: ngl_excluded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) volumes have been excluded from the reported production figure per OPEC quota measurement conventions. True = NGL excluded; False = NGL included. Ensures consistency with OPEC crude-only quota scope.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Quota Measurement Conventions; OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions

attributes.name: opec_plus_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quota position is governed under the broader OPEC+ (Declaration of Cooperation) framework, which includes non-OPEC allied producers such as Russia, Kazakhstan, and Mexico, in addition to core OPEC members. True = OPEC+ agreement applies; False = core OPEC quota only.
attributes.references: OPEC+ Declaration of Cooperation; OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions

attributes.name: production_measurement_basis
attributes.description: Defines the accounting basis on which the actual production volume is reported: 'gross' = total field production before deductions; 'net' = production net of royalties and government take; 'equity' = company equity share; 'working_interest' = Working Interest (WI) share of production.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework; SPE PRMS; SEC Reserves Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: production_report_ref
attributes.description: Official reference or submission number assigned to the production report filed with the OPEC Secretariat for this quota period. Enables cross-referencing with secretariat records and internal compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Monthly Production Survey; Internal Regulatory Compliance Records Management

attributes.name: production_report_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company or member state submitted its official production report for the quota period to the OPEC Secretariat. Used to verify timely compliance with OPEC reporting obligations.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Monthly Production Survey; OPEC Statute

attributes.name: quota_adjustment_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quota Adjustment Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The incremental adjustment (positive for increase, negative for cut) applied to the baseline reference to arrive at the allocated quota for this period, expressed in BOPD. Captures voluntary cut commitments, compensation adjustments, and OPEC+ agreement modifications.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC+ Agreement Framework

attributes.name: quota_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the OPEC production quota period to which this position record applies. Together with quota_period_start_date, defines the compliance measurement window.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework

attributes.name: quota_period_label
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the quota period, formatted as YYYY-MM for monthly periods (e.g., 2024-03) or YYYY-Q# for quarterly periods (e.g., 2024-Q1). Used in regulatory submissions and management reporting.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework; Internal Compliance Reporting Standards

attributes.name: quota_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the OPEC production quota period to which this position record applies. OPEC quota periods are typically monthly or quarterly as determined by ministerial conference decisions.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Reporting Framework

attributes.name: quota_review_cycle
attributes.description: The frequency at which the OPEC quota for this period is subject to ministerial review and potential adjustment. Reflects the cadence established in the relevant ministerial conference decision.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Statute Article 11

attributes.name: quota_utilization_pct
attributes.description: The ratio of actual_production_bopd to allocated_quota_bopd expressed as a percentage (actual / quota × 100). Values above 100 indicate overproduction; values below 100 indicate underproduction. Used in executive dashboards and OPEC compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring Framework; Internal Compliance KPI Standards

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this quota position record, incremented each time the record is updated. Supports optimistic concurrency control and audit trail reconstruction in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Architecture

attributes.name: responsible_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal business unit, subsidiary, or operating company responsible for managing and reporting the production volumes covered by this quota position. Supports accountability assignment in multi-entity corporate structures.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: secretariat_correspondence_ref
attributes.description: Official document reference number of the OPEC Secretariat letter or communication notifying the member of the quota allocation or adjustment. Supports audit trail and regulatory correspondence management.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Correspondence; Internal Regulatory Compliance Records Management

attributes.name: secretariat_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OPEC Secretariat formally communicated the quota allocation for this period to the member country. Used to establish the official notification timeline for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Correspondence; OPEC Statute Article 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this OPEC quota position record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every modification to support change tracking, audit trails, and SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX); Internal Data Governance Standards; ISO 8601

attributes.name: variance_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Production Quota Variance Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between actual_production_bopd and allocated_quota_bopd (actual minus quota), expressed in BOPD. A positive value indicates overproduction (non-compliance); a negative value indicates underproduction relative to quota. Used for curtailment planning and compliance assessment.
attributes.references: OPEC Secretariat Compliance Monitoring; Internal Compliance Reporting Standards

attributes.name: voluntary_cut_bopd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Voluntary Production Cut Barrels of Oil Per Day (BOPD)
attributes.description: Additional voluntary production cut (in BOPD) committed by the member above and beyond the mandatory OPEC quota reduction, as announced unilaterally or through side agreements. Null if no voluntary cut is in effect for this period.
attributes.references: OPEC Ministerial Conference Decisions; OPEC Secretariat Voluntary Cut Notification

products.name: sox_control
products.description: Master record of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls defined for financial reporting processes relevant to oil and gas operations including reserves estimation, revenue recognition, JIB billing, and CAPEX authorization. Tracks control ID, control description, control type (preventive/detective), process area, control owner, testing frequency, design effectiveness assessment, and periodic test results (test date, methodology, sample size, exceptions, operating effectiveness conclusion, remediation response). Supports external auditor reliance and SOX 404 management assessment documentation.
products.reference: SOX Section 302, SOX Section 404, PCAOB AS 2201, COSO Framework

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each SOX internal control record. Primary key for the sox_control data product.

attributes.name: scoped_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: SOX controls are scoped to legal entities (accounts) for financial reporting. Real process: entity-level control testing requires linking controls to specific legal entities for SOX 404 compliance, au

attributes.name: business_unit
