attributes.description: The organizational business unit or division responsible for this control (e.g., Upstream E&P, Refining, Petrochemicals, Supply Chain, Corporate Finance). Enables SOX scoping and coverage analysis by business segment for SEC reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: compensating_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control serves as a compensating control for another control that has been identified as deficient. Compensating controls provide alternative assurance over the same financial reporting risk and are documented in the SOX 404 management assessment to support the overall effectiveness conclusion.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control is executed manually by a person, fully automated by an IT system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA system-enforced approval workflow), IT-dependent manual (relies on system-generated reports), or semi-automated. Drives testing approach and reliance on IT General Controls (ITGCs).
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: control_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the control objective, the specific procedure performed, the population of transactions covered, and the expected outcome. Used by internal and external auditors to assess design adequacy.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control activity itself is performed in the normal course of business operations (distinct from testing frequency). For example, a daily production volume reconciliation control in OSIsoft PI System vs. a quarterly reserves certification control. Used to determine appropriate sample sizes for operating effectiveness testing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|transaction_level|ad_hoc — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the SOX control, used in audit workpapers, management assessment documentation, and external auditor reliance packages. Format: SOX-[PROCESS_CODE]-[SEQUENCE]. Example: SOX-REVR-0042.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual accountable for the design, execution, and ongoing effectiveness of this SOX control. The control owner is responsible for ensuring the control operates as designed and for responding to audit findings or remediation requirements.

attributes.name: control_owner_title
attributes.description: Job title of the control owner (e.g., VP Finance, Controller, Reservoir Engineering Manager). Used to assess segregation of duties and appropriate seniority of control ownership relative to the risk being mitigated.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_performer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who physically executes the control activity (may differ from the control owner). For example, a staff accountant who performs the JIB reconciliation while the Controller owns the control. Relevant for segregation of duties analysis.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SOX control. Active controls are in scope for the current SOX 404 assessment period. Controls under remediation have identified design or operating effectiveness deficiencies being addressed. Retired controls have been decommissioned due to process changes.

attributes.name: control_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable name of the SOX internal control, used in management assessment reports, audit committee presentations, and SOX 404 documentation packages.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: control_type
attributes.description: Classification of the control by its timing relative to the risk event. Preventive controls stop errors before they occur (e.g., authorization limits on AFE approvals); detective controls identify errors after the fact (e.g., reconciliation of JIB billings); corrective controls remediate identified issues.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOX control record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for SOX control inventory management and supports SOX 404 documentation completeness requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SOX Section 302; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: deficiency_classification
attributes.description: Classification of any identified control deficiency per PCAOB standards. A material weakness requires disclosure in the annual report (10-K) and may trigger SEC enforcement. A significant deficiency is communicated to the audit committee. Particularly sensitive for oil and gas companies given reserves estimation complexity and SEC disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308; SEC Staff Bulletin on Material Weakness

attributes.name: design_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent design effectiveness assessment was completed for this control. Used to track the currency of design assessments and ensure all controls are assessed within the SOX 404 annual cycle.

attributes.name: design_assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal audit or management representative who performed the design effectiveness assessment. Required for SOX 404 management assessment documentation and external auditor reliance.

attributes.name: design_effectiveness_conclusion
attributes.description: Management's conclusion on whether the control is suitably designed to prevent or detect material misstatements if it operates as intended. Design effectiveness is assessed before operating effectiveness testing. An ineffective design conclusion requires remediation before operating effectiveness can be evaluated.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this control became active and in scope for SOX 404 assessment. New controls added mid-year (e.g., following a material acquisition or new joint venture) have an effective date after the fiscal year start.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of exceptions (deviations from the expected control operation) identified during the most recent operating effectiveness test. Exceptions are evaluated to determine whether they constitute a control deficiency, significant deficiency, or material weakness requiring disclosure.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404; SEC Staff Guidance on Management's Report on ICFR

attributes.name: external_auditor_reliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the external auditor (e.g., Big 4 firm) has elected to rely on management's testing of this control as part of their integrated audit under PCAOB AS 2201. When True, the external auditor reduces their own testing scope for this control, reducing audit fees and disruption to operations.

attributes.name: financial_statement_assertion
attributes.description: The financial statement assertion(s) addressed by this control per PCAOB standards. Assertions include existence (assets/liabilities exist), completeness (all transactions recorded), valuation (amounts are appropriate), rights and obligations, presentation and disclosure, accuracy, and cutoff. Critical for SEC reserves disclosure and IFRS/GAAP oil and gas accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: existence|completeness|valuation|rights_and_obligations|presentation_and_disclosure|accuracy|cutoff — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; IFRS 6; ASC 932 (Oil and Gas Producing Activities); SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: itgc_dependency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control relies on IT General Controls (ITGCs) for its effectiveness. When True, the operating effectiveness of this control is contingent on the effectiveness of ITGCs over the relevant system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA access controls, change management, computer operations). ITGC failures can cascade to dependent application controls.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework — IT Controls; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: last_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent operating effectiveness test was completed for this control. Used to monitor testing currency, identify overdue controls, and support SOX 404 management assessment sign-off.

attributes.name: next_test_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: SOX Control Next Test Due Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next operating effectiveness test must be completed for this control, based on the testing frequency and the SOX compliance calendar. Used to drive the internal audit testing schedule and ensure all key controls are tested before the annual management assessment sign-off.

attributes.name: operating_effectiveness_conclusion
attributes.description: Management's conclusion on whether the control operated effectively throughout the assessment period based on testing results. An ineffective conclusion triggers deficiency classification and remediation tracking. Feeds directly into the SOX 404 management assessment and CEO/CFO certifications under SOX Section 302.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 302 and 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: process_area
attributes.description: The financial reporting process or business cycle to which this control belongs. Common oil and gas process areas include: Reserves Estimation and SEC Disclosure, Revenue Recognition and Crude Lifting, Joint Interest Billing (JIB), Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Authorization for Expenditure (AFE), Lease Operating Expense (LOE), DD&A (Depreciation Depletion and Amortization), Accounts Payable, Payroll, and Financial Close. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reserves_estimation|revenue_recognition|jib_billing|capex_afe|loe|dda|accounts_payable|payroll|financial_close|procurement|treasury|tax — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COPAS Accounting Procedures

attributes.name: related_sox_control_number
attributes.description: Control number of a related or compensating SOX control. Used to document control interdependencies, compensating control relationships, and control hierarchies (e.g., an entity-level control that provides coverage over multiple process-level controls). Supports impact analysis when a control is modified or retired.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which remediation of an identified control deficiency must be completed. Tracked against the SOX compliance calendar to ensure timely resolution before the annual management assessment sign-off date.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Description of the corrective actions planned or in progress to address identified control deficiencies. Includes process redesign, system configuration changes in SAP S/4HANA, additional training, or compensating controls. Required for audit committee reporting and external auditor communication.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation activities for any identified control deficiency. Overdue remediations are escalated to the CFO and Audit Committee. Verified status indicates that retesting has confirmed the remediated control is now operating effectively.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this control was retired or removed from the SOX 404 scope, typically due to process automation, divestiture of the related business unit, or replacement by a redesigned control. Null for active controls.

attributes.name: risk_statement
attributes.description: Formal statement of the financial reporting risk that this control is designed to mitigate. Describes the specific misstatement risk (e.g., overstatement of proved reserves leading to incorrect DD&A, or unauthorized CAPEX commitments exceeding AFE limits) and the relevant financial statement assertion.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of transactions or instances selected for testing during the most recent operating effectiveness test. Sample size is determined based on control frequency, risk level, and PCAOB guidance (e.g., 25 samples for monthly controls, 60 for daily controls). Documented in audit workpapers.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2301; AICPA Audit Sampling Guide

attributes.name: significance_level
attributes.description: Classification of the control's significance within the SOX 404 framework. Key controls are those whose failure could result in a material misstatement of the financial statements. Entity-level controls (ELCs) operate at the company-wide level (e.g., tone at the top, risk assessment). Non-key controls provide supplementary assurance.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: sox_assessment_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this SOX 404 control assessment applies (e.g., 2024). Enables year-over-year comparison of control effectiveness, tracking of repeat deficiencies, and historical audit trail for SEC disclosure purposes.

attributes.name: subprocess_name

attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: system_of_record

Drives IT General Controls (ITGC) dependency assessment.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework — IT Controls

attributes.name: test_methodology

attributes.name: testing_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is tested for operating effectiveness during the SOX assessment period. attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: walkthroughcompleted_flag

attributes.name: operating_effectiveness_conclusion
attributes.description: The tester's conclusion on whether the control operated effectively during the assessment period. Effective means the control prevented or detected material misstatements as designed. This is the primary outcome of the SOX control test and drives management's Section 404 assessment.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: population_size
attributes.description: Total number of transactions, items, or occurrences in the population from which the test sample was drawn. Required for statistical sampling documentation and PCAOB AS 2315 audit sampling compliance.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2315 Audit Sampling; PCAOB AS 2201; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: prior_year_test_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the corresponding control test from the prior assessment year. Supports year-over-year comparison, repeat deficiency identification, and PCAOB AS 2201 benchmarking of control effectiveness trends.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which management commits to completing remediation of identified control deficiencies. Tracked against the SOX compliance calendar to ensure timely resolution before year-end assessment.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SOX 404 Management Assessment

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation effort for identified control deficiencies. Not Required applies when no exceptions were found. Overdue indicates the remediation due date has passed without completion. Supports SOX compliance calendar monitoring.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: repeat_deficiency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deficiency identified in this test was also identified in a prior assessment period (True). Repeat deficiencies carry elevated risk of escalation to Significant Deficiency or Material Weakness classification under PCAOB AS 2201.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who reviewed the control test results. Retained for audit workpaper documentation and management assessment sign-off evidence.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating assigned to the control based on the significance of the financial reporting risk it mitigates. High-risk controls typically address material account balances such as crude oil reserves valuation, revenue, or joint venture billings. Drives testing frequency and sample size requirements.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Enterprise Risk Management Framework; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: rollforward_test_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is a rollforward test (True) performed to extend interim testing coverage to year-end, or a standalone test (False). Rollforward tests are required when interim testing does not cover the full fiscal year per PCAOB AS 2201.

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Number of items selected for testing from the population. Determined by control frequency, risk rating, and PCAOB sampling guidance. Supports external auditor reliance assessment and SOX 404 management assessment documentation.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2315 Audit Sampling; PCAOB AS 2201; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: The sampling approach used to select items for testing. Statistical sampling provides quantifiable confidence levels; judgmental sampling is based on auditor expertise. Documented per PCAOB AS 2315 requirements.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2315 Audit Sampling; PCAOB AS 2201; AICPA AU-C Section 530

attributes.name: sap_process_area
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA module or process area associated with the control being tested (FI=Financial Accounting, CO=Controlling, MM=Materials Management, PM=Plant Maintenance, PS=Project Systems, SD=Sales and Distribution, PP=Production Planning, JVA=Joint Venture Accounting). Supports system-of-record traceability for IT application controls. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FI|CO|MM|PM|PS|SD|PP|JVA|Cross-Module — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Internal Controls Framework; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the control test was performed. Represents the principal real-world event time for this testing transaction. Used to confirm testing occurred within the required assessment window.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: test_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this control test. Together with test_period_start_date, defines the coverage window for the assessment. Must align with the fiscal year-end for annual SOX 404 reporting.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: test_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this control test. The test period must span a sufficient portion of the fiscal year to support the annual SOX 404 management assessment conclusion.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 308

attributes.name: test_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this control test, used in audit workpapers, management assessment documentation, and external auditor reliance packages. Format: SOX-TST-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201; SOX 404 Management Assessment

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the control test record. Tracks progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation. Supports SOX 404 management assessment completeness monitoring.

attributes.name: tester_business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or department to which the tester belongs (e.g., Internal Audit, Finance Controls, Compliance). Used to assess independence and segregation of duties for SOX reliance purposes.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework; SOX 404 Management Assessment

attributes.name: tester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who performed the control test. Retained for audit workpaper documentation and external auditor reliance packages where employee ID alone is insufficient for human-readable reporting.

attributes.name: testing_methodology
attributes.description: The audit testing approach applied to evaluate the control. Aligned with PCAOB AS 2201 testing procedures. Determines the nature and sufficiency of evidence gathered for external auditor reliance.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 2201; AICPA AU-C Section 330; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOX control test record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and SOX 404 documentation version control.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 1215 Audit Documentation; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: workpaper_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this control test to the corresponding audit workpaper in the audit management system. Enables traceability between the data record and supporting evidence documentation.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 1215 Audit Documentation; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SOX 404 Management Assessment

products.name: consent_order
products.description: Master record of consent orders, consent decrees, and settlement agreements entered into with regulatory agencies including EPA, BSEE, OSHA, and state regulators. Tracks issuing agency, violation basis, agreed remediation actions, penalty amounts, compliance milestones, reporting obligations imposed by the order, and current fulfillment status.
products.reference: EPA Consent Decree, BSEE Compliance Order, DOJ Settlement Agreement

attributes.name: consent_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the consent order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — a binding regulatory instrument with its own lifecycle, effective dates, and compliance obligations.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Enterprise Data Architecture Standards

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary facility, plant, refinery, offshore platform, pipeline segment, or operational asset subject to the consent order. Links to the asset management domain for facility-level compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Maximo Asset Management; Enablon HSE Management; BSEE Facility Identification

attributes.name: compliance_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Consent orders require designated compliance officer for milestone tracking, periodic reporting to regulatory agencies, stipulated penalty avoidance, and legal counsel coordination. Multi-year commitm

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Consent orders are submitted to and approved by regulatory authorities, making them regulatory filings. Adding regulatory_filing_id FK links the consent order to its filing record, enabling tracking o

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Consent order fulfillment costs (SEP projects, monitoring, reporting) are allocated to cost centers for compliance budget tracking and variance analysis. Essential for tracking milestone completion co

attributes.name: customer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_counterparty. Business justification: Consent orders target counterparties as responsible parties for enforcement. Real process: tracking which counterparty is subject to enforcement actions for joint venture liability allocation, operato

attributes.name: epa_facility_id
attributes.description: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) unique identifier for the regulated facility associated with this consent order. Used for cross-referencing EPA enforcement databases (ECHO, ICIS) and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS); EPA ECHO Database; ICIS-Air; ICIS-NPDES

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: Consent orders often include monetary penalties. The consent_order table tracks penalty_amount and penalty_paid_amount but has no FK to the regulatory_penalty table where detailed penalty records are

attributes.name: remediation_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Consent order fulfillment often requires vendor services (environmental remediation contractors, monitoring equipment suppliers). Real business process: consent order compliance execution via procurem

attributes.name: subject_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Consent orders are issued against legal entities (accounts) for enforcement actions. Real process: tracking which account is subject to each consent order for compliance monitoring, financial accruals

attributes.name: agency_case_officer
attributes.description: Name of the primary regulatory agency enforcement officer or case manager responsible for overseeing compliance with this consent order. Used for correspondence, milestone reporting submissions, and audit trail.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the consent order has legal effect (e.g., USA, GBR, NOR). Supports multinational compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent order record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 8601; Oil Gas Enterprise Data Architecture Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this consent order record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multinational financial reporting under IFRS/GAAP.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consent order becomes legally binding and enforceable, as stipulated in the instrument. Marks the start of the compliance obligation period and triggers milestone scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: enablon_case_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the corresponding enforcement case or compliance obligation record in the Enablon HSE Management system. Enables traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management; Oil Gas Enterprise Integration Standards

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consent order was formally signed or entered by all parties (company and regulatory agency), which may differ from the effective date. Represents the principal real-world business event timestamp for this agreement.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; OSHA Citation Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consent order expires or all obligations are scheduled to be fully discharged, as specified in the instrument. Null for open-ended orders with no fixed termination. Used for compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current operational fulfillment status of the consent order's compliance obligations: on_track (milestones being met), at_risk (potential delay identified), overdue (missed milestone or report), fulfilled (all obligations satisfied), or partially_fulfilled (some milestones complete). Distinct from order_status which reflects the legal lifecycle.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; Enablon HSE Management; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent order relates to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions violations, including methane, CO2, or other regulated GHG emissions under EPA Clean Air Act or state equivalents. Supports GHG compliance and ESG reporting.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98); Clean Air Act; ISO 14001; ESG Reporting

attributes.name: hse_classification
attributes.description: HSE domain classification of the consent order: environmental (spills, emissions, waste disposal), safety (worker safety, OSHA), health (occupational health), process_safety (PSM, BSEE), or combined (multiple HSE domains). Aligns with Enablon HSE Management categorization.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; EPA; BSEE; ISO 45001; ISO 14001; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: is_esg_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent order must be disclosed in the company's ESG or sustainability report. True for orders involving GHG emissions, environmental spills, HSE violations, or other ESG-material events.
attributes.references: ESG Reporting Frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD); ISO 14001; EPA GHG Reporting Rule

attributes.name: is_sec_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent order meets the materiality threshold requiring disclosure in SEC filings under Regulation S-K Item 103 (Legal Proceedings). True if the penalty exceeds $300,000 or is otherwise material to investors.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: issuing_agency
attributes.description: Name of the federal, state, or international regulatory agency that issued or is party to the consent order (e.g., U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, state environmental agency). Determines applicable regulatory framework.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; State Environmental Agencies

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Level of governmental jurisdiction under which the consent order was issued: federal (EPA, BSEE, OSHA, PHMSA, FERC, BOEM), state (state environmental or safety agency), local (county or municipal authority), or international (foreign regulatory body). Determines reporting chain and legal venue.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; State Environmental Agencies

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code (FIPS/USPS standard) for the state in which the consent order has legal effect, or the state agency that issued it. Null for purely federal or international orders.
attributes.references: FIPS 5-2 State Codes; EPA Regional Offices

attributes.name: last_report_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent mandatory compliance progress report was submitted to the issuing regulatory agency. Used to verify reporting cadence adherence and identify overdue submissions.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: legal_counsel_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal or external legal counsel representing the company in negotiations and ongoing compliance management for this consent order. Supports attorney-client privilege tracking and legal matter management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: milestone_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct compliance milestones or deliverables stipulated in the consent order (e.g., equipment installation deadlines, audit submissions, monitoring report due dates). Used for progress tracking and compliance calendar population.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: milestones_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of compliance milestones that have been fulfilled and accepted by the regulatory agency to date. Compared against milestone_count to assess overall fulfillment progress.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: next_milestone_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next outstanding compliance milestone or deliverable must be completed and submitted to the regulatory agency. Drives compliance calendar alerts and escalation workflows in Enablon HSE Management.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: next_report_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next mandatory progress or compliance status report must be submitted to the issuing regulatory agency under the consent order's reporting obligations.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; PHMSA Safety Reporting

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known docket or case number assigned by the issuing regulatory agency to uniquely identify this consent order, consent decree, or settlement agreement (e.g., EPA Docket No. CAA-06-2023-0042). Used for all regulatory correspondence and submissions.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; OSHA Citation Standards

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the consent order: active (in force and obligations ongoing), fulfilled (all milestones and penalties satisfied), terminated (voided or withdrawn), superseded (replaced by a subsequent order), or under_negotiation (draft stage prior to execution). Drives compliance calendar and SOX disclosure.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; EPA Enforcement and Compliance

attributes.name: order_title
attributes.description: Official short title or caption of the consent order as designated by the issuing agency, used for identification in regulatory filings, internal compliance registers, and SEC disclosure documents.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory instrument: consent_order (administrative), consent_decree (judicial/court-entered), settlement_agreement (negotiated resolution), administrative_order (unilateral agency directive), or compliance_order (corrective mandate). Determines legal enforceability and reporting treatment.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement Response Policy; BSEE Enforcement Policy; OSHA Penalty Structure

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Specific statutory or regulatory citation(s) that form the legal basis for the consent order (e.g., Clean Air Act § 113(d), 40 CFR Part 60, 30 CFR § 250.401). Supports regulatory compliance mapping and legal review.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; FERC 18 CFR

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which progress reports must be submitted to the issuing regulatory agency under the terms of the consent order: monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, one_time, or as_required. Populates the compliance obligation calendar.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; BSEE Enforcement Policy; PHMSA Safety Reporting

attributes.name: responsible_business_unit
attributes.description: Name of the internal business unit, division, or operating company accountable for managing compliance with this consent order (e.g., Upstream E&P, Refining and Marketing, Midstream Pipeline Operations). Aligns with SAP CO cost center hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302/404; COPAS

attributes.name: sap_legal_case_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the corresponding legal case or provision record in SAP S/4HANA (FI/Legal module) used for financial provisioning, penalty accruals, and CAPEX/OPEX cost tracking associated with this consent order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS/GAAP IAS 37 Provisions; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sep_credit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of penalty mitigation credit granted for Supplemental Environmental Projects (SEPs) agreed to as part of the consent order settlement. SEPs are environmentally beneficial projects that reduce the net cash penalty obligation. Specific to EPA enforcement settlements.
attributes.references: EPA Supplemental Environmental Projects Policy (2015); EPA Civil Penalty Policy

attributes.name: stipulated_penalty_per_day
attributes.description: Daily stipulated penalty amount (in the designated currency) that accrues for each day of non-compliance with a milestone or reporting obligation under the consent order. Critical for financial risk quantification and CAPEX/OPEX planning.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; BSEE Enforcement Policy; OSHA Penalty Structure; SEC Regulation S-K Item 103

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent order record was most recently modified in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit trail, and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 8601; Oil Gas Enterprise Data Architecture Standards

products.name: regulatory_penalty
products.description: Transactional record of monetary penalties, fines, and civil penalties assessed by regulatory authorities for compliance violations. Tracks penalty amount, assessing authority, violation basis, assessment date, payment due date, payment status, appeal status, and final settled amount. Supports financial accrual reporting and regulatory liability disclosure.
products.reference: EPA Civil Penalty Policy, BSEE Civil Penalty, OSHA Penalty Schedule

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory penalty record in the Oil Gas compliance system. Primary key for the regulatory_penalty data product.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, plant, terminal, or operational site where the violation occurred that resulted in the penalty (e.g., refinery, processing plant, offshore platform, pipeline segment).
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Data Standards; EPA Facility Registry

attributes.name: compliance_audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Reference to the audit finding that identified the violation leading to this penalty, enabling traceability from audit to enforcement action.
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Data Standards; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: compliance_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Regulatory penalties require assigned employee for payment processing, appeal management, accrual tracking, and SEC disclosure coordination. Financial materiality and audit requirements demand clear o

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Penalties require GL account mapping for accrual posting, payment clearing, and financial statement preparation. Links assessed_amount, settled_amount, and paid_amount to proper liability and expense

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance obligation that was violated, linking the penalty to the specific regulatory requirement that triggered it.

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the permit associated with the violation, applicable when the penalty arises from a permit condition breach (e.g., emission limit exceedance under an EPA air permit).

attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: Amount accrued in the financial statements for this penalty under IFRS/GAAP contingent liability provisions. May differ from assessed or settled amounts based on probability-weighted estimates. Supports SOX financial controls and SEC disclosure.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 37; US GAAP ASC 450; SOX; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: appeal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority or administrative tribunal issued its final decision on the appeal. Triggers update to settled_amount and penalty_status.

attributes.name: appeal_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company formally filed an appeal or contest against the penalty assessment with the regulatory authority or administrative tribunal.

attributes.name: appeal_status
attributes.description: Current status of any formal appeal or contest filed against the penalty assessment. Determines whether the settled_amount may change and affects financial accrual estimates under IFRS IAS 37 / ASC 450.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 37; US GAAP ASC 450; SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: assessed_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary penalty amount originally assessed by the regulatory authority before any reductions, waivers, or negotiated settlements. Used as the basis for financial accrual and liability disclosure.

attributes.name: assessing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or government agency that assessed and issued the penalty (e.g., EPA, BSEE, PHMSA, FERC, BOEM, OSHA, state environmental agency). Determines applicable regulatory framework and appeal process.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; PHMSA; FERC; BOEM; OSHA

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally assessed and issued the penalty notice or order. Serves as the principal business event date for the penalty lifecycle and triggers payment due date calculation.

attributes.name: authority_case_number
attributes.description: Internal case or docket number assigned by the assessing regulatory authority for tracking the enforcement action in their system (distinct from the company-assigned penalty_number).

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the mandated corrective action plan must be completed and demonstrated to the regulatory authority. Applicable when corrective_action_required is true.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the regulatory authority has mandated a corrective action plan (CAP) or supplemental environmental project (SEP) as a condition of the penalty settlement or consent order.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; OSHA; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the jurisdiction where the violation occurred (e.g., USA, GBR, NGA). Supports multinational regulatory liability reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory penalty record was first created in the compliance management system. Supports audit trail and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX; Oil Gas Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this penalty record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multinational financial reporting and currency conversion.

attributes.name: enablon_incident_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the Enablon HSE Management system for the incident or non-compliance event that triggered this penalty. Enables cross-system traceability between HSE incident management and regulatory enforcement.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility, plant, or operational site where the violation occurred. Retained as a denormalized field for reporting and regulatory submissions without requiring a join.

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the penalty is related to a Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emission violation (e.g., methane flaring exceedance, GHG reporting failure). Supports ESG reporting and carbon liability disclosure.
attributes.references: EPA GHG Reporting Rule (40 CFR Part 98); ESG Reporting Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: hse_classification
attributes.description: Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) classification of the penalty, indicating whether it relates to an environmental, occupational safety, health, process safety, or security violation. Supports ESG reporting and HSE performance metrics.
attributes.references: OSHA; EPA; ISO 14001; ISO 45001; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: is_sec_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Reportable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this penalty meets the materiality threshold requiring disclosure in SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q) under SEC Regulation S-K Item 103 (Legal Proceedings). Supports SOX compliance and investor relations.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-K Item 103; SOX; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Level of government jurisdiction under which the penalty was assessed. Determines applicable legal framework, appeal venue, and disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount paid to the regulatory authority to date. May be less than settled_amount if payment is in installments or partially paid. Supports cash flow reporting and accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the penalty payment was remitted to the regulatory authority. Used to confirm timely payment and close the penalty record.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the penalty payment must be remitted to the regulatory authority to avoid additional interest, late fees, or escalated enforcement. Drives accounts payable scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; PHMSA; FERC; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the penalty amount. Drives accounts payable follow-up, interest accrual, and regulatory relationship management.

attributes.name: penalty_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned penalty or civil penalty case number issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., EPA enforcement case number, BSEE incident of non-compliance number, PHMSA penalty order number). Used for correspondence and regulatory tracking.

attributes.name: penalty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory penalty. Drives financial accrual decisions and regulatory liability disclosure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: assessed|contested|settled|paid|waived|appealed|closed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: penalty_title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the penalty or enforcement action as designated by the assessing regulatory authority (e.g., 'Notice of Violation - Flaring Exceedance', 'Civil Penalty Order - Pipeline Integrity').

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory citation, statute, or code section under which the penalty was assessed (e.g., 'Clean Air Act Section 113(b)', '30 CFR Part 250', '49 CFR Part 195'). Supports legal defense and compliance gap analysis.
attributes.references: EPA; BSEE; PHMSA; FERC; OSHA; API

attributes.name: regulation_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regulation, rule, or statute under which the penalty was assessed (e.g., 'Clean Air Act', 'Clean Water Act', 'Pipeline Safety Improvement Act', 'Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act').

attributes.name: repeat_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this penalty arises from a repeat violation of the same regulation or permit condition within a defined lookback period. Repeat violations typically attract higher penalty multipliers and heightened regulatory scrutiny.

attributes.name: responsible_business_unit
attributes.description: Name of the business unit or division within Oil Gas that is accountable for the violation and responsible for penalty payment and corrective action (e.g., Upstream E&P, Refining, Midstream, Petrochemicals).
attributes.references: Oil Gas Internal Data Standards; SOX

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI module document number for the financial posting (accrual or payment) associated with this penalty. Enables reconciliation between the compliance register and the general ledger.

attributes.name: settled_amount
attributes.description: Final negotiated or adjudicated penalty amount agreed upon after appeal, mitigation, or settlement proceedings. May differ from assessed_amount due to reductions granted by the authority. Used for final financial accrual and SEC disclosure.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the jurisdiction where the violation occurred and penalty was assessed. Applicable for state-level enforcement actions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory penalty record was last modified in the compliance management system. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX; Oil Gas Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: well_api_number
attributes.description: American Petroleum Institute (API) well number for the specific well associated with the violation, applicable for drilling, production, or well integrity violations assessed by BSEE or state regulators.

attributes.description: The standard recertification or surveillance audit cycle in years as defined by the certifying body (e.g., 3 years for ISO management system certifications with annual surveillance audits).

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The organizational business unit or division responsible for maintaining and renewing this certification (e.g., 'Upstream Gulf of Mexico', 'Downstream Refining', 'Midstream Pipeline Operations', 'Petrochemicals').
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001:2015; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: certificate_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference path, document management system ID, or URL to the scanned or digital copy of the official certificate document issued by the certifying body. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: certification_number

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the certification. 'active' indicates the certification is valid and in force; 'expired' indicates the certification has passed its expiration date without renewal; 'suspended' indicates temporary withdrawal by the certifying body; 'revoked' indicates permanent cancellation; 'pending_renewal' indicates renewal is in progress; 'withdrawn' indicates voluntary surrender.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the certification by its governing domain (e.g., management_system for ISO certifications, regulatory_attestation for BSEE/BOEM, financial_attestation for SOX CEO/CFO, operator_qualification for pipeline operator qualifications). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: management_system|operator_qualification|regulatory_attestation|financial_attestation|api_standard|pipeline_safety|environmental|hse|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API Standards; ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; Sarbanes-Oxley Act; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195

attributes.name: certifying_auditor_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead auditor or assessor from the certifying body who conducted the certification audit or assessment.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015; ISO 19011:2018 Guidelines for Auditing Management Systems

attributes.name: certifying_body_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation number or reference of the certifying body issued by an accreditation authority (e.g., ANAB, UKAS, DAkkS accreditation number), confirming the certifying body is authorized to issue the certification standard.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015 Conformity Assessment; ANSI National Accreditation Board (ANAB)

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the certification is applicable or was issued (e.g., USA, GBR, NLD, SAU, NGA).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; BOEM; BSEE; EPA; PHMSA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001:2015; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the certification fee amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, SAR). Supports multi-currency financial reporting for multinational operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS/GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: enablon_cert_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this certification record in the Enablon HSE Management system, enabling traceability between the enterprise data platform and the operational HSE system of record.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management System; ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018

attributes.name: esg_reporting_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Social and Governance (ESG) Reporting Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is referenced in or supports the company's Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reporting disclosures (e.g., ISO 14001 certification cited in ESG report, GHG verification certifications).
attributes.references: ESG Reporting Frameworks; GRI Standards; TCFD Recommendations; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null for certifications with no defined expiry (e.g., certain SOX attestations). Used to drive renewal workflows and compliance calendar alerts.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The fee paid to the certifying body for the initial certification or most recent renewal audit, expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. Used for OPEX budgeting and cost tracking.
attributes.references: COPAS Petroleum Accounting Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS/GAAP

attributes.name: ghg_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is related to Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions verification, carbon accounting, or climate-related compliance (e.g., ISO 14064 GHG verification, EPA GHG Reporting Program certifications).
attributes.references: ISO 14064:2018; EPA 40 CFR Part 98 GHG Reporting; ESG Reporting Frameworks

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: The regulatory or standards body whose requirements underpin the certification (e.g., API, ISO, BSEE, BOEM, EPA, OSHA, PHMSA, FERC, SEC, OPEC). Distinct from the certifying body which performs the audit and issues the certificate.
attributes.references: API; ISO; BSEE; BOEM; EPA; OSHA; PHMSA; FERC; SEC; OPEC

attributes.name: hse_classification
attributes.description: Classifies the certification by its Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) domain. 'environmental' for ISO 14001 and EPA-related certifications; 'occupational_health_safety' for ISO 45001 and OSHA certifications; 'process_safety' for API RP 750/OSHA PSM certifications; 'combined_hse' for integrated management system certifications; 'not_applicable' for financial or non-HSE certifications.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119; API RP 750; Enablon HSE Management

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certifying body formally issued or granted the certification. Represents the start of the certification's validity period.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; API Standards; BSEE SEMS Rule

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent surveillance, recertification, or assessment audit conducted by the certifying body against this certification standard.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards; ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015

attributes.name: major_nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Number of major nonconformances identified during the most recent certification audit. Major nonconformances typically require resolution before the certificate can be issued or maintained.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned surveillance or recertification audit scheduled by the certifying body. Used to drive compliance calendar planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015

attributes.name: nonconformance_count
attributes.description: Number of nonconformances or findings identified during the most recent certification audit. Major and minor nonconformances must be resolved before or after certification issuance per certifying body requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17021-1:2015; ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule

attributes.name: offshore_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification applies to offshore operations (True) or onshore operations (False). Offshore certifications are subject to BSEE/BOEM jurisdiction and additional regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; API RP 75

attributes.name: operator_qualification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is an Operator Qualification (OQ) certification for pipeline operations personnel, as required by PHMSA regulations for covered tasks on pipeline facilities.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192 Subpart N; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195 Subpart G; API RP 1161

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification or evidence of certification was submitted to the relevant regulatory authority. Null if regulatory_submission_required is False or submission has not yet occurred.
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/906; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification or evidence of its maintenance must be formally submitted to a regulatory authority (e.g., BSEE SEMS certification submission, SEC SOX certifications filed with annual reports).
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/906; SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the renewal application or re-certification audit must be initiated or completed to maintain continuous certification coverage. Typically set ahead of the expiration date based on certifying body requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; API Standards; BSEE SEMS Rule

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the renewal process for this certification. 'not_required' for certifications that do not expire; 'pending' when renewal has not yet been initiated; 'in_progress' when the renewal audit or application is underway; 'submitted' when the renewal application has been filed; 'approved' when renewal is confirmed; 'rejected' when renewal was denied.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; API Standards

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the organizational scope, geographic boundaries, operational activities, and processes covered by the certification (e.g., 'Offshore drilling operations in Gulf of Mexico including platforms A, B, C', 'Refinery crude distillation and hydrodesulfurization units at Baytown facility').
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 4.3; ISO 45001:2018 Clause 4.3; BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250 Subpart S

attributes.name: sems_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety and Environmental Management System (SEMS) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is associated with the BSEE Safety and Environmental Management System (SEMS) program applicable to offshore oil and gas operations on the U.S. Outer Continental Shelf.
attributes.references: BSEE SEMS Rule 30 CFR Part 250 Subpart S; API RP 75

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is directly associated with a Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control requirement, such as CEO/CFO Section 302 or Section 906 certifications, or certifications supporting SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 906; SEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: standard
attributes.description: The specific standard, regulation, or framework against which the certification is issued (e.g., ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 55001:2014, API RP 75, BSEE SEMS, SOX Section 302, PHMSA OQ, OSHA PSM 29 CFR 1910.119).
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; ISO 55001:2014; API RP 75; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250; Sarbanes-Oxley Act; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: State or province code where the certification applies, using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., US-TX for Texas, US-LA for Louisiana). Relevant for state-level regulatory certifications.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; EPA State Programs; OSHA State Plans

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the certification (e.g., 'ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management System Certification', 'BSEE Safety and Environmental Management System Certification', 'SOX CEO/CFO Section 302 Certification').
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015; ISO 45001:2018; BSEE SEMS Rule; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 302/906

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ISO 14001:2015; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

products.name: release_report
products.description: Transactional record of environmental incidents requiring regulatory notification or reporting including oil spills, produced water releases, air emission exceedances, and NORM releases. Captures incident date, location, media affected (air, water, soil), volume or quantity released, regulatory notification deadlines met, reportable quantity threshold analysis, and remediation actions taken. Distinct from HSE domain safety incidents — this focuses on regulatory environmental reporting obligations.
products.reference: EPA CERCLA Reportable Quantity, BSEE NTL 2010-N10, OPA 90 Spill Reporting, NORM Reporting

attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 302; CERCLA Section 103; EPCRA Section 304

attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS); BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_well. Business justification: Release reports track spills and releases from specific wells. Product has well_api_number text field. Incident investigation and corrective action workflows require linking release reports to the sou

attributes.name: responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Environmental releases (spills, emissions exceedances) require designated incident commander for NRC notification, written report submission, remediation oversight, and regulatory agency coordination.

attributes.name: rig_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.violation. Business justification: Environmental releases often result in regulatory violations (NOVs). The release_report table has regulatory_penalty_usd suggesting enforcement action but no FK to violation. Adding violation_id FK li

attributes.name: applicable_regulation
attributes.description: Primary regulatory citation governing the reporting obligation for this release (e.g., CERCLA Section 103, EPCRA Section 304, OPA 90 Section 4201, Clean Water Act Section 311, BSEE 30 CFR Part 254, PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195.52). Used for compliance obligation traceability and regulatory audit support.
attributes.references: CERCLA; EPCRA; OPA 90; Clean Water Act; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the jurisdiction where the release occurred. Supports international operations reporting, host country regulatory notification, and ESG environmental disclosure aggregation across multinational operations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources; ESG reporting frameworks

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this release report record was first created in the compliance data system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 55001 Asset Management; NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: discovery_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the release was first discovered or detected by company personnel, SCADA system, or third party. May differ from incident_datetime (when the release actually began). The discovery timestamp is the trigger point for regulatory notification deadline clocks under CERCLA, EPCRA, and OPA 90.
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 103(a); EPCRA Section 304(b); OPA 90 Section 4201; EPA 40 CFR Part 302.6

attributes.name: enablon_incident_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this regulatory release report to the corresponding incident record in the Enablon HSE Management system, which serves as the operational system of record for HSE incident management, permit to work, and environmental compliance tracking. Enables cross-system traceability between the compliance data product and the source HSE system.
attributes.references: Enablon HSE Management system integration; ISO 14001 Environmental Management System; OSHA 29 CFR 1904 recordkeeping

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility, well site, pipeline segment, refinery unit, or offshore platform where the environmental release occurred. Denormalized for reporting convenience and regulatory submission forms where the facility name must appear directly on the report.
attributes.references: EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS); BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; API RP 75 Offshore Safety

attributes.name: ghg_emission_co2e_tonnes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Emission in CO2 Equivalent Tonnes
attributes.description: Estimated greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in CO2 equivalent tonnes resulting from the release event, applicable for gas releases (methane, VOCs) subject to EPA GHG reporting under 40 CFR Part 98. Required for ESG environmental disclosure, EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP), and OPEC/IEA emissions tracking.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 GHGRP; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ESG reporting frameworks; SEC climate disclosure rules

attributes.name: incident_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Release Incident Date and Time
attributes.description: Date and time when the environmental release event occurred or was first detected, recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. This is the principal real-world event timestamp used for regulatory notification deadline calculations and compliance reporting. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 302.6; CERCLA Section 103; EPCRA Section 304(b)

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the environmental release incident including circumstances, sequence of events, immediate response actions taken, and any relevant operational context. Used for regulatory submission narratives, internal investigation reports, and ESG disclosure summaries.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; EPCRA Section 304(c) written follow-up report requirements

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier assigned to the environmental release incident at the time of initial notification. Used for cross-referencing with regulatory agency submissions, Enablon HSE Management incident records, and internal compliance tracking. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 302; EPCRA Section 304; Enablon HSE Management incident numbering convention

attributes.name: initial_notification_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Regulatory Notification Date and Time
attributes.description: Date and time when the initial verbal or written notification was made to the National Response Center (NRC), EPA, BSEE, state agency, or other required regulatory body. Used to calculate notification timeliness compliance against the regulatory deadline (typically within 24 hours of discovery for CERCLA/EPCRA).
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 103(a) — 24-hour NRC notification; EPCRA Section 304(b); OPA 90 Section 4201; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254.46

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the release location. Required for GIS mapping, spill trajectory modeling, regulatory notification forms, and emergency response dispatch. Positive values indicate North latitude.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112 SPCC; OPA 90; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; WGS84 datum standard

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the release location. Required for GIS mapping, spill trajectory modeling, regulatory notification forms, and emergency response dispatch. Negative values indicate West longitude.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112 SPCC; OPA 90; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; WGS84 datum standard

attributes.name: notification_deadline_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regulatory Notification Deadline Date and Time
attributes.description: Calculated deadline by which the initial regulatory notification must be made, based on discovery_datetime plus the applicable regulatory timeframe (e.g., 24 hours for CERCLA NRC notification, 15 minutes for BSEE offshore spills). Used for compliance monitoring and deadline tracking.
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 103(a); EPCRA Section 304(b); BSEE 30 CFR Part 254.46; OPA 90

attributes.name: notification_deadline_met
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the initial regulatory notification was made within the required timeframe. A value of False indicates a potential regulatory violation requiring documentation of root cause and corrective action. Critical for compliance audit and penalty risk assessment.
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 103; EPCRA Section 304; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; EPA enforcement policy

attributes.name: nrc_report_number
attributes.description: Report number assigned by the National Response Center (NRC) upon receipt of the initial verbal notification for releases meeting CERCLA or OPA 90 reportable quantity thresholds. Serves as the official federal tracking number for the spill notification and is required on follow-up written reports.
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 103; OPA 90 Section 4201; NRC — U.S. Coast Guard operated; EPA 40 CFR Part 302.6

attributes.name: offshore_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the release occurred on an offshore facility (OCS — Outer Continental Shelf) subject to BSEE and BOEM jurisdiction, as opposed to onshore facilities regulated by EPA and state agencies. Determines applicable regulatory reporting pathway and notification recipients.
attributes.references: BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; BOEM 30 CFR Part 550; OPA 90 Section 4201; Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act

attributes.name: recovered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the released substance that was recovered through containment, skimming, vacuum recovery, or other response measures, expressed in the same unit as release_quantity_unit. Net environmental impact is calculated as release_quantity minus recovered_quantity. Required for OPA 90 and BSEE spill response reporting.
attributes.references: OPA 90 Section 4201; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; EPA 40 CFR Part 112; NCP — National Contingency Plan

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: Primary regulatory agency to which the release report is submitted or notified. Determines the applicable reporting form, submission portal, and regulatory requirements. Multiple agencies may be notified for a single incident; this field captures the primary lead agency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EPA|BSEE|BOEM|PHMSA|USCG|OSHA|state_agency|multiple|NRC|FERC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Parts 110, 112, 302; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; USCG 33 CFR Part 153

attributes.name: release_cause
attributes.description: Narrative description of the root cause or contributing factors that led to the environmental release (e.g., corrosion failure, mechanical failure, operator error, third-party damage, natural disaster, overpressure event). Supports root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and regulatory investigation response.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 195; API RP 1175; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254

attributes.name: release_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated or measured duration of the release event in hours, from the time the release began (incident_datetime) to the time it was contained or stopped. Used for total volume estimation, environmental impact assessment, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112; OPA 90; BSEE 30 CFR Part 254; API RP 1175

attributes.name: release_medium
attributes.description: Environmental medium or media affected by the release event. Determines applicable regulatory reporting frameworks: surface water and marine releases trigger Clean Water Act and OPA 90 obligations; air releases trigger Clean Air Act Title V and EPCRA Section 304 obligations; soil releases trigger RCRA and CERCLA obligations.
attributes.references: Clean Water Act Section 311; OPA 90; Clean Air Act Title V; CERCLA; RCRA

attributes.name: release_quantity
attributes.description: Measured or estimated quantity of the substance released to the environment. Used for reportable quantity (RQ) threshold analysis under CERCLA/EPCRA and for regulatory notification determination. Satisfies QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role (non-monetary transaction).
attributes.references: CERCLA Section 102; EPA 40 CFR Part 302 Table 302.4; EPCRA Section 304

attributes.name: release_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the release quantity field. Common units include barrels (BBL) for crude oil spills, pounds for chemical releases under CERCLA/EPCRA reportable quantity thresholds, and cubic feet for gas releases. Paired with release_quantity for complete measurement.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 302; CERCLA Section 102; API RP 1175 Pipeline Leak Detection

attributes.name: release_source
attributes.description: Specific source or equipment from which the environmental release originated. Used for root cause analysis, equipment failure trending, and SPCC/FRP plan updates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pipeline|storage_tank|wellhead|process_equipment|vessel|loading_facility|flare|separator|compressor|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 112 SPCC; API RP 1175 Pipeline Leak Detection; BSEE 30 CFR Part 250

attributes.name: release_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of environmental release event. Oil spill covers crude oil and refined product releases; produced water covers brine and formation water discharges; air emission exceedance covers permit limit violations; NORM (Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material) covers radioactive scale and sludge releases; gas release covers uncontrolled hydrocarbon gas venting or fugitive emissions. domains.name: procurement
