attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this company code ceased operations or was deactivated for financial postings. Null if the company code is still active. Used for historical reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: elimination_company_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this company code is used exclusively for intercompany elimination entries during consolidation. True if this is an elimination company; false if it is an operating entity.

attributes.name: field_status_variant
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the field status control rules for financial document entry in this company code. Determines which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during transaction posting, supporting data quality and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Field Status Variant Configuration

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the fiscal year calendar structure for this company code, including the number of periods, period start/end dates, and year-end closing rules. Aligns with statutory reporting requirements and internal management reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: gaap_framework
attributes.description: Primary accounting framework used for statutory financial reporting. IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards), US GAAP (United States Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), or local GAAP as required by the country of incorporation.
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation, FASB Accounting Standards Codification

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_assignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured identifier of intercompany trading partner company codes with which this entity has regular intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation, netting, and elimination processes.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, SAP S/4HANA Intercompany Reconciliation

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this company code record. Supports audit trail and change management requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this company code record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404, SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: legal_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity structure. IOC (International Oil Company) subsidiary, NOC (National Oil Company) subsidiary, joint venture entity, holding company, special purpose vehicle (SPV), or branch office.

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency of the company code. All financial transactions are recorded in this currency for statutory reporting and local GAAP compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: posting_period_variant
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the number of posting periods and special periods (e.g., year-end adjustment periods) for this company code. Controls the opening and closing of accounting periods for transaction posting and period-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Variant Configuration

attributes.name: profit_center_required_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether profit center assignment is mandatory for financial postings in this company code. Profit centers enable internal management reporting, profitability analysis, and segment performance evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the legal registered address of the company code as filed with regulatory authorities. Used for statutory correspondence, legal notices, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the legal registered address, typically containing building name, suite number, or additional location details.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the legal registered address.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the legal registered address. Relevant for jurisdictions with state-level tax or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the group reporting currency used for consolidated financial statements and management reporting. Transactions are translated from local currency to reporting currency for consolidation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: sec_cik_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Central Index Key (CIK) Number
attributes.description: Ten-digit Central Index Key (CIK) number assigned by the SEC to identify the registrant for EDGAR filings and public disclosures. Null if not an SEC registrant.

attributes.name: sec_registrant_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registrant Indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this company code is a registrant with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and subject to SEC financial disclosure and reserves reporting requirements under Regulation S-X and S-K.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X, SEC Regulation S-K

attributes.name: sox_scope_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this company code is within the scope of Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) compliance testing and internal control certification. True if SOX controls apply; false otherwise.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Tax authority jurisdiction code or identifier where the company code is registered for tax purposes. Determines applicable tax rates, filing requirements, and compliance obligations for income tax, VAT, sales tax, and other statutory taxes.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: valuation_area
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the organizational level at which material and inventory valuation is performed. Typically aligned with the company code for legal valuation purposes, supporting IFRS IAS 2 Inventories and LIFO/FIFO/weighted average costing methods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Valuation, IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Transactional header record of every general ledger posting in the oil and gas enterprise, representing the atomic document unit of financial accounting. Captures journal entry number, posting date, document date, document type (original entry, accrual, reversal, intercompany, allocation, reclassification), company code, fiscal year, fiscal period, reference document, currency, exchange rate, reversal indicator, parking/hold status, and SOX control reference. Each journal entry contains one or more journal_entry_line items carrying the debit/credit detail. Supports IFRS/GAAP oil and gas accounting including DD&A postings, successful efforts write-offs, production revenue accruals, cost allocations, and intercompany eliminations. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-GL (BKPF header).

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the journal entry header record. Primary key for the journal entry transaction.

attributes.name: commercial_term_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.term_contract. Business justification: Journal entries reference term contracts for revenue recognition (ASC 606), contract liability adjustments, accruals, and deferrals. Required for contract accounting, audit trail, and financial statem

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Every journal entry is posted to a legal entity (company code). The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id for referential integrity

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries can have a default cost center at header level (inherited by lines if not overridden). The existing cost_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Created By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SOX compliance and financial audit requirements mandate tracking who created each journal entry. Essential for segregation of duties analysis, fraud detection, and audit trail in Oil & Gas financial r

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Journal entries can be charged against AFEs for capital project accounting. The existing afe_number STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to finance_afe.finance_afe_id to enable AFE-lev

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entries can have a default profit center at header level (inherited by lines if not overridden). The existing profit_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to profit_cente

attributes.name: spot_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commercial.spot_trade. Business justification: Spot trade settlements generate journal entries for revenue/cost recognition and mark-to-market adjustments. Required for trade accounting, P&L reconciliation, audit trail, and financial statement pre

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal entries can be linked to WBS elements for project-level financial postings. The existing wbs_element STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to enabl

attributes.name: allocation_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is the result of an automated cost allocation, distribution, or assessment cycle. True for allocation postings; False for direct manual or transactional postings.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset (well, facility, equipment, pipeline) to which this journal entry relates. Used for asset capitalization, depreciation (DD&A), and asset retirement obligation (ARO) tracking.

attributes.name: batch_input_session
attributes.description: Name of the batch input session if this journal entry was created through batch processing or mass upload. Used to trace entries back to their batch source for error resolution and audit.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Code identifying the business area or segment (Upstream E&P, Midstream, Downstream Refining, Petrochemicals) for segment reporting and internal management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the exact date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the document currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated. All line items within the entry share this currency.

attributes.name: dd_and_a_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents a DD&A posting for oil and gas assets. True for DD&A entries calculated using unit-of-production or straight-line methods; False for other entries.
attributes.references: IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the original source document or invoice that gave rise to this journal entry. May differ from posting date. Used for document tracking, audit trail, and reconciliation with external parties.

attributes.name: document_header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field providing a brief description or explanation of the business purpose of the journal entry. Visible at header level and inherited by all line items unless overridden.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit accounting document number assigned by the system or entered manually. Serves as the business identifier for the journal entry within the company code and fiscal year. Unique within company code and fiscal year combination.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the business transaction type of the journal entry. Controls document number ranges, account types allowed, and posting behavior. Common types: SA (General Ledger), AB (Accounting Document), AF (Depreciation Posting), DR (Customer Invoice), KR (Vendor Invoice), RE (Invoice Receipt), RV (Reversal), ZP (Payment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|AF|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KR|KZ|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the journal entry was physically entered into the system by the user. Used for audit trail and internal control monitoring.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert document currency amounts to local company code currency and group reporting currency. Expressed as units of local currency per one unit of document currency. Null if document currency equals local currency.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric fiscal period (1-16) within the fiscal year to which this journal entry is posted. Periods 1-12 represent regular monthly periods; periods 13-16 are special periods for year-end adjustments and closing entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Variant

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned based on the posting date and the company code fiscal year variant. Used for period-based reporting and year-end closing processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Code representing the functional area or business function (Exploration, Drilling, Production, Refining, Marketing, HSE, G&A) for cost of sales and functional expense classification in financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between two or more company codes within the enterprise. True for intercompany postings requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the internal order used to collect costs for a specific purpose (maintenance campaign, turnaround, workover). Used for short-term cost tracking and budget monitoring.

attributes.name: joint_venture_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture, production sharing agreement (PSA), or joint operating agreement (JOA) to which this journal entry relates. Used for partner billing, cost recovery, and revenue distribution.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this journal entry. Null if the entry has never been modified after initial creation. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the exact date and time when this journal entry was last modified. Null if never modified. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the ledger or ledger group to which this journal entry is posted. Supports parallel accounting for different accounting principles (IFRS, GAAP, tax ledger). Default is leading ledger (0L).

attributes.name: parking_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the journal entry is parked (saved but not yet posted), posted (committed to the general ledger), or held (temporarily suspended pending approval). Parked documents do not update account balances until posted.

attributes.name: partner_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage share of costs or revenues allocated to a specific joint venture partner in this journal entry. Used for joint interest billing (JIB) and partner netting calculations. Null for non-JV transactions.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger and becomes effective for financial reporting. Determines the fiscal period and fiscal year for the transaction. Used for period-end closing and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: posting_key_indicator
attributes.description: Two-digit code that controls the type of posting (debit or credit) and the account type (General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset). Inherited by line items but captured at header for summary control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key Configuration

attributes.name: reference_document
attributes.description: Free-text field containing the reference number of an external document, invoice, purchase order, Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) number, or other source document that originated this journal entry. Used for cross-referencing and audit trail.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted document. True if this entry reverses another entry; False for original postings.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Two-digit code indicating the business reason for reversing the original document. Common codes: 01 (Reversal in current period), 02 (Reversal in prior period), 03 (Correction), 04 (Accrual reversal), 05 (Other). Null for non-reversal entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason Configuration

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original journal entry that is being reversed by this entry. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Establishes audit trail linkage between original and reversing entries.

attributes.name: sox_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this journal entry to a specific SOX internal control or control activity. Used for SOX compliance testing, audit sampling, and control effectiveness monitoring.

attributes.name: successful_efforts_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is related to successful efforts accounting treatment (capitalization of successful wells, expensing of dry holes). True for successful efforts postings; False otherwise.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 932 Extractive Activities - Oil and Gas

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and consolidation elimination entries. Null for non-intercompany transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code (T-code) used to create or post this journal entry. Examples: FB01 (Post Document), FB50 (G/L Account Posting), F-02 (General Posting). Used for audit trail and user activity analysis.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual line item within a general ledger journal entry, capturing the debit or credit posting to a specific GL account with full cost object assignment. Captures line item number, GL account, posting key (debit/credit), amount in transaction currency, amount in company code currency, cost center, profit center, WBS element, internal order, asset number, tax code, assignment field, text, business area, cost element, quantity, unit of measure, and business transaction type. Serves as the unified actual cost record for all financial and controlling postings — including LOE, CAPEX actuals, overhead allocations, and depreciation charges. Supports granular cost allocation across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations and LOE per BOE analysis when joined with production data. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-GL (BSEG) and CO actual line items (COEP).
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry Line Item (BSEG)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL BSEG table structure

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be allocated to cost centers for detailed cost tracking. The existing cost_center_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost_center_id to ena

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Every journal entry line posts to a GL account. The existing gl_account_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to gl_account.gl_account_id to enable chart of accounts validation, fi

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header document. Links this line item to the overall journal entry batch and document number.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be allocated to profit centers for detailed profitability analysis. The existing profit_center_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to profit_center.profit

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: JE lines for PO accruals, adjustments, and reclassifications must reference PO for audit trail and accrual reconciliation. Standard accrual accounting for oil & gas procurement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: JE lines for vendor accruals, adjustments, and manual postings need direct vendor reference for reconciliation and vendor account management. Real month-end close requirement in oil & gas.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal entry lines can be linked to WBS elements for project-level cost tracking. The existing wbs_element_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs_element.wbs_element_id to e

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The fixed asset number for asset-related postings including CAPEX capitalization, depreciation, and asset retirement. Links to wells, facilities, pipelines, and equipment in the asset register.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Asset Accounting, SEC/IFRS fixed asset accounting

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: The subnumber or component identifier within a main asset. Used for tracking individual components or sub-assets within a larger asset structure.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field for additional reference information such as well name, lease number, AFE number, or vendor invoice number. Used for reconciliation and drill-down analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date
attributes.description: The baseline date from which payment terms are calculated for AP/AR line items. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area classification for cross-company code segment reporting. Represents upstream (E&P), midstream (transportation), downstream (refining), or petrochemical business segments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area, IFRS 8 operating segment disclosure

attributes.name: business_transaction_type
attributes.description: The business transaction type code that classifies the nature of the posting. Examples include CAPEX, OPEX, LOE, DD&A, revenue, inventory movement, and intercompany transfer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BSEG-VRGNG, COPAS transaction classification

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared through payment, offset, or other settlement. Null for uncleared items.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the clearing transaction that settled this open item. Links to the payment or offset document.

attributes.name: company_code_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item converted to the company code local currency. Used for financial statement preparation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BSEG-DMBTR, IFRS/GAAP functional currency reporting

attributes.name: company_code_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the local currency of the company code. Used for statutory reporting and consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS/GAAP local currency reporting

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: The controlling cost element that mirrors the GL account for cost accounting purposes. Used for primary and secondary cost allocation in CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Explicit indicator of whether this line item represents a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Derived from posting key but stored for query performance.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the source document (invoice date, receipt date, contract date). May differ from posting date for backdated or future-dated transactions.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: The functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting. Distinguishes between production, exploration, development, G&A, and marketing expenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area, IFRS/GAAP functional expense classification

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item converted to the group reporting currency. Supports consolidated financial statements and enterprise-wide analytics.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the reporting currency of the corporate group. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, IFRS consolidation requirements

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: The internal order number for overhead cost collection and allocation. Used for tracking indirect costs, maintenance orders, and short-term cost objects that are not full projects.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the journal entry document. Determines the ordering and position of this line within the parent entry.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text providing additional context for this journal entry line item. May include vendor name, invoice description, or transaction narrative.

attributes.name: partner_profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center of the trading partner for intercompany profit elimination and transfer pricing analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA partner profit center, IFRS consolidation requirements

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code for accounts payable and receivable line items. Determines due date calculation and cash discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP/AR payment terms configuration

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this line item is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period and year for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BSEG-BUDAT, IFRS/GAAP transaction date requirements

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code that determines whether the line item is a debit or credit posting and controls the account type and field status. Standard values include 40 (debit GL), 50 (credit GL), 01 (debit customer), 11 (credit customer), 21 (debit vendor), 31 (credit vendor).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Key configuration

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity associated with this line item for quantity-based postings. Used for inventory movements, production volumes, and unit cost calculations.

attributes.name: reference_key_1
attributes.description: First reference key field for customer-defined reference information. Often used for well identifier, lease code, or joint venture partner reference.

attributes.name: reference_key_2
attributes.description: Second reference key field for customer-defined reference information. May contain AFE number, production month, or cost category code.

attributes.name: reference_key_3
attributes.description: Third reference key field for customer-defined reference information. Supports additional dimensional analysis such as reservoir zone or product stream.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction that negated this line item. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this line item has been reversed. True if the posting has been negated by a subsequent reversal document.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code that determines the tax calculation procedure and tax accounts for this line item. Handles sales tax, use tax, VAT, and excise taxes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TV Tax Configuration, jurisdiction-specific tax regulations

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction identifier for multi-jurisdictional tax reporting. Captures state, county, and local tax authorities for severance tax and production tax compliance.
attributes.references: State and local tax authority codes, PHMSA jurisdiction identifiers

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: The trading partner identifier for intercompany and joint venture transactions. Used for elimination entries in consolidation and partner netting in JIB processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA intercompany accounting, COPAS JIB partner netting

attributes.name: transaction_currency_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item in the original transaction currency. Positive for debits, negative for credits in some system configurations.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the original transaction was denominated. May differ from company code currency for foreign currency transactions.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field. Common values include BBL (barrels), MCF (thousand cubic feet), MT (metric tons), GAL (gallons), and EA (each).
attributes.references: API measurement standards, ISO 80000 quantities and units

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The value date for cash management and bank reconciliation. Represents the date funds are available or debited from bank accounts.

products.name: finance_afe
products.description: Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) master record representing the formal capital or expense budget authorization for a specific oil and gas project or well. Captures AFE number, AFE title, AFE type (drilling, workover, facility construction, pipeline, EOR project), well or facility reference, operator, working interest (WI) percentage, gross AFE amount, net AFE amount, CAPEX/OPEX classification, AFE status (proposed, approved, active, closed, over-run), approval date, spud date, expected completion date, and cost code breakdown. Integrates with SAP Joint Venture Accounting for partner cost sharing and JIB billing.

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Authorization for Expenditure record. Primary key for the finance AFE product.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: AFE approval authority tracking is critical for capital expenditure governance in Oil & Gas. Regulatory and JOA requirements mandate documented approval chains. Links financial authorization to specif

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: AFEs can be charged to cost centers for expense tracking and organizational cost allocation. The existing cost_center_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost_cent

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operating company responsible for executing the AFE project and managing day-to-day operations under the Joint Operating Agreement (JOA).

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AFEs post to GL accounts for financial statement capitalization. The existing gl_account_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to gl_account.gl_account_id to enable AFE capitalizat

attributes.name: superseded_afe_finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous AFE record that this AFE supersedes or revises, enabling tracking of AFE revision history and budget change audit trail.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: AFEs can be linked to WBS elements for project-level cost tracking and integration with project management systems. The existing wbs_element STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to wbs

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the AFE project was completed and closed out, enabling variance analysis between planned and actual timelines.

attributes.name: actual_cost_to_date
attributes.description: The cumulative actual costs incurred against this AFE as of the current reporting date, enabling budget-versus-actual variance tracking and over-run detection.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique business identifier for the AFE, used for tracking and reference across joint venture partners and in Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statements.

attributes.name: afe_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AFE, tracking its progression from proposal through approval, execution, and closure. Over-run status indicates actual costs have exceeded the authorized budget. products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master record for all capitalized assets in the oil and gas enterprise including wells, pipelines, processing facilities, FPSOs, compressors, and refinery units. Captures asset number, asset description, asset class (oil and gas properties, machinery, buildings, vehicles), company code, cost center, WBS element, capitalization date, acquisition value, accumulated depreciation, net book value, depreciation key (unit of production, straight-line, declining balance), useful life, depletion unit (BOE), asset status (active, under construction, retired, abandoned), SEC proved property classification, last depreciation run date, depreciation area values (book, tax, IFRS), and retirement/abandonment details. products.name: project_economics
products.description: Financial economics master record for oil and gas capital projects capturing NPV, IRR, DCF, and payback period calculations used for investment decision-making and portfolio management. Captures project economics ID, project reference, evaluation date, discount rate, risk-adjusted discount rate, gross NPV, net NPV (WI-adjusted), IRR, payback period (years), peak CAPEX, total CAPEX, total OPEX, total LOE, gross revenue, net revenue (NRI-adjusted), BOE reserves (1P/2P/3P), finding and development cost (F&D cost per BOE), reserve replacement ratio, and economic limit date. Supports AFE justification, portfolio ranking, and SEC reserves economics.

attributes.name: project_economics_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project economics evaluation record.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Investment decision governance requires linking economics approval to specific employee. Essential for capital allocation decisions, FID (Final Investment Decision) documentation, and management accou

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Project economics are calculated for AFEs (capital projects). The existing afe_number STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to finance_afe.finance_afe_id to enable linking economic anal

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project being evaluated. Links to the master project record in the project management system.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the project economics evaluation was formally approved for capital allocation.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval status of the project economics evaluation in the AFE and capital allocation workflow.

attributes.name: boe_reserves_1p
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Reserves - Proved (1P)
attributes.description: The proved reserves in barrels of oil equivalent. Reserves with reasonable certainty of being recoverable under existing economic and operating conditions.
attributes.references: SPE PRMS, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: boe_reserves_2p
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Reserves - Proved Plus Probable (2P)
attributes.description: The proved plus probable reserves in barrels of oil equivalent. Includes proved reserves plus reserves with greater than 50% probability of recovery.

attributes.name: boe_reserves_3p
attributes.business_glossary_term: Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE) Reserves - Proved Plus Probable Plus Possible (3P)
attributes.description: The proved plus probable plus possible reserves in barrels of oil equivalent. Includes all reserve categories with at least 10% probability of recovery.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments and notes regarding the economic evaluation, assumptions, or special considerations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this project economics record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this evaluation (e.g., USD, GBP, CAD).

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The base discount rate applied to future cash flows for NPV calculation, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10%).

attributes.name: economic_limit_date
attributes.description: The projected date when the project reaches its economic limit and production is no longer profitable. Used for abandonment planning.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this economic evaluation was performed. Critical for time-series analysis of project economics.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: The type of economic evaluation being performed: initial assessment, revised forecast, final economics, annual review, or reforecast.

attributes.name: finding_and_development_cost_per_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Finding and Development (F&D) Cost per Barrel of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The finding and development cost per BOE. Total exploration and development costs divided by reserves added. Key metric for portfolio efficiency.

attributes.name: first_production_date
attributes.description: The projected or actual date of first commercial production from the project.

attributes.name: gas_price_assumption
attributes.description: The natural gas price assumption used in the economic evaluation, typically in USD per thousand cubic feet (MCF) or million British thermal units (MMBTU).

attributes.name: gross_npv
attributes.description: The gross net present value of the project before working interest adjustments. Represents the total economic value at the discount rate.

attributes.name: gross_revenue
attributes.description: The total gross revenue from hydrocarbon sales over the project lifecycle before royalties and working interest adjustments.

attributes.name: irr
attributes.description: The internal rate of return for the project, expressed as a percentage. The discount rate at which NPV equals zero.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that last modified this project economics record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this project economics record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_npv
attributes.description: The net present value adjusted for working interest ownership. Represents the company's share of project economics.

attributes.name: net_revenue
attributes.description: The net revenue after net revenue interest adjustments. Represents the company's share of revenue after royalties and burdens.

attributes.name: net_revenue_interest
attributes.description: The company's net revenue interest percentage after royalties and overriding royalty interests, expressed as a percentage. Determines revenue share.

attributes.name: oil_price_assumption
attributes.description: The oil price assumption used in the economic evaluation, typically in USD per barrel. May reference WTI or Brent benchmark.

attributes.name: payback_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years required to recover the initial capital investment from net cash flows.

attributes.name: peak_capex
attributes.description: The maximum annual capital expenditure required during the project lifecycle. Critical for cash flow planning.

attributes.name: price_deck_scenario
attributes.description: The price deck scenario used for the evaluation: base case corporate assumptions, high case, low case, SEC pricing rules, or current spot pricing.

attributes.name: project_life_years
attributes.description: The total economic life of the project in years from first production to economic limit.

attributes.name: reserve_replacement_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of reserves added to reserves produced during the period. A ratio above 1.0 indicates reserves are being replaced faster than production.

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_discount_rate
attributes.description: The risk-adjusted discount rate incorporating project-specific risk factors, expressed as a percentage. Used for risk-weighted NPV calculations.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_category
attributes.description: The overall risk category assigned to the project based on technical, commercial, and operational risk factors.

attributes.name: sensitivity_analysis_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether sensitivity analysis on key variables (price, reserves, costs) was performed as part of this evaluation.

attributes.name: total_capex
attributes.description: The total capital expenditure over the project lifecycle including drilling, completion, facilities, and infrastructure costs.

attributes.name: total_loe
attributes.description: The total lease operating expense over the project lifecycle. Direct costs of operating producing properties.

attributes.name: total_opex
attributes.description: The total operating expenditure over the project lifecycle including production operations, maintenance, and overhead.

attributes.name: working_interest
attributes.description: The company's working interest percentage in the project, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 65.00 for 65%). Determines cost-bearing obligation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system identifier that created this project economics record.

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of intercompany financial transactions between legal entities within the oil and gas enterprise, including crude oil transfers, gas sales, service charges, management fees, and loan interest. Captures intercompany transaction ID, transaction date, sending company code, receiving company code, transaction type (product transfer, service charge, loan, dividend, royalty), GL account, amount, currency, exchange rate, netting indicator, elimination status, and reconciliation reference. Supports intercompany elimination for consolidated financial statements under IFRS 10 and SOX intercompany reconciliation controls.
products.reference: IFRS 10 Intercompany Elimination / SAP FI Intercompany

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be allocated to cost centers for cross-entity cost allocation. The existing cost_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to cost_center.cost_center_id

attributes.name: finance_afe_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.finance_afe. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be charged against AFEs for cross-entity capital project cost tracking. The existing afe_number STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to finance_afe.financ

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Intercompany transactions post to GL accounts. The existing gl_account STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to gl_account.gl_account_id to enable intercompany GL account analysis and e

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be allocated to profit centers for cross-entity profitability analysis. The existing profit_center STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to profit_center.p

attributes.name: sending_company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Intercompany transactions have a sending legal entity. The existing sending_company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable intercompany rec

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit or operating segment associated with the intercompany transaction for segment reporting and performance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the financial system.

attributes.name: elimination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was eliminated in the consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: elimination_status
attributes.description: The current status of the intercompany transaction in the consolidation elimination process (pending elimination, eliminated in consolidation, excluded from elimination, or flagged for manual review).

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction amount from the transaction currency to the group reporting currency at the time of the transaction.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the transaction is recorded.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recorded for financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the group reporting currency (typically USD) using the exchange rate for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: A free-text description providing additional details about the nature, purpose, or context of the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: jib_reference
attributes.description: The JIB reference number if the intercompany transaction is related to joint venture operations and joint interest billing processes.
attributes.references: COPAS JIB Guidelines; SAP Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was last modified or updated in the financial system.

attributes.name: netting_group
attributes.description: The netting group identifier used to aggregate intercompany transactions for multilateral netting settlement processes.

attributes.name: netting_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transaction is subject to intercompany netting processes to reduce the number of cross-border payments (True if subject to netting, False otherwise).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the intercompany transaction was settled or paid.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the intercompany transaction amount is due for payment from the receiving entity to the sending entity.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: A reference identifier linking this transaction to the payment record or bank transfer used to settle the intercompany obligation.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of the intercompany transaction (unpaid, partially paid, paid in full, overdue, or waived).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms agreed upon for settling the intercompany transaction (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Due on Receipt).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the transaction was posted to the general ledger for accounting period assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date Standard

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The category of product or service involved in the intercompany transaction (e.g., crude oil, natural gas, NGL, refined products, petrochemicals, technical services, administrative services) for product-level analysis.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The physical quantity of product transferred in the intercompany transaction, if applicable (e.g., barrels of crude oil, MCF of natural gas).

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the legal entity that is the receiver or beneficiary of the intercompany transaction (e.g., the entity receiving crude oil, services, or loan proceeds).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference
attributes.description: A reference identifier linking this transaction to the corresponding intercompany reconciliation record or matching transaction in the counterparty entity's books.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The status of the intercompany transaction reconciliation between the sending and receiving entities (matched, unmatched, disputed, resolved, or pending review).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Internal Controls; COPAS Guidelines

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax (e.g., VAT, GST, withholding tax) associated with the intercompany transaction, if applicable.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 12 - Income Taxes; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code that determines the tax treatment and rate applicable to the intercompany transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration; Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency before any adjustments or eliminations.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the intercompany transaction was originally denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date on which the intercompany transaction was executed or recorded in the financial system.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number assigned to the intercompany transaction for external reference and reconciliation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number Standard

attributes.name: transaction_subtype
attributes.description: A more granular classification within the transaction type to further specify the nature of the intercompany activity (e.g., crude oil transfer, natural gas transfer, technical services, administrative services, short-term loan, long-term loan).

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: The category of intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the business activity (e.g., crude oil or NGL product transfer, service charge, management fee, intercompany loan, dividend distribution, royalty payment, overhead allocation, interest charge, lease payment, or cost recharge). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_transfer|service_charge|management_fee|loan|dividend|royalty|overhead_allocation|interest_charge|lease_payment|recharge — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IFRS 10 - Consolidated Financial Statements; COPAS Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: transfer_price_documentation
attributes.description: A reference to the transfer pricing documentation or study that supports the pricing methodology and arm's length nature of the intercompany transaction.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: transfer_price_method
attributes.description: The transfer pricing methodology applied to determine the intercompany transaction price (e.g., cost plus markup, market price, negotiated price, resale minus, comparable uncontrolled price) for tax compliance and arm's length pricing.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; IRS Section 482

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity transferred (e.g., BBL for barrels, BOE for barrel of oil equivalent, MCF for thousand cubic feet, MMCF for million cubic feet, MT for metric tons, GAL for gallons, LB for pounds, KG for kilograms). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BBL|BOE|MCF|MMCF|MT|GAL|LB|KG — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The price per unit of product or service in the intercompany transaction, used to calculate the total transaction amount.

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Transactional record of income tax provisions, deferred tax assets/liabilities, and tax accruals for oil and gas operations across jurisdictions. Captures tax provision ID, fiscal period, company code, jurisdiction (federal, state, country), tax type (corporate income tax, production tax, severance tax, windfall profit tax, resource rent tax), current tax expense, deferred tax expense, deferred tax asset, deferred tax liability, effective tax rate, statutory tax rate, temporary difference, and tax basis. Supports IFRS/GAAP tax accounting (IAS 12 / ASC 740) and SEC financial disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax provision record. Primary key for the tax provision entity.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes, ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Tax provisions are calculated for legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level tax report

attributes.name: preparer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Tax provision preparer accountability is critical for tax compliance governance. Links tax calculation to specific employee for deferred tax analysis and audit support in Oil & Gas tax reporting.

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard under which the tax provision is prepared. IFRS follows IAS 12, US GAAP follows ASC 740, and local GAAP follows jurisdiction-specific standards.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes, ASC 740 Income Taxes

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Status of tax authority audit for this jurisdiction and period. Tracks whether the tax position is under examination by tax authorities (IRS, state revenue departments, international tax authorities).

attributes.name: book_basis_amount
attributes.description: The financial statement carrying amount (book basis) of the underlying asset or liability. The difference between book basis and tax basis creates the temporary difference.

attributes.name: carryforward_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax loss carryforward or tax credit carryforward expires if not utilized. Some jurisdictions allow indefinite carryforwards; others have time limits (e.g., 20 years).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tax provision record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this tax provision record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP, EUR). All amounts are recorded in this currency.

attributes.name: current_tax_expense
attributes.description: The amount of income tax expense for the current period based on taxable income. Represents taxes payable or refundable for the current year.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_asset
attributes.description: The amount of income taxes recoverable in future periods related to deductible temporary differences, tax loss carryforwards, and tax credit carryforwards. Common in oil and gas for Depreciation Depletion and Amortization (DD&A) timing differences and Abandoned and Dry Hole (ADH) costs.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense
attributes.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit related to changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities. Represents the tax effect of temporary differences between book and tax basis.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_liability
attributes.description: The amount of income taxes payable in future periods related to taxable temporary differences. Common in oil and gas for accelerated tax depreciation versus book depreciation and successful efforts versus full cost accounting differences.

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The actual tax rate calculated as total tax expense divided by pretax book income. Expressed as a decimal. Differs from statutory rate due to permanent differences, rate changes, and jurisdictional mix. Key metric for SEC financial disclosure and investor analysis.
attributes.references: IAS 12 Income Taxes paragraph 81, ASC 740-10-50-12, SEC Regulation S-K Item 303

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate used to convert foreign currency tax provisions to the reporting currency. Represents the rate from the local jurisdiction currency to the company reporting currency.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates, ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for which the tax provision applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.
attributes.references: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the tax provision applies. Four-digit year representation.
attributes.references: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, GAAP

attributes.name: interest_on_tax_position
attributes.description: Interest accrued on underpayment or overpayment of taxes, or on uncertain tax positions. Calculated based on applicable jurisdiction interest rates.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (federal, state, country, or local). Format: ISO country code for federal (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR), or country-state for state/provincial (e.g., USA-TX, CAN-AB).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, IRS Publication 515, OECD Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., United States Federal, Texas, Alberta, United Kingdom).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax jurisdiction level: federal (national), state (US state), provincial (Canadian province), country (international), local (county/city), or municipal.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code, OECD Tax Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the tax provision record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking to support SOX compliance.

attributes.name: net_deferred_tax_position
attributes.description: Net deferred tax asset or liability position, calculated as deferred tax asset minus deferred tax liability. Positive values indicate a net asset position; negative values indicate a net liability position.

attributes.name: penalty_on_tax_position
attributes.description: Penalties assessed or accrued related to tax positions, underpayments, or late filings. Common in oil and gas for royalty and severance tax disputes.

attributes.name: permanent_difference
attributes.description: Differences between book income and taxable income that will never reverse. Examples in oil and gas include percentage depletion in excess of cost depletion, non-deductible fines and penalties, and tax-exempt income.

attributes.name: pretax_book_income
attributes.description: Income before income taxes per the financial statements (book income). Used as the starting point for the tax provision calculation and effective tax rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: provision_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax provision. Actual method uses actual year-to-date results, estimated method uses projections, and annualized method estimates full-year effective tax rate applied to interim periods per IAS 34 and ASC 740-270.

attributes.name: provision_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting assumptions, judgments, and significant items in the tax provision calculation. Used to document complex positions such as transfer pricing, Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) interpretations, and uncertain tax positions.

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current status of the tax provision record in the financial close process. Draft provisions are prepared during the close cycle, preliminary provisions are subject to review, final provisions are approved for financial reporting, amended provisions reflect corrections, and audited provisions have been reviewed by external auditors.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who reviewed and approved the tax provision calculation. Required for SOX internal controls over financial reporting.

attributes.name: statute_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statute of limitations expires for this tax period, after which the tax authority can no longer assess additional tax. Typically 3 years from filing date in the US, but varies by jurisdiction.

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The enacted tax rate for the jurisdiction. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Used to calculate the expected tax expense and for effective tax rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_basis_amount
attributes.description: The tax basis of the underlying asset or liability that gives rise to the temporary difference. For oil and gas properties, represents the remaining tax basis for depletion and depreciation purposes under either successful efforts or full cost method.

attributes.name: tax_credit_amount
attributes.description: Tax credits available to reduce current tax liability. Oil and gas specific credits include Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) credits, marginal well credits, Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) credits (Section 45Q), and renewable energy credits.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 43 (EOR), Section 45Q (CCS), ASC 740-10-25-46

attributes.name: tax_loss_carryforward
attributes.description: Net Operating Loss (NOL) available to offset future taxable income. Common in oil and gas during commodity price downturns or for companies with significant exploration and development expenditures.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 172, IAS 12 Income Taxes paragraph 34, ASC 740-10-30-18

attributes.name: tax_return_filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax return for this jurisdiction and period was filed with the tax authority. Used to track filing compliance and statute of limitations.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 6072, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Type of tax for which the provision is recorded. Oil and gas specific types include production tax (tax on volume produced), severance tax (state tax on extraction), windfall profit tax (tax on excess profits), and resource rent tax (tax on economic rent from resources).
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 29, State Severance Tax Statutes, OECD BEPS Guidelines

attributes.name: taxable_income
attributes.description: Income subject to tax as determined under the applicable tax law. Differs from book income due to permanent and temporary differences. For oil and gas, includes adjustments for Intangible Drilling Costs (IDC), depletion methods, and production-based deductions.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Code Section 61, IAS 12 Income Taxes paragraph 5

attributes.name: temporary_difference
attributes.description: Differences between the tax basis and book basis of assets and liabilities that will reverse over time. Common oil and gas temporary differences include DD&A timing, successful efforts versus tax accounting for exploration costs, and Asset Retirement Obligation (ARO) timing.

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: Total income tax expense for the period, calculated as current tax expense plus deferred tax expense. This is the amount reported on the income statement.

attributes.name: unrecognized_tax_benefit
attributes.description: The amount of tax benefit from an uncertain tax position that does not meet the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold. Common in oil and gas for transfer pricing positions, Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) interpretations, and cross-border transactions.

attributes.name: valuation_allowance
attributes.description: Reduction in deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some portion or all of the deferred tax asset will not be realized. Common in oil and gas during commodity price downturns or for marginal properties.

products.name: financial_statement
products.description: Periodic financial statement master record representing the formal financial reports prepared for the oil and gas enterprise including balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, and statement of changes in equity. Captures financial statement ID, statement type (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, equity statement, segment report), reporting period, fiscal year, company code or consolidation group, accounting standard (IFRS, US GAAP), reporting currency, preparation date, approval status, auditor sign-off indicator, restatement flag, and SEC filing reference (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F). Supports SEC financial disclosure, EBITDA reporting, and SOX-compliant financial close.
products.reference: IFRS / US GAAP Financial Statements — SEC 10-K/10-Q

attributes.name: financial_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial statement record. Primary key for the financial statement entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Financial reporting governance requires linking statement approval to specific employee. Critical for SEC filing accountability, SOX certification, and CFO/Controller sign-off documentation in Oil & G

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Financial statements are prepared for legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level financ

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard framework under which the financial statement has been prepared (IFRS, US GAAP, IFRS for SMEs, or local GAAP).
attributes.references: IFRS Foundation, FASB Accounting Standards Codification

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the financial statement was formally approved by management or the board of directors for publication.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 10 Events after the Reporting Period, SOX Section 302

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval and publication status of the financial statement in its lifecycle (draft, pending review, approved, published, or restated).
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 Management Certification, IFRS IAS 10

attributes.name: audit_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the external audit was completed and the audit report was signed by the auditor.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: The name of the external audit firm that performed the independent audit of the financial statement.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, IFRS IAS 1, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: auditor_opinion
attributes.description: The type of audit opinion issued by the external auditor (unqualified/clean, qualified, adverse, or disclaimer of opinion).
attributes.references: ISA 700 Forming an Opinion and Reporting on Financial Statements, PCAOB AS 3101

attributes.name: capex_amount
attributes.description: Total capital expenditures incurred during the reporting period for exploration, drilling, facilities, and other long-term assets. Expressed in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: comparative_period_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this statement includes comparative prior period financial information as required by accounting standards.

attributes.name: consolidation_group
attributes.description: The consolidation group or reporting unit identifier when the statement represents consolidated financial results across multiple legal entities or business segments.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements, US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user identifier or name of the person who created this financial statement record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this financial statement record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: dd_and_a_method
attributes.description: The depreciation, depletion, and amortization method applied to oil and gas assets in this financial statement (units of production, straight line, or declining balance).
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment, US GAAP ASC 932

attributes.name: ebitda_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Amount
