products.name: hedge_position
products.description: Master record of commodity price and foreign exchange hedge positions held by the oil and gas enterprise to manage exposure to crude oil price volatility (WTI, Brent), natural gas prices (Henry Hub, TTF), NGL prices, and currency risk. Captures hedge position ID, hedge type (crude oil swap, gas collar, put option, costless collar, FX forward, interest rate swap), hedged commodity or currency pair, notional volume or amount, hedge start date, hedge end date, settlement dates, strike price or fixed price, premium paid, market price at inception, current fair value (mark-to-market), realized gain/loss, hedge accounting designation (cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, net investment hedge), effectiveness test result (prospective and retrospective), ineffectiveness amount, counterparty, ISDA master agreement reference, and credit exposure. Supports IFRS 9 / ASC 815 hedge accounting, SEC commodity risk disclosure (Item 7A), and board-level risk reporting.
products.reference: IFRS 9 / ASC 815 Hedge Accounting — Commodity Risk

attributes.name: hedge_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hedge position record. Primary key for the hedge position entity.

attributes.name: commercial_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the financial institution or counterparty with whom the hedge contract is executed. Links to commercial counterparty master data.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the cost center responsible for managing this hedge position. Used for internal cost allocation and budgeting.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Created By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Risk management accountability requires linking hedge transaction initiator to specific employee. Essential for commodity hedging governance, trading authority verification, and ISDA documentation in

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the profit center or business unit to which this hedge position is allocated. Links to finance profit center master data for cost allocation and performance reporting.

attributes.name: business_segment
attributes.description: The business segment to which this hedge position is allocated. Segments include upstream (E&P), midstream (transportation), downstream (refining), petrochemicals, and corporate.

attributes.name: ceiling_price
attributes.description: The ceiling price for collar structures. Represents the maximum price participation. Null for non-collar instruments.

attributes.name: collateral_posted
attributes.description: The amount of collateral posted to the counterparty under the Credit Support Annex. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number issued by the counterparty for the hedge transaction. Used for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the hedge position record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: credit_exposure
attributes.description: The current credit exposure to the counterparty, representing the potential loss if the counterparty defaults. Calculated as the positive mark-to-market value net of collateral. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Basel III, IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss

attributes.name: credit_support_annex_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Credit Support Annex is in place for this hedge position, requiring collateral posting based on mark-to-market exposure.

attributes.name: currency_pair
attributes.description: Currency pair for foreign exchange hedges. Format: BASE/QUOTE (e.g., USD/EUR, USD/GBP). Null for commodity hedges.

attributes.name: current_fair_value
attributes.description: The current fair value of the hedge position based on mark-to-market valuation. Represents the net present value of expected future cash flows. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: current_market_price
attributes.description: The current market price of the underlying commodity or currency. Updated regularly for mark-to-market valuation. Expressed in USD per unit.

attributes.name: floor_price
attributes.description: The floor price for collar structures. Represents the minimum price protection. Null for non-collar instruments.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region associated with the hedged exposure. Examples include North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America.

attributes.name: hedge_accounting_designation
attributes.description: The hedge accounting treatment designation under IFRS 9 or ASC 815. Options include cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, net investment hedge, or not designated for hedge accounting.

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_status
attributes.description: The current effectiveness status of the hedge based on prospective and retrospective testing. Highly effective hedges qualify for hedge accounting treatment.

attributes.name: hedge_end_date
attributes.description: The maturity or expiration date of the hedge position. Represents when the hedge coverage terminates.

attributes.name: hedge_position_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the hedge position, externally visible and used in reporting and confirmations. Format: HP-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence.

attributes.name: hedge_start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the hedge position. Represents when the hedge coverage begins.

attributes.name: hedge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hedge position. Active positions are in force, matured positions have reached expiration, terminated positions were closed early, cancelled positions were voided, and suspended positions are temporarily inactive.

attributes.name: hedge_type
attributes.description: Type of derivative instrument used for hedging. Includes crude oil swaps, natural gas collars, put/call options, costless collars, foreign exchange forwards, and interest rate swaps.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments, ASC 815 Derivatives and Hedging

attributes.name: hedged_commodity
attributes.description: The underlying commodity being hedged. Includes WTI crude, Brent crude, Henry Hub natural gas, TTF natural gas, NGL, LPG, and refined petroleum products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crude_oil_wti|crude_oil_brent|natural_gas_henry_hub|natural_gas_ttf|ngl|lpg|refined_products — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hedged_forecast_transaction
attributes.description: Description of the forecasted transaction being hedged. For cash flow hedges, identifies the specific future production, sales, or purchase transaction that the hedge is designed to protect.

attributes.name: ineffectiveness_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the hedge that is deemed ineffective and must be recognized immediately in profit or loss. Represents the excess gain or loss beyond the effective portion. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: isda_master_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the ISDA (International Swaps and Derivatives Association) Master Agreement governing the hedge transaction. Establishes legal framework and netting arrangements.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the hedge position record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the hedge position record was last updated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: market_price_at_inception
attributes.description: The prevailing market price of the underlying commodity or currency at the time the hedge was initiated. Used for effectiveness testing and valuation. Expressed in USD per unit.

attributes.name: next_settlement_date
attributes.description: The next scheduled settlement date for the hedge position. Updated after each settlement event.

attributes.name: notional_volume
attributes.description: The notional quantity of the hedged commodity or financial instrument. For commodity hedges, expressed in barrels (BOE), cubic feet (MCF), or gallons. For FX hedges, expressed in base currency amount.

attributes.name: premium_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the premium paid. Typically USD for oil and gas hedges.

attributes.name: premium_paid
attributes.description: The upfront premium paid to enter the hedge position. Applicable for purchased options. Zero for costless collars and swaps. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: prospective_effectiveness_result
attributes.description: The result of the prospective effectiveness test, expressed as a ratio or percentage. Tests whether the hedge is expected to be highly effective in offsetting future cash flow or fair value changes.

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The cumulative realized gain or loss from settled hedge transactions. Positive values represent gains, negative values represent losses. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: retrospective_effectiveness_result
attributes.description: The result of the retrospective effectiveness test, expressed as a ratio or percentage. Tests whether the hedge has been highly effective in offsetting past cash flow or fair value changes. Must be within 80-125% range for hedge accounting qualification.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the hedge position is cash-settled. Common frequencies include monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual, or at maturity.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hedge position is subject to SOX internal controls and testing requirements due to materiality or risk profile.

attributes.name: strike_price
attributes.description: The fixed price or strike price at which the hedge is executed. For swaps, this is the fixed price. For options, this is the strike price. Expressed in USD per unit (e.g., USD/BBL, USD/MMBTU).

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the hedge transaction was executed and confirmed with the counterparty.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The current unrealized gain or loss on the hedge position based on mark-to-market valuation. Represents the difference between current fair value and carrying value. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the notional volume. BOE (Barrel of Oil Equivalent), BBL (Barrels), MMBTU (Million British Thermal Units), MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet), MMCF (Million Cubic Feet), GAL (Gallons), or currency code for FX hedges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOE|BBL|MMBTU|MCF|MMCF|GAL|USD|EUR|GBP — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: impairment_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of oil and gas asset impairment assessments conducted to evaluate whether the carrying value of proved and unproved properties, goodwill, or other assets exceeds their recoverable amount. Captures impairment assessment ID, assessment date, asset or cash-generating unit (CGU) reference, triggering event (price decline, reserve revision, regulatory change, abandonment decision), carrying amount, recoverable amount (higher of fair value less costs to sell and value in use), impairment loss recognized, reversal amount, discount rate used, price deck applied (WTI, Brent), reserve estimate used (1P/2P), and accounting standard (IAS 36 / ASC 360). Supports SEC ceiling test calculations under full cost method.
products.reference: IAS 36 / ASC 360 Asset Impairment — SEC Ceiling Test

attributes.name: impairment_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the impairment assessment record. Primary key for the impairment assessment entity.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets, ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Impairment assessor accountability is critical for ceiling test and asset impairment governance. Links technical evaluation to specific employee for reserves engineer/financial analyst accountability

attributes.name: cgu_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cash-generating unit to which the asset belongs for impairment testing purposes under IAS 36.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Impairment assessments are performed for legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level imp

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center associated with the asset or CGU being assessed for impairment.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which the impairment loss or reversal is posted.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the profit center responsible for the asset or CGU being assessed for impairment.

attributes.name: accounting_method
attributes.description: The oil and gas accounting method used: successful efforts method or full cost method, which determines how exploration and development costs are capitalized and amortized.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10, IFRS 6 Exploration for and Evaluation of Mineral Resources

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: The accounting standard framework applied for the impairment assessment: IAS 36 (International Accounting Standard), ASC 360 (Accounting Standards Codification), IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards), or GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment assessment was formally approved by the reviewer or management.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment assessment was performed or completed.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to the impairment assessment for tracking and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IFRS/GAAP Oil and Gas Accounting Standards

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the impairment assessment: draft, in review, approved, posted to the general ledger, or cancelled.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the impairment assessment based on the reason or timing of the evaluation.

attributes.name: brent_price_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed Brent crude oil price per barrel used in the impairment assessment cash flow projections.

attributes.name: carrying_amount
attributes.description: The book value or carrying value of the asset or CGU on the balance sheet at the assessment date, before any impairment loss is recognized.

attributes.name: ceiling_test_limit
attributes.description: The calculated ceiling test limit under the full cost method, representing the maximum allowable capitalized costs based on the present value of estimated future net revenues from proved reserves.

attributes.name: ceiling_test_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a ceiling test was performed as part of the impairment assessment under the full cost method, which limits capitalized costs to the present value of estimated future net revenues.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this impairment assessment record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this impairment assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this impairment assessment are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The pre-tax discount rate applied in the discounted cash flow (DCF) calculation to determine value in use, reflecting the time value of money and asset-specific risks.

attributes.name: estimated_ultimate_recovery
attributes.description: The Estimated Ultimate Recovery (EUR) of hydrocarbons from the asset over its entire productive life, used in the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: fair_value_less_costs_to_sell
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Value Less Costs to Sell
attributes.description: The estimated amount obtainable from the sale of the asset in an arm's length transaction between knowledgeable, willing parties, less the costs of disposal.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets, IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the impairment assessment was performed and recorded.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the impairment assessment was performed and recorded.

attributes.name: gas_price_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed natural gas price per unit (e.g., per MMBTU or MCF) used in the impairment assessment cash flow projections.

attributes.name: impairment_loss_recognized
attributes.description: The amount by which the carrying amount exceeds the recoverable amount, recognized as an impairment loss in the financial statements.

attributes.name: impairment_reversal_amount
attributes.description: The amount of previously recognized impairment loss that is reversed in the current period due to an increase in the recoverable amount (not applicable to goodwill under IFRS).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified or updated this impairment assessment record in the system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this impairment assessment record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or explanations related to the impairment assessment, including assumptions, methodologies, or special considerations.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the impairment loss or reversal was posted to the general ledger and reflected in the financial statements.

attributes.name: price_deck_applied
attributes.description: The commodity price forecast or price deck used in the impairment assessment, including references to benchmark prices such as West Texas Intermediate (WTI), Brent, or Henry Hub.

attributes.name: property_type
attributes.description: Classification of the oil and gas property being assessed: Proved Developed Producing (PDP), Proved Developed Non-Producing (PDNP), Proved Undeveloped (PUD), unproved properties, goodwill, or other assets.

attributes.name: recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The higher of the asset's fair value less costs to sell and its value in use, representing the maximum amount recoverable from the asset.

attributes.name: reserve_estimate_used
attributes.description: The reserve classification used in the impairment assessment: 1P (Proved), 2P (Proved plus Probable), 3P (Proved plus Probable plus Possible), PDP (Proved Developed Producing), PDNP (Proved Developed Non-Producing), PUD (Proved Undeveloped), or unproved reserves. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1P|2P|3P|PDP|PDNP|PUD|unproved — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: PRMS Petroleum Resources Management System, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 4-10

attributes.name: reserve_volume_boe
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reserve Volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE)
attributes.description: The estimated reserve volume in Barrels of Oil Equivalent (BOE) used in the impairment assessment calculations.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual or team responsible for reviewing and approving the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this impairment assessment is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal control testing and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: triggering_event
attributes.description: Description of the event or indicator that triggered the impairment assessment, such as commodity price decline, reserve revision, regulatory change, abandonment decision, or adverse market conditions.

attributes.name: triggering_event_date
attributes.description: The date on which the triggering event occurred that necessitated the impairment assessment.

attributes.name: value_in_use
attributes.description: The present value of the future cash flows expected to be derived from the asset or CGU, calculated using discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis.

attributes.name: wti_price_assumption
attributes.description: The assumed West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil price per barrel used in the impairment assessment cash flow projections.

products.name: cash_management
products.description: Master and transactional record for enterprise cash management including bank accounts, cash positions, cash forecasts, and liquidity planning across the oil and gas enterprise. Captures bank account details, daily cash balances, cash inflows/outflows by category (operating, investing, financing), short-term investment positions, credit facility drawdowns, and cash pooling arrangements. Supports treasury operations, working capital management, and cash flow forecasting for CAPEX-intensive upstream and midstream projects. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA FI-BL (Bank Ledger) and treasury modules.

attributes.name: cash_management_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cash management record. Primary key for the cash management data product.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Cash positions belong to legal entities. The existing company_code STRING attribute should be replaced with a proper FK to company_code.company_code_id to enable legal entity-level cash consolidation

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Created By User Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Treasury accountability requires linking cash position preparer to specific employee. Essential for daily cash management, JIB settlement tracking, and treasury operations governance in Oil & Gas cash

attributes.name: primary_cash_pool_header_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master bank account that serves as the header account for the cash pooling structure. Null if this account is not part of a cash pool.

attributes.name: afe_related_amount
attributes.description: Cash outflow amount related to approved Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) projects. Tracks CAPEX spending for drilling, completion, and facility construction projects.

attributes.name: bank_statement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier from the bank statement used for reconciliation and audit trail. Links cash management records to external bank documentation.

attributes.name: business_date
attributes.description: The business date for which the cash position or transaction is recorded. Represents the effective date for treasury operations and cash flow analysis.

attributes.name: cash_pool_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bank account participates in a cash pooling arrangement for centralized treasury management and interest optimization.

attributes.name: cash_position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cash position record indicating whether it represents an opening balance, closing balance, intraday position, forecast, or actual position.

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: Cash balance at the end of the business day in the bank account. Used for daily cash reconciliation and liquidity reporting.

attributes.name: commodity_sales_receipt_amount
attributes.description: Cash inflow from crude oil, natural gas, Natural Gas Liquids (NGL), and refined product sales. Primary operating cash inflow for upstream and midstream operations.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cash management record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_facility_available_amount
attributes.description: Total available credit facility amount that can be drawn for liquidity management. Represents undrawn portion of committed credit lines and revolving facilities.

attributes.name: credit_facility_drawn_amount
attributes.description: Amount currently drawn from credit facilities. Represents outstanding borrowings under revolving credit agreements and short-term credit lines.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cash position and transaction amounts. Critical for multi-currency treasury operations and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate used to convert transaction currency to local or group currency. Critical for multi-currency cash management and FX exposure tracking.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: forecast_confidence_level
attributes.description: Confidence level assigned to the cash forecast based on data quality, historical accuracy, and business volatility. Used for risk-adjusted liquidity planning.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: Number of days into the future that this cash forecast record represents. Used for short-term liquidity planning and working capital management.

attributes.name: group_currency_amount
attributes.description: Cash position or transaction amount expressed in the group reporting currency for consolidated financial statements and enterprise-wide cash visibility.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: inflow_financing_amount
attributes.description: Total cash inflows from financing activities including debt drawdowns, credit facility utilization, equity issuance, and partner contributions. Aligns with cash flow statement financing section.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: inflow_investing_amount
attributes.description: Total cash inflows from investing activities including asset sales, divestiture proceeds, and investment redemptions. Aligns with cash flow statement investing section.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: inflow_operating_amount
attributes.description: Total cash inflows from operating activities including customer payments, production revenue, and operating receipts. Aligns with cash flow statement operating section.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: jib_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Cash flow amount related to Joint Interest Billing (JIB) settlements with joint venture partners. Includes partner billings, receipts, and netting transactions.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the cash management record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cash management record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Cash position or transaction amount expressed in the local currency of the operating entity. Used for local statutory reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: loe_payment_amount
attributes.description: Cash outflow for Lease Operating Expense (LOE) including well operations, maintenance, utilities, and field-level operating costs. Key Operating Expenditure (OPEX) component.

attributes.name: net_change_amount
attributes.description: Net change in cash position for the business day calculated as total inflows minus total outflows across all activity categories. Reconciles opening to closing balance.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or context regarding the cash position, forecast assumptions, or reconciliation issues.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: Cash balance at the beginning of the business day in the bank account. Starting point for daily cash position reconciliation.

attributes.name: outflow_financing_amount
attributes.description: Total cash outflows for financing activities including debt repayments, interest payments, dividend distributions, and partner distributions. Aligns with cash flow statement financing section.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: outflow_investing_amount
attributes.description: Total cash outflows for investing activities including Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for drilling, facilities, and equipment purchases. Aligns with cash flow statement investing section.

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Manages the full employee and contractor lifecycle including recruitment, onboarding, competency management, crew scheduling, rig personnel tracking, training, performance evaluation, payroll, benefits, workforce planning, and OSHA-mandated training records. Owns employee profiles, organizational hierarchy, certifications, labor cost allocation, and HSE certification tracking. Supports SIMOPS crew coordination, offshore manning requirements, and labor regulations.

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for all employees of Oil Gas, capturing full personal and employment profile including employee number, legal name, date of birth, national ID, employment type (staff/contract/secondee), hire date, termination date, employment status, job title, grade level, cost center, home country, work location, union membership flag, and SAP HR personnel number. Serves as the SSOT for employee identity across all workforce sub-domains.

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.description: Binary or categorical outcome of the assessment indicating whether the assessee passed, failed, conditionally passed, or the assessment was incomplete.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to achieve a passing outcome for this specific competency assessment, as defined by the competency standard or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: Qualitative proficiency level achieved by the assessee, categorized as novice, competent, proficient, expert, or master based on demonstrated capability.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Citation or reference to the specific regulatory requirement, OSHA standard, API recommended practice, or industry guideline that this assessment addresses.
attributes.references: OSHA Standards and API Recommended Practices

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_met
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this assessment satisfies a specific regulatory or compliance requirement such as OSHA-mandated training verification or offshore manning certification.

attributes.name: remedial_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the specific remedial training, coaching, or corrective actions required to address competency gaps identified during the assessment.

attributes.name: remedial_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether remedial training or corrective action is required before the assessee can be reassessed or certified.

attributes.name: score_achieved
attributes.description: Numerical score or percentage achieved by the assessee in the competency assessment, typically on a 0-100 scale or other defined scoring system.

attributes.name: simops_qualified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this assessment qualifies the assessee for SIMOPS crew coordination roles, critical for offshore and complex operational environments.

products.name: workforce_certification
products.description: Master record of each professional certification, license, or regulatory qualification held by an employee or contractor. Captures certificate type (BOSIET, HUET, H2S Awareness, IWCF, IADC WellCAP, OSHA 30-Hour, First Aid), issuing body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and verification document reference. Critical for offshore manning compliance and BSEE/OSHA regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: workforce_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: competency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.competency. Business justification: Professional certifications often prove specific competencies from the competency catalog (e.g., BOSIET certification proves offshore survival competency). Adding competency_id FK (nullable) links cer

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contractor who holds this certification. Links to the workforce employee master record.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: The unique certificate or license number issued by the certifying body. This is the externally-known identifier for the certification.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the certification or license as it appears on the certificate document.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The type or category of certification held. attributes.references: OSHA 1910, API RP 75, BSEE NTL 2010-N06, IWCF Standards, IADC HSE Reference Guide

attributes.name: competency_level
attributes.description: The proficiency or competency level associated with this certification. Basic indicates foundational knowledge. Intermediate indicates working proficiency. Advanced indicates expert-level skills. Expert indicates mastery and ability to handle complex scenarios. Instructor indicates qualification to train others.
attributes.references: API RP 75 Competency Framework, IADC Competency Standards

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost incurred to obtain or renew this certification, including training fees, examination fees, travel expenses, and administrative costs. Expressed in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the scanned or digital copy of the certification document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: endorsement_details
attributes.description: Additional endorsements, specializations, or restrictions associated with the certification. For example, a CDL (Commercial Driver License) may have Tanker or Hazmat endorsements; a Well Control certification may specify pressure rating or equipment type.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Null if the certification does not expire or is valid indefinitely.
attributes.references: BSEE NTL 2010-N06, OSHA Training Requirements, IWCF Certification Validity Periods

attributes.name: facility_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of facility types or specific facilities where this certification is required. Examples include Offshore Platform, Drilling Rig, FPSO (Floating Production Storage and Offloading), Onshore Production Facility, Refinery, Petrochemical Plant, Pipeline, Terminal, Warehouse, Office.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the expiry date during which the certification is still considered valid or during which renewal can occur without penalty, as specified by the issuing body or company policy.
attributes.references: Issuing Body Policies, Internal HR Policies

attributes.name: hse_critical_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Critical Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is critical for Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) compliance and risk management. HSE-critical certifications are prioritized for tracking and renewal.
attributes.references: API RP 75, OSHA Process Safety Management (PSM) Standards

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued to the employee or contractor.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: The organization, agency, or institution that issued the certification. Examples include OPITO (Offshore Petroleum Industry Training Organisation), IADC (International Association of Drilling Contractors), IWCF (International Well Control Forum), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), American Red Cross, National Safety Council, API (American Petroleum Institute), SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers), state licensing boards, or accredited training providers.
attributes.references: BSEE Training Requirements, OSHA Training Standards, API Certification Programs

attributes.name: job_role_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of job roles, positions, or work assignments for which this certification is required or applicable. Examples include Driller, Derrickhand, Roustabout, Toolpusher, Rig Manager, Production Operator, Maintenance Technician, HSE Coordinator, Well Control Specialist, MWD Engineer, Directional Driller, Crane Operator, Scaffolder, Electrician, Instrumentation Technician, Process Engineer, Refinery Operator, Pipeline Inspector, Truck Driver, Helicopter Pilot, Medic, Emergency Response Team Member.
attributes.references: Internal Job Role Matrix, BSEE Manning Requirements

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this certification record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the certification must be renewed to maintain continuous validity. Used for proactive renewal planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or contextual information about the certification that does not fit into structured fields.

attributes.name: offshore_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is required for offshore operations, including platform, rig, or Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) assignments.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is mandated by federal, state, or local regulatory authorities (True) or is a voluntary company-required or industry best-practice certification (False).
attributes.references: BSEE Regulations, OSHA Standards, State Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last renewed or recertified. Null if the certification has never been renewed.

attributes.name: simops_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this certification is required for personnel involved in Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS), where multiple high-risk activities occur concurrently on the same site or facility.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee successfully completed the training program and passed any required examinations or assessments.

attributes.name: training_hours
attributes.description: The total number of training hours required to obtain or maintain this certification, as specified by the issuing body or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Hour Requirements, BSEE Training Standards

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: The city, state, or facility where the training was conducted. Relevant for tracking training delivery and travel logistics.

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: The name of the organization or institution that delivered the training program leading to this certification. May be the same as the issuing body or a separate accredited training provider.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was verified by the employer or third-party verification service.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity of the certification. Document Review indicates physical or digital certificate inspection. Issuing Body Confirmation indicates direct contact with the certifying organization. Third-Party Service indicates use of a credential verification service. Self-Attestation indicates employee declaration without independent verification. Database Lookup indicates verification through an online registry or database maintained by the issuing body.
attributes.value_regex: Document Review|Issuing Body Confirmation|Third-Party Service|Self-Attestation|Database Lookup
attributes.references: BSEE Verification Standards, Internal Audit Procedures

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certification has been verified with the issuing body or through document review. Verified means the certification authenticity has been confirmed. Pending Verification means verification is in progress. Not Verified means no verification attempt has been made. Verification Failed means the certification could not be authenticated.
attributes.references: BSEE Verification Requirements, Internal Compliance Procedures

attributes.name: workforce_certification_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the certification. Active indicates the certification is valid and current. Expired indicates the certification has passed its expiry date. Suspended indicates temporary suspension by the issuing body or employer. Revoked indicates permanent revocation. Pending Renewal indicates the certification is approaching expiry and renewal is in process. In Progress indicates the employee is currently undergoing training or testing to obtain the certification.
attributes.references: BSEE Offshore Manning Requirements, OSHA Training Compliance Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this certification record.

products.name: training_course
products.description: Master catalog of training courses offered or mandated at Oil Gas, including course code, course title, course category (HSE, Technical, Leadership, Regulatory), delivery mode (classroom, e-learning, simulator, OJT), duration hours, mandatory flag, regulatory requirement reference (OSHA, BSEE, EPA), passing score threshold, validity period, and approved training provider. Supports OSHA-mandated training records management.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the training course record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approved_training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the authorized organization or vendor approved to deliver this training course. May be internal training department or external certified training provider.
attributes.references: Internal Vendor Management, Training Provider Qualification Standards

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Description of how learner competency is evaluated, including written exams, practical demonstrations, simulator exercises, skills assessments, or observation checklists.

attributes.name: certificate_type
attributes.description: Type or name of the certificate or credential awarded upon successful completion (e.g., Well Control Certificate, H2S Safety Card, Confined Space Entry Permit, Forklift Operator License).
attributes.references: Internal Training Management Standard, Industry Certification Bodies

attributes.name: certification_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal certificate or credential is issued upon successful completion of the training course. True indicates certificate is issued, False indicates completion record only.

attributes.name: competency_level
attributes.description: The skill or knowledge level that this training course is designed to develop. Awareness provides basic familiarity, Foundation establishes core knowledge, Intermediate builds practical skills, Advanced develops specialized expertise, Expert certifies mastery.

attributes.name: continuing_education_credits
attributes.description: Number of continuing education units or professional development hours awarded for completing this training course. Used for professional license maintenance and career development tracking.

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Standard cost to deliver the training course per participant, including instructor fees, materials, facility rental, and equipment. Used for training budget planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: course_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the training course by subject area. HSE covers Health Safety and Environment training, Technical covers job-specific skills, Leadership covers management development, Regulatory covers mandatory compliance training, Operational covers process and equipment training, Compliance covers legal and policy requirements.

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the training course for identification and registration purposes. Used in training management systems and employee records.

attributes.name: course_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the training course content, learning objectives, target audience, and prerequisites.

attributes.name: course_materials
attributes.description: Description of training materials provided to participants, including manuals, workbooks, reference guides, job aids, personal protective equipment, or digital resources.

attributes.name: course_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the department, functional area, or individual responsible for maintaining the training course content and ensuring its accuracy and relevance.

attributes.name: course_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training course in the catalog. Active indicates available for enrollment, Inactive indicates temporarily unavailable, Under Review indicates content is being updated or audited, Retired indicates no longer offered, Pending Approval indicates awaiting authorization.

attributes.name: course_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing more granular categorization within the primary course category (e.g., Well Control, Confined Space Entry, Drilling Operations, Emergency Response).

attributes.name: course_title
attributes.description: Full official title of the training course as it appears in the training catalog and on certificates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this training course record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per participant (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Method by which the training course is delivered. Classroom indicates in-person instructor-led training, E-Learning indicates online self-paced modules, Simulator indicates hands-on equipment simulation, OJT (On-the-Job Training) indicates supervised workplace training, Blended indicates combination of methods, Virtual indicates live remote instruction.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total instructional time required to complete the training course, measured in hours. Includes classroom time, practical exercises, and assessments but excludes breaks and travel time.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this training course version became active and available for enrollment in the training catalog.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this training course version will be retired or replaced. Null indicates no planned expiration.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training course is mandatory for specific job roles or all employees. True indicates required training, False indicates optional or elective training.

attributes.name: language_offered
attributes.description: Primary language in which the training course is delivered. Multiple languages may be listed if course is available in multiple languages.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the training course content was last reviewed for accuracy, regulatory compliance, and alignment with current practices.

attributes.name: learning_management_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this training course in the Learning Management System used for enrollment, tracking, and reporting.

attributes.name: maximum_class_size
attributes.description: Maximum number of participants allowed in a single training session to maintain instructional quality and safety. Null indicates no limit or not applicable for self-paced courses.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this training course record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the training course content to ensure continued accuracy and compliance.

attributes.name: offshore_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training course is mandatory for personnel working on offshore platforms, rigs, or vessels. True indicates offshore requirement.
attributes.references: BSEE Offshore Safety Requirements, Internal Offshore Operations Standards

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to successfully complete the training course, expressed as a percentage (0-100). Learners must achieve this score or higher on assessments to receive certification.

attributes.name: prerequisites
attributes.description: Required prior training, certifications, experience, or qualifications that participants must have before enrolling in this course. Null indicates no prerequisites.

attributes.name: provider_accreditation
attributes.description: Accreditation or certification held by the training provider that qualifies them to deliver this course. Examples include IADC accreditation for well control, OPITO approval for offshore training, API certification for technical training.
attributes.references: Industry Training Accreditation Bodies (IADC, OPITO, API)

attributes.name: recertification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic recertification or refresher training is required to maintain competency and compliance. True indicates recertification is mandatory, False indicates one-time training.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The governing body or regulatory agency that mandates or oversees this training requirement. OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), BSEE (Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement), EPA (Environmental Protection Agency), API (American Petroleum Institute), PHMSA (Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration), DOT (Department of Transportation), FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission), State indicates state-level requirements, Internal indicates company policy requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSHA|BSEE|EPA|API|PHMSA|DOT|FERC|State|Internal — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Citation of the specific regulatory standard, law, or industry requirement that mandates this training. Examples include OSHA 1910.146 for Confined Space, BSEE SEMS for offshore safety, API RP 54 for well control, EPA SPCC for spill prevention.
attributes.references: OSHA Standards, BSEE Regulations, EPA Requirements, API Standards

attributes.name: simops_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training course is required or recommended for personnel involved in Simultaneous Operations where multiple activities occur concurrently on the same site or facility. True indicates SIMOPS relevance.

attributes.name: subject_matter_expert
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technical expert who provides content expertise and validates the accuracy of the training course materials.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Description of the intended participants for this training course, including job roles, experience levels, and functional areas (e.g., Drilling Crew, Production Operators, HSE Coordinators, New Hires, Supervisors).

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months that the training certification remains valid before recertification or refresher training is required. Null indicates no expiration or one-time training.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the training course content, following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented when course content, assessments, or requirements are updated.

products.name: workforce_training_record
products.description: Transactional record of each training completion or HSE site induction event for an employee or contractor. Captures course or induction type, training/induction date, training provider or induction officer, delivery location (rig, plant, classroom, online), facility ID for site-specific inductions, topics covered (for inductions: H2S awareness, NORM, PTW, emergency procedures, SIMOPS), score achieved, pass/fail status, certificate issued flag, expiry date, OSHA training record reference number, and Enablon record reference. Serves as the SSOT for OSHA-mandated training records, HSE induction compliance, and BSEE site access verification.
products.reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132 / Enablon HSE Training Module

attributes.name: workforce_training_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce training or HSE site induction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility, rig, plant, or site where the training or site-specific induction was conducted. Null for online or classroom training not tied to a specific operational site.

attributes.name: primary_workforce_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor who completed the training or induction.

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the training course or HSE induction program completed.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: AFE number authorizing the training expenditure, particularly for project-specific or capital training programs (e.g., new rig commissioning, major turnaround training).
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, SAP PS (Project System)

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the trainee on the training assessment or competency test, typically expressed as a percentage (0-100). Null if no formal assessment was conducted.

attributes.name: attendance_status
attributes.description: Attendance status of the trainee for the scheduled training session: Attended (full participation), Absent (did not attend), Partial (attended part of session), Excused (absence approved), Rescheduled (moved to another session).

attributes.name: bsee_site_access_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Site Access Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training record has been verified and approved for BSEE offshore site access authorization. True if verified for offshore access, False otherwise.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a training certificate or completion credential was issued to the trainee. True if certificate issued, False otherwise.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number issued upon successful completion of the training. Null if no certificate was issued.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the training session, trainee performance, special accommodations, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: competency_level_achieved
attributes.description: Level of competency or proficiency achieved by the trainee upon completion: Awareness (introductory understanding), Basic (foundational skills), Intermediate (working proficiency), Advanced (expert-level skills), Expert (mastery and ability to train others), Certified (formal credential granted).

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center or business unit to which the training expense is allocated for financial reporting and labor cost tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training was delivered (e.g., Houston Training Center, Offshore Platform A, Online Portal, Refinery Control Room).

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Mode of training delivery: Classroom (in-person lecture), Online (e-learning platform), On-Site (conducted at operational facility), Simulator (rig simulator or process control simulator), Field Demonstration (hands-on at work location), Blended (combination of methods).

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training session in hours, including classroom time, practical exercises, and assessments.

attributes.name: enablon_record_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this training record to the corresponding entry in the Enablon HSE Management system for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training certification or competency expires and requires renewal or refresher training. Null for training that does not expire.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910, BSEE 30 CFR 250, API RP 75

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the instructor, induction officer, or HSE coordinator who conducted the training or site induction.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training is mandatory for the employee's role or site access. True if mandatory (e.g., OSHA-required, BSEE offshore access, H2S certification for sour gas operations), False if optional or developmental.

attributes.name: osha_record_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Record Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this training record to the OSHA-mandated training log or regulatory filing. Required for OSHA 29 CFR 1910 compliance.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the training assessment: Pass (trainee met minimum competency requirements), Fail (trainee did not meet requirements), Incomplete (training not finished), Waived (requirement waived by authority), Not Assessed (no formal assessment conducted).

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the training record: Active (current and valid), Archived (historical record retained for audit), Superseded (replaced by a newer training record), Voided (invalidated due to error or policy change).

attributes.name: refresher_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the trainee must complete refresher training to maintain competency or certification. Calculated based on training type and regulatory requirements (e.g., annual H2S refresher, biennial well control recertification).
attributes.references: OSHA, BSEE, API Training Recertification Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard or requirement that mandates this training (e.g., OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 Confined Space Entry, BSEE 30 CFR 250 Subpart O Well Control, API RP 75 SEMS, EPA 40 CFR 68 Process Safety Management). Null if not regulatory-driven.

attributes.name: supervisor_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trainee's supervisor or line manager has approved and acknowledged the training completion. True if approved, False if pending or not required.

attributes.name: topics_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or narrative description of topics covered in the training or induction. For HSE inductions: H2S (Hydrogen Sulfide) awareness, NORM (Naturally Occurring Radioactive Material) handling, PTW (Permit to Work) procedures, emergency response, SIMOPS (Simultaneous Operations) protocols, LDAR (Leak Detection and Repair), BOP (Blowout Preventer) operations, confined space entry, fall protection, etc.
attributes.references: API RP 75, OSHA 29 CFR 1910, BSEE 30 CFR 250

attributes.name: training_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the training session, including instructor fees, materials, facility rental, travel, and per-trainee charges. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: training_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training session or induction was completed.

attributes.name: training_language
attributes.description: Primary language in which the training was delivered (e.g., English, Spanish, Portuguese). Important for multinational operations and contractor workforce compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication Language Requirements

attributes.name: training_materials_provided
attributes.description: Description of training materials provided to the trainee (e.g., participant manual, safety data sheets, emergency response guide, online access credentials, USB drive with course content).

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or vendor that delivered the training (e.g., external training company, internal HSE department, contractor safety team).

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Category of training or induction event: HSE Induction (site-specific safety orientation), Technical Competency (job-specific skills), OSHA Mandatory (regulatory-required training), Certification (credential-granting program), Refresher (periodic recertification), SIMOPS (Simultaneous Operations coordination training).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910, API RP 75, BSEE Training Requirements

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility where this crew schedule is assigned (offshore platform, FPSO, onshore processing plant, refinery, or drilling rig).

attributes.name: joint_venture_id
attributes.description: Reference to the joint venture or joint operating agreement under which this crew schedule operates. Nullable for wholly-owned operations.

attributes.name: logistics_coordinator_employee_id

attributes.name: relief_crew_id

attributes.name: rig_id

attributes.name: approval_status

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or employee ID of the manager or supervisor who approved this crew schedule. Nullable if schedule is not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
