attributes.references: Workforce Management Approval Workflow, SOX Controls

attributes.name: bed_down_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of personnel that can be accommodated overnight at the facility or rig. Constrains the crew complement size for this schedule.
attributes.references: Facility Design Standards, Offshore Manning Requirements

attributes.name: budget_afe_number
attributes.description: The AFE number under which crew labor costs for this schedule are authorized and budgeted. Links crew costs to capital or operating expenditure authorization.
attributes.references: AFE Management Standard - COPAS, SAP PS Module

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or employee ID of the person who created this crew schedule record. Supports accountability and audit requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew schedule record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standard - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: crew_complement_size
attributes.description: The total number of personnel positions in the crew complement for this rotation schedule. Represents the full manning requirement for one rotation cycle.
attributes.references: Offshore Manning Requirements - BSEE, SIMOPS Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this crew rotation schedule ceases to be effective. Nullable for open-ended schedules with no planned termination.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this crew rotation schedule becomes effective and operational. Marks the beginning of the schedule's validity period.

attributes.name: emergency_response_team_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this crew schedule includes designated emergency response team members with specialized training for incident response.
attributes.references: Emergency Response Plan - API RP 75, OSHA 1910.120

attributes.name: hse_certification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether crew members on this schedule must hold current HSE certifications (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, H2S training) as mandated by regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: HSE Management Standards - OSHA, BSEE, API RP 75

attributes.name: labor_cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center code to which labor costs for this crew schedule are allocated for financial tracking and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module - Cost Center Accounting, COPAS Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or employee ID of the person who last modified this crew schedule record. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew schedule record was last updated. Audit trail for record modification tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standard - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: minimum_offshore_experience_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of offshore experience required for personnel assigned to this crew schedule. Used to ensure competency requirements are met.
attributes.references: Competency Management Framework, BSEE Offshore Requirements

attributes.name: mobilization_location
attributes.description: The onshore base or heliport location from which crew members mobilize to the offshore facility or rig (e.g., 'Lafayette Heliport', 'Aberdeen Base').

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or operational notes related to this crew schedule (e.g., special mobilization requirements, temporary modifications).

attributes.name: operator_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the operator responsible for managing this crew schedule. Relevant in joint venture or multi-operator environments.
attributes.references: Organizational Structure Standard, SAP FI Module

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction governing this crew schedule (e.g., 'US Gulf of Mexico - BSEE', 'UK North Sea - HSE', 'Norway - PSA'). Determines applicable labor and safety regulations.
attributes.references: Regulatory Compliance Framework - BSEE, BOEM, International Standards

attributes.name: rest_days_per_cycle
attributes.description: Number of consecutive days off in one rotation cycle following the work period (e.g., 28 days off in a 28/28 rotation).

attributes.name: rotation_pattern
attributes.description: The work-rest rotation pattern expressed in days on/days off format (e.g., '28/28' for 28 days on followed by 28 days off, '14/14', '7/7', '21/21'). Defines the cyclical crew rotation schedule.
attributes.references: Offshore Manning Requirements - BSEE, OSHA Workplace Standards

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the crew schedule for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation for the crew rotation schedule (e.g., 'Platform Alpha 28/28 Rotation', 'FPSO Beta 14/14 Schedule').

attributes.name: schedule_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this crew schedule used in resource allocation and crew assignment decisions. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the crew schedule indicating whether it is actively in use, temporarily suspended, or archived.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crew schedule based on the type of operation or facility it supports.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Daily shift structure within the rotation (e.g., '12-hour shifts', 'day/night rotation', '8-hour three-shift'). Defines the work schedule within each 24-hour period.
attributes.references: Workforce Management Best Practices, OSHA Standards

attributes.name: simops_coordination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this crew schedule requires SIMOPS coordination due to simultaneous operations at the facility (e.g., drilling and production activities occurring concurrently).
attributes.references: SIMOPS Guidelines - API RP 96, HSE Management Standards

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for crew changeover between onshore base and the facility or rig.
attributes.references: Transportation and Logistics Standard, HSE Travel Guidelines

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the collective bargaining agreement or union contract governing labor terms for this crew schedule. Nullable for non-union operations.
attributes.references: Labor Relations Standard, Collective Bargaining Agreements

attributes.name: weather_contingency_days
attributes.description: Number of additional days built into the schedule to accommodate weather-related delays in crew changeover transportation.

attributes.name: work_days_per_cycle
attributes.description: Number of consecutive days worked in one rotation cycle before rest period begins (e.g., 28 days in a 28/28 rotation).

products.name: crew_assignment
products.description: Transactional record of each individual crew member assignment to a specific rotation slot on a rig, FPSO, platform, or plant, including mobilization and demobilization lifecycle. Captures employee or contractor ID, crew schedule reference, role on crew (OIM, Driller, Toolpusher, Medic, HSE Officer), mobilization date and time, demobilization date, origin location, transport mode (helicopter, vessel, commercial flight), relief personnel ID, POB (Personnel on Board) status, muster station assignment, emergency contact details, helideck manifest reference, visa/work permit clearance flag, and medical fitness clearance date. Serves as the SSOT for offshore personnel tracking, POB reporting, emergency muster, and BSEE offshore safety compliance. Subsumes mobilization event and POB record tracking.
products.reference: BSEE POB Tracking / SEMS Personnel Accountability

attributes.name: crew_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each crew member assignment to a rotation slot on a rig, FPSO, platform, or plant. Primary key for crew assignment tracking and POB reporting.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rig, FPSO, platform, refinery, or plant where the crew member is assigned. Links to asset master data.

attributes.name: crew_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew schedule defining the rotation pattern, shift duration, and manning requirements for this assignment.

attributes.name: primary_crew_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contractor being assigned to the crew rotation. Links to workforce master data for personnel details.

attributes.name: actual_rotation_days
attributes.description: The actual number of days the crew member spent on the facility during this rotation. May differ from planned due to operational needs or early relief.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: The priority level of this crew assignment. Critical assignments are for essential personnel; standby assignments are for backup crew members.

attributes.name: assignment_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or operational comments related to this crew assignment. Used for handover information and special considerations.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the crew assignment. Tracks progression from scheduled through mobilization, on-board duty, to demobilization or relief.

attributes.name: cabin_number
attributes.description: The accommodation cabin or quarters assigned to the crew member during their rotation. Used for facility management and emergency accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: crew_role_code
attributes.description: The specific role or position the crew member holds during this assignment. OIM (Offshore Installation Manager), Driller, Toolpusher, Medic, HSE Officer, and other operational roles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OIM|DRILLER|TOOLPUSHER|MEDIC|HSE_OFFICER|ROUSTABOUT|DERRICKMAN|MOTORMAN|CRANE_OPERATOR|ELECTRICIAN|MECHANIC|WELDER — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: The date when the crew member is scheduled to demobilize from the facility and return to shore. Used for rotation planning and relief crew coordination.

attributes.name: demobilization_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the crew member physically departed the facility. Marks the end of POB status and completion of rotation.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary emergency contact person to be notified in case of incident or emergency involving the crew member.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the emergency contact person. Must be current and verified for emergency notification purposes.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: The relationship of the emergency contact to the crew member (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling). Provides context for emergency communications.

attributes.name: h2s_certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the H2S safety certification. Must be renewed before expiry to maintain assignment eligibility in H2S environments.

attributes.name: h2s_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crew member holds valid H2S safety certification. Mandatory for assignments in sour gas environments.

attributes.name: helideck_manifest_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this crew assignment to the helicopter flight manifest for mobilization or demobilization. Critical for aviation safety compliance.

attributes.name: hse_induction_completed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Induction Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crew member has completed the mandatory HSE induction training for the specific facility. Required before starting work.

attributes.name: hse_induction_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Induction Date
attributes.description: The date when the crew member completed the HSE induction training for this facility. Used to track training currency and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this crew assignment record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: medical_fitness_clearance_date
attributes.description: The date when the crew member received medical fitness clearance for offshore duty. Must be current and valid before mobilization.

attributes.name: medical_fitness_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the medical fitness certification. Crew member must renew certification before this date to maintain offshore work eligibility.

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: The date when the crew member is scheduled to mobilize to the offshore facility or plant. Used for logistics planning and POB forecasting.

attributes.name: mobilization_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the crew member physically arrived and checked in at the facility. Marks the start of POB status.

attributes.name: muster_station_code
attributes.description: The designated emergency muster station assigned to this crew member on the facility. Critical for emergency response and evacuation procedures.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: The departure point or base location from which the crew member mobilizes (e.g., heliport, supply base, airport). Used for logistics coordination.

attributes.name: planned_rotation_days
attributes.description: The planned duration of this rotation in days (e.g., 14 days on, 21 days on). Defines the expected length of the assignment.

attributes.name: pob_status
attributes.description: Current POB status indicating whether the crew member is physically on the facility, off-board, or in transit. Critical for emergency muster and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: rotation_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying which rotation cycle this assignment represents for the crew member at this facility. Used for tracking rotation history.

attributes.name: simops_clearance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crew member has received clearance and training for SIMOPS activities. Required when multiple operations occur concurrently on the facility.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The primary mode of transportation used for mobilization and demobilization. Critical for logistics planning and safety compliance.

attributes.name: visa_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the work visa or permit required for this assignment. Monitored to ensure continuous legal work authorization.

attributes.name: visa_work_permit_cleared_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required visa and work permit clearances have been obtained for this assignment. Must be true before mobilization for international operations.

products.name: pob_record
products.description: Transactional Personnel on Board (POB) record capturing the real-time and historical headcount at each offshore facility, FPSO, or drilling rig. Records facility ID, date, shift, total POB count, breakdown by role category, muster station assignments, emergency contact details, and helideck manifest reference. Mandatory for BSEE offshore safety compliance and emergency response.
products.reference: BSEE 30 CFR Part 250 / SEMS II Personnel Accountability

attributes.name: pob_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Personnel on Board record. Primary key for the POB record entity.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the offshore facility, FPSO (Floating Production Storage and Offloading), drilling rig, or platform where personnel are located.

attributes.name: recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who recorded or certified this POB count, typically the offshore installation manager or designated safety officer.

attributes.name: bop_certified_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel certified to operate BOP (Blowout Preventer) systems. Mandatory for drilling operations.

attributes.name: catering_crew_count
attributes.description: Number of catering, housekeeping, and support services personnel on board.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding this POB record, including explanations for unusual headcount, operational changes, or safety incidents.

attributes.name: contractor_count
attributes.description: Number of third-party contractor personnel on board. Critical for joint venture billing and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance tracking.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this POB record. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POB record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: drilling_crew_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel assigned to drilling operations, including drillers, roughnecks, and drilling supervisors.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency contact details for all personnel on board have been verified and are current.

attributes.name: employee_count
attributes.description: Number of direct company employees on board, excluding contractors and visitors.

attributes.name: h2s_qualified_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel on board who hold current H2S (Hydrogen Sulfide) safety certification. Critical for sour gas operations.
attributes.references: API RP 55 Safe Operations in H2S Environments

attributes.name: helideck_manifest_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this POB record to the helideck flight manifest for personnel transport tracking.

attributes.name: hse_personnel_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Personnel Count
attributes.description: Number of dedicated HSE personnel, safety officers, and medics on board.

attributes.name: joint_venture_partner_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel representing joint venture partners or non-operating interest holders. Relevant for JOA (Joint Operating Agreement) cost allocation.

attributes.name: lifeboat_capacity
attributes.description: Total lifeboat and life raft capacity available on the facility. Must meet or exceed total POB count per SOLAS regulations.

attributes.name: maintenance_crew_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel assigned to maintenance, inspection, and repair activities.

attributes.name: management_count
attributes.description: Number of management, supervisory, and administrative personnel on board.

attributes.name: max_pob_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum authorized personnel capacity for the facility as defined in the safety case and facility design specifications.

attributes.name: medical_personnel_on_board_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether qualified medical personnel (medic, paramedic, or physician) are present on the facility.
attributes.references: OSHA Medical Services and First Aid Requirements

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this POB record. Audit trail field for tracking changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POB record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking amendments and corrections.

attributes.name: muster_station_assignments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured reference to muster station assignments for emergency evacuation. Critical for emergency response and BSEE compliance.

attributes.name: offshore_survival_certified_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel with current offshore survival and sea safety training (BOSIET, HUET, or equivalent).

attributes.name: operational_mode
attributes.description: Current operational mode of the facility at the time of POB recording. Determines manning requirements and safety protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: normal|drilling|completion|workover|maintenance|shutdown|emergency — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: API RP 75 Safety and Environmental Management

attributes.name: pob_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this POB count and manifest is recorded. Critical for daily compliance reporting and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: pob_record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the POB record. Active records represent current headcount; archived records are historical; amended records have been corrected; cancelled records are voided.

attributes.name: production_crew_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel assigned to production operations, including operators, technicians, and production supervisors.

attributes.name: recording_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this POB record was captured or submitted. Represents the business event time for compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: regulatory_inspector_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether BSEE, BOEM, or other regulatory inspectors are present on the facility during this POB period.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The work shift or rotation schedule during which this POB count was recorded. Supports SIMOPS (Simultaneous Operations) crew coordination and offshore manning requirements.

attributes.name: simops_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether SIMOPS (Simultaneous Operations) are being conducted, requiring enhanced crew coordination and safety measures.

attributes.name: total_pob_count
attributes.description: Total headcount of all personnel present on the facility at the time of recording. Mandatory for BSEE offshore safety compliance and emergency muster verification.

attributes.name: visitor_count
attributes.description: Number of visitors, auditors, inspectors, or other non-operational personnel on board.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather condition at the time of POB recording. Impacts evacuation planning and personnel safety protocols.

attributes.name: well_control_certified_count
attributes.description: Number of personnel holding current well control certification (IWCF or equivalent).

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Transactional record of each formal employee performance evaluation cycle, capturing review period, reviewer ID, reviewee ID, overall performance rating, individual KPI scores, competency ratings, development goals, promotion recommendation flag, merit increase eligibility, and review completion date. Supports annual performance management and succession planning processes.

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance review record. Primary key for the performance review entity.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee being reviewed (reviewee). Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the employee conducting the review (typically direct supervisor or manager). Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: bonus_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for performance bonus or incentive compensation based on review results. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: collaboration_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employee's ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, support SIMOPS coordination, contribute to joint venture partnerships, and foster collaborative work environment.

attributes.name: collaboration_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for collaboration and teamwork assessment.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the system user who created the performance review record. Audit trail field for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was initially created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance.

attributes.name: development_goals
attributes.description: Narrative description of professional development goals and objectives established for the employee for the upcoming review period. May include training requirements, skill development targets, certification goals, and career progression milestones.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee acknowledged receipt and review of their performance evaluation. Required for compliance and documentation purposes.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Self-assessment comments and feedback provided by the employee regarding their own performance, accomplishments, challenges faced, and development needs.

attributes.name: goals_achieved_count
attributes.description: Number of individual performance goals or objectives successfully achieved during the review period. Used to calculate goal attainment percentage.

attributes.name: goals_total_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual performance goals or objectives set for the employee during the review period.

attributes.name: hr_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the HR department reviewed and approved the performance review. Part of the review governance and quality assurance process.

attributes.name: hse_performance_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employee's adherence to HSE policies, safety protocols, incident prevention, environmental stewardship, and contribution to safety culture. Critical metric in oil and gas operations.

attributes.name: hse_performance_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Score
attributes.description: Numeric score for HSE performance assessment. Weighted heavily in oil and gas performance evaluations due to industry safety criticality.

attributes.name: improvement_areas_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of areas where the employee needs improvement, skill gaps identified, and constructive feedback for performance enhancement.

attributes.name: leadership_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employee's leadership capabilities, including team management, decision-making, strategic thinking, and ability to influence and develop others. Not applicable for individual contributor roles without leadership responsibilities.

attributes.name: leadership_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for leadership competency assessment. Null for roles without leadership responsibilities.

attributes.name: merit_increase_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for a merit-based salary increase based on performance rating. True if eligible, False otherwise. Drives compensation planning decisions.

attributes.name: merit_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Recommended percentage increase in base salary as a merit award based on performance. Null if no merit increase is recommended. Confidential compensation data.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or username of the system user who last modified the performance review record. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking changes and data lineage.

attributes.name: operational_excellence_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employee's contribution to operational efficiency, process optimization, cost management, production targets, and continuous improvement initiatives.

attributes.name: operational_excellence_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for operational excellence assessment. Reflects contribution to OPEX reduction, production optimization, and operational KPIs.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Summary performance rating assigned to the employee for the review period. Represents the holistic assessment of employee performance against expectations and objectives.

attributes.name: overall_rating_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the overall performance rating on a standardized scale (typically 1.00 to 5.00). Used for quantitative analysis and compensation decisions.

attributes.name: pip_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Performance Improvement Plan is required due to unsatisfactory performance. True if PIP is mandated, False otherwise.

attributes.name: promotion_recommended_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reviewer recommends the employee for promotion based on performance during the review period. True if promotion is recommended, False otherwise.

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance review was finalized and all approvals were obtained. Marks the official completion of the review cycle.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period being assessed. Marks the conclusion of the review cycle.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period being assessed. Typically the beginning of the fiscal year or the date following the previous review.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the performance review. Tracks the review through its lifecycle from draft creation to final completion and approval.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance review cycle. Indicates whether this is an annual review, mid-year check-in, probationary period assessment, project-based evaluation, ad-hoc review, or promotion evaluation.

attributes.name: reviewer_comments
attributes.description: Detailed narrative comments and observations provided by the reviewer regarding the employee's performance, achievements, challenges, and overall contribution during the review period.

attributes.name: strengths_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the employee's key strengths, exceptional contributions, and areas of excellence demonstrated during the review period.

attributes.name: succession_planning_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has been identified as a candidate for succession planning and leadership pipeline development. True if identified for succession planning, False otherwise.

attributes.name: technical_competency_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of the employee's technical skills and job-specific competencies relevant to their role (e.g., drilling operations, reservoir engineering, process safety, refinery operations).

attributes.name: technical_competency_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for technical competency assessment on a standardized scale. Supports weighted performance calculations.

products.name: payroll_record
products.description: Transactional payroll and compensation record for each employee pay period, capturing gross pay, net pay, base salary, overtime hours and pay, shift differentials (offshore allowance, hazard pay), deductions (tax, pension, health insurance), allowances (housing, transport, expatriate), payroll period, payment date, bank account reference, and SAP payroll document number. Includes benefit enrollment details: benefit plan type (medical, dental, vision, pension, life insurance, disability), coverage tier, premium amount, employer and employee contributions, effective and termination dates, and benefit provider reference. Serves as the SSOT for total compensation, labor cost actuals, and benefits administration.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Payroll / COPAS Labor Cost Standards

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each payroll record. Primary key for the payroll transaction.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee receiving this payroll payment.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch payroll run that generated this record, used for grouping and reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the employee bank account used for direct deposit. Full account number stored in secure vault.

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The base salary or hourly wage component for the pay period, excluding overtime and allowances.

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Performance-based bonus, safety bonus, production incentive, or other discretionary payments included in this payroll cycle.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center to which this payroll expense is allocated for financial reporting and OPEX tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payroll record was initially created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record.

attributes.name: disability_insurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of short-term or long-term disability insurance premium deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: expatriate_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Special allowance for employees on international assignments covering cost-of-living adjustments, hardship, and relocation support.

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Federal income tax withheld from gross pay per IRS withholding tables and employee W-4 elections.

attributes.name: garnishment_amount
attributes.description: Court-ordered wage garnishment for child support, tax liens, or other legal obligations deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total gross compensation before any deductions, including base salary, overtime, allowances, and bonuses.

attributes.name: hazard_pay_amount
attributes.description: Additional compensation for employees working in hazardous environments such as H2S zones, high-pressure operations, or SIMOPS scenarios.

attributes.name: health_insurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of health insurance premium deducted from gross pay for medical, dental, and vision coverage.

attributes.name: housing_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Allowance provided to employees for housing expenses, common for expatriate assignments or remote field locations.

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code for the employee role during this pay period, used for labor cost analysis and workforce planning.

attributes.name: life_insurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of life insurance premium deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of Medicare tax withheld from gross pay.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payroll record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: Final take-home pay after all deductions, representing the amount deposited to employee bank account or issued as check.

attributes.name: offshore_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Allowance paid to employees working on offshore platforms, rigs, or FPSO vessels to compensate for remote and hazardous working conditions.

attributes.name: other_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Miscellaneous deductions including charitable contributions, loan repayments, or other voluntary withholdings.

attributes.name: overtime_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked during the pay period, subject to premium pay rates.

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total overtime compensation paid for hours worked beyond standard work schedule.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payroll payment was issued or deposited to the employee.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee.

attributes.name: payroll_document_number
attributes.description: SAP payroll document number or external payroll system reference identifier for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: payroll_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

attributes.name: payroll_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the pay period covered by this payroll record.

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this payroll record in the payroll workflow lifecycle.

attributes.name: pension_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee contribution to defined benefit pension plan or 401(k) retirement savings plan deducted from gross pay.

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of regular (non-overtime) hours worked during the pay period.

attributes.name: shift_differential_amount
attributes.description: Premium pay for employees working non-standard shifts such as night shifts, rotating shifts, or 24/7 operations common in refining and production facilities.

attributes.name: social_security_tax_amount
attributes.description: Employee portion of Social Security (FICA) tax withheld from gross pay.

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: State income tax withheld from gross pay per state tax regulations.

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions including taxes, benefits, and other withholdings subtracted from gross pay.

attributes.name: transport_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Allowance for transportation costs including commuting, helicopter transport to offshore rigs, or company vehicle usage.

attributes.name: union_dues_amount
attributes.description: Union membership dues deducted from gross pay per collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary work location for this pay period such as offshore platform, refinery, field office, or drilling rig.

attributes.name: year_to_date_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay for the employee from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period, used for tax reporting.

attributes.name: year_to_date_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative federal and state tax withheld for the employee from the beginning of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period.

products.name: labor_cost_allocation
products.description: Transactional record allocating employee and contractor labor costs to specific cost objects including wells (AFE), projects, cost centers, joint venture partners (JIB), and production sharing agreements. Captures employee or contractor ID, pay period, hours worked, cost rate, total cost, allocation percentage, WBS element, AFE number, JV partner share, and SAP CO document reference. Supports LOE tracking and JIB cost allocation per COPAS standards.
products.reference: COPAS Model Form Accounting Procedure / SAP CO-PA

attributes.name: labor_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor cost allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (platform, plant, terminal) for which labor costs are allocated. Used for facility operations and maintenance.

attributes.name: contractor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor whose labor cost is being allocated. Nullable when allocation is for an employee.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee whose labor cost is being allocated. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: original_allocation_labor_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original labor cost allocation record that this record reverses or adjusts. Nullable for original allocations.

attributes.name: psa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production sharing agreement under which labor costs are allocated. Used for international operations with host governments.

attributes.name: well_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the well asset for which labor costs are being allocated. Used for production operations and well maintenance activities.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Type of work activity performed during the allocated hours. Used for activity-based costing and operational analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Drilling|Completion|Production|Maintenance|Construction|Engineering|HSE|Administrative — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: AFE number for well or drilling project to which labor costs are allocated. Primary cost tracking mechanism for capital drilling and completion activities.

attributes.name: allocated_cost_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total labor cost allocated to this cost object, calculated as total cost multiplied by allocation percentage.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor cost allocation was posted to the accounting system. Represents the business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the labor cost allocation transaction. Externally visible reference number used in reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total labor cost allocated to this specific cost object. Used when labor is split across multiple cost objects.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the labor cost allocation record. Tracks the approval and posting workflow.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor cost allocation was approved by the authorized manager or cost controller.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who approved the labor cost allocation. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Business area or segment (e.g., Upstream, Midstream, Downstream) to which the labor cost is allocated. Used for segment reporting.

attributes.name: capitalized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labor cost is capitalized (CAPEX) or expensed (OPEX). Determines financial statement treatment and depreciation.

attributes.name: co_document_number
attributes.description: SAP CO document number generated when the allocation was posted. Provides audit trail to source financial transaction.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes regarding the labor cost allocation. Used for explanations, justifications, or special instructions.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity incurring the labor cost. Used for statutory reporting and intercompany reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which labor costs are allocated. Used for operational expense (OPEX) tracking and departmental cost management.

attributes.name: cost_object_type
attributes.description: Type of cost object to which labor costs are being allocated. Determines the accounting treatment and reporting structure.

attributes.name: cost_rate
attributes.description: Hourly cost rate applied to calculate the total labor cost. Includes base wage plus burden (benefits, taxes, overhead).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the labor cost allocation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the labor cost allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which the labor cost allocation belongs. Used for annual budgeting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked by the employee or contractor during the pay period that are being allocated to the cost object.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Internal order number for specific work orders or maintenance activities. Used for tracking discrete operational tasks.

attributes.name: jv_partner_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the joint venture partner to whom a portion of labor costs should be billed. Used in Joint Interest Billing (JIB) processes.

attributes.name: jv_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage share of labor costs allocated to the joint venture partner based on working interest or production sharing agreement terms.

attributes.name: loe_category
attributes.description: Classification of labor cost within lease operating expense structure. Used for production cost analysis and SEC reporting.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the labor cost allocation record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the labor cost allocation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: offshore_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work was performed at an offshore location. Used for premium pay calculations and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked during the pay period, typically hours exceeding standard work schedule.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the pay period for which labor costs are being allocated.

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the pay period for which labor costs are being allocated.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (YYYYMM format) to which the labor cost allocation is posted. Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular hours worked during the pay period, excluding overtime and premium hours.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation record is a reversal of a previous allocation. Used for correction and adjustment tracking.

attributes.name: total_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost amount being allocated. Calculated as hours worked multiplied by cost rate.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element code for project-based cost allocation. Used for capital projects and major initiatives tracked in SAP PS module.

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the work was performed (e.g., rig name, platform, office, field). Used for geographic cost tracking and SIMOPS coordination.

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of each employee benefit plan enrollment, capturing benefit plan type (medical, dental, vision, pension, life insurance, disability), enrollment date, coverage tier (employee only, employee+spouse, family), premium amount, employer contribution, employee contribution, effective date, termination date, and benefit provider reference. Supports HR benefits administration.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each benefit enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific benefit plan in which the employee is enrolling. Links to the benefit plan master record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who is enrolling in the benefit plan. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Administrative approval status for the enrollment, particularly for special enrollments or qualifying life events that require HR review and documentation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment was approved by HR or the system. Nullable if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the HR representative or system user who approved the enrollment. Nullable if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan being enrolled in. Classifies the type of coverage or benefit provided to the employee. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability|pension|retirement_401k|hsa|fsa — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: benefit_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or benefit provider administering the plan. Used for claims processing and provider coordination.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Individual certificate of coverage number issued to the employee by the benefit provider. Unique identifier for the employees coverage under the group policy.

attributes.name: cobra_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of employment. True if eligible, False otherwise.
attributes.references: COBRA Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act

attributes.name: cobra_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Start Date
attributes.description: Date when COBRA continuation coverage begins if the employee elects to continue coverage after employment termination. Nullable if not applicable.
attributes.references: COBRA Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which premium contributions are deducted from employee pay and remitted to the benefit provider. Aligns with payroll cycle.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the employer benefit contribution expense is allocated. Used for financial reporting and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee, indicating who is covered under the benefit plan (employee only, employee plus dependents, or full family).

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person or system process that created this enrollment record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this enrollment record. Supports multi-currency payroll operations.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this benefit enrollment. Used for premium calculation and coverage tier validation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage terminates or expires. Nullable for ongoing enrollments. Marks the end of the coverage period.
attributes.references: ERISA Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit coverage becomes active and the employee is eligible to use the benefit. Marks the beginning of the coverage period.
attributes.references: ERISA Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount deducted from the employee paycheck for the benefit premium per pay period. Represents the employee-funded portion of the benefit cost.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount contributed by the employer toward the benefit premium per pay period. Represents the company-funded portion of the benefit cost.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the benefit enrollment election. Represents the business event timestamp for this enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the employee submitted the benefit enrollment election. Tracks enrollment process efficiency.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique enrollment confirmation number provided to the employee for reference and tracking purposes.

attributes.name: enrollment_period_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment period during which the employee made the election. Determines eligibility and timing rules for the enrollment.
attributes.references: ERISA Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Tracks the enrollment from initial submission through active coverage to termination.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person or system process that last modified this enrollment record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this enrollment record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates and changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the enrollment, including special circumstances, documentation requirements, or administrative actions taken.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy or contract number assigned by the benefit provider for this enrollment. Used for claims submission and provider communication.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount for the benefit plan coverage per pay period. Represents the full cost of the benefit before employer and employee contribution split.

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualifying life event occurred that allowed the employee to enroll outside the standard enrollment period. Nullable if not applicable.
attributes.references: HIPAA Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: Type of qualifying life event that triggered a special enrollment period outside of the standard open enrollment window. Nullable if not applicable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|birth|adoption|divorce|death|loss_of_coverage|employment_change — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HIPAA Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment was formally terminated, either by employee action, employment termination, or administrative action. May differ from effective_end_date.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the benefit enrollment was terminated. Used for benefits administration analysis and compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employee_resignation|employment_termination|plan_change|life_event|cost|retirement|death — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: COBRA Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee explicitly waived or declined this benefit offering. True if waived, False if enrolled.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the employee for waiving or declining the benefit. Nullable if waiver_flag is False. Used for benefits strategy analysis.

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Transactional record of each employee leave request and approval, capturing leave type (annual, sick, maternity/paternity, offshore rotation leave, R&R, emergency, unpaid, FMLA), requested start date, end date, number of days, approval status, approver ID, leave balance before and after, and SAP absence document reference. Supports crew rotation planning, offshore manning gap analysis, and ensures minimum manning levels are maintained during leave periods.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved or rejected the leave request. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility, rig, or offshore platform from which the employee is taking leave. Relevant for offshore rotation leave and manning gap analysis. Null for onshore employees.

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: actual_days_taken
attributes.description: The actual number of leave days taken, which may differ from the requested number due to early return, extension, or partial-day adjustments.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual last date the employee was absent, which may differ from the requested end date due to early return or extended leave.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual first date the employee was absent, which may differ from the requested start date due to operational changes or early departure.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: The AFE number to which labor costs during the leave period are charged, particularly relevant for project-based or joint venture operations.
attributes.references: COPAS Accounting Guidelines, Joint Venture Accounting

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the leave request was approved or rejected by the approver.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes related to the leave request, entered by the employee, approver, or HR administrator.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center to which the employee's leave time and any associated costs (e.g., replacement labor) are allocated for financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or user ID of the person who created the leave request record (typically the employee or an HR administrator acting on their behalf).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the leave request record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: hse_clearance_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Clearance Date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee received HSE medical clearance to return to work following leave. Null if clearance is not required or not yet obtained.

attributes.name: hse_clearance_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Clearance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HSE medical clearance or fitness-for-duty assessment is required before the employee returns from leave (True) or not (False). Typically required for extended sick leave or offshore rotation leave.

attributes.name: leave_balance_after
attributes.description: The employee's remaining leave balance (in days) for the specified leave type after this request is approved and deducted. Used for balance tracking and future leave eligibility checks.

attributes.name: leave_balance_before
attributes.description: The employee's available leave balance (in days) for the specified leave type immediately before this request was approved. Used for audit trail and balance reconciliation.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave request: annual leave, sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, offshore rotation leave, rest and recuperation (R&R), emergency leave, unpaid leave, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) leave, or bereavement leave. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|sick|maternity|paternity|offshore_rotation|r_and_r|emergency|unpaid|fmla|bereavement — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR, FMLA 29 USC 2601, Company HR Policy

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or user ID of the person who last modified the leave request record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the leave request record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: number_of_days
attributes.description: Total number of leave days requested, including partial days (e.g., 5.5 days for half-day leave). Calculated based on working days excluding weekends and public holidays.
attributes.references: Company HR Policy, SAP Time Management

attributes.name: offshore_rotation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request is part of a scheduled offshore rotation cycle (True) or ad-hoc leave (False). Used for crew rotation planning and SIMOPS coordination.

attributes.name: pay_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request impacts the employee's pay (True for unpaid leave or leave without sufficient balance) or is fully paid (False).

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when rejecting a leave request. Null if the request was approved.

attributes.name: replacement_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temporary replacement or backfill is required to maintain minimum manning levels during the leave period (True) or not (False). Critical for offshore operations and HSE compliance.
attributes.references: Offshore Manning Requirements, HSE Minimum Manning Standards

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee submitted the leave request.

attributes.name: request_reason
attributes.description: Optional free-text explanation provided by the employee describing the reason for the leave request (e.g., personal travel, medical appointment, family emergency).

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the leave request: draft (not yet submitted), submitted (awaiting review), pending approval (under manager review), approved (granted), rejected (denied), cancelled (system cancelled), or withdrawn (employee retracted). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|pending_approval|approved|rejected|cancelled|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the requested leave period.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the requested leave period.

attributes.name: sap_absence_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP HR absence document reference number generated upon leave request submission or approval in SAP S/4HANA HCM.

products.name: mobilization_event
products.description: Transactional record of each personnel mobilization or demobilization event for offshore, remote, or international assignments. Captures employee or contractor ID, origin location, destination facility (rig, FPSO, platform, plant), transport mode (helicopter, vessel, commercial flight), mobilization date and time, demobilization date, visa and work permit status, medical fitness clearance date, and Enablon HSE induction completion flag.
products.reference: BSEE Offshore Personnel Tracking / SEMS II

attributes.name: mobilization_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each personnel mobilization or demobilization event. Primary key for the mobilization event record.

attributes.name: asset_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target facility where personnel is being deployed. May be a rig, Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) vessel, offshore platform, onshore plant, refinery, or remote field location.

attributes.name: contractor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor being mobilized or demobilized. Links to the contractor master record for contingent workforce.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee being mobilized or demobilized. Links to the employee master record for permanent workforce.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time of arrival at the destination facility. Marks the official start of the work assignment for time tracking and labor cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: actual_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time of departure from the origin location. Captured for operational tracking, delay analysis, and Non-Productive Time (NPT) reporting.

attributes.name: afe_number
attributes.description: Authorization for Expenditure (AFE) number under which the mobilization and assignment costs are authorized and tracked. Used for Joint Interest Billing (JIB) and partner cost allocation in joint ventures.

attributes.name: assignment_duration_days
attributes.description: Planned or actual number of days the personnel is assigned to the destination facility. Common rotation schedules include 14/14, 21/21, 28/28 (days on/days off) for offshore operations.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the mobilization event costs and subsequent labor costs will be charged. Used for Lease Operating Expense (LOE) tracking and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) versus Operating Expenditure (OPEX) allocation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the mobilization event record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mobilization event record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the personnel is scheduled to or did depart from the work assignment and return to origin. Used for rotation planning and crew replacement scheduling.

attributes.name: destination_facility_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the destination facility. Includes rig name, platform designation, FPSO vessel name, or plant name for operational reference.

attributes.name: destination_facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination facility type. Determines applicable Health Safety and Environment (HSE) requirements, manning standards, and logistical protocols. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: offshore_platform|fpso|drilling_rig|onshore_plant|refinery|petrochemical_plant|pipeline_station|remote_field_site|support_vessel — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Facility Classification

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mobilization event. Tracks the progression from planning through execution to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|confirmed|in_transit|completed|cancelled|delayed|aborted — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the personnel movement event. Mobilization indicates deployment to a work location; demobilization indicates return from assignment; rotation change indicates scheduled crew rotation; emergency evacuation indicates unplanned removal due to safety incident; medical evacuation indicates removal for health reasons; crew change indicates routine personnel swap during Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS).

attributes.name: flight_vessel_number
attributes.description: Flight number, vessel name, or helicopter tail number used for the transport leg. Enables tracking and coordination with transport operations.

attributes.name: h2s_training_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the H2S training certification expires. Typically valid for 2-3 years depending on jurisdiction and company policy.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Hazard Communication Standard

attributes.name: h2s_training_status
attributes.description: Current status of Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) awareness and safety training certification. Required for personnel working in sour gas environments where H2S exposure risk exists.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Hazard Communication Standard

attributes.name: hse_induction_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Induction Completion Date
attributes.description: Date when the site-specific HSE induction training was completed. Recorded in Enablon HSE Management system for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: hse_induction_completion_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Induction Completion Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the personnel has completed the mandatory Health Safety and Environment (HSE) site-specific induction training for the destination facility. Required before personnel can commence work.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date when medical fitness clearance was granted by occupational health physician. Establishes the baseline for fitness validity period.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the medical fitness clearance expires and re-examination is required. Typically annual or biennial depending on age, role, and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: medical_fitness_status
attributes.description: Current medical fitness clearance status for the work assignment. Offshore and remote assignments typically require medical examination to ensure personnel can safely perform duties and respond to emergencies.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Medical Surveillance Standard

attributes.name: mobilization_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the mobilization event, including transportation, accommodation, per diem, and administrative costs. Captured for cost tracking and Joint Interest Billing (JIB) allocation.
attributes.references: Council of Petroleum Accountants Societies (COPAS) Accounting Guidelines

attributes.name: mobilization_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the mobilization cost amount. Required for multi-currency operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the mobilization event record. Used for audit trail and change accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mobilization event record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: offshore_survival_training_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the offshore survival training certification expires. Typically valid for 4 years; personnel cannot mobilize offshore with expired certification.
attributes.references: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Training Requirements

attributes.name: offshore_survival_training_status
attributes.description: Current status of offshore survival and emergency response training certification. Mandatory for personnel mobilizing to offshore platforms, rigs, and Floating Production Storage and Offloading (FPSO) vessels. Includes Basic Offshore Safety Induction and Emergency Training (BOSIET) or equivalent.
attributes.references: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement (BSEE) Training Requirements

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin location. Used for visa, work permit, and cross-border labor regulation compliance.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Departure location for the mobilization event. May be a city, airport code, heliport, or facility name from which the personnel is departing.

attributes.name: ptw_authorization_level
attributes.description: Level of Permit to Work (PTW) authorization granted to the personnel for the destination facility. Determines what types of work permits the individual can request, issue, or approve. Critical for Management of Change (MOC) and safe work execution.

products.name: plan
products.description: Master record for workforce planning and succession planning cycles at the business unit or department level. Captures planning period (annual/quarterly), org unit, planned headcount by job family and grade, current headcount, gap analysis (surplus/deficit), planned hires, planned attrition, CAPEX/OPEX labor budget, and plan approval status. Includes succession planning for critical positions: target position, incumbent employee, identified successors (primary and secondary), succession readiness rating (Ready Now / Ready in 1-2 Years / Ready in 3-5 Years), development actions required, and talent pool category. Supports strategic workforce planning, rig manning forecasts, and leadership pipeline management for safety-critical roles (OIM, Plant Manager, Chief Drilling Engineer).
